title: Medical Biller and Coder
description: Medical Biller and Coder Interview Process: Candidates selected to move forward will complete a written exercise, followed by two rounds of interviews. About Clarity Works Clarity Works helps medical practices recover revenue, reduce billing delays, work denials, and improve revenue cycle performance. We are looking for an experienced Medical Biller and Coder who can manage complex billing workflows, own client work, and help create cleaner, repeatable processes. Role Overview This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone with at least 7 years of medical billing and coding experience, preferably in a senior, lead, or supervisory role. The right candidate is a self-starter who can work in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction. This person must be able to create claims from scratch, not just work existing claims. They should be comfortable owning assigned clients, identifying problems, working through billing issues, and documenting processes clearly. Responsibilities * Create, review, correct, and submit medical claims * Build claims from scratch using documentation, codes, payer rules, and billing requirements * Work denials, rejections, underpayments, and aged A/R * Review documentation and assign or validate appropriate codes * Identify billing, coding, payer, and workflow issues * Follow up with payers on claim status, denials, and payment issues * Review EOBs, ERAs, and payer correspondence * Support payment posting and account reconciliation when needed * Own assigned client workflows and communicate updates, blockers, and next steps * Problem-solve issues independently before escalating * Create SOPs for new systems, workflows, and client-specific processes * Work across different EHR, PM, clearinghouse, and payer portal systems * Help improve internal billing processes as the company grows Requirements * Minimum 7 years of medical billing and coding experience * Prior experience in a senior, lead, or high-responsibility billing role preferred * Strong denial management and A/R follow-up experience * Ability to create claims from scratch, not just correct or resubmit existing claims * Experience working in multiple EHR, PM, clearinghouse, and payer portal systems * Strong understanding of claim submission, coding, payer rules, EOBs, ERAs, and reimbursement workflows * Ability to work independently with minimal direction * Comfortable owning client work and taking initiative * Able to work in a fast-paced environment * Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented * Strong written and verbal English communication skills * Comfortable creating SOPs and documenting processes * Detail-oriented, reliable, and accountable Preferred Experience * Certified coder preferred, but not required with strong experience * Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers * Experience supporting multiple specialties * Experience working in a billing company, RCM company, or multi-client environment * Experience training or supporting other billers Schedule Part-time in the beginning with move to full time eventually What We Are Looking For We are looking for a seasoned biller and coder who can take ownership, move quickly, problem-solve, and manage client work without constant oversight. This role is best for someone who has already handled complex billing environments and does not need beginner-level training.

title: Etsy Listing & Mockup VA (10-15+hrs/a week)

Also, have you used Photopea and/or Canva ? How quickly can you typically turn around a batch of listings?

title: Pet Ecommerce Growth Specialist (Paid Media / Retention)
job_title: Pet Ecommerce Growth Specialist (Paid Media / Retention)
description: We're building out a marketing agency division dedicated entirely to pet ecommerce brands — DTC pet food, treats, supplements, and accessories. We're not a generalist shop trying to figure out this category; we're specializing in it, and we're looking for someone who's already lived in it. This is a specialist role, not a generalist ecommerce VA position. You'll be running real paid media budgets and retention programs for pet brand clients, and your existing experience in this specific category is the reason we're hiring you — not something you'll learn on the job. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Build, manage, and optimize Meta Ads campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, creative testing) for pet ecommerce clients - Manage Google Ads / Shopping / Performance Max campaigns - Run TikTok Ads and TikTok Shop campaigns - Build and optimize retention flows (Klaviyo, Postscript, or similar) — pet is a subscription and repeat purchase heavy category - Monitor and report on CAC, ROAS, and subscriber/LTV metrics (GA4, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar) - Advise on omnichannel strategy where relevant (Amazon, Chewy, DTC) REQUIRED: - Real, hands-on experience running paid media and/or retention for pet ecommerce brands specifically (not general consumer products) — this is non-negotiable - A portfolio showing actual campaigns: platforms used, budgets managed, real performance numbers (ROAS, CAC, revenue growth) - Solid Shopify platform fluency - Strong written English STRONGLY PREFERRED: - Existing relationships or network within the pet DTC/ecommerce space - Experience with subscription/LTV-driven brands (churn management) - Familiarity with post-iOS14 tracking (CAPI setup, modeled conversions) TO APPLY: Start your application with the word "KIBBLE" on the first line, or it won't be reviewed. Include your resume, your portfolio (required — must show real pet ecommerce campaign numbers), any existing network in the pet ecommerce space, and your availability/preferred hours (need US time zone overlap for client calls). APPLICATION QUESTION: Pick one pet ecommerce campaign from your portfolio — what were the actual numbers (spend, ROAS, CAC, or revenue), and what would you do differently if you ran it again today?

title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator

More than a travel company, we create experiences that bring women together, inspire confidence, and foster lifelong friendships. This role is responsible for creating, editing, and publishing engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Required Software Applicants should be experienced with most of the following: Canva Pro (must) CapCut (must) Adobe Premiere Pro (preferred) Adobe Photoshop (must) Meta Business Suite YouTube Studio Google Drive ChatGPT (or other AI tools for content ideation and workflow support) Vista Social How to Apply To be considered, please submit the following: Include the keyword LSF Social Media in your application subject line. A link to your Google Drive portfolio showcasing your previous work, or examples of social media content you've created (Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube videos, graphics, carousel posts, thumbnails, etc.). Your resume. Applications submitted without a portfolio or work samples will not be considered.

title: SuiteDash Implementation Consultant
description: Part-Time SuiteDash Implementation Consultant / Solutions Specialist We are looking for an experienced SuiteDash Implementation Consultant / Solutions Specialist to work with us on a part-time, ongoing basis. This is a hands-on configuration and implementation role. We need someone who understands SuiteDash deeply and can take business requirements and translate them into a well-designed, maintainable SuiteDash implementation. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING You will configure and support SuiteDash environments for our company and our clients. Responsibilities may include: - Client and staff portals - CRM configuration and contact management - Custom fields and data organization - Client onboarding processes - Staff onboarding processes - Projects, project templates, tasks, and task dependencies - FLOWs and automated onboarding sequences - Automations and triggers - Dynamic data placeholders - Forms and Kickoff Forms - Scheduling and appointment configuration - Email templates and automated email sequences - Secure messaging - File and folder management - Documents, proposals, contracts, and e-signatures - Estimates, invoices, subscriptions, and payment workflows - LMS and training content, where appropriate - Knowledge Base configuration - Roles, permissions, and access controls - Custom menus, portal pages, dashboards, and branding - Reports, exports, and administrative workflows - Integrations with external applications, where required - Troubleshooting existing SuiteDash configurations - Reviewing and improving existing SuiteDash implementations You should be comfortable building both relatively simple client portals and more sophisticated systems involving multiple workflows, automations, user roles, projects, forms, and business processes. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You must have substantial hands-on SuiteDash experience. We're specifically looking for someone who can independently configure SuiteDash, rather than someone who has simply used SuiteDash as an end user. You should be able to: - Take a description of a business process and determine how it should be implemented in SuiteDash - Recommend the appropriate use of Projects, FLOWs, Automations, Forms, CRM features, and other SuiteDash components - Build the implementation yourself - Test workflows from the perspective of clients, staff, and administrators - Identify edge cases and potential workflow problems - Document what you build - Explain the configuration clearly to technical and non-technical team members - Troubleshoot automations and workflows that are not behaving as expected REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Applicants should have experience implementing several of the following in SuiteDash: - CRM - Projects - FLOWs - Automations - Custom Fields - Forms - Client Portals - Staff Portals - Scheduling - Email and messaging - Documents and e-signatures - Billing and invoicing - LMS - Knowledge Base - Permissions and roles - Custom dashboards and pages - External integrations Preference will be given to candidates who have built complete SuiteDash environments from initial requirements through production deployment. IMPORTANT This is not a general virtual assistant position, and it is not a role for someone who is looking to learn SuiteDash on the job. We are looking for someone who already knows the platform well enough to make implementation decisions and work independently. ENGAGEMENT - Part-time - Remote - Ongoing work - Hours will vary depending on active client projects - Some projects will involve building a SuiteDash environment from scratch - Other assignments will involve enhancing, troubleshooting, or maintaining existing implementations There may also be opportunities to participate in requirements gathering and help design client solutions before implementation begins. TO APPLY Please provide: 1. A brief description of your SuiteDash experience. 2. How long you have been working with SuiteDash. 3. Examples of SuiteDash implementations you have completed. 4. The SuiteDash features you consider yourself most experienced with. 5. Any SuiteDash features you do not have significant experience with. 6. Your current availability and typical weekly capacity. 7. Your hourly rate. 8. Screenshots, videos, or other examples of SuiteDash implementations you have built, if you are permitted to share them. SCREENING QUESTION Please describe one of the most complex business processes you have implemented in SuiteDash. Explain which SuiteDash components you used—for example, FLOWs, Projects, Automations, Forms, Custom Fields, Documents, Scheduling, or CRM—and briefly explain why you structured the solution that way. We are particularly interested in your reasoning and SuiteDash architecture, not simply a list of features you have used.

title: Residential Director of Construction (Virtual)

infrastructure required for Supple Homes' continued growth What We're Looking For At least 10 years of progressive experience in residential construction, with significant experience in luxury or high-end custom homes Multiple years of experience directly managing Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, or construction teams Proven success overseeing multiple complex construction projects simultaneously Strong knowledge of the Bay Area luxury residential construction market Thorough understanding of California building codes, permitting, inspections, and construction practices title: Client Success Manager
description: About Us At ProfitWorks, we genuinely believe that our people are the heart of everything we do. We’ve focused on building a workplace that feels less like a corporate machine and more like a community, creating a space where you’re supported, heard, and actually excited to grow. We aren't big on empty promises and prefer to let our history speak for itself. We’re incredibly proud that two of our tea ---------- mbers have been with our founder for 13 years, while many others are nearing their 6th anniversary. It’s a steady, welcoming environment where people don’t just pass through, they stay and thrive. At ProfitWorks, we make sure our contractors can focus on what they do best by providing the security, support, and balance you deserve. To back that up, we offer a generous package including 80–120 hours of PTO, 7 paid holidays, 13th-month payroll, and life insurance up to ?100,000. Your well-being is a top priority, so we cover a paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan, your Annual Physical Exam (APE), mental health consultation reimbursements (up to ?20,000/year), and SSS, PhilHealth, or Pag-IBIG reimbursements. Beyond financial and health security, we invest directly in your career through a comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program, clear performance goals with advancement compensation, and opportunities for advancement after proof of mastery. If you’re looking for a team that prioritizes real connections, long-term stability, and continuous support, we’d love to hear from you. Come say hi and see if ProfitWorks is the right fit for you! Role Overview The Client Success Manager (CSM) serves as a vital strategic pillar bridging client relationship management, end-to-end talent acquisition, and operational service delivery. Working in close alignment with the CEO, the CSM translates company vision into actionable operational and growth strategies. The CSM takes full accountability for managing the entire client lifecycle—from identifying high-value prospects, conducting initial discovery calls, and crafting tailored proposals, to overseeing offshore candidate screening, recruitment, and seamless onboarding. Beyond initial integration, the CSM acts as the primary client liaison, proactively managing client concerns, leading cross-functional teams (including Recruitment, HR, and Operations), and enforcing service quality through continuous performance monitoring, daily End-of-Shift reporting, and KPI tracking. By combining strategic workforce planning with hands-on process optimization, the CSM ensures exceptional service delivery, drives long-term client retention, and unlocks sustainable account growth across ProfitWorks' accounting and staffing solutions. Key Responsibilities 1. Client Engagement, Relationship & Account Growth Lead discovery calls and business development conversations with prospects to understand hiring, accounting, and operational requirements. Manage the full client journey, acting as the primary point of contact for all client inquiries, feedback, and strategic account planning. Foster long-term relationships and drive client retention through proactive communication, regular workforce alignment, and exceptional service delivery. Support proposal development, agreement management, and account expansion opportunities with existing U.S. clients. 2. End-to-End Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Partner directly with clients to define staffing needs, draft custom job profiles, and establish recruitment timelines. Oversee recruitment and candidate screening workflows alongside internal sourcing teams to match top-tier offshore talent to client requirements. Facilitate seamless onboarding, system integration, and task handoffs between clients and placed offshore contractors. 3. Performance Monitoring, Quality Assurance & Operations Establish, track, and analyze client and team KPIs, daily reports, and End-of-Shift summaries to evaluate performance. Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, performance gaps, or service friction points, delivering data-driven solutions and process improvements. Utilize project management tools (e.g., ClickUp, HubStaff, Time Doctor) to manage workload distribution, task execution, and team productivity. 4. Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Coordination Collaborate closely across internal units—including Recruitment, HR, Operations, and Virtual Support teams—to ensure complete alignment with client expectations. Lead internal syncs and alignment meetings to streamline communication, share feedback, and resolve challenges. Provide coaching, support, and guidance to tea ---------- mbers to maintain high service quality and continuous professional growth. What We’re Looking For Experience & Expertise Experience: 3–5+ years in Account Management, Client Success, Operations Management, or offshore talent delivery. U.S. Market Experience: Demonstrated background working directly with U.S.-based business owners, executives, or offshore staffing models. Domain Context: Prior exposure to accounting/finance, construction, home services, mortgage, or non-tech client services is a strong advantage. Skills & Tool Proficiency Project & Ops Management: Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Time Doctor, Google Workspace, and MS Office. Recruitment & Sourcing: Solid grasp of end-to-end recruitment pipelines, candidate screening, and workforce planning. Communication: Superior written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence leading client presentations and discovery calls. Strategic & Critical Thinking: Able to analyze complex client requirements, design scalable operational frameworks, and resolve problems independently. Why You Will Love Working Here Supportive Team & Mentorship: Work alongside a collaborative, growth-oriented team with clear guidance from implementation leadership. Continuous Learning: Deepen your expertise daily with cutting-edge AI tools, automation platforms, and complex integration projects. Career Growth: Real opportunity to progressively step into larger implementation, governance, and systems responsibilities over time. Flexible Remote Work: 100% remote setup within a highly collaborative US-Philippines hybrid working environment. Real Impact: Your work directly dictates how efficiently and successfully our business scales. Perks: 80-120 Hours of PTO 7 Paid Holidays 13th Month Payroll Life insurance of up to Php100,000 Paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan Paid Annual Physical Exam (APE) Mental Health Consultation Reimbursement up to ?20,000/year (capped at ?2,000 per session for up to 10 sessions) Social Security System Reimbursement PhilHealth or PagIbig Reimbursement Comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program Advancement after Proof of Mastery Performance Goals with advancement compensation We can’t wait to meet you and discover the value you’ll bring to our team! If this sounds like a role you’re excited about, apply now and help us continue building a workplace we all love.

title: Medical Assistant
description: Pay: $5.00/hour to start Hours: Approximately 3 hours per day, 7 days per week (about 21 hours/week total) Schedule: Flexible within an 8:30 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time availability window Location: Remote Job Type: Independent Contractor, Part-Time (with room to grow) About Us We're a growing healthcare practice focused on delivering high-quality patient care while building the operational systems that support long-term growth. Our team works closely with patients, providers, and partner agencies to keep communication and care delivery running smoothly. Position Overview We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Medical Assistant to provide clinical monitoring and on-call support for our practice, with the potential to grow into a broader Clinical Operations role for the right person. This isn't a role where you're actively working every minute of every day — it's a monitoring-based, on-call position to start. Most days won't require heavy active work, but you do need to be consistently reachable and responsive throughout your window, since patient and provider needs can come up at any time. In practice, this typically adds up to about 3 hours of active work per day. This role is ideal for someone who wants flexible, remote, part-time work they can build into their own schedule — as long as they're genuinely available and responsive when something comes up — and who's interested in taking on more clinical operations responsibility over time. Key Responsibilities (To Start) Monitor our patient text messaging system and intake email throughout the day Handle light calls related to patient and provider needs Escalate urgent patient or clinical issues to the appropriate provider promptly, by phone or direct message Stay reachable and responsive to notifications throughout your working window, even during downtime between active tasks De-escalate non-urgent issues and route them appropriately Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality in all monitoring and communication tasks Room to Grow For the right candidate, this role has a real path to expand into a fuller Clinical Operations position, which could include: Clinical intake support (rooming, vitals if applicable) Assisting providers during clinical workflows (telehealth or in-person) Tracking and following up on labs, orders, prescriptions, and care plans Supporting patient education and care coordination Ensuring clinical documentation is complete and accurate Participating in daily team huddles Providing front-office backup coverage when needed Hours and pay would be revisited together with you if and when the role expands in this direction — we're not asking you to take on more without adjusting compensation to match. What Makes This Role a Good Fit for You You want part-time, flexible remote work — you d ---------- when within the day you get things done You're comfortable with an on-call structure: not constantly busy, but consistently reachable You're organized and self-directed, and don't need someone checking in on you to stay on top of things You're interested in growing your responsibilities over time, not just staying in a fixed lane Requirements Medical Assistant experience or equivalent clinical support background (certification helpful but not required) A reliable, working computer and smartphone An Apple Watch (or equivalent wearable) so you can reliably receive and respond to notifications in real time, even when you're away from your phone Strong communication skills, including comfort speaking with patients, providers, and outside agencies by phone Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets) Comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently — this role rewards someone who's quick to adopt new tech, not intimidated by it Ability to genuinely commit to being reachable throughout your chosen hours within the 8:30 AM–5:00 PM Pacific window — this role depends on consistent responsiveness Preferred Spanish speaking Experience with Athena or another EHR system Compensation $5.00/hour to start, paid as an independent contractor (1099). Compensation and hours would grow along with the role if it expands into fuller Clinical Operations duties.

title: Carrier Sales rep

title: Sales
description: Sales Development Representative – Cold Caller (3PL / Freight Brokerage) About the Role We're looking for a high-energy cold caller to drive new business for our logistics operation. We are looking for someone who sees what needs doing and does it, who brings us solutions instead of questions, and who can be handed something unfamiliar and figure it out. Process tenant applications and screening, post and respond to openings on vacant units. handle evictions etc. CRM & Reporting Keep our CRM clean and current — no duplicates, no missing information, no stale records Deliver a weekly summary of key numbers across the business Flag leads and deals that have gone quiet so our team can act Monitor the CEO's mailbox to flag anything that needs his immediate attention. Medical Sales Support Build targeted contact lists for physician outreach Load and schedule email campaigns, monitor responses, and route interested contacts to our sales lead Follow up on paperwork and orders with our supplier Executive Support Calendar and schedule management across business and personal commitments Inbox triage — sorting what matters, drafting replies, and surfacing what needs a decision Travel planning and booking, including itineraries and confirmations Preparing documents, agreements, spreadsheets, and reports Expense tracking, receipt organization, and light bookkeeping support Research on vendors, services, tools, contractors, or anything else we are evaluating Coordinating with team members, vendors, and partners on our behalf Meeting preparation, notes, and follow-up on action items Personal Support This role includes personal and household assistance for the owners and their family. Expect things like: Managing family calendars, appointments, and reminders Scheduling and coordinating with home vendors, service providers, and contractors Online ordering, returns, and tracking purchases Researching and booking personal travel, reservations, and events Organizing personal documents, records, and subscriptions Handling accounts, renewals, insurance, and utilities for personal properties Research on personal decisions, purchases, and services we are considering Whatever else comes up that we do not have time to handle ourselves Some weeks the business work will dominate. Other weeks the personal side will. You need to be comfortable moving between the two without treating either as less important. Discretion is essential — you will see personal and financial information, and we need to trust you completely with it. How We Will Measure You You will be evaluated on results, not hours logged: No missed deadlines. No inspection period, due diligence date, or closing date is ever missed because it was not tracked. Closing files complete well before closing day. Not the morning of. Buyer criteria recorded promptly after every conversation, every time. Research turned around within one business day. Weekly reporting delivered on schedule without being asked. CRM accuracy that holds up to spot checks. Requests acknowledged same day and either completed or given a clear timeline. Who We Are Looking For Required Fluent written English — you will be emailing U.S. title companies, attorneys, and vendors, and your writing needs to be professional enough that they cannot tell you are not in our office Strong spoken English for calls with our team and outside parties At least two years of remote work experience supporting a U.S. company, ideally as an assistant to an owner or executive Comfortable with spreadsheets, web-based software, and learning new tools quickly Reliable high-speed internet with a backup option, a working computer, and a quiet place to work Able to work U.S. Eastern business hours — our vendors and title companies are only reachable during their business day, and we cannot compromise on this Complete discretion with confidential business and personal information Preferred Prior experience in U.S. real estate — transaction coordination, title, escrow, property management, or investor support Experience with real estate CRMs, property data tools, or email marketing platforms Comfort reading U.S. purchase contracts and closing documents The kind of person who does well here You start things. Given an unfamiliar problem, you research it, form a view, and come to us with a recommendation rather than an open question. You use judgment. You know which decisions are yours to make and which ones need us, and you rarely get that line wrong. You are bothered by an inconsistency until you resolve it You tell us when you made a mistake, immediately, before we find it You take a process you were taught and improve it, then write down the improvement You can shift from detailed research to a last-minute personal request without losing the thread on either You are steady and consistent rather than dramatic and heroic This job is not for you if you need constant supervision, you want a fixed and predictable task list, you would feel that personal and household tasks are beneath you, you dislike detailed work, or you are looking for something to fill gaps between other clients. Compensation & Growth Starting pay: $1,200 – $2,000 USD per month, full-time, depending on experience Performance review at 90 days with a pay increase for meeting expectations Paid U.S. holidays and paid time off after 90 days 13th month pay where customary Annual raises based on performance Paid monthly via Wise We are building a long-term team. title: Business Development Representative
description: Applications that do not have the following requirements will not be accepted: - speed test - short video introduction (camera on) - resume Cold Calling Appointment Setter We own and operate websites that generate exclusive inbound customer leads for local contractors (concrete, roofing, masonry, and similar home-service businesses) across the U.S. Your job: when a lead comes in for a business we don't have a contractor lined up for yet, you find a local contractor willing to take that lead for free, communicate with them regularly while sending more leads for free then you book a closing call with our sales representative, who signs them as a paying client. You do not close deals. You get the contractor to agree to receive a few free leads, send them a few leads to prove the value, and set the appointment. That's it. But getting a cold contractor who's never heard of us to say yes takes real cold-calling and sales skill — this is not a passive, script-reading role. What You'll Do - Answer inbound calls for leads that don't yet have an assigned contractor - Capture the lead details accurately - Find and contact a local contractor who services that area/trade - Pitch them on taking this lead for free, no strings attached - Send them a few free leads to build trust and prove the leads are real - Check in with them regularly to see how the leads are going — are they answering, are they interested, is it working out - Let us know if a contractor isn't answering or doesn't seem interested, so we can stop sending them leads and find a different contractor instead - Once they're warmed up, book a closing call on our founder's calendar - Log every step in Airtable - Communicate with the team through Slack - Make and receive calls through Quo (we provide access) Daily Goal: Sign up at least 1 new contractor per day (get them to agree to receive free leads). This is the core metric this role is measured on. Who We're Looking For - Strong and confident on the phone — not timid or shy. You need to sound assertive and sure of yourself from the first sentence of a cold call. - Genuinely comfortable cold-calling strangers, every single day - Can handle a "no" or pushback without losing energy or confidence - Good at building quick trust and rapport with someone who's never heard of us - Organized — can track multiple leads and contractors at once without dropping the ball - Reliable and self-directed — this role runs on daily output, not just hours logged - Clear, professional English, spoken and written Required Experience: One or more of the following — cold calling is the most important: - Cold calling (required or strongly preferred) - B2B sales or business development - Appointment setting - Lead generation - Customer service involving high phone volume Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers/business owners is strongly preferred. Tools You'll Use Quo (calling) Airtable (tracking every lead and contractor) Slack (team communication) Compensation $4.00 USD/hour base Full-time (40 hours/week) $50 bonus for every contractor that becomes a paying client Paid bi-weekly via PayPal 10 days PTO annually Paid U.S. and Philippine holidays Schedule Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST (U.S. time) Training We provide: Detailed SOPs Scripts for pitching contractors Training videos Ongoing coaching

title: Marketing Lead - Strategy, Meta & Google Ads, and Direct Our Creative Team (US health + LongevityBrand)
job_title: Marketing Lead - Strategy, Meta & Google Ads, and Direct Our Creative Team (US health + LongevityBrand)
description: MUST BE AVAILABLE TO WORK US EASTERN TIMEZONE US-based Telehealth brand. Weight loss, Longevity, beauty, and aesthetic products We are LegitScript certified and approved to advertise on Meta and Google. Experienced healthcare marketers will understand this importance. Founder-led, small, fast. You report directly to the founder. THE ROLE You will be the marketing lead. What we say, who we say it to, where it runs, and what the website needs to do to convert the traffic is led by this role. You report directly to the founder and CEO with a strategy . You pitch, he signs off, you execute with the resources available (graphic designer, Web developer + Ad spend account). You will have access to two roles providing resources to you: 1. Graphic designer: Creates graphics and edits video for your campaign 2. Web Specialist: Builds and deploys pages you think will maximize conversion Your Responsibilities: Market research and strategy 1. Research our market: competitors, how they position and advertise, where the gaps are, what our audience actually responds to. 2. Build a marketing strategy from that research and pitch it to the CEO for sign-off - channels, budget split, positioning, targets, timeline, and the reasoning behind each. 3. Once signed off, you own executing it 4. Revisit and re-pitch quarterly, or sooner when the data says the strategy is wrong. Telling us the plan isn't working is part of the job, not a failure. 5.Maintain the angle bank: a running list of campaign concepts to test, ranked by expected impact Campaign concepts and directing the creative team 1.Develop the concept: audience, message, hook, format 2. Write a one-page creative brief for each: reference examples, format specs, claim boundaries 3.Write all ad copy, headlines and hooks 4. You are accountable for the quality of what our Creative Producer ships. Everything they produce must be high quality, on brand, and aligned to the signed-off strategy - if it isn't, that's yours to fix. 4. You have the authority to reject work, request revisions and set deadlines for the creative team. 5. Hold the brand guidelines. If work drifts off-brand, you catch it before it ships, not after. Media buying - Meta and Google 1. Build, launch and manage campaigns on both platforms 2. Audience research, targeting, exclusions, lookalikes 3. Full-funnel structure: prospecting, retargeting, retention 4. Own daily and monthly spend against agreed targets Conversion direction 1. Specify what our landing pages and key site pages need to do to convert: what a visitor sees first, what order sections run in, what to cut, where the CTA sits and why 2. Brief the Web Specialist, who builds it 3. Where you two disagree: you own the conversion intent, they own the implementation and can override on technical grounds like page speed or breakage. Escalate to the founder if it can't be resolved — but that should be rare. Creator and UGC partnerships 1. Build a vetted list of micro-creators (roughly 1,000-5,000 followers) in health, fitness, longevity, wellness and beauty 2. Outreach using approved templates, manage replies, coordinate gifting and shipping 3. Secure paid usage and whitelisting rights up front, not just gifting terms. A creator who agreed to one organic post has not agreed to let us run their face as an ad. 4. Run the best creator content as partnership ads and Spark Ads from the creator's own handle 5. Raw footage goes to the Creative Producer, who cuts it into ad assets for you 6. Score the creator channel on CAC the same way you score paid Testing and reporting 1. Structured testing: one variable, a stated hypothesis, a success metric 2.One weekly written report to the CEO: spend, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, what changed, what's next 3. A monthly review against the signed-off strategy: what's on track, what isn't, what you're changing 4. Honest reporting. We would much rather hear "this isn't working and here's why" than watch a number get spun. Compliance 1. Keep every campaign inside healthcare advertising policy and our written claim guidelines 2. Ensure every creator partnership is properly disclosed under FTC rules. We are liable for what our creators say, so enforcing this is your job. 3. Protect the ad account. It is a hard-won asset. What you are NOT responsible for Designing graphics or editing video - the Creative Producer Writing or deploying code - the Web Specialist Blog posts, newsletters, product page copy - the founder Medical or product claims - the founder sets those boundaries; you are responsible for staying within them. Requirements - 3+ years running paid acquisition for e-commerce or DTC brands, with real budget - Hands-on Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. Tell us the largest monthly budget you have personally controlled. - Experience advertising in healthcare, telehealth, supplements, skincare. - Proven creative strategy: you have d ---------- what ads should say, not just uploaded them - You have researched a market and built a strategy off it, then presented it to a decision-maker and defended it - Experience directing designers - briefing them, holding a quality bar, and giving useful feedback when work misses - A real point of view on landing page structure and conversion optimization - Strong ad copywriting in US English - Comfortable with GA4, attribution, Conversions API Nice to have - Prior work with a LegitScript-certified advertiser - Whitelisted or Spark Ads campaigns with micro-creators - Telehealth, GLP-1, hormone or longevity vertical - Klaviyo or email marketing Important - please read Healthcare advertising is not normal advertising. Certification lets us run ads; it does not make approvals automatic or creative latitude wide. Campaigns get disapproved, copy gets rejected, costs run higher than in unregulated categories. Pay Base: $1,200/month, paid twice monthly via Wise Performance bonus: paid monthly on new customers acquired at or below our target CAC, above a minimum spend threshold. Realistic total comp at target is $1,600-$1,800/month, with no cap if you significantly outperform. We will agree the exact targets with you in writing in your first two weeks, before the bonus period starts. 30-day paid trial, then permanent We have structured it this way deliberately. If you are confident in your ability to move numbers, you will earn more here than a flat salary elsewhere. What to include in your application: - Access to a portfolio of design examples from prior work (ads, web, marketing emails etc) (ideally in relevant category - Google / meta account ad success We look forward to reviewing your application

title: Accounts Payable Specialist - Remote
description: Company Overview The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it. MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow. What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf. Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next. Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place. Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Position Overview: The Accounts Payable Specialist is the operational backbone of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' vendor payment process — the person who makes sure every bill is entered right, every check run goes out on time, and every vendor and client interaction reflects the accuracy and dependability our finance operation is built on. This is an individual-contributor role for someone who's detail-obsessed and doesn't just process what's in front of them — you notice when something's off, and you bring it up. You'll work closely with our Accounting Program Manager to spot and fix process gaps, and report to our Accounting Team Lead. Key Responsibilities: Accounts Payable & Vendor Payments Enter vendor bills accurately and in a timely manner Process weekly check runs Provide vendor remittances as needed Ensure all payable records are properly coded and matched before payment Client & Vendor Support Manually upload client invoices to third-party portals Support finance-related tasks for clients and vendors, including direct client- and vendor-facing communication Respond to vendor and client inquiries with accuracy and professionalism Process Improvement Partner with the Accounting Program Manager to identify and implement accounts payable process improvements Flag recurring errors or inefficiencies before they become bigger problems Qualifications Required: 3-5 years of experience in accounts payable and/or finance operations Accounts payable AND customer service experience — this role is regularly client- and vendor-facing Hands-on Salesforce experience Strong verbal and written English communication skills Nice-to-Have: Experience with process improvement initiatives in an AP or finance operations setting Familiarity with AI-enabled finance/AP tools Compensation & Benefits: Starting Rate: $5.00–$6.00/hour. 90-Day Review: Upon successful completion of the first 90 days, compensation may be reviewed for a performance-based rate increase based on results, reliability, ownership, and overall contribution to the team. Permanent work-from-home 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST — overlap with our Naperville, IL accounting team) Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday) Work Anniversary Bonus No work with pay on US Holidays Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment Basic Technical Requirements: Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply Noise-canceling headset/headphones A quiet and dedicated workspace at home Application Process: Your most updated resume Submit to all of these emails: ---------- ---------- Equal Employment Opportunity Statement MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Sales Operations Administrator
description: Welcome to MEGHANI, an independent timepiece company that believes in the power of time. MEGHANI is dedicated to surveying the relativity of individual and collective relationships within time and memory. Our commitment to exceptional design and storytelling is guided by this fundamental principle. The purpose of what we create is rooted in a deep history of timekeeping; Now run by the third generation of family members, sibling duo Amir and Shabeena Meghani — MEGHANI is made up of a tight knit team of individuals who run our two in-house timepiece brands: BREDA & JBW. Welcome to our world. The Sales Operations Administrator at MEGHANI is a full-time, hourly position reporting to the Wholesale Director. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our product catalog, pricing, and promotional content are accurate, up to date, and optimized for both internal teams and retail partners. You will work cross functionally with Merchandising, Product, Marketing, and Retail teams to streamline operational processes and maintain high quality digital and inventory data. What You’ll Do Product Launch & Templates - Create and maintain product launch templates to ensure consistent data, imagery, and promotional information - Coordinate with cross functional teams to collect necessary assets and information for new product launches. Catalog & Inventory Management - Conduct regular product audits to ensure inventory and product information is accurate and live. - Update pricing and promotional details in systems and maintain accuracy across digital and retail channels - Monitor inventory liveness to prevent stock discrepancies or issues affecting product availability Digital Asset & Data Management - Manage product imagery across platforms, ensuring correct specifications and organization. - Maintain Drive and Dropbox folders, keeping all product and marketing assets well structured and up to date. - Update and maintain retailer, internal, and vendor contact lists for accurate communication and outreach. Process Improvement & Collaboration - Identify inefficiencies in current product operations workflows and propose solutions. - Partner with Marketing, Retail, and Product teams to implement best practices for product data and asset management. - Support reporting and ad hoc requests related to product operations and inventory. What You’ll Bring - 2+ years of experience in product operations, merchandising, retail operations, or e-commerce support. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. - Comfortable managing multiple digital tools, cloud storage systems, and spreadsheets. - Proficiency in Excel – Strong expertise required. Candidate must be highly skilled with advanced functions including VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, PivotTables, and related tools. - Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally. - Proactive and solutions oriented with a focus on maintaining accurate, timely product data. What You’ll Get: - Competitive salary and performance incentives - 4 ½ Day Work Week - Discretionary Time Off (DTO) - Employee discounts for both JBW and BREDA brands Schedule: Full Time. Eight (8) hours Monday through Thursday (8:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST) and four (4) hours on Fridays (8:00 AM - 12:00 AM CST)

title: Shopify Growth Wizard NEEDED
description: # MUST BE PROFICIENT WITH CLAUDE COWORK ## Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Shopify Store Manager to help build, manage, and scale our Shopify business. This is a long-term position for someone who understands DTC eCommerce operations, product sourcing, conversion rate optimization, customer retention, paid traffic fundamentals, and revenue growth. We are not looking for a basic virtual assistant. We are looking for someone who can identify profitable products, build high-converting storefronts, manage operations end to end, and grow revenue consistently. ## Responsibilities **Store Management** - Manage daily Shopify store operations - Build and optimize product and collection pages - Monitor store speed, uptime, and app performance - Process orders and coordinate fulfillment - Handle customer inquiries, chargebacks, and disputes - Track store KPIs: conversion rate, AOV, LTV, ROAS, refund rate - Monitor competitor pricing, offers, and market trends **Product Research** - Identify profitable products and niches - Research trending and high-demand products - Analyze competitor stores and ad creative - Evaluate margins, sales velocity, and CAC-to-LTV ratios - Source from wholesalers, private label suppliers, agents, and 3PLs - Present product opportunities with supporting data **Conversion & SEO Optimization** - Write high-converting product titles, descriptions, and offer copy - Optimize theme layout, PDP structure, and checkout flow - Improve organic SEO: meta data, URL structure, blog content, schema - Build upsells, bundles, and post-purchase offers - Run and interpret A/B tests - Reduce cart and checkout abandonment **Marketing & Retention** - Manage email and SMS flows (Klaviyo or similar) - Build abandoned cart, welcome, browse abandonment, and win-back sequences - Coordinate with paid media on landing pages and creative - Manage discount codes, promotions, and launch calendars **Inventory & Operations** - Track inventory levels and forecast reorders - Prevent overselling and stockouts - Coordinate with suppliers and 3PL partners - Monitor shipping performance and delivery times - Manage returns, refunds, and exchanges - Maintain and audit the app stack **Graphic Design** - Create product and lifestyle images - Design banners, promotional graphics, and email creative - Build infographics and comparison charts for product pages - Edit and retouch product photos - Maintain consistent branding across the store ## Required Skills **Must Have** - Previous Shopify store management experience - Fluent English (written and spoken) - Strong product research skills - Experience with Shopify SEO and CRO - Working knowledge of Shopify Analytics and GA4 - Excellent communication skills - Strong analytical abilities - Attention to detail **Preferred** - Experience with Klaviyo, Triple Whale, or Lifetimely - Experience with Liquid theme editing - Experience with Meta and Google Ads reporting - Experience with dropshipping, private label, or wholesale sourcing - Experience with 3PL and inventory management software - Experience scaling Shopify stores beyond $50,000/month ## To Apply - How many years of Shopify experience do you have? - Have you built and managed a Shopify store from start to finish? - What monthly revenue volume have you managed? - What research and analytics tools do you use? - What is the highest conversion rate you've achieved, and how did you get there? - Describe a winning product you found. - Record a 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself. - Begin your application with: "Shopify Growth Expert."

title: After Hour Receptionist and Admin
description: SERVPRO Team Fox is seeking an experienced, highly organized Remote Restoration Operations & Dispatch Coordinator to support our growing restoration operation. This is not a basic administrative VA position. The person in this role will help manage after-hours emergency calls, coordinate and dispatch crews, assist with estimating platforms, follow up on outstanding estimates and approvals, and support accounts receivable and collections. Knowing how to post on social media is also a plus. We are looking for someone who is comfortable communicating directly with customers, insurance professionals, property managers, and our internal production team and who can remain calm and organized when handling emergency situations. Key Responsibilities After-Hours Emergency Response & Dispatch Answer and manage incoming after-hours emergency calls. Gather critical First Notice of Loss (FNOL) information, including customer information, loss location, type of damage, insurance information, and emergency conditions. Determine the appropriate level of response based on established company procedures. Contact and dispatch on-call crews for water, fire, mold, board-up, and other emergency losses. Communicate job information clearly to the responding crew and management. Maintain communication with customers while crews are being dispatched. Document all calls, communications, and actions in the appropriate system. Escalate large losses, commercial emergencies, or unusual situations to management. Estimating & Insurance Administration Assist with Xactimate and Symbility estimating workflows. Upload estimates, photographs, documentation, invoices, and supporting information to carrier/program portals. Review files to make sure required documentation has been submitted. Track estimates that are awaiting review or approval. Follow up with adjusters, insurance carriers, TPAs, and customers regarding outstanding estimates. Document all follow-up activity and maintain accurate file notes. Identify files that are stalled or require management attention. Accounts Receivable & Collections Follow up on outstanding invoices and accounts receivable. Contact insurance companies, adjusters, customers, and other responsible parties regarding payment status. Track promised payments and follow-up dates. Maintain detailed collection notes. Escalate aging or disputed balances to management. Assist with obtaining payment documentation and resolving administrative issues delaying payment. Administrative & Operational Support Maintain accurate customer and job information. Assist project managers and office staff with job-file administration. Monitor open tasks and follow up to make sure deadlines are met. Prepare reports on outstanding estimates, approvals, receivables, and follow-ups. Help ensure jobs continue moving through the workflow rather than sitting without action. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate will have: Excellent spoken and written English. Experience working with a U.S.-based company. Strong telephone and customer-service skills. Ability to handle emergency calls professionally and calmly. Strong organizational and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple active files and priorities. Excellent attention to detail and documentation. Comfortable making outbound calls and following up repeatedly when necessary. Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software. Ability to work independently without constant supervision. Reliable high-speed internet and a professional, quiet work environment. Highly Preferred Experience: Restoration or construction industry experience. Water/fire damage restoration experience. Xactimate Symbility Insurance claims TPA/carrier portals Dispatching field technicians or emergency-service crews Accounts receivable or collections CRM/job-management software

title: AI Video Editor for DTC Ads & VSLs - $1,200-$1,500/mo + 3% Ad Spend Bonus
job_title: AI Video Editor for DTC Ads & VSLs - $1,200-$1,500/mo + 3% Ad Spend Bonus
description: Full-time. Exclusive. Remote. US supplement brand. THE SHORT VERSION We hand you the script, the hook, the avatar and the competitor ad it is based on. You generate the footage with AI and cut it into a finished ad. Short-form ads and full VSLs. 8 to 10 deliverables a week to start, 10 to 15 once you know our system, plus statics. 24 to 48 hour turnaround. We pay for every AI tool you need, and you get 3% of every dollar of ad spend that performs. WHO WE ARE We are a new US direct-response supplement brand for women. We launched this year and we are scaling on Meta right now. Small team, no layers, no meetings that go nowhere. We are not going to pretend we are an 8-figure brand. We are early. That is the honest pitch: you are hire number one on creative, you will see every number, and the seat grows as the account grows. WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS Most editing jobs hand you raw footage and a deadline. This one is different in one specific way: we do the thinking, you do the making. We run TrendTrack, so we can see exactly which competitor ads are winning, how long they have been running, and how much they are spending. We pull the winners apart and hand you: - The competitor ad we want to iterate on, with a link so you can watch it yourself - The full script, written and approved - The hook variations - The avatar: who she is, what she looks like, how she talks - Locked character and product references so nothing drifts between videos Your job starts there. You generate the visuals with AI, you build the scenes, you cut it, you grade it, you subtitle it, you deliver a finished ad ready to upload. You are not being asked to invent the strategy. You are being asked to execute it better than the brand we took it from. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Generate AI footage: b-roll, environments, avatars, talking heads, product scenes - Cut finished direct-response ads for Meta. Anything from a 15-second hook test to a full VSL of 4 to 5 minutes. Both are part of the job and they are not the same craft. - Voiceover with AI, lip sync where needed, clean subtitles that read on a phone - Build static image ads from the same material - Deliver 8 to 10 videos a week in your first month while you learn our system, then 10 to 15 once you are up to speed, plus statics. This is a guide, not a rigid quota. A five-minute VSL is not one unit of work the way a 20-second hook variation is, and we count it accordingly. - Turn around revisions within 24 to 48 hours - Keep a shared library of approved assets so we reuse instead of regenerating - Report weekly on credits used per delivered video WHAT WE SUPPLY - Every AI tool. Higgsfield or equivalent, ElevenLabs or equivalent, and anything else the job needs. The accounts are ours, you get your own workspace and a monthly credit allocation. - Scripts, hooks, avatars, competitor references, brand and claim guidelines - Direct access to the founder. No account manager, no ticket system. COMPENSATION Base: $1,200 to $1,500 USD per month, depending on where your skills are. Full-time, 40 hours a week, exclusive. If you are clearly above this range, say so and tell us what you need. We are early and we are careful with money, but we are not going to lowball someone who can actually deliver. Bonus: 3% of the ad spend that performs. Every month we look at the ad account. The spend that ran at or above our break-even ROAS is the spend that made money. You get 3% of that number, on top of your base. Uncapped. An example so it is concrete. If the account spends $50,000 in a month and $30,000 of it ran above break-even, that is $900 on top of your base. If we scale and $200,000 runs above break-even, that is $6,000. For your first three months we guarantee a minimum bonus of $200 a month while the account is still ramping. The percentage will not be worth much in month one and we would rather pay you than tell you to be patient. The base is modest because we are early. The percentage is not. That is the trade we are offering, and we would rather be honest about which half is which. Three things we put in writing before you start, so there is never a discussion about it: - Break-even ROAS is one agreed number, fixed in your agreement and reviewed each quarter. - It is measured blended across the whole ad account, not per individual ad. We run CBO campaigns where spend moves between ads, so per-ad attribution is not honest maths. - The attribution window is 7-day click, 1-day engaged view, 1-day view. The same window we make every other decision on. You see the same dashboard we do. No black box. Your base is reviewed at 90 days, and we mean it. If your ads are carrying the account, the number moves. We would rather pay you properly than train you up and lose you to the next brand. Paid per calendar month, 12 payments a year, not every 4 weeks. Bank transfer or Wise. To be clear so nobody is surprised in December: this is an independent contractor agreement. There is no 13th month pay. The performance bonus is the upside, and it is uncapped. WORKING HOURS You organise your own day. What we need is overlap, not a clock. - Be reachable 2pm to 6pm Manila time, Monday to Friday. That is our morning in Europe, when briefs go out and feedback comes back. - Deliver by the end of your working day so we can review it during ours. That gives us one clean round every 24 hours. - Outside that window your time is yours. We do not track hours and we do not care when you edit, only that deadlines hold. REQUIREMENTS - You can generate realistic AI video and make it look like footage, not like AI - You are fast with at least one serious editor: Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci or CapCut Pro - You can hold attention over long form. Keeping someone watching at minute three of a VSL is a different skill from stopping the scroll in second one, and we need both. - Your written English is flawless. Use whatever tool you like to get there, we only care about the result. Subtitles and on-screen text go in front of American women and a typo costs us credibility. - You can watch a competitor ad and see why it works: the timing of the hook, where the cut lands, what the first three seconds are doing - You have a real portfolio of ads, not wedding videos or gaming edits - You can work full-time and exclusively, and you are reachable in the overlap window above - You take blunt feedback and come back with a better version the same day NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED - Static ad design - Experience with supplement or health advertising on Meta, and what gets rejected - You have used TrendTrack, Foreplay or a similar ad library before DO NOT APPLY IF - You are stacking this with two other clients - You need every detail spelled out twice - A 24 to 48 hour turnaround stresses you out - You think AI video is a gimmick - You go quiet when something slips HOW WE WORK, READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY Two rules that are not negotiable, because they are how we keep quality up and cost down. One approved variant before the batch. For any new scene you generate one version, we approve it, and only then do you generate the rest. Never six at once on an unapproved look. Reuse before you regenerate. Approved footage goes in the shared library. Most winning ads in our category run the same twenty clips behind twenty different hooks. If those rules sound like micromanagement to you, this is not your seat. If they sound like common sense, we will get along. HIRING PROCESS - Step 1: a short Loom. That is your application. No CV, no cover letter. - Step 2: a paid test video. $50, one brief, 30 to 60 seconds, real work. - Step 3: a short call, then you start. We reply to everyone who follows the instructions. STEP 1, THE LOOM Record it in one take. Under three minutes. Phone or webcam is fine, we are not judging your lighting, we are judging what you notice. Cover exactly these three things, in this order. 1. Who you are, what you edit in, and what your AI stack is. Thirty seconds. Name the actual editing software you work in every day, whether that is Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci or CapCut Pro, and then the AI tools you use for generation and voice, and what you use each one for. 2. Share your screen and play one ad you made that used AI-generated footage. Then tell us what you would change about it today. If you cannot find anything to change, you are not the person we are looking for. 3. Pick any ad in the wild, from any brand, that you think is working. Play the first three seconds and tell us what they are doing. Not "the editing is clean". Tell us what the hook is doing to the viewer and where you would have cut it differently. Send the Loom link plus one line with your rate and your start date. Start your message with the word AMBER so we know you read this far. STEP 2, THE PAID TEST VIDEO If your Loom lands, we send you a brief and pay you $50 for it, whether we hire you or not. You get a real competitor ad we want to iterate on, the script, and the avatar. You deliver one finished ad of 30 to 60 seconds with AI-generated footage, plus a one-page outline of how you would structure the same script as a four-minute VSL. The edit shows us your hands. The outline shows us your head. We need both. Turnaround for the test is three days.

title: Retreat Center Sales and Event Coordinator
job_title: Retreat Center Sales and Event Coordinator
description: Location: Remote – Philippines Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week | U.S. Pacific Time coverage required Employment Type: Long-term, full-time Overview We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Retreat Center Sales and Event Coordinator to support the sales, booking, and coordination of retreats and events for our U.S.-based retreat center. This is a client-facing role that requires excellent spoken and written English, strong follow-through, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate comfortably and professionally with clients over the phone, email, and video calls. The Retreat Center Sales and Event Coordinator will manage inquiries and bookings throughout the sales and event lifecycle while working closely with the Senior Retreat Coordinator, management, operations, and other departments. A key part of this position is being able to take initiative and work independently when senior team members are offline. We are looking for someone who does not need constant reminders to follow up, provide updates, respond to clients, or complete time-sensitive tasks. Key Responsibilities 1. Sales & Client Communication Manage the sales cycle from initial inquiry through booking, contract execution, and payment. Respond promptly and professionally to retreat and event inquiries via email, phone, and other communication platforms. Qualify prospective clients, understand their needs, and provide accurate information about the venue and available services. Conduct client calls and coordinate virtual or in-person venue tours. Prepare proposals, pricing sheets, contracts, and event agreements. Consistently follow up with prospective clients and existing bookings without requiring reminders. Maintain timely communication to ensure inquiries and client requests do not go unanswered. Build strong client relationships and provide a professional, welcoming experience throughout the entire sales and event lifecycle. 2. Retreat & Event Coordination Work closely with the Senior Retreat Coordinator and other team members to manage upcoming retreats and events. Develop and maintain detailed agendas, run-of-show documents, event flows, checklists, and schedules. Coordinate pre-event planning meetings with clients, catering teams, vendors, and internal departments. Organize and document floor plans, setup requirements, food service needs, technical requirements, and staffing details. Ensure event details are accurate, finalized, and communicated promptly to everyone involved. Maintain the retreat and event calendar and monitor upcoming deadlines and deliverables. 3. Independent Coverage & Initiative Work independently and confidently during hours when the Senior Retreat Coordinator or other team members are offline. Take ownership of client requests, follow-ups, and time-sensitive matters rather than waiting for reminders or instructions. Anticipate next steps and proactively address issues before they become problems. Exercise sound judgment and know when an issue can be handled independently versus when it needs to be escalated. Maintain continuity of client service and operations during team members' offline hours, including designated Friday coverage as needed. 4. Cross-Department Communication & Collaboration Collaborate closely with retreat center operations, management, and other departments to ensure information is shared accurately and promptly. Provide requested reports, updates, and information to relevant team members without repeated follow-up. Proactively communicate changes, outstanding items, potential issues, and important client updates. Maintain clear communication and accountability across departments to keep operations moving efficiently. Follow through on requests and confirm completion when appropriate. 5. Administrative & Operational Support Prepare invoices, track payments, and follow up on outstanding balances. Maintain accurate client files, contracts, event documentation, and checklists. Keep CRM and event management systems accurate and up to date. Track sales activity, bookings, follow-ups, and other relevant metrics. Assist with venue listings, marketing materials, website updates, client testimonials, and other promotional activities as needed. Prepare post-event reports, client surveys, and other documentation. 6. Post-Event Follow-Up Follow up with clients after retreats and events to assess satisfaction. Collect client feedback and communicate relevant recommendations to management. Assist with final billing, vendor invoices, and event financial reconciliation. Maintain relationships with past clients to encourage repeat bookings and referrals. Required Qualifications Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. job_title: Amazon Listing & Catalog Operations Specialist (3+ Yrs, Flat Files)
description: TYPE OF WORK: Full Time WAGE / SALARY: $5.00 to $7.00/hr. Your starting rate is set by your verified experience and your paid skills test result. HOURS PER WEEK: 40 LOCATION: Remote Read this first This is a senior specialist role, not a general VA role. We require at least 3 years of hands on seller side experience. If your Amazon experience is customer service, product research, sourcing, PPC, or online courses only, please do not apply. We verify experience and you will not be shortlisted. If you have personally built parent and child variation families, fixed a suppressed listing, and debugged a flat file upload error, please keep reading. We are hiring one person for the long term. About the work We run an established Amazon store with a large, variation heavy catalog. Our listings are our storefront, so catalog accuracy is the job itself. You will own daily listing operations: creating new products, building variation families, keeping data clean across hundreds of SKUs, and making sure every image and attribute is correct. This is detail work with real consequences. One wrong UPC or a broken variation theme can cost us sales for days. We want someone who finds that kind of precision satisfying rather than tedious. What you will actually do - Create and maintain Amazon listings, including parent and child variation families - Build and upload flat files and bulk templates, and debug upload errors and rejections - Fix suppressed, stranded, and incomplete listings, and find the root cause instead of only the symptom - Manage product images: naming conventions, main and alt image mapping, Amazon image requirements - Clean and restructure product data in Excel and Google Sheets before it reaches Seller Central - Run catalog audits using Category Listing Report and inventory reports, and flag inconsistencies before we notice them - Document your process so it can be repeated Hard requirements (all four) 1. At least 3 years of hands on Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central experience on the seller side. Buyer side or CS only experience does not count. 2. You have personally created and maintained product listings, including variations. Product research or sourcing alone does not count. 3. Strong Excel and Google Sheets. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, text functions for SKU building, removing duplicates, and handling CSV files without losing leading zeros. 4. Reliable internet and backup power, plus consistent attendance. You work independently with minimal supervision. We also need written English clear enough to explain a listing problem without a call, and the honesty to say "I don't know" instead of guessing. Nice to have - Flat file experience across multiple categories - Shopify or other marketplace catalog experience - Basic image editing (crop, background, resize to Amazon spec) - Experience writing or following SOPs Pay and how we set it - $5.50 to $7.00/hr, 40 hours per week. Your starting rate depends on verified experience and your skills test result. - First 2 weeks are a paid probation at your agreed rate. Not a free trial. - Raises are tied to written performance criteria and reviewed at 3 months. No vague promises. - Paid on time, every time, through Wise. We have a documented payroll process. - Long term position. We are hiring someone to grow with the catalog. Our hiring process 1. Application with screening answers (see below). 2. Experience verification. We will ask for your resume and for specifics about listings you have built. 3. A 30 minute video interview. Your microphone is required so we can hear you clearly. Turning your camera on is optional. You will share your screen for part of it. We work through a short live session together in Excel or Google Sheets, using a real flat file with messy source data in it. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to submit beforehand. If the skill is genuinely yours, this is the easiest part of the process. 4. Offer, then your paid 2 week probation. We are open about this process because it works in both directions. If your experience is overstated, the live session will be uncomfortable. If you are the real thing, it is the fastest way we know to see it. There is no unpaid take home task and no week of waiting for a result. How to apply Apply through OnlineJobs.ph messaging only. Please do not email. Put the word AMAZON on the first line of your message, then answer these four questions briefly. Applications that skip the questions are not reviewed, because these answers are the only way we can tell you apart from a hundred other applicants. 1. Roughly how many SKUs have you personally managed, and in which categories? 2. Have you built and uploaded flat files? If yes, name one thing that commonly breaks an upload and how you fixed it. 3. What is a variation theme, in your own words? Give one example of a variation family you personally built. 4. Name one listing error or suppression you have resolved (an error code, a compliance issue, a missing attribute) and describe the fix. Please attach your resume. Strong candidates often get held up simply because we cannot verify anything without one. Short and specific answers are better than long polished ones. Four honest sentences will get you further here than a page of AI written text.
