title: Automotive Product Research VA (Google Sheets, Vehicle Data)
job_title: Automotive Product Research VA (Google Sheets, Vehicle Data)
description: Virtual Assistant: Automotive Product Research and Data Verification (Vehicle Fitment Data, Google Sheets) TYPE OF WORK: Full Time WAGE / SALARY: Research VA $4.50 to $5.50/hr. Cross-Check VA $5.50 to $6.50/hr. Your role and your rate are confirmed during a paid trial period. HOURS PER WEEK: 40 NUMBER OF HIRES: 3 (two Research VAs, one Cross-Check VA) READ THIS FIRST This is a research role, not a data entry role. If your experience is typing jobs, lead generation list building, or copy and paste work only, please do not apply. Speed is not what we are paying for here. If you are the kind of person who notices that two websites list the same car with different dimensions, and you want to know which one is right before you write anything down, please keep reading. JOB OVERVIEW We are looking for detail oriented Virtual Assistants to support research and data collection for automotive accessory product development. The primary responsibility of this position is to research vehicle specific and marketplace information required for new product development and accurately organize the findings in our Master Google Sheets. Research may include vehicle specifications, dimensions, compatibility and fitment information, existing product specifications, marketplace information, and customer feedback. The team will consist of two Research VAs and one Cross-Check VA. Research VAs collect and organize data, while the Cross-Check VA independently verifies the collected information before it is finalized. You do not apply for a specific role. Both roles start from the same application, and we assign them during the paid trial period based on the work you actually produce. This position requires more than simple data entry. Research accuracy, source verification, and consistency are extremely important. A wrong dimension in our sheet becomes a product that does not fit a customer's car, so the cost of a careless entry is real. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: RESEARCH VA - Conduct online research for automotive accessory product development - Research required information by vehicle Make / Model / Year - Collect vehicle specifications, dimensions, fitment and compatibility information, and other requested data - Research existing products and specifications across online marketplaces - Review relevant customer reviews and feedback when needed - Enter findings accurately into the provided Master Google Sheets - Record supporting sources and links for every entry - Compare information from multiple sources whenever possible. Manufacturer specifications outrank marketplace listings, and marketplace listings outrank forum posts - Clearly flag unavailable, uncertain, or conflicting information instead of guessing - Follow provided research guidelines and formatting consistently KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: CROSS-CHECK VA Everything above, plus the verification layer: - Independently verify data collected by the Research VAs using sources they did not use - Confirm that vehicle Make / Model / Year is correctly matched, including trim and generation changes within the same model year - Identify inaccurate, inconsistent, incomplete, or questionable entries and send them back with a reason - Flag discrepancies that cannot be confidently resolved rather than picking the more convenient answer - Keep verification standards identical across all rows and both researchers - Complete final verification before data is marked as approved REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS - You can find the same fact in two independent sources and tell us which one you trust more, and why - Google Sheets: you have used filters, sorting, and VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP - You can read an English product specification page and pull exact numbers out of it without asking for clarification - Written English good enough to explain, in two or three sentences, why two sources disagree - Comfortable working in a sheet with thousands of rows without losing your place - You can follow a formatting rule the same way on row 40 as you did on row 4 - Self directed. You will work with written guidelines and asynchronous feedback, not constant supervision - You say "I could not verify this" instead of filling in a plausible number - Reliable internet, backup power, and consistent attendance PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Genuine interest in cars. You will look at vehicle dimensions and body styles every working day, and people who find that interesting are measurably more accurate than people who do not - Previous experience in online research, product research, or e-commerce - Experience researching Amazon, eBay, or other online marketplaces - Automotive industry or automotive accessory research experience - Experience with vehicle fitment or compatibility data - Experience managing large spreadsheets or product databases WORK SCHEDULE Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM US Pacific Time, including a 30 minute break. 40 hours per week. PAY, AND HOW WE SET IT - Research VA $4.50 to $5.50/hr. Cross-Check VA $5.50 to $6.50/hr - The Cross-Check role pays more because it is the last check before data is approved. It is not a supervisor role, it is a harder accuracy role - Both your role and your rate are confirmed during a paid trial period of 3 to 5 days, based on the work you actually produce - Paid on time, every time, through Wise. We have a documented payroll process - Long term position. This is an ongoing product development program, not a one off project - Raises are tied to written performance criteria and reviewed at 3 months. No vague promises HOW TO APPLY Apply through OnlineJobs.ph messaging, or email your application to ---------- are the only two channels we review. Do not send your application to ---------- sent to that address will not be reviewed. On the first line of your message, write RESEARCH followed by the number of people we are hiring for this role. Then answer the five questions below. Keep every answer to three sentences or fewer. We read short answers first. 1. Find the overall length of a 2022 Ford F-150. Give the number, your source link, and anything else you think we should know about your answer. 2. Open this sheet: ---------- Column A and column B should hold the same vehicle, but a few rows do not match. List the row numbers that do not match. 3. Describe one time you researched something online and the sources disagreed. What did you do? 4. How do you d ---------- whether an online source is reliable? Name one type of source you would not trust for technical specifications, and why. 5. Name one car you know well, and one thing about it that most people do not know. Please attach your resume. Strong candidates often get held up simply because we cannot verify anything without one. Three things worth knowing before you write: - If you could not confirm something, say so. "I could not verify this" is a good answer here and costs you nothing. A confident wrong number costs you the application. - Answers that read as AI written are not considered. We are not looking for polish. Four honest sentences beat a page of clean text. - We contact shortlisted applicants within 48 hours with one follow up question. If we do not hear back from you within two days, we move on.

description: Position Summary The Home Health Quality Assurance (QA) Registered Nurse is responsible for reviewing and auditing patient clinical records to ensure compliance with agency policies, payer requirements, and applicable regulations. Documentation Quality Assurance • Review and verify required documentation, including: ? History and Physical (H&P) ? Plan of Care (POC) ? Medication profiles ? Admission documentation ? Qualifications • Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing. • Minimum of 2 years of home health nursing experience preferred. • Previous Quality Assurance, clinical auditing, or chart review experience preferred. • Knowledge of home health regulations, documentation standards, and payer requirements. • Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR) systems. Creating exception alerts for missing records, duplicate transactions, failed imports, and inconsistent balances. Replacing manual spreadsheet processes with controlled applications and automated workflows. Documenting current systems, data flows, dependencies, and technical risks. Models must not use protected characteristics or unlawfully discriminatory variables. A reliable backup internet connection. Reliable electrical service and backup power. A private and secure workspace. A professional headset and webcam. title: Video Editor - Real Estate
description: To apply, complete the Google Form linked in this posting. ---------- Applications submitted directly through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed. ABOUT ALLISON MEDIA CO. Allison Media Co. is a premium real estate media company serving high-performing agents and developers across Ontario — from Niagara to Toronto. We produce photo, video, aerial, and marketing content that helps properties sell and brands stand out. We're growing fast. Volume is up. Our standard is high. And we need editors who can keep up. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS This isn't a filler role. We have real estate shoots happening daily and a growing backlog of video content that needs to be edited to a premium standard — fast. The edit is where the brand lives. Every video we deliver goes to an agent's listing, a developer's launch, or a brand's social presence. Your work directly impacts how our clients are perceived and how our business grows. We need someone who can jump in, learn the standard quickly, and start cutting clips that are clean, consistent, and on-brand — immediately. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING This is a high-volume, high-standard editing role. You'll be responsible for: Editing 3–5 real estate video packages per day Working primarily in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve Following AMC's editing style, pacing, and color guidelines Catching your own errors before files are submitted for review Organizing and managing your own project files cleanly Communicating clearly with the lead editor and owner on status and flags Improving your output quality continuously based on feedback HOW YOU WIN HERE You'll know you're succeeding when: Your edits are consistently clean and require minimal revisions You're hitting turnaround targets without sacrificing quality The team trusts your files without needing to double-check everything Your output is improving week over week Clients are proud to post what we deliver REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: Real estate video editing experience — you must have a portfolio that proves it Proficiency in Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve Strong understanding of pacing, color, and storytelling for property video Ability to work full-time immediately upon hiring Reliable internet, computer, and professional editing setup Strong written English for team communication High attention to detail — you catch mistakes before anyone else does Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously without losing quality WHO THIS IS FOR You've edited real estate content before and you're good at it You work fast without getting sloppy You take feedback seriously and apply it on the next edit, not the one after You want consistent full-time volume, not sporadic freelance work You're self-directed — you don't need to be told what to do next You care about the quality of your work, not just getting files out the door WHO THIS IS NOT FOR Editors without real estate experience Anyone who avoids feedback or gets defensive about revisions People who ship 'good enough' work Freelancers looking for passive, low-commitment work Anyone who needs constant direction to stay on task COMPENSATION Starting Rate: $6–$10 CAD per hour, based on experience and portfolio quality Growth: Performance-based — not time-based. title: Instagram Content Creator / Brand Designer – Creative Ownership
job_title: Instagram Content Creator / Brand Designer – Creative Ownership
description: Instagram Content Creator + Brand Designer We’re looking for a talented creative to take ownership of building the Instagram presence for VSN Quest, a branding company that helps businesses look more professional, credible, and trustworthy. Our primary focus is branding and rebranding: logos, visual identity, websites, landing pages, and branded materials. We already have a large library of logos, designs, branding projects, and visual assets organized in a Google Photos album. Your job is to turn those assets into a strong Instagram presence. CREATIVE OWNERSHIP We are not looking for someone who needs to be told: “Use this logo.” “Make a post about this.” “Put this text here.” We want someone who can review our assets, understand the business, and independently determine: What we should post What the feed should look and feel like What content categories make sense How to creatively repurpose our existing work How to make the account feel cohesive and professional Our main goal is TRUST. When a potential customer visits VSN Quest, we want them to think: “These people understand branding. I would trust them with my business.” Static posts and carousels are completely fine. We currently have more design assets than video content. INITIAL PAID PROJECT The selected designer will receive $100 to create the first 9–12 Instagram posts and establish the initial visual and content direction for the account. For an experienced designer, we estimate this to be roughly a 10-hour project. If the project goes well, this can lead to ongoing paid work creating future VSN Quest content and maintaining the visual direction of the account. We would love to find someone we can continue working with long term. You do not need years of agency experience. We care much more about visual taste, creativity, initiative, and good judgment. SHORT CREATIVE TEST (Unpaid Test) Shortlisted candidates will receive access to a selection of real VSN Quest assets. We intentionally will not provide detailed creative direction. We will ask you to: 1. Create ONE Instagram post for VSN Quest. 2. Briefly explain where you would take the rest of the Instagram feed. TO APPLY Please send your portfolio or examples of Instagram/social media content you have created. Also answer: What tools do you primarily use? Have you built a visual style or Instagram feed for a brand before? Are you comfortable coming up with content ideas without receiving individual post instructions? Why do you think you would be a good fit for VSN Quest?

title: Referral Coordinator
description: We are seeking a New Patient Referral Coordinator to manage the intake of new patient referrals and calls. This remote position involves creating and documenting patient charts, scheduling appointments, and ensuring that all necessary paperwork and pre-visit requirements are completed in advance. The ideal candidate must have excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to follow protocols to ensure efficiency and accuracy in patient onboarding. Key Responsibilities New Patient Intake & Referral Management 1. Process all incoming patient referrals from providers, insurance companies, and patient self-referrals. 2. Document and create charts for all new patients in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. 3. Verify patient demographics, insurance details, and referral information for accuracy. 4. Schedule initial appointments based on provider availability and urgency of the referral. Pre-Visit Documentation & Coordination 1. Ensure all required paperwork and consents are completed before the patient’s appointment. 2. Obtain prior authorizations and referral approvals as needed for specialist visits. 3. Communicate with patients regarding appointment details, required forms, and any pre-visit instructions. 4. Coordinate with the front office and clinical team to ensure a smooth transition for the patient on the day of the visit. Patient Communication & Support 1. Serve as the primary contact for new patients, answering queries about their upcoming appointments. 2. Proactively follow up via phone calls, text messages, and emails to ensure all referrals are promptly processed, scheduled, and confirmed. 3. Provide clear guidance on what to expect during their visit and any required preparations. 4. Follow up with patients for paperwork, to confirm appointments and reschedule if necessary. Administrative & Compliance Tasks 1. Maintain accurate records of all referral sources, appointment statuses, and completed paperwork. 2. Ensure compliance with HIPAA and other confidentiality regulations in handling patient information. 3. Monitor referral trends and report any workflow inefficiencies to management. 4. Assist in resolving any scheduling conflicts or documentation gaps before the patient’s visit. 5. Actively communicate with the Referring Providers’ office in providing updates of the referral status. Qualifications & Skills 1. Prior experience in medical scheduling, patient referrals, or healthcare administration preferred. 2. Proficiency in EHR systems and strong data entry skills. 3. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with a patient-centered approach. 4. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities to manage a high volume of referrals efficiently. 5. Ability to follow strict checklists and protocols. 6. Familiarity with insurance verifications, prior authorizations, and medical terminology is a plus. Schedule & Work Environment 1. Complete remote, full-time position, working in US business hours. 2. Must have a reliable internet and electricity connection, appropriate equipment, and a quiet workspace to ensure professional and uninterrupted patient communication while working remotely. 3. Expected to manage a consistent volume of new patient referrals and documentation daily as per the company policy.

title: YouTube Video Editor & Content Specialist – Long-Form, Shorts & Content Repurposing
job_title: YouTube Video Editor & Content Specialist – Long-Form, Shorts & Content Repurposing
description: I’m looking for an experienced YouTube Video Editor & Content Specialist for an ongoing part-time role of approximately 12–15 hours per week to start. I create educational, motivational and personal development content, including interviews, podcast-style conversations and teaching videos. I have both a substantial existing content library and new content being created regularly. A major part of this role will be reviewing my existing video catalog and finding opportunities to turn older content into fresh, relevant YouTube videos, Shorts and clips. This is not just a technical editing position. I’m looking for someone who understands storytelling, pacing, audience retention, content repurposing and copywriting — someone who can recognize the strongest part of a conversation and turn it into content people actually want to watch. Important Requirement You must have a strong OnlineJobs.ph background verification score. Please do not apply if your profile is not well verified. Reliability, honesty and professionalism are extremely important to me because this is intended to become an ongoing working relationship. What You’ll Be Doing Repurposing My Existing Video Catalog A major part of your work will be reviewing older interviews, podcast episodes, teaching videos and other long-form content and identifying material that can be given a new life. I do not want someone who simply reposts old videos. I want someone who can look at existing content with fresh eyes and identify: Strong sections that could become new standalone YouTube videos Older 20–30 minute episodes that could become much stronger 8–15 minute videos Stories, lessons or teaching moments that can be pulled out and repackaged Segments that could become YouTube Shorts or Reels Older videos that need a stronger opening Opportunities for updated titles and thumbnail concepts Content that is still relevant and worth bringing back to the audience Multiple pieces of new content that could be created from one older video You should be comfortable working through a content library independently and making recommendations about what is worth repurposing. Editing New Content You will also edit newly recorded interviews, podcasts and teaching videos. This may include: Editing long-form YouTube videos Removing repetition, unnecessary explanations and slow sections Tightening the content without losing the message or personality Identifying the strongest opening or hook Improving pacing and audience retention Creating clean, professional edits without making the content feel overproduced Adding text, graphics, B-roll or visual changes where appropriate Creating Shorts and other short-form clips Identifying strong moments that could become separate pieces of content YouTube Copy & Content Support Strong written English is important. You may also help with: Writing compelling YouTube titles Writing descriptions Suggesting thumbnail wording Identifying searchable topics Basic YouTube SEO Repurposing selected content for other social platforms Helping organize a pipeline of older and new content I will also occasionally meet with you on Zoom to review videos, explain the audience and direction, and discuss what is working. The Person I’m Looking For I need someone who can think beyond: “Where should I make the cuts?” I want someone who watches a video and thinks: Where does this actually get interesting? Is the introduction too long? What would make someone want to keep watching? What can we remove without losing the message? Is there a better way to open this video? Could one interview become three or four separate videos? What section would make the best Short? Is there a strong story buried halfway through the conversation? What would make someone click on this topic today? You should have good judgment and be able to make recommendations rather than waiting for detailed editing instructions for every video. Skills I’m Looking For YouTube video editing Long-form video editing Content repurposing Podcast and interview editing YouTube Shorts / Reels Storytelling Audience retention Strong written English Copywriting YouTube titles and descriptions Thumbnail concept development Basic YouTube SEO Strong attention to detail Independent decision-making Experience with personal development, education, coaching, motivational or interview-based content would be an asset. You may use Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or another professional editing program. Hours & Ongoing Opportunity This is an ongoing role of approximately 12–15 hours per week to start. I have years of existing content as well as new material being created, so there is potential for the role to grow over time for the right person. I value someone who: Communicates clearly Meets deadlines Takes ownership of their work Can work independently Is comfortable making recommendations Is interested in improving over time Wants a stable, ongoing working relationship To Apply Please do not send a generic application. At the very top of your application, write: The first 30 seconds matter. Applications that do not include this sentence will not be considered. Please include: Links to 3 YouTube videos you personally edited. Long-form examples are especially helpful. An example of a Short or Reel you created from longer content, if available. An example of older content you have repurposed into something new, if you have one. Tell me what you think makes viewers stop watching a YouTube video. If I gave you a 30-minute interview, tell me how you would d ---------- what should be removed. Tell me how you would approach reviewing a large library of older videos to d ---------- what should be repurposed. Tell me about your experience writing YouTube titles, descriptions or thumbnail copy. Tell me which editing software you use. Tell me your hourly rate in Canadian dollars (CAD). Confirm that you are available for approximately 12–15 hours per week. Please confirm that your OnlineJobs.ph profile has a strong background verification score. Please also tell me briefly what interests you about working with educational, motivational and personal development content.

title: Full-Time Customer Service Agent (E-commerce)
description: Full-Time · Long-Term · Philippines (Remote) Pay: $5.00–$7.00 USD/hour depending on experience Schedule: 40 hrs/week over 5 days, US Eastern Time — see "The honest version" below Type: Full-time, exclusive employment Start: Paid 2-week trial ? permanent Before you apply We're hiring one person for a role we want to be someone's home for years — not a gig, not a rotating bench of freelancers. That means a stable schedule, a fair rate paid on time, real benefits, and room to grow. In return, we're looking for someone who's genuinely happy doing this work well, day in and day out. This post is longer and more detailed than most, on purpose. We'd rather tell you exactly what the job is — the good and the hard parts — so you can d ---------- honestly whether it fits your life. The best hires we've ever made are the ones who read all of this, recognized themselves in it, and thought "yes, that's me." If that's you, we'd love to hear from you. The honest version of this job The schedule is US Eastern hours, 5 days a week — roughly 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time, with two days off. That's standard for most VA roles, so it may already be your normal. Some of your working days may fall on weekends; we'll agree your fixed days off together so you can plan your life around them. It's the same work most days. Order status. Where's my package. Refund requests. Warranty claims. Someone who is angry about something that isn't your fault. The variety is in the people, not the tasks. If you need novelty to stay engaged, you'll be unhappy here. You'll have a team around you. Two other support specialists work these same hours from the Philippines, and you'll report to our Customer Service Manager, who works alongside you on a similar schedule. You won't be isolated — you'll have people to ask, learn from, and lean on. We still need someone self-motivated: the best people here do careful, honest work because they take pride in it, not because someone is standing over them. You will be measured. Response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction — reviewed with you weekly for the first month, then monthly. You'll always know where you stand. You will never be surprised by feedback. What you'll actually do - Answer customer emails, live chat, phone calls, and social media DMs/comments - Look up and process orders in Shopify; track shipments; proactively update customers when something is late - Issue refunds, handle returns and warranty claims, and de-escalate complaints - Keep customer and order records accurate — including logging issues we should fix upstream - Answer product questions and make simple recommendations - Flag patterns: if five people ask the same question this week, we want to hear about it What we need from you - Based in the Philippines, working from a quiet space with fiber internet (25 Mbps+ real speed, not advertised speed) - This is your only job. Not your main job — your only one. We pay a fair full-time rate, on time, and treat this as a real career, so that's a reasonable ask - Hands-on Shopify admin experience. Not "familiar with." You should be able to find a partial refund option without a tutorial - At least 1 year in e-commerce or BPO customer support, ideally for a US or Canadian brand - Excellent written English — this is most of the job. Your writing should sound like a warm, competent human, not a template - Comfortable on the phone with North American customers - A backup plan for power and internet. A UPS or power bank plus a mobile data plan is the minimum — this is your responsibility to have in place - Willing to provide two references we can actually call, including a direct supervisor - When you apply, the first word of your email subject line must be BLUEBERRY. What we offer - $5–7 USD/hour depending on experience, paid every two weeks via Wise, on time, without exception - Paid training during your first two weeks - 13th month pay - 5 days paid time off per year after your first year - Reviewed for a raise at 6 months and annually after that — good work gets paid for, you won't have to ask - A defined role with written processes, not a chaotic "wear all the hats" situation How to apply - Follow every instruction in this post — including the one that isn't in this section. We use this as our first filter, and most applications are eliminated here. Send us: 1. Your resume and two references (name, role, company, and a working phone or WhatsApp number for each — we do call them). 2. A short written test. Below is a real customer message. Write the reply you'd send, in 150 words or less, plus two sentences on what you'd check in Shopify before sending it. "This is the THIRD time I'm writing. I ordered on the 4th, tracking hasn't moved in 9 days, and nobody has answered me. I needed this for a gift that was LAST WEEKEND. I want a refund and I want to know why nobody bothered to respond. Honestly considering just doing a chargeback." Write this yourself. We compare your writing to how you speak on video, and we can tell when they don't match. A real, human, slightly imperfect answer beats a polished AI one every time. 3. Your preferred working hours, in EST 4. Your expected hourly rate in USD. 5. A video (Loom or Google Drive, sharing enabled — test the link before you send it). Unedited, one take, 5 minutes or less. Applications without a video are not reviewed. Video questions: - Show us your workspace on camera right now. Run a live internet speed test on screen, and walk us through exactly what you do when the power goes out mid-shift. - Tell us one thing about Shopify that most support agents get wrong. Be as specific and technical as you like. - Describe a time you made a real mistake with a customer. What happened, what did it cost, and what did you change afterward? "I'm a perfectionist" answers get skipped. - Of every job you've had, which one did you do your best work at — and what about it made that possible? - What's the part of this job you think you'd struggle with most? What happens next 1. We review applications and reply to everyone who followed the instructions 2. Short interview call 3. Reference calls 4. Paid 2-week trial at full rate, real work, real feedback 5. Permanent offer

title: Technical Support Specialist
description: We’re hiring a Technical Support Specialist to bring a deeper technical knowledge to our support inbox. Someone who can help troubleshoot, triage, manage, and respond to technical support requests from our amazing clients. Read more about what we’re looking for below! Are you someone who is… - Perceptive and Practical: You can look at a broken automation and start forming a hypothesis before you’ve finished reading the ticket. You triage fast and prioritize well. - Intentional: You don’t just fix, you document. You create order so the next person (or future you) isn’t starting from zero. - A skilled communicator: You can translate a technical problem into plain language for a client without making them feel talked down to. Your written communication is clear, warm, and professional. - Detail-oriented: You notice when something is off. You don’t close a ticket until the fix actually holds. - Self-directed: We’re a small, remote team. You’ll have context and support, but you won’t have someone checking over your shoulder. That should feel freeing, not scary. About STRING Marketing STRING is a vibrant and growing digital marketing team dedicated to balancing excellence in our work and in our lives. We put people first in all we do. This means we value our clients and their dreams over formulas or technologies. And we value our lives, relationships and workday joy over pure profit. STRING team members are vested. We build long-term partnerships with our clients and with one another. Also, we laugh. A lot! We experiment. We occasionally fall on our faces and get up with better ideas than ever. We value growth, but we do it together. We value success, but only if we get to be honest and authentic along the way. If this sounds lightweight and mushy, not so. Each of us brings decades of solid digital marketing and technology experience to the table. We join up knowing our stuff and with the habit of pushing our skills and knowledge forward. This is one of those teams where everyone can operate with autonomy, but we work together because it’s better that way. So, if you sign on, you won’t get any hand-holding, but we might all just hold hands. Awwww. : ) But, seriously, what do we DO? STRING provides branding, marketing, and technology services to Registered Dietitians across the US and Canada. We deliver value-packed projects that launch and build RDN careers. Our process starts with a Connected Practice Audit and ends with a ready-to-launch CRM or website and marketing support materials. After the project, we continue to help our clients with hosting, design, content development, and general marketing and technical support. About the role: We are looking for a technically sharp support specialist with a deep level of understanding of GoHighLevel and someone who knows their way around n8n and APIs. You’ll own our support inbox by triaging incoming client tickets, troubleshooting GHL issues, and resolving or escalating to the senior or development teams with the right context already assembled for handoff. You’ll also create documentation and process maps so the team isn’t rebuilding knowledge from scratch every time a problem comes up. This role is critical to one of our core beliefs: to serve our clients with excellence. As we’ve onboarded clients for more complex projects, there’s been a gap in knowledge when they shift over to support and our senior team’s time is better spent building and strategizing than fielding repetitive technical questions. You’re the person who changes that. This is a part-time contractor position with real room to grow as we do. We’re looking for someone collaborative, engaged, and fast-learning, with outstanding written and oral customer-facing communication skills. How does this look on a given day? You’ll start by reviewing the support inbox and triaging anything that came in overnight. Some tickets you’ll resolve directly. What You'll Do - Design and build an automated pipeline using workflow/automation tools (e.g., Clay, Zapier/Make, PhantomBuster, Instantly) to track ICP job-change signals. - Integrate pre-outreach warming mechanisms across ad platforms and LinkedIn engagement before cold email sequences trigger. - Chain multi-tool architectures and logic to ensure data flows reliably across signal identification, social engagement, and email delivery. - Own the entire technical setup over a 3–4 month build while working independently in a fast-paced, async environment. What Success Looks Like - A fully operational, end-to-end automated GTM pipeline delivered within the target timeline. - Increased cold outreach response rates resulting from prospects recognizing the brand across channels prior to email contact. - Reduced manual sales-ops effort through seamless multi-tool trigger logic and data routing. Nice to Have - Experience in B2B SaaS or complex, multi-touch B2B sales cycles. - Sharable case studies or architecture diagrams of previously built automated GTM pipelines. Logistics - Location: Remote - Work Style: Async / High-Ownership - Weekly Hours: 20 hours/week - Focus or Expectation: Build-focused technical execution, complex workflow logic, and independent project ownership. How to Apply To apply, send a message with the subject line: GTM Engineer - [Years of Experience] Include the following: - An answer to this question: "What is the hardest problem that you've solved as it pertains to this role?" Your answer must cover the context, your specific actions, and the results. Limit your response to a maximum of three paragraphs. - Visit this link and tell us what animal is shown in the image: ---------- Applications that skip these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
job_title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description: READ THIS FIRST We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California. This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment. This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here. On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here. If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work. THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT OR A SALE. OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses). 13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top. --- ABOUT THE COMPANY You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years. The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked. A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time. We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't. --- WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support. Daily: - Call new Facebook/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day) - Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time. - Respond to inbound SMS, Facebook ---------- , and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them - Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel - Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar - Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs - Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM) - Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers Weekly: - One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min) - Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings - Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them During training (first 2–4 weeks): We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence. --- A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY) We use a script. We also need you to think. Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words. Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment. This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you. Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works. If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well. --- SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES) All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning. - US workdays: Monday through Friday - US days off: Saturday and Sunday - Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call) - Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March): Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT - A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time - A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time - Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night) Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November): - Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT - Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit. Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying. --- COMPENSATION Base pay: $900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month. 13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000. Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly): - $3 per new client showed appointment - $2 per existing client showed appointment - $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon) Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly): - +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month - +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month - +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month Worked examples: Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 (midpoint) - Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90) - Threshold bonus: $75 - Total: ~$1,250/month Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 - Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120) - Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150) - Total: ~$1,475/month Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked): - Base: $1,000 - Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking) - Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350) - Total: ~$2,025/month This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role. --- OTHER BENEFITS 1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year 2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can. 3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation. To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form --- TARGET KPIs - Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+ - Show Rate: 90%+ - Bookings per day: 4–9 - Showed appointments per month: 100–160 - Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit. --- WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Background: - Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders. - Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required. Non-negotiable skills: The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for: - Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role. - Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings. - Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going. - Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe. - Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists. Everything else: - ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier. - STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work. - Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application. - Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind. - Script discipline for the structured parts of the call. - Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused. - Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified. - Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising. - Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean: - Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire. - Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop - Mouse - Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods. - Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls. - Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients. Preferred: - Second monitor - You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster) --- DO NOT APPLY IF: - You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait. - You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it. - You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next. - You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking. - You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale. - Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker - You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast. - You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure - You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating" - You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it" - You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term - You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation --- HIRING PROCESS 1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions 2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner 3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay 4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion 5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7 6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance --- HOW TO APPLY Submit your application through this Tally form: | ---------- | IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience. The form will ask for: - A screenshot of your typing test results ( ---------- ) - A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net) - A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor) - A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages - A few short questions to gauge fit - A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) - A short Loom video introducing yourself Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form. --- Looking forward to meeting the right person. Ethan Founder, Midnight Siren --- Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind. - Script discipline for the structured parts of the call. - Natural call control. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. title: Apparel Graphic Designer (Hand Illustration) for US Coastal Lifestyle Brand. Paid Test Project, Then Ongoing Work.
job_title: Apparel Graphic Designer (Hand Illustration) for US Coastal Lifestyle Brand. Paid Test Project, Then Ongoing Work.
description: I run ATEOTD, a coastal lifestyle apparel brand in the US. Think of brands like Vuori, Faherty, and Quicksilver: quiet, premium, restrained. Small placements, limited ink colors, nothing loud. The brand has a second layer. Our phrases come from scripture, but they are chosen so that a stranger with no faith background would read them as simply well written. We never print verse citations on garments. If a design feels "churchy," it has failed. If it feels like a great vintage surf graphic that happens to carry weight, it has succeeded. I am hiring one illustrator, starting with a single paid test design. If the work is strong, this becomes ongoing per-design work. I only run one design at a time, and I am honest with you up front: I am picky. What I offer in return is clear briefs, fast decisions, and steady work if we fit. The Work Hand-illustrated graphic tees. Surf, and minimal coastal styles. Designs print DTG on garment-dyed tees, so: Maximum 2 to 3 ink colors per design No fine details below roughly 1.5mm (they will not print reliably) Designs must work on muted garment colors (dusty blue, khaki, seafoam) Hard Requirements No AI-generated artwork. None. Not as a base, not "cleaned up," not for reference compositing. Original illustration only. I will ask to see process work (sketches, WIP screenshots) and I check. Editable source files. Layered Adobe Illustrator files (vector, with both outlined and live-text versions where type is used), plus print-ready PNG at 300 DPI on transparent background. You must be comfortable working from written briefs in English. Sample Brief (this is the actual test design) Phrase: "Let the sea roar" Direction: A contained emblem in the retro surf style: an ocean scene built from flat, layered organic shapes inside an arch frame. A breaking wave as the focal point, a low sun, and a simple horizon. Four flat ink colors maximum, drawn from a muted coastal palette (dusty blue, sage, ochre, cream). No gradients, no outlines doing heavy lifting, no fine detail. The phrase is part of the lockup, either arced along the inside of the frame or set beneath the scene like a badge, never floating as a caption. A slight handmade quality at the edges is welcome; sterile vector perfection is not. Back print, roughly 10 to 12 inches tall Three links to hand-illustrated apparel or print work you made (not a full portfolio dump, your three best) Two or three sentences on your illustration process, including what tools you draw in Confirmation that you understand and agree to the no-AI rule How many days you would need for the test design Applications that skip these steps will not get a reply.

description: ABOUT THE BUSINESS I am Mike Thompson, owner of SelfCare Sustained LLC, a health-coaching and wellness-education business based in Georgia, USA. I am a Precision Nutrition Level 1 Certified Coach, newspaper wellness columnist, author, speaker and water-fitness instructor. We help people improve their nutrition, movement, sleep, stress recovery and overall Deep Health. I already have articles, coaching frameworks, videos, program materials and a GoHighLevel account. I need a dependable implementation assistant who can organize the technology, build a coherent lead-generation system and keep it operating. This is not a position for someone to invent my health opinions or business strategy. I will provide the coaching direction and approve the content. Your job is to turn approved plans and content into functioning systems. THE PRIMARY MISSION Your first major assignment will be to build and maintain one complete lead pathway: Deep Health Scorecard landing page → form → tags → GoHighLevel pipeline → five-email nurture sequence → appointment calendar → follow-up The system must work correctly from beginning to end and be simple enough for me to understand and use. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. GoHighLevel implementation * Audit and organize my existing GoHighLevel account * Build and maintain landing pages, forms, tags, pipelines and calendars * Create and troubleshoot email and SMS workflows * Load approved email copy and schedule campaigns * Test every automation before launch * Identify broken links, missed triggers, duplicate workflows and delivery problems * Keep the system organized and documented * Provide simple screen-recorded explanations of completed work 2. Website and lead-generation support * Connect landing pages, forms and calls to action * Make basic website updates * Check mobile display, links and forms * Help build the Deep Health Scorecard lead flow * Later, help create a program waitlist * Track where leads come from and where they stop in the process 3. Content implementation I will normally record one 8–12-minute teaching video each week. You will: * Create approximately three short, captioned clips using CapCut or a similar tool * Load and schedule approved social-media content * Format approved articles, emails and posts * Create simple, on-brand graphics when needed * Never invent or publish my health opinions without my approval 4. Lead and inquiry follow-up * Send approved responses to routine inquiries * Update contact records and pipeline stages * Make sure interested people receive timely follow-up * Refer all medical, medication, marital, grieving, crisis-related, angry or otherwise sensitive messages directly to me * Never diagnose, prescribe, promise a cure or suggest that health coaching replaces medical care 5. Daily communication At the end of every working day, send this three-bullet report: * DONE TODAY: * STUCK ON: * NEED FROM MIKE: Dependable communication is essential. If you encounter a problem, report it promptly, document what you tried and continue with another useful task whenever possible. Going silent is not acceptable. Honest, timely communication is always better than pretending everything is fine. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Please apply only if you have personally built and troubleshot systems inside GoHighLevel. You should be able to demonstrate experience with several of the following: * GoHighLevel funnels and landing pages * Forms, tags and pipelines * Calendars and appointment workflows * Email and SMS automations * Workflow testing and troubleshooting * Domain or website connections * Contact management * CapCut or similar short-video editing * Canva * Google Drive, Docs and Sheets * Loom or another screen-recording tool You do not need to know every tool perfectly. However, you must be able to learn independently, communicate honestly and show which GoHighLevel systems you have personally built. THE PERSON I AM LOOKING FOR You are: * Dependable and consistent * Honest when you make a mistake or do not know something * Comfortable asking clear, organized questions * Able to troubleshoot before requesting help * Careful with private business and client information * Able to follow written instructions * Willing to document your work * Interested in a stable, long-term role * Respectful of a health-coaching business grounded in integrity, service, excellence and faith-informed purpose * Comfortable working within ethical, evidence-informed coaching boundaries SCHEDULE, COMMUNICATION AND HEALTHY WORKING HOURS This is initially a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week. My time zone is U.S. Eastern Time. Important schedule information: * I am normally unavailable from 7:00–11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on weekdays. * I am generally available to answer questions and review work between 11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. Eastern Time. * Preferred live Zoom windows are 5:00–7:00 a.m. or 5:00–7:00 p.m. Eastern Time. * I do not expect you to work overnight or remain available throughout my entire workday. * I do not want you sacrificing adequate sleep or damaging your health to maintain this position. * Much of the work can be completed independently during hours that are healthy and sustainable for you. * We will agree in writing on one dependable daily overlap or reporting window. * In your application, state the specific Eastern Time window you can consistently maintain without disrupting your normal sleep schedule. Reliable communication matters more than working the same hours I work. PAY AND TRIAL PROCESS Starting compensation is $400–$600 USD per month for approximately 20 hours per week, depending on demonstrated GoHighLevel experience and ability. The selection process will be: 1. Written application 2. Approximately 15-minute Zoom interview for selected candidates 3. The same paid three-hour skills test for three finalists 4. Payment of $35 USD for the test, paid regardless of whether you are selected 5. The selected candidate begins a 30-day working trial 6. Performance and compensation review after 30 days 7. Opportunity for a stable, long-term role and increased responsibility if the relationship is successful Approximately 10% of the role may include paid training in my coaching philosophy, audience, marketing approach, content standards and business systems. PAID SKILLS TEST Finalists will receive identical instructions and source material. The test will involve building a small GoHighLevel workflow with dummy contacts. It may include: * Creating a form * Applying a tag * Moving the contact into a pipeline * Sending a confirmation email * Creating an owner notification * Testing the complete workflow * Recording a short walkthrough * Submitting the daily three-bullet report APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Begin your application with these exact words: DEEP HEALTH GHL Applications that do not begin with those words may not be reviewed. Finish this sentence honestly: “The last time a client stopped hearing from me, it was because…” Also include: * Your current internet speed * Your backup plan for power or internet interruptions * A link to a short screen recording showing a GoHighLevel system you personally built, if available * Your desired monthly compensation for 20 hours per week * Your earliest available starting date * Whether you currently work for other clients and during what hours * The normal working schedule you would prefer for this position Please do not submit a generic cover letter. I am more interested in specific, honest answers than polished marketing language. If you are technically capable, communicate reliably and want to help build a meaningful health-coaching business for the long term, I look forward to hearing from you. Mike Thompson SelfCare Sustained LLC Richmond Hill, Georgia, USA

description: FULL-ARCH CALL CLOSER GnA Consulting · The Conversion Lab · Remote Salary. $1,200 to $1,600 per month, paid on the 1st and the 15th, every time. ABOUT THE WORK We work with dental practices in the United States. You'll be the first human a patient talks to after they raise their hand about full-arch implant treatment. These are not small decisions. Most of the people you call have struggled with their teeth for years. They're embarrassed. They're scared of the procedure. They've been quoted a number that frightened them. Some have already been to another office and walked out. Your job is to understand the person behind the inquiry, find what's actually in the way, and help the ones who should move forward commit to showing up. This is not a call center seat and it is not a script. We train people in frameworks, not lines. You'll have to listen, think and lead the conversation in real time. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Call people who've asked about full-arch implant treatment, and build trust on the first call • Ask real discovery questions and find what's actually driving the inquiry • Read emotional cues and change your approach when the person needs something different • Handle fear, embarrassment and money without flinching and without pushing • Talk about financing and monthly payments with confidence • Book the consultation, then build enough commitment that they actually show • Follow up by phone, text and email with the people who aren't ready yet • Keep clean CRM notes. Every call, every time. • Sit in weekly call reviews and role-play, and put the coaching into the next call WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR Three things, and we test all three before we ever get on a call with you. Empathy. You can connect with what somebody is going through. You don't say "I'm sorry to hear that" and move to the next question. Emotional intelligence. You know when to slow down, when to be quiet, when to reassure, and when to stop asking and start leading. Critical thinking. You can take everything a patient just gave you, work out what's really in the way, and d ---------- what to do next without a script telling you. WHAT SUCCESS SOUNDS LIKE You can take a call with someone who says any of these: "I can't afford this." "I've already been somewhere else." "I need to talk to my spouse." "I'm scared of going through the procedure." "I've been embarrassed about my teeth for years." and you know each one is a different conversation. WHAT WE REQUIRE • Real time in a sales seat. You've handled objections and carried a number. High-ticket, healthcare or consultative selling is a plus. The instinct matters more than the industry. • Near-native spoken English. Clear and neutral. You can command a call in English the way you could in your first language. We assess this from your recording, not your resume. • A quiet workspace, a headset and a stable wired connection. Mobile data and pocket WiFi won't work for this role. • Coachability. We record calls and review the hard ones together every week. If that sounds like a problem, this isn't the seat. Dental experience is preferred and not required. We'd rather train someone with exceptional communication, empathy and judgment than hire someone who knows dental words. THIS IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF • You need to read a script word for word • You get lost when a conversation doesn't follow the expected path • Talking about money makes you uncomfortable • You go passive the moment someone objects • You think the job is done when the appointment is booked HOW TO APPLY Read all four steps. Applications that skip a step aren't reviewed. 1. Record one voice clip answering all three scenarios below. Use ---------- . It's free, needs no account, and works on a phone. Paste the link into your application. Respond exactly as you would if the patient were on the line right now. Don't tell us what you would say. Say it. Take a few seconds between each one. Scenario A. The patient says: "My son passed away two years ago." Scenario B. The patient says: "Another office wanted $79,000. I don't have that kind of money." Scenario C. The patient says: "I'm sick of these dentures. When can I come in?" One take. No script, and please don't use AI to write your answers. AI will give you good wording and lose your voice, and your voice is the entire thing we're listening for. There are no perfect answers here. 2. Answer this one question in writing. Be specific. At your highest-volume phone job: how many dials a day, how many real conversations, and what did you do in the ten seconds right after someone hung up on you? 3. Use 10 Apply Points on this application. 4. Start your application with the words FULL ARCH so we know you read to the end. We reply to everyone who completes all four steps.

title: Operations & Customer Service Coordinator

Primary Responsibilities General Inbox Management Continuously monitor the Range Mart general email inbox during working hours. Incoming messages commonly include: * Customer service questions * New customer orders * Existing order questions * Product availability questions * Shipping and delivery questions * Requests for invoices or order documentation * Vendor invoices * Vendor questions * General business correspondence Review, categorize, respond to, process, or escalate each message as appropriate. Maintain a clean inbox where unresolved messages represent actual outstanding work rather than accumulated email. Customer Service Respond professionally and promptly to customer inquiries by email and telephone. Typical responsibilities include: * Answering questions about existing orders * Checking sales order status * Checking shipment and delivery status * Providing invoices and other order documentation * Updating customer contact information * Communicating delays or outstanding requirements * Following up when additional information is needed from customers * Escalating technical, pricing, or unusual customer issues to management The coordinator should take responsibility for following an issue until it is resolved rather than simply forwarding it to another person. New Order Processing Process new orders received by email or telephone. Responsibilities include: * Review customer purchase orders * Verify customer information * Verify products, quantities, pricing, shipping instructions, and other order details * Create Sales Orders in ERPNext * Attach relevant customer documents to the transaction * Identify missing or conflicting information * Contact the customer when clarification is required * Notify management when pricing, credit, product availability, or another issue requires approval Accuracy is extremely important. Existing Order Administration Handle routine questions and administrative work related to open customer orders. This may include: * Reviewing Sales Orders in ERPNext * Checking fulfillment status * Communicating estimated shipment information * Updating customer information * Coordinating with internal staff * Sending order confirmations or invoices * Documenting customer correspondence * Following up on unresolved order issues Vendor Invoice / Accounts Payable Entry Monitor incoming vendor invoices received through the general inbox or designated accounting email. Responsibilities include: * Review vendor invoices for completeness * Identify the correct vendor * Enter vendor bills / Purchase Invoices into ERPNext * Enter invoice number, dates, terms, amounts, taxes, freight, and other required information accurately * Attach the original vendor invoice to the ERPNext transaction * Match invoices against Purchase Orders or supporting documents when applicable * Identify duplicate invoices * Identify discrepancies between invoices, purchase orders, or expected charges * Request missing information when necessary * Route unusual or questionable invoices for approval This role enters and organizes payables but does not independently authorize or send company funds. Telephone Support Answer or return routine Range Mart business telephone calls. Calls may include: * Customers placing orders * Customers checking existing orders * Shipping questions * Vendor inquiries * General customer service * Prospective customer inquiries Document important calls and enter resulting orders, notes, tasks, or follow-up actions into the appropriate system. Technical or complex sales questions should be escalated appropriately. ERPNext Responsibilities The coordinator will receive training in Range Mart’s ERPNext system. Typical ERPNext activities will include: * Customer records * Contact records * Sales Orders * Purchase Invoices * Purchase Orders * Sales Invoices * Order notes and attachments * Customer and vendor transaction history * Basic reporting and transaction searches Prior ERPNext experience is helpful but not required. Experience with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Odoo, Zoho, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or another ERP/accounting/CRM platform is valuable. What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate: * Has excellent spoken and written English * Is comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by telephone * Has previous customer service or administrative experience * Has experience entering financial or business transactions into software * Is extremely accurate with numbers and data entry * Writes professional, natural customer emails * Is comfortable learning new software * Understands basic business documents such as purchase orders, invoices, sales orders, and shipping documents * Can independently research an issue before asking for help * Has good judgment about when an issue should be escalated * Is reliable and consistently available during scheduled working hours * Takes ownership of unfinished work * Is comfortable working in a small business where responsibilities sometimes cross traditional job boundaries Most Important Trait: Ownership We are not looking for someone who simply completes a list of assigned tasks. We want someone who sees an incoming issue and thinks: “What needs to happen to get this completed?” For example: If a customer sends a purchase order with missing information, do not simply forward it. Identify what is missing, contact the customer, obtain the information, enter the Sales Order, and make sure the order is ready for the next step. If a vendor invoice does not match our records, investigate the discrepancy and prepare the issue for management rather than simply entering an incorrect invoice. Working Relationship This person will work closely with company management but should progressively become capable of independently handling the majority of routine administrative and customer service activity. A successful person in this position will ultimately become someone that customers, vendors, and Range Mart employees recognize as a dependable member of the Range Mart team. Application Instructions Please provide: 1. A brief description of your previous administrative and customer service experience. 2. Any experience you have with ERP, accounting, CRM, or order-management software. 3. Your experience handling customer email and telephone calls for U.S.-based businesses. 4. Your normal working hours and availability in U.S. Pacific Time. 5. Your desired hourly compensation. 6. A short 60–90 second video introduction so we can evaluate spoken English and telephone communication ability. Identify potential opportunities for additional patient referrals. Maintain accurate records of referral outreach and results. Maintain accurate lead and appointment information in the EHR/CRM. Track outstanding leads and follow-up activities. Assist the administrative team with scheduling changes, cancellations, and rescheduling. Maintain organized electronic records.
