Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Professional and friendly telephone presence. Comfortable making outbound calls. Strong follow-up skills and persistence. Highly organized and detail-oriented. Ability to work independently without constant supervision. Reliable internet connection and appropriate home-office environment. Proficient with email, Google Workspace/Microsoft Office, and basic computer systems. Ability to learn an EHR and CRM system quickly. Comfortable working with performance goals and activity metrics. Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements. Preferred Experience Preference may be given to candidates with experience in: Psychiatry or behavioral health Medical offices Healthcare scheduling Patient intake Medical sales Lead generation Appointment setting Referral development TMS Spravato Medication management Insurance-based healthcare Behavioral Health & Compliance Requirements Because this position involves communication with individuals seeking psychiatric care, the Virtual Assistant must maintain a high level of professionalism, compassion, and confidentiality. I need one person to own the editing and posting end to end so that all I have to do is record. What you will do Edit my long-form YouTube videos. This is the main job. Cuts, pacing, b-roll, on-screen text, thumbnails, and uploading with title, description, tags, chapters, and end screens. Run short-form through Opus Clip. Opus Clip handles the captions and most of the clipping. Your job is quality control on what it produces: every clip starts at the beginning of an idea and ends at the end of an idea, no cut-off first or last words, and nothing that makes no sense out of context. When Opus Clip picks a bad segment, you fix the in and out points or throw the clip out. Post the approved short-form to Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Facebook on the schedule we set. Keep a simple tracker of what is published and what is queued. Requirements Real experience editing YouTube videos. Not stock-footage reels, not wedding videos. YouTube. Links to actual published YouTube videos you edited. I will watch them. Tell me which parts were your work. Strong English comprehension. You have to hear where a thought starts and stops to judge a clip. Reliable internet and a machine that can handle 4K footage. Overlap with US Central time. Please answer these in your application Paste 3 to 5 links to published YouTube videos you edited. For each one, say what you did on it and roughly how long it took you. What editing software do you use, and what version? What plugins or presets do you rely on? What do you use for thumbnails? For captions on long-form? Have you used Opus Clip, Descript, or a similar AI clipping tool? Which one, and what do you fix by hand after it runs? Watch this video ---------- . Tell me the timestamp of one moment you would cut into a short, and why that exact in point and out point. How many videos per week can you handle? What is your rate, hourly or per video? Say which you prefer. Monitoring policy, so there are no surprises This is a monitored role. You will run time-tracking and screen-monitoring software during all paid hours. It records screenshots and activity while the timer is running. This is non-negotiable and applies from day one. If that is not something you are comfortable with, this is not the right job for you, and I would rather you skip applying than find out later. Time is tracked only while you are on the clock. You start and stop the timer yourself. Pay and terms Paid trial project first: one long-form edit plus five shorts. If it goes well, ongoing work.

You must have: * Reliable high-speed internet * Quiet workspace * Computer or laptop * Quality headset * Ability to work during U.S. business hours * Professional communication habits ## Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who brings great energy to every call, follows instructions, stays organized, and enjoys helping create sales opportunities for licensed producers. title: Legal Research Analyst
description: Engagement type: Freelance, project-based, remote Duration: Pilot project (3 states), then ongoing per-state engagements through completion of all US jurisdictions. About Cairnul Cairnul is agentic fundraising compliance infrastructure that runs a startup's early rounds end to end: SAFEs, advisor agreements, federal and state filings, and the records, deadlines, and governance behind them. We build for first-time founders raising their initial round under Reg D Rule 506(b) or 506(c). At the core of the product is a compliance library: researched, cited, state-by-state entries covering the securities and corporate law requirements a startup triggers when it raises. Our agents draft only from library entries that outside counsel has verified. If an entry is unverified or stale, the agent declines to draft. That constraint is the product. Your work is what makes it possible. The project Every state has its own rules for what a company owes when it sells securities to an investor who lives there: notice filings, fees, deadlines, filing methods, renewal requirements. Roughly 46 states enforce a notice filing for Rule 506 offerings, and the details vary widely. Layered on top are corporate law requirements in key states: board authorization, consent formalities, interested-director rules. We are building a complete, structured, citation-backed library of these requirements. Your job is to research each state from primary sources, capture the findings in Cairnul's standardized entry format, and produce entries clean enough that a reviewing securities attorney can verify them efficiently. You research and document. Counsel verifies. Nothing ships until counsel signs off. What you'll do -Research state securities law requirements for Reg D Rule 506(b) and 506(c) offerings from primary sources: state statutes, administrative codes, securities regulator websites, and official filing systems (EFD and state-specific portals) -Research state corporate law requirements relevant to early-stage fundraising in designated states: board consent formalities, authorization requirements, interested-director provisions -Capture findings in Cairnul's entry template: every fact tied to a pinpoint citation (statute or rule section) and a retrieval date -Record the practical mechanics, not just the law: filing method, fee amount, payment method, deadline trigger, renewal cycle, consequences of late filing as stated by the regulator -Flag ambiguities, conflicts between sources, and questions that require attorney judgment, rather than resolving them yourself -Note where a state's official guidance contradicts its statute, or where secondary sources disagree; these flags are part of the deliverable, not a failure of it -Revise entries based on feedback from Cairnul and, later, from reviewing counsel On AI tools: Using AI research assistants to find sources and accelerate the work is fine and expected. The rule is that every fact in a submitted entry must be verified by you against the primary source it cites. An AI-generated claim is a lead, not a finding. Deliverables For each assigned state: -A completed entry in Cairnul's template (provided), covering all required fields -A source log: every authority consulted, with URL, citation, and retrieval date -An open-questions memo: anything ambiguous, conflicting, or judgment-dependent, stated as a question for counsel An entry is complete when a securities attorney could verify it by checking your citations, without redoing your research. What we provide -A v1 entry template and field definitions. This is a first version; part of the pilot is telling us where it breaks against real state material -Prioritized state list and sequencing -Direct access to the Founder for scope questions, with fast turnaround How you'll work You are the research function, not a contributor to one. That means high ownership and high agency: you set your approach, you own the accuracy of every entry you submit, and your name is effectively on the library. The team is small and obsessive about detail; the product's core promise is that it never drafts from an unverified fact, and your work is where verification starts. You'll work directly with the Founder, who runs product, and coordinate with our two engineers on how entries map into the product's data structures. You'll also coordinate with a data engineer who builds the pipeline loading your verified entries into the product; your entries are captured in the structured template, so their work is plumbing, not editing your research. Once outside securities counsel is engaged, your entries go to them for verification and you'll field their questions directly. Clear, precise written communication with all of these audiences is part of the job. Who this is for Required: -Demonstrated legal research experience with US statutes and administrative codes: paralegal background, JD or JD candidate, law librarian, or equivalent freelance track record -Ability to read a blue sky statute and its implementing regulations and extract operative requirements accurately -Rigorous citation habits; you distinguish between what a statute says, what a regulator's FAQ says, and what a law firm blog says -Comfort saying "this is unclear" instead of guessing -Strong written English; entries are read by engineers and attorneys, so plain and precise beats formal Strongly preferred: -Prior work with securities law, Reg D, or blue sky filings specifically -Familiarity with the EFD system and state securities regulator websites Not required: -A license to practice law. This role does not provide legal advice or legal conclusions. You compile, cite, and flag. What this role is not -Not web scraping or data engineering. The work is reading and structured capture, done by a person, because accuracy is the point. -Not legal advice. You do not interpret close calls; you surface them for counsel. -Not content writing. Entries are structured records, not articles. Scope and structure Pilot: Three states assigned at the start, at full per-state rate. The pilot establishes format fit, accuracy, and pace, and it stress-tests the v1 entry template: we expect you to propose field changes where the template doesn't fit what states actually publish. Continuation is at Cairnul's discretion based on pilot quality. Ongoing: Remaining states assigned in batches, sequenced by Cairnul's priority list. Estimated total scope: 40 to 50 state entries. You control your schedule within agreed per-batch deadlines. Terms: Work for hire; all research product is assigned to Cairnul, Inc. A confidentiality agreement covers the engagement. Payment per completed, accepted entry. How to apply Send the following: -A short note on your relevant research background (no cover letter formalities) -One sample of prior legal research or citation-heavy analytical work Your answer to this screening question: What notice filing, if any, does the state of Texas require from an issuer selling securities under SEC Rule 506(b) to a Texas resident? Cite the specific authority and state your retrieval date. The screening question is representative of the work. An answer with a pinpoint citation and honest treatment of anything ambiguous will stand out more than a fast one.

Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the email flows — the video. That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. To be clear about what we're offering: Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works. Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors. We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time. You'll take a script and: Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it) Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats 3. Running Meetings -Chair or facilitate general meetings, or support the chairperson to do so -Confirm quorum and ensure the meeting is validly constituted -Manage the order of business, motions, debate and voting -Ensure procedural compliance with the Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA) and the scheme's by-laws -Manage difficult or contested meetings calmly and impartially -Attend meetings outside standard business hours where scheme requirements demand it 4. Minutes, Records and Follow-Through -Prepare accurate minutes recording motions, votes and resolutions -Distribute minutes to all owners within statutory and service timeframes -Maintain a resolution register tracking every decision made at every meeting -Refer financial resolutions to the Strata Manager — Finance and operational resolutions to the Assistant Strata Manager responsible for the scheme -Follow up to confirm resolutions have been actioned, and report exceptions -Ensure meeting records are filed correctly and are audit-ready in Urbanise 5. General Support and Flexibility -Assist the portfolio Assistant Strata Managers with maintenance coordination where required — logging jobs, obtaining quotes, following up contractors -Assist with owner correspondence and enquiry overflow during busy periods -Provide cover for team members during leave, absence or peak workload -Support the Strata Manager — Finance with levy distribution and administrative tasks where capacity allows -Assist with the onboarding of new schemes as directed -Undertake other reasonable duties within the strata division as directed by the Senior Strata Manager Skills and Attributes: -Experience in strata, body corporate, community title or a comparable governance or meetings environment -Working knowledge of the Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA), or demonstrated ability to acquire it quickly -Confident running a formal meeting — quorum, motions, procedure and voting -Calm and impartial when meetings become contested or emotional -Precise, clear written English; able to draft motions and minutes that stand up to scrutiny -Highly organised, with the discipline to work to fixed statutory deadlines across many schemes -Available to attend meetings outside standard business hours, with time off in lieu by arrangement -Flexible and willing to assist across the wider strata team between meeting cycles -SCA (WA) training or certification is well regarded; the business will support relevant training and any applicable regulatory or continuing education requirements Employment Salary and Benefits: -Immediate Start -Full-time, Monday-Friday 9:00AM to 5:30PM PH Time -Salary: $230 AUD per week -Benefit: 13th Month Pay **Working hours note: General meetings in strata are frequently held in the evening to suit owner availability. title: Google Ads Manager
description: Role Overview This role owns Google Ads end to end, across a full portfolio of client accounts. You are the only Google Ads person on the team, and you are trusted to make the strategic calls yourself. Nobody hands you a campaign structure or finished ad copy to load in. You build it! When a new client comes on board, you take it from kickoff to launch. You get them fully set up and you make every technical and strategic decision along the way. You work directly inside the accounts yourself. You are the point of contact for any question about an account you own. This role does not own client meetings or client reporting. Another team member handles the client relationship and report delivery. You are the strategic and technical engine behind the account, not the face of it. Core Responsibilities New Client Setup & Onboarding - Own full setup of new Google Ads clients from kickoff to launch, including CallRail tracking numbers, call forwarding and recording configuration, GA4, Search Console, Google Ads conversion tracking, and linking Google Business Profile(s) - Diagnose and fix conversion tracking issues yourself - Build campaign and ad group structure from a client kickoff, including keyword research and targeting strategy - Set up or coordinate landing pages for campaigns where a dedicated page will outperform sending traffic to the main site, thinking in terms of the full customer journey from ad click through conversion, not just the ad itself Hands-On Execution - Work directly inside Google Ads accounts yourself - Write original ad copy, headlines, and descriptions from scratch for new campaigns - Manage bids, budgets, and targeting adjustments based on your own read of the performance data - Proactively flag and act on optimization opportunities you notice, rather than waiting to be asked Other Platforms & Account Administration - Set up and manage campaigns on Microsoft Ads - Meta Ads and ChatGPT Ads may come up for specific clients. It's a plus if you're comfortable picking up a new ad platform's setup process on your own, without needing a step-by-step guide, but this is not required - Handle advertiser and business verification requirements across platforms - Take on adjacent account administration tasks as they come up. This role is not limited to a fixed task list Being the Point of Contact - Field questions about any account you own, from teammates or from the client directly over email, and give a clear, direct answer - Flag anything that genuinely needs escalation, but the default expectation is that you can answer the question yourself What This Role Does Not Own - Client meetings and report delivery stay with the founder and the client success lead. You are not expected to lead calls - Report automation is a separate, ongoing project. You are not building or maintaining the reporting system What We Offer - A real team, not a vendor relationship. You'll work directly with the people making decisions, not kept at arm's length because of where you're located - Real ownership. You're trusted to make the strategic calls yourself, not handed a task list to execute - Deep focus on one niche: home service and local service businesses, so you build real expertise instead of relearning a new industry with every account - A real standard for the work. We chase the 80/20 that actually drives results and stay current on where paid search is headed, not the same playbook we ran two years ago - A long-term, full-time seat on the team, not a per-project gig, with flexible, async-first hours - Competitive pay, with room to grow as your ownership grows Required Skills & Experience - 3+ years managing Google Ads independently, including a specific account where you changed strategy based on your own read of the data - Experience managing $5,000 to $20,000/month in combined ad spend across 5+ accounts, including setting up an account from scratch with conversion tracking - Comfortable writing ad copy from a blank page and picking up new ad platforms on your own - Hands-on with Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and CallRail, plus landing page setup and full-funnel thinking - Willing to push back on requests that aren't worth the effort, backed by data or reasoning - Strong written English for clear async communication - Home services experience and/or Meta Ads experience is a plus, though not required How This Role Will Be Measured - New clients launch on time, with conversion tracking validated before going live - You make optimization decisions proactively, not just when told to - Account questions get a clear, direct answer without needing to be escalated - You push back on weak ideas or requests, backed by reasoning - Multiple accounts run at once without missed deadlines or dropped issues

We don’t want another pair of hands. We want a brain. We want an operator. And, over time, we want a leader. THE MISSION Your mission is simple: MAKE OUR E-COMMERCE BUSINESS BETTER EVERY MONTH. Better conversion. Better merchandising. Better customer experience. Better retention. Better inventory visibility. Better systems. Better reporting. Better automation. Better execution. More profitable growth. Less unnecessary complexity. You will work directly with the CEO. Initially, your job will be to learn the business. Then improve it. Then take increasing ownership of it. Our long-term goal is for you to become the person responsible for the performance and operation of our entire digital business. We want to eventually reach the point where the CEO can ask: “What’s happening with digital?” And within five minutes you can explain: Here’s what happened. Here’s why it happened. Here’s what the numbers are telling us. Here’s what’s going wrong. Here’s what we’re fixing. Here’s what we’re testing. Here’s the opportunity I’ve found. And here’s what I need from you. That’s ownership. That’s the standard. WHAT YOU WILL OWN You will progressively take responsibility for the operation and performance of our e-commerce business. This will include: SHOPIFY & E-COMMERCE You should be extremely comfortable operating inside Shopify. You will manage and improve areas including: • Products • Collections • Navigation • Online merchandising • Promotions • Discounting • Landing pages • Product launches • Website content • Search and filtering • Product recommendations • Upsells • Cross-sells • Bundles • Shopify apps • Integrations • Mobile experience • Site usability • Website performance You do NOT necessarily need to be a developer. We can use developers when required. But you need to understand e-commerce and technology well enough to identify problems, propose solutions, write clear briefs and manage developers or agencies to get things done properly. CONVERSION RATE OPTIMISATION We don’t want someone who simply maintains a website. We want someone constantly asking: “HOW DO WE MAKE THIS PERFORM BETTER?” You should understand or be eager to master: • Conversion rate • Funnel analysis • Product page optimisation • Collection page optimisation • Cart abandonment • Checkout behaviour • Mobile UX • Landing page performance • A/B testing • Customer behaviour • Heatmaps • Session recordings • Offers • Bundling • Upselling • Cross-selling • Promotional strategy We want hypotheses. We want experiments. We want measurement. Opinions are useful. DATA IS BETTER. COMMERCIAL THINKING This is one of the most important parts of this role. E-commerce is not about making a website look pretty. It is about building a profitable business. You should understand, or be capable of quickly mastering: • Revenue • Gross margin • Contribution margin • Conversion rate • Average order value • Customer acquisition cost • ROAS • MER • Repeat purchase rate • Customer lifetime value • Returning customer rate • Refund and return rates • Discount performance • Product profitability • Category profitability • Inventory availability • Stock-outs You should be comfortable working with Shopify Analytics and ideally GA4. Eventually, we want you maintaining a simple CEO-level dashboard showing us exactly what matters. We do NOT want 50-page reports filled with numbers nobody uses. We want clarity. We want insights. We want the truth. And then we want action. EMAIL, SMS & CUSTOMER RETENTION Acquiring customers is expensive. Keeping good customers is extremely valuable. You should understand platforms such as Klaviyo or equivalent and be able to analyse and improve: • Welcome flows • Abandoned cart • Browse abandonment • Post-purchase communication • Win-back campaigns • Customer segmentation • Product recommendations • Promotional campaigns • Customer retention • Email deliverability • Campaign performance • Testing and optimisation If an agency or specialist manages some of these areas, that’s fine. But you will still need to understand the numbers. You should be capable of challenging an agency when performance isn’t good enough. DIGITAL MARKETING You do NOT necessarily need to personally operate every advertising campaign. We would rather have an excellent operator who knows how to manage specialists than someone mediocre at everything. However, you need to understand digital marketing well enough to recognise when something is working and when someone is wasting our money. Knowledge of the following is highly desirable: • Meta Ads • Google Ads • Google Shopping • Google Merchant Center • Product feeds • SEO • Retargeting • Attribution • Landing pages • Creative testing • Email marketing • SMS • Organic acquisition You may manage external agencies, freelancers and specialists. Their performance becomes part of your responsibility. RETAIL + E-COMMERCE We are not purely an online business. We also operate two physical retail stores. We believe online and offline retail should work together. You will help us identify opportunities involving: • Inventory visibility • Product availability • Stock-outs • Promotions • Customer databases • Click & collect • Store-to-online opportunities • Online-to-store opportunities • Customer experience • Product launches • Returns • Stock movement • Reporting We want ONE BUSINESS. Not an e-commerce business and two disconnected stores. AI, AUTOMATION & TECHNOLOGY This is extremely important to us. We believe exceptional operators in 2026 should be using AI and automation as leverage. We want someone genuinely curious about technology. You should already be experimenting with, or be excited to master, tools such as: • ChatGPT • Claude • AI agents • Workflow automation • Zapier • Make • Shopify automation • Reporting automation • AI-assisted analytics • AI-assisted merchandising • AI-assisted customer service • AI-assisted content creation But we’re not interested in using AI simply because AI is fashionable. We want you asking: “WHY IS A HUMAN STILL DOING THIS MANUALLY?” If something takes five hours every week and can safely be automated, we want you to identify it. If three systems should be communicating but aren’t, we want you to notice. If information is being copied manually from one spreadsheet to another, question it. Technology should create leverage. YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH THE CEO You will report directly to the CEO. We don’t want endless meetings. We don’t want bureaucracy. We don’t want activity reports telling us how busy everyone was. We care about outcomes. Your weekly CEO update should eventually answer six questions: 1. What happened? 2. What are the numbers telling us? 3. What’s going wrong? 4. What opportunities have you discovered? 5. What are you changing or testing? 6. What decisions do you need from the CEO? Simple. Clear. Commercial. Actionable. THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience matters. But HOW YOU THINK matters more. We are looking for someone who is: EXTREMELY CURIOUS You investigate things without being asked. COMMERCIALLY MINDED You understand that revenue without profit isn’t necessarily success. DATA DRIVEN You don’t hide behind opinions when evidence is available. RESOURCEFUL When you don’t know something, your first instinct is to figure it out. TECHNICALLY CONFIDENT New software doesn’t intimidate you. OBSESSED WITH IMPROVEMENT “That’s how we’ve always done it” is not an acceptable explanation. HIGHLY ORGANISED You can manage multiple projects without creating chaos. AN EXCELLENT COMMUNICATOR You can explain complicated problems simply. ACCOUNTABLE When something goes wrong, you don’t disappear or blame someone else. You investigate it. You solve it. And you build a system to reduce the chance of it happening again. PROACTIVE You bring opportunities to us instead of waiting for instructions. MOST IMPORTANTLY: YOU TAKE OWNERSHIP. WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY Please do NOT apply if: • You need someone to create a daily task list for you. • You routinely miss deadlines. • You disappear when something goes wrong. • You are uncomfortable being measured against results. • You exaggerate your skills on job applications. • You are secretly planning to work several full-time jobs simultaneously. • You think being busy is the same as being productive. • You dislike numbers. • You aren’t interested in learning new technology. • You need permission before investigating obvious problems. • You are looking for the easiest job you can find. • You want a comfortable position where nothing changes. There are plenty of jobs like that. THIS ISN’T ONE OF THEM. WHO SHOULD APPLY Apply if reading this job description makes you EXCITED rather than nervous. Maybe you’ve spent several years working on Shopify stores and realised you’re capable of contributing far more than your current employer allows. Maybe you’re already the person everyone turns to when something goes wrong. Maybe you’ve independently taught yourself analytics, CRO, automation, AI or digital marketing because you wanted to understand it. Maybe you’ve worked inside businesses and repeatedly thought: “IF SOMEONE GAVE ME THE AUTHORITY, I COULD MAKE THIS SO MUCH BETTER.” If that’s you, we want to meet you. EXPERIENCE WE VALUE Ideally, you have strong experience with several of the following: • Shopify • E-commerce operations • E-commerce management • Conversion rate optimisation • GA4 • Shopify Analytics • Klaviyo • Google Merchant Center • Meta Ads • Google Ads • SEO • Inventory management • Retail operations • Project management • Automation • AI tools • Managing agencies • Managing freelancers • Managing developers You do NOT need to tick every box. An exceptional person who learns incredibly quickly is more interesting to us than someone with 15 certificates and no initiative. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS — UNDERSTAND Learn the business. Understand our products. Understand our customers. Understand the website. Understand the numbers. Understand our physical stores. Understand our marketing. Understand our inventory. Understand our systems. Understand our problems. Identify quick wins. But don’t change things just to prove you’re doing something. Understand first. Then act. DAYS 30–90 — IMPROVE Establish useful reporting. Prioritise opportunities. Fix obvious problems. Start CRO testing. Improve merchandising. Improve retention. Improve workflows. Introduce useful automation. Document important systems. Start making measurable improvements. MONTHS 3–6 — OWN Take increasing ownership. You should increasingly become the person who understands our digital operation better than anyone else. Problems should begin reaching you before they reach the CEO. Opportunities should be identified before the CEO asks about them. MONTHS 6–12 — LEAD Become indispensable. Not because information is trapped inside your head. Quite the opposite. Become indispensable because you’ve built such good systems, reporting, processes and standards that the entire business operates better because you’re here. COMPENSATION & CAREER This is intended to be a FULL-TIME, LONG-TERM position. We are NOT looking for the cheapest person in the Philippines. Read that again. WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE CHEAPEST PERSON. We’re looking for the best person we can find. Compensation will reflect your capability, experience and the value you can create. For an exceptional candidate, we are prepared to pay exceptional compensation relative to the market. We also believe exceptional performance deserves exceptional rewards. For the right person, there will be opportunities for: • Salary progression • Performance bonuses • Increasing responsibility • Leadership • Professional development • Greater decision-making authority • Long-term career progression If you help us grow the business, we want your career and compensation to grow with it. This is not intended to be a 12-month stepping stone. For the right person, this could become a major chapter of your career. HOW TO APPLY READ THIS SECTION VERY CAREFULLY. We expect to receive many applications. We are deliberately making our application process different. DO NOT SEND US A GENERIC COVER LETTER. Please don’t tell us you’re: “Hard-working.” “Detail-oriented.” “A fast learner.” “A team player.” Almost everyone says these things. SHOW US. At the VERY BEGINNING of your application, write: BUILD, MEASURE, IMPROVE. Applications that don’t contain those exact words at the beginning will not progress. Why? Because attention to detail matters. Then answer ALL of the following questions. QUESTION 1 Why does THIS particular role interest you? Maximum 200 words. QUESTION 2 Tell us about the e-commerce business you’re most proud of working on. What was your responsibility? What did YOU personally change? What measurable result occurred? Be specific. QUESTION 3 Tell us about something you improved without being asked to improve it. What did you notice? What did you do? What happened? QUESTION 4 Tell us about a mistake you made that cost a business money or caused a significant problem. We don’t expect perfection. We do expect honesty. What happened? What did you learn? What system did you introduce to reduce the chance of it happening again? QUESTION 5 Give us an example where DATA changed your opinion. What did you originally believe? What did the numbers show? What did you do differently? QUESTION 6 What is one repetitive e-commerce task you believe businesses should no longer be doing manually in 2026? Explain exactly how you would automate it. QUESTION 7 What AI tools are you currently using? Tell us specifically HOW you use them. We’re not interested in simply hearing: “I use ChatGPT.” Tell us what you’ve actually built, automated, analysed or improved. QUESTION 8 SCENARIO: You become responsible for our Shopify business tomorrow. You discover: Traffic is increasing. Revenue is flat. Advertising spend is increasing. Conversion rate has fallen. Customers are complaining that popular products are frequently unavailable. What are the FIRST FIVE THINGS you investigate? Put them in order. Explain WHY you chose that order. QUESTION 9 What is something you taught yourself during the last 12 months that your employer never asked you to learn? Why did you learn it? How have you used it? QUESTION 10 Complete this sentence: “If I owned this business, the first thing I would want to understand is __________ because __________.” BONUS QUESTION You have 15 minutes with our Shopify store, without access to the backend or our internal data. What would you investigate before speaking with the CEO? Tell us exactly what you would look at and why. IMPORTANT APPLICATION RULES Do NOT use AI to manufacture impressive answers that aren’t true. We expect good candidates to use AI. In fact, we encourage it. But there is a difference between using AI to communicate clearly and using AI to pretend you have experience you don’t have. We will test the claims made in your application during the interview and practical assessment. If you say you improved conversion by 40%, expect us to ask exactly how. If you say you’ve built AI automations, expect us to ask you to explain them. If you say you’re advanced in Shopify, expect us to test that. We aren’t looking for perfect answers. WE’RE LOOKING FOR REAL THINKING. OUR SELECTION PROCESS Candidates who impress us will progress through several stages. STAGE 1 — APPLICATION We assess your experience, communication, attention to detail and, most importantly, how you think. STAGE 2 — INTERVIEW We will discuss your experience and give you real business scenarios. We may challenge your answers. That’s deliberate. STAGE 3 — PRACTICAL ASSESSMENT Final candidates may be given a PAID practical project using realistic e-commerce information. We want to see how you: • Analyse • Prioritise • Communicate • Solve problems • Make commercial decisions We care far more about what you can actually do than how impressive your résumé looks. STAGE 4 — FINAL CEO INTERVIEW The final candidates will speak directly with the CEO. THE CHALLENGE If you’re looking for another job where someone tells you exactly what to do every day: PLEASE DON’T APPLY. But if you’re looking for an opportunity where you can eventually say: “I RUN THE DIGITAL SIDE OF THIS BUSINESS.” Then we want to hear from you. We will give the right person responsibility. We will give them access to the numbers. We will listen to good ideas. We will invest in useful technology. We will challenge them. We will expect a lot from them. And when they demonstrate that they can handle more: WE WILL GIVE THEM MORE. We are not trying to hire another pair of hands. WE ARE TRYING TO FIND A FUTURE LEADER. If you believe that could be you: PROVE IT. Start your application with: BUILD, MEASURE, IMPROVE.

title: *UPDATED* Executive Assistant / Right Hand to Law Firm Owner — Senior Role, Real Authority (Full-Time, Remote)
job_title: *UPDATED* Executive Assistant / Right Hand to Law Firm Owner — Senior Role, Real Authority (Full-Time, Remote)
description: I'm hiring someone who's already done this job. Probably for someone who didn't pay you what you were worth. You've run an executive's calendar and inbox for years. You've managed managers. You've tracked KPIs for a team, sat in the meetings that mattered, and quietly held the whole operation together while someone else's name was on the door. You're good at it. You're tired of being underpaid for it, or of doing it somewhere the culture drains you. This is a real job, with real authority, for that person. I'm Hunter Garnett, a personal injury lawyer and the owner of Garnett Patterson Injury Lawyers in Huntsville, Alabama. We're a growing firm with dozens of team members. I work around the clock and on weekends when a case demands it, and I need a right hand who can keep pace. I respect my team's time. But the simplest way to earn my trust is responsiveness, and I'll never pretend otherwise. Here's the honest version of the job. You'll be the gatekeeper for my inbox and the keeper of my commitments. You'll take the notes in every meeting I'm in and turn my thinking into action items with owners and deadlines. You'll own my to-do list: delegate what should be delegated, complete what you can, and ruthlessly protect my focus for the things that actually move the firm. You'll monitor our dashboards and KPIs and bring me the story behind the numbers. And then the part that makes this a senior role: you'll help me oversee several mid-level managers and track performance across dozens of team members. When something's slipping, you'll know before I do, and you'll already have a plan. I'm looking for someone well-rounded. Operations and management experience is essential. Project management and digital marketing experience are strongly preferred. A background in personal injury law is a huge plus, because you'll understand the rhythm of the work without a long ramp-up. You need to be tech-forward: comfortable in Filevine, Microsoft 365, and Asana, and quick to pick up whatever we adopt next. We run on a daily check-in and a weekly tag-up. Beyond that, you operate independently. If you need direction to function, this isn't your role. If you've been waiting for someone to hand you the keys, it is. A word on culture, because I know that's part of why you're reading. Our Christian faith is central to why this firm exists and how we treat people. We're not going to make it a job requirement, but if you've wanted to work somewhere your values aren't checked at the door, you'll find that here. The details. Full-time. Remote. Flexible schedule with meaningful overlap with US Central business hours, and reachable when it counts. Pay: $12.50–$17.50/hour, and I'm willing to pay for experience. Target start: as soon as we find the right person. HOW TO APPLY Use the Apply button on this page. Please do not email us. Applications sent by email will not be reviewed. BEFORE YOU APPLY, TWO THINGS HAVE TO BE TRUE. 1. YOUR PROFILE MUST SHOW YOUR DISC PROFILE AND YOUR IQ TEST RESULTS. Both are free through OnlineJobs.PH and take about twenty minutes between them. We will not review an application without both showing on your profile. 2. THIS HAS TO BE YOUR ONLY JOB. Full time, and we mean it. We are not looking for someone to fit us around other clients or a second job. If you are working somewhere else right now, that is fine. Just tell us when you could start. WHAT TO INCLUDE Begin your application with the words: RIGHT HAND and then answer all five questions below. Applications missing a section will not be reviewed. 1. THE QUESTION Tell us about the hardest team or executive you have ever had to keep on track. What did you do, and what would you do differently now? We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking for a real one. 2. PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE How long, and what did you actually handle? Be specific. Intake, medical records, demand packages, liens, provider follow up, litigation support. Write NONE if you have none. It is not a disqualifier. 3. CONTENT WRITING EXPERIENCE What have you written, who was it for, and where can we read it? Write NONE if you have none. 4. TASK RANKING Give us your top five from this list, most comfortable first. 1 Inbox and calendar ownership for an attorney 2 Task and follow up tracking in Asana or similar 3 Meeting notes, turned into action items someone can work from 4 Case file management in Filevine or similar 5 Medical records requests and provider follow up 6 Client communication and intake follow up 7 Content writing for blog, email and social 8 Reporting and dashboards 9 Overseeing other assistants 10 Billing and finance admin My top five, best first: 5. AVAILABILITY Confirm you can work a full day with meaningful overlap with US Central time, and tell us the earliest date you could start. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT We read every application. After the deadline we reach out to schedule short conversations with the people we want to talk to. Either way, you will hear back from us. You will not be left wondering.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator
job_title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator
description: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator ROLE SUMMARY This is a highly focused, part-time content creation and social media management role supporting two distinct brands: 1. A travel-focused YouTube channel 2. The Instagram account for a new podcast brand The primary skill needed for this role is strong video editing and content creation, particularly for YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube content. The ideal candidate should also have strong visual judgment, understand social media content strategy, and be able to adapt their creative approach to two very different brands. This is not a general virtual assistant role. Administrative work, email management, unrelated social media accounts, and other business tasks are outside the scope of this position. HOURS AND COMPENSATION Starting rate: $5 USD per hour Maximum: 8 hours per week There is a hard weekly cap of 8 hours unless additional hours are approved in advance. There is potential to increase the rate to $6-$7 per hour for a candidate who demonstrates exceptional editing, content judgment, and brand execution through the paid test and actual work. This is a part-time, ongoing opportunity based on performance. The candidate must accurately track their working time and work efficiently within the allotted weekly hours. TOOLS AND ACCESS The business will provide: * SocialPilot access * Canva access, if needed * Approved brand materials and brand guidelines * Access to source content and footage * YouTube Studio access at the appropriate manager permission level The contractor must provide their own video editing tools and software, such as CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform. The contractor is responsible for maintaining their own computer, reliable internet connection, editing software, and any other equipment necessary to perform the role. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 1: TRAVEL YOUTUBE CHANNEL CONTENT STRATEGY Before beginning regular content production, develop a proposed YouTube content strategy based on: * Existing travel footage * Available long-form videos * Previous trips and destinations * Target audience * Channel positioning * Opportunities for Shorts * Opportunities for long-form content * YouTube Community content * Relevant content themes and recurring series * Recommended posting cadence * Opportunities to repurpose existing content The strategy should identify what content should be created first and explain why. Regular content production should not begin until the initial strategy has been reviewed and approved. YOUTUBE SHORTS Review existing travel footage and identify moments with strong potential for short-form content. Responsibilities include: * Selecting strong clips or stories * Developing hooks * Editing high-retention YouTube Shorts * Adding appropriate text, captions, transitions, music, graphics, and visual elements * Maintaining good pacing * Writing titles and descriptions * Recommending appropriate calls to action * Scheduling approved content through SocialPilot Content should feel intentional and platform-native rather than overly templated. LONG-FORM YOUTUBE CONTENT Create or repurpose long-form YouTube content from available source material, including: * Travel footage * Existing YouTube videos * Recorded meetings * Webinars * Presentations * Educational content * Other approved recordings Responsibilities may include: * Identifying the strongest content * Structuring the story or educational narrative * Removing unnecessary portions * Improving pacing * Adding B-roll where appropriate * Adding text or graphics * Creating clean transitions * Adding intros and outros when appropriate * Creating or recommending thumbnails * Writing titles and descriptions YOUTUBE COMMUNITY Create and publish YouTube Community content such as: * Questions * Polls * Travel photos * Conversation starters * Travel recommendations * Behind-the-scenes content * Promotional posts tied to new videos YOUTUBE ENGAGEMENT Monitor routine audience engagement and: * Respond to appropriate comments in the established brand voice * Like or acknowledge relevant comments * Identify useful audience questions * Flag sensitive, unusual, negative, partnership, sales, or business-related inquiries for review The contractor should not make commitments on behalf of the business without approval. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 2: PODCAST INSTAGRAM The podcast has a separate editor who will edit full podcast episodes and produce video clips. This role is not responsible for editing full podcast episodes from raw footage. Instead, this person will take approved podcast clips and package them appropriately for Instagram. PODCAST REELS For finished clips provided by the podcast editor: * Create branded Reel covers * Ensure the visual presentation follows the podcast brand guidelines * Write compelling captions * Add appropriate calls to action * Schedule content through SocialPilot * Maintain consistency across the Instagram feed PODCAST CAROUSELS Identify ideas from podcast clips or related episode material that can be turned into standalone educational or thought-provoking carousel posts. Examples may include: * Key lessons * Quotes * Frameworks * Questions * Mindset shifts * Lists * Episode takeaways * Discussion-provoking ideas Create the carousel in Canva using the approved podcast visual identity. The candidate must be able to distinguish between the travel brand and podcast brand. The same templates, visual style, editing approach, and tone should not simply be reused across both brands. FIRST 30-DAY DELIVERABLES The first month will function as both an onboarding period and a working trial. WEEK 1: STRATEGY AND BRAND FAMILIARIZATION Complete the following: * Review the existing travel content library * Review the travel YouTube channel * Review the podcast brand guidelines * Review the existing podcast Instagram presence, if applicable * Become familiar with SocialPilot * Become familiar with Canva templates and brand assets Deliver a concise 30-60 day content strategy. The Travel YouTube strategy should include: * Recommended target audience * 3-5 primary content pillars * Recommended Shorts strategy * Recommended long-form strategy * Community post strategy * Proposed recurring content series * Suggested posting cadence * At least 10 initial content ideas * Recommended priorities based on the existing footage library The Podcast Instagram strategy should include: * Recommended Reel posting approach * Recommended carousel approach * Suggested content categories * Recommended posting cadence * Suggestions for maintaining a cohesive branded feed The strategy must be approved before regular production begins. WEEKS 2-4: CONTENT PRODUCTION Travel YouTube: * Create approximately 6 YouTube Shorts * Create approximately 3 YouTube Community posts * Create approximately 1 long-form YouTube video * Create titles and descriptions as needed * Create or recommend thumbnails * Schedule approved content * Monitor and respond to comments at least twice per week Podcast Instagram: * Prepare approximately 6 Instagram Reels using clips supplied by the podcast editor * Create 6 branded Reel covers * Create approximately 3 Instagram carousel posts * Write captions for approved posts * Schedule approved content through SocialPilot END-OF-MONTH REVIEW Provide a short 30-day performance summary that includes: * Content published * Views and reach * Engagement * Strongest-performing content * Weakest-performing content * Observations about hooks, topics, and editing styles * Audience questions or recurring themes * Recommendations for the next 30 days * Any recommended changes to the original content strategy The goal is not simply to publish content. The contractor should learn from content performance and use those insights to improve future content. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE After the initial onboarding period, the ideal contractor should be able to: * Independently identify promising content from existing footage * Make good editorial decisions without excessive direction * Create polished, engaging videos * Understand what makes a strong hook * Maintain two clearly differentiated brands * Follow brand guidelines * Work efficiently within an 8-hour weekly cap * Meet deadlines consistently * Communicate clearly when clarification is actually needed * Schedule content correctly * Use analytics to improve future content * Reduce the amount of content-production work requiring the owner's direct involvement Creativity, judgment, attention to detail, reliability, and editing ability are more important than simply having years of virtual assistant experience.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description: We are seeking an experienced and data-driven Full-Time Meta Ads Specialist to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of all paid social advertising campaigns across Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger) for a portfolio of diverse agency clients. This is a highly strategic, client-facing role that requires a mastery of performance marketing fundamentals combined with a strong creative intuition and a dedication to staying ahead of platform algorithm shifts. The ideal candidate not only knows how to execute, but is also fluent in the latest AI-driven delivery systems, such as the Andromeda update, and understands the new imperative of creative diversification over hyper-specific audience targeting. Key Responsibilities I. Campaign Strategy & Optimization (The Science) Client Performance Ownership: Plan, launch, manage, and scale high-performing campaigns across multiple client accounts and the entire marketing funnel (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to meet aggressive ROAS/CPA targets. title: Social Media Marketing + Graphic Design Associate
job_title: Social Media Marketing + Graphic Design Associate
description: We're building the in-house creative function for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for someone we can grow from the ground up — not just a designer who fills briefs, but someone who takes genuine pride in how our brand shows up in public. This role blends design with judgment: you won't just produce assets; you'll read what's actually landing with our audience and adjust. This is not a template-filling role. You'll be shaping how a financial product presents itself to real users — where a sloppy asset or a careless caption costs us trust, not just engagement. Our audience is discerning, and much of it is Japanese. Quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and reach the right creative call on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for taste. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts. We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the brand guidelines, content calendar, and asset library you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want someone who takes initiative to help build them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading. Responsibilities: • Design static creative for social, community channels, and campaigns — posts, banners, announcement cards, event graphics, presentation assets • Own the content calendar: plan it, keep it filled, and keep it shipping on schedule • Publish and monitor posts across our channels, and track how each one actually performs • Recognize what's working and bring that back into the next round of creative — not just produce volume • Report on performance in numbers, not impressions of impressions — you should be comfortable saying which post did what, and why • Maintain and extend our brand system — colors, type, templates, asset library — so the whole team can move faster • Use AI tools to sharpen your own well-considered concepts, not to generate work you haven't thought through • Keep organized, accessible files — versioned, named properly, findable by someone who isn't you • Escalate anything involving financial claims, promotions, or numbers to your Lead before it goes out — nothing about money publishes unreviewed • Follow team rules, protocols, and brand guidelines diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected • We believe every public post is a first impression for someone, and deserves your full presence and care What We're Looking For: Non-negotiables — read these carefully: • Real graphic design experience. Not "I've used Canva." You should have designed for a brand or client with an actual audience, and be able to walk us through your choices. • A social account you personally ran, with the numbers to show for it. This is the core of your portfolio. We want to see accounts you managed — the graphics you made for them, and the performance behind those posts: impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth over a stated period. Screenshots of your analytics are exactly what we're asking for. A portfolio of pretty graphics with no audience data attached will not get you through this stage. • Japanese market experience is highly preferred. If you've designed or run social for a Japanese brand, a Japan-facing account, or a JP audience — say so early and show it. This is the single biggest differentiator in this search. Also required: • Strong with Figma, Canva, or Adobe — whichever you use, you should be genuinely fluent in it • A body of work that shows range and taste — we care far more about what you've actually made than where you studied • High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges • Confident — you can explain why you made a design choice, and defend it or drop it without going quiet • Understands hierarchy — you know what you can ship yourself and what needs your Lead's eyes, and you act without being told • Conscientious — deadlines hold, files are clean, nothing gets published with a typo in it • Audience-minded — you can tell the difference between a post that looks nice and a post that works • Follows rules diligently — brand guidelines aren't suggestions • Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional, and able to write a caption that doesn't sound like a press release • Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a brief yourself, not just execute the literal request • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch • High discretion — you'll see campaign plans and product information before they're public • Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you): • JLPT N2/N1 or business-level Japanese — especially if you can review Japanese-language creative for tone, not just accuracy • Short-form video or motion graphics ability (Reels, TikTok, CapCut, After Effects) • Experience running paid social or reading analytics beyond surface-level metrics • Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products — and the visual language that comes with them • Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate • Meta Blueprint, HubSpot Marketing, or similar certification • Has grown an account from zero to a real audience • Illustration, 3D, or photography skills Reporting to: Growth Operations Lead and CMO Setup: • 100% WFH from day one • Flexible hours, output-based — you'll need meaningful overlap with Philippine business hours (JST business hours) for team syncs and reviews, but we're not counting the hours you spend at your desk • No time tracker • Deadlines are firm; how you get there is yours to manage • Team communication via Slack • BYOD — your own machine capable of running your design tools, plus stable fiber internet • Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you see any campaign or product information • Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle) • Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your work is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too • Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here • Internal growth and promotions for top performers To Apply: Start your message with the subject line: [Social + Design] – [Your Name] – [City] Then send the following. We read every response personally — take your time with these. 1. Your portfolio, which must include: The social account(s) you personally ran — handle or link, and what your actual role was (you ran it solo, you handled design only, you shared it with a team — just be honest) The numbers. Impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth, over a period you state clearly. Analytics screenshots are ideal. If an account was small, show it anyway — we'd rather see 3,000 real followers you grew than a vague claim about a big one. The graphics you made for those accounts — so we can connect the design work to the results it produced Any Japanese-market work, called out specifically If your best work is under NDA or on an account you no longer have access to, tell us what you can and show what you have. We're reasonable about this — we're not reasonable about people who skip the numbers entirely. 2. Answer all three questions: Pick your best-performing post and your worst-performing post from the same account. What was different about them? (Numbers, then your read on why.) If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us? Think of a time you were part of a startup, org, or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates? A note on AI: using it to help you write or ideate is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it, and we can tell when a portfolio piece was generated rather than made. Edit before you submit. Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, creative, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language. Applications without the correct subject line, a portfolio with performance numbers, and all three answers will not be reviewed.

description: Senior Recruiter (RPO) – Full-Cycle Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing Company: Contact Marketers LLC Experience: 3–5+ Years Position Type: Full-Time, Hands-On Individual Contributor ABOUT THE ROLE Contact Marketers LLC is seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter to support our Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) clients. This is a hands-on recruiting and headhunting position—not a people-management role. You will not have direct reports. We need someone who knows how to proactively find great candidates, including passive candidates who aren't actively applying for jobs. You will personally manage searches from initial client intake and candidate sourcing through interviews, offers, and successful placement. If you are a recruiter who enjoys hunting for talent, building candidate pipelines, and filling difficult positions, we want to hear from you. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Proactively source active and passive candidates for client openings. • Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, professional networks, referrals, Google, and other sourcing methods. • Conduct direct outreach through LinkedIn, email, phone, text, and other appropriate channels. • Develop sourcing strategies for specialized and difficult-to-fill positions. • Conduct phone and video candidate screenings. • Evaluate candidates for experience, skills, compensation, availability, communication, and overall fit. • Present qualified candidates to clients with clear candidate summaries. • Conduct job-intake meetings with clients and hiring managers. • Translate hiring requirements into effective sourcing and recruiting strategies. • Manage multiple open positions and candidate pipelines simultaneously. • Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers. • Maintain consistent candidate and client follow-up throughout the hiring process. • Coordinate background checks and required pre-employment documentation. • Support offer preparation, candidate negotiations, and offer acceptance. • Maintain accurate candidate and recruiting activity in the ATS/CRM. • Take ownership of each search from intake through successful placement. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 3–5+ years of professional recruiting or talent acquisition experience. • Strong full-cycle recruiting experience. • Demonstrated success sourcing and headhunting passive candidates. • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, and direct candidate outreach. • Experience conducting candidate screens and interviews. • Experience managing multiple job requisitions simultaneously. • Experience working directly with hiring managers and/or external recruiting clients. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Excellent organization, follow-up, and candidate-management skills. • Experience using ATS and recruiting CRM platforms. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience with Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), staffing agencies, executive search, direct-hire recruiting, agency recruiting, corporate talent acquisition, or difficult-to-fill professional positions is strongly preferred. We offer monthly performance bonuses. WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE? You're a recruiter and headhunter first. When you're given a difficult position, your first thought isn't: "Where should I post this job?" It's: "Where are these people working right now, and how do I reach them?" You know how to research a market, identify potential candidates, build a target list, conduct outreach, generate interest, qualify candidates, and keep the recruiting process moving. You don't depend solely on inbound applicants. You're comfortable approaching passive candidates and persistent about follow-up. Most importantly, you take ownership of getting positions filled. HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED Success will be based on qualified candidates sourced and submitted, interviews generated, candidate response rates, time-to-fill, offer acceptance, successful placements, hiring manager satisfaction, and overall candidate experience. Applications that include HEADHUNTER will receive priority consideration. ABOUT CONTACT MARKETERS Contact Marketers LLC provides specialized staffing and Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) solutions to businesses that need experienced recruiting support. Our RPO team helps clients keep their candidate pipelines full and their hiring processes moving—from candidate sourcing and screening through interviews, background checks, offers, and hiring.

title: Lead List Building & Operations Specialist
description: ABOUT THE ROLE FlowLead runs cold-email and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a detail-oriented, technically comfortable person to take ownership of our lead-list-building operation. Your main responsibility will be building accurate B2B lead lists. You will learn each client's target market, create different search approaches, review lead quality, and prepare lists for our outbound campaigns. As you master the process, the role may expand into other marketing and operational responsibilities. THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE We need someone who can think independently and critically. After training, you should be able to understand the goal, test possible solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make reasonable decisions without needing every task broken into exact steps. You should ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification, but first make a real effort to investigate and solve the problem yourself. This role is not a good fit for someone who needs to be repeatedly reminded what to do or who waits for detailed instructions whenever something changes. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Learn the targeting rules for each client. - Build cold-email and LinkedIn lead lists using AI Ark, Apollo, and approved supporting tools. - Turn a client's target market into multiple useful search strategies. - Use different combinations of filters and signals instead of blindly copying one search. - Review samples to make sure the companies and contacts fit the client. - Export, combine, organize, and deliver completed lists accurately. - Run the required lead-history checks and AI-personalization steps. - Track completed work and communicate genuine blockers early. - Troubleshoot tools and processes before asking for help. - Gradually take on additional marketing or operational responsibilities as the role develops. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - B2B lead-generation, prospecting, research, or list-building experience. - Strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving. - Comfortable learning new software and technical workflows. - Experience with tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay, AI tools, spreadsheets, CSV files, or similar platforms. - Able to explain why a search or lead matches the client's target market. - Excellent attention to detail. - Fluent written and spoken English. - Honest about errors and willing to correct them. - Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan. - Interested in a long-term position. SCHEDULE AND PAY - Full time, Monday-Friday. - 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time. - Starting pay: $500 USD per month, paid as two $250 payments. - Compensation reviews after 90 days, six months, and annually. - Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or recurring commitments before hiring. They must not interfere with this schedule or your work for FlowLead. HOW TO APPLY - STEP 1 Do not send a video yet. Start by sending a short written application that answers these questions: 1. What country and time zone are you located in? 2. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday from 11:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Eastern European Time? 3. What experience do you have building B2B lead lists or performing prospect research? 4. Which prospecting, spreadsheet, AI, and other technical tools have you used? 5. How do you determine whether a company and a contact match a client's target market? 6. Tell me about a time you had to solve a work problem independently. What did you do before asking for help? 7. Is the $500 USD monthly starting pay acceptable? 8. Attach your resume or provide a link to it. Please give specific, honest answers. Generic or copied answers will not help us evaluate you. HIRING PROCESS 1. We review your written answers. 2. Selected applicants receive more detailed questions to answer in a short video. 3. Applicants who pass the video step complete a practical list-building assignment. 4. Final candidates join a video call with us. You will not receive client data or production access during the hiring process.

Strong vendor negotiation and relationship-management skills - Excellent written and verbal communication - Ability to stay calm and organized while juggling multiple priorities and occasional after-hours emergencies - Paid time off and holiday pay - Comprehensive 2-week onboarding with mentorship from our Operations Manager - A collaborative, supportive remote team environment Schedule Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST preferred, with flexibility for occasional after-hours or weekend emergency coverage. How to Apply Please send us the following: 1. Resume 2. Loom Video (Answer the questions below) a. Short introduction b. title: Marketing Director
description: About Starbond Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels. We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth. About the Role The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth. This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others. You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance. Key Responsibilities Marketing Strategy and Leadership Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes. Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability. Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs. Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention. Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions. Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions. Profitable DTC Growth Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels. Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort. Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments. Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives. Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone. Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics. Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy. Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps. Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation. Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making. Agency and Channel Management Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions. Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths. Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines. Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions. Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property. Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards. Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization. Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews. Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed. Cross-Functional Leadership Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO. Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments. Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation. Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision. What We’re Looking For Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth. Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy. Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis. Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data. Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders. Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations. Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity. Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization. Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations. Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required. Tools and Platforms Experience with several of the following is expected: Shopify Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Analytics 4 Google Search Console Email and lifecycle marketing platforms Amazon reporting Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools Google Workspace ClickUp or similar project-management platforms Agency reporting and attribution systems What Success Looks Like Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth. CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort. At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned. Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions. Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data. The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence. Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions. This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor. Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance. Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality. Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision. Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work. Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively. How to Apply Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions: Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.
