job_title: TRUST ACCOUNTANT - SHORT TERM ACCOMODATION AGENCY
description: We are an Australian property business in the Blue Mountains, west of Sydney. We a short-stay holiday letting business that manages 25 properties for their owners. We are looking for one careful, reliable bookkeeper to take over the day-to-day accounts work for the holiday letting business. Here is the part that matters. Every week, guests pay money that belongs to our property owners, not to us. It arrives from Airbnb, ---------- and direct bookings, in lump sums that do not match the individual bookings. Your job is to take those payouts apart, match every dollar — to the right booking and the right property, and make sure each owner gets paid exactly what they are owed at the end of the month. If a number does not balance, we need to know about it that day. We do not want it smoothed over. What you will do every week Match platform payouts (Airbnb, ---------- , Stripe) against individual bookings in Guesty, allowing for platform commission, processing fees, refunds and chargebacks Enter and code supplier invoices in Xero — cleaners, linen, gardeners, tradespeople Keep each property's ledger up to date so we always know what it has earned and what it has cost Chase missing invoices and unmatched payments Flag anything that does not reconcile What you will do every month Prepare the bank reconciliation for review Prepare owner statements: gross revenue, less our commission, less cleaning, linen, consumables and maintenance Prepare the supplier payment run Prepare a summary report by property: revenue, costs, occupancy Prepare GST figures for our Australian accountant What you will NOT do You will not have authority to move money. You will not approve payments or be a bank signatory. Under Australian law those responsibilities stay with our licensed staff in Sydney. You prepare the work, we review and release it. This is not a limitation on you — it is how the regulation works here. SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED Essential At least 2 years bookkeeping experience, including work for Australian or other international clients Strong Xero skills — you should be comfortable with bank rules, manual journals, and reconciling accounts that do not balance easily Confident with spreadsheets. You will be matching hundreds of line items and you need to be fast and accurate with lookups and pivots Excellent written English. You will be writing owner statements and emails that Australian property owners will read A stable internet connection and a working computer Available to start within 4 weeks Nice to have, not required Experience with Guesty, Hostaway, Uplisting or another short-stay platform Experience with Australian real estate trust accounting Understanding of Australian GST Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, or CPA WHAT WE OFFER Steady, long-term work. We are not looking for a short project — we want someone who is still here in five years Paid Philippine public holidays and paid leave after 6 months Genuine training on our systems, and a documented process for everything A small team. You will work directly with our General Manager and with our existing VA, and you will hear directly from the business owner Annual review and increase for good work HOW TO APPLY Please follow these instructions exactly. Applications that do not follow them will not be read. Start your message with the word RECONCILE so we know you read the whole ad. Tell us, in your own words, how you would handle this situation: a payout of AUD 4,820 lands in the bank account. Your system says the bookings in that payout period total AUD 5,110. What do you do? Tell us how long you have used Xero and what kind of clients you used it for. Tell us your internet speed and your available hours in Philippine time. Attach your CV. We read every application that follows the steps. We will reply to shortlisted applicants within one week, and there will be a short paid test task before we make an offer.

title: AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer
job_title: AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer
description: Job Description We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer to work across a handful of DTC brands in the fashion, fitness, and beauty niches selling in Scandinavia. This role is for someone who is highly competent, fast, independent, and deeply fluent with AI tools. You should be able to take concepts, references, product details, brand direction, and rough ideas — then turn them into polished static ad creatives and Shopify landing pages without needing constant hand-holding. We are not looking for a basic Canva designer or someone who only follows templates. We are looking for a sharp ecommerce creative who understands Shopify design, can build directly inside Shopify, and knows how to use AI tools daily to move faster and produce better work. What You’ll Be Doing You will create static ad concepts in a wide range of styles for our DTC brands. This includes AI-generated product visuals, lifestyle concepts, comparison ads, testimonial-style creatives, problem-solution graphics, product benefit visuals, and other ecommerce-focused static ads. You will also build landing pages directly inside regular Shopify, based on concepts, references, and direction provided by us. You should be comfortable working inside the Shopify theme editor, building page sections, adjusting layouts, improving visual presentation, and solving small design or code-related issues when they come up. This is a hands-on execution role, but you should also be able to think creatively and suggest better ways to execute a concept when needed. Tools & Skills We Care About You should be highly comfortable using AI tools every day, especially for image generation, prompt refinement, creative problem-solving, and Shopify troubleshooting. Experience with the following is highly relevant: * Higgsfield * ChatGPT / GPT * Claude * Nano Banana * Canva or another strong visual editing platform * Shopify theme editor * Basic Liquid/CSS troubleshooting with the help of AI * AI prompt refinement and image-generation iteration Higgsfield understanding is especially important. You should know how to troubleshoot AI-generated visuals, refine prompts, fix weak outputs, and keep iterating until the final result looks strong enough for ecommerce use. Requirements You should have at least **1–2 years of ecommerce, Shopify, design, or AI creative experience**. You must be able to: * Create strong static ad concepts using AI * Build landing pages directly inside Shopify * Work quickly without sacrificing quality * Follow references and brand direction closely * Use AI tools daily as part of your workflow * Troubleshoot problems independently * Work with copy provided by our copywriters * Handle Scandinavian-language copy carefully, even if you do not speak the language * Communicate clearly and directly * Manage tasks through Notion * Work full-time with high availability and high output expectations You do not need to be fluent in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish. Our copywriters handle the copy. However, you need to be careful when placing Scandinavian text into designs and landing pages. Who This Role Is For This role is for someone who is brutally competent, resourceful, and AI-native. You should enjoy figuring things out. When something breaks in Shopify, you should be able to use AI, documentation, and your own judgment to solve it. When an AI image output looks bad, you should know how to refine the prompt, change the direction, or manually polish the asset until it works. You should be comfortable being given a reference and a goal, then independently producing something usable. Who This Role Is Not For This is not for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task. This is not for someone who only makes generic Canva templates. This is not for someone who claims to “know AI” but cannot consistently generate high-quality visuals. This is not for someone who only designs pages but cannot build them inside Shopify. This is not for someone who works slowly, waits around, or gives up when a tool produces a bad result. Work Setup This is a full-time remote role. You can work from anywhere in the world. Tasks will be assigned through **Notion**, and you will communicate directly with us. Compensation is a **competitive salary based on experience, skill level, and output quality. To Apply Please send: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Examples of AI-generated static ad creatives you have made 3. Examples of Shopify landing pages or ecommerce pages you have built 4. A quick explanation of which AI tools you use most and how you use them in your workflow 5. Your availability and expected monthly salary We care much more about output quality, speed, taste, and problem-solving ability than formal credentials.

title: Part-Time Operations & Customer Service Manager (Phone) — US Fence Staining Company
job_title: Part-Time Operations & Customer Service Manager (Phone) — US Fence Staining Company
description: **8 READ BEFORE APPLYING **. StainTex is a US fence staining and wood restoration company operating in Texas. Homeowners call us, we quote them, we put them on the schedule, and our crews stain their fence. Simple business — but it lives or dies on how well the customer is handled between "they called" and "the crew shows up." Right now the owner does all of that himself. That is the job we are hiring for. THIS IS NOT A DATA ENTRY JOB You will be on the phone with American homeowners. You will be the voice of the company. When a job goes sideways — wrong color, crew is late, weather pushed the schedule, customer doesn't like how it dried — you are the person who calls them, apologizes sincerely, and fixes it. If that sentence makes you nervous, this is not your role. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Answer inbound calls from homeowners and return missed calls same-day - Book, confirm, reschedule, and reshuffle jobs on our calendar around weather and crew availability - Walk customers through stain color selection and set correct expectations about how a color will actually look on their wood - Learn our two product lines (water-based and oil-based) well enough to recommend the right one for each fence — including when a previously stained fence must stay with the same base, and when we should recommend our premium oil-based line - Explain our service tiers and pricing clearly and confidently - Follow up on quotes that haven't been answered - Keep the CRM clean: notes on every call, correct stage on every job - Send day-before confirmations and after-job follow-ups ****- Handle complaints start to finish and escalate only what truly needs the owner***8 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Clear, neutral, easy-to-understand spoken English. Americans should not have to ask you to repeat yourself. - 2+ years on the phone with US customers (support, dispatch, appointment setting, or a US home-services / contractor account) - Genuinely calm and warm when someone is upset. You apologize like you mean it, you don't get defensive, and you don't hide from a hard call. - A problem solver. When a customer has an issue, we want to hear "here's what I already did about it," not "what should I do?" - Organized enough to run a live schedule without dropping anyone - Reliable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and a working headset - Available during US Central business hours NICE TO HAVE (not required — we will train you) - Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM - Background in home services, construction, painting, or contracting - Any knowledge of stains, paint, or coatings SCHEDULE AND PAY - Part time, about 20-25 hours per week - Hours fall inside US Central business hours (roughly 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST) - $600 USD per month to start - We are building this into a full-time Operations Manager seat. The person who does this well grows into running our scheduling and customer operations across multiple cities. - Paid training on our products, pricing, and systems HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY, WE DO CHECK Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed. 1. Start your message with the word CEDAR so we know you read this. 2. Record a voice message (30-90 seconds) and share the link. In it: - Say your name and briefly describe your phone experience. - 3. In your written message, answer these two questions in your own words: - Tell me about the angriest customer you have ever dealt with. What did you actually do, and how did it end? what was the happiest customer experience?

title: Sales Administrator
description: Anything Supplies Global is looking for an organised, confident and results-focused Sales Team Administrator to help us build and support our growing network of Independent Sales Partners. This is more than a general administration role. You will work closely with our sales partners, help train and onboard them, monitor their opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records and support them as they move leads through to RFQs, quotations and successful sales. Your Responsibilities You will be responsible for: * Onboarding and training new Independent Sales Partners. * Teaching partners how to use our CRM and follow our sales process. * Maintaining partner records, agreements and documents. * Monitoring leads, RFQs, quotations and follow-ups. * Ensuring opportunities are updated correctly in the CRM. * Coordinating with sourcing, logistics and management teams. * Preparing weekly sales pipeline and KPI reports. * Maintaining commission records and assisting with commission calculations. * Following up with partners on outstanding actions. * Supporting partners with customer presentations and sales preparation. * Identifying inactive partners and reporting performance concerns. * Helping create an organised, motivated and results-driven sales network. Gohighlevel prefered. * Good written and spoken English. * Confidence communicating with salespeople and management. * The ability to train and guide team members. * Strong attention to detail. * Experience preparing reports and monitoring KPIs. * The ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities. * A positive, supportive and results-driven attitude. Experience in B2B sales, business development, quotations, RFQs, logistics or procurement will be highly regarded. Employment Details * Full-time position. * Monthly salary of 35,000 to 45,000, depending on experience. * Remote Philippines-based role. * Opportunity for future salary growth and performance incentives. * You will work directly with management and support a growing network of approximately 10 Independent Sales Partners. How to Apply Please send: * Your updated resume. * A brief introduction about your relevant experience. * Details of any CRM systems you have used. * An example of how you have supported or coordinated a sales team. * Your expected monthly salary. * Your current location in the Philippines. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. Help us build a strong sales network, support great people and turn opportunities into results.

That promise only works if someone takes care of the customer after the sale. That's this role. WHAT YOU'LL DO You are the voice of the company after the install. Your job is to make sure every customer feels taken care of, and to solve problems before they turn into bad reviews. Call and text customers after installation to confirm everything is working and answer questions Handle service issues — take the call, understand the problem, d ---------- if it's a real defect or a misunderstanding, and coordinate the fix with our field team Manage our Biscayne Care maintenance plan — schedule salt deliveries, annual filter replacements, and follow-ups Turn happy customers into reviews and referrals — ask for the Google review at the right moment Save cancellations — when someone wants to cancel their plan, find out why and fix the real reason Keep the CRM clean — every call logged, every issue tracked to closed Escalate properly — you'll know what you can solve and what needs the owner WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required: Excellent spoken English. Clear, natural, easy for an American homeowner to understand. This is non-negotiable — you will be on the phone with US customers every day. Comfortable on the phone. You'll make and take calls all day, including calls with upset people. Calm under pressure. Some customers will call angry. You need to stay steady, listen, and solve. 2+ years in customer service, support, or account management. Home services, HVAC, plumbing, or trades experience is a big plus. Reliable internet and a quiet workspace with a good headset. No background noise, no roosters, no traffic. Available 11 AM – 9 PM US Eastern Time. This is intentional. Attention to detail is part of the job. Step 1 — Write "SOFT WATER" as the first two words of your application This tells us you read the whole posting. Step 2 — Tell us in a few sentences Your customer service experience Your internet speed (run a speed test and give us the number) Your setup: headset, workspace, background noise Your available hours in US Eastern Time Step 3 — Record a voice sample (THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART) Record yourself on your phone or computer handling the scenario below, as if you are actually on the phone with the customer. Speak the whole thing out loud as one continuous recording, 2–3 minutes. Upload it to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo and paste the link in your application. Make sure the link is set so anyone can listen. Do not write out the answer. Do not read from a script in a flat voice. We want to hear how you actually sound talking to a real customer. THE SCENARIO You get a call from Mrs. Delgado. We installed her whole-home water filtration system three weeks ago. She is upset and talking fast. Here is everything she tells you: She was told the system drains water every night around 2 AM, but she has never heard it run once, so she is convinced it is broken. She opened the salt tank and it "looks like just water" with no salt in it. Our installer put the system in the middle of her patio and she hates where it is. She says she wants it moved to the corner. She cut her hand on the outdoor faucet last week reaching behind the tank. She just found out her neighbor paid $600 less for a system from another company and she wants to know why she paid more. At the end she says: "Honestly I'm thinking about telling you to just come take the whole thing out." Here is what you know internally: The system regenerates roughly every 14 days, not nightly. Not hearing it is completely normal. Salt sits underneath the water at the bottom of the brine tank. It looks like plain water on top. If there is truly no salt at the bottom, that is a real problem and needs a technician. She is under a 1-year labor warranty, so a service visit costs her nothing. Moving the system may or may not be possible depending on the plumbing — you cannot promise it on the call. The neighbor's cheaper system is almost certainly a different, smaller unit without professional installation or a lifetime warranty. We do not discount and we do not offer refunds to keep people happy. We fix problems instead. Handle the call. We want to hear how you open, how you handle her being upset, what you tell her about each issue, what you promise, what you do not promise, and how you end the call. WHAT WE'RE LISTENING FOR Do you acknowledge her hand injury before jumping into explanations? Do you let her feel heard, or do you immediately start correcting her? Do you explain the 14-day cycle and the salt in a way a non-technical person understands? Do you promise things you cannot deliver, or do you commit only to what you control? Do you handle the price comparison without getting defensive and without discounting? Do you turn a cancellation threat into a scheduled service visit? Does your voice sound calm, warm, and confident? There is no single perfect answer. We are evaluating your judgment and your delivery, not whether you hit a script. title: Experienced Corporate Legal Operations Specialist
description: Corporate Focus | Independent Contractor | Remote We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Corporate Legal Operations Specialist to provide remote legal support to our growing business law firm. The role will focus on business entity formations, corporate governance, annual reports and other corporate filings, business transactions and maintenance, corporate governance, annual reports and other corporate filings, and support for business transactions. Candidates with direct corporate or business-transaction experience is strongly preferred and will receive priority consideration. Experienced paralegals from other practice areas may also be considered if they can demonstrate relevant transferable skills, independent matter management, and the ability to learn new areas quickly. The engagement is expected to begin at approximately 5 to 10 hours per week. As our firm's needs evolve and additional projects become available, there may be opportunities to take on additional work and increased hours. Applicants should be available for regular overlap with Pacific Time business hours for training, meetings, and collaboration with our team. About Bend Law Group, PC Bend Law Group is a boutique law firm that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses build, protect, and grow what they have created. About the Role We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy experienced paralegal who can take ownership of assignments, independently handle routine corporate work after focused onboarding, and grow into more complex matters while supporting the day-to-day legal operations of our growing business law firm. This position is intended to add experienced paralegal capacity to our team, not simply administrative support. We are particularly interested in candidates who understand how individual assignments fit within the broader lifecycle of a legal matter and who can review a matter, determine its current status, identify outstanding tasks or missing information, and help move it toward completion. You will receive onboarding and training in the firm's systems, procedures, templates, and workflows, along with targeted training in unfamiliar substantive areas. You should already have a solid foundation in paralegal work, including managing deadlines, handling detailed legal documents, communicating professionally, and independently managing established assignments, and recognizing when attorney guidance is required. Your initial responsibilities will focus primarily on entity formations and maintenance, corporate governance, compliance filings, corporate records, and business-transaction support. You will be expected to gather information from clients and attorneys, maintain complete and organized records, track deadlines, identify missing or inconsistent information, communicate proactively, and escalate substantive legal questions appropriately. As you become proficient with our systems and procedures, there will be opportunities to take ownership of more complex corporate, governance, and business-transaction projects. We value team members who take ownership of their work, communicate proactively, and consistently produce accurate, high-quality results. We are looking for someone who enjoys learning new technology, improving systems and processes, solving problems, and providing exceptional client service. Key Responsibilities • Prepare and submit government filings related to the formation and maintenance of corporations, limited liability companies, and other business entities. • Prepare and file articles of incorporation, articles of organization, annual reports, California Statements of Information, foreign qualifications, amendments, dissolutions, and other entity maintenance filings. • Assist attorneys with corporate governance and business-transaction matters, including written consents, resolutions, stock issuances, minute books, due diligence, closing checklists, signature packets, and post-closing organization. • Review corporate records and supporting documents for completeness and consistency, identify potential issues, and escalate substantive legal questions to the supervising attorney. • Review filing requirements and verify that all submissions are complete, accurate, and timely. • Identify opportunities to improve the firm's systems, workflows, templates, and internal processes. • Gather information and supporting documentation from attorneys, staff members, clients, government agencies, and online resources. • Track filing deadlines, renewal dates, annual reports, and other corporate compliance requirements using the firm's calendaring and workflow systems. • Obtain business licenses and other government registrations as needed. • Maintain organized electronic corporate records, minute books, and other legal documentation. • Monitor the status of pending filings and communicate with government agencies, registered agents, clients, and attorneys regarding entity maintenance matters. • Enter and update information in the firm's practice management, document management, and workflow systems, including Microsoft 365, Clio, and other cloud-based legal technology platforms. • Assist with special projects and additional legal operations or administrative responsibilities as the firm's needs evolve. • Maintain and improve written procedures, checklists, and training materials for recurring legal operations, helping ensure that the firm's institutional knowledge is documented and easily transferable across the team. • As proficiency grows, serve as an additional experienced resource for the paralegal and support team by answering routine process questions, reviewing work when appropriate, reinforcing documented procedures, and escalating substantive legal issues to an attorney. You Will Thrive Here If You Are • Detail-Oriented and Reliable: You carefully review your work, follow instructions, and take ownership of deadlines. • Highly Organized: You can manage multiple tasks and responsibilities without losing track of important details. • Tech-Savvy: You learn new technology quickly and are comfortable working in cloud-based systems. • A Strong Communicator: You have professional English verbal and written communication skills. • Proactive: You anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and ask thoughtful questions. • Team-Oriented: You enjoy collaborating with others and contributing to a supportive work environment. • Self-Sufficient: You can independently complete established corporate paralegal assignments in a remote environment, exercise sound judgment, and know when to request attorney guidance. • Service-Minded: You have a genuine passion for helping clients and colleagues. • Positive and Resourceful: You bring a can-do attitude and look for solutions rather than dwelling on problems. • Adaptable: You are willing to take on new responsibilities as the position and firm continue to grow. Qualifications • A minimum of two years of experience working in a paralegal role at a law firm or in-house legal department is required. • Hands-on experience supporting corporate or business-transaction legal matters, including business entity formations, corporate governance, ongoing entity maintenance, or transactional closings, is strongly preferred and will be weighted heavily during candidate review. • Experience with corporations, limited liability companies, and related formation, governance, maintenance, or compliance requirements is preferred. • Experience preparing or supporting corporate governance documents and business transactions, such as board, stockholder, member, or manager consents; equity issuances; due diligence; closing checklists; and closing sets, is a plus. • Demonstrated ability to manage paralegal assignments from intake through completion with limited supervision, learn new substantive areas efficiently, and recognize when to seek attorney input. • Demonstrated ability to understand how individual tasks fit within the lifecycle of a legal matter, maintain continuity across multiple workstreams, and apply documented procedures consistently. • Professional fluency in written and spoken English. • Strong organizational and time-management skills. • Careful attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work. • Ability to manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities. • Ability to follow written procedures and document recurring processes. • Comfort learning and using cloud-based legal, communication, and productivity systems. • Ability to work effectively and communicate consistently in a fully remote environment. • Experience supporting attorneys, executives, or professional-services firms is a plus. • Availability for regular working-hour overlap with the Pacific Time Zone. • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment. • Experience with Clio and Microsoft 365 is preferred. • Demonstrated ability to learn new software and technology quickly. Schedule and Engagement • Independent contractor position. • Approximately five to 10 hours per week initially. • Hours may increase as the candidate demonstrates proficiency and assumes additional responsibilities. • Potential to transition into a substantially expanded or full-time role. • Fully remote. • Regular availability during Pacific Time business hours will be required. Compensation and Benefits • We anticipate paying $6 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience. • Flexible remote-work arrangement. • Opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities. • Long-term collaboration with a supportive, values-driven team. • Meaningful work helping entrepreneurs and small businesses. • A culture built on kindness, clarity, teamwork, and zero tolerance for “law firm jerkiness.” How to Apply Please email the following to ---------- • Resume (PDF) • A video introduction (maximum two minutes) • Your current location • Your desired hourly rate • Your general availability and the number of hours you are currently seeking • A brief list of the types of corporate or transactional matters you have personally worked on, if applicable Video Introduction In your video, please tell us: • about your paralegal background and a complex matter you handled with limited supervision; • If you have corporate or business-transaction experience, please describe the types of matters and specific tasks you supported, and if your experience is in another practice area, please explain how your skills would transfer and how you would approach learning this work; • which Bend Law Group value resonates with you most after reviewing our About Us page, and why; • about a technology, AI tool, or software platform you learned quickly and how it improved your work; and • what you believe would make you a valuable addition to our team? Department: Marketing Reports to: Social Media Manager Direct reports: Marketing Agents (social media comments & inquiries) ROLE SUMMARY The Social Marketing Virtual Assistant Supervisor owns the day to day performance of the Marketing Agent team responsible for social media comments and private inquiries. This role keeps the review process efficient, the SOPs current, and the Hootsuite environment properly configured, while acting as the first point of escalation for agents and the connective tissue between Marketing and other departments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Process & SOP Ownership - Optimize review process efficiency and identify bottlenecks in agent workflows. - Recommend, document, and roll out SOP improvements as processes evolve. - Develop response and coverage strategies, then cascade them across the full team, including Sydney, to keep processes consistent across locations. SUCCESS METRICS (FIRST 90 DAYS) - Response time and resolution time on social inquiries at or below target. - SOP library reviewed, with at least two documented process improvements implemented. - Weekly reporting cadence established and consistently delivered. - End of shift report sent every working day. - No waiting item in the Hootsuite queue left unhandled past end of day. Tell us about the last automation rule or routing setup you built in Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or Agorapulse. What problem was it solving, and what exactly did you configure? Name the feature. 2. If you have only worked as an agent replying to messages, just say so. Supervising a live queue 3. How many agents were you responsible for, and did that queue have a response time target? If it did, what was the target? 4. How did you check whether an agent was actually working the queue, not just logged in? And what did you do the last time one of them was slow or went off brand? Optional If you have an SOP you personally wrote or improved, send the file or a 5 to 10 line excerpt. No penalty if you do not have one or cannot share it. Please write this message yourself. title: Project Manager - Practice Management Platform
description: Healthcare practice management platform Employment type: Full-time, permanent Location: Fully remote (any location) Working hours: 9:00am – 6:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), Mon–Fri Team size: 8+ developers plus QA About us We are a healthcare organisation. Alongside our clinical and operational business, we build and run our own software — the platforms our practices, partners and customers use every day, spanning both B2B and B2C use cases. Our development, QA and product teams work remotely across multiple time zones, anchored to Sydney business hours. We are a small, hands-on technology group. Decisions get made quickly, the approval chain is short, and the person managing a project is genuinely the person who owns it. About the role We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our Australian healthcare practice management platform. The platform runs live healthcare practices. Appointments, patient records, clinical workflow and billing all depend on it, which makes release quality and regression discipline the defining features of this role. A bad release is not an inconvenience for our customers — it stops them seeing patients. You will own the delivery of a substantial roadmap with a team of 8+ developers plus QA, and you will also be pulled onto adjacent initiatives — device integrations, support tooling, partner projects — at short notice. Being able to switch context quickly and come back without losing the thread is essential. The product Practice Management Platform An Australian healthcare practice management system used day-to-day by healthcare practices. Ongoing work spans clinical workflow, patient data, third-party device and imaging integrations, customer support tooling, and platform modernisation. What you will do • Own end-to-end delivery of the platform roadmap — scope, plan, schedule, dependencies, risk, budget and release. • Run the day-to-day delivery cadence in Jira: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, velocity and burndown reporting, and honest status reporting to stakeholders. • Keep Confluence current and authoritative — requirements, functional specs, clinical workflow documentation, architecture decisions, runbooks and release notes. • Lead a delivery team of 8+ developers alongside QA, working with tech leads on sequencing, capacity and technical dependencies. • Own the QA/QC gate with particular rigour. Practices depend on this system: regression coverage, staged rollouts, UAT with real practice users, defect triage and a defensible go/no-go on every release are all yours. • Plan releases against AWS-hosted environments (EC2, RDS) with the engineering team — environment readiness, release windows, data migrations, backup verification and rollback plans. • Coordinate third-party and device integrations, and manage the vendor relationships that come with them. • Work closely with customer support and practice-facing teams so that production issues, escalations and customer feedback feed back into the backlog properly. Manage stakeholders across clinical, operations and executive; give them a clear, regular, unvarnished picture of where delivery stands. • Pick up adjacent projects at short notice and integrate them into the delivery plan without derailing the core roadmap. • Continuously improve how we deliver — process, tooling, documentation and release safety. What you must bring • 5+ years' experience as a Project Manager or Delivery Manager on commercial software products (not internal IT projects alone). • Proven track record managing large delivery efforts with development teams of 8 or more engineers, plus dedicated QA. • Expert-level Jira — epics and stories, boards, sprints, workflows, JQL, dashboards and delivery reporting. You should be comfortable configuring, not just using. • Expert-level Confluence — you treat it as the single source of truth and you keep it that way: specs, decision logs, runbooks, release notes, meeting outcomes. • Working knowledge of AWS, specifically EC2 and RDS. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to plan releases, environments, migrations, backups and rollbacks with engineers and understand what you are agreeing to. • Hands-on oversight of QA/QC — test planning, UAT coordination, defect triage and prioritisation, and release sign-off. • Comfortable running Agile (Scrum or Kanban) with the pragmatism to bend it when the work calls for it. • Genuinely adaptable and fast-moving. You will switch between projects inside the same week and be expected to pick each one back up without losing the thread. • Excellent written English and a written-first communication habit — this is non-negotiable in a distributed team. • Self-managing and highly organised, with the confidence to escalate risks early rather than hope they resolve themselves. • Available 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday. Desirable • Experience delivering practice management, EMR/EHR, clinical or other healthcare software. • Understanding of Australian health data privacy obligations and the care that patient data demands. • Experience with software that is deployed into live customer sites, including staged rollout and hotfix processes. • Familiarity with PHP/Laravel back-ends and modern JavaScript front-ends — enough to follow a technical conversation. • Bitbucket or Git branching, pull request and release workflows. • Awareness of CI/CD and deployment tooling (Laravel Forge or similar). • Experience managing device, imaging or third-party API integrations and the vendors behind them. • PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified Scrum Master certification. Remote work and hours This role is fully remote — you can be based anywhere — but you must be online and available during Sydney business hours, 9:00am to 6:00pm (AEST/AEDT), Monday to Friday. Sydney observes daylight saving, so the UTC offset shifts between +10 and +11 through the year. Please only apply if that overlap works for you long term. title: LOGISTICS COORDINATOR ROLE
description: SPARTAN FILL SOLUTIONS Logistics Coordinator Remote — Philippines · Independent Contractor · Daily Rate + Bonus THE OFFER Pay: $25 AUD per day worked, plus a performance bonus. Bonus: $50 for every $1,000 of revenue you generate in a week. Uncapped. Example: A $3,000 week = $125 base + $150 bonus = $275 for the week. Paid: Weekly, every Monday, via Remitly. Pay increases: Your rate goes up as you gain experience and hit targets consistently. Hours: 8:00am – 5:00pm Brisbane, Australia time (AEST), Monday to Friday. Early 6:00am start only on days trucks are running early — you'll be told the day before. Breaks: Yours to manage — take a lunch break and short breaks as you need them. Reporting: Short daily report to the business owner at the end of each shift. Agreement: You will sign an independent contractor agreement and an NDA covering all customer, site, pricing and business information. This is a long-term role for the right person. As the business grows, so does the responsibility and the earning. ABOUT THE COMPANY Spartan Fill Solutions provides clean fill delivery and tip site coordination across South East Queensland, Australia. We connect customers who need fill delivered with contractors and businesses that need approved locations to dispose of clean material. We coordinate customer enquiries, material information, tip sites, truck movements, payments and load tracking. THE ROLE You will communicate with Australian customers, contractors, truck operators, landowners and tip site contacts. You will take allocated enquiries from first contact through to payment, delivery coordination and job completion. A DAY IN THE ROLE Contacting new and existing customers by phone, WhatsApp, SMS and email. Confirming customer names, phone numbers, addresses and job requirements. Collecting photos, videos, declarations and required forms. Confirming material type, quantity, truck type, access conditions and delivery timeframe. Following up with customers until they proceed, decline, or need future contact. Advertising tip site opportunities through approved channels, including Facebook groups and industry apps. Finding your own customers through your own advertising — this counts toward your bonus. Matching clean fill jobs with available receiving sites. Confirming receiving sites can accept the material and quantity. Coordinating customers, contractors, truck operators and site contacts. Tracking truck movements and load counts. Recording calls, messages, payments, quantities and job updates accurately in company systems. Sending a daily report to the business owner. Escalating unclear, unsafe or non-compliant material immediately. Completing clear handovers for active and unfinished jobs. TARGETS YOU'LL BE WORKING TO We'll be upfront about what good looks like. These are the numbers the role is measured on: THE MAIN ONE — conversion rate You are measured on how much of what we hand you actually converts. If we supply $5,000 of enquiries in a week, we expect you to convert most of it. Paid tip site jobs — convert 90%. These are quick: search our site list, match it, confirm it. Paid import jobs — convert 70%. Harder, because you are advertising and chasing fill to come available. These percentages are confirmed after your first month, once we have measured together what is realistic in this market. They will not be set against you before then. TURNAROUND Paid tip site, under 500m3 — confirmed within 1 hour. Paid tip site, 500m3 and over — escalate to the business owner, timeframe agreed at the start. Paid import — fill sourced, confirmed and delivered within 3 days. Paid import — customer updated by day 2 if it is not sorted yet. Nobody is left wondering. REVENUE Building toward $3,000 AUD per week, where enough suitable customers are supplied. This is context, not a stick. If we do not supply you enough leads in a week, that is on us, not you — which is why conversion rate is the number that actually matters. EVERY DAY Daily report sent to the business owner at the end of each shift. Log the reason on any job that does not convert — no site in range, fill did not come, or customer pulled out. Customer records, payments and load counts kept accurate. New leads followed up promptly and consistently. WhatsApp messages answered quickly during agreed availability. You will not be expected to hit full targets in your first two weeks. Week one is learning the systems. We build from there. ABOUT YOU Previous experience in customer service, sales, logistics, admin or dispatch. Strong spoken and written English. Confident speaking with Australian customers by phone. Comfortable making outbound and cold calls. Organised, with good attention to detail. Able to manage several customers and jobs at once. Stays calm when customers are confused or frustrated. Confident with Excel and Google Sheets, Google Maps, Google Drive, email, WhatsApp and CRM systems. Follows scripts, checklists and procedures. Asks questions rather than guessing. Has worked to deadlines and weekly targets before. Works independently while keeping management updated. WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE A reliable computer or laptop. A working smartphone you can install apps on (ReadyFill, WhatsApp and others we use). A Facebook account you're happy to post from in clean fill groups. Strong, reliable internet — plus backup internet or mobile data. A backup plan for power or internet interruptions. A quiet, professional place to make customer calls. A suitable headset and microphone. Availability matching Brisbane, Australia hours (AEST) — 8:00am to 5:00pm, with occasional 6:00am starts. Willingness to sign an independent contractor agreement and NDA. PAY IN DETAIL Base: $25 AUD per day worked, Monday to Friday. Bonus: $50 for every $1,000 of revenue generated in a week. No cap — the more you do, the more you earn. Self-sourced work: Customers you bring in yourself, or free customers you convert to paid, count toward your bonus the same as supplied jobs. Pay increases: Your daily rate increases as you gain experience and consistently hit targets. Reviewed openly, not left vague — good work gets paid better. Payment method: Remitly, weekly, every Monday for the previous week. What that looks like in practice: $2,000 week — $125 base + $100 bonus = $225 $3,000 week — $125 base + $150 bonus = $275 $4,000 week — $125 base + $200 bonus = $325 $5,000 week — $125 base + $250 bonus = $375 Every job is logged as either a supplied lead or self-sourced, so there is never any question about which applies. The bonus is payable only after: The customer has paid the company and the payment has been retained. Required customer records have been completed. The correct sales, logistics and compliance processes have been followed. No refund, chargeback or unresolved dispute applies. No work days. Work volume depends on customer demand and weather. Wet weather can stop or slow jobs. If there is no work on a given day, you will be told by 4:00pm the previous day and that day is not paid. This is normal in this industry — some weeks are full, some are quieter. The company aims to supply a good volume of enquiries and job opportunities. However, the number of leads, sales, hours and commission may vary. The clean fill industry is affected by rain and site conditions, so available work can fluctuate. CONFIDENTIALITY + NDA You will sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement before starting. All customer details, leads, tip site locations, prices, databases, training materials and business information belong to the company and must remain confidential — during the role and after it ends. Contractors must not: Privately contact or service company customers. Redirect company customers outside the business. Collect customer payments personally. Share confidential site locations or customer information. Use company leads, systems or relationships for personal benefit. Release tip site details before the required approval and payment steps are completed. TRAINING + SUPPORT Full onboarding and direct mentoring from the business owner. Training videos, scripts, templates and checklists. Demonstrations of the customer and logistics processes. Close support during the first one to two weeks. Ongoing guidance for unusual or difficult situations. Leads and existing customer opportunities supplied. Access to company systems and resources. You must complete the required training and demonstrate competency before independently managing sensitive customer, pricing or tip site information. YOUR APPLICATION — PLEASE ANSWER THESE What experience do you have in customer service, sales, admin or logistics? Have you worked with Australian, UK or US customers? Are you confident making outbound and cold calls? Have you worked to weekly targets or KPIs before? Tell us about it. What days and hours are you available? Are you available 8:00am – 5:00pm Brisbane, Australia time (AEST), Monday to Friday, with occasional 6:00am starts? Do you have another job or regular commitment? Do you have a reliable laptop, smartphone and internet, plus a backup? Do you have a quiet place to make customer calls? Do you have a Facebook account you're happy to post from? What systems have you used — Excel / Google Sheets, Google Maps, Google Drive, WhatsApp, email, CRM? How do you organise customer follow-ups and unfinished tasks? When could you start? Are you comfortable with $25 AUD per day, plus $50 per $1,000 of weekly revenue, paid weekly via Remitly? Are you comfortable signing an independent contractor agreement and NDA?

title: Project Manager - Digital Products
description: Employment type: Full-time, permanent Location: Fully remote (any location) Working hours: 9:00am – 6:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), Mon–Fri Team size: 8+ developers plus QA across three products About us We are a healthcare organisation. Alongside our clinical and operational business, we build and run our own software — the platforms our practices, partners and customers use every day, spanning both B2B and B2C use cases. Our development, QA and product teams work remotely across multiple time zones, anchored to Sydney business hours. We are a small, hands-on technology group. Decisions get made quickly, the approval chain is short, and the person managing a project is genuinely the person who owns it. About the role We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to take end-to-end ownership of three of our customer- facing digital products. This is a multi-project role, and that is the whole point of it. The three products have different users, different release rhythms and different stakeholders, and you will be moving between all of them in any given week. If you like the certainty of one long-running project, this is not the role. If you are energised by holding several threads at once and keeping every one of them moving, read on. The products Product 1 — Booking Widget An embeddable online appointment booking component that lets our business locations take bookings directly from their own websites. High visibility, high traffic, and unforgiving of regressions. Product 2 — Content Hub A digital hub for content and imaging assets, serving both internal teams and external partners. Product 3 — Product Catalogue The central catalogue of products that feeds our customer-facing systems and partner integrations. Data quality and integration reliability are the core challenges here. What you will do • Own end-to-end delivery for all three products — scope, plan, schedule, dependencies, risk, budget and release. • Run the day-to-day delivery cadence in Jira: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, velocity and burndown reporting, and honest status reporting to stakeholders. • Keep Confluence current and authoritative — requirements, functional specs, architecture decisions, runbooks and release notes. • Coordinate a delivery team of 8+ developers alongside QA, working with tech leads on sequencing, capacity and cross-product dependencies. • Own the QA/QC gate. Agree the test plan, coordinate UAT, triage and prioritise defects, and make the go/no-go call on every release. • Plan releases against AWS-hosted environments (EC2, RDS) with the engineering team — environment readiness, release windows, data migrations and rollback plans. • Manage stakeholders across operations, marketing and external partners; translate their needs into a backlog the developers can actually work from. Actively manage the trade-offs between the three products when they compete for the same people, and make the resourcing call rather than escalating it by default. • Surface risks and blockers early, in writing, with a proposed path forward. • Continuously improve how we deliver — process, tooling, documentation and handover quality. What you must bring • 5+ years' experience as a Project Manager or Delivery Manager on commercial software products (not internal IT projects alone). • Proven track record managing large delivery efforts with development teams of 8 or more engineers, plus dedicated QA. • Expert-level Jira — epics and stories, boards, sprints, workflows, JQL, dashboards and delivery reporting. You should be comfortable configuring, not just using. • Expert-level Confluence — you treat it as the single source of truth and you keep it that way: specs, decision logs, runbooks, release notes, meeting outcomes. • Working knowledge of AWS, specifically EC2 and RDS. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to plan releases, environments, migrations, backups and rollbacks with engineers and understand what you are agreeing to. • Hands-on oversight of QA/QC — test planning, UAT coordination, defect triage and prioritisation, and release sign-off. • Comfortable running Agile (Scrum or Kanban) with the pragmatism to bend it when the work calls for it. • Genuinely adaptable and fast-moving. You will switch between products inside the same week and be expected to pick each one back up without losing the thread. • Excellent written English and a written-first communication habit — this is non-negotiable in a distributed team. • Self-managing and highly organised, with the confidence to escalate risks early rather than hope they resolve themselves. • Available 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday. Desirable • Experience with booking or scheduling systems, e-commerce, or product catalogue / PIM platforms. • Health or medical industry experience. • Familiarity with PHP/Laravel back-ends and modern JavaScript front-ends — enough to follow a technical conversation. • Bitbucket or Git branching, pull request and release workflows. • Awareness of CI/CD and deployment tooling (Laravel Forge or similar). • Experience managing third-party integrations and external vendors. • PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified Scrum Master certification. Remote work and hours This role is fully remote — you can be based anywhere — but you must be online and available during Sydney business hours, 9:00am to 6:00pm (AEST/AEDT), Monday to Friday. Sydney observes daylight saving, so the UTC offset shifts between +10 and +11 through the year. Please only apply if that overlap works for you long term. What we offer • Fully remote work, with the autonomy that comes with it. • Real ownership of named products, not a slice of someone else's roadmap. • Direct access to decision makers — short approval chains, fast answers. • A small, capable team where your delivery process choices actually stick. How to apply Send your CV and a short cover note to [insert application email or Seek/LinkedIn apply link]. In your note, please tell us: the largest development team you have personally run, how you kept its QA cycle honest, and the last time you had to pick up an unfamiliar project at short notice. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

If a designer is unavailable, you reassign; you do not open Figma to fix it. - You do **not** handle pricing, scope, or strategy conversations with clients. If you are hoping this role will evolve into a creative or copywriting position, it is not the right fit. --- ### What we need from you - **2 + years** in project coordination, production management, or creative operations (agency experience preferred; paid social or e‑commerce strongly preferred). - **Notion** at a power‑user level: you have personally run a board with real statuses, relations, and filtered views, the core of the job. - Working knowledge of **ClickUp** and **Airtable**: you can open a client’s board, find the task, and read the brief without breaking anything. - Excellent written English: your messages go to clients under our name. - Obsessive attention to detail: noticing a $3 price discrepancy or an outdated bottle label is essential. title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — Laravel / API Integrations / BigBlueButton
job_title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — Laravel / API Integrations / BigBlueButton
description: Hellooooo onlinejobbers! We are a large Australian education company providing online and in-home tutoring to K–12 students. We operate on our own custom platform that manages students, families, tutors, lessons, payments and operations. Our core application is built in PHP/Laravel. We are now looking for an experienced developer to take ownership of a major new project: building a deeply integrated online classroom experience. The Project: We currently use BigBlueButton (BBB) for thousands of online tutoring lessons. BBB works well as the underlying classroom technology, but our current implementation is relatively basic and feels separate from the rest of our platform. We want to change that. Our goal is to build a deeply integrated, fully branded online classroom experience powered by BigBlueButton. We do NOT want to build our own video conferencing technology. Instead, we want to use BBB for video, audio, screen sharing, whiteboards, presentations and other classroom functionality, while our platform owns the surrounding experience, integrations, resources and data. Phase 1 Our first objective is to: Remove Greenlight from the normal tutor/student experience Integrate BigBlueButton directly with our Laravel application Automatically create a unique BBB meeting for every scheduled online lesson Allow tutors to click Enter Classroom directly from their dashboard Allow students/families to do the same Handle authentication and participant roles automatically Create an Instant Classroom feature for tutors who need an unscheduled classroom Customize BBB so it looks and feels like part of our platform Connect each BBB meeting to the corresponding lesson in our database Capture attendance, join/leave times, meeting duration and other available meeting data Return this data to our Laravel application after each lesson Build the integration in a reliable and scalable way From the tutor/student perspective, they should simply feel like they are entering another part of our platform. They shouldn't need to know that BigBlueButton is powering it. Where We Want to Take It Phase 1 is only the foundation. Once the classroom is deeply integrated with our platform, we want to explore features including: Lesson transcription AI-generated lesson summaries Parent-friendly lesson reports Automatic extraction of topics covered Homework and next-step extraction AI lesson recommendations Teaching resources available from within the classroom Previous lesson information available to tutors Student learning profiles Curriculum mastery tracking Tutor analytics and coaching Student engagement analytics We want every online lesson to eventually produce useful structured information for the tutor, parent, student and our internal platform. Who We're Looking For This isn't a role where we will provide you with a list of tickets and tell you exactly how to implement them. We are looking for someone who can take technical ownership of this project. You should be comfortable being given a desired outcome, researching the available technology, proposing an approach, building it and improving it over time. Required Skills You should have strong experience with: PHP Laravel REST APIs and third-party integrations MySQL/database design JavaScript/TypeScript Git Linux/server environments Webhooks and event-driven integrations Debugging complex integrations Reading technical documentation and independently learning unfamiliar systems You should also be comfortable working across the boundary between backend and frontend development when required. Highly Desirable Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable: BigBlueButton BigBlueButton APIs BigBlueButton plugins React Node.js WebRTC GraphQL LLM/AI APIs Open-source software customization EdTech platforms Previous BigBlueButton experience is NOT required, but will naturally be advantageous. If you are an excellent developer who is confident you can become deeply familiar with BBB and its documentation, we still want to hear from you. Forecasting a 6 month project, with potential for permanent work. Please reply with your experience and how you would tackle this project. If you meet requirements you will be invited to complete a paid BBB/Laravel challenge.

title: Senior PHP / Livewire/ Laravel Developer — General Requirements
job_title: Senior PHP / Livewire/ Laravel Developer — General Requirements
description: Contract: 12-week initial term, extension expected Engagement: Project-Based Location: Remote — must overlap Australia / Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT) Time Tracking: TimeDoctor (screenshots + activity tracking) — required for the duration of the contract Experience: 8+ years professional PHP / Laravel development Working hours: 40 hours/week Monday to Friday Positions: 3 — Clinical & Supplier Integrations, Business & Financial Integrations, Product Features About the Project We build and run a multi-tenant practice management platform used by healthcare clinics — patient records, appointments, clinical notes, prescriptions, invoicing, and reporting. The platform is a set of interconnected Laravel applications sharing a central PostgreSQL database, and we are progressively rewriting our main portal into Laravel + Livewire 3. We are hiring three senior Laravel developers. All three sit on the same platform and share the same bar; they differ in what each owns. This document is the baseline every candidate must clear before their specialisation is considered. Each role has its own job description covering what it adds on top. The Three Positions • Clinical & Supplier Integrations — supplier and laboratory ordering systems, health-claims and rebate platforms, partner clinical networks. Correctness over speed. • Business & Financial Integrations — accounting platforms, email and calendar providers, payment terminals and banking APIs. Money and communications, both unforgiving. • Product Features — new customer-facing features including AI-assisted clinical documentation and self-service financial tooling. UI-forward; the only role where Livewire is a hard requirement. Requirements Experience & Skills • 8+ years building production PHP applications, with at least 5 years in Laravel (Laravel 9+), hands-on and current. • Large or long-lived production systems — code with history, constraints you did not choose, and users who noticed when it broke. A string of greenfield builds is a different kind of experience; this platform is not a greenfield. • You have owned something in production — not just built it, but carried it, watched it fail, and fixed it. Be ready to talk about a specific failure in detail. • Eloquent at depth — relationships, eager loading, query performance, and knowing when to drop to the query builder or raw SQL instead. • Strong SQL — non-trivial queries, joins, indexes, and the ability to read a query plan and act on it. PostgreSQL preferred; MySQL transfers fine. • Queues and background jobs — Laravel queues, Horizon, Supervisor or equivalent. You have debugged a job that failed silently in production. • REST and web services in general — HTTP semantics, auth headers / bearer tokens, status-code handling, retries/backoff, idempotency, and what happens when a request times out mid-write. • Reading code you didn’t write — much of this work is understanding existing systems before changing them. Comfort navigating an unfamiliar codebase is essential. • Multi-tenant awareness — every record here is scoped by account and practice; getting that wrong is a data-leak class of bug, not a cosmetic one. • Able to work independently — self-directed and comfortable owning a component end to end with minimal supervision. • Testing & QA — can write unit and feature tests (Pest or PHPUnit), perform manual QA, identify and log defects, and verify fixes against acceptance criteria. • Agentic Coding — familiar with Claude Code in coding, testing, and review in the workflow. • Project Management — capable of lightweight PM tasks: tracking milestones, updating task status, flagging blockers proactively, and estimating remaining effort. • Security Awareness — aware of data sensitivity and handling. This platform holds patient and financial records. • Good verbal and written communication in English — clear and professional in async written communication (Slack, Jira, Confluence) and comfortable in spoken sync calls. Tools & Workflow • Comfortable working in our toolchain: Jira (issues/sprints), Confluence (docs), Postman (API testing), Sentry (error monitoring), and Bitbucket (source control / pull requests). • Clean commits, clear pull requests, and clear written communication in English. Not Required • A degree. We care about what you’ve shipped. • Livewire — except for the Product Features role, where it is a hard requirement. • Tailwind or Alpine specifically — the fundamentals underneath them are what matter. • Python or Django — helpful for reading legacy business logic, not a requirement. • Healthcare or clinical software background — useful context, genuinely not a hard requirement. • PostgreSQL specifically — strong MySQL transfers fine. Working Arrangement • Project-based. 12-week initial term with milestones agreed up front. Extension expected for the right person. • Sydney business-hour overlap required for daily sync and quick turnaround on questions. A minimum of 6 hours of genuine overlap each working day is required — you don’t need to be Sydney-based. • TimeDoctor is used for time tracking and is a condition of the engagement; please only apply if you’re comfortable with activity monitoring. • Resources provided: codebase access, database schema documentation, and a staging environment to test against. How to Apply Please include: • Which of the three positions fits you best and why. If more than one does, say so — we’d rather place you well than fill a slot. • Relevant Livewire work — links or descriptions of comparable projects, and what you owned on them. • Relevant Laravel work — links or descriptions of comparable projects, and what you owned on them. • Links to any code you’ve written — GitHub, GitLab, personal projects, anything. • Your experience with agentic coding tools — which you’ve genuinely used, one task you completed with one, and one time the tool got it wrong and how you caught it. • Examples of working independently and owning a component end to end. • Any Testing, QA, or light project management experience. • Your time-zone and the daily hours you can overlap with Sydney. • Confirmation you’re comfortable using TimeDoctor, Jira, Confluence, Postman, Sentry, and Bitbucket. • A rough estimate / milestone breakdown for work of this shape, and your rate.

title: Part-Time Social Media & Brand Coordinator-Please read 10 steps to apply
job_title: Part-Time Social Media & Brand Coordinator-Please read 10 steps to apply
description: **Remote | 15–20 Hours per Week | Long-Term Opportunity** We are seeking a creative, organized, and brand-conscious Social Media & Brand Coordinator to manage the social media presence of two growing brands: * **Elevation Individual and Family Therapy** — a multi-location mental health practice serving individuals, couples, families, and children. * **Calm and Capable CEO (CCC)** — a personal brand focused on leadership, entrepreneurship, faith, business systems, and building a successful therapy practice without constant chaos. This is not simply a posting position. We need someone who can understand the distinct voice and audience of each brand, turn ideas and raw content into polished posts, maintain a consistent publishing schedule, evaluate performance, and proactively recommend content that supports each brand’s goals. ## Primary Responsibilities ### Social Media Strategy and Planning * Develop and maintain a monthly social media strategy for both brands. * Create organized weekly and monthly content calendars. * Recommend content topics based on brand goals, audience needs, current trends, seasonal opportunities, and performance data. * Identify appropriate trends, sounds, formats, keywords, and content opportunities without forcing trends that do not fit the brand. * Balance educational, relatable, promotional, community-building, and authority-building content. * Recommend campaigns to increase engagement, website traffic, client inquiries, followers, email subscribers, and brand awareness. * Repurpose strong-performing content into new formats and across platforms. * Monitor relevant competitors and industry trends to identify content gaps and opportunities. ### Content Creation and Editing * Turn raw videos, voice notes, photographs, written ideas, and longer recordings into polished social media content. * Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and other appropriate platforms. * Add captions, on-screen text, transitions, branding, music, and calls to action. * Create branded carousels, graphics, quote posts, stories, thumbnails, and other visual content. * Write captions, hooks, headlines, calls to action, hashtags, and platform-appropriate descriptions. * Maintain consistent colors, fonts, visual style, messaging, and tone for each brand. * Adapt content appropriately for each platform instead of publishing identical content everywhere. * Help organize and maintain a searchable content library containing raw footage, edited content, graphics, captions, and reusable brand assets. ### Publishing and Community Management * Schedule and publish approved content accurately and on time. * Ensure links, tags, locations, cover images, captions, and calls to action are correct before publishing. * Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all assigned platforms. * Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience engagement. * Respond to general comments and messages using approved brand guidelines. * Escalate clinical questions, complaints, negative feedback, media inquiries, partnership opportunities, and sensitive messages to leadership. * Engage thoughtfully with relevant accounts and communities to increase organic visibility. * Assist with maintaining updated bios, profile links, highlights, pinned posts, and platform information. ### Analytics and Optimization * Review platform analytics weekly and monthly. * Track reach, views, watch time, retention, engagement, follower growth, link clicks, inquiries, conversions, and other relevant metrics. * Identify which topics, hooks, formats, and posting times perform best. * Provide a concise monthly report explaining: * What performed well * What underperformed * Why the results may have occurred * What should be repeated, changed, or tested next * Use performance data to improve future content rather than relying only on personal preference. * Conduct simple A/B tests of hooks, covers, captions, calls to action, and content formats. * Track content progress from idea through approval, scheduling, publication, and reporting. ## Brand-Specific Expectations ### Elevation Individual and Family Therapy Content should feel professional, compassionate, inclusive, trustworthy, and accessible. It should help potential clients understand therapy, connect with the practice, learn about services, and feel comfortable taking the next step. The coordinator must understand the importance of privacy when working with a mental health organization. No client information, testimonials, identifying details, or clinical content may be used without explicit authorization. Content must never diagnose followers, promise treatment outcomes, or provide individualized clinical advice. ### Calm and Capable CEO Content should feel confident, polished, relatable, honest, encouraging, faith-aware, and practical. It should reflect the voice of a successful therapy practice owner who shares real lessons about leadership, systems, staffing, growth, and becoming a calmer CEO. The coordinator must be able to preserve the founder’s natural voice rather than making the content sound generic, overly corporate, or AI-generated. ## Platforms May Include * Instagram * Facebook * TikTok * LinkedIn * YouTube Shorts * Pinterest * Google Business Profile * Email or blog content repurposing when needed Experience with every platform is not required, but you should be able to explain which platforms you have managed and what results you achieved. ## Required Qualifications * At least two years of professional social media management, content creation, or digital marketing experience. * A strong portfolio showing social media graphics, carousels, short-form video editing, branding, and caption writing. * Demonstrated understanding of branding, visual consistency, audience positioning, and brand voice. * Strong short-form video editing and graphic-design skills. * Excellent written English, grammar, communication, and proofreading skills. * Ability to create distinct content for two different brands without blending their voices or visual identities. * Experience using analytics to improve content strategy. * Strong organization, attention to detail, and deadline management. * Ability to work independently, communicate proactively, and ask questions when expectations are unclear. * Ability to receive feedback and make revisions without becoming defensive. * Reliable internet connection and dependable computer. * Willingness to sign confidentiality and intellectual-property agreements. * Ability to protect confidential business information and follow privacy requirements. ## Preferred Experience * Experience with mental health, healthcare, wellness, coaching, entrepreneurship, or personal brands. * Familiarity with HIPAA-sensitive or highly confidential environments. * Experience growing service-based business accounts organically. * Experience creating content designed to generate inquiries, leads, or appointments. * Familiarity with tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Metricool, Meta Business Suite, Later, Buffer, Google Drive, ChatGPT, or similar platforms. * Experience with basic SEO, social-search optimization, YouTube keywords, and Google Business Profile content. * Experience supporting a founder who provides raw ideas or footage and needs someone to turn them into finished content. * Basic understanding of paid social media campaigns is a plus but not required. ## What Success Looks Like The right person will: * Keep both brands posting consistently without frequent reminders. * Learn and maintain the voice and visual identity of each brand. * Bring thoughtful content recommendations instead of waiting for every idea to be assigned. * Turn raw content into polished, engaging, brand-aligned posts. * Catch errors before content is published. * Use analytics to make specific recommendations. * Maintain an organized calendar and content-production system. * Communicate early when content, approvals, or information are needed. * Help Elevation generate greater community visibility and qualified client inquiries. * Help Calm and Capable CEO grow an engaged audience and establish strong thought leadership. ## Schedule and Work Arrangement * Part-time: approximately 15–20 hours per week. * Long-term remote opportunity. * Flexible working hours, with some availability required during U.S. Central Time for meetings, communication, and approvals. * Participation in a weekly content-planning or progress meeting may be required. * Additional hours may become available as the brands grow and performance is demonstrated. ## Compensation Compensation is based on experience, portfolio quality, and demonstrated skill. Please include your desired hourly or monthly rate in your application. ## How to Apply To be considered, submit all of the following: 1. A current resume. 2. A portfolio or links to relevant work samples. 3. A brief introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. 4. Examples of social media accounts you have managed and your specific responsibilities for each. 5. Any measurable results you helped achieve, such as increased reach, engagement, followers, inquiries, website traffic, or conversions. 6. The platforms and content tools you use confidently. 7. Your desired hourly or monthly rate. 8. Your weekly availability and the hours you can overlap with U.S. Central Time. 9. A description of how you would keep two brands with different audiences and personalities visually and strategically distinct. 10. The words **“Elevate the Brand”** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire posting. Applications without both a resume and relevant portfolio or work samples will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid skills assessment involving content planning, branding, caption writing, or short-form video editing. Submitted materials will be used only for candidate evaluation and will not be published or used commercially without payment and permission.

For example: A potential patient searches for a dentist → visits our website → doesn't book → later sees our clinic's advertisement on Facebook or Instagram. We would like to develop retargeting strategies for people who visit different areas of our website, including services such as: General dentistry / new patients Cosmetic dentistry Teeth whitening Invisalign / clear aligners Sleep dentistry Other key dental services You should be comfortable setting up and managing the tracking required to do this properly. Who We're Looking For You should have strong hands-on experience with: - Meta Ads Manager - Facebook & Instagram advertising - Lead generation - Funnel strategy - Meta Pixel - Conversions API - Custom Audiences - Lookalike Audiences - Website retargeting - Conversion tracking - Landing pages / lead forms - A/B testing - Creative testing - Campaign optimisation - Campaign scaling - Performance analysis Experience with dental, medical, cosmetic, healthcare or appointment-based local businesses would be highly regarded.
