description: Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time **Location:** Remote About the Role We are looking for a highly organized, responsive **Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to support our Parts and Supply Chain operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for parts customers while helping keep estimates, payments, Parts Research requests, purchase orders, and order updates moving forward. You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day follow-through that creates a great customer experience and gives our internal Supply Chain team more time to focus on purchasing, sourcing, technical research, inventory, and complex procurement needs. ## What You’ll Do * Answer inbound parts calls, emails, and assigned leads. * Gather customer and equipment information, including make/model, serial numbers, data tags, photos, quantities, and requested parts. * Create and maintain accurate customer and lead records. * Coordinate requests requiring technical identification with our internal Parts Research team. * Create and send parts estimates using approved information. * Follow up consistently on open estimates through sale or closure. * Communicate pricing, availability, and lead times to customers. * Send payment links or instructions and follow up on routine outstanding payments. * Create clear handoffs to Supply Chain when parts are ready to be ordered or shipped. * Follow up on open purchase orders and vendor acknowledgments. * Maintain accurate expected ship dates, lead times, backorder/delay information, and tracking details. * Keep customers and internal teams informed throughout the process. * Proactively flag delays, exceptions, or issues requiring additional support. ## What Success Looks Like You are responsive, organized, and consistent. Customers receive timely communication, estimates don’t fall through the cracks, open orders have clear status updates, and internal teams can quickly determine where an order stands. Key performance expectations include: * **95%+** compliance with inbound customer response standards * **98%+** compliance with required parts estimate follow-up * **95%+** compliance with open purchase order visibility requirements ## What This Role Does Not Own This role supports procurement and order coordination but does **not** independently make purchasing, sourcing, pricing, or technical parts-identification decisions. Complex vendor issues, inventory management, physical receiving/shipping, and other procurement exceptions remain with the internal Supply Chain team. ## Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is: * Highly organized and detail-oriented * Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and email * Consistent with follow-up and task management * Able to manage multiple open requests without losing track of details * Proactive about communicating delays and next steps * Comfortable working across multiple systems and maintaining accurate records * Team-oriented and able to coordinate effectively with Sales, Service, and Supply Chain * Able to work consistently during **7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time** This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, coordination, organization, and keeping processes moving from initial request through completion.

title: Executive Assistant & Founder Support VA - Full-Time
job_title: Executive Assistant & Founder Support VA - Full-Time
description: THIS IS NOT A BASIC "DO WHATEVER I SEND YOU" VA JOB. The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become the recognized authority in their industry. Our founder, Brad Holcman, is building a business around a simple but powerful idea: Do not be the best. Be the ONLY. Brad has a lot of ideas, opportunities, commitments, projects, and responsibilities moving at once. He needs someone who is naturally organized and genuinely enjoys turning a messy stream of tasks, voice notes, meetings, and reminders into a calm, visible plan. You will work directly with Brad as his Executive Assistant and Founder Support VA. Your job is to help make sure important business and personal commitments do not disappear, priorities are clear, follow-ups happen, the calendar supports what matters, and Brad knows what deserves his attention today. This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who is hungry to learn, takes ownership, communicates clearly, and wants to become an indispensable right hand over time. THE BASICS Type of work: Full time, 40 hours per week Pay: $500 USD per month Start date: As soon as the right person is found Location: Philippines English level: Fluent / Advanced Experience level: Intermediate to Advanced Schedule: Full-time remote. Required weekday overlap of 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. Remaining hours are flexible around agreed deliverables. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Run the founder's daily operating system You will collect tasks and ideas from messages, meetings, voice notes, email, and conversations. You will put them into one organized task system, clarify deadlines and next actions, and keep a close eye on what is due, stuck, or forgotten. Each workday, you will prepare a short founder brief with the day's highest priorities, calendar, deadlines, follow-ups, and decisions needed. At the end of the day, you will close loops and prepare the next day so nothing important is lost. 2. Protect the calendar and inbox You will help organize Brad's Google Calendar, schedule and reschedule meetings, add preparation details, protect focused work time, avoid conflicts, and make sure important meetings have the right information attached. You will help organize email and messages under agreed rules. You will flag urgent items, draft simple replies when appropriate, track waiting-on responses, and make sure people are not left without an answer. You will never send sensitive communications or make commitments without clear approval rules. 3. Keep business projects and follow-ups moving You will track important priorities across our content, marketing, coaching, client, and team work. You will follow up with people, maintain simple status views, convert meeting notes into next actions, and alert Brad early when something needs a decision or is at risk of slipping. You are not expected to do every specialized job in the company. Your responsibility is to make sure requests, deadlines, and decisions do not get lost. 4. Support approved personal logistics With clear privacy boundaries, you may help research and coordinate personal appointments, travel options, family-calendar reminders, gifting, reservations, orders and returns, and other practical logistics that protect Brad's time. You will always ask before making purchases, sharing sensitive information, or doing anything outside pre-approved rules. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 30 days: You create one clean task/follow-up system, learn Brad's preferences, establish the daily brief, improve calendar habits, and begin reliably capturing actions from meetings and messages. Days 31-60: You run a consistent weekly priority review, keep a forward-looking calendar view, track key projects, and proactively close routine communication loops. Days 61-90: Brad trusts the system. He knows his priorities, important commitments are anticipated, and business and personal logistics are more organized with fewer reminders coming from him. WHO WILL DO WELL HERE You have at least one year of meaningful administrative, executive-support, operations-support, or project-coordination experience. You may have supported a founder, manager, small business owner, agency owner, or executive. You do not need to have been a Chief of Staff. But you must be able to explain the system you personally used to stay organized. You have excellent written and spoken English. You are highly reliable, calm under pressure, discreet, detail-oriented, comfortable using Google Workspace, and not afraid to ask a clear question when the next step is ambiguous. Experience with Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, Slack, WhatsApp, Zoom, travel research, and AI productivity tools is helpful. Strong judgment, follow-through, and communication matter more than knowing every tool. SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE Executive assistance, administrative support, calendar management, email management, task management, project coordination, personal assistance, Google Workspace, Google Calendar, Gmail, meeting management, online research, documentation, written English, problem solving, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, travel planning, AI productivity tools. THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF Do not apply if you want a passive role where you simply wait for a written list of tasks. Do not apply if you cannot reliably work the required Eastern-Time overlap, have unstable internet without a backup plan, or are uncomfortable handling confidential business and personal information with maturity. We are not looking for someone to be on call 24/7, perform every specialized function in the company, or make financial or personal decisions without approval. We are looking for a proactive, reliable assistant who wants to grow into a true right-hand support role. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with this exact phrase: I am the Operating System. Applications without that phrase will not be considered. Please include ALL of the following: 1. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile and a short explanation of whom you supported in your most relevant role. 2. A two-minute Loom or video introduction. Tell us about the messiest workload you had to organize and the system you used. 3. In 250 words or fewer, answer this question: A founder sends scattered voice notes, three meeting requests, two personal reminders, and five urgent-looking emails. What do you do first, and what does your end-of-day update look like? 4. A redacted example of a tracker, agenda, calendar-preparation template, daily plan, or follow-up system you created. Never share confidential prior-employer information. 5. Your availability in Philippines Time, confirmation of the Eastern-Time overlap, internet backup plan, and expected monthly pay. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid US$20 practical exercise involving a fictional task dump and calendar. We will evaluate how you prioritize, ask questions, organize follow-ups, and communicate, not how fancy your design is. WHY JOIN US You will work directly with a founder who cares about growth, creativity, and building something that stands out. This is an opportunity to become a trusted part of a small, ambitious business and grow in responsibility as you prove yourself.

You will recommend content pillars, formats, calls to action, distribution priorities, and posting rhythm based on the goal of each piece of content. Our content VA handles most publishing and distribution. You will supply the why: whom we are speaking to, what message we need to test, which format and channel makes sense, what call to action belongs with it, and what signal tells us it worked. 4. You are expected to know what should be built, why, and how success should be measured. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 30 days: A concise audit, a measurement and tracking checklist, a 90-day priority plan, a first scorecard, one lead-magnet or funnel recommendation, and a focused paid and organic test plan. Days 31-60: Weekly scorecards, clearer content priorities, one or two well-defined paid or funnel tests, and implementation briefs that the team can execute. Days 61-90: A documented learning system. What is working, what is not, what should be scaled or stopped, and the next most valuable test. Four years is the floor, not a suggestion. If you have two, this is not your role yet. You have personally worked in Meta Ads Manager and can show that you understand more than posting boosts or reporting likes. You understand how content, ads, lead magnets, landing pages, forms, CRM handoffs, email sequences, and tracking should work together. You have used GoHighLevel, ---------- , HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, ClickFunnels, Webflow, or comparable tools. You know how to use Google Analytics and UTM tags, and you recognize when the data is insufficient to make a confident optimization decision. You write excellent English, are commercially minded, bring recommendations rather than vague opinions, and can coordinate with a small team without turning strategy into a complicated document no one uses. SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE Growth marketing, marketing strategy, Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, paid social, social media strategy, content strategy, email marketing, lead generation, funnel strategy, GoHighLevel, CRM, landing pages, conversion rate optimization, Google Analytics, UTM tracking, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, retargeting, A/B testing, copywriting. THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF Do not apply if your experience is only scheduling social-media posts or designing Canva graphics. We already have publishing support. Do not apply if you expect to be paid to make a generic strategy deck and then disappear. We need someone who will help turn the strategy into a weekly operating rhythm. At 10 hours per week, this is also not a request for you to edit every video, create every design, publish daily across every channel, build all technical funnels, write every email, or manage an unlimited number of ad campaigns. The scope is strategic direction, focused performance work, and excellent coordination with our existing execution team. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with this exact phrase: ONLY growth is measurable. Applications without that phrase will not be considered. Please include ALL of the following: 1. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile and a clear statement of your actual role in each campaign or client result. 2. A two-to-three-minute Loom or video introduction explaining one paid campaign, funnel, or email-growth project you personally improved. 3. One short case study that states the starting problem, your actions, the spend range if paid media was involved, the tracking approach, the result, and what you learned. Anonymized screenshots are welcome. Do not disclose confidential client information. 4. Your answer: What is the largest monthly Meta Ads budget you have personally managed, and what conversion event did you optimize for? 5. Your hourly rate, confirmation you can work 10 hours weekly with two Eastern-Time calls, the CRM, funnel, and email tools you have used hands-on, and two references. The ideal candidate is an experienced QA or quality engineer who can set expectations for the QA team while remaining technically hands-on with testing, automation, CI/CD, deployments, and release troubleshooting. The role combines QA leadership, quality engineering, release management, and practical DevOps responsibility. Core Responsibilities QA Leadership, Standards & Discipline • Own and continuously improve the QA process across the product and engineering organization. • Establish clear QA standards for test planning, execution, regression testing, defect reporting, evidence, retesting, and sign-off. • Set a high and consistent quality bar for the QA team and coach team members on effective testing practices. • Ensure QA work is systematic, reproducible, documented, and traceable rather than dependent on informal or ad-hoc testing. • Define what must be validated for different types of changes and ensure appropriate test coverage before release. • Review QA results and challenge incomplete testing, weak defect reproduction, or unsupported sign-off. • Identify recurring gaps in QA execution and drive corrective process improvements. • Help establish useful QA metrics such as escaped defects, regression failures, reopen rates, automation coverage, and recurring defect categories. • Work constructively with Engineering and Product while maintaining independent authority to determine when quality requirements have not been met. Hands-On Quality Assurance • Personally perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and release testing as needed. • Create and maintain test plans and test cases for new functionality, regressions, integrations, and critical workflows. • Validate acceptance criteria and verify that completed engineering work behaves correctly across relevant environments and scenarios. • Produce clear, actionable defect reports with reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, supporting evidence, and appropriate severity. • Ensure defects are properly retested and regressions are covered before closure. • Focus QA effort based on product risk, customer impact, change scope, and historical failure patterns. QA Automation & Quality Engineering • Own and expand meaningful automated regression coverage across the product. • Determine which tests should be automated and which are better suited to manual or exploratory testing. • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests as appropriate. • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure they run at the correct stages of software delivery. • Establish automated quality gates that prevent progression or release when required tests fail. • Track flaky tests, automation failures, coverage gaps, and recurring regressions and drive them to resolution. • Work with Engineering to ensure unit and engineering-level tests remain an engineering responsibility while QA provides broader product, integration, and regression assurance. • Continuously reduce repetitive manual QA work where reliable automation provides better coverage and faster feedback. Release Ownership & Deployment Control • Own or directly support the end-to-end release process from QA readiness through production deployment and validation. • Establish and enforce clear Definition of Release Ready and Definition of Release Complete standards. • Confirm required code reviews, tests, scans, approvals, documentation, QA sign-off, deployment steps, and rollback preparation are complete before release. • Plan, coordinate, execute, and validate production releases across relevant application components. • Maintain release schedules, release manifests or records, release notes, deployment evidence, and rollback procedures. • Identify release risks and dependencies early and escalate blockers before they affect delivery. • Have the authority and judgment to stop or delay a release when required quality or readiness criteria have not been met. • Ensure failed or partially completed releases have clear recovery and rollback procedures. CI/CD, DevOps & Deployment Automation • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment. • Maintain and improve Bitbucket repositories, Git workflows, branching practices, pull-request workflows, and pipeline integrations as they relate to quality and releases. • Automate deployments across development, QA/staging, and production environments. • Reduce manual deployment steps and opportunities for human error while preserving appropriate controls. • Ensure pipelines provide clear visibility into failures and prevent unsafe deployments. • Support and troubleshoot Docker/containerized application environments and deployment workflows. • Support and oversee deployments into AWS environments, including configuration, permissions, dependencies, logs, monitoring, and deployment health. • Help maintain consistency across development, QA/staging, and production environments and troubleshoot environment-related failures with Engineering. Security, Release Validation & Production Follow-Through • Integrate and maintain automated security, dependency, vulnerability, and code-quality scanning within the delivery pipeline. • Define how critical test, security, and code-quality findings affect release readiness. • Define and execute post-deployment smoke tests and validation procedures. • Verify that releases are functioning correctly before considering deployment complete. • Monitor deployment health, errors, logs, and other production signals following releases. • Coordinate rapid response, rollback, or remediation when a release introduces problems. • Lead or participate in post-release reviews and ensure quality or release failures result in concrete corrective actions. • Maintain a clear audit trail showing what was released, when, by whom, and with which validations. Required Skills & Traits Must Have • Strong hands-on software QA experience in a production SaaS, web application, or similarly complex software environment. • Experience leading QA practices, setting testing standards, or serving as a senior/lead QA engineer responsible for the quality bar of a team. • Strong understanding of test strategy, functional testing, regression testing, exploratory testing, integration testing, defect management, and release validation. • Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated software tests, ideally including API, integration, regression, and/or browser-based testing. • Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. • Experience managing or directly supporting software releases and production deployments. • Strong experience with Git workflows, branches, pull requests, and repository management; Bitbucket experience is strongly preferred. • Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments. • Working knowledge of AWS and cloud deployment environments. • Ability to troubleshoot failed builds, pipelines, automated tests, environment problems, and deployments. • Understanding of rollback strategies, release risk management, and production i ---------- response. • Ability to distinguish between QA responsibilities and engineering responsibilities and hold both functions to appropriate quality standards. • Strong attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and low tolerance for undocumented, unverified, or casually bypassed quality steps. • Ability to coach others, enforce standards constructively, and communicate clearly when work is not ready to progress. • Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have • Previous experience as a QA Lead, QA Manager, Senior QA Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, SDET, Release Engineer, or similar hands-on quality role. • Experience managing or mentoring a distributed QA team. • Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines. • Experience with Docker or containerized deployments. • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and AWS deployment automation. • Experience with automated security, vulnerability, dependency, or static-analysis scanning. • Familiarity with PHP, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, and web application architectures. • Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools. • Experience improving an existing QA organization where processes, automation, or release discipline needed to mature. • Experience supporting distributed engineering and QA teams. Ideal Profile The ideal candidate is a senior QA practitioner who wants ownership, not someone who views QA management as primarily assigning test work or tracking tickets. They are comfortable getting directly involved in difficult testing, reproducing defects, reviewing automation, troubleshooting pipelines, and validating releases. They can walk into an existing QA process, identify where discipline or coverage is weak, establish practical standards, coach the team to meet them, and measure whether quality is actually improving. They know when a defect indicates an isolated issue and when it points to a broader gap in testing, engineering checks, or release controls. They also understand the software delivery process beyond QA: why a build failed, why a test should block deployment, how environments differ, how a release should be packaged and validated, and where CI/CD or deployment automation can eliminate risk and manual work. They are comfortable saying that a release is not ready when required standards have not been met, while working constructively with Engineering, Product, and QA to resolve the issue quickly. Success in this role means the QA team becomes more disciplined and effective, automated coverage increases where it matters, fewer defects escape into production, and releases become more predictable, auditable, and automated over time.

This is a sales and conversion-focused position. The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that prospective students who express interest in our programs receive timely, professional, consistent, and persuasive follow-up designed to move qualified prospects from inquiry to conversation, conversation to application, and application to enrollment. The ideal candidate must be comfortable with sales, follow-up, telephone conversations, text messaging, email communication, CRM systems, lead organization, customer service, marketing, and working toward measurable enrollment goals. We are looking for someone who understands that every inquiry represents a potential student whose life and career may be positively impacted by the right educational opportunity. This individual must be able to build relationships, communicate value, overcome reasonable objections, follow up consistently, and help prospective students confidently determine whether our programs are the right fit for their goals. ? Primary Responsibilities Lead Management & Organization The specialist will be responsible for maintaining an organized and effective lead-management system. Responsibilities include: * Receive and manage leads generated through websites, landing pages, Google Ads, social media, events, referrals, telephone calls, email, and other marketing sources. * Ensure new leads are entered into the appropriate CRM or lead-management system. * Respond to new inquiries promptly. * Maintain accurate lead statuses and contact information. * Categorize leads according to their stage within the enrollment process. * Maintain detailed notes regarding conversations, interests, concerns, objections, follow-up dates, and next steps. * Schedule appropriate follow-up activities. * Prevent qualified leads from becoming lost due to inconsistent communication. * Maintain an organized daily pipeline of prospects requiring attention. * Identify older leads that should be re-engaged. * Keep lead databases accurate, current, and organized. * Identify high-intent prospects who may be ready to enroll. * Track prospects from initial inquiry through enrollment. Every qualified lead should have a clear status, a documented next step, and an appropriate follow-up date. Sales & Enrollment Conversion This individual must be comfortable selling educational programs and communicating the value of making an investment in professional education. Responsibilities include: * Speak confidently with prospective students regarding available programs. * Explain program benefits, schedules, learning formats, tuition, payment options, enrollment requirements, and next steps accurately. * Learn and understand the features, benefits, and ideal student profile for each program. * Conduct professional sales and admissions conversations by telephone, text, email, video call, and other approved communication methods. * Ask appropriate questions to understand the prospect’s goals, concerns, career interests, financial considerations, and barriers to enrollment. * Help prospective students understand which program may best support their goals. * Clearly communicate the value of the educational opportunity rather than focusing solely on price. * Professionally address common objections involving tuition, scheduling, distance, fear, uncertainty, timing, and other enrollment concerns. * Create urgency when appropriate without using misleading or high-pressure sales tactics. * Ask qualified prospects for the enrollment. * Provide clear instructions regarding the application and enrollment process. * Follow up with prospects who begin but do not complete applications or enrollment. * Re-engage prospective students who previously expressed interest but did not enroll. * Work toward individual and organizational enrollment goals. The specialist should understand that successful sales involves relationship building, listening, education, follow-through, confidence, and consistency. Lead Follow-Up & Nurturing Consistent follow-up is a major responsibility of this position. The specialist will: * Conduct daily follow-up with assigned prospective students. * Utilize telephone calls, SMS/text messaging, email, and other approved channels. * Follow established lead-nurturing sequences. * Personalize communication when appropriate. * Follow up after tours, consultations, information sessions, events, and applications. * Reconnect with prospects who stop responding. * Maintain appropriate communication without becoming unprofessional or excessively aggressive. * Identify why prospects are not moving forward and communicate useful trends to leadership. * Ensure scheduled follow-ups are completed on time. * Create or recommend additional nurturing strategies when current approaches are not producing results. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management The specialist must be comfortable working with technology and maintaining accurate information within a CRM or lead-management platform. Responsibilities may include: * Maintain prospect records. * Update lead stages. * Enter notes after conversations. * Schedule follow-up activities. * Track appointments and consultations. * Monitor application progress. * Track enrollment outcomes. * Identify overdue follow-ups. * Help maintain automated email and SMS campaigns. * Identify duplicate or incomplete records. * Produce or assist with lead and conversion reports. * Work with platforms such as GoHighLevel, Leadpages, Google Sheets, Kajabi, or other systems adopted by the organization. * Identify opportunities to improve automation and lead management. Marketing Support The specialist will work closely with leadership and other team members to help promote programs and generate qualified inquiries. Responsibilities include: * Assist with marketing campaigns for school programs. * Help develop promotional messaging based on questions and concerns received from prospective students. * Assist with email and SMS campaigns. * Support program launches, enrollment campaigns, open houses, information sessions, webinars, and special events. * Help identify effective promotional opportunities. * Review lead quality from different marketing sources and report findings to leadership. * Communicate recurring questions and objections so marketing messages can be improved. * Assist with basic social media and digital marketing activities when assigned. * Work with the team to ensure advertisements, landing pages, sales messaging, and admissions conversations communicate a consistent message. * Recommend new strategies for generating and converting qualified leads. Customer Service & Student Experience Excellent customer service is essential. The specialist may be one of the first representatives a prospective student encounters and therefore must represent Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute professionally. Responsibilities include: * Provide warm, professional, knowledgeable service to prospective and current students. * Answer general program and enrollment questions accurately. * Respond to telephone calls, emails, text messages, and inquiries in a timely manner. * Assist newly enrolled students with understanding their next steps. * Help direct students to the appropriate staff member when an issue falls outside the specialist’s responsibilities. * Handle concerns professionally and calmly. * Document significant concerns or complaints. * Escalate serious student or customer concerns to leadership appropriately. * Follow through to ensure questions and concerns are addressed. * Maintain appropriate professional boundaries with students and prospective students. * Protect confidential student and business information. Enrollment Onboarding & Handoff The responsibility does not end immediately after a prospect says “yes.” The specialist will help ensure a smooth transition from prospect to enrolled student. Responsibilities include: * Confirm required enrollment steps have been completed. * Ensure necessary information is properly documented. * Communicate orientation or onboarding information. * Confirm students understand their immediate next steps. * Coordinate with appropriate staff regarding newly enrolled students. * Ensure the student receives a professional handoff from admissions into the educational experience. * Identify incomplete enrollment requirements and follow up appropriately. Sales Performance & Accountability This is a performance-driven position. The employee must be comfortable having performance evaluated using measurable indicators such as: * Number of new leads received. * Lead response time. * Number of leads contacted. * Number of meaningful conversations. * Follow-up completion rate. * Consultation or appointment bookings. * Application starts. * Application completion. * Enrollment conversions. * Lead-to-enrollment conversion rate. * Re-engagement of older leads. * Customer service responsiveness. * CRM accuracy. * Achievement of assigned enrollment goals. The specialist will be expected to understand their numbers and work with leadership to improve performance when necessary. Time Management & Productivity Strong time-management skills are required. The specialist must: * Prioritize high-intent leads while maintaining appropriate follow-up with the entire pipeline. * Complete assigned projects by the assigned due date and due time. * Manage sales activities, marketing responsibilities, customer service, and administrative assignments simultaneously. * Maintain an organized daily schedule. * Respond promptly to time-sensitive inquiries. * Complete scheduled follow-ups when promised. * Communicate proactively when a legitimate issue may affect a deadline. * Demonstrate reliability and consistency. * Work independently without requiring constant reminders to complete routine responsibilities. Communication Skills The successful candidate must demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills. The specialist must be able to: * Communicate confidently by telephone. * Write professional text messages and emails. * Explain complex information in simple terms. * Listen carefully to prospective students. * Ask effective discovery questions. * Build rapport quickly. * Communicate with empathy while remaining sales-focused. * Professionally address objections. * Ask for enrollment confidently. * Maintain a professional tone during difficult conversations. * Adjust communication styles appropriately for different prospective students. Artificial Intelligence & Technology Experience using modern technology and AI is strongly preferred. The specialist should be able to: * Utilize AI tools to improve productivity. * Assist with developing follow-up messages, email campaigns, sales scripts, FAQs, and marketing ideas. * Use AI to organize information and improve workflows. * Understand basic marketing automation. * Quickly learn new CRM and technology platforms. * Recommend ways technology and automation can improve lead response and conversion. * Use technology to work more efficiently without sacrificing personalization or customer service. Team Collaboration The specialist will work closely with admissions, marketing, administration, instructors, and leadership. The employee must: * Communicate effectively with team members. * Participate in meetings and sales training when required. * Provide accurate updates regarding leads and enrollment activity. * Share information that may help improve marketing and admissions strategies. * Accept coaching and constructive feedback. * Implement requested changes promptly. * Support team enrollment goals in addition to individual goals. * Maintain a professional and positive working relationship with staff. * Communicate important prospective student concerns to the appropriate team member. Required Skills The ideal candidate should demonstrate: * Strong sales ability. * Strong customer service skills. * Excellent telephone communication. * Excellent written communication. * Lead management experience. * CRM experience. * Sales pipeline management. * Strong organizational skills. * Strong follow-up skills. * Ability to handle objections. * Relationship-building skills. * Marketing knowledge. * Digital marketing familiarity. * Basic understanding of landing pages and funnels. * Strong computer skills. * Google Ads and Google Workspace proficiency. * Ability to learn new technology quickly. * Strong time-management skills. * Attention to detail. * Problem-solving ability. * Ability to work independently. * Ability to work effectively as part of a team. * Professionalism and confidentiality. Preferred Experience Preference may be given to candidates with previous experience in: * Admissions * Education sales * Career school admissions * Enrollment advising * Consultative sales * Inside sales * Lead generation * Lead conversion * CRM management * Digital marketing * Customer service * Call-center sales * Beauty, aesthetics, cosmetology, wellness, or healthcare education * High-ticket products or services * Financing or payment-plan conversations Ideal Candidate Profile Our ideal candidate is someone who can receive a new inquiry and immediately understand: “This person should never become just another name on a spreadsheet.” They will know how to make contact, build rapport, understand the prospect’s goals, communicate the value of our programs, address concerns, follow up consistently, organize the relationship within our CRM, and confidently guide qualified students toward making an enrollment decision. We want someone who is: Persistent without being pushy. Confident without being aggressive. Compassionate without losing focus on the sale. Organized without needing constant supervision. Creative enough to bring new ideas. Competitive enough to want to reach goals. Professional enough to represent our institution well. Overall Performance Expectation The Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist is ultimately responsible for helping Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute create a reliable and professional pathway from: Marketing ??Lead ??Contact ?? Relationship ?? Consultation ?? Application ??Enrollment ??Successful Student Handoff We are looking for someone who understands that strong marketing generates opportunities, but excellent lead management, communication, customer service, follow-up, and sales conversion turn those opportunities into enrolled students. The successful candidate will bring energy, discipline, organization, initiative, creativity, and a genuine desire to help prospective students move forward with their educational and career goals while contributing directly to the continued growth of Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute.

Our Expectation Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is continuing to expand its educational reach through online, hybrid, and technology-supported programs. This position will play an important role in helping us build the infrastructure necessary for that growth. We are looking for someone who sees technology as more than software. Technology should make education easier to access, make students more engaged, make our team more efficient, and help more prospective students successfully move from interest to enrollment. The right individual will be organized, creative, dependable, technology-driven, solutions-focused, and excited about helping us build educational programs that can grow and serve students at a high level.

You understand that a good ad is not just beautiful. It stops the scroll, holds attention, and converts. If you love both video editing AND figuring out what makes people buy, keep reading. ## What you will create - AI cartoon UGC ads - AI animated storytelling ads - Short-form Meta creatives - New variations of our winning ads ## What we are looking for - Strong short-form video editing skills for social and Meta ads (portfolio required) - A direct-response mindset: you care about hooks, retention, and conversion, not just aesthetics - Experience with, or real eagerness to master, AI video tools (Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, or similar) - Experience with (or the ability to create) styles like Zak D film, claymation, hypermotion, Pixar-style animation, and Sing-style music videos - Reliable, communicative, and able to take ownership of the work You do not need to have done 100% AI cartoon work before. This work compounds: the longer your head is in one account, the better the results get. That is why we want a long-term partner, and exclusivity is something we are happy to discuss and reward. ## How to apply Please send us: 1. A short motivation: why this role is a good fit for you. 2. Your portfolio, with your best short-form ad and AI animation / cartoon examples. 3. Your AI tool stack, tool by tool. 4. Any results you can share (for example ads that performed well or spent heavily on Meta, including long-form VSLs), plus your availability and whether you are open to exclusivity. We are looking for someone to help us find winning creatives and scale them with us long-term.

title: Podcast Video/Audio Editor
description: I am looking for an experienced Video/Audio Editor who is SKILLED, RELIABLE and has a great EAR for pacing. I need someone who can take raw podcast footage and remove the pauses and filler words to make me and my cohost sound even smarter than we already are. I am looking for someone DETAIL-ORIENTED, HONEST and DEDICATED to join the team as soon as possible! You’ll be editing approximately one hour of raw podcast footage per week (video + audio), cutting dead air, filler words ("um," "uh"), long pauses, and false starts, choosing 10 - 30 second teasers to open the episode, and Inserting provided intro (between teaser and start of episode) and outro (at the very end). You will not need to worry about multi-camera cuts or overlays. You’ll deliver a finished episode ready for publishing on Patreon (video + audio) and to the podcast platforms (audio only). I anticipate this will be 3-5 hours of work per week to start, with the potential to grow to 7-10 hours per week if we're a good fit — including social media clips down the line. Must know Riverside.fm's editor OR your own software (Premiere, DaVinci, Final Cut, etc). Bonus points if you use a platform that leverages AI to identify filler words and balance audio levels, etc. I’m looking for someone with a good ear for PACING, in other words, you know when a cut helps the conversation flow vs. when it kills the natural rhythm. There are REAL deadlines every week. So this is a GREAT long-term opportunity with room to grow, but you must be reliable and consistent. If this sounds like you, reply to this job post with: A link to 1-2 podcast OR video edits you've done, your typical turnaround time, and a movie or tv show you loved as a child.

title: Graphics Designer for Anime, TCG & Hobby Brands
job_title: Graphics Designer for Anime, TCG & Hobby Brands
description: ============== ABOUT THE ROLE ============== We're a friendly digital marketing agency working with ecommerce and hobby brands: anime-inspired brands, trading card games (Magic, Pokémon, sports cards), collectibles, and local game stores. We love this world, and we're looking for a designer who does too. We're after someone who makes designs that look great and get people to click and buy. If you've got a good eye and solid work to show, we'd love to hear from you. ============== WHAT YOU'LL DO ============== - Design marketing emails that are clean, on-brand, mobile-first, and built to convert. - Create static ads and social media content. - Whip up multiple versions of a design for testing. - Match each client's brand and keep it consistent. - Help build brand guidelines for clients who don't have them yet. - Take feedback and turn revisions around fast. ====================== WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ====================== - A good eye for clean, modern design, and a sense of where you want the reader's eye to go. - You get what makes an ad or email actually perform, not just look nice. Our stuff needs to drive clicks and sales, so you can explain why your design choices work. - Figma is a must. It's what we use to pass designs to our email team. Canva, Photoshop, or similar are a plus. - Comfortable switching between very different brand styles. - Branding experience. You can help build brand guidelines for brands that don't have them. - Reliable and organized. You can handle a few brands at once without quality slipping. =========== NICE TO HAVE =========== - You're into the hobby world yourself: anime, trading card games (Magic, Pokémon, sports cards), collectibles. You'll design better for these brands if you actually get them. ============ HOW TO APPLY ============ 1. Start your message with "Pikachu" so we know you read this in full. 2. Send your portfolio link. 3. Record a short Loom (1 to 3 minutes): who you are, why you want to work with us, and your favorite anime, card game, or hobby. Keep it casual, no need to make it fancy. 4. Tell us your expected monthly rate and when you can start. Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Creative Video Editor for E-commerce Ads
job_title: Creative Video Editor for E-commerce Ads
description: We are a Swedish e-commerce company with several brands. We need a full-time Creative Video Editor to research, source content and create direct-response video ads for Meta (Facebook and Instagram). This is not only a video editing job. You must do the full creative work: - Research the customer, product, reviews, competitors and ads - Study our active ads in Meta Ads Library - Study our reference video carefully - Find strong hooks and angles - Write or improve scripts - Find, create or generate the footage you need - Edit the complete ad - Improve ads based on results At first, you will work with Scarlet Intimates / Scarlet Flow, a Scandinavian period-underwear brand. The two main customers are: 1. Mothers buying Scarlet Flow Teen for daughters before or around their first period. 2. Adult women who want a comfortable and dry alternative to pads. IMPORTANT: THE PAID TEST Selected applicants receive a Google Drive folder with the full creative brief, brand information, research and a reference ad. You must create two complete Swedish ads: 1. One Adult ad 2. One Teen ad These are not quick sample videos. Both videos must be complete, polished and ready to run as real Meta ads. Treat the test exactly like real full-time work. For the test, you must: - Read and follow every part of the brief - Search Scarlet Intimates in Meta Ads Library and study our active ads - Study the reference video carefully - Do more research yourself - Source or create your own content and B-roll. TikTok is a good source for research and B-roll ideas - Make natural Scandinavian-looking visuals - Keep the Scarlet product correct and consistent in every scene - Avoid obvious one-prompt AI content - Use fast cuts, scene variation, text, transitions, movement, sound effects and strong pacing - Write the hooks and scripts, make voice-over and captions, and deliver finished ads Deadline: 3 days. The test pays $50 total when both finished creatives are delivered and the complete brief and requirements have been followed. Rushed, incomplete or off-brief tests are not approved for payment. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with this exact first line: CREATIVE EDITOR | [the editing software you use most] Then include: 1. A link to one real, finished e-commerce or direct-response ad that you personally made. Do not send a montage. 2. Go to Meta Ads Library. Find one active Scarlet Intimates ad and paste the link. In 3 simple bullet points, explain the target customer, the hook, and one thing you would improve. 3. Confirm that you can source or create content yourself and finish two test ads within 3 days. If any item is missing, we will not review the application. LONG-TERM ROLE This is a full-time role, 40 hours per week. Salary is $400-$750 per month plus performance bonuses, with room to grow. We want someone who can stay for several years. If hired, we provide the AI tools needed for the work.

You must do the full creative work: - Research the customer, product, reviews, competitors and ads - Study our active ads in Meta Ads Library - Study our reference video carefully - Find strong hooks and angles - Write or improve scripts - Find, create or generate the footage you need - Edit the complete ad - Improve ads based on results At first, you will work with Scarlet Intimates / Scarlet Flow, a Scandinavian period-underwear brand. The two main customers are: 1. Mothers buying Scarlet Flow Teen for daughters before or around their first period. 2. Adult women who want a comfortable and dry alternative to pads. IMPORTANT: THE PAID TEST Selected applicants receive a Google Drive folder with the full creative brief, brand information, research and a reference ad. You must create two complete Swedish ads: 1. One Adult ad 2. One Teen ad These are not quick sample videos. Both videos must be complete, polished and ready to run as real Meta ads. Treat the test exactly like real full-time work. For the test, you must: - Read and follow every part of the brief - Search Scarlet Intimates in Meta Ads Library and study our active ads - Study the reference video carefully - Do more research yourself - Source or create your own content and B-roll. TikTok is a good source for research and B-roll ideas - Make natural Scandinavian-looking visuals - Keep the Scarlet product correct and consistent in every scene - Avoid obvious one-prompt AI content - Use fast cuts, scene variation, text, transitions, movement, sound effects and strong pacing - Write the hooks and scripts, make voice-over and captions, and deliver finished ads Deadline: 3 days. A link to one real, finished e-commerce or direct-response ad that you personally made. Do not send a montage. 2. Go to Meta Ads Library. Find one active Scarlet Intimates ad and paste the link. In 3 simple bullet points, explain the target customer, the hook, and one thing you would improve. 3. Confirm that you can source or create content yourself and finish two test ads within 3 days. title: WordPress Engineer (1 to 2 Months)
description: WordPress Engineer Mid-Level | Remote-Friendly | Contract or Full-Time About the Role We're hiring a mid-level WordPress Engineer to join a growing engineering team that treats WordPress as a serious, modern engineering discipline — not a drag-and-drop CMS. You'll work on version-controlled, Composer-managed WordPress builds with structured content, design-token-driven theming, automated testing, and a proper CI/CD pipeline. If you're tired of plugin-soup builds and want to work the way front-end and back-end engineering is supposed to be done, this role is for you. What You'll Do • Build and maintain WordPress sites on a Composer-managed project architecture — WordPress core, plugins, and themes declared as pinned, version-controlled dependencies (no wp-admin plugin installs). • Develop bespoke, classic (non-block) WordPress themes coded from a client's design system, using structured, reusable template components. • Build page-composition experiences using ACF Flexible Content (or comparable structured-field tooling), with a strict one-to-one mapping between each content block and its template partial. • Implement and maintain a design-token pipeline so every colour, spacing, and typography value flows from a single source of truth — nothing hardcoded into templates or stylesheets. • Model custom post types, taxonomies, and fields in code so content structure is reviewable, version-controlled, and reproducible. • Build accessible, secure custom forms without general-purpose form-builder plugins — proper nonce protection, honeypots, rate limiting, and spam prevention. • Maintain a small, vetted set of third-party plugins — every addition assessed, pinned to an exact version, and justified. • Apply WordPress security hardening as standard practice: locked-down file editing, environment-based secrets, disabled XML-RPC, rate-limited login endpoints, and related measures. • Write and maintain automated tests — coding standards, static analysis, accessibility checks, and end-to-end coverage. • Work within a CI/CD pipeline where every change is peer-reviewed, scanned, and tested before it reaches production. • Use a containerised local development environment for consistent, reproducible setups across the team. What We're Looking For • 2–4 years of professional WordPress development experience. • Strong PHP fundamentals, comfortable working outside a "vanilla" WordPress install (Composer-based project structures such as Bedrock or similar). • Experience building custom themes from a design system — semantic, accessible markup, no reliance on page-builder plugins. • Familiarity with Advanced Custom Fields (or comparable structured-content tooling) for content modelling. • Working knowledge of modern front-end practice: progressive enhancement with vanilla JavaScript, and CSS custom properties or design tokens. • Solid understanding of WordPress security fundamentals — sanitisation, escaping, nonces, and capability checks. • Some exposure to automated testing (unit, accessibility, or end-to-end) and Git-based CI/CD workflows. • Comfortable working independently against documented engineering standards, and collaborating closely with designers and other developers. • Good written and spoken English for async collaboration with a distributed team. Nice to Have • Experience with a design-token / style-dictionary pipeline, or with Storybook as a component review tool. • Familiarity with WCAG AA accessibility standards and automated accessibility testing tools. • Experience with WordPress multisite. • Exposure to dependency or security scanning tools in a CI pipeline. What You Can Expect • A remote-friendly, engineering-first WordPress role built around real standards — not a one-off plugin-install job. • Clear technical documentation and conventions to build against from day one. • A collaborative code-review culture and modern CI/CD tooling. • The opportunity to grow into more senior architecture and mentorship responsibility over time. Attach your CV or CV Links (PDF File Preferred)

title: Personal Assistant
description: Company Overview BKG is a Dutch home-renovation group running 25+ brands including Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and Tegelstudio (tiles). We are building a small remote team to support the founder and the captains running the brands. This role sits next to the founder day-to-day. Job Description We are looking for a Personal Assistant who works as an Agenda Setter: someone who looks at what needs to happen today, this week and this month, d ---------- the priority order, and makes sure the founder's calendar and the team's project boards reflect that. You are the person who prevents things from slipping through the cracks. Your day is a mix of: reviewing what's on the founder's plate, blocking focus time in the calendar, keeping the project boards (Trello, Bitrix24) up to date, sending short follow-ups so tasks don't stall, and organizing incoming information so decisions are easy. You will handle confidential information — contracts, salaries, personal details — and are expected to be discreet with it at all times. Your Responsibilities ● Set daily, weekly and monthly priorities for the founder and confirm the order with him each morning. ● Own the founder's calendar: block deep-work time, schedule meetings, defend focus blocks against low-priority requests. ● Keep project boards (Trello, Bitrix24) accurate: cards in the right column, owners set, deadlines realistic, stale items chased. ● Track open action items across the captains (Devita, Sanne, Anne, Sandy/Christine) and send short follow-ups when something stalls. ● Organize incoming information — email, WhatsApp, docs — into a short daily brief so the founder can d ---------- fast. ● Handle confidential information (contracts, offers, finance, HR) with full discretion. ● Prepare meetings: agenda, links, short brief; capture decisions and next actions after. Must-have ● 1+ years as a PA, EA, or project coordinator with a founder or small leadership team. ● Proven working knowledge of Trello and Bitrix24 (or a very similar project/CRM system — Asana, ClickUp, Monday, HubSpot). ● Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Drive, Docs, Gmail) — this is your home base. ● Working knowledge of an AI assistant (Google Gemini, ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, summarize and research. ● Strong sense for confidentiality — you keep sensitive information to yourself, no exceptions. ● Reliable written English; responsive during Dutch office hours (CET). Nice-to-have ● Any Dutch language (not required — the team writes in English with you). ● Experience running a weekly review / prioritization ritual with a founder. ● Light bookkeeping / invoice tracking exposure. Hours & rate Part-time, 16–20 hours per week (we plan on 18). $4–6/hour depending on proven skill; recommended $5/hour = about $360/month. How to Apply Start your message with the word "PLAN" so we know you read the full post. Then, in 4–5 sentences: ● Which project/CRM systems (Trello, Bitrix24, Asana, ClickUp, HubSpot, …) have you actually worked in, and for how long? ● Describe one time you set priorities for a founder or manager when everything felt urgent — how did you d ---------- the order? ● Which AI assistant (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) do you use in your daily work, and for what? ● Give one concrete example of how you handled confidential information — what made it work. We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren't considered.

title: Creative Strategist / Head of Creative — DTC Ecommerce Brands (Full Time, Remote)
job_title: Creative Strategist / Head of Creative — DTC Ecommerce Brands (Full Time, Remote)
description: Creative Strategist / Head of Creative — DTC Ecommerce Brands (Full Time, Remote) We run a portfolio of direct to consumer ecommerce brands in the USA, including clothing brands. Our growth comes from one thing: volume and quality of creative. We are building an in house creative team and looking for a creative strategist to lead it — someone who owns the ideas, the angles, the testing, and the people. You don't need to come from an agency. You need to come from performance. If you have spent years figuring out why one ad prints money and another dies in the first two seconds, this role is for you. ## WHAT YOU WILL DO You are the brain of the creative operation. Editors execute — you d ---------- what gets made, why, and what happens to it after it launches. Day to day this looks like: • Owning the creative strategy across all our brands: angles, hooks, concepts, and formats • Writing scripts and briefs for ads — UGC style, advertorial, direct response video, and static ads • Managing and directing our video editors: assigning work, giving sharp feedback, and holding a high quality bar • Running the testing system: d ---------- what gets tested, structuring hook and angle tests, reading the data, and calling winners and losers • Turning winners into scaling plans — new variations, new angles, new formats • Building creative briefs that editors can execute without back and forth • Researching competitors, trends, and what's working in the market right now • Working hands on with AI tools when needed — you should be able to generate, not just direct • Reporting directly to the founders on creative performance and pipeline ## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Real experience in performance creative for DTC ecommerce — you have made ads that spent real money on Meta, and you can show the results • Strong scriptwriting for paid social: UGC ads, advertorials, VSLs, statics. You know how to write a hook that stops the scroll and a structure that sells • Deep understanding of marketing angles, customer psychology, and how to test them systematically • Experience managing editors or a creative team — giving feedback that makes work better, not just different • Hands on with the tools: CapCut, Claude, and Higgsfield are must haves. You use AI daily for scripting, ideation, image and video generation • Familiarity with the wider AI stack — Nano Banana Pro, ChatGPT Image, Seedance, Kling 3.0, Sora — and platforms like Freepik and Artlist • You understand the full ad production pipeline and can spot where it breaks • An interest in clothing and fashion, or experience with clothing brands, is a strong plus • Comfortable working independently, communicating clearly in English, and being reachable during agreed hours • Reliable internet and a machine that can handle heavy creative and AI workflows Claude, CapCut, and Higgsfield are non negotiable. They are part of the daily workflow, not bonus skills. ## WHERE THIS ROLE GOES This is a leadership seat. As the team grows, you grow with it — more editors under you, more brands, more budget, more ownership. The path here is head of creative, with real influence over how our brands look, sound, and sell. We invest in the person in this seat and expect them to build the creative machine with us. ## COMPENSATION • 1,500 – 2,000 USD per month depending on experience • Higher compensation is on the table based on performance and negotiation ## HOURS Full time, 40 hours per week, Philippines time working hours. Start date: ASAP. ## HOW TO APPLY Your application will not be reviewed unless it includes all of the following: 1. **A portfolio or proof of work** — ads you have strategized, scripted, or produced for ecommerce brands, with results where possible (spend, ROAS, CTR, or context on performance). Links or attachments (Drive, ---------- , personal site) are fine. 2. **Script samples** — at least two ad scripts you have written (any format: UGC, advertorial, direct response). Real work, not theory. 3. **A written description of your AI workflow** — how you use Claude, Higgsfield, CapCut, and any other AI tools day to day. What do you use each one for, and what have you produced with them? This is required. 4. **A short note on how you test creative** — how you structure tests, what you look for in the data, and how you d ---------- what scales. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to walk through real examples during the interview — actual scripts, actual tests, actual generations — so be ready to show your work, not just talk about it. --- A couple of things you may want to adjust before posting: - **Job title** — I'd post it as **"Creative Strategist (Head of Creative Track)"** — "Head of Creative" alone tends to attract agency people who expect agency salaries, while "Creative Strategist" attracts the performance marketing crowd you actually want. - **Proof of results** — if you've had issues with inflated portfolios, you could add "be ready to share ad account screenshots" to the interview line.

You don't want somebody checking every single thing you do forever. You want to understand the role properly, take ownership of it and become excellent at it. You enjoy being the person who knows what is going on. You notice when something doesn't make sense and investigate it. You care about getting things right. And you are looking for a long-term position where you can become an important part of a growing team. Working With Us We are a friendly, down-to-earth UK accountancy practice and we genuinely value our team. We already work with team members in the Philippines and are continuing to build our Philippines-based team. We care far more about the quality of your work, communication and reliability than somebody simply appearing online for a certain number of hours. title: EVENT LOGISTICS COORDINATOR
description: Charlotte Party Rentals is seeking a highly organized, proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented Event Logistics Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day coordination of our U.S.-based event logistics, warehouse operations, inventory, and field workforce. This is a key operational position working remotely from the Philippines while closely coordinating with our Charlotte, North Carolina team. The ideal candidate is a strong organizer and problem-solver who can manage multiple moving parts, anticipate what needs to happen next, coordinate people and resources, follow through on deadlines, and ensure events are operationally ready from preparation through completion. Consistent attendance, punctuality, and availability during scheduled U.S. Eastern working hours are essential requirements of this position. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Event Logistics & Scheduling • Coordinate event delivery, setup, pickup, and return schedules. • Prepare and maintain daily and weekly logistics schedules. • Coordinate field crew assignments and work schedules. • Assist with efficient routing and event sequencing. • Review event orders and confirmed details for logistics requirements. • Communicate special instructions, site/access requirements, schedule changes, and operational details to the appropriate teams. • Monitor upcoming events for readiness and proactively identify missing information or potential problems. • Coordinate with Sales when additional client/event information is required. Warehouse & Field Team Coordination • Coordinate warehouse preparation and loading priorities according to upcoming events. • Organize warehouse and field workers based on schedules, workload, and event requirements. • Maintain clear communication among Sales, Warehouse, Field, and Management. • Coordinate vehicle and equipment requirements. • Monitor completion of assigned warehouse and field responsibilities. • Help maintain organization, accountability, efficiency, and workflow within warehouse operations. Worker Efficiency & Evaluation • Monitor warehouse and field worker productivity and efficiency. • Review job completion times and overall execution. • Track adherence to schedules, procedures, and assigned responsibilities. • Review required event photos, documentation, and job-completion requirements when applicable. • Maintain appropriate worker efficiency and performance records. • Identify recurring performance or operational concerns. • Assist management with periodic worker evaluations. • Escalate significant performance concerns to management when appropriate. Inventory Maintenance • Help maintain accurate rental inventory records. • Monitor inventory availability against upcoming reservations. • Identify shortages, discrepancies, damaged equipment, and missing items. • Coordinate routine inventory counts and verification. • Track equipment requiring cleaning, repair, maintenance, or replacement. • Help ensure rental-management software accurately reflects operational inventory availability. • Communicate inventory concerns before they affect upcoming events. Subrental & Vendor Coordination • Identify items that need to be sourced from outside vendors. • Order and coordinate approved subrental equipment, including linens and other rental items. • Verify quantities, sizes, colors, specifications, dates, and event requirements. • Coordinate vendor communication and track incoming subrental orders. • Coordinate receipt and return of sub-rented equipment. • Ensure subrental requirements are completed according to event deadlines. NC 811 & Tent Permitting Coordination • Coordinate NC 811 utility-marking requests for applicable tent installations. • Track marking requests and completion status. • Coordinate required tent permitting and organize information needed for permit applications. • Track permit deadlines, approvals, inspections, and outstanding requirements. • Maintain organized records of permits, utility markings, and related documentation. • Escalate unresolved permitting or site-compliance concerns before installation. Event Execution Support • Monitor logistics throughout active event days. • Coordinate schedule and routing changes when necessary. • Assist with unexpected field or site issues. • Maintain communication with warehouse and field personnel. • Coordinate pickup and return requirements and track subrental returns. • Maintain accurate logistics documentation. After-Event Evaluation • Review completed events from an operational perspective. • Evaluate whether scheduling, preparation, delivery, setup, pickup, and return were completed properly. • Identify delays, damages, missing equipment, incomplete responsibilities, or other operational issues. • Review worker efficiency and execution. • Document recurring problems and opportunities for improvement. • Communicate significant findings to management. • Help turn lessons learned into improvements for future events. TECHNICAL SKILLS & SYSTEM EXPERIENCE AI & Productivity Tools • Proficient with modern AI-assisted productivity tools, including ChatGPT, Manus, and similar platforms. • Comfortable using AI responsibly for research, problem-solving, documentation, organization, communication, data review, process development, and workflow efficiency. • Resourceful and able to use technology to solve routine problems independently while knowing when management involvement is required. Rental Management Software • Previous event/equipment rental software experience is strongly preferred. • Experience with RentKit, Event Office / Inflatable Office, ERS / Event Rental Systems, Point of Rental, or comparable rental-management platforms is particularly valuable. • Direct event rental, equipment rental, tent rental, event logistics, or related industry experience is a significant advantage. General Technical Skills • Google Workspace, Google Sheets/spreadsheets, shared documents, cloud storage, email, and calendar management. • CRM systems, digital scheduling tools, data entry, record maintenance, and online research. • Ability to learn new software quickly and work across multiple applications simultaneously. • Strong data accuracy and attention to detail. ATTENDANCE & RELIABILITY Consistent attendance is a must. • Excellent and consistent attendance and dependable punctuality. • Availability throughout scheduled working hours. • Reliable high-speed internet and dependable computer/workstation. • A reasonable backup plan for common internet or power interruptions. • Prompt communication when an unavoidable emergency affects availability. • Ability to consistently maintain an overnight Philippine work schedule. • Strong personal accountability and follow-through. IDEAL CANDIDATE • Highly organized and detail-oriented; proactive rather than reactive. • Dependable, consistent, resourceful, and technologically adaptable. • Comfortable coordinating people remotely and holding others accountable for assigned responsibilities. • Able to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously. • Strong written and spoken English. • Confident communicating with workers, vendors, and management. • Able to prioritize urgent versus non-urgent matters and recognize problems before they become emergencies. • Able to work independently without constant supervision. • Comfortable researching solutions and escalating appropriately when management decisions are required. • Experience in event rentals, event logistics, dispatching, warehouse operations, inventory management, project coordination, construction logistics, workforce coordination, or similar environments is strongly preferred. WORK SCHEDULE Full-Time | Remote | Philippines-Based Working Hours: 6:00 AM-3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time Because U.S. Eastern Time observes daylight saving time while the Philippines does not, Philippine working hours will generally be 6:00 PM-3:00 AM PHT during U.S. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) and 7:00 PM-4:00 AM PHT during U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST). Applicants must be comfortable maintaining an overnight Philippine schedule that follows U.S. Eastern Time throughout the year. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A successful Event Logistics Coordinator does not simply wait for instructions. They consistently think: What events are coming up? Is everything ready? What needs to happen next? Who is responsible? Has it actually been completed? Is anything missing? What could cause a problem tomorrow? What can we improve next time? The goal of this position is to create organized, efficient, predictable event operations and help ensure that the right people, equipment, information, permits, subrentals, and resources are in the right place at the right time. ABOUT CHARLOTTE PARTY RENTALS Charlotte Party Rentals is an established event rental company serving Charlotte, North Carolina and surrounding communities. Our team provides tents, tables, chairs, linens, and other event rental equipment and services for private, corporate, community, and large-scale events. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our operations team and contribute to improving the systems, organization, efficiency, and quality of our company. HOW TO APPLY • Your updated resume. • A brief introduction about yourself. • Your relevant experience in logistics, operations, event rentals, warehouse coordination, inventory, workforce coordination, or project management. • Any experience with RentKit, Event/Inflatable Office, ERS, Point of Rental, or other rental-management software. • The AI tools you regularly use and a brief explanation of how you use them professionally. • Other software/platforms you are proficient with. • Description of your computer, internet, and backup work setup. • Confirmation that you can consistently work 6:00 AM-3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time. • Your expected monthly compensation. • Your earliest available start date. Email Subject: Event Logistics Coordinator - [Your Full Name]
