description: Needs to hire 2 Freelancers Summary Long-term faceless YouTube editor — cinematic gaming breakdowns (multiple hires) — Please only apply for long-term work Compensation This is a per-video position with real room to grow. We're starting with modest trial rates while we learn each other's workflow; strong, reliable editors get raises, performance bonuses, and steady volume as we scale. Starting rates (trial / first-video, then they grow): 5–12 minutes: $12 per video 13 minutes: $13 per video 14 minutes: $14 per video 15–19 minutes: $15 per video 20–25 minutes: $20 per video 26–30 minutes: $25 per video 31–35 minutes: $30 per video — and so on Reliable turnaround is highly valued and rewarded with bonuses and more work. As soon as we get monetized, the rates change — our policy is simple: if we grow, you grow with us. Expected workload We publish on a consistent schedule, so we're looking for someone who can reliably deliver 4–8+ videos per month and scale up as we grow. Speed matters — but never at the cost of retention or quality. About us We run a faceless YouTube channel doing cinematic, investigative breakdowns of a huge open-world game universe — "everything we actually know," "how [topic] really works," and the real story behind the hype. Think measured, evidence-first, a little noir — but with real energy where it counts. Every video is opened on screen: confirmed facts stamped and sourced, rumors clearly labeled as rumors (we provide those in the script). The look is one consistent, high-end template — dark neon-noir, clean motion graphics — reused across every video so the brand stays instantly recognizable. The retention comes from a mix of two speeds: deliberate, cinematic reveals and push-ins that let big moments land — and fast, punchy, high-energy sequences (rapid cuts, quick on-screen text, fast graphics reveals) where the script builds momentum. We need an editor who can do both and knows which the moment calls for. This is not basic cut-and-trim editing We need an editor who can turn a script + voice-over into a polished, high-retention breakdown: original maps and diagrams, on-screen stamps and callouts, source lower-thirds, deliberate push-ins and rack focus, restrained texture (subtle grain/vignette), and clean sound design. If you only "cut clips and put talking over them," this isn't the role. What we provide for every video: 1. A complete, timestamped script (scene-by-scene) 2. A voice-over recording (real human VO) 3. A locked channel style template / style guide so the look stays consistent 4. Scene direction + creative feedback Your responsibilities: 1. Edit cinematic, high-retention gaming breakdowns (typically 12–25 minutes) to our locked template 2. Build original graphics — maps, region diagrams, timelines, "confirmed vs. rumored" stamp cards, source lower-thirds, chapter cards (NOT just clips with a voice over them) 3. Source relevant b-roll, images, and short official clips — used transformatively, with commentary/analysis over them 4. Add deliberate motion — push-ins, parallax on layered cards, rack focus, clean transitions and on-screen text that matches our neon-noir look 5. Design restrained sound — licensed music + SFX, and protect the two hard-silence beats the scene direction calls out (we use silence on purpose) 6. Keep every video 100% monetization-safe. This is the single most important part of the job in this niche: Absolutely no leaked or datamined footage — ever. Rumored details get rebuilt as original graphics, never shown as stolen clips. Transformative use only — short clips with real commentary, never long re-uploads of anyone's video. 7. Properly licensed music/SFX only (we use Epidemic Sound). 8. You understand what triggers a copyright claim or a "reused content" strike, and you actively build to avoid it. Protecting the channel's monetization is part of the job. 9. Follow the pacing, tone, and style of our reference videos and template 10. Deliver on schedule — turnaround matters 11. Revise based on time-stamped feedback (we review on ---------- , free) Requirements 1. Strong experience editing YouTube videos — ideally gaming, documentary, or long-form breakdown content 2. Excellent pacing and retention instincts — comfortable with both deliberate cinematic pacing and fast, punchy, high-energy cutting within the same video 3. Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar Ability to independently source visuals and build clean original motion graphics, maps, and text — not just place clips 4. A clear, specific understanding of copyright and YouTube monetization safety — you know exactly what gets a channel claimed or demonetized, and how to avoid it 5. Fast, reliable turnaround and communication 6. Good English comprehension 7. Familiarity with gaming culture (especially open-world / GTA-style games) is a big plus 8. Willingness to use ---------- (free) for reviews and revisions Preferred experience: Experience editing videos similar in build quality and pacing to: No Fast Travel RENZI Eufalla That GTA Gamer (TGG) gameranx / Spawn Wave (for gaming fluency) We blend cinematic/investigative pacing with fast, high-energy sequences — No Fast Travel and RENZI are the closest match for the overall build, but you should also be comfortable with the punchy, fast-paced style of gameranx/TGG where the script calls for it. ⚠️ Application instructions (read carefully) To confirm you've read this entire posting: Include the word VICE as the second line of your application. Record a short 30–60 second Loom video introducing yourself and why you're a good fit. Answer all application questions below. Do not apply if you aren't willing to complete a short free 30–60 second trial edit (materials sent only to shortlisted applicants). Applications that don't follow these instructions will be automatically rejected. Application questions 1. Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited — ideally gaming, documentary, or long-form breakdown content — and explain your exact role in each. 2. Which editing software do you use? Are you willing to use ---------- (free) for our review process? 3. How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have? 4. Have you edited gaming, documentary, or news/commentary channels before? Share examples. 5. If we provide only a script and voice-over, can you source all footage and build the maps, diagrams, and graphics yourself? Walk us through your exact process. 6. What sources do you use for footage, images, music, and sound effects — and specifically, how do you make sure everything is safe for YouTube monetization (no copyright claims, no reused-content issues, no leaked footage)? Be specific. 7. How fast can you realistically turn around a 15-minute video? 8. How many videos can you realistically edit per week and month? 9. How many hours per week are you available, and what hours overlap with GMT+3? Final selection Shortlisted applicants complete a 30–60-second sample edit using a script, voice-over, and reference video we provide, so we can judge pacing, sourcing, original graphics, sound design, retention, and attention to detail. Please don't apply if you're unwilling to complete it. Only shortlisted candidates receive the test materials. Long-term opportunity We're building out a growing channel — and more channels behind it — and want reliable editors to grow with us. Strong performers earn higher rates, bonuses, more projects, and the chance to work across multiple channels. If you love gaming and can make cinematic videos people can't stop watching, we'd love to hear from you!

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Faceless Channel Storyteller
description: Are you looking for an awesome job that's not only fun, challenging, and enjoyable, but also pays you more money the harder you work? If so, then please read this job listing carefully. I have a fantastic job opportunity available for a YouTube Scriptwriter that can meet certain criteria. And I have to state upfront, this job isn't for everyone. I'm looking for a very unique person to fill this job. I'm looking for someone who would also enjoy contributing ideas and sharing their thoughts, while they do their job. I'm basically looking for a talented, hard-working person who would like to become a valuable member of my team. And you can do this job completely from your home if you have a high-speed Internet connection and a computer. Not only do we work on fun and challenging projects, but as my business grows so does everyone's SALARY! :) I am putting together a small, tight-knit team, and the scriptwriter (that's you!) is a key seat on it. I'm looking for that special person who can become a superstar on my team. Someone hard-working, passionate, who would love their job and loves writing videos that evoke emotion and keep people watching to the very end. Someone who can help me take my YouTube channels to the next level. Attention to detail, good work ethic, and a strong desire to excel in everything they do are just some of the qualities that can set you apart from the other candidates. I am looking for an A-player, who can work full time, long term, and can commit and dedicate fully to ensure the success of the business. Here's just some of the criteria that this person would meet: Has their own computer and high-speed Internet connection Speaks, Reads, and Writes excellent English Can work from home without distractions Is always learning and improving his/her skills Has a Wise/PayPal account Has access to the paid Claude plan ($20/month Claude Pro) — or is willing to get it before starting. Our entire scriptwriting system runs on it. Is willing to learn new skills and can easily be trained in other skills Can work full-time (30–40 hours per week) HOW WE WORK — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING: We write with a specific system that mixes AI with your own skill. You will not be writing from a blank page, and you will not be pasting raw AI output either. I provide a defined scriptwriting system, a series of training videos, and clear instructions. You bring the judgment, the hooks, and the voice. If you think "AI writes it for me," this isn't the role. If you think "AI is a tool I drive," we'll get along. TASKS YOU WILL TAKE CARE OF: - Write engaging long-form scripts for faceless YouTube channels (different niches, from tech and science documentary to bird watching) - Hook the viewer in the first 15–30 seconds and earn their attention into the video - Hold attention across the whole video using open loops, STR (situation–tension–resolution), and curiosity gaps — opening tension early and paying it off later so the viewer can't leave - Write in each channel's established voice rather than imposing your own - Work with the AI to pull the facts and details the script needs - Take a title and turn it into a finished, ready-to-record script - Iterate on feedback until the voice is locked - Meet script deadlines so the production pipeline never stalls - Collaborate with me on content ideas and creative direction You'll start on one channel first, then you'll write across others. I will need you to work 6–8 hours per day, 40 hours per week. You can make your own hours. SKILLS NEEDED FOR THIS JOB: Proven long-form YouTube scriptwriting experience — REQUIRED Deep understanding of viewer retention: hooks, open loops, STR, curiosity gaps — REQUIRED Writing for spoken narration, not blog/article/SEO copy — REQUIRED Very comfortable working with AI/LLM platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) — you know how to prompt the AI to get exactly what you want out of it Excellent written English and a strong storytelling instinct Sharp attention to detail Fast learner — you can pick up new tools quickly and put them to use right away Understanding of YouTube as a platform — what makes people click and stay Creative thinking and coming up with great hooks Outside-the-box thinking Ability to take initiative and self-accountability Positive mindset Good communication skills Self-motivated and able to adhere to deadlines Problem solver and able to get the job done without supervision Willingness to go above and beyond the tasks they are given A passion for constant self-improvement and a desire to over-deliver Open-minded, willing to innovate and find better ways to do things I'm not looking for just another writer, I'm looking for a teammate who will work side by side with me and help me grow my YouTube channels. This role starts as a scriptwriting seat, but for the right person it grows into a department manager / team lead position — running a small team of writers under you as we scale. You will have the opportunity to be promoted and achieve a higher position on my team, with a bigger salary, all while working from home. PERFORMANCE-BASED COMPENSATION: Starting budget is around $500/month, and your salary will grow based on performance! The better our videos perform (views, engagement, revenue), the more money you earn. This means you're directly incentivized to write the best scripts possible. There are also bonuses which will be awarded according to your performance. The job is full time and it is an ongoing position, hopefully for as long as possible. HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, this is the part that matters: Send me an email with the subject line "YouTube Script Superstar" and let me know why you think you'd be great for this job. Please include the phrase 'Amber Lighthouse' in the first paragraph of your email so I know you read this all the way through. Also tell me: what channels have you written for, can you share a script sample or a video made from your script, and do you already have the paid Claude plan? IMPORTANT: A simple test task will be given to further evaluate your skills. If you are not ok with that, please do not apply for this job. Thank you! Sincerely, Romy Banciu

description: We are a small physician-owned pain management practice in New York. We run our own document pipeline: providers fill in patient visit forms, Python and Node scripts turn them into clinical notes, and browser automation files them into our EMR. It runs nightly on a Mac and in Google Cloud. It mostly works. When it doesn't, it usually fails silently - a job reports success and the output is empty. Your job is to own that pipeline and make it honest. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO - Maintain a Python and Node.js codebase plus six scheduled jobs on macOS launchd and Google Cloud Scheduler - Read the nightly audit output every morning and work the exceptions - Write a failing test for a defect before you fix it - Improve the monitoring so that a job which ran but did not work is visible without a human noticing - Occasionally join a call with the doctor and explain what broke, in plain English YOU MUST HAVE - Real Python. Not "I have used Python" - you can debug code you have never seen before, written by someone else - Comfort in a terminal: git, cron or launchd, log files, ssh - Enough JavaScript to maintain a Playwright or Puppeteer browser automation script - The habit of checking that a thing worked, rather than that it ran - Reliable power and internet, and a machine you can work on for eight hours NICE TO HAVE Google Cloud (Functions, Scheduler, Storage). PDF form tooling. Any exposure to US healthcare. HOURS AND PAY 40 hours a week, of which 4 must overlap 9am-1pm New York time. The rest you schedule yourself. $1,800-$2,600 per month depending on what you demonstrate, paid twice monthly, plus 13th month pay in December. Reviewed at six months. This is long-term. We are not looking for project work and we are not looking for an agency. ABOUT THE DATA This role handles US patient health information. You will be trained on HIPAA, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will be given your own named logins. You will never be asked to share an account or to use someone else's. title: Operations Virtual Assistant – E-commerce & Ticketing
description: FULL-TIME OPERATIONS VA – E-COMMERCE & TICKETING LONG-TERM GROWTH ROLE WITH MANAGEMENT OPPORTUNITY We are looking for a smart, organised and reliable Operations Virtual Assistant to join our growing ticketing and e-commerce businesses. This is a full-time, long-term position. I am not looking for somebody who just wants a temporary VA job. I want to find somebody I can train, trust and grow with the businesses over the long term. Our ticketing business is something we want to scale significantly over the coming months and years. As the company grows, I intend to hire additional Virtual Assistants, and the right person will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, increase their salary and eventually progress into an Operations Manager / VA Manager position. You do NOT need previous experience in ticketing or Amazon FBA. I can teach you the industry-specific parts. What matters much more is that you are intelligent, extremely comfortable using a computer, organised, good with customers, good with spreadsheets and able to learn quickly. -------------------- TICKETING OPERATIONS -------------------- You will gradually help oversee the day-to-day administration and operation of our ticketing business. Responsibilities will include: - Reviewing our ticket inventory spreadsheets and making sure all information is accurate - Checking that sold tickets have been transferred correctly by other members of our team - Identifying tickets that still require action - Informing and following up with our other Virtual Assistants when work needs completing - Monitoring payments and refunds - Matching payments and refunds against our records - Identifying missing payments or refunds - Investigating discrepancies when figures do not match - Following up and chasing outstanding payments where required - Creating invoices for ticket purchases and sales - Saving and organising invoices from suppliers and ticketing platforms - Keeping clear records explaining transactions - Calculating profit splits with partners - Confirming that payments have been received - Preparing clear information showing me which payments need to be made - Monitoring selected ticketing ---------- communities for useful information and upcoming events - Alerting and reminding me about important ticket releases and good opportunities - Auditing the inventory shown on our website and correcting it when necessary - General ticketing administration and problem solving We already have other VAs who handle some of the repetitive ticket purchasing and transferring work. Your role will increasingly be to oversee the process and make sure everything is accurate, organised and completed properly. -------------------- CUSTOMER SERVICE & TICKET SALES -------------------- An important part of this role will be communicating professionally with customers. We operate a ticketing website and Instagram account. You will help with: - Responding quickly and professionally to Instagram enquiries - Answering ticket availability and pricing questions - Helping convert enquiries into sales - Checking our existing ticket inventory - Sourcing tickets through the suppliers and marketplaces we provide - Identifying opportunities where we can fulfil a customer order profitably - Asking me for approval initially when required - Gradually learning which sales can be completed without needing to ask me - Handling customer questions after purchase - Helping resolve ticket delivery problems or complaints - Advertising available ticket stock - Creating ticket advertisements and social media posts - Using ChatGPT and prompts we provide to help create content - Making sure the inventory displayed on our website remains accurate For example: If a customer wants to buy a ticket from us and we can source that ticket elsewhere for a lower price, your job may be to identify the opportunity, communicate professionally with the customer, confirm the deal with me initially and help complete the sale. As you gain experience, you will be given more independence. Good written English, customer service skills and professional communication are very important for this part of the role. -------------------- AMAZON FBA -------------------- We also operate an Amazon FBA business. Previous Amazon experience is NOT required. I will personally teach you our buying process and what makes a good product for us. You will gradually learn how to: - Review Amazon buying opportunities - Use SellerAmp SAS - Understand basic Keepa information - Place suitable products into a pending buying queue for my approval - Alert me when a product looks especially strong - Purchase approved stock - Record all purchases accurately - Save supplier invoices - Maintain our purchasing spreadsheets - Enter Cost of Goods into our inventory software - Monitor stock levels - Check that purchased stock has been received - Check that stock sent to Amazon has arrived correctly - Monitor returns and refunds - Identify missing stock - Identify discrepancies - Raise issues initially and eventually help investigate and resolve them independently - Make sure what we buy, receive, send, return and refund is properly accounted for You will NOT be required to source Amazon products yourself. We already have systems for providing buying opportunities. Your responsibility will be to help analyse, purchase, record and monitor them correctly. -------------------- ACCOUNTS, INVOICES & RECORD KEEPING -------------------- Another important part of this role is helping keep our business records organised for accounting purposes. You do NOT need to be a qualified accountant. The goal is simply to make sure transactions are properly recorded, explained and supported with the correct documentation. For example: If we purchase football tickets from a private supplier through a bank transfer, you may need to create an invoice or transaction record explaining what was purchased. If we purchase proxies, software or another business service, you would save the invoice and clearly record what the expense was for. Tasks may include: - Downloading invoices - Generating invoices where required - Organising invoices into the correct folders - Matching invoices to transactions - Recording what business expenses were for - Updating spreadsheets - Reviewing bank transaction reports - Helping reconcile incoming and outgoing payments - Identifying payments that do not match our records - Preparing organised information for our accountant The objective is simple: Every important transaction should have a clear explanation and supporting documentation so that we never look at a transaction months later and wonder what it was for. -------------------- WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR -------------------- You should be: - Extremely comfortable using a computer - Experienced with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel - Comfortable working with multiple websites, browser tabs and systems - Very organised - Detail-oriented - Able to notice when information or numbers do not match - Able to investigate problems instead of ignoring them - Reliable - Able to communicate professionally in written English - Confident communicating with customers - Able to learn new software quickly - Comfortable asking questions when you are unsure - Able to work independently after training - Proactive - Interested in staying with one company long-term Being genuinely good with computers is extremely important. I have previously worked with VAs who struggled with basic computer navigation, and this role would not be suitable for somebody like that. You should feel completely comfortable: - Navigating websites - Using Google Drive - Using spreadsheets - Downloading and organising files - Working across multiple browser tabs - Learning new software - Following online processes - Troubleshooting basic problems yourself -------------------- BONUS EXPERIENCE -------------------- The following experience is useful but NOT required: - Customer service - Sales - E-commerce - Amazon FBA - Amazon Seller Central - SellerAmp SAS - Keepa - Ticketing - Bookkeeping - Administration - ---------- - Instagram - Social media management - ChatGPT - AI tools - AI automation - Claude - Claude Code - Coding Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT is a big advantage. Experience with Claude Code, coding or AI automation would definitely get my attention, but it is absolutely not required. -------------------- WORKING HOURS -------------------- This is a FULL-TIME position. Approximately 40 hours per week. Monday-Friday is preferred, although I am flexible regarding the exact working schedule and can discuss this with the successful applicant. We will communicate regularly through WhatsApp and/or Microsoft Teams. At the beginning of the role, we will have several calls where I will personally show you our systems, explain how our businesses operate and train you. I am friendly, approachable and happy to explain things properly. I do not expect somebody to understand our businesses immediately. Once you are trained, most day-to-day communication will be through messages, with calls whenever useful. -------------------- CAREER PROGRESSION -------------------- This is one of the most important parts of this position. I am looking for somebody who wants to grow with the company. One of the main reasons I am making this hire is to free up my own time so that I can focus more heavily on growing our ticketing business. If we grow as planned, we will need additional employees and Virtual Assistants. My intention is for the person hired into this role to gradually progress through something like: Operations VA → Senior Operations VA → Operations Manager / VA Manager Eventually, your responsibilities could include: - Managing other Virtual Assistants - Assigning their work - Checking their work - Following up when tasks have not been completed - Training new members of the team - Improving our systems and processes - Managing more of the company's daily operations - Reporting important information directly to me As your responsibility and contribution to the business increases, your salary and position will increase accordingly. I am looking for somebody I can build a strong professional relationship with, trust and work with for many years. -------------------- SALARY -------------------- STARTING SALARY: $400 USD PER MONTH This is the starting salary while you learn our businesses, systems and processes. There will be opportunities for salary reviews and increases as you become trained, take on additional responsibility and provide more value to the company. Someone who eventually progresses into a management position and becomes responsible for managing other VAs would obviously be compensated at a significantly different level. -------------------- HOW TO APPLY -------------------- Please answer ALL of the questions below: 1. Tell me about your previous work experience. 2. What customer service experience do you have? 3. How would you rate your Google Sheets / Excel ability from 1-10? Please explain what you have previously used spreadsheets for. 4. Tell me about a situation where you noticed a mistake, discrepancy or problem at work. What did you do about it? 5. What does being "good with computers" mean to you? Please give examples of software, websites or systems you have used regularly. 6. Have you previously worked in e-commerce? If yes, please explain. 7. Have you ever used any of the following? Amazon Seller Central SellerAmp SAS Keepa Experience is NOT required, so please answer honestly. 8. Do you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT? If yes, explain how you use them. 9. Have you ever used Claude, Claude Code, coding tools or any other AI tools? Again, this is only a bonus. 10. Are you comfortable communicating with customers and helping convert enquiries into sales? Please tell me about any relevant experience. 11. Are you looking for a temporary VA position, or are you interested in staying somewhere for several years and potentially progressing into management? 12. What monthly salary are you looking for? 13. What are your normal available working hours and timezone? 14. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this particular position? title: Creative Strategist – E-commerce & Performance Ads
description: Creative Strategist – E-commerce & Performance Ads We are looking for a **Creative Strategist** who can take real ownership of the creative strategy behind our e-commerce brands. This is **not just a video editing position**. We need someone who understands WHY an ad works, can research markets and competitors, discover new angles, and translate those insights into strong **Top of Funnel (TOF), Middle of Funnel (MOF), and Bottom of Funnel (BOF)** creatives. Our goal is simple: **develop winning creatives that allow us to scale our products profitably while achieving the highest possible ROAS.** ## What You’ll Be Doing You will help develop and continuously improve our overall creative strategy. Your responsibilities will include: * Conducting competitor and market research * Researching winning ads using Meta Ad Library and other sources * Analyzing customer reviews, comments, feedback and competitor messaging * Identifying customer pain points, desires, objections and buying triggers * Understanding different customer awareness levels * Developing new hooks, angles and advertising concepts * Building clear TOF, MOF and BOF creative strategies * Writing scripts and detailed creative briefs * Analyzing existing ad performance * Identifying winning creatives and developing new iterations * Testing new creative formats * Working with editors and other creatives to turn concepts into finished ads **Top of Funnel is especially important to us.** We want to continuously find new ways to reach people who have never heard of our brand or product before. That means creating ads that first make people aware of a problem, capture their attention, and introduce our product as the solution. ## The Type of Products We Sell We primarily work with e-commerce products that solve a clear problem. For example, one of our products focuses on protecting people against **pickpocketing and theft while travelling, visiting cities or being in crowded public places.** Because of this, we need someone who thinks beyond: “Let's make a nice product video.” We want you to think about questions such as: **Why does someone actually need this product?** **What problems does our target audience experience?** **Which problems might they not even be aware of yet?** **What hook will stop someone from scrolling?** **Which angles can introduce the problem to a completely cold audience?** **What objections prevent someone from purchasing?** **Which creatives do we need for TOF, MOF and BOF?** And most importantly: **What should we test next to improve performance and increase ROAS?** ## AI Is a Big Part of Our Creative Workflow We use AI heavily throughout our creative process. You should therefore be comfortable working with tools such as: * ChatGPT * Claude * Higgsfield * Other AI video and image generation tools We don't expect everything to be produced traditionally. We actually want someone who understands how to use AI to **rapidly develop and test new concepts, hooks, scripts, visuals and creative formats.** Examples of creatives we want to produce include: * AI-generated video ads * UGC ads * AI UGC * Mashup ads * Problem/solution ads * Storytelling ads * Educational ads * Founder-style ads * VSL-style creatives * Static ads * Product demonstrations * Testimonial/review ads * Competitor-inspired concepts * Awareness-focused creatives We don't want to produce the same three formats every week. You should constantly be looking for **new formats, new angles and new ways to communicate the problem and solution.** ## Who We're Looking For You could be a great fit if you: * Have experience as a Creative Strategist in e-commerce/performance marketing * Understand Meta Ads and direct-response creative * Fully understand TOF, MOF and BOF * Are strong at competitor and market research * Understand customer psychology and awareness levels * Can independently develop new hooks and angles * Can analyze performance data and turn it into new creative decisions * Are comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude and AI creative tools * Have experience with AI-generated creatives and/or UGC * Are proactive and constantly bring new ideas to the table Most importantly, **we are NOT looking for someone who waits for us to tell them exactly what to create every week.** We want someone who independently researches the market, identifies opportunities and can come to us saying: **“This is what we should test next, this is the angle, this is the format, and this is why I believe it can work.”** ## What Matters Most to Us Your way of thinking is more important than simply making beautiful creatives. We are looking for someone who can combine: **Creative thinking + Data + Customer psychology + Performance marketing** Your goal isn't to create the prettiest advertisement. Your goal is to **find winning ads that we can scale.** ## How to Apply Please include: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Your experience with e-commerce/performance creatives 3. Examples of ads you've developed or worked on 4. The AI tools you currently use 5. An example of a creative strategy you've previously worked on **And one important question:** Imagine you're selling an anti-theft crossbody bag designed to protect travellers against pickpockets. **What are the first 3 Top of Funnel angles you would test — and why?** We're much more interested in how you think than in receiving a generic application. Applications that don't answer this question will not be considered.

title: Website Designer/Developer
description: Ghost Engine Digital is Hiring: Creative Website Designer Ghost Engine Digital is looking for a highly creative Website Designer who can take a brand, an objective, and a general direction and turn it into a website that stands out and converts. Creativity comes first. We are not looking for someone who needs to be handed a completed design and told exactly where every element goes. We need someone who can think through the design, create the visual direction, and build it in WordPress/Elementor. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR You should have a strong eye for: - Modern, high-end website design - Creative layouts and section concepts - Typography and visual hierarchy - Brand consistency - Imagery and visual storytelling - Conversion-focused design - Creative use of backgrounds, graphics, and visual elements - Clean spacing and composition - Exceptional mobile website design - Turning basic content into something visually engaging We want someone who looks at a brand and asks, “How can I make this better?” — not “What template should I use?” TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE REQUIRED You must be highly proficient with: - WordPress - Elementor Pro - Hostinger - DNS management - Cloudflare - SSL and domain configuration - Responsive design - Custom Elementor elements and layouts - Staging environments and website migrations - Website performance optimization - Plugin configuration and troubleshooting - Cross-device and cross-browser QA MOBILE DESIGN IS A MUST Your mobile work should be just as strong as your desktop work. We expect you to intentionally design the mobile experience — not simply stack desktop sections on top of each other. title: Senior Shopify CX Operator — One-of-a-Kind E-com, Night Shift ET
job_title: Senior Shopify CX Operator — One-of-a-Kind E-com, Night Shift ET
description: Cowhides Direct is a US hide brand, in business since 1998. We own the warehouse in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Every cowhide rug is photographed in our own studio. The hide in the photo is the hide that ships — no stock shots, no substitutions, a certificate of authenticity in the box. Around 10,000 hides in stock. Every one is different. This post is for someone who can drop in. If you have already run Shopify for a brand where the unit on the page is the unit that ships — handmade, vintage, furniture, rugs, one-of-ones — you already know the job. Unique SKUs. The photo is a promise. The process has to match the product. If your last role was a ticket queue on identical SKUs, our other CX post is a better fit. THE SEAT One Senior Customer Experience & Operations Operator. Phone, email, chat. You finish the problem on that contact. You notice the same issue twice and write the process so it stops. Project-manager brain, willing to do the customer work. Same pay and shift as our other CX seat. Higher bar on what you already know. PAY $1,300–$1,600 USD per month, full-time, 40 hours. Long-term. THE SHIFT (read this twice) - 9:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time / 9:00pm to 5:00am Philippines - Eight-hour shifts. 40 hours. Night shift covering US daytime. - We answer seven days. Weekend days are assigned. Daytime Philippines hours is the wrong post. - Attendance is tracked. Cameras on for training gates. First seven calendar days are paid training, earned by completing every scheduled 8-hour shift. Miss or leave early without notice before the shift starts, and that day ends the engagement. WHAT "DROP-IN" MEANS HERE Shopify order states are already muscle memory. You have changed an address, cancelled an unfulfilled order, issued a partial refund, and written a note the next person could pick up cold. You already know unique-product support is different: - Ask before you recommend. Size, room, light, pets, floors. Recommending first creates returns. - Never extend a one-of-a-kind promise to a product stocked by color. - "It arrived folded" is usually not a defect. Save that call. - Natural marks are character. Never call a clearance hide a second, a reject, or B-grade. - Check history before you speak. You will learn our hides, sizing, and authority table in training. You will not be learning what an order is, or how to talk to someone spending real money on a room they care about. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO - US customers on the phone. Greeting, read-back of every number, solve it before she hangs up. - One inbox: live chat, email, phone. Shopify data beside the conversation. Written procedures with citations. D ---------- . Escalate only when it is actually not yours. - Cancels, address changes, returns, missing gifts, folded-on-arrival, "is this the exact hide" — inside a written authority table. - English we can send unedited. Short sentences. No filler. No invented reasons. - Flag gaps. If you escalated something that should have had a procedure, write the procedure. WHO THIS IS FOR - 3+ years Shopify e-commerce support or ops, not "I used Shopify once." - Unique-SKU or made-to-order catalog, or a brand where the photo is the unit. - Helpdesk you could open tomorrow (Gorgias, Help Scout, Zendesk, or Reamaze) plus actual Shopify admin: orders, refunds, addresses, inventory exceptions. - Tenures of 18 months or longer. You built a system other people still use. - Hard customers do not make you blame the customer. When you mess up, you can say exactly what you did. - Quiet workspace, a computer (not a phone), stable internet, backup power or internet. Speed-test screenshot required. - You can commit to THIS shift. "I can start whenever" is a no. No overlapping full-time job. WHO THIS IS NOT FOR Flexible VA gigs, overlapping jobs, script readers, AI-written applications, anyone who cannot do a live video gate camera-on with no notes, anyone who needs a week to learn what fulfilled means. HOW TO APPLY We read every file. The people who do all three get seen first. 1. Put GRAIN as the first word of your reply. Then why this night shift works for your life right now. 2. Walk through one Shopify (or equivalent) exception you finished without escalating: wrong address after fulfillment, unique SKU out of spec, split shipment, partial refund, or a photo-vs-product complaint. Tools, clicks, what you told the customer, what you wrote down. Specifics. No essays. 3. In the last two years, how many scheduled shifts or meetings did you miss without giving notice beforehand? What happened? Also include: recent internet speed-test screenshot, backup power or internet (yes/no), hours you can actually work in Philippines time. If you cannot do 9:00pm–5:00am Philippines, do not apply. One long-term seat. Smart enough to drop in. Jason H Cowhides Direct

We help homeowners and businesses with septic tank pumping, septic backups, inspections, hydrojetting, sewer camera inspections, and related service needs. We are looking for a long-term remote team member in the Philippines who can answer inbound customer calls, help customers understand our services, and book appointments accurately. This is a phone-first role for someone with excellent spoken English neutral or light accent, good judgment, and a calm, professional customer service style. Customers are calling us because they already need septic service. However, this is not only basic customer support. The right person must be comfortable helping ready-to-book customers get scheduled, and must also know how to explain our value when a caller is shopping around, unsure, or comparing prices. Main Responsibilities Phone-Based Customer Care & Booking — 60% • Answer inbound calls from U.S. customers with warmth, confidence, and professionalism. • Schedule septic service appointments in Jobber CRM and enter accurate customer details. • Explain basic pricing clearly and confidently. • Ask the right questions about the customer’s issue, location, tank size, timing, and access. • Help customers understand why Open Water Septic is a strong choice when they are comparing providers. • Send follow-up texts and emails to customers who requested pricing but did not book. • Coordinate with the owner and field technician so service details are clear before arrival. • Process basic payment and billing questions according to company instructions. Administrative Support — 20% • Keep organized notes, customer records, and follow-up tasks. • Assist with unpaid invoice follow-up and simple reports. • Help improve scripts, templates, and customer communication over time. Social Media Support — 20% • Prepare simple Facebook and Instagram posts using provided photos, service updates, and guidance. • Respond to basic messages and route service requests quickly. • Help organize job photos and customer review opportunities. Service Advantages You Will Learn to Explain Open Water Septic does more than basic septic pumping. Our service truck can bring multiple solutions to one visit, including: • A septic pump truck for tank pump-outs. • A hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of lines at up to 3,000 PSI and reach up to 200 feet. • A sewer camera that can inspect lines in color and record photos/videos up to 150 feet. This matters because some septic problems are not only a full tank. If there is a clog or line issue, we may be able to help during the same visit instead of the customer needing to call another company, pay another fee, and wait another day. What We Are Looking For Required Experience • 3+ years phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, or BPO experience. • Experience speaking with U.S., Canadian, Australian, or U.K. customers. • Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines. • CRM experience preferred; Jobber experience is a plus. • Home services, plumbing, HVAC, pest control, roofing, garage door, or similar service company experience is a strong plus. Spoken English Requirement • Strong spoken English is required because this role involves live phone calls with U.S. customers. No accent or light accent required. • You must be easy for U.S. callers to understand over the phone. • You must be able to understand customers without repeatedly asking them to repeat themselves. • You must be able to explain pricing and service benefits naturally, not just read a script. Skills and Qualities • Warm, patient, and confident phone manner. • Comfortable asking for the booking when the customer is ready. • Detail-oriented and accurate with names, addresses, phone numbers, prices, and scheduling notes. • Able to memorize simple pricing and local service area towns. • Reliable attendance and strong follow-through. • Good judgment when a customer is upset, has an emergency, or needs a technician quickly. • Willing to learn basic septic service language over time. Technical Requirements • Reliable computer suitable for voice calls, CRM work, email, and basic social media tasks. • Stable internet with at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload. • Backup internet connection, such as mobile data or a second ISP. • Quiet workspace for professional customer calls. • Quality headset with noise-canceling microphone. • Ability to use phone/CRM systems, email, text messaging tools, Google Workspace, and basic design tools such as Canva. Information You Will Be Expected to Learn The right candidate does not need septic experience on day one. We will train you. However, you must be able to memorize and use simple information, including: • Basic pump-out pricing, including common tank sizes. • Which towns are in our service area. • How to explain pump-outs, septic backups, hydrojetting, and camera inspections in simple customer-friendly language. • How to identify when a customer is ready to book versus when they need a follow-up. Compensation Base Pay $700 - $900/month base Performance Bonus Possible $50-$100/month based on attendance, call quality, booking accuracy, calls converting into jobs, and customer communication. Payment Schedule Paid twice monthly through an agreed payment platform such as Payoneer, Wise, EasyPay, or similar. Growth Opportunity Long-term role with room for rate increases as performance and company growth support it. Contractor Relationship This is an independent contractor role. The contractor will: • Complete IRS Form W-8BEN for U.S. tax purposes. • Handle their own Philippine tax obligations. • Use their own equipment, internet connection, and workspace. • Be paid a flat contracted monthly rate plus any earned bonus. Screenshot of computer specs. 5. A 2-3 minute video recording using the script below. Required Voice Recording Script Please record yourself saying this naturally. Do not use AI voice tools. I understand your septic system is backing up. We can help with that. Our standard pump-out for a 1,000-gallon tank is $500. What makes us different is that we bring more than just a pump truck. Our truck also has a hydrojetter that can blast clogs out of the line at up to 3,000 PSI, and we also have a sewer camera that can inspect the line in color up to 150 feet. Bonus Points - Experience in environments where empathy and execution were equally important. - Spanish fluency - many of the families we serve speak it. Details: - Remote, full-time Compensation: $5-$7.80/hr (USD) Tools: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system Shift: Full-time (consistent schedule) Days: - Monday–Friday Hours: US Day Shift: - 8 a.m. - 4:30 pm PT including a 30-minute lunch break Why You’ll Love Working With Us: - We’re a real business, built to last. description: We are a Japan-based e-commerce and fulfillment company helping international brands and sellers enter the Japanese market. We are looking for a skilled Research & Outreach Specialist who can identify promising overseas brands and TikTok Shop sellers, evaluate whether their products may have potential in Japan, find the correct business contacts, and introduce our Japan fulfillment and market-entry services. This is NOT a simple data-entry or mass-email position. We are looking for someone who can research, think, verify information, understand basic compliance risks, and explain why a company is a strong prospect. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Research promising brands, manufacturers, and sellers in Southeast Asia and other Asian markets. Main platforms may include: - TikTok Shop - Shopee - Lazada - Instagram - Amazon - Shopify / brand websites 2. Identify products and brands that may have potential in TikTok Shop Japan. 3. Research whether the company is already active in Japan. Please check for: - Official Japanese website - TikTok Shop Japan presence - Amazon Japan / Rakuten / Yahoo Japan presence - Japanese distributor or importer - Japanese warehouse / fulfillment partner - Japanese company or branch 4. Perform a BASIC regulatory risk check before outreach. Examples: - Electrical products / PSE or other Japanese safety requirements - Cosmetics / skincare - Food - Supplements - Medical or health-related products - Children's products - Restricted or prohibited TikTok Shop categories You are NOT expected to be a lawyer or Japanese regulatory expert. However, you must be able to research potential risks, use reliable sources, and FLAG products that may require additional review before we contact the company. 5. Find official business contact information. Preferred contact priority: Business Development → International Sales → Wholesale → Distributor → Partnership → Sales → Collaboration → General Contact Do NOT guess email addresses. 6. Explain WHY each company is a strong prospect. Your research should include evidence such as: - Sales activity - Reviews - Product popularity - Social media traction - Marketplace presence - Japan market gap - Product suitability for TikTok-style content - Logistics suitability 7. Prepare personalized outreach messages. AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini may be used, but all information must be personally verified. 8. Send approved outreach messages and follow up with prospects. 9. Maintain accurate records in Google Sheets or CRM. TARGET MARKETS Initial focus: - Indonesia - Thailand - Vietnam - Malaysia - Philippines - Singapore Future expansion: - South Korea - China - Taiwan - Hong Kong IDEAL CANDIDATE Required: - Strong online research skills - Strong written English - Experience with e-commerce research - Experience with B2B lead generation or outreach - Good Google Sheets skills - Ability to verify information carefully - Comfortable using AI tools - Strong attention to detail - Ability to explain your reasoning clearly Highly preferred: - TikTok Shop experience - Shopee or Lazada experience - Cross-border e-commerce experience - Product research experience - Experience finding brands, manufacturers, distributors, or wholesalers - Cold email / LinkedIn / Instagram outreach experience - Experience researching Asian e-commerce markets IMPORTANT We do NOT want mass-generated lead lists. Finding 100 random companies is less valuable than finding 10–20 genuinely strong prospects. Quality, evidence, and accuracy are more important than volume. HOW TO APPLY Please answer ALL questions below. 1. Which e-commerce marketplaces have you researched professionally? Please specify TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Amazon, Shopify, or others. 2. Have you done B2B lead generation or cold outreach before? Please explain your process. 3. Imagine you find a product selling very well on TikTok Shop Thailand. How would you determine whether the brand is a good prospect for entering Japan? 4. How would you check whether the brand already has a distributor, warehouse, official seller, or business presence in Japan? 5. If the product is an electrical appliance, cosmetic, supplement, food product, or health-related product, what would you check before contacting the company? 6. Please find ONE real brand from Southeast Asia that you believe may be a good candidate for TikTok Shop Japan. Handle Incoming Corporate Inquiries Companies regularly contact us asking about customized products. You will eventually be responsible for helping manage these inquiries from beginning to end. Manage Leads and Follow-Ups Organization is extremely important for this role. You will maintain our corporate sales tracking system and make sure no potential customer is forgotten. You will: * Track every lead * Record conversations * Schedule follow-ups * Keep track of quotes * Track samples sent * Track pending orders * Follow up with old leads * Contact previous corporate clients about reorders We want someone who naturally thinks: "I haven't heard from this customer for five days. I should follow up." Rather than waiting to be told what to do. ### 5. Develop Wholesale Accounts Over time, you will also help grow our wholesale business. This may include: * Finding retailers * Finding distributors * Contacting potential wholesale partners * Sending wholesale information * Handling sample requests * Following up with wholesale prospects * Maintaining relationships with existing wholesale customers ## What We're Looking For You should have: * Excellent written English * Strong communication skills * Very good organization * Attention to detail * Confidence communicating with business customers * Experience with B2B sales, lead generation, customer service, account management, or business development * Experience using spreadsheets or a CRM * Basic Canva or graphic design ability * Good online research skills * Strong follow-up habits * Ability to work independently Experience selling physical products, promotional products, corporate gifts, merchandise, wholesale products, or customized products is a big advantage. ## Most Important Qualities We care more about your attitude and working style than having the perfect resume. The ideal person is: * Proactive * Organized * Persistent without being pushy * Professional * Friendly * Reliable * Comfortable learning new things * Good at keeping track of many conversations at once * Not afraid to follow up multiple times We are especially looking for someone who can eventually take ownership of our corporate sales pipeline instead of waiting for instructions for every task. ## About Us We operate a portfolio of consumer brands selling internationally. Our corporate customers purchase customized products for: * Employee gifts * Customer gifts * Events * Conferences * Promotional campaigns * Company merchandise * Wholesale and retail You will work closely with the business owners and will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility as the corporate side of the company grows. ## Work Type Long-term remote position. We are looking for someone interested in growing with the company rather than someone looking for a short-term freelance project. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. A short introduction about yourself. 2. Any experience you have with B2B sales, lead generation, account management, customer service, or wholesale. 3. What tools you have used for CRM or tracking leads. 4. Your experience with Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator. 5. An example of how you would follow up with a potential corporate customer who received a quotation five days ago but has not replied. 6. Your expected monthly salary. 7. Your available working hours and timezone. Please start your application with the words **"CORPORATE SALES"** so we know you read the full job description. title: UGC Content Editor
description: About the role I’m a full-time UGC creator and creative strategist producing paid video content for brands and agencies across supplements, skincare, wellness, home goods, pet, food & beverage, apps, and more. I film everything myself — I need an editor who can take my raw footage and turn it into finished, brief-compliant deliverables that go straight to the brand without me rebuilding them. This content will be for both META ads, as well as organic content. Understanding the nuances of paid ads and organic content is important as well as the ability to adhere to brand requirements. This is not “make it look cool” editing. Every video is tied to a paid brief with rules attached: required hooks, banned words, mandatory disclosures, exact runtimes, specific product moments that must appear on screen. Your job is to make the footage feel effortless and native to TikTok/Reels while hitting every single requirement in the brief. If you’re strong, this becomes ongoing, recurring work with steady volume because the more work we can create together (I record, you edit) we both win! I see this continuing to grow and scale throughout the rest of 2026 and beyond. What you’ll do • Edit raw vertical footage into finished UGC deliverables, typically 15–60 seconds in length • Read and follow the brand brief closely — angle, hook, runtime, CTA, required callouts, banned language, and any compliance restrictions • Review brand-supplied example and reference videos and match the pacing, style, and editing feel • Tighten pacing: trim filler words (“um,” “like,” “so”), dead air, false starts, and long pauses without making the delivery sound choppy or robotic • Build a strong hook in the first 3 seconds from my footage — often the brief specifies this, sometimes you’ll need to find the best take • Cut multiple versions of the same concept when requested (e.g. 15s / 30s / 45s, or 3 different hook variations on one body) • Layer in b-roll, product close-ups, unboxing, and screen recordings where the brief calls for it. • Add captions/subtitles that are accurate, well-timed, readable on mobile, and styled to match the brand or platform norm • Add sound and music only from commercially safe/royalty-free sources — many briefs explicitly ban copyrighted audio • Add on-screen text, simple graphics, product/label callouts, and disclosure text (#ad, “Individual results vary,” etc.) when required • Basic color correction and audio cleanup so cuts don’t jump between clips • Export to spec (resolution, aspect ratio, file type, file naming) and deliver to the correct folder in Google Drive • Flag problems early — missing shots, unusable audio, a required element I didn’t film, or anything in the footage that would violate the brief Requirements • Proven experience editing short-form vertical content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or paid social ads (UGC ad experience strongly preferred over vlog/YouTube editing) • Fluent in CapCut, Canva, or a comparable editing tool (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut also fine — CapCut fluency is a big plus) • Comfortable working from written briefs and following instructions exactly, including restrictions on what cannot be said or shown • Excellent English comprehension — you need to hear filler words, catch a misread line, and know when a take doesn’t land • Strong sense of pacing and rhythm for short-form; you know when a cut is a half-second too long • Reliable with deadlines. Brand deadlines are firm and revisions are on tight turnarounds • Comfortable with Google Drive; ClickUp or similar project tools a plus • Able to accept feedback and turn revisions around quickly and without friction Nice to have • Familiarity with UGC platforms like JoinBrands, Billo, Insense, or Amazon shoppable video and their spec/compliance requirements • Understanding of FTC disclosure basics and ad compliance (no medical claims, no guarantee language, etc.) • Ability to build simple motion text, animated captions, or light graphic overlays • Experience editing Amazon and Meta ad creative specifically How you’ll work with me • I deliver raw footage + the brand brief + any reference videos in a shared Drive folder. I will record a loom video explaining in more detail if needed. We can also communicate specifics via WhatsApp. • You edit, export to spec, and drop the finished file back in the same folder by the agreed deadline • I review and send revision notes if needed — my revision rate with brands is under 10% and I want to keep it there • Communication over email or WhatsApp. I’m responsive and I give clear notes, I am open to looking at an hourly rate and also a per-deliverable rate. It will definitely depend on what we are able to produce in what time and keeping in mind most jobs are simple edits and more rarely will there be complex projects and those can also be handled on a case by case basis as we get into a good flow and routine. I said roughly 10 hours per week but can be flexible, especially if you’re looking for more work.

description: Marketing Mindset is looking for an experienced, hands-on marketer to take ownership of our paid acquisition and help us turn a mature product into a growing business. Part-Time job with flexible hours. This is not a task-execution marketing role. We are looking for someone who thinks before they execute: someone who considers the target audience, challenges weak ideas, develops campaign hypotheses, understands the commercial objective behind the work, and uses results to d ---------- what to do next. About Marketing Mindset Marketing Mindset is a new marketing education and execution platform built for entrepreneurs, marketers, consultants and professionals who want to improve their marketing capabilities and put what they learn into practice. The platform combines: Marketing courses and practical learning Interactive exercises and activities Marketing execution and productivity tools AI-assisted features Expert and consultant access Professional profiles and Talent Hub Community and collaboration features The platform is already substantially built. We are moving from a product-development-heavy stage into customer acquisition, validation and growth. Our immediate challenge isn't building more features. It's finding the right audiences, messages and acquisition channels that can turn the product into a sustainable business. What we need We're primarily looking for someone with advanced practical experience with Google Ads and Meta/Facebook Ads. You should be comfortable owning the process from: Audience → hypothesis → message → creative → campaign → landing page → measurement → iteration We don't want to provide a list of ads and have someone mechanically build them. For example, if we say: “We want to attract small-business owners who need to become better at marketing.” We expect you to think about who specifically we should target, what problem matters to them, what message could get their attention, which channel is appropriate, what landing page they should see, how much we should spend testing it, and what evidence would tell us whether the hypothesis worked. And if our original idea is bad, we expect you to tell us. Responsibilities Your main focus will be paid customer acquisition through Google Ads and Meta Ads, including campaign strategy and structure, keyword/audience research, targeting, copywriting, creative concepts, testing, optimization and performance analysis. You'll also help develop our positioning and advertising messages for different customer segments and recommend changes to landing pages when the advertising data suggests they are needed. Ideally, you can also create good advertising images/creatives yourself using tools such as Figma, Photoshop, Canva or similar. You don't need to be a dedicated graphic designer, but you should understand visual hierarchy, simplicity, ad creative principles and how people actually consume advertising in a feed. We already have support for lower-level communication and routine marketing activities, so this role should concentrate primarily on acquisition, creative thinking and decision-making. What we're specifically looking for We'd like someone who: Has substantial hands-on experience managing Google Ads Has substantial hands-on experience managing Meta/Facebook Ads Understands conversion tracking, attribution, CAC/CPA, ROAS and funnel metrics Can create and systematically test different audiences, propositions and creative hypotheses Can write strong advertising copy Ideally can create advertising graphics independently Understands landing-page conversion and can identify obvious CRO problems Thinks commercially rather than optimizing vanity metrics Can distinguish cheap traffic from valuable traffic Is comfortable working with an early-stage product where some experiments will fail Can work independently with relatively little supervision Understands Google Analytics and Clarity Most importantly, we're looking for judgment. We want someone who naturally asks: Who are we actually trying to reach? Why would this person care? What problem are we solving for them? Does this message accurately represent the product? What behavior will this campaign attract? Why should this experiment work? What would prove that our hypothesis is wrong? We value someone who says “I don't think we should do this, and here's why” more than someone who quickly completes every task they're given. What this role is NOT This isn't primarily a social-media posting position. We aren't hiring based on how many posts you can produce per week, and we're not interested in generating activity simply to keep marketing busy. Likewise, task → execute → next task isn't the working style we're looking for. We want someone capable of taking increasing ownership of marketing decisions so that the founders don't need to define every audience, campaign concept, headline and experiment beforehand. Current objectives Our near-term priorities are to: 1. Find repeatable paid acquisition channels. description: WHO WE ARE Eagle Key Solutions is a real estate acquisitions company based in New Jersey. Since 2020, we have been buying off market properties, fixing them, and selling them. We operate lean and we move fast. We run on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System). We are growing and we need an operations person who can scale with us. WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO You are responsible for two things. First, you process 200 to 300 clean records daily for our sales team to call. Second, you build and maintain the systems that make our entire company run. On the data side, you skip trace records, verify phone numbers, clean datasets, and upload to our CRM by 9am EST every morning. On the operations side, you manage our DataSift presets, maintain our Lead Management board, document processes, prepare reports for our weekly meetings, and troubleshoot when systems break. This is not a data entry job. This is an operations job that includes data as part of it. YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES You arrive each day with one job: make sure 200 to 300 clean, verified records are ready for our team by 9am EST. You use DataSift for skip tracing, Trestle for phone verification, and Closer Control as our CRM. You monitor SiftStack (our automation system) and alert immediately if it fails. You tag leads by county and priority. You audit quality constantly and trace bad records back to find where they broke. You also manage our DataSift sequences across 25 counties. You build and update the Lead Management board as we grow. You prepare metrics and reports for our Monday & Friday L10 meetings. You troubleshoot system integrations. You document everything so that anyone can follow your processes. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Most companies hire data people to process data. We hire operations people who understand that data directly impacts deals. Bad data equals wasted dials. Good data equals closed deals. You are not just cleaning records. You are building the foundation that lets our sales team close deals efficiently. You will see every metric we track. You will understand our pipeline from raw lead to close. You will build the processes that connect everything. You will train new team members on the systems you create. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU 2+ plus years working with real estate data, skip tracing, or CRM operations. You understand how data quality impacts deal flow. You can troubleshoot systems without panic. You see how processes connect and where they break. You are detail oriented but also strategic. You communicate clearly via email and Slack. You can commit to 8am to 1pm EST daily (9am deadline is hard, no exceptions). Internet speed of 100 plus Mbps minimum with a backup internet plan. WHAT WE OFFER Company domain email ---------- performance bonus when you hit KPI targets. Quarterly pay adjustments based on impact. Remote work. Fast moving, execution focused team that respects your time and pays fairly. HOW WE HIRE Record a 60 second Loom video of you reading this job posting aloud. This shows us your internet quality, English clarity, and whether you actually read the job post. Send it back within 24 hours. If we like it, we interview you. It is a 30 minute conversation about your process thinking and how you approach operations. If the interview goes well, we make you an offer. Here is what comes next: you read a book we share with you. It is the operating system we run on. After you finish, you give us a 15 minute presentation on what you learned and how it applies to your role and prepares you for our culture. Once you complete the book and deliver the presentation, we pay you $100 USD. No payment before completion. Then you start a paid trial week. Your target is 200 plus clean records daily plus one process improvement or system build. Hit it and we hire you permanent. Miss it and we move to the next candidate. THE REAL TALK This job is for someone who wants to build something, not just work. You will be the person holding the operations together. You will see the entire company. You will make or break how we scale. If you want to process data and clock out at 5pm, this is not your job. If you want to build systems that run a real company, let us hear from you. NEXT STEP Send us your 60 second Loom. Do it today. We move fast and we hire fast. Best candidates get locked in this week.

title: YouTube Video Editor Needed for Cinematic Golf Channel Trailer
job_title: YouTube Video Editor Needed for Cinematic Golf Channel Trailer
description: We’re looking for a talented video editor to create a 60–75 second YouTube channel trailer for a new golf documentary series called Tuesday Golf. Tuesday Golf is not a typical fast-paced golf YouTube channel. We play nine holes with regular golfers and hear the interesting stories behind their lives — funny stories, unusual careers, successes, failures, difficult moments, and everything in between. The style is cinematic, documentary-inspired, thoughtful, human, and occasionally funny. We already have: Professionally shot multi-camera golf footage Drone footage Guest audio Pre-interview audio from future guests Full transcripts A completed trailer script Voiceover that will be provided Your job will be to take those assets and assemble the finished trailer. Some specific guest quotes are identified in the script. You’ll need to locate those moments within the supplied footage/audio using the transcripts and build the edit around them. We want someone with a strong sense of storytelling, pacing, music, sound design, and emotional contrast — not just someone who can make quick cuts. Deliverable: One polished 60–75 second channel trailer, including music, sound design, color, and final audio mix. Please send 2–3 examples of your best cinematic/documentary or story-driven editing work. If you’ve edited golf, sports documentaries, human-interest stories, or cinematic YouTube content, even better.
