title: Social Media Manager & Content Designer
description: Social Media Manager & Content Designer — Skin & Wellness Clinic Group (Ireland) Job Type: Full-time, remote (40 hrs/week) Salary: ₱80,000 – ₱100,000/month, depending on portfolio Working hours: Flexible, but a minimum 3-hour daily overlap with Irish time (GMT/IST) is required Start: Immediate, after a paid trial Top skills: Graphic Design · Copywriting · Social Media Management · Attention to Detail --- The role in one sentence Take our existing photo and video library and turn it into consistent, on-brand daily social media content across three Irish skin and wellness brands — designing, scheduling, publishing and reporting on it, while following our brand voice exactly. This is an execution role, not a strategy role. We set the direction; you make it happen, every day, without drift. About us Three brands, based in Cork and Dublin, Ireland: - The FILO Clinic — a nurse-led advanced skin and laser clinic - FILO First Skin + Glow Studios — an entry-level skin and glow studio - CALMA Health + Wellness — massage and wellness Our voice is calm, educational and evidence-based. We are not a hype brand. No shock before/afters, no countdown-timer discounts, no "miracle" or "transformation" language. Our clients are professionals aged 25–55 who are tired of being sold to, and they will notice immediately if we start sounding like everyone else. If your background is Philippine beauty marketing — whitening, glutathione, celebrity endorsements, hard-sell promos — this is the opposite of that. Only apply if you can genuinely work in a restrained, clinical, understated voice. What you'll do Design and production (the core of the job) - Design daily content from our existing library of professional photos and video: carousels, static posts, Reels, Stories - Build and maintain a template system so three brands stay visually distinct but consistently on-brand - Publish 3 grid posts per week per brand, scheduled ahead and approved before posting - Publish daily Stories: 3–5/day for The FILO Clinic and FILO First, 2/day for CALMA - Edit and publish raw phone clips sent through from our Cork and Dublin clinics, usually within 24 hours - Repurpose content for TikTok, Facebook and YouTube Shorts with format-appropriate edits, not straight re-uploads - Keep the media library organised and tagged so assets are findable and rotated properly Copy - Write captions in our established brand voice, working to a written brand guide - All copy goes through approval before publishing — no exceptions Planning and reporting - Maintain a rolling 4-week content calendar for approval - Report monthly on reach, saves, shares, profile visits, follower growth and link clicks, with a short written read on what worked and what didn't - Flag when the asset library is running thin and build shot lists for our next photo/video shoot day - Research trending formats and hooks weekly, and tell us which ones fit our brand — and which don't Non-negotiables These are legal and clinical requirements in Ireland. Applicants who can't work within them won't be considered. - No before/after images published unless we have confirmed written client consent for that specific image - No content referencing prescription-only medicines, including botulinum toxin, by brand or generic name — it is illegal to advertise these to the public in the EU - No treatment advice, pricing promises or medical claims in captions, comments or DMs. All enquiries are routed to the clinic - Irish English spelling throughout (moisturise, specialise, colour, programme) - No AI-generated skin imagery and no stock "results" photos, ever Must have - 5+ years designing social content for brands, with a portfolio you personally produced - Strong Canva skills; Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign a significant plus - Genuinely fluent written English — captions must not read as translated - Proven ability to work inside an existing brand guide without improvising on it - CapCut or Premiere Pro for light video and Stories editing - Meta Business Suite scheduling and Instagram Insights - Reliable fibre internet and a machine that can handle design and video work - Comfortable working from a brief, to a calendar, and taking direct feedback Nice to have - Experience with medical, aesthetics, dental or wellness clients - Basic motion graphics - Experience with an approval workflow (Notion, Trello, ClickUp or similar) How to apply Applications missing any of these will not be read. 1. Answer this first, in two or three sentences: What is one thing most beauty and aesthetics accounts do that you think actively damages client trust? 2. Send three social graphics or carousels you personally designed from a brand's existing photo library — and tell us what brand guide or rules you were working to. 3. Tell us your expected monthly salary in PHP. 4. Start your message with the word - CORK - so we know you read this. Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial task, we send you our brand guide and a folder of real clinic photos, and you produce three Stories and one carousel. We pay for the trial whether or not we hire you.

title: Follow Up Boss Expert — Full CRM Build-Out for a 1,200-Door Property Management Company (Project + Ongoing Retainer)
job_title: Follow Up Boss Expert — Full CRM Build-Out for a 1,200-Door Property Management Company (Project + Ongoing Retainer)
description: Follow Up Boss Expert — Full CRM Build-Out for a 1,200-Door Property Management Company (Project + Ongoing Retainer) Job type: Project-based (6–8 weeks, part-time to full-time hours), then optional ongoing monthly retainer Pay: Above market. I’m looking for the best FUB person on this platform, not the cheapest. Tell me your rate. Fixed-price project bids also welcome. Hours: Flexible, but you must be able to overlap 3–4 hours/day with US Central Time (Dallas–Fort Worth) for screen shares and Q&A. Start: Immediately ________________________________________ About us McCaw Property Management is a locally owned property management and real estate brokerage in the Dallas–Fort Worth area of Texas. We’ve been in business since 2002 and manage 1,200+ rental homes across 50+ DFW cities. Our leads are landlords and real estate investors, not home buyers. We currently run our lead follow-up in LeadSimple and are moving everything to Follow Up Boss. We have a full-time sales team (business development managers and licensed agents) who are already busy. What we don’t have is someone who truly knows how to build Follow Up Boss the right way. That’s you. What you’ll build This is a build-from-scratch engagement. Our FUB account is open but mostly empty. You will own the entire setup end to end: 1. Lead migration from LeadSimple Export, clean, de-duplicate, and import our existing leads and contacts into FUB with the correct stages, tags, sources, assigned agents, and notes/history preserved wherever possible. 2. Lead source connections Connect every inbound lead source so leads land in FUB automatically and correctly attributed: WordPress website forms (currently email-forwarded and not parsing correctly — this must be fixed properly, e.g., via Zapier/Gravity Forms/webhook), BiggerPockets, Google Business Profile, Zillow/rental listing sites, geo landing pages, and inbound office phone calls. Every source should have a correct Source value in FUB for reporting. 3. Lead routing and speed-to-lead Set up round-robin / first-to-claim routing so new landlord leads are grabbed by whichever agent responds first, with alerts to the team and automatic re-assignment if nobody claims the lead within a set time. Speed to lead is our #1 priority. 4. Phone, text, and email — fully connected Set up FUB Calling and texting for the team (including A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration so our texts actually deliver), connect every team member’s email (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), set up call recording and voicemail drop where available, and make sure every call, text, and email logs to the right contact. 5. Property-management drip campaigns (Action Plans) Build automated text + email Action Plans for landlord/owner leads at every stage: new lead, no response, warm but not closed, long-term nurture, and past clients/referral. We will provide the messaging and copy; you build the sequences, timing, triggers, exit conditions, and Smart Lists so no lead ever falls through the cracks. 6. Team structure, pipeline, and reporting Configure users and permissions, stages/pipeline that match a property-management sales process (not a buyer/seller process), ponds, Smart Lists for daily agent workflow, and reporting dashboards so ownership can see lead volume by source, response time, and conversion. 7. Training and documentation Record short Loom-style training videos for our agents, and deliver a written setup document so we know how everything works and can maintain it. Who we’re looking for This role is for a FUB expert who has built accounts from zero, not someone who has only worked inside an already-built account. You should be able to say yes to most of the following: • You’ve personally set up Follow Up Boss from scratch for at least 3 real estate teams or brokerages (not just administered them) • You know Action Plans, Smart Lists, ponds, lead routing, tags, and custom fields deeply • You’ve done a CRM-to-FUB migration before (LeadSimple, kvCORE, BoomTown, Lofty/Chime, Sierra, LionDesk, etc.) • You’ve set up FUB Calling/texting and handled A2P 10DLC registration • You’re comfortable with Zapier (or Make) and webhooks to connect lead sources FUB doesn’t natively support • You’ve connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 email to FUB • Bonus: property management experience, or experience with LeadSimple, AppFolio, or landlord-focused lead gen • Excellent written English and clear communication. You’ll be talking directly with the owner and the sales team. What happens after the build If the build goes well, I’d like to keep you on a monthly retainer (roughly 5–10 hours/month) to maintain the system, build new Action Plans as we add campaigns, onboard new agents, and keep integrations healthy. Strong performers will also be first in line for other systems and automation work across my companies. How to apply To be considered, please answer these questions in your application. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed. 1. List the FUB accounts you have built from scratch (team name or type, size, and year). Describe one in detail. 2. Walk me through, step by step, how you’d set up first-to-claim lead routing with a fallback if nobody claims the lead in 5 minutes. 3. What is A2P 10DLC, and what do you need from me to get our texting registered? 4. Describe a CRM-to-FUB migration you’ve done. What went wrong and how did you fix it? 5. Attach screenshots (with client info blurred) of an Action Plan and a Smart List you built. 6. Your hourly rate and/or fixed-price bid for the seven items above, and your rough timeline. 7. Type the words “landlord leads” at the top of your reply so I know you read the whole post. Shortlisted candidates will do a paid 1-hour screen share where you configure a few items live in a test account. Thank you — I’m looking forward to working with someone who really knows this platform.

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description: Role Overview We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed. You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement. Engagement Terms - Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer. - You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings. - You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow. - Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule. - Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels. Key Responsibilities - Meeting support - Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated. - Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side. - Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions. Follow-up and chasing - Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates. - Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets. - Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status. - Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the email thread. - Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after. - Admin support - Calendar management, scheduling and rescheduling across the team. - Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive. - Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents. - Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool. Preferred Skills - Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time. - Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet. - Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients. - Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls. - Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head. - Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus. - Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion). - Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4 or Looker Studio, even at a viewing level. - Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet working space, and a plan for power outages.

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
description: DIGITAL MARKETING & E-COMMERCE SPECIALIST Aromabotanical Philippines | MY PRIME AROMA TRADING CORP. Location: Philippines Employment: Full-time Salary: ?30,000/month + performance incentives ABOUT THE ROLE MY PRIME AROMA TRADING CORP. is the exclusive Philippine distributor of Aromabotanical, an Australian home fragrance brand. We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist who will take an active role in building Aromabotanical’s online presence and, most importantly, turning that presence into sales. This is not a social media posting job. We are looking for someone who can think beyond “What should we post?” and instead ask: Who are we trying to reach? What should we sell them? What campaign should we create? What content will make them interested? How do we convert that interest into a purchase? And did it actually generate sales? You will have significant ownership of Aromabotanical’s digital marketing activities—from brainstorming campaigns and creating content to managing online stores, launching campaigns, coordinating promotions, and analyzing results. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Digital Marketing Strategy Develop and execute a practical digital marketing strategy for Aromabotanical in the Philippine market. Help establish the brand’s online identity and positioning. Research competitors, trends, customers, products, and market opportunities. Identify which products, customer segments, offers and marketing channels have the greatest sales potential. Develop monthly marketing plans and campaigns aligned with sales objectives. Continuously test new ideas and improve based on results. 2. Campaign Development & Execution You will be expected to develop campaign ideas and actually execute them. Examples include: Product launches Seasonal campaigns Gift guides Bundles and promotions Payday campaigns Christmas campaigns Valentine’s Day campaigns Mother’s Day campaigns Limited-time offers Brand-awareness campaigns User-generated-content campaigns Influencer/affiliate campaigns You will be responsible for taking a campaign from: Idea ? Strategy ? Content ? Launch ? Promotion ? Measurement ? Optimization 3. Content Creation You will create and coordinate content for Aromabotanical’s digital channels. This includes: Short-form videos/Reels/TikTok Product photography using a phone/basic equipment Lifestyle content Product demonstrations Educational content Promotional content Social media graphics Captions and copywriting Product descriptions Advertising creatives You should be comfortable using tools such as Canva, CapCut or equivalent software. You do not need to be a professional photographer or videographer. However, you should be capable of producing good, commercially useful content independently. 4. Social Media Management Manage and grow Aromabotanical’s: Facebook Instagram TikTok Other relevant platforms Responsibilities include: Content planning Content calendars Posting Community engagement Responding to comments/messages when appropriate Monitoring trends Identifying content opportunities Tracking performance The objective is not simply to increase followers. The objective is to build an audience that can ultimately become customers. 5. E-Commerce Management Help establish and grow Aromabotanical’s online sales channels, including: Shopee Lazada TikTok Shop Website/e-commerce platform Responsibilities include: Product listings Product titles and descriptions Product images and videos Store merchandising Promotions and vouchers Bundles Campaign participation Pricing/promotion coordination Store optimization Monitoring sales and conversion You should understand how marketplace customers actually shop and what influences conversion. 6. Digital Advertising Manage and/or coordinate basic paid advertising campaigns through platforms such as: Meta Ads TikTok Ads Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop advertising You will be expected to: Develop ad concepts Select appropriate products/offers Create or coordinate creatives Launch campaigns Monitor performance Test different audiences and creatives Optimize spending Track sales and return on advertising spend We are not looking for someone who simply “boosts posts.” 7. Influencer & Affiliate Marketing Develop relationships with: Micro-influencers Content creators Affiliates Relevant lifestyle/home/interior creators Identify creators who can genuinely help generate awareness and sales, coordinate collaborations, and measure results. 8. Analytics & Reporting You will regularly track: Online sales Traffic Engagement Conversion rate Advertising spend Cost per acquisition ROAS Best-selling products Campaign performance Content performance You should be comfortable looking at numbers and asking: “Why did this work?” “Why didn’t this work?” “What should we change next?” You will provide regular updates and recommendations to management. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a hands-on digital marketer, not a traditional social media manager. Required 2–4 years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, or a related role. Practical experience with social media platforms. Experience with Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop or other e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred. Experience creating short-form video content. Familiarity with Canva, CapCut or similar tools. Basic understanding of Meta/TikTok advertising. Good copywriting and communication skills. Comfortable using analytics and sales data. Strong organizational skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership. Strong commercial mindset—understands that marketing ultimately needs to contribute to business growth. Strongly preferred Experience working with: Consumer brands Beauty/wellness Home & lifestyle Home fragrance Retail FMCG E-commerce startups Small businesses where you had to wear multiple hats Experience managing an actual online store with measurable sales results is a major advantage. THE IDEAL PERSON You might be a good fit if you can say: “I have an idea for a campaign, I know who we’re targeting, I can create the content, I can launch it, I can run the ads, and I can tell you whether it worked.” We want someone who is: Creative but commercially minded Strategic but willing to execute Comfortable getting their hands dirty Curious and willing to experiment Data-driven Proactive Resourceful Comfortable working with limited resources Able to turn an idea into an actual campaign You will not have a large marketing department behind you. We need someone who can make things happen. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 30 Days Understand Aromabotanical, its products and target customers. Audit our existing digital presence. Research competitors and opportunities. Develop a practical digital marketing roadmap. Establish priorities for our online channels. Create the initial content and campaign plan. Identify immediate opportunities to generate online sales. 60–90 Days Consistent content and campaign execution. Improved online presence. Optimized e-commerce listings/stores. Initial paid advertising tests. Initial influencer/affiliate activities. Measurable online sales. Clear understanding of which products, content and campaigns perform best. 6–12 Months Establish a sustainable online sales channel. Grow marketplace and direct-to-consumer sales. Develop repeatable campaigns. Build a growing audience and customer base. Improve advertising efficiency and conversion. Establish a clear digital marketing system for Aromabotanical. IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A CONTENT-ONLY ROLE Please do not apply if your primary interest is simply: Creating Instagram posts Making Canva graphics Scheduling social media posts Growing followers Taking aesthetic product photos Content creation is part of the job, but it is not the main objective. Our objective is: BUILD THE BRAND. BUILD THE AUDIENCE. DRIVE ONLINE SALES. APPLICATION Please submit: Your CV/resume Portfolio or examples of social media/content work Examples of e-commerce accounts you have managed, if applicable A brief description of one digital campaign you personally worked on, including: What was the objective? What did you do? What content/campaign did you create? How much was spent, if applicable? What were the results? Shortlisted applicants will be given a practical case exercise: “Aromabotanical currently has very limited online presence. You are given the responsibility of building its online sales. What would you do during your first 90 days?” We are more interested in how you think and execute than in having a perfect answer. MY PRIME AROMA TRADING CORP. Exclusive Philippine Distributor of Aromabotanical

title: Video Editor

What we need Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve — cutting, audio levels, titles, exporting. You don't need to be advanced. You must have access to one of these platforms. CapCut users will not be accepted as we need project Adobe compatible file exports when you are done. The ability to follow a written process exactly, without shortcuts or improvising Attention to detail. Small mistakes matter here. Good written English — enough to read a brief and flag a problem clearly Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing without crashing A few hours of overlap with US Eastern time Reliability above everything. If you say Thursday, we need Thursday. We also want people who speak up. If something in the source material looks wrong or doesn't make sense, tell us. Editors who quietly pass problems through cost us more than they save. Pay Paid per completed segment, not hourly $6 per segment Guaranteed minimum of 150 segments per month once you're hired — most editors will do more than this Realistic full-time earnings: $1,100–1,300 per month Paid weekly by Wise for your first month, then biweekly Growth This is a long-term position, not a short project. We're not making promises up front. But the opportunity is real, and it goes to whoever earns it. Hiring process Send your application (details below) If we like it: a paid test — 4 segments, real source material, with our full SOP and reference videos provided. $25 flat, paid whether or not we move forward. 72 hours to complete. If you pass: a paid batch of 3 full programs at $6 per segment, so we can see your consistency and turnaround Then an ongoing full-time position We pay for every stage. We never ask anyone to work for free. How many 10–15 minute segments you think you could finish in a day Your available hours in US Eastern time Tell us about a time you had to follow a detailed process exactly. Two or three sentences. description: Are you looking for an awesome job that's not only fun, challenging, and enjoyable, but also pays you more money the harder you work? If so, then please read this job listing carefully. Not only do we work on fun and challenging projects, but as my business grows so does everyone's SALARY! :) I am putting together a small, tight-knit team, and the scriptwriter (that's you!) is a key seat on it. I'm looking for that special person who can become a superstar on my team. Someone hard-working, passionate, who would love their job and loves writing videos that evoke emotion and keep people watching to the very end. Someone who can help me take my YouTube channels to the next level. Attention to detail, good work ethic, and a strong desire to excel in everything they do are just some of the qualities that can set you apart from the other candidates. I am looking for an A-player, who can work full time, long term, and can commit and dedicate fully to ensure the success of the business. Here's just some of the criteria that this person would meet: Has their own computer and high-speed Internet connection Speaks, Reads, and Writes excellent English Can work from home without distractions Is always learning and improving his/her skills Has a Wise/PayPal account Has access to the paid Claude plan ($20/month Claude Pro) — or is willing to get it before starting. Our entire scriptwriting system runs on it. Is willing to learn new skills and can easily be trained in other skills Can work full-time (30–40 hours per week) HOW WE WORK — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING: We write with a specific system that mixes AI with your own skill. You will not be writing from a blank page, and you will not be pasting raw AI output either. I provide a defined scriptwriting system, a series of training videos, and clear instructions. You bring the judgment, the hooks, and the voice. If you think "AI writes it for me," this isn't the role. If you think "AI is a tool I drive," we'll get along. TASKS YOU WILL TAKE CARE OF: - Write engaging long-form scripts for faceless YouTube channels (different niches, from tech and science documentary to bird watching) - Hook the viewer in the first 15–30 seconds and earn their attention into the video - Hold attention across the whole video using open loops, STR (situation–tension–resolution), and curiosity gaps — opening tension early and paying it off later so the viewer can't leave - Write in each channel's established voice rather than imposing your own - Work with the AI to pull the facts and details the script needs - Take a title and turn it into a finished, ready-to-record script - Iterate on feedback until the voice is locked - Meet script deadlines so the production pipeline never stalls - Collaborate with me on content ideas and creative direction You'll start on one channel first, then you'll write across others. I will need you to work 6–8 hours per day, 40 hours per week. You can make your own hours. SKILLS NEEDED FOR THIS JOB: Proven long-form YouTube scriptwriting experience — REQUIRED Deep understanding of viewer retention: hooks, open loops, STR, curiosity gaps — REQUIRED Writing for spoken narration, not blog/article/SEO copy — REQUIRED Very comfortable working with AI/LLM platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) — you know how to prompt the AI to get exactly what you want out of it Excellent written English and a strong storytelling instinct Sharp attention to detail Fast learner — you can pick up new tools quickly and put them to use right away Understanding of YouTube as a platform — what makes people click and stay Creative thinking and coming up with great hooks Outside-the-box thinking Ability to take initiative and self-accountability Positive mindset Good communication skills Self-motivated and able to adhere to deadlines Problem solver and able to get the job done without supervision Willingness to go above and beyond the tasks they are given A passion for constant self-improvement and a desire to over-deliver Open-minded, willing to innovate and find better ways to do things I'm not looking for just another writer, I'm looking for a teammate who will work side by side with me and help me grow my YouTube channels. This role starts as a scriptwriting seat, but for the right person it grows into a department manager / team lead position — running a small team of writers under you as we scale. You will have the opportunity to be promoted and achieve a higher position on my team, with a bigger salary, all while working from home. PERFORMANCE-BASED COMPENSATION: Starting budget is around $500/month, and your salary will grow based on performance! The better our videos perform (views, engagement, revenue), the more money you earn. This means you're directly incentivized to write the best scripts possible. There are also bonuses which will be awarded according to your performance. The job is full time and it is an ongoing position, hopefully for as long as possible. HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, this is the part that matters: Send me an email with the subject line "YouTube Script Superstar" and let me know why you think you'd be great for this job. Please include the phrase 'Amber Lighthouse' in the first paragraph of your email so I know you read this all the way through. Also tell me: what channels have you written for, can you share a script sample or a video made from your script, and do you already have the paid Claude plan? IMPORTANT: A simple test task will be given to further evaluate your skills. If you are not ok with that, please do not apply for this job. Thank you! Sincerely, Romy Banciu

title: Executive Assistant
description: The Mission of This Role 🎯 Protect the Founder’s time, attention, and energy so he can remain focused on the highest-value activities of the organization. The Executive Assistant will take ownership of four primary areas: Email. Phone. Calendar. Problems. Success means fewer interruptions, fewer unnecessary decisions, a cleaner calendar, faster communication, and significantly less administrative work reaching the Founder. Primary Responsibilities 📧 1. Executive Email & Inbox Management Take primary responsibility for managing the Founder’s business email inbox. Responsibilities include:📋 ✅Review and organize incoming email throughout the business day. ✅Identify messages requiring immediate executive attention. ✅Separate important communication from routine requests and low-priority correspondence. ✅Respond to routine emails on the Founder’s behalf when appropriate. ✅Draft responses for executive review when personal involvement is required. ✅Delegate requests to the appropriate team member. ✅Follow up with employees, vendors, carrier representatives, clients, and business partners. ✅Archive, organize, flag, and categorize messages. ✅Maintain outstanding follow-up items so important communication does not fall through the cracks. ✅Reduce the number of emails the Founder personally needs to review or respond to. Goal: The Founder should spend as little time as reasonably possible managing his own inbox. 📞 2. Phone Call & Voicemail Management Serve as the first line of defense for incoming calls and voicemails. Responsibilities include:📋 ✅Screen incoming business calls when appropriate. ✅Review missed calls and voicemails. ✅Determine the urgency and appropriate next action. ✅Return routine calls or coordinate responses when authorized. ✅Route callers to the appropriate member of the Legacy Insurance Group team. ✅Schedule calls requiring the Founder’s involvement. ✅Provide concise summaries before important callbacks. ✅Protect the Founder from unnecessary interruptions and unsolicited calls. The Executive Assistant should become skilled at determining: Does Sean actually need to handle this—or can I solve it, delegate it, or route it somewhere else? 📅 3. Executive Calendar Management Own and protect the Founder’s calendar. Responsibilities include:📋 ✅Schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings. ✅Confirm appointments and meeting logistics. ✅Prevent unnecessary meetings from consuming executive time. ✅Resolve scheduling conflicts. ✅Create appropriate buffers between meetings. ✅Reschedule appointments when priorities change. ✅Ensure the Founder has the necessary information before important meetings. ✅Coordinate meetings with employees, vendors, carrier representatives, clients, recruits, and strategic partners. ✅Maintain dedicated time for strategic work and other high-priority responsibilities. ✅Anticipate scheduling issues before they become problems. The calendar should reflect the Founder’s priorities—not simply other people's requests for his time. 🔥 4. Handle Small Problems Before They Become Big Problems A major responsibility of this position is preventing minor operational issues from unnecessarily reaching the Founder. When a problem arises, the Executive Assistant should first ask: Can I solve this? If not: Who on the team can solve this? Only issues that genuinely require executive authority, judgment, or involvement should be escalated. Examples may include:📋 ✅Coordinating with vendors. ✅Following up on outstanding requests. ✅Tracking down missing information. ✅Resolving scheduling conflicts. ✅Coordinating communication between team members. ✅Researching solutions to minor operational problems. ✅Following up with carrier representatives. ✅Handling routine administrative requests. ✅Identifying the appropriate person to own an issue. ✅Making reasonable decisions within established authority. ✅Ensuring delegated tasks actually get completed. We want someone who does not simply report problems. We want someone who solves problems. Additional Responsibilities The Executive Assistant may also assist with:📋 ✅Preparing meeting agendas and executive summaries. ✅Tracking important commitments and deadlines. ✅Coordinating travel arrangements and itineraries. ✅Preparing documents and presentations. ✅Maintaining confidential executive information. ✅Conducting basic research. ✅Following up on delegated projects. ✅Coordinating recruiting interviews and candidate scheduling. ✅Organizing leadership meetings. ✅Maintaining executive task lists. ✅Documenting recurring processes. ✅Identifying opportunities to automate or delegate repetitive administrative work. ✅Supporting special projects assigned by the Founder. What Success Looks Like Within the first several months, the right person should create a noticeable reduction in the amount of administrative work reaching the Founder. Success will look like:🏆 ✅The executive inbox is consistently organized and under control. ✅Important emails receive timely responses. ✅Routine emails are handled without executive involvement. ✅Missed calls and voicemails are screened and appropriately routed. ✅The Founder receives concise summaries rather than having to investigate issues himself. ✅The calendar is organized around strategic priorities. ✅Low-value meetings and interruptions are reduced. ✅Minor problems are solved independently. ✅Delegated tasks are followed through to completion. ✅Important commitments do not fall through the cracks. ✅The Founder spends substantially more time on strategy, leadership, recruiting, systems, sales, marketing, relationships, and organizational growth. Who We Are Looking For🔍 The ideal candidate is someone who is: 🥇Highly Organized You naturally create order from chaos and can manage many moving pieces without losing track of details. 🥇Proactive You don't wait to be told every next step. You anticipate what needs to happen and take action. 🥇Resourceful When you encounter something you don't know, your instinct is to figure it out. 🥇Decisive You are comfortable making reasonable decisions without constantly seeking approval. 🥇An Excellent Communicator You communicate clearly, professionally, and concisely with executives, employees, clients, vendors, and business partners. 🥇Discreet You understand that working directly with a Founder means having access to confidential business and personal information. 🥇Persistent If someone owes you an answer, document, confirmation, or deliverable, you follow through until it gets done. 🥇Comfortable With Technology You can quickly learn communication platforms, calendars, CRM systems, automation tools, AI tools, and other business software. 🥇Calm Under Pressure When several things happen at once, you prioritize instead of panic. 🥇Ownership-Oriented You don't say: "Nobody got back to me." You say: "It wasn't resolved, so I followed up, found the right person, and got it handled." The Most Important Question in This Role🎯 Before bringing something to the Founder, ask: “Does this truly require the Founder’s time, authority, or judgment?” If the answer is no, take ownership of getting it resolved. If the answer is yes, bring the issue forward with the relevant information and a recommended solution. Instead of: “Sean, we have a problem. What do you want me to do?” We prefer: “Sean, here's the situation. I looked into it and see two options. I recommend Option A because of X. Unless you disagree, I'll move forward with that.” Qualifications🥅 Preferred qualifications include: ✅3+ years of Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Management, Operations, or similar experience. ✅Experience directly supporting a Founder, CEO, President, or senior executive strongly preferred. ✅Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. ✅Strong email and calendar management skills. ✅Excellent attention to detail. ✅Strong judgment and problem-solving ability. ✅Ability to prioritize competing demands. ✅Comfortable communicating with senior-level business professionals. ✅Experience working with Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft 365 preferred. ✅Familiarity with CRM and business communication systems is helpful. ✅Strong proficiency with modern AI and productivity tools is a plus. ✅Insurance experience is helpful but not required. Our Culture Legacy Insurance Group operates with a high-performance mentality. We believe in: 🎯Taking 100% Ownership — Own the outcome, not the excuse. 🎯Making Decisions — Gather the information, make the best decision available, and move forward. 🎯Continuous Improvement — Get 1% better every day. 🎯Thinking Big — Look beyond today's problem and consider how the organization can operate better tomorrow. 🎯Being Resourceful — Find answers and solutions instead of waiting for instructions. 🎯Teamwork — The organization wins when everyone executes their role at a high level. 🎯Never Giving Up — Persistence and resilience are part of who we are. Why This Role Matters As Legacy Insurance Group grows, the Founder & Chief Risk Officer must increasingly focus on responsibilities that cannot easily be delegated: ✅Strategic vision and business planning ✅Recruiting and developing exceptional talent ✅Building scalable systems and processes ✅Sales and marketing strategy ✅Developing strategic relationships ✅Leadership and culture ✅Identifying new opportunities for growth Every hour spent sorting emails, listening to routine voicemails, coordinating calendars, chasing information, or solving minor administrative problems is an hour that cannot be invested in those responsibilities. Your job is to give those hours back. The right Executive Assistant will become one of the most trusted and valuable people in the organization—not simply by helping the Founder accomplish more, but by progressively reducing the number of things that require his involvement. The Ultimate Goal🥅 Make the Founder less necessary to the day-to-day operation of the business. Protect his time. Protect his attention. Solve what you can. Delegate what others can solve. Escalate only what truly requires him. And help build an organization that can operate effectively without everything flowing through one person.

title: Structural Engineer - US Residential Construction
description: ABOUT US At Contemporary Tiny Homes, we design, sell, and build high-quality, custom Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) that help homeowners create flexible, modern living solutions. As a fast-growing design-build company, we combine thoughtful design, technical excellence, and streamlined construction to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Joining us means working with a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values precision, accountability, and continuous improvement. If you’re passionate about residential construction and structural design—and enjoy working closely with architects, engineers, and builders—this role offers an opportunity to make a real impact. YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES As a Structural Designer - US Residential Construction, you will be responsible for developing and coordinating the structural portion of our Construction Drawings, producing accurate, code-compliant structural plans that support permitting and successful construction of our ADU projects. Structural Design & Plan Deliverables - Develop and produce complete structural plans for ADU projects. - Prepare foundation plans, floor framing plans, roof framing plans, wall framing/bracing plans, and structural connection details required for permitting and construction. - Develop structural details for beams, headers, posts, joists, rafters, load paths, connections, footings, and foundations. - Coordinate wall bracing and lateral-load requirements based on applicable codes and project conditions. - Ensure drawings clearly communicate structural intent and construction requirements. - Review architectural and structural drawings for inconsistencies or conflicts before permit submission. Technical Execution & Construction Knowledge - Demonstrate a strong understanding of residential wood-frame construction and foundation construction practices, including: > Formwork installation and layout > Placement of wood and steel reinforcement per structural plans > Verification of levels, alignment, and dimensions prior to concrete placement > Concrete footings, columns, and foundation beams >Floor, wall, and roof framing systems > Structural connections, hardware, and load paths - Apply practical construction knowledge to ensure designs are structurally sound and buildable. - Identify potential constructability issues and address them during the design process. Building Code & Engineering Coordination - Ensure structural plans comply with current U.S. building codes, including applicable Connecticut state and local requirements. - Incorporate applicable structural requirements, including wind loads, snow loads, spans, bearing conditions, wall bracing, and other project-specific design criteria. - Coordinate with licensed Structural Engineers when calculations, engineered designs, professional review, or signed and sealed drawings are required. - Incorporate engineer comments and revisions into the Construction Drawing set. - Assist in addressing structural comments or correction notices received from Building Departments/AHJs. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with the in-house Architect, Structural Engineer, and broader U.S.-based team. - Coordinate structural drawings with architectural and MEP plans to identify and resolve conflicts. - Work with Design, Permitting, and Construction teams to resolve structural questions throughout the project. - Provide clear communication and timely revisions when adjustments are required. - Support the construction team when clarification of structural plans or details is needed in the field. WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE Structural Design Expertise - Proven experience producing structural plans for US residential projects, such as ADUs, single-family homes, additions, or similar projects. - Strong understanding of foundations, wood framing systems, structural connections, and load paths. - Good to have experience in creating structural plans using helical piers. - Ability to read, interpret, and coordinate architectural and structural Construction Drawings. - Experience preparing or coordinating permit-ready structural plans. Construction & Technical Knowledge - Hands-on understanding of how structural designs translate to real-world construction. - Ability to anticipate constructability issues and address them during design. - Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies between architectural and structural plans. - Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, or comparable drafting/design software. Code Knowledge - Working knowledge and minimum of 2-year experience of U.S. residential building codes. - Familiarity with IRC/IBC structural requirements. - Experience with Connecticut building codes, residential construction, or local permitting requirements is a strong plus. Collaboration, Communication & Accountability - Ability to work effectively with architects, engineers, permitting teams, and construction professionals. - Clear written and verbal English communication skills. - Open, receptive, and responsive to feedback, with the ability to incorporate revisions efficiently. - Strong sense of ownership and accountability for deliverables, timelines, coordination, and design accuracy. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Compensation - Market-competitive pay based on experience and qualifications. Professional Growth - Opportunity to work on real, buildable ADU projects in the U.S. market. - Exposure to structural design, engineering coordination, permitting, and construction. - Opportunity to grow with a design-build company as our processes and standards continue to evolve. Collaborative & Supportive Culture - Work with a skilled, respectful, and process-driven team. - Collaborate directly with architectural, engineering, permitting, and construction professionals. - Contribute meaningfully to projects that directly impact homeowners and communities. JOIN US! If you’re a detail-oriented Structural Designer who understands both design and construction, can take ownership of the structural portion of residential Construction Drawings, and is excited to collaborate with a U.S.-based ADU team, we’d love to hear from you. Message us with a link of your resume so we can prioritize you for an initial interview. Apply now and help shape the future of smart, efficient housing.

This isn't filler for slow days — it's the second door to the same number, and you'll spend real hours here. •⁠ ⁠Book qualified discovery calls onto our closer's calendar •⁠ ⁠Use our qualification checklist so the calls you book are real, not filler •⁠ ⁠Follow up on a fixed cadence — nothing sits untouched •⁠ ⁠Keep the CRM spotless: every lead has a stage, a note, and a next action with a date •⁠ ⁠Write a short brief on every prospect before their call so the closer walks in prepared •⁠ ⁠Sit in on discovery calls and take notes — this is how you learn the sale One number defines your week: qualified discovery calls held. Not dials. Not conversations. Calls that happened and were worth having. Warm database or ice-cold prospect — we don't care where the call came from, only that it happened and it was real. Where this goes. This is a starting seat, not a ceiling. Reps who consistently hit their call numbers and demonstrate they can run a conversation move up into running their own sales calls, at senior pay. We'll walk you through exactly what that path looks like on the interview. Who this is for •⁠ ⁠You've done real outbound — cold calls, cold DMs, cold email — and you don't dread the phone •⁠ ⁠Your spoken English is clear and easy for a 62-year-old clinic owner in Ohio to follow on the first pass, over a phone line •⁠ ⁠You're organized. Nothing falls out of your CRM. •⁠ ⁠You want to become a closer and you're willing to earn it in the trenches first •⁠ ⁠You can be measured on one public number every week without falling apart Who this is not for •⁠ ⁠Anyone who wants warm leads handed to them •⁠ ⁠Anyone who needs reminding to follow up •⁠ ⁠Anyone who wants to run sales calls on day one — that's not this seat Big advantages (not required) •⁠ ⁠You've worked at a virtual assistant, staffing, outsourcing, or recruitment company in any role — including as a VA. If you've supported a US business remotely and you want to move into sales, we especially want to talk to you. You already understand our product better than most salespeople ever will. •⁠ ⁠Healthcare or medical background — clinics are our specialty and this is our single biggest advantage to have •⁠ ⁠You've sold to US small business owners in any industry •⁠ ⁠GoHighLevel experience Compensation •⁠ ⁠$6–$8/hour, based on experience — 40 hrs/week •⁠ ⁠$10 for every call you book that is held and passes our qualification checklist (no-shows don't count; unqualified prospects don't count) Requirements •⁠ ⁠Based in Latin America •⁠ ⁠Schedule: 10:00am – 8:00pm US Eastern, Monday–Friday, with a 2-hour midday break. That's 8 working hours a day, 40 per week. You need to be genuinely available across that window — this shift exists so we can reach owners on both US coasts. •⁠ ⁠Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, working headset How to apply Email: ---------- Subject: Junior Pipeline Rep Send three things. Missing any one of them and we don't review the application. 1.⁠ ⁠Your CV 2.⁠ ⁠Three short written answers A few sentences each. Specifics beat polish. •⁠ ⁠What outbound work have you done? Roughly how many calls, DMs, or emails per day — and what were you trying to get people to do? •⁠ ⁠Tell us about one time you got a hard-to-reach person to respond. What did you actually do? •⁠ ⁠What CRM have you used, and what did you personally do in it every day? 3.⁠ ⁠A voice recording Vocaroo ( ---------- ) or similar. 90 seconds max. One take — no script, no editing. •⁠ ⁠0:00–0:20 — Your name, where you're based, what you do now. •⁠ ⁠0:20–1:00 — Role-play: You're calling a clinic owner who asked us for information three weeks ago and never replied. title: Project Manager
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Lorla is looking for a highly organized, detail-obsessed Project Manager to lead project execution from contract signing through final installation. This is not an administrative support role. The designer owns what we're creating; the Project Manager owns how it gets done. You will bring genuine ownership to every project you touch — anticipating problems before they surface, never letting a detail slip, and holding the broader team accountable to deadlines and commitments. PROJECT PLANNING & SCHEDULING Own the project schedule from kickoff through installation and closeout, setting milestones, deadlines, and dependencies. Lead new client onboarding: send the design questionnaire and "What to Expect" documentation immediately after contract and retainer are received. Keep projects moving proactively — anticipate issues rather than reacting to them, and escalate early when schedule, budget, or execution risks arise. Maintain an accurate, up-to-date view of every project's status. TEAM COORDINATION & ACCOUNTABILITY Coordinate tasks and deadlines across designers, procurement/operations, vendors, contractors, and other project partners. Lead weekly internal team meetings and run or prepare for project-status check-ins. Ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned, followed through, and completed on time — holding the team accountable. Give designers the information they need to make decisions without having to chase it down. Lead communication with outside project partners, including general contractors and architects. CLIENT COMMUNICATION Serve as the primary point of contact for all logistics and project-management matters. Lead weekly client email updates covering schedule, next steps, outstanding decisions, deliveries, and installations. Track client approvals and decisions to keep projects on schedule. Maintain Lorla's high-touch client experience through every operational step of a project. BUDGET & FINANCIAL TRACKING Maintain project budgets and monitor actual and committed spend against budget. Flag potential overruns or scope changes early. Coordinate proposals, deposits, invoices, change orders, and other financial milestones with the appropriate team member. Keep project records and financial information current. PROCUREMENT & VENDOR COORDINATION Participate in bid-set preparation and the detailed review of labor bids, including related communications and site visits. Lead the transition from design to procurement, including transition meetings and procurement sheets. Oversee the purchasing timeline, ensuring approved items move promptly into procurement. Monitor lead times, backorders, shipping, receiving, damages, replacements, and outstanding vendor issues. Resolve procurement issues before they become installation-day emergencies. INSTALLATION & CLOSEOUT Lead and participate in project site visits, with particular attention to timing and logistics. Develop and manage installation schedules, confirming products, trades, deliveries, and team readiness. Maintain punch lists and drive outstanding items to completion. Ensure final documentation, invoicing, photography, returns/claims, and full project closeout are completed. Develop client goodbye packets and lead client and vendor gifting. PROCESS & SYSTEMS Maintain clean, accurate project information in Lorla's project-management systems. Develop and maintain repeatable checklists, workflows, and client-facing "What to Expect" documents. Lead updates to Lorla's operations manual and website content. Identify recurring bottlenecks or inefficiencies and recommend improvements. ADDITIONAL SUPPORT Respond to new client inquiries in the leads inbox. Support marketing and networking efforts as needed, including social media, events, and gifting. TOOLS & SYSTEMS Houzz Pro and Canva. Comfort learning and maintaining structure within project-management and design software is essential. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Fanatical attention to detail — nothing falls through the cracks, ever. A true sense of ownership over project execution, not just task completion. A proactive self-starter who drives projects forward and holds others accountable. Excellent written and verbal communication, especially with high-end clientele. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects. Experience in interior design, architecture, or high-end residential construction project management preferred, but not required. OUR APPLICATION PROCESS - Please submit a short <60 sec video sharing your interest in the role and why you applied - We will invite the top 2-4 applicants to complete a paid work trial, paid at $8/hour (approx 4 hours of time to complete) - Upon completion of the paid work trial we will invite the next round of candidates to zoom interviews. Thank you!

title: Influencer Research & Outreach Specialist — Remote
description: ## How does the job work and when do you get paid? You will receive a specific campaign from us with clear brand requirements, including the target country, platform, creator category, and required performance. The process is simple: 1. **Find the right influencers** who match the campaign requirements. 2. **Contact the influencers** and offer them the opportunity to work directly with brands. 3. **Help interested influencers sign a service agreement with our company.** From that point, the creator is assigned to you and we can introduce them to relevant brands. 4. **Wait for the brand’s decision.** If a brand is interested in your creator, we connect the brand and influencer directly. 5. **The brand and influencer agree on the details and sign a contract for the campaign.** 6. **Once we receive confirmation that the brand and the influencer you brought in have agreed to work together, your task is considered successfully completed and we pay you within 24 hours.** ### You don’t have to wait for the campaign to be completed This is an important part of our payment model. **You don’t have to wait.** You don’t need to wait: * for the influencer to publish the sponsored content, * for the campaign to be completed, * or for the influencer to receive payment from the brand. Once we receive confirmation that the brand and influencer have signed an agreement, **we pay you within 24 hours.** Your job is to find and bring in the right creator. Once your creator is selected by the brand and the collaboration is confirmed, **your job is done and you receive your payment.** This is a fully remote, flexible, performance-based position. There are no fixed working hours — you d ---------- when and how much you work. There is no fixed salary at the beginning. You are paid for successful results, so this position is best for people who prefer flexible, task-based work. If you're interested, apply and we'll send you the current campaigns, workflow, and payment details.

title: Creative Video Editor & Hook Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term)
job_title: Creative Video Editor & Hook Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description: We're looking for a video editor with real creative instinct - someone who can feel what makes an opening pull a viewer in, not just technically execute a checklist. This isn't only about mechanical clarity cuts - we have tools that speed those up. What sets the right person apart is the part a tool can't do: taste, energy, and judgment, especially in the first 30 seconds of every video. You'll handle the clarity editing too, but the hook is where you'll really prove yourself. If you have an eye for what makes content feel premium and magnetic, keep reading. About us: We're an established digital agency producing high-volume YouTube content on business automation and tutorials across two active channels, with a consistent and growing publishing schedule. This is a stable, long-term, full-time role - not a one-off gig. You'll work directly with the person who currently edits these videos, learn our exact style, and eventually take the editing load so we can scale. Clear expectations, direct communication, real growth. This role has three parts. You need to be strong at all three: 1. The Hook (first 20–45 seconds) - this is the artistic part The opening of every video has to be beautiful, engaging, and pull viewers in immediately. This means: - Captions placed thoughtfully - well-timed, visually appealing, never covering the wrong thing - Attention-grabbing visual edits in the first 3–5 seconds - B-roll layered in to illustrate and emphasize what's being said - Captions on top of b-roll to reinforce key spoken points - Zoom effects and behind-the-speaker edits used tastefully throughout - Clean introduction of the subject/topic We are NOT looking for over-the-top motion graphics. We're looking for tasteful, artistic, high-retention editing. If you have an eye for what makes an opening feel premium, this is for you. 2. The Full Edit - clarity + precision This half is about making the video clean, professional, and error-free. Your job on the main body: Clarity editing: - Cut retakes, filler words, dead air, and gaps so the video flows and makes sense - We use a wavelength gap-cutting tool (TimeBolt) to speed this up - you'll either run it yourself and review its output, or use an equivalent tool in your own workflow if you have one that does the same thing - The end result must be professional-grade: clean, clear, and easy to follow - no awkward cuts, no leftover stumbles Redaction (zero tolerance - this is reputation-critical): - Blur the creator's private information shown on screen - home address, personal phone number, personal email addresses, ID numbers, or any other personal/private details - Bleep private info if it's spoken aloud - if the creator OR an AI agent/chatbot in the video says his personal information out loud (email, phone, etc.), mute it and add a bleep sound so it can't be heard, and remove/blur it visually if it's also on screen - Where needed, edit the transcript/captions so private info isn't written out either - Exception: demo contacts and clearly public-facing business info do NOT need to be hidden - those are already public. This is specifically about the creator's private information. - We'll give you the exact list of what counts as private during onboarding Other in-video tasks: - Add on-screen layouts when the speaker interacts with a voice agent - Flash awards / b-roll graphics on screen on cue when directed - A full watch-through before delivery to confirm nothing was missed Critical: Missing a single un-blurred private detail, un-bleeped spoken email/phone number, or clipped word is not acceptable. This content goes out publicly, and accuracy protects the creator's privacy and our reputation. We review every video - but we need someone we can eventually trust to get it right the first time. Style matching: We have an established editing style. A big part of this role is learning it well enough that viewers can't tell where our current editor stops and you begin. We'll give you reference videos to study and match. 3. The Thumbnail - the click-driver Every video you edit, you also create the thumbnail for. This is a core part of the role, not an add-on. You'll be set up for success: - We provide the exact prompts we use, plus a "things to know about thumbnails" style guide - We provide access to AI image generation - Your job is to produce a scroll-stopping, on-brand thumbnail that matches our established look - strong composition, clear focal point, readable text, the right facial expression/emotion - We want one person owning the full visual output of each video - edit AND thumbnail - so the look stays consistent end to end HARD SKILLS REQUIRED - Advanced video editing in a professional tool of your choice (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, CapCut, etc. - we care about the quality of your work, not which software you use) - Thumbnail design - strong sense of composition, focal point, readable text, and eye-catching layout (AI tools and our prompts/style guide provided) - Strong sense of visual design and pacing - especially for short, high-retention hooks - Caption timing and placement with zero spelling/grammar errors - Comfort with b-roll, zoom effects, text overlays, and simple on-screen layouts - Clarity editing - cutting retakes, filler words, and gaps for a clean, professional flow (experience with TimeBolt or a similar gap-cutting tool is a plus) - Precise censoring/redaction work (blurring, bleeping, transcript editing) - Strong English listening comprehension - able to catch clipped words and errors by ear SOFT SKILLS REQUIRED - Deadline-driven - able to sustain ~10 videos/week once ramped up - Self-starter - takes direction once, then executes without hand-holding - Detail-obsessed - you double-check your own work before calling it done - Coachable - takes feedback and redo requests professionally - Reliable & communicative - flags problems early instead of guessing - Consistent - same high quality on video #10 as on video #1 WHO THIS IS NOT FOR - A "checklist-only" editor who executes instructions but brings no creative judgment of their own - we need taste, not just compliance - Editors who are fast but skip the final watch-through - Anyone who can't handle detailed redaction/censoring rules precisely - Anyone uncomfortable being told "redo this, it's not there yet" - Anyone looking for a short-term or part-time gig WHO THIS IS FOR - A skilled editor who takes pride in artistic, premium-feeling work - Someone who wants a stable, long-term, full-time home - Someone who can be trusted with precise, reputation-critical detail work - Someone excited to learn and match an established style WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE - Target output: ~10 videos per week once fully ramped (phased ramp-up in the first few weeks) - Full-time role - but we do not track hours. We care about output and quality, not clock time. Get the work done to standard and manage your own schedule. TO APPLY 1. Put "AHOY [Your Name]" in the subject line, in all caps. Applications without this will not be reviewed - it's our first check that you read carefully. 2. In the body, put your answer to this question between the lines >>> START > END

We design and build high-end custom pools, spas, and landscape environments — and we need a sharp, dependable Drafter / Landscape Architect to help us keep projects moving smoothly from design to approved permit. This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the Philippines. You'll work closely with our US-based designers and engineers, preparing technical drawings and permit packages, communicating with city building departments, and helping manage the full permit lifecycle for multiple projects at a time. We value reliability, strong communication, and someone who takes ownership of their work. What you'll do - Prepare detailed CAD drawings — site plans, section drawings, structural details, and full working plan sets ready for permit submittal. - Coordinate with our US-based designers and structural engineers to gather all information needed to complete permit packages and HOA submittals. - Convert raw job-site measurements into clean, accurate blank site plans for the design team to work from. - Research city planning and zoning requirements (setbacks, easements, code requirements) to ensure designs are buildable before work begins. - Communicate with California city building departments and HOA offices (via email, phone, and online portals) to expedite permit approvals. - Log and update project progress in our project management system, keeping clients and office staff consistently informed across multiple active projects. - Manage revision cycles and respond to plan check corrections from city departments until permits are approved. Required skills Proven experience as a Drafter, Landscape Architect, or similar role Strong hands-on CAD software skills (AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar) Experience with 3D modeling tools Familiarity with US city building departments and HOA submittal processes Strong written and spoken English communication skills Highly organized, self-directed, and able to manage multiple projects independently Reliable internet connection and a dedicated home workspace Nice to have Background in pool, spa, or outdoor living design Previous remote work experience with a US-based client or employer Artistic eye or rendering ability for presentation drawings Familiarity with project management tools (Buildertrend, Asana, or similar) Degree in Landscape Architecture, Architecture, or Civil/Environmental Design Experience reading and interpreting structural and civil engineering plans What reliability looks like to us We're not looking for someone to clock in and disappear. Our ideal candidate is someone who: Responds promptly Replies to messages within a reasonable window during agreed working hours Meets deadlines Delivers drawings on time and flags issues early — not at the last minute Takes ownership Tracks their own tasks without needing to be chased, and follows through Communicates clearly Keeps the team updated, asks smart questions, and escalates when needed What to expect Overlap with US Pacific Time (PST/PDT) is required All communication and coordination is done remotely via email, video calls, and our project management platform You'll work directly with the project lead, designers, and engineers — a small, collaborative team Volume varies by season — strong project flow with opportunities to grow as the company scales How to apply Apply to this ad with the subject line "Drafter / Landscape Architect – [Your Name]" 1. Your updated CV / resume 2. Portfolio or work samples (CAD drawings, site plans, or similar) 3. A short note (3–5 sentences) on your remote work experience and why this role interests you

title: Technical Drafter
description: About the role Calimingo Pools builds luxury custom pools and outdoor living spaces throughout Los Angeles and Orange County. Every project goes through a permitting process — and we need someone who can take raw site data and designer intent and turn it into clean, accurate, permit-ready drawings that actually get approved. This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the Philippines. You'll work directly with our U.S.-based design and engineering team, managing the full drafting lifecycle from blank site plans to final HOA and building department submissions. Strong rendering skills are a real advantage here — our clients expect drawings that are both technically precise and visually impressive. Open to candidates from: Landscape Architecture Civil Engineering Structural Engineering Architecture Drafting & Design Technology What matters most is your ability to produce accurate technical drawings and high-quality renders — not the specific degree on your diploma. What you'll do - Produce complete plan sets — site plans, section drawings, structural details, and working drawings ready for building permit submittal and HOA approval. - Create high-quality renders — produce visually polished presentation drawings and 3D renders that clearly communicate design intent to clients and reviewers. - Convert site measurements into blank site plans — clean, accurate base drawings the design team can build on. - Coordinate with the design and engineering team — gather structural requirements and design intent from our U.S.-based team to ensure drawings are complete and buildable. - Research zoning and code requirements — confirm setbacks, easements, and local restrictions before designs are finalized to avoid costly revisions. - Support the permit process — communicate with city building departments and HOA offices via email and online portals to help move permits forward. - Track project progress — update our project management software to keep clients and office staff informed across multiple active projects. Must-haves Strong hands-on CAD proficiency — AutoCAD, SketchUp, or equivalent Proven ability to create accurate 2D technical drawings and plan sets Good rendering skills — 3D visualization or presentation-quality output Detail-oriented with a strong sense of accuracy and spatial understanding Good written and spoken English communication skills Reliable internet, dedicated home workspace, and available for PST overlap Self-directed — able to manage tasks independently without micromanagement Nice to have Experience with pool, hardscape, or outdoor living construction drawings Familiarity with U.S. building permit or HOA submittal processes Experience with Lumion, Enscape, V-Ray, or similar rendering software Previous remote work with a U.S.-based client or employer Familiarity with project management tools (Buildertrend, Asana, or similar) Ability to read and interpret structural or civil engineering plans What reliability looks like to us Responds promptly Replies within a reasonable window during agreed working hours Meets deadlines Delivers on time and flags issues early — not at the last minute Takes ownership Tracks their own tasks without needing to be chased Communicates clearly Keeps the team updated and asks smart questions when stuck If this is you, send your CV alongside with your Portfolio or work samples — technical drawings, site plans, and renders (include both if you have them)
