title: AI Search & Visibility Specialist (GEO + SEO)
description: — This is NOT a traditional SEO role. Please read carefully before applying. — About the Role Search has fundamentally changed. Buyers no longer just Google — they ask ChatGPT, query Perplexity, and rely on Google AI Overviews to make decisions. At Calimingo Pools, a luxury pool design and construction company based in Southern California, we want to be the brand AI recommends when someone starts dreaming about their backyard. We're hiring an AI Search & Visibility Specialist who lives at the intersection of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and traditional search. You understand how large language models retrieve, rank, and cite information — and you know how to get a brand into those answers. Traditional SEO is your foundation, not your ceiling. This is a freelance, remote role with real ownership over how Calimingo is discovered across every search surface — from Google rankings to AI-generated responses. ?? Who This Role Is NOT For Candidates who only know traditional SEO and have never worked with AI search platforms Candidates who cannot name the difference between how Google indexes content vs. how an LLM retrieves and cites it Candidates who have not actively used tools like Perplexity, ChatGPT, or Google AI Overviews as part of their professional work What You'll Do Own Calimingo's full search visibility strategy — from Google rankings to AI-generated answers Conduct GEO and SEO audits covering AI discoverability, citation potential, technical health, and content structure Optimize pages and content for LLM readability — answer-first formats, clear heading hierarchies, passage-level clarity that AI engines can extract and cite Build topical authority and entity signals so both search engines and AI tools associate Calimingo with luxury pools, pool design, and outdoor living Implement schema markup (FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization) for rich results and AI citation Monitor and grow Calimingo's citation presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini Pursue earned media placements — directories, review platforms, editorial features — that strengthen both backlinks and AI multi-source authority Manage technical search fundamentals — crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, site architecture Publish and maintain content directly on the Calimingo website via WordPress Report monthly on organic rankings, AI citation frequency, and share of voice vs. competitors Must-Have Skills Hands-on GEO experience — you have actively worked to get brands cited in AI-generated answers, not just read about it Working knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) — you understand why it matters for brand visibility Fluency with AI platforms — you regularly use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini as professional tools, not just casually AI visibility tracking — experience with tools like Otterly.ai, Ahrefs Brand Radar, BrightEdge, or similar Traditional SEO foundation — keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, technical audits Schema markup — FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization Search tools — Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console WordPress — confident navigating, editing, and publishing on a live website Content strategy — semantic architecture, entity-based strategy, topical authority building Nice to Have Digital PR and earned media experience Knowledge graph and E-E-A-T optimization Familiarity with agentic search (OpenAI Operator) and agent-driven discovery Experience with home improvement, construction, luxury goods, or lifestyle brands To Apply, Please Answer These Questions Applications without answers will not be reviewed. Have you worked on a GEO strategy before? If yes, describe one specific result — ideally a brand you helped get cited in an AI-generated answer and how you did it. What tools do you currently use to monitor AI citations and brand visibility across AI platforms? What is RAG and why does it matter for a brand trying to appear in AI search answers? What's one difference between optimizing content for Google vs. optimizing it for an LLM? What Success Looks Like Within 90 days: a comprehensive audit, a prioritized roadmap, and early improvements in how Calimingo appears in both Google results and AI-generated responses. Long term: Calimingo is the brand AI tools reach for when someone searches "luxury pool builders" or asks ChatGPT where to start.

title: Business Manager
description: Job Description: Virtual Business Manager September 2026 Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Reports To: Executive Director Location: Remote Position Summary I am seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Business Manager to provide day-to-day administrative, operational, client, fundraising, marketing, event, and reporting support. This position is ideal for someone who can work independently, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities with minimal supervision. The Business Manager will help keep my organization organized and moving forward by managing administrative systems, maintaining client and donor information, supporting communications and marketing, assisting with fundraising campaigns, coordinating event activities, maintaining organizational records, and completing grant reporting. The ideal candidate is a "get-it-done" person who does not need to be reminded repeatedly about assigned tasks and who will identify problems and opportunities and bring solutions to the Executive Director. Key Responsibilities 1. Administrative & Business Management • Print and organize monthly/quarterly reports as needed. • Maintain organized electronic business records. • Assist staff with routine administrative tasks. • Create labels, flyers, forms, notices, signs, and other office materials. • Prepare documents and materials for staff meetings, programs, and events. • Maintain calendars, deadlines, and recurring administrative tasks. • Assist with general office organization and administrative projects. • Follow established organizational procedures and maintain confidentiality. 2. Website Management • Monitor the organization's website for accuracy and current information. • Make routine website updates as requested. • Add or remove program information, announcements, events, documents, and other content. • Update website forms, links, images, and basic content as necessary. • Identify outdated or incorrect information and bring it to the Executive Director's attention. • Respond to website inquiries and route requests to the appropriate staff member. 3. Social Media & Marketing • Create and schedule weekly social media posts. • Maintain a consistent social media presence. • Develop simple graphics, flyers, announcements, and promotional materials. • Repurpose organizational content for social media. • Promote programs, events, fundraising campaigns, community activities, and organizational accomplishments. • Assist with maintaining a monthly or quarterly content calendar. • Monitor basic engagement and provide the Executive Director with updates when appropriate. 4. Client & Contact Management • Maintain and update client information in HubSpot. • Maintain and update donor and contact information in Givebutter. • Ensure client and donor records are accurate and organized. • Enter new contacts and update existing records. • Track client follow-ups and communication. • Create and send client follow-up communications. • Identify incomplete or outdated records and correct them. • Maintain appropriate documentation of communications and follow-ups. 5. Donor & Fundraising Support • Create and send donor communications and fundraising campaigns. • Assist with developing donor campaign content. • Schedule fundraising emails and communications. • Maintain donor information in Givebutter. • Send donor acknowledgments and follow-up communications as directed. • Help promote fundraising campaigns through email, social media, and the website. • Track basic campaign results and provide reports to the Executive Director. • Help maintain consistent communication with donors throughout the year. 6. Website Email & Customer Communication • Monitor organizational website email inquiries. • Respond to routine questions in a timely and professional manner. • Forward specialized or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate staff member. • Track inquiries requiring follow-up. • Ensure that website inquiries do not go unanswered. • Maintain professional and compassionate communication with clients, donors, partners, and community members. 7. Annual Event Support Assist the Executive Director and team with planning and organizing the organization's annual event. Responsibilities may include: • Maintaining an event planning checklist and timeline. • Contacting potential sponsors. • Sending sponsorship information and follow-up communications. • Following up with potential sponsors. • Maintaining a sponsor and participant tracking list. • Recruiting event participants, vendors, community partners, and supporters. • Sending invitations and event communications. • Creating event flyers and promotional materials. • Assisting with registration and participant communications. • Coordinating administrative details leading up to the event. • Maintaining sponsor commitments and documentation. • Assisting with post-event follow-up and acknowledgments. 8. Insurance & Organizational Records • Help maintain current organizational insurance documentation. • Organize insurance certificates, policies, renewal information, and related records. • Maintain a calendar of insurance renewal dates. • Notify the Executive Director of upcoming renewals or missing documentation. • Request updated certificates or documents when authorized. • Keep insurance files organized and easily accessible. Note: The employee will maintain and organize insurance records but will not make insurance coverage decisions or provide insurance advice. 9. Graphic Design & Staff Support • Create professional flyers for programs, events, staff announcements, and community outreach. • Create basic promotional materials and informational handouts. • Create labels, signs, certificates, forms, and other materials requested by staff. • Maintain consistency with organizational branding. • Assist staff with basic design needs using Canva or similar design software. 10. YouTube & Video Content • Create and edit videos for the organization's YouTube channels. • Develop basic video graphics, titles, thumbnails, and descriptions. • Upload and schedule videos. • Add appropriate tags, descriptions, and links. • Repurpose existing organizational content into short-form video when appropriate. • Maintain an organized YouTube content calendar. • Monitor basic YouTube analytics and report significant trends to the Executive Director. Familiarity with Claude, Eleven Labs, CapCut, etc., preferred. 11. Grant Reporting • Maintain a calendar of quarterly and other grant-reporting deadlines. • Gather required program information, statistics, accomplishments, and supporting documentation from staff. • Organize information needed for grant reports. • Complete routine quarterly grant reports using information provided by program staff and the Executive Director. • Maintain copies of submitted reports and supporting documentation. • Track reporting deadlines and notify the Executive Director in advance of upcoming deadlines. • Follow up with staff when required information is missing. • Ensure reports are submitted on time after required internal review and approval. Success in this position means the Executive Director can confidently delegate administrative and operational responsibilities and know that they will be completed without repeated reminders. The successful employee will help the organization: • Stay organized • Respond to clients promptly • Maintain accurate donor and client records • Keep marketing and communications consistent • Increase donor engagement • Maintain an active online presence • Prepare for events efficiently • Keep important organizational documents current • Meet grant-reporting deadlines • Reduce the administrative workload on the Executive Director

description: Type: Full-time, long-term Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month retainer + leaderboard performance bonuses Hours: ~40/week, Monday–Friday (weekends optional but encouraged) Location: Fully remote ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT THIS IS ------------------------------------------------------------ I'm hiring a direct response video editor to join our creative team. You'd come in as an editor — but I do need someone who already has solid experience and a strong skillset, not a beginner. Full-time and long-term for the right person, not a one-off gig. ------------------------------------------------------------ ABOUT US ------------------------------------------------------------ You'll be working with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling hard in the US market. We run a huge creative team that ships a high volume of paid ad creatives every week, and we spend serious money on ads — so the work you make actually goes out and gets tested at scale. You'll see real numbers on your edits, not just upload and forget. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO I'M LOOKING FOR ------------------------------------------------------------ A direct response editor who makes ads built to perform, not just look nice. If you've only ever done pretty edits with no understanding of what makes an ad convert, this probably isn't for you. You should be able to cut these ad styles confidently: - AI UGC ads - Voiceover + b-roll style ads - Greenscreen / AI avatar style - Claymation / Pixar / 3D animation style - Podcast-style ads - And honestly, whatever style is winning right now You'll be making a high volume of AI-generated creative — AI UGC, claymation, Pixar-style, podcast ads, avatars, and more — so you need to be genuinely comfortable producing and blending AI generative assets into ads that convert. ------------------------------------------------------------ THE ACTUAL EDITING SKILLS YOU NEED ------------------------------------------------------------ This is the part people usually leave vague, so let me be specific. Day to day, you'll need to be genuinely good at: HOOKS & RETENTION EDITING You understand the first 3 seconds make or break an ad. You know how to open strong, hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts, and pacing, and keep someone watching to the CTA. PACING & RHYTHM You cut to the energy of the voiceover/script — tight where it needs to be, never letting a clip drag. Your edits feel fast and snappy without being messy. STORYTELLING TO A SCRIPT You can take a VO or ad script and build the visual story around it: matching b-roll, on-screen text, and beats to what's being said so the message actually lands. B-ROLL SOURCING & SEQUENCING You know how to find (or generate) the right supporting footage and place it so it reinforces the message, not just fills space. CAPTIONS & ON-SCREEN TEXT Clean, readable, well-timed subtitles and kinetic text — styled to match the brand, synced properly, and used to drive retention (not just slapped on). SOUND DESIGN Music selection that fits the mood, proper audio leveling, SFX and "whooshes" on transitions, ducking music under VO. Bad audio kills good visuals. BASIC MOTION GRAPHICS & TEXT ANIMATION Simple, clean animated text, callouts, highlights, and transitions that look professional. COLOR & CLEANUP Basic correction so clips match and look consistent, plus a clean, polished finish (no jarring cuts, no random aspect-ratio jumps). AI GENERATION You can actually prompt and produce usable assets — AI UGC clips, claymation, Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images — and blend them into a real ad so it doesn't look obviously AI. ORGANIZATION Named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines. You make it easy for the team to work with you. ------------------------------------------------------------ TOOLS YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW ------------------------------------------------------------ CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, Veo 3, Nano Banana, Higgsfield — and whatever else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every single week and I need someone who actually keeps up, not someone I have to drag along. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU'LL OWN (KPIs) ------------------------------------------------------------ DAILY OUTPUT: 2 high-quality ad creatives per day, following our scripts and styles. 70% FIRST-PASS APPROVAL RATE: At least 7 out of 10 of your submissions should require no revisions — meaning they match the brief and are ready to test. AVAILABILITY: Online and responsive Monday–Friday. Weekends are optional but encouraged for the people who want to climb the leaderboard faster. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT MATTERS MOST (BEYOND THE SKILLS) ------------------------------------------------------------ - DTC experience is a must. You've already worked with one or more DTC / ecom brands — this is non-negotiable. Show me the work. - You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop. - Mindset — this is the big one. Coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, and the type who tries to overdeliver instead of doing the bare minimum. You don't have to be perfect on day one. But you should be good enough to hit the ground running and hungry enough to keep leveling up. We've got a head editor who'll guide you on frameworks, hook structures, and what actually makes an ad win — so this is a genuine chance to learn ecom and direct response from the inside while getting paid well to do it. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION ------------------------------------------------------------ Base retainer: $1,000–$1,500/month, depending on your skill level and experience. Retainers go up over time as your skills grow and you take on more responsibility. Leaderboard bonuses — on top of your retainer. Here's how it works: the editor with the highest number of winning ads gets first place, and so on. The whole team is ranked on a leaderboard each month, and the top 5 editors get paid bonuses on top of their base. The better your creatives perform, the higher you climb, the more you earn. ???? 1st place: $[500] ???? 2nd place: $[400] ???? 3rd place: $[300] 4?? 4th place: $[200] 5?? 5th place: $[100] We spend at a scale where this adds up to real money for editors who consistently ship winners. The leaderboard isn't just for show — it's there so the people putting in the work actually get rewarded for it. ------------------------------------------------------------ THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF ------------------------------------------------------------ - You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response. If you can't explain why a hook works or what makes an ad convert, this isn't the role. - You need hand-holding. You'll get guidance and frameworks from our head editor, but you're expected to manage your own workload, hit deadlines, and solve problems without constant check-ins. - You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things. Our stack changes weekly. If a new AI tool drops and the team adopts it overnight, you need to pivot without frustration. - You see this as "just a job." The people who win here are genuinely into short-form, AI creative, and direct response — and want to grow with a fast-scaling brand, not clock in and out. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY ------------------------------------------------------------ In your proposal, include: - The Names of the previous Ecom Brands/Companies you have edited for - A short description of your current skillset. - A few examples of past ad creative work (UGC, voiceover, animation — whatever you've got) to back it up, including the DTC brand(s) you've worked with. Then answer these questions: 1. Pick one ad creative you've made that performed well. Break down WHY it worked from a direct-response angle — the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, or any specific editing choice that drove the result. 2. Tell me about a creative that underperformed. How did you use the performance data to figure out why, what did you change in the next version, and what happened? 3. Walk me through how you produce AI UGC or generative ads (claymation, Pixar, podcast, avatar, etc.) so they don't look obviously AI. What's your process and which tools do you reach for? 4. This role is high-volume — 2 creatives a day. Describe your experience working at that kind of pace and how you keep quality high while moving fast. Include the code word 'ScaleMode' somewhere in your application. I only review applications that include it — it tells me you actually read the post and pay attention to detail. Then submit the trial task after you send your proposal. That's it. Looking forward to seeing what you can do.

title: Blog Production Specialist
description: Kova Team manages SEO and content programs for a portfolio of roughly 20 clients, primarily in home services, construction, restoration, roofing, fencing, and remodeling, along with several professional-services accounts. We are hiring a Blog Production Specialist to support the execution of our blog program. Content plans and keyword research are completed before the work reaches you, and our blog system automates much of the drafting and editing. Your responsibility is to run that system correctly for each client, apply careful human judgment where automation falls short, and ensure every published article is accurate, on-brand, correctly dated, and appropriately illustrated. This is a production and quality-assurance position rather than a creative writing position. You will work closely with the owner, who remains accountable for the overall program, and will coordinate day to day with our virtual assistants. All work is tracked and communicated through ClickUp. Scope and onboarding You will not be handed the full portfolio on day one. New specialists begin with a small number of clients and receive direct support while learning the system, the clients, and our quality standards. As you become confident in the process, additional clients are added until you are supporting the full portfolio. Once you are up to speed, the owner shifts into a check-in and oversight role while you manage the day-to-day flow of the blog system and coordinate the virtual assistants responsible for images. Core responsibilities Article setup and generation Enter the assigned keyword and keyword title from the client's content plan into the blog system so the tool has the appropriate context and H1, then generate the draft. Draft review Review every article before it moves forward, confirming that it: Reflects the client's documented brand voice Describes only services the client actually offers Contains no competitor names Is accurate and appropriate for the client's market, service area, and customers Client submission Submit the reviewed article to the client for approval through the system. Revisions and verification When a client requests changes, apply them using our AI editing tool, then verify that each requested change was actually implemented. Verification may involve cross-referencing the revision request against the updated article using AI, reviewing it manually, or both. Any missed or partially applied edit should be identified and corrected before the article moves forward. Publishing and scheduling accuracy Publish approved articles to WordPress on their intended dates. Target dates are not always displayed accurately, so you will review the live site, identify which dates have already been filled, and determine where each article belongs. Articles that have passed their scheduled date should be backdated to that date rather than published on the current date, so that each client's blog reflects a consistent and deliberate publishing cadence. Image coordination After publishing, our virtual assistants add images. You are responsible for ensuring this is completed promptly and that the selected images genuinely match the content. For example, an article about flat roofing should not be illustrated with pitched roofs. When an image is not a good fit, provide the VA with clear, specific direction in ClickUp on what is needed and confirm the correction is made. Final review Complete a final pass on copy, images, formatting, and publish date before the article goes live. Volume and cadence Standard clients: 8 articles per month, approximately two per week, spaced roughly every four days Higher-volume clients: 16 articles per month, approximately four per week, spaced roughly every two days Consistency is more important than speed. Articles should land on their scheduled dates rather than in clusters. Tools and communication All task management and day-to-day communication run through ClickUp, including assignments, status updates, questions to the owner, and direction given to virtual assistants. Work should be documented there rather than handled informally, so that anyone reviewing an account can see where each article stands. You will also work in our internal blog system, WordPress, and other client CMS platforms as needed. Trust and system access This role includes access to internal Kova systems and to the back end of client websites. We are looking for someone who treats that access with the seriousness it deserves: careful with changes, honest about mistakes, protective of client data, and reliable. We take this seriously and expect the same in return. Candidates should be comfortable with reference checks and with signing a confidentiality agreement. Qualifications Required Excellent written English, with the ability to recognize awkward phrasing, factual inconsistencies, and off-brand tone without being prompted Strong, sustained attention to detail across repetitive work Sound judgment and problem-solving instincts: the ability to notice when something is missing, incorrect, or illogical, and to resolve it rather than pass it along Comfort with structured, administrative, process-driven work Clear and direct communication in ClickUp, including the ability to give specific, actionable feedback to virtual assistants Availability with Pacific Time business hours: 9am - 5pm PST Dependable self-management in a remote role with recurring deadlines Demonstrated trustworthiness and discretion Preferred Experience in copywriting or SEO blog content Hands-on experience with WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot, or comparable CMS platforms Familiarity with AI writing and editing tools Experience with ClickUp or a comparable project management platform Prior agency or multi-client experience About the nature of the work We want to set accurate expectations. This role follows the same defined process repeatedly, across many clients, every month. You will not be writing articles from scratch or setting creative direction. The value of the position lies in consistency, accuracy, and the judgment to catch what an automated system would otherwise miss. Candidates who find satisfaction in well-run, dependable processes tend to do very well in this role.

title: GCLID tracking setup for my ads
job_title: GCLID tracking setup for my ads
description: # Google Ads Conversion Tracking Specialist — GCLID / ServiceM8 / n8n **Type:** Project-based (with potential ongoing retainer for maintenance) **Location:** Remote, Philippines preferred **Client:** Laserline Tiling Ltd — tiling & waterproofing contractor, Christchurch, New Zealand ## The Problem We Need Solved Right now, Google Ads counts a "conversion" the moment someone submits a form on our website. But a form submission isn't a sale — some of those leads turn into real, paid tiling jobs, and some go nowhere. Google Ads currently can't tell the difference, which means our ad spend is being optimized toward *form fills*, not *real customers*. We need someone to build (and verify end-to-end) a pipeline that: 1. Captures the Google Click ID (GCLID) when someone clicks our ad and lands on our site 2. Passes that GCLID through to the job record in **ServiceM8** (our job management system) 3. Tracks that job through to a real outcome (quoted, won, lost) 4. Automatically reports **won jobs** back to Google Ads as offline conversions — so Google starts optimizing toward actual paying customers, not just enquiries Our automation layer is **n8n**, already linked to ServiceM8. There is a partially-built pipeline using ---------- that may be scrapped or migrated — you'll assess and recommend. ## Scope of Work 1. **Audit the website form** — confirm the hidden GCLID field correctly captures the parameter from the ad click and isn't dropped on submission (flagged as a known risk with our current CMS setup). 2. **Verify GCLID reaches ServiceM8** — confirm it's correctly attached to the job/quote record via API or webhook. 3. **Build the n8n workflow** that: - Monitors job status changes in ServiceM8 (Quote Sent → Won / Lost / Completed) - Matches the outcome to the stored GCLID - Formats and uploads the conversion (GCLID, conversion action, value, date) to Google Ads via the **Offline Conversion Import** API on an appropriate schedule 4. **Test end-to-end** with real test leads to confirm conversions appear correctly in Google Ads, attributed to the right keyword and campaign. 5. **Document the finished workflow** — a plain-English walkthrough plus a simple diagram, so our team can troubleshoot without you. 6. **Recommend and implement** whether to repair the existing ---------- piece or rebuild fully in n8n, given ServiceM8 is already integrated there. ## Must-Have Skills - Demonstrated experience with the **Google Ads API / Offline Conversion Import (OCI)** — please share a specific example or portfolio piece - Strong **n8n** workflow-building experience - Comfortable reading/writing to the **ServiceM8 API** or webhooks - Working knowledge of **Google Tag Manager / JavaScript** for GCLID capture on web forms - Clear written English and async communication — you'll be working with a NZ-based owner (Christchurch, GMT+12) with limited overlap hours ## Nice to Have - Experience with Google Ads Enhanced Conversions - Prior work with home service / trade businesses - Familiarity with ClickUp for documentation handoff - Experience with ---------- (to help assess/migrate the existing partial build) ## Deliverables - A verified, working GCLID → ServiceM8 → n8n → Google Ads pipeline, tested with real data - Written documentation covering how it works and how to troubleshoot common failures - A short screen-recorded walkthrough (Loom or similar) of the finished workflow ## How to Apply Please include: 1. A specific example of an offline conversion import or similar Google Ads API integration you've built (screenshot, Loom, or GitHub link) 2. A short Loom walkthrough of an n8n workflow you've built previously 3. Your estimate of hours/timeline to complete this scope 4. Your hourly or fixed-project rate --- *Note: rate/budget range and expected hours are intentionally left open above — fill in before posting based on what you're willing to pay.*

description: THE JOB We are looking for an elite outbound sales hunter / appointment setter whose primary responsibility is simple: Create conversations with qualified eCommerce brands and book meetings with decision-makers. This is NOT customer service. This is NOT account management. This is NOT a role where you wait for inbound leads. You will be expected to hunt every day. We provide the technology, CRM, prospecting tools, data, email infrastructure, sales collateral, and executive team. Your job is to turn those resources into qualified meetings. If you are excellent at researching companies, finding the right executives, cold calling, emailing, following up relentlessly, and getting legitimate prospects onto a calendar, we want to hear from you. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build targeted prospect lists of qualified eCommerce brands Identify the actual decision-makers within those companies Research prospects before outreach Cold call aggressively Run high-volume, targeted outbound email Use LinkedIn and other channels to reach executives Create and execute multi-touch outbound sequences Follow up repeatedly instead of giving up after one or two attempts Reactivate dormant leads and old opportunities Identify trigger events that create potential sales opportunities Qualify prospects sufficiently to determine whether a meeting is worthwhile Book the meeting Once a legitimate opportunity is identified, you hand it over to the sales team. You are not responsible for running discovery calls, preparing pricing, designing solutions, or closing contracts. Your job is to create the opportunity. YOUR #1 KPI Qualified Meetings Held. Not emails sent. Not LinkedIn connections. Not names added to a spreadsheet. We care about qualified prospects who actually attend meetings with our sales leadership. A qualified meeting means a legitimate eCommerce business with a plausible current or upcoming logistics/fulfillment requirement and the appropriate decision-maker or strong influencer attending. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We want someone who has demonstrated that they can hunt and personally create pipeline from nothing. Experience prospecting or selling into any of the following is especially valuable: 3PL / fulfillment Logistics eCommerce Amazon ecosystem Supply chain SaaS serving eCommerce brands Freight / parcel Warehousing eCommerce agencies or services Direct 3PL experience is highly desirable. We're much less interested in impressive job titles than in what you personally produced. Be prepared to tell us: - How many cold calls you made - How many meetings you personally booked - Your meeting conversion rate - Who you prospected - How you found prospects - What tools you used - What your cold-call opener sounds like TOOLS You should be comfortable with modern outbound technology such as: - HubSpot or comparable CRM - LinkedIn Sales Navigator - Apollo / ZoomInfo or similar prospecting databases - Email sequencing and automation platforms - AI research and writing tools - Google Workspace - Dialers / VoIP systems You don't need to know every platform, but you should be able to learn new technology quickly. COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS Exceptional spoken and written English is mandatory. You will represent a U.S.-based company and speak directly with founders, CEOs, COOs, and senior supply-chain executives. You must be confident on the phone, think quickly when someone answers, and communicate professionally with senior U.S. business leaders. WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE Competitive. Resourceful. Persistent. Curious. Organized. Coachable. Tech-savvy. Unafraid of rejection. Most importantly: you genuinely enjoy hunting. You don't need someone to hand you a list of warm leads every morning. You enjoy figuring out which companies to target, who the right person is, how to reach them, and what will get them to respond. When emailing your application, use a subject line with your full name, and make sure the subject line start with Flibbertigibbet. COMPENSATION $1,500/month base salary + generous performance-based commission. You'll earn additional compensation for qualified meetings held, with further upside tied to opportunities and resulting sales. This is a production-driven role designed to meaningfully reward people who perform. Strong performers can earn $2,500–$3,500/month, with $4,000+ months possible for exceptional performers. If you consistently create legitimate sales opportunities, your earning potential should reflect it. HOW TO APPLY To be considered, you must email your application to ---------- submitted only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed. REQUIRED: Include a link to a 60–90 second voice or video introduction using Vocaroo or Google Drive. In your recording, briefly: Introduce yourself Describe your outbound sales experience Tell us why you're a strong fit for a high-performance hunting role To strengthen your application, we also encourage you to include: - The types of companies you've previously prospected - Your historical outbound activity and meeting-booking numbers - A cold email you personally wrote that generated meetings - Your cold-call opener for a VP of Supply Chain at an eCommerce brand - The prospecting and sales tools you know well These additional items are not mandatory, but candidates who demonstrate measurable outbound performance will receive stronger consideration. We're interested in what you've personally produced—not a generic cover letter.

title: After Effects Motion Designer-— Short-Form Social Content
job_title: After Effects Motion Designer-— Short-Form Social Content
description: After Effects Motion Designer — Short-Form Social Content Paid Per Project to start and could evolve to Paid Monthly Per Client *IMPORTANT:* We understand that CapCut is an accessible and increasingly popular tool for short-form content. However, we are specifically looking for an After Effects-first motion designer. If CapCut is your primary program for creating motion graphics, this position probably isn't the right fit. Templates, plugins, presets, and other tools can absolutely be part of your workflow, but we're looking for someone capable of designing and animating intentionally rather than relying primarily on pre-built templates. We are looking for a skilled Motion Designer who specializes in Adobe After Effects to work with us on an ongoing freelance basis, primarily creating motion graphics, typography, captions, and visual assets for short-form social content. This is not a video editing position. Our editors handle the core edit. Your role is to take detailed creative briefs and provided assets and bring specific moments of the video to life through motion design. Depending on the project, your work may include: Animated typography Captions and subtitles Titles and text treatments Image and photo animations Motion graphics Masks and compositing Custom assets designed to support the edit Some videos may require just caption design. Others may combine captions, typography, imagery, graphics, and more involved animation. We will typically provide the creative brief, copy/captions, images, brand assets, backgrounds, fonts, and overall visual direction. Your responsibility is to execute that direction at a high level while also bringing your own design judgment to the work. Our work generally leans premium, modern, editorial, minimal, and intentional. We're looking for someone who understands that good motion design isn't about making everything move. It's about knowing what should move, how it should move, and when restraint creates a stronger result. You should have a strong understanding of: Typography and hierarchy Composition Spacing Scale Visual rhythm Animation timing Pacing Brand consistency Clean, intentional transitions Motion / Animation References These examples aren't meant to be replicated exactly, but they provide a general reference for the level of motion we're looking for: [Instagram reference] ---------- [Instagram reference] ---------- Caption + Title Inspiration [Instagram reference] ---------- Each client and project will have its own visual system and creative brief. Requirements Adobe After Effects must be your primary motion-design tool. We're looking for someone who: Is highly proficient in Adobe After Effects Has experience designing specifically for short-form / 9:16 content Has a strong understanding of typography and typographic hierarchy Has excellent visual composition and design instincts Understands premium, modern, editorial, and minimalist visual design Can follow detailed creative briefs accurately Can work within established brand guidelines Is comfortable receiving and implementing feedback Can take an existing concept and creatively improve it **without abandoning the original direction** Understands how motion graphics interact with video editing Can organize and deliver clean project/source files Communicates clearly and proactively Has strong time-management skills Can consistently meet agreed-upon deadlines Life happens, and we understand that occasionally something unexpected can affect a deadline. What matters to us is that delays are RARE and communicated proactively rather than after a deadline has already been missed. Projects will generally look something like: Creative brief → Assets provided → Motion design → Review/revisions → Final asset delivery Depending on the project, final delivery may include rendered assets for our editor as well as organized After Effects project files. For animations requiring transparency, you should be comfortable delivering appropriate formats such as ProRes 4444 with alpha. Projects are paid per project, with pricing agreed upon before work begins. For the right person, our goal is to build an ongoing working relationship and consistently send projects rather than hire for a single project. Application Please include: 1. Your portfolio or 3–5 examples of work most relevant to this position 2. Your general availability and turn around times Please do not send only a general video-editing reel. We specifically want to see your ability as a motion designer. Test Project Finalists may be asked to complete a small test project based on one of our creative briefs. The purpose of the test is to evaluate: Your ability to follow a creative brief Design judgment Typography Motion Attention to detail Communication Ability to deliver within an agreed timeline The test should be submitted **watermarked** and will not be used unless paid for. Please only apply if you're confident that your experience and portfolio align with the requirements above. We're looking for someone who can take strong creative direction, execute it precisely, and then use their own creative judgment to make the final result even better.

title: Executive / Personal Assistant to Busy Entrepreneur (Long-Term, High Trust Role)
job_title: Executive / Personal Assistant to Busy Entrepreneur (Long-Term, High Trust Role)
description: A busy entrepreneur is looking for a highly capable, reliable Executive/Personal Assistant to support both business operations and personal life. This is a varied, high-responsibility role for someone who is sharp, proactive, and trustworthy — not a repetitive, low-responsibility VA position. Must be available 10AM–6PM PST. About the Role I'm a busy entrepreneur who owns and operates a successful luxury service business, actively searches for additional businesses to acquire, and has a background in real estate investing and management. I work on multiple entrepreneurial projects at once, communicate regularly with business partners, investors, vendors, and other professionals, and also have a full personal life — family, appointments, medical obligations, travel, and other commitments. I'm looking for a true right-hand Executive/Personal Assistant: someone who can manage both my business and personal world, keep me organized and on schedule, and represent me professionally with the people I work with. This is a combination EA + PA role, and the work will vary significantly day to day — this is not a job with the same few repetitive tasks every day. What You'll Do - Manage personal and business calendars; schedule appointments, meetings, calls, reminders, and Zoom meetings - Coordinate and occasionally communicate directly with business partners and investors - Build and maintain investor, networking, acquisition, and contact databases - Support research on potential business acquisitions and other projects - Conduct research, data collection, and maintain spreadsheets as directed - Track projects, deadlines, follow-ups, and priorities, and keep me accountable - Manage inboxes, send emails/texts, and handle follow-ups - Make outbound phone calls when necessary - Book flights, hotels, transportation, and handle travel logistics and reservations - Assist with a wide range of business and personal projects — you'll often need to take incomplete instructions, use good judgment, and figure out how to move things forward independently. Who You'll Be Working With You'll interact directly with business partners, investors, vendors, and other professional contacts on my behalf, so professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment are essential. You'll also be trusted with important business and personal information, so confidentiality matters. Requirements - Strong previous Executive Assistant experience (required); Personal Assistant experience is a major plus - Excellent spoken and written English - Strong organization and attention to detail - High intelligence, judgment, and problem-solving ability - Initiative and resourcefulness — comfortable working independently without constant supervision - Confident and professional on the phone; comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with investors and business professionals - Strong computer, spreadsheet, calendar, email, and internet research skills - Stable employment history - Professionalism, maturity, discretion, and trustworthiness - Genuine interest in a long-term, stable position Availability Must be available and responsive 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday. Reliability and responsiveness are critical to this role — if I call and you can't answer, I expect a prompt callback or message. This is not a fit for anyone who tends to go quiet, miss meetings, respond slowly, or need frequent follow-up to get things done. Why This Role This is intended to become a long-term, trusted working relationship. For the right person, this grows into a genuine right-hand role with real ownership and responsibility — not just task execution. How to Apply Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Please answer the screening questions thoughtfully — generic or low-effort applications will not be considered. Include your resume, a brief note on your EA/PA experience, and if possible, a portfolio or sample of your work (e.g. a sample inbox/email management workflow, a calendar/scheduling system you've used, a spreadsheet or tracker you've built, or a brief write-up of your process for managing someone's schedule and communications). This helps us see how you actually work, not just what you say you can do. Screening Questions - Describe your most significant Executive Assistant or Personal Assistant experience — what did you manage, and for whom? - This role requires availability from 10 AM–6 PM PST. Can you confirm you can consistently work these hours? - Describe a time you had to complete a task with incomplete or unclear instructions. How did you handle it? - This role includes making and taking phone calls with investors, partners, and vendors. How comfortable are you with phone-based communication, and can you give an example? - Tell us about a time you had to juggle multiple priorities or deadlines at once. How did you stay organized? - Why are you looking for a long-term position, and what does that mean to you? - What is your current work situation, and how soon could you start if selected? Thank you for taking the time to apply, I look forward to meeting you.

title: Bookkeeper
description: About School Psych AI School Psych AI is a bootstrapped EdTech company serving school psychologists, special educators, and related service providers across the country. We run on Stripe for subscription revenue, Gusto for payroll, QuickBooks Online for accounting, and we sell to school districts on purchase orders with real procurement timelines. About the Role We need a bookkeeper who will get our books accurate and keep them that way. Right now our QuickBooks does not tie to our bank. Balances are off, credit card accounts are misstated, deposits are uncategorized, and our P&L cannot be trusted for decision-making or for a lender. Your first job is cleanup. Your ongoing job is making sure it never drifts again. This is not a role where you wait for instructions. We are looking for someone who spots the discrepancy before we do and tells us plainly what they found. What You'll Do Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts monthly, and clean up historical periods that were never properly reconciled Categorize transactions correctly and consistently, including Stripe deposits, payouts, and fees Maintain accurate accounts receivable for district contracts, invoices sent, and payments collected Track and record our line of credit activity, including draws, weekly repayments, fees, and interest Record payroll from Gusto correctly, including taxes, benefits, and contractor payments Produce a monthly close package: profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow, delivered on a set schedule Flag discrepancies, unusual charges, and anything that does not reconcile, without waiting to be asked Prepare clean, lender-ready financials when we need them Coordinate with our CPA at tax time Who We're Looking For You are meticulous. Numbers either tie or they do not, and you do not move on until they do. You communicate clearly in plain language. We need someone who can tell a non-accountant founder what a number means and why it changed, without jargon and without burying the point. You raise issues early. If cash is trending in a direction we should know about, or something looks miscategorized, you say so before it becomes a problem. You work independently. This is remote, part-time, and largely self-directed. You will own the close calendar and hold yourself to it.

title: Data Entry & Verification Virtual Assistant
description: We are a US-based hospitality technology company. We work with restaurants and the people who send them new guests. When a guest we referred completes a visit, we pay the person who sent them. Getting that right depends on confirming, every day, which referred guests actually showed up. That confirmation is this job. In one sentence: you take our daily list of referred guests and confirm each one against the restaurants' reservation records, carefully, by hand. What you will do each day You receive a list of referred guests, typically 50 to 150 per day. Each line has a guest's name, email and/or phone number, the restaurant, and the expected visit date. You log in to the restaurant guest-management dashboard we give you access to. It is a normal web application with a search box. You search for each guest by name, email, or phone, open the matching guest record, and find the reservation for that restaurant and date. You record the result in our tracking sheet: found or not found, the reservation ID, date and time, party size, status (reserved, seated, cancelled, or no-show), and any notes on the record. When a match is uncertain, for example two guests with the same name, a date one day off, or a partial phone number, you mark it "needs review" and write one line explaining why. You do not guess. You finish the day's list before 9:00 am US Central time so our team starts the day with the results. Rules of the work You look up only the guests on the list. You do not browse, download, or export other guests or reservations. All work is done by hand: no scripts, browser extensions, macros, or automation of any kind. This is a person reading a screen and typing what they see. Guest information goes only into the tracking sheet we provide. No copies, no screenshots shared outside our workspace, no personal notes. You will sign a confidentiality agreement. Accuracy matters more than speed. A wrong reservation ID or status costs us money and trust. We would rather have 80 correct lookups than 120 fast ones. Who does well in this role You have done data verification, QA, back-office, or reconciliation work and can show it. You are precise. Matching a phone number written three different ways to one guest is a normal part of the job. Your written English is clear, because your "needs review" notes have to make sense to someone who was not there. You have a reliable computer, stable internet, and a quiet place to work. Experience with restaurant reservation software such as OpenTable, Resy, SevenRooms, or Tock, or hospitality front-desk work, is a plus but not required. Hours and pay About 3 to 4 hours per day, 5 to 6 days a week, on a schedule that finishes before 9:00 am US Central, which is evening or early morning in the Philippines. Hourly rate: [RATE], paid [weekly / twice monthly] via [platform]. Independent contractor. Long-term if the trial goes well. This is daily work that does not go away. How we hire Reply with a few sentences on your relevant experience and one example of a time you caught a data error someone else missed. Then a paid trial: 20 lookups on a test list, with a clear rubric. We check every one. If your accuracy is 95% or better and your review notes are clear, we start the regular schedule. We are a small team. You will work directly with the person who owns this process, get answers the same day, and see your work matter.

description: # Job Description: Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist (Remote – Philippines) **Company:** KangaCare Group **Location:** Remote (Philippines-based) **Type:** Full-time / Part-time (specify hours e.g. 20-40 hrs/week, AEST-overlap preferred) **Industry:** NDIS Disability Support Services (Melbourne, Australia) ## About KangaCare Group KangaCare Group is a Melbourne-based NDIS-registered provider delivering day programs, complex care, and Supported Independent Living (SIL) services across Melbourne's north. We're growing fast and need a marketing specialist who can build our social presence, run email marketing, and keep our brand consistently visible and professional across every channel. ## Role Overview We're looking for an experienced Social Media, Email Marketing & Advertising Specialist to plan, create, and manage content across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, run monthly email newsletters, and execute paid ad campaigns that generate real enquiries (day program referrals, SIL leads, support coordinator relationships). This is not an entry-level role — we need someone who has already run campaigns that worked, can maintain a consistent brand identity, and can prove results. ## Trial Period This role begins with a **2-week paid trial** before any ongoing engagement is confirmed. During the trial, you will be asked to deliver: - A 2-week social media content calendar (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) that reflects a consistent brand theme. - One draft newsletter, ready to send, including subject line options. - One test ad campaign plan (objective, targeting, budget, creative concept) for either Meta or TikTok Ads. - Daily or every-second-day check-ins so we can assess communication and reliability, not just output quality. Performance during the trial (quality, consistency, communication, and ability to meet deadlines) determines whether the engagement continues on an ongoing monthly or hourly basis. Trial work is paid at [insert trial rate] regardless of outcome. ## Key Responsibilities ### Social Media - Plan and schedule content 2-3 weeks in advance across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook so we're never scrambling for posts. - Create engaging content (photos, short-form video/reels, captions, graphics) that reflects a consistent, professional brand theme — same colour palette, fonts, tone of voice, and visual style across every platform and every post. - Maintain and evolve a brand style guide/content template system so anyone reviewing our feed instantly recognises KangaCare's identity. - Respond to or flag comments/DMs for follow-up, and support community engagement. ### Email Marketing - Plan and send a monthly newsletter to participants, families, referrers, and support coordinators. - Build and manage an email campaign calendar at least 3 cycles (3 months) in advance, so content, offers, and sends are never last-minute. - Write and design newsletters using an email platform (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, or similar), including subject line testing, segmentation, and performance tracking (open rate, click rate, conversions). - Grow and maintain the email list ethically and in compliance with Australian spam/privacy regulations. ### Paid Advertising & Campaigns - Plan, launch, and optimise paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) targeting NDIS participants, families, and support coordinators — with clear budget, targeting, and performance tracking. - Design campaigns that generate genuine interest and measurable leads, not just vanity metrics (likes/follows) — cost-per-lead and conversion tracking are essential. - Monitor and report on all campaign performance (social + email + ads) weekly, with clear recommendations for what to scale or cut. ### General - Develop and maintain a master content/campaign calendar covering social, email, and ads together so all channels stay aligned and consistent. - Coordinate with our team for photos/videos/testimonials from programs and SIL homes. - Stay current on platform algorithm changes and trends relevant to service-based/healthcare marketing. ## Requirements - Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts for a business (not personal accounts). - Proven experience running email marketing/newsletter campaigns — must be able to show past newsletters and performance metrics. - Proven track record running paid ad campaigns with measurable results — must be able to share case studies, screenshots, or metrics from past campaigns. - Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook content formats, algorithms, and best practices (reels, trends, hashtags, posting times). - Demonstrated ability to build and maintain a consistent, professional brand identity across multiple channels — not just individually good posts, but a cohesive overall look and voice. - Content creation skills — basic photo/video editing (Canva, CapCut, Adobe tools, or similar). - Excellent written English for captions, ad copy, email copy, and community responses. - Experience with a content calendar/scheduling tool (Later, Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, etc.) and an email platform (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or similar). - Ability to work independently, plan well ahead of deadlines, and communicate proactively (daily/weekly check-ins). - **Highly desirable:** previous experience marketing for an NDIS provider, disability service, aged care, or healthcare/community services business. - Bonus: experience with Canva templates, brand kits, or basic graphic design. ## What to Include in Your Application - Links to social media accounts/pages you've managed (with your role clearly stated) — ideally showing a consistent visual theme across the feed. - Sample newsletters or email campaigns you've built, with open/click rate results if available. - Examples of ad campaigns you've run, including approximate budget, objective, and results (leads, CPL, ROAS, engagement). - A short mock plan showing: 1 week of social content + 1 newsletter concept + 1 ad campaign idea, all following a single consistent theme, for an NDIS-style service business. - Your availability (hours/week) and timezone overlap with AEST. - If applicable, details of any NDIS, disability services, or healthcare marketing experience.

title: Property Management Virtual Assistant (Australian Property Management is a MUST)
job_title: Property Management Virtual Assistant (Australian Property Management is a MUST)
description: We are looking for an experienced Property Management Virtual Assistant to provide administrative and operational support to Australian real estate agencies. The role will involve supporting the day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial property portfolios, including property and tenancy onboarding, maintenance coordination, arrears, invoicing, compliance, inspections, and general property administration. This is a phone-facing role, so clear and easily understood spoken English is essential. You will communicate with tenants, landlords, property owners, tradespeople, and other relevant parties while helping ensure that all property management tasks are completed accurately and on time. We are particularly looking for candidates with Australian property management experience, ideally those who have managed or supported a residential rent roll and/or commercial property portfolio. Experience using Console (Reapit) is strongly preferred and may be a key requirement. Key Responsibilities Property & Tenancy Administration Assist with onboarding new properties into the property management system. Set up and maintain property, owner, and tenant profiles. Upload, organise, and maintain tenancy and property documentation. Ensure records are complete, accurate, and easily accessible. Assist with lease renewals, rent reviews, and tenancy administration. Maintain accurate property and tenancy records throughout the management lifecycle. Arrears & Tenancy Management Run and monitor rent and water arrears. Follow up tenants regarding outstanding payments. Prepare breach notices and other tenancy-related documentation where required. Assist with tribunal applications and case management. Track important dates, notice periods, and tenancy requirements accurately. Ensure tasks are completed in line with relevant Australian tenancy legislation and client procedures. Maintenance Coordination Receive and log maintenance requests from tenants via phone, email, text, or maintenance portals. Review maintenance requests and record all relevant information. Liaise with property owners regarding quotes, approvals, and next steps. Obtain quotes and issue or assist with work orders. Coordinate with tradespeople and contractors. Follow up outstanding maintenance jobs through to completion. Ensure completion invoices are received, uploaded, and allocated correctly. Keep property management records updated throughout the maintenance process. Routine Inspections & Compliance Schedule, notify, and reschedule routine inspections. Prepare and send inspection notices within the required timeframes. Maintain inspection-related documentation. Track compliance due dates and required certificates. Monitor and maintain records for: Smoke alarm compliance Water efficiency compliance Pool compliance Other legislative or property-specific requirements Contact trades or service providers to arrange inspections, servicing, or recertification. Ensure compliance documentation is accurately saved and readily available. Accounts & Financial Administration Process rent receipts and reconcile transactions. Enter and manage maintenance invoices and other property-related expenses. Process invoices for council rates, water rates, levies, land tax, and other payables. Raise tenant invoices where required. Monitor due dates and outstanding invoices. Maintain accurate and organised financial records. Attach and file invoices and receipts appropriately. Support property accounting and financial administration using Xero and property management software. Note: The role will not require access to bank logins. Financial tasks will be completed through approved accounting and property management systems only. Communication & General Administration Manage and triage emails and inbox enquiries. Take and screen phone calls from tenants, landlords, property owners, trades, and other stakeholders. Respond to general enquiries professionally and efficiently. Maintain shared task lists and ensure follow-ups are completed. Prepare reports and provide updates to the Property Manager or Business Owner. Send a brief end-of-day report outlining completed tasks, outstanding items, and required follow-ups. Assist with general document management, filing, and workflow improvements. Support ad hoc property management and administrative tasks as required. Light Marketing Support Create simple Canva graphics when required. Assist with basic social media or website updates. Support general marketing and administrative tasks as needed. What We're Looking For Previous experience as a Property Management VA, Property Manager, Assistant Property Manager, Property Administrator, or Leasing/Property Management Support professional. Australian property management experience is essential. Experience supporting or managing an Australian residential rent roll and/or commercial property portfolio. Experience with Console (Reapit) is strongly preferred; experience with other Australian property management platforms may also be considered. Experience supporting a Victorian real estate agency and managing Victorian properties is highly regarded, particularly for commercial property management requirements. Strong understanding of Australian property management processes. Familiarity with Australian residential and/or commercial tenancy legislation, notice periods, and compliance requirements. South Australian tenancy experience is highly regarded for clients managing SA residential properties. Confident using Xero, particularly for receipting, reconciliation, invoice entry, and payables. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when managing dates, notice periods, invoices, and compliance requirements. Clear, professional, and easily understood spoken English is essential. Comfortable handling phone calls and communicating directly with tenants, landlords, owners, tradespeople, and other stakeholders. Highly organised and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities independently. Proactive, reliable, and results-focused. Software Experience Experience with the following is highly desirable: Console / Reapit – strongly preferred Xero Other Australian property management platforms Microsoft Office Google Workspace Canva Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is an experienced Australian Property Management professional or VA who can confidently support a busy property portfolio with minimal supervision. They should be comfortable handling phone calls, tenancy administration, maintenance coordination, arrears, compliance, inspections, and property-related financial administration. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with clear spoken English, strong Australian property management experience, excellent attention to detail, and preferably hands-on experience using Console (Reapit). Application Questions How many years of experience do you have in Australian property management? Have you supported or managed an Australian residential rent roll, commercial property portfolio, or both? Please describe your experience. Have you worked with a Victorian real estate agency or managed properties located in Victoria? Please provide details. Which property management software have you used? Please indicate your level of experience with Console (Reapit). What property management tasks have you personally handled? (e.g., arrears, lease renewals, breach notices, maintenance coordination, inspections, compliance, invoicing, tenant communication, tribunal applications, etc.) Do you have experience using Xero for receipting, reconciliation, invoice entry, or payables? Are you comfortable handling inbound and outbound phone calls with tenants, landlords, property owners, and tradespeople as part of your daily responsibilities? Do you have experience working with Australian tenancy legislation, notice periods, and compliance requirements? If yes, which Australian state or territory have you supported?

title: Social Media & Facebook Community Lead Generation Assistant – Australian Business
job_title: Social Media & Facebook Community Lead Generation Assistant – Australian Business
description: Job Description Social Media & Facebook Community Lead Generation Assistant About the Role We are an Australian business looking for a reliable and proactive Social Media & Facebook Community Lead Generation Assistant to support our growth. This is not a traditional social media role focused only on creating posts. A major part of the role will involve identifying relevant Facebook groups and online communities, monitoring discussions, spotting potential opportunities, engaging appropriately in writing, and helping generate genuine enquiries for the business. The successful applicant will work remotely and report directly to the business owner. This is intended to become a long-term contractor position for the right person. Key Responsibilities Your responsibilities will include: * Creating and scheduling regular social media posts * Helping develop useful and engaging content * Monitoring comments and messages on business social media accounts * Responding to simple written enquiries using approved information and templates * Identifying relevant Facebook groups and online communities * Joining and monitoring appropriate Facebook groups * Reading group rules and ensuring all activity complies with those rules * Identifying posts or discussions where someone may be looking for services relevant to the business * Engaging naturally and professionally in written conversations where appropriate * Avoiding spam, aggressive selling or inappropriate promotion * Passing genuine leads and more complex enquiries to the business owner * Maintaining a simple record of leads and where they came from * Monitoring competitors and relevant industry activity * Identifying businesses announcing closures, changes or other developments that may create opportunities * Providing a short weekly summary of activity, leads and useful market information Facebook Group Research Facebook community engagement will be an important part of this role. You will be expected to: * Search for relevant Facebook groups * Assess whether groups contain genuine potential customers or referral opportunities * Keep a database of useful groups * Record group size, activity level and posting rules * Identify which groups allow business promotion * Monitor relevant conversations regularly * Flag high-quality opportunities quickly The objective is quality rather than simply joining hundreds of groups. Lead Generation You will help identify potential leads through social media and Facebook groups. However, you will not be expected to: * Make sales calls * Speak with potential customers by telephone or video * Provide professional or technical advice * Make commitments on behalf of the business * Handle complaints or sensitive situations independently * Pressure people into using our services Where someone has a genuine enquiry, your role is to make an appropriate initial written response and then refer the enquiry to the business owner. Content You will assist with approximately three to four social media posts each week. Content may include: * Helpful information * Frequently asked questions * Industry updates * Educational posts * Business information * Service explanations * Community-focused content The aim is to build trust and visibility rather than constantly advertise. You should be comfortable using tools such as Canva and social media scheduling platforms. Communication Excellent written English is essential. You must be able to write in a natural, professional and friendly way suitable for an Australian audience. We do not want responses that sound robotic, overly formal or obviously AI-generated. You should also be comfortable following approved scripts and knowing when an enquiry needs to be escalated. Skills and Experience We are looking for someone with experience in some or all of the following: * Social media management * Facebook community engagement * Facebook group research * Lead generation * Content scheduling * Canva * Written customer engagement * Community management * Competitor research * Basic CRM or spreadsheet management Previous experience working with an Australian, UK, US, Canadian or similar English-speaking business would be an advantage. Experience in healthcare, disability, professional services or other regulated industries would also be useful, but is not essential. Personal Attributes The right person will be: * Reliable * Organised * Proactive * Confident using initiative * Comfortable researching independently * Able to follow instructions * Careful with details * Professional in written communication * Able to recognise when something needs to be escalated * Comfortable working without constant supervision We particularly value someone who can identify opportunities rather than simply wait to be given tasks. Reporting You will provide a simple weekly report covering: * Posts published * Facebook groups identified * New groups joined * Relevant conversations found * Leads generated * Enquiries passed to the business owner * Competitor or industry developments identified * Any issues or recommendations Hours Initially, we expect this role to require approximately 10–15 hours per week. Hours may increase as the role and business grow. The role is flexible, although some activity should occur during Australian business hours so that relevant conversations and enquiries can be identified promptly. Long-Term Opportunity We are looking for someone who wants to develop a long-term working relationship. As the business grows, the role may expand into broader digital marketing, community engagement, lead management and market research. Important This role is about genuine community engagement. We are not looking for someone who: * Spams Facebook groups * Sends large numbers of unsolicited messages * Copies and pastes promotional comments everywhere * Buys followers * Uses fake engagement * Makes exaggerated marketing claims We want someone who understands that good social media lead generation comes from being useful, visible, professional and trustworthy.
