job_title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role)
description: READ THIS FIRST This application requires a paid test video. It takes about an hour and I pay $25 USD for it whether or not I hire you. Applications without a test video are deleted unread. Not set aside, not reviewed later - deleted. I've run this post before without the test as a hard requirement and got thirty applications I couldn't tell apart. I'd rather read five real edits than fifty resumes. If that's not something you want to do, no hard feelings, but please don't apply - you'll be spending your time for nothing. INTERVIEWS HAVE ALREADY STARTED. There is no closing date because there doesn't need to be one. I'm reviewing tests as they arrive and interviewing the strong ones the same week. The moment I find the right editor this post comes down. If you're reading this and you want the role, do the test today. Every day you wait is a day the seat is more likely already filled. THE TEST Folder (everything you need for the test is in here): ---------- Inside, you'll find the reference video, the raw footage, and a "Further Directions" file. Read that file before you start. POSITION Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role) TYPE / SALARY Full Time · 5–6 days per week · PH or similar time zone $1,000 USD/month starting, potential for performance bonuses. Raises tied to skill and results. JOB DESCRIPTION I run a TikTok page and produce UGC that consistently reaches large audiences. I'm looking for one editor to take ownership of the editing work alongside me, long term. Success in this role comes down to two things above all else: editing quality and English comprehension. Because of that, this posting is specific about what the work requires, and the application asks for more than a résumé. I'd rather be clear upfront than have either of us discover a mismatch a month in. THE WORK Daily short-form vertical content — mostly talking heads with occasional voiceover/b-roll: Cutting dead space so videos stay paced and never drag Stitching the strongest takes into one seamless piece Adding image overlays on screen to support what's being said Zooms, crops, and reframes to keep the frame dynamic B-roll builds: I provide a voiceover and footage, you find the visual that matches each line Sourcing your own overlay assets — reading the script and independently finding the images it calls for The last two items are the core of the role. The rest is technical work most editors can learn. Choosing the right visual for the right sentence is what separates a video that reaches 4,000 people from one that reaches 4,000,000. SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS This is one of the most important parts of the job, and the part most editors are not set up for. I'll give you background and direction, but I want you fully self-sufficient at finding the visuals a script needs. That means: Reading the script and working out which images the moment actually calls for Finding high-quality, aesthetically strong photos of who/what is being discussed — not the first search result, but the image that looks right on screen Learning the brands I work with well enough to represent them correctly Knowing which parts of a brand's website are worth capturing, and pulling clean screenshots of them Sourcing relevant comments, posts, and screenshots that support the point being made Placing every asset at the right moment in the video, on the beat the script lands on I shouldn't have to send you an image folder for a video to get made. You should be able to take the script and go find what it needs. This requires genuinely understanding English — hearing a sentence and catching the humor, the tone, the reference — because you can't source the right image for a line you don't fully understand. Your English does not need to be perfect. It needs to be strong enough that you follow everything being said and that we can communicate quickly and clearly. Familiarity with internet and pop culture is a significant advantage here, and it's rewarded. EXAMPLES OF THE WORK Please watch all three before applying so you know exactly what you'd be producing. Basic talking head — cutting dead space, piecing clips together, light crops and zooms: ---------- Talking head with overlays — the same, plus supplied images placed on screen: ---------- B-roll — a voiceover with footage matched to it line by line. This is where English comprehension shows most: ---------- WHO I'M LOOKING FOR Strong attention to detail. You catch the frame held a beat too long or the overlay that sits slightly off. This is the most important quality in the role. Self-sufficiency with assets. You can take a script and go find the images it needs without being handed a folder. This is weighted as heavily as your editing. Willingness to go the extra step. Reviewing your own export once more and fixing what wasn't flagged. Strong English comprehension. Understanding is essential; polished speaking and writing is a bonus. Responsive communication. When I message during working hours, I need a reply promptly rather than the following day. Exclusivity. This is a full-time position and I'm looking for someone working with me only — no other clients, agencies, or subcontracting. In return you get stability, a real salary, and an employer invested in your growth. A long-term outlook. I'm hiring someone to grow with my content over years, not to fill a short-term gap. This role likely isn't the right fit if you're applying broadly today, prefer briefs explained in detail more than once, or intend to use AI to write your application answers — I'm looking for your own thinking. REQUIREMENTS Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) CapCut or any software you work quickly in — the output is what matters Confident sourcing your own images, screenshots, and reference material online, with good taste in what looks right on screen Reliable internet and a computer that handles daily editing without issues Available full time, with reasonable overlap with my hours. The volume moves with the content schedule — some weeks run 4–5 days, others run 6–7. I need someone who can flex with it rather than hold to a fixed number of days Able to receive payment via Wise Comfortable receiving direct feedback and applying it the first time PAY AND GROWTH $1,000 USD/month paid through Wise, with potential for performance bonuses. The ceiling on this role sits well above the starting salary — as you learn my style and begin contributing your own ideas, your compensation grows accordingly. You'd be working directly with me each day on videos that have proven to get millions of views. HOW TO APPLY Subject line: EDITOR — [number of the example video above you think is hardest to edit] (For example: EDITOR — 2. Applications that don't follow this format won't be reviewed.) Please include in your message: Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, and what you handled on each. If you worked on only part of a video, please say so — accuracy matters more to me than scope. In your own words, 3–5 sentences, without AI assistance: watch example #3 and describe one editing choice that worked well and one you would have approached differently. There's no right answer — I'm interested in how you evaluate a video. The software you use and how long you've worked in it. Your internet speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal) and your typical available hours in PH time. One sentence on your current work and why you're looking to move. Paid test — $25 USD. Applicants completing the paid test will use the Google Drive folder linked below, which contains the reference video, original voiceover take, raw footage, and further directions. You'll stitch together the strongest takes, match footage to the voiceover, and send back your version. Note that the folder deliberately does not contain every image the script calls for — part of the test is sourcing a few visuals yourself and placing them where you feel they could belong. It should take about an hour. This test is paid $25 USD regardless of the hiring outcome — I don't ask anyone to work unpaid. Google Drive (reference video and source files): ---------- A strong test is followed by a short call, and then a start date. I review every application that follows the instructions above.

description: Who I am I run a licensed property team in Singapore — me and four agents under me. You report to me. Only me. The four agents are people you help. They can tell you what to say to their own leads — their own words, their own templates. That is fine, just show me before you change anything. But your hours, your tasks, your daily list, your pay — that is me. Nobody else. You will never be pulled five ways. I have been hiring Filipino staff for real estate teams for over 8 years. I have 2 full-time Filipino team members with me right now. You will not be my experiment. I pay on time, every time. The problem I need you to fix My team has too many leads. Here is what happens. A person messages one of my agents and says "I'm thinking of upgrading to a better home, but maybe next year." The agent replies. Then the agent forgets them. Six months later they buy a home through somebody else. We are not losing money because we lack leads. We lose money because nobody follows up. That is your whole job. You are the person who never forgets. What you will actually do every day Reply to new leads on my team WhatsApp. Ask the questions I give you. Book them in. Reply to Instagram DMs too. Same job, different app. Message 50 to 70 old leads a day from my second WhatsApp number. I give you the list and the scripts. You do not write from scratch. I will also help you find ways to make your job easier with automation. Ask 4 simple questions to check if the person is the right fit. Look at my agents' Google Calendars and book the meeting into the right one. Log every reply in my Google Sheet or CRM. Set the next follow-up date. Never let a name go cold. When a lead asks something you don't know, pass it to me or the agent. Do not guess. You will NOT be cold calling. This is typing only. You will NOT be doing social media posting, video editing, or graphic design. You will NOT need to know Singapore property. I train you. Your numbers 50 to 70 follow-up messages sent, every working day. Every lead who replies gets an answer within 30 minutes. No lead sits with no next follow-up date. Ever. Qualified appointments booked — this is what I pay your bonus on. Hours — read this part carefully 9:00am to 6:00pm Singapore time, Monday to Friday. Singapore is the same time zone as the Philippines. So 9am here is 9am there. No night shift. No graveyard. No weekends. You work normal daytime hours and you eat dinner with your family. Short Google Meet with me every morning. Camera on. Pay S$600 to S$800 per month, depending on your experience. Tell me your number. Paid twice a month — every 15th and every 30th. Not once a month. S$10 bonus for every qualified appointment you book, up to 50 a month. That is up to S$500 extra. S$50 perfect attendance bonus every month. 13th month bonus after you pass probation. Prorated for your first year. 1 month probation. If you are not a good fit, no love lost, we say our goodbyes. A good month: S$800 base + S$250 bonus + S$50 attendance = S$1,100. You must be comfortable working with AI I use AI every day. You will too. I will give you an AI helper that knows my business. When you are stuck — a lead asks something odd, you don't know how to word a reply — you ask the AI first, before you ask me. You don't need to be a tech person. You don't need to code. You just need to be the type who tries the new tool instead of avoiding it. If AI makes you nervous, this is not the job. What I need from you You have followed up with customers before. Chat, email, or phone — any of it counts. Tell me what you did. You can type clear, simple English. Short sentences. No fancy words. You have a proper desk and a quiet room. Not a bed, not a noisy house. I will ask for a photo. Stable internet and a working webcam. The daily meeting is on camera. You are fine with Hubstaff time tracking. I use it every day, screenshots included. If this bothers you, do not apply. You can use Google Sheets and Google Calendar. Nice to have, not required You have made sales or follow-up phone calls before. I don't need you to call, but people who can call are usually braver on chat. You have worked with a CRM before. Real estate experience. Truly optional. I train you. How to apply Change your subject line to exactly: "I will send 50 messages a day" - If not then I know you've not read the application throughly Send a short message. Tell me one time you followed up with a customer who had gone quiet, and what happened. Tell me one way you have used AI at work or at home. ChatGPT, Claude, anything. If you have never used it, say so honestly and tell me why you are willing to learn. Attach a photo of your work desk. Just as it is. I am not judging how expensive it is — I want to see it is a real work space. Tell me the salary you want, in Singapore dollars. Attach your resume link. If your subject line is wrong, or there is no desk photo, I will skip you. Not to be difficult — this job is about following instructions carefully, every single day. Short Google Meet interview with me, camera on.

Oh, and we get the team together each year in the Philippines for an epic gathering! A little about you You’re the kind of person who notices when a product page is almost right, but not quite. A banner is slightly off. A mobile layout could convert better. A promo flag has not been updated. A landing page could be cleaner, faster, sharper. You spot it, you fix it, or you find a smarter way to make sure it does not become a recurring problem. You know Shopify (inside and out). Not just “I can update a product description”… But “I can get into the theme, understand what is going on, and build or improve a page using Liquid, HTML and CSS”. You have a practical eye for UX, layout, hierarchy and mobile experience, and you care about whether the online store is easy to use, accurate, on-brand and performing properly. You’re organised, curious and detail-driven, not someone who wants to spend their days doing the same manual audit over and over again. You like building templates, SOPs, better ways of working and simple automations that make the job cleaner and easier next time. Work smarter, not harder. And yes, AI is a tool, not a threat when you know how to use it well. And your favourite time of year is when Shopify drop their seasonal updates. You’re quickly thinking about the application of the updates and if it aligns with our strategy and mission! Most importantly, you care about doing good work with great people. You’re happy working with cross functional Team Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support. You’re confident turning numbers, feedback and site performance into clear recommendations people can actually act on. About us Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a proud B Corp, Carbon Neutral Certified, and 1% for the Planet members meaning we give 1% of our revenue (not profit) to environmental partners. We’re 100% committed to using business as a force for good. Our mission is to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee, roast with care, support cafe partners, and help more people Drink Better Coffee™ at home, at work and beyond. We are digital, design-centric and sustainability-led. We have high expectations, we move quickly, and we are always looking for ways to improve how we work. We strongly believe that if we are not spending at least 10% of our time innovating, we will not succeed. About the role This is first and foremost an e-commerce role. We’re looking for an E-commerce Specialist with strong Shopify build capability, someone who understands how to improve the performance, accuracy and customer experience of an online store. Shopify build skills are important, but they’re only one part of the role. This is a hands-on Shopify role with a strong mix of platform build, content updates, campaign support, reporting and catalogue accuracy. You’ll help keep the store clean, current and easy to use, while also building custom landing pages, supporting promotional campaigns, maintaining product information, and helping stakeholders understand what is working online and what needs to improve. This is not a role for someone who only wants to pass tasks on to developers or rely entirely on page-builder apps. We need someone who is comfortable getting into Shopify, working with themes, building properly, testing carefully and using good judgement. Okay, you’re mid way through this ad, congrats but to help ensure you’re not just using AI tools to skim the job post, make sure you include “Buy Better Coffee Online” in your application subject line. You’ll work closely with Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support to make sure the online store is accurate, on-brand, commercially useful and improving over time. A few things you’ll be across - Owning Shopify theme customisation, including hands-on use of Liquid, HTML and CSS - Building and maintaining sections, templates and custom landing pages - Keeping the Online Store 2.0 structure and theme configuration clean, current and easy for others to use - Applying practical UX and conversion judgement to page layout, hierarchy and mobile experience - Managing website content, including homepage, category pages, landing pages, promo flags, navigation and seasonal campaign content - Working closely with the Marketing team to execute the promotional calendar as it relates to e-com outputs. - Setting up and testing promotions in line with planned campaign activity - Coordinating assets for new product launches, sales, campaigns and e-commerce changes with Design, Marketing and the wider team - Supporting end-to-end online e-commerce projects, from stakeholder briefing through to testing - Providing real-time and monthly reporting on campaign, product and site performance - Translating reporting into clear, useful recommendations, not just sending raw numbers - Maintaining sources of truth for performance data that stakeholders can reference directly - Monitoring stock and maintaining accurate catalogue information - Auditing the site and assets to make sure all available products are live, current and accurate - Supporting and optimising subscription operations through Recharge - Building SOPs, templates and automation where possible to reduce manual catalogue and audit work over time What you’ll bring - Minimum two years’ experience in a similar Shopify-focused e-commerce role - Advanced Shopify experience, including hands-on theme customisation with Liquid, HTML and CSS - Confidence building custom landing pages and templates without relying only on third-party page-builder apps - Practical UX and conversion design sense, especially around layout, hierarchy and mobile experience - Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy - Good written and verbal communication skills - Confidence working with stakeholders across Customer Support, Design, Marketing and Operations - Ability to turn data and reporting into clear, practical recommendations - Comfortable working independently across time zones, while still being part of a collaborative team - Confidence using Microsoft 365 systems, tools and a willingness to learn new apps, plugins and systems. Bonus points if you’ve got Microsoft Business Central experience. - A continuous improvement mindset, you notice repetitive work and look for better ways to get it done Highly regarded - Experience with Recharge or a comparable subscription app - Experience with Yotpo or a comparable rewards app - Experience with Shopify Plus, including Plus migration experience - Familiarity with Figma or a similar design/collaboration tool - Experience in online coffee, food and beverage, retail, subscription, or multi-channel e-commerce (including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Google Shopping) - Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual effort What success looks like - The online store is accurate, organised, current and easy to manage - Product catalogue data is clean, reliable and well maintained - Campaigns and assets are turned around within agreed timelines - Promotions are uploaded, tested and launched accurately - Reporting leads to clear recommendations and better decisions - Manual audit effort reduces over time through SOPs, templates or automation - Stakeholders have confidence in the store, the data and the way campaign work is coordinated - You help make the e-commerce function smarter, cleaner, more scalable over time and ultimately a more profitable channel What’s in it for you First up: we want this role to be one of the best jobs you’ve ever had. That is our commitment to everyone in our team. That does not mean the work will always be easy. It will be detailed, fast-moving and sometimes full of competing priorities. But it will also be rewarding. You’ll be working with a team that genuinely cares about our mission, our customers, our impact, and each other. You’ll have the chance to grow your skills, improve systems, work on meaningful e-commerce projects, and help a purpose-led coffee brand keep building a better online experience. This role will be part of our growing e-com Team. We offer a generous package, Quarterly Performance bonus after probation, HMO Program after one year of tenure, Volunteer and Training Leave, Philippine Public Holidays converted to Annual Leave credits, access to ongoing learning and development, and an Employee Assistance Program. And importantly, you’ll get P&R coffee delivered directly to your place every month. Work schedule This is a full-time independent contractor role, 40 hours per week. The role is remote and based offshore, with working hours to overlap with Sydney business hours Monday to Friday, AEST/AEDT. Specific hours will be agreed based on business needs. Sounds like your kind of role? Send us your resume and cover letter (Resume without cover letters won’t be considered), plus: 1. A link to one live Shopify store you’ve personally built or theme-customised (yours, a client’s, or an employer’s), with a sentence or two on one specific section or page you built using Liquid, HTML or CSS, and why you built it that way. 2. One thing you’d change on ---------- right now, why and how you’d actually build that change in Shopify. Let’s make great coffee easier to find, buy and enjoy. ☕

title: Senior Email Marketing Designer & Automation Specialist — Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Pardot
job_title: Senior Email Marketing Designer & Automation Specialist — Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Pardot
description: Read this entire post before applying. Applications that skip the instructions at the bottom are deleted without review. About us Global Axiss is a luxury sports, entertainment and hospitality company. We sell premium VIP experiences around the Super Bowl, the Masters, the U.S. Open, the Kentucky Derby, PGA tournaments, Formula 1 and other major events. Our clients are high-net-worth individuals, corporate executives and strategic partners — not consumers buying a $50 product. What this role actually is We are building a world-class email marketing program from the ground up. Our first campaign promotes Super Bowl LXI in Los Angeles, followed by the Masters, U.S. Open, Kentucky Derby, PGA and Formula 1. We need someone who can produce campaigns that hold up next to On Location and similar premium hospitality brands. You will own strategy, customer journeys, copy, visual design, email production, testing and optimization. Our Salesforce architect handles advanced CRM configuration and infrastructure — you are not being asked to be a Salesforce admin, but you must be fluent in the marketing platform. You report directly to our management team. What you will do Build complete email campaigns and automated nurture sequences (welcome, inquiry, package launch, deposit, urgency, re-engagement, follow-up) Design premium responsive emails that look correct on desktop and mobile Write subject lines, preview text, body copy and CTAs in native-level English Build or adapt Salesforce-compatible responsive HTML email templates Segment audiences by event, customer type, lead source and corporate partner Produce separate journeys for individual buyers, corporate buyers and partner-referred clients Produce co-branded campaigns for corporate partners Create supporting graphics and landing page concepts Run A/B tests and optimize based on results Test across major devices and email clients before every send Track and report on opens, clicks, inquiries and conversions Maintain Global Axiss brand consistency across everything Repurpose selected campaign creative for LinkedIn and social NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS Every item below is a hard requirement. If you do not meet all of them, you will not be considered. 1. 3+ years of professional email marketing experience — as your primary job function, not as one duty inside a general VA role. 2. Hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud OR Account Engagement (Pardot) experience. You must be able to name the specific modules you worked in (Email Studio, Content Builder, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Engagement Studio, Dynamic Content, AMPscript/HML) and describe what you built in them. "Familiar with" is not experience. 3. Hand-coded responsive HTML email development. Table-based layouts, media queries, inline CSS, dark mode handling, Outlook fallbacks. You must be able to fix a broken template, not just drag blocks. 4. A portfolio of complete campaigns you personally built — with live links or full desktop and mobile screenshots. 5. Premium visual design skill in Figma, Photoshop or Illustrator. Your work must look expensive. 6. Strong English copywriting and proofreading. You will write client-facing copy for high-net-worth buyers. Typos and awkward phrasing are disqualifying. 7.Working knowledge of deliverability — SPF, DKIM, DMARC, list hygiene, warm-up, unsubscribe/CAN-SPAM compliance. A/B testing, UTM tracking and campaign reporting experience. 8. You must be based in the Philippines and able to work 2–3 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific Time. Be realistic about this: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Pacific is roughly 12:00 AM–3:00 AM Philippine Time (1:00–4:00 AM during US winter). If you cannot commit to a graveyard overlap on a consistent schedule, do not apply. 9. Reliable internet and a working computer capable of running Figma/Adobe and testing tools. 10. Strongly preferred: experience in luxury travel, hospitality, sports, entertainment, VIP events, corporate incentive travel, or any high-ticket offer. DO NOT APPLY IF You are a general virtual assistant, admin assistant or "social media manager" hoping to grow into this Your email experience is Canva templates, Mailchimp drag-and-drop, or scheduling sends someone else designed You cannot show three complete campaigns you personally worked on You have never touched Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Pardot You cannot hand-code or debug HTML email You are an agency, a team, or applying on behalf of someone else You cannot work the Pacific overlap hours You are looking for full-time hours right now We will not ask you for free sample work. Finalists are offered the same paid test project. HOW TO APPLY Applications that do not follow this format exactly will be deleted. Start your message with the words: GLOBAL AXISS Then include, numbered in this order: 1. Three links to complete email campaigns you personally helped create. Live links preferred; otherwise full-length desktop and mobile screenshots. Do not send a generic portfolio homepage. 2. Your exact role in each one — strategy, copy, design, HTML, automation. Say which parts were yours and which were not. At least one example from luxury, hospitality, travel, sports, entertainment or another high-ticket offer. 3. Your exact Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Pardot experience — which platform, how long, which modules, and one specific thing you built in it. 4. One paragraph on how you would handle a Super Bowl package launch sequence to a segmented list of individual buyers and corporate buyers. Three to five sentences, your own words. 5.Your normal working hours in Philippine Time, and confirmation that you can cover 2–3 hours of Pacific overlap. 6. Your hourly rate in USD. Shortlisted applicants will do a short video interview. Be prepared to walk through your own HTML on a screen share.

title: Project Cordinator
description: Project Coordinator – Residential Construction Full-Time | Remote About the Role Dreamville Homes is a Sydney-based residential construction company specialising in custom homes. We are looking for an experienced, organised and proactive Project Coordinator to support our Project Manager and construction team with the day-to-day coordination and administration of residential building projects. This is a long-term, full-time position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of tasks, follow up outstanding items and keep projects organised without requiring constant supervision. Key Responsibilities Project Coordination Assist the Project Manager with day-to-day project activities. Coordinate with trades, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and internal staff. Follow up outstanding tasks, quotations, documents and information. Maintain project task lists and ensure outstanding items are followed through. Coordinate information between the office, site team, trades and consultants. Quotes & Procurement Send requests for quotations to trades and suppliers. Follow up quotations and supplier pricing. Compare quotes, including price, scope, inclusions and exclusions. Prepare quote comparison summaries for management. Assist with procurement and ordering. Maintain accurate records of trade and supplier pricing. Invoice Processing Receive and process supplier and subcontractor invoices. Check invoices against approved quotations, purchase orders and agreed pricing. Identify pricing or scope discrepancies. Allocate invoices to the correct project. Prepare invoices for management approval. Maintain accurate invoice and cost records. Drawings & Approvals Coordinate architectural, structural, engineering and consultant drawings. Follow up consultants for outstanding drawings and revisions. Maintain drawing registers and ensure current revisions are correctly recorded. Assist with preparing and collecting documentation required for Council, CDC, certifier and other approvals. Follow up outstanding approval requirements. Maintain organised records of approvals, certificates and project documentation. Inspection Coordination Book construction inspections with certifiers and consultants. Coordinate inspection timing with the Project Manager and Site Supervisor. Follow up inspection reports. Maintain records of inspections, reports and certificates. Follow up outstanding documentation or rectification items where required. Administration & Record Keeping Maintain organised electronic project files. Keep accurate records of trades and suppliers. Maintain quote, invoice, inspection and document registers. Prepare emails, letters, spreadsheets and other project documentation. Assist with meeting notes and action lists. Perform general day-to-day construction administration duties. Provide administrative support to the Project Manager and management team as required. Candidate Requirements We are looking for someone with: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience. Previous construction, project coordination or construction administration experience. Excellent written and spoken English. Strong organisational and time-management skills. Good attention to detail. Strong Microsoft Excel, Word and general computer skills. Confidence communicating with trades, suppliers and consultants. Ability to compare quotations and identify differences in pricing and scope. Experience processing and checking invoices. Ability to understand construction terminology and basic construction drawings. Strong document-control and record-keeping skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. Ability to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks. A proactive attitude – we want someone who follows up outstanding matters rather than waiting to be reminded. Previous experience working with an Australian residential builder or construction company will be highly regarded. Experience with Australian construction processes, Council/CDC approvals, private certifiers, architectural drawings and construction management software will also be an advantage. Working Hours Full-Time – 40 hours per week Monday to Friday during Sydney, Australia business hours. You must be available during our normal working hours to communicate with our Project Managers, office team, trades, suppliers and consultants. Who We Want We are looking for someone who can become an important part of our construction team. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for tasks such as: A quotation hasn't arrived → follow it up. Three trades have quoted → compare the quotes and prepare a summary. An invoice doesn't match the approved quote → identify and report the discrepancy. A consultant hasn't provided a drawing → follow it up. Documentation is missing for an approval → identify what is outstanding and coordinate it. An inspection is required → organise and book it. A Project Manager has outstanding actions → help coordinate and follow them through. The objective of this position is to reduce the administrative workload of our Project Manager and help keep our projects organised and moving efficiently. How to Apply Please send: Your resume. Your expected monthly salary in PHP. Details of your construction/project coordination experience. Details of any previous experience working with Australian construction companies. Software and systems you have used. A brief explanation of your experience with quote comparison, invoice processing and construction documentation. A 2-minute video introduction explaining your experience and why you believe you would be suitable for this role. Please start your application with: “DREAMVILLE PROJECT COORDINATOR” Applications without this phrase may not be considered. We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow with Dreamville Homes.

title: Brand Consultant for a Private Individual To Join A Small Team– Senior, Part-Time, Long-Term, Top-of-Market Pay
job_title: Brand Consultant for a Private Individual To Join A Small Team– Senior, Part-Time, Long-Term, Top-of-Market Pay
description: The problem A small, careful group of people are making one of the biggest decisions of their lives, and they make it almost entirely on trust built through text: Facebook groups, Reddit, a couple of niche platforms, and DMs. Most of the alternatives they're comparing me against are either slick and untrustworthy or trustworthy and invisible. I'm the second kind. I have the substance (a long, candid profile; documented evidence; a track record; references) and the operational side is in good hands: inquiries get answered, documents go out, follow-ups happen on time. That part works, the person running it is staying, and I'm not looking to change any of it. It's what frees this role to be purely about the brand. What's missing is the layer above it: someone who takes a private individual with real credibility and makes him the obvious, memorable, trusted choice in a skeptical community, without a hint of salesmanship, because salesmanship is exactly what this audience has learned to distrust. The full context is personal and shared on a first call, then under NDA. It's legal and ethical. It's also sensitive, so if that's not for you, no hard feelings. What the job actually is Positioning first: find the one thing that makes me the safe choice and build everything around it. Then the whole surface: a one-page site, a document packet people forward to their partner and their lawyer, photo direction, and post and message copy tuned to how each community reads, screenshots, and compares notes. Then the machine: where to show up, how often, how to respond so that reply rate stays high and the spam filter stays quiet, and a playbook clear enough that the person already running the day-to-day can execute it without you in the loop. You'd own the brand and the strategy; the execution stays with the person who already handles it, and part of your job is making her more effective, not doing her work. To be clear, this is an addition, not a replacement: I'm building this role around the people I already have. Think of it as consulting with real ownership: your judgment, their hands, my time when you need it. Who I'm looking for Someone who has done this before for a person, not a product: a consultant, a physician, a founder, a candidate, anyone whose whole business was being trusted by strangers online. You write with precision and restraint; you know that in a high-stakes decision, one overclaiming sentence undoes ten honest ones. You have a feel for community dynamics that can't be faked, and you're the sort of person who'd rather cut a paragraph than add one. Discretion is non-negotiable. I don't care about your follower count, your agency, or your certifications. I care whether you can look at what I have and see what it should become. The filter Don't send a proposal. Send one paragraph answering this: a person is choosing between two strangers for something irreversible. Both are qualified. One writes beautifully; the other shares every document up front. Who wins, and what does the winner's first message look like? Under 150 words. Start with the word "baseline." description: Social Media & Marketing Manager – Real Estate Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Mitchell Properties is looking for an experienced Social Media & Marketing Manager to manage the social media and digital marketing for an established Texas real estate business. This is NOT an entry-level position and is not a project-based content creation role. I am looking for someone who understands marketing AND social media and has previous experience working directly with a real estate professional or real estate business. REAL ESTATE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED You must have previous, ongoing experience managing social media and/or marketing for a: Realtor or Real Estate Broker Real Estate Team or Brokerage Property Management Company Home Builder Or another real-estate-related business You must be able to prove this experience and provide examples of business accounts you personally managed. Managing your own Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, or personal brand does not qualify. Completing occasional graphics, videos, or one-time projects for real estate clients does not qualify. I am looking for someone who has actually been responsible for managing another person's or company's business marketing and social media on an ongoing basis. ABOUT THE POSITION I am a full-time Texas Real Estate Broker actively selling homes and working with buyers, sellers, relocation clients, listings, and past clients. The purpose of this position is not simply to “post on social media.” I need someone who understands how to use social media and marketing to support and grow a real estate business. You will be responsible for helping manage the overall marketing and social media presence of Mitchell Properties, including creating and implementing marketing strategies, managing content, creating and editing social media content, marketing real estate listings, repurposing existing content, monitoring performance, and bringing new ideas and recommendations to the business. I am looking for someone who can take ownership of this area of the business. I do not want to have to tell you every day what needs to be posted or what marketing needs to be done. You should be able to look at what is happening in the business, recognize marketing opportunities, develop ideas, and execute them. I also do not want a social media strategy that requires me to become a full-time content creator. I am a Realtor first. Social media and marketing should support the real estate business—not become the business. QUALIFICATIONS You should have: Proven professional social media and marketing experience Previous ongoing real estate marketing experience Experience managing social media for someone else's business Strong marketing and strategic thinking skills Strong written and spoken English Excellent communication skills Strong attention to detail Social media content creation and video editing skills Experience analyzing social media performance Ability to work independently and take initiative Ability to manage deadlines and priorities Ability to learn and maintain an established brand voice Ability to communicate ideas and make recommendations instead of simply waiting for instructions Experience with platforms and tools such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Canva, CapCut, Flodesk, Google Workspace, Trello, and AI tools is beneficial. HOURS This is a long-term, part-time position. Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start. You must have some availability during U.S. Central Time business hours for communication and collaboration. HOW TO APPLY Email your application to: ---------- Your email subject line MUST be: ONLINEJOBS.PH – PINK SOCIAL – Social Media & Marketing Manager – [YOUR NAME] Please tell me about your professional social media and marketing experience and specifically about your real estate experience. Your application should include: The real estate businesses/professionals you have worked with Links to real estate business social media accounts you personally managed on an ongoing basis How long you managed each account/business What you personally were responsible for Examples of your actual work Results you achieved, when available Your current weekly availability Your availability during U.S. Central Time Your requested hourly rate Do not submit your personal social media accounts as proof of professional experience. Please be specific about what you actually did for the businesses you managed. I am not looking for a general description of what a social media manager does.

We provide compassionate, customized care that helps seniors age safely and comfortably at home. MD-owned and clinically led, we combine advanced medical insight with hands-on leadership, recently strengthened by a partnership with experienced operators who have built and scaled organizations across health care. Unlike franchise agencies, we operate independently, so our clinicians can prioritize quality care and meaningful patient relationships. Why Join • Mission-driven and clinician-led, focused on quality outcomes and excellent patient-care. • A young, entrepreneurial company growing fast, with new ventures, new markets, and real room to grow with us and expand into leadership roles. • Technology-forward: we invest in modern tools so the work keeps getting smarter • A flat organization where leaders work right next to you and your ideas shape the company’s direction • A supportive, collaborative culture with ongoing mentorship and professional development

title: Illustrator Wanted — Play a key role in growing fun, educational YouTube channels with your artistic talents
job_title: Illustrator Wanted — Play a key role in growing fun, educational YouTube channels with your artistic talents
description: You'll collaborate with me, a content creator, on my YouTube channels by providing illustrations and graphics that complement and enhance mostly "faceless" long-form videos (explainer, listicle, and on occasion, vlog-style videos). The channels focus on entertaining, educational topics. You'll help grow the channel audience and engagement by crafting visually stimulating illustrations that are both easy-to-grasp, yet also reflect a unique visual style consistent with the channel brand. What's expected of you: • good English and communication skills • meet a standard of quality under deadline within a busy production schedule For example, for a 5 minute faceless explainer video, I may ask you to produce an illustration that visually reinforces or enhances the voiceover narrative content for every 5 to 15 seconds of the video. So that would be a total of about 30 illustrations for the 1 video. We'd establish together a reasonable deadline for producing those 30 illustrations. I'll handle video ideation, scripting, voiceover recording, editing and publication. The more efficient you are (we both are), the more videos we can publish per week, and the faster the channel(s) will grow. We'll find a pace that's workable for both of us. I don't want you to rush or burn out. Yet I also want us to keep up with an effective publishing schedule. • collaborate with channel owner/content creator on executing the vision for a given video topic • freedom to choose the design applications you like to use (for example, Illustrator, Photoshop or Procreate). You'll be submitting work in standard formats for incorporating them into videos during editing phase (for example, compressed JPG or PNG files). These illustrations will be sketches—mostly black & white, grayscale or using a simple color palette—not super-detailed masterpieces. Think cartoons, doodles, or simple line drawings. Their purpose is to illustrate the idea or point being made at a given juncture in the narrative. Speed is more important than perfection. • I'm less interested in how much experience you have and more interested in your commitment to grow as an artist and collaborator. I value creativity, reliability, a willingness to take ownership of your work, and the drive to learn. What you can expect from me: • clear guidelines on what to produce • the chance to express your unique artistic style • openness to your ideas and suggestions—I see this as a collaboration • an open door policy when it comes to discussing concerns or problems—no need to disappear if something worries you • encouragement—detail-specific praise for quality work, as well as constructive notes on changes needing to be made. I'm a former professor who's taught ESL and literature in Asia. I take pride in being a supportive coach. I want you to succeed, and I'll do my best to help you do so. • opportunity for professional development—for example, adding video thumbnail design, digital animation, video editing and/or book illustrating to your skillset • eventually, when the channel(s) are profitable, a chance to share in the rewards full-time position — 40 hours/week salary — $750/month to start, with performance-based raises Work schedule: full-time, Monday to Friday, with flexible hours after the trial period, you'll quality for 3 vacation leaves and 3 sick leaves Filipino holidays off except for All Saints and All Souls Day Benefits: 13th month The hiring process will have 2 rounds: Round 1 — apply by submitting a cover letter, resume and, most importantly, a portfolio of your best work similar to what you'd be doing in this position. I'll choose 3 candidates for Round 2 based on a review of these materials. Round 2 — a 30-minute videoconference interview + a trial mini-project. I'll pay the 3 of you $5/hour to complete a sample project of 5 illustrations. I'll share with you a video voiceover script. Once you read the script and understand the project scope, you'll tell me how many hours you think it'll take you to complete the 5 illustrations and how long it'll take. For the person I hire, there will be a 90-day fully paid trial period to see if we're a good fit.

title: iOS Real Estate App Redesign

Judgment. Anyone can pull traffic numbers. The rare skill is looking at a community and knowing whether it's genuinely valuable and worth the money — the right niche, real search/monetization potential — without us weighing in on every call. 2. Deal-making. Cold outreach to a stranger, opening the conversation, negotiating value, and closing cleanly. This is most of the job, day to day. Reddit familiarity is a plus, but it is NOT the requirement — the mechanics (how moderation and transfers work) are quick to learn for the right person. Don't skip applying because you're not a "Reddit person." COMPENSATION Competitive base salary + bonus structure WHO YOU PROBABLY ARE • A domain or website flipper, digital-asset broker, or someone who's done acquisition/partnership outreach and negotiation • You have real commercial judgment — you can size up an asset's value fast and be right • You're comfortable cold-reaching strangers and closing deals • You're highly organized and self-directed — you own your pipeline with minimal oversight • Clear written English • Bonus (not required): Reddit, affiliate, or SEO experience TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE 1. title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description: ABOUT US We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it. We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today. ABOUT THE ROLE You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role. This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Amazon PPC Strategy (core) – Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps – Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs – Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats – Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle – Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth – Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation – Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role Listing Optimisation (core) – Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent – Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content – Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings – Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact – Keep listing and PPC strategy working together Systems & Reporting – Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance – Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers – Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner – Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce Operations & Team Leadership – Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches – Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment – Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions – Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding – Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR – 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience – Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios – Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis – Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency – Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures – Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment – Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation – Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious – Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding – Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain – Experience managing people and coordinating across functions – Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why STRONG ADVANTAGES Experience with any of the following is a plus: 1. Amazon Marketing Cloud 2. Amazon Marketing Stream 3. Amazon DSP 4. Search Query Performance data 5. Brand Analytics 6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis 7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems 8. Portfolio-level budget allocation 9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation 10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue 11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE You will do well if you: 1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities 2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally 3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it 4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts 5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change 6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know. WORKING DAYS AND HOURS – Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri) – Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break) – 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Please apply with the following. title: Part-Time Ecommerce Customer Support & Retention Specialist (USA HOURS)
job_title: Part-Time Ecommerce Customer Support & Retention Specialist (USA HOURS)
description: # Part-Time Ecommerce Customer Support & Retention Specialist **Location:** Remote — Philippines **Schedule:** Part-Time initially, working during U.S. business hours **Growth Path:** Expected to transition to full-time quickly after training and ramp-up ## About the Role We are a fast-growing U.S.-based ecommerce company looking for a highly reliable, thoughtful, and customer-focused **Customer Support & Retention Specialist**. This is not a basic copy-and-paste customer service position. Customer service is extremely important to our business, and we are looking for someone who can communicate professionally, solve problems, calm frustrated customers, and make good decisions while protecting both the customer relationship and the business. You will work closely with the owner during your initial training period and will be given clear SOPs, templates, and guidance. This role will begin **part-time only temporarily** while you learn our systems, policies, products, and customer service standards. Once you are fully trained, comfortable handling cases, and able to work independently, we expect the position to **transition into a full-time role quickly**. We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a long-term position with the company. ## Responsibilities You will help manage customer support across our ecommerce business, including: * Responding to customer emails * Answering inbound customer phone calls * Making outbound calls when necessary * Responding to shipping and tracking questions * Investigating delayed or unusual shipments * Handling return and refund requests * Offering appropriate solutions to retain customers when possible * Coordinating replacements and reshipments * Handling damaged, incorrect, or missing-item cases * De-escalating frustrated customers professionally * Following company return, refund, and retention procedures * Keeping accurate notes on customer cases * Escalating unusual or high-risk situations to the owner * Following up with customers until cases are fully resolved During the training period, you will work closely with the owner and can escalate situations whenever you are unsure rather than guessing. As you become more experienced, you will gradually be given more responsibility and authority to resolve customer cases independently. ## What We're Looking For The ideal candidate: * Has excellent written English * Speaks clear, confident, professional English * Is comfortable talking directly with U.S. customers on the phone * Has previous customer service or ecommerce experience * Is calm when dealing with upset or demanding customers * Has strong judgment and problem-solving skills * Can follow SOPs carefully without sounding robotic * Understands that issuing a refund is not always the first or best solution * Is comfortable offering alternatives such as replacements, reshipments, or partial refunds when appropriate * Pays close attention to order details, tracking information, and previous customer communication * Is organized and documents their work carefully * Is reliable during scheduled U.S. working hours * Takes ownership of problems instead of simply passing them along * Is interested in growing into a larger, long-term role with the company Experience with **Shopify** is strongly preferred. Experience with ecommerce fulfillment, tracking systems, chargebacks, returns, refunds, or customer retention is a major plus. ## What Success Looks Like We do not measure good customer service simply by how quickly tickets are closed. A successful person in this role will: * Keep customers informed and reassured * Resolve issues without unnecessary refunds * Save sales when a reasonable solution exists * Prevent avoidable chargebacks * Catch shipping or fulfillment problems early * Maintain fast response times * Communicate naturally rather than sending robotic responses * Make thoughtful decisions * Know when to resolve something independently and when to escalate it Customer support is an important part of the revenue and reputation of the business, so we are looking for someone who takes the role seriously. ## Schedule & Growth This position will **start part-time for training and ramp-up purposes only**. The part-time period is intended to give you time to learn: * Our customer service standards * Our policies and SOPs * Our products * Our shipping and fulfillment processes * How we handle refunds and returns * How we approach customer retention * When to escalate situations Once you are fully trained and consistently handling cases correctly, the position is expected to **move to full-time quickly**. Candidates should therefore be interested in and available for a future full-time schedule. You must also be comfortable working hours that overlap with normal U.S. business hours. ## Compensation Competitive hourly compensation based on experience. There will also be opportunities for **performance-based bonuses** for consistently strong work. We want someone who cares about customer experience, protects the business, and grows with the company, and strong performance will be rewarded accordingly. ## How to Apply Please include: 1. Your previous customer service or ecommerce experience. 2. Whether you have worked with Shopify before. 3. Whether you have handled returns, refunds, shipping problems, or angry customers. 4. Your experience answering U.S. customer phone calls. 5. Your available working hours in U.S. Central Time. 6. Your expected hourly rate. 7. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted long-term member of the team and grow into a full-time role as quickly as they are ready.

title: Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus)
job_title: Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus)
description: BEFORE YOU APPLY — KNOCKOUTS (must be YES) 1. Are you willing to work over 40 hours a week? YES 2. Are you willing to work over the weekend? YES 3. Are you completely fluent in English (written and spoken)? YES # Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus) **Connect Social · Full-time · Remote (Worldwide) · Mid–Senior** Connect Social is a performance marketing partner for e-commerce and DTC brands. We've worked with 120+ brands across subscription, established DTC, celebrity/creator, and high-stakes niches including politics. We run paid media, email/SMS, CRO, creative, and influencer under one roof — which means the media buyer here isn't handed a black box. You see the whole funnel, and you're accountable for what happens in it. We're hiring one senior Paid Media Buyer. Location is open globally. English must be completely fluent (written and spoken). This is a high-output remote seat: we expect people who can sustain **40+ hours/week** and are **willing to work weekends** when accounts or launches need it. If that is not a hard yes, do not apply. ## Before you apply — answer these (must be YES to both) 1. Are you willing to work over 40 hours a week? 2. Are you willing to work over the weekend? If either answer is no, this role is not a fit. Applications that do not confirm both will be declined. ## What you will own - Full ownership of a book of e-commerce accounts on Meta and Google — strategy, build, launch, optimization, and the number at the end of the month - Media planning and budget allocation across platforms, tied to blended targets, not in-platform vanity metrics - Structured creative testing: writing briefs, reading results, and telling our creative team what to make next based on data — not taste - Feed and Shopping health on the Google side, including PMax, brand/non-brand separation, and search term hygiene - Measurement integrity: CAPI, server-side tracking, and reconciling platform-reported numbers against actual business results - Client-facing reporting and calls — presenting performance, defending decisions, and telling a founder the truth when a month goes sideways - Diagnosing accounts that are underperforming and having a specific point of view on why, backed by evidence ## Non-negotiable qualifications Read this section carefully. If you don't clear these bars, this role isn't the right fit. - **English:** Completely fluent in English (written and spoken). Client calls and Slack are in English. - **Hours:** Willing and able to work **40+ hours/week** and **weekends** when needed. Overlap with US Eastern business hours for client calls is required. - **Scale:** You've personally managed at least $5M+ in lifetime ad spend, or you're currently running $200K+/month sustained across your book of accounts. Not agency-wide spend you were adjacent to — spend you had your hands in. - **Tenure:** 3+ years buying media specifically for e-commerce/DTC. Lead gen, B2B, and app install experience is fine as a supplement, but it isn't a substitute. - **Both platforms:** Deep, current, hands-on experience in both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. Not "I've dabbled in Google." We need someone who can build a PMax campaign and fix a broken product feed without escalating it. - **Business math:** You're fluent in blended ROAS, MER, contribution margin, CAC, AOV, and LTV. You understand why a 2.1x in-platform ROAS can be a great month or a disaster depending on the P&L, and you can explain which one it is. - **Measurement:** You've implemented or overseen server-side tracking and CAPI. You've worked with a third-party attribution tool (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar) and you know where those numbers lie. - **Creative literacy:** You can look at 40 ads and tell us which 3 to scale, which 5 to iterate, and why. You understand that creative is the primary targeting lever, and you can brief it clearly. - **Receipts:** You can walk us through specific accounts you've scaled — starting point, ending point, what you changed, and what you'd do differently. Real numbers, real timelines. - **Setup:** Reliable high-speed internet, quiet space for client calls, and your own computer capable of running Ads Manager / Sheets / Meet without friction. ## You'll stand out if you have - Experience navigating ad account restrictions, policy appeals, and compliance-sensitive verticals - TikTok and/or Truth Social buying experience - Experience running incrementality or geo-lift testing - You've taken an account from healthy to great and pulled one back from the edge — both skills, not just one ## The mentality we are hiring for Skills can be taught. This part can't. **You figure it out.** When you hit something you've never seen before — a new platform update, a tracking break, an account structure you didn't build — your first instinct is to go find the answer, not to ask who's handling it. You'll have support here and you'll never be left stranded, but you should be the kind of person who shows up to the conversation with a hypothesis already formed. **You're a perfectionist about your output.** Nothing leaves your hands that you're not proud to put your name on. No typos in ad copy. No mismatched UTMs. No report with a number that doesn't tie out. If it's 90% done, it's not done, and you know the difference between the two without being told. **Your attention to detail is uncomfortable.** You're the person who notices the landing page headline doesn't match the ad, catches the duplicated audience exclusion, and spots the $400 spending in a paused-but-not-really-paused ad set. Small things compound in this job. Missing them costs real money. **You're relentlessly curious.** You're reading changelogs, testing things in your own accounts, and following what's actually working right now — not what worked in 2023. This industry rewrites itself every six months and you find that energizing rather than exhausting. **You own the outcome.** When a campaign underperforms, you show up with the diagnosis and the plan before anyone asks. You don't hide behind the algorithm, iOS, or a bad creative cycle. You also speak up early when something isn't working — bad news travels fast here, and that's by design. **You operate independently.** We're remote. Nobody is watching your calendar. You manage your own priorities, hit your own deadlines, and communicate proactively enough that no one has to chase you for a status update. **You care about the client's business, not just the account.** Our clients aren't campaign IDs. Your success is measured by whether their business grew — and we treat their success as our own. ## How to apply 1. Confirm in your application / cover note that you answer **YES** to both: (a) willing to work 40+ hours/week, and (b) willing to work weekends. 2. Include your LinkedIn (or portfolio), location/timezone, and 2–3 account receipts (spend scale + outcomes — anonymized is fine). 3. Apply through the board where you found this post. Connect Social · Remote worldwide · Full-time
