title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
job_title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description: READ THIS FIRST We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California. This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment. This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here. On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here. If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work. THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT OR A SALE. OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses). 13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top. --- ABOUT THE COMPANY You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years. The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked. A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time. We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't. --- WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support. Daily: - Call new Facebook/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day) - Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time. - Respond to inbound SMS, Facebook ---------- , and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them - Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel - Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar - Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs - Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM) - Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers Weekly: - One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min) - Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings - Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them During training (first 2–4 weeks): We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence. --- A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY) We use a script. We also need you to think. Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words. Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment. This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you. Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works. If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well. --- SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES) All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning. - US workdays: Monday through Friday - US days off: Saturday and Sunday - Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call) - Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March): Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT - A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time - A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time - Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night) Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November): - Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT - Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit. Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying. --- COMPENSATION Base pay: $900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month. 13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000. Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly): - $3 per new client showed appointment - $2 per existing client showed appointment - $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon) Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly): - +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month - +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month - +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month Worked examples: Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 (midpoint) - Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90) - Threshold bonus: $75 - Total: ~$1,250/month Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 - Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120) - Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150) - Total: ~$1,475/month Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked): - Base: $1,000 - Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking) - Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350) - Total: ~$2,025/month This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role. --- OTHER BENEFITS 1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year 2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can. 3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation. To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form --- TARGET KPIs - Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+ - Show Rate: 90%+ - Bookings per day: 4–9 - Showed appointments per month: 100–160 - Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit. --- WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Background: - Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders. - Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required. Non-negotiable skills: The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for: - Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role. - Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings. - Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going. - Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe. - Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists. Everything else: - ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier. - STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work. - Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application. - Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind. - Script discipline for the structured parts of the call. - Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused. - Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified. - Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising. - Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean: - Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire. - Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop - Mouse - Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods. - Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls. - Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients. Preferred: - Second monitor - You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster) --- DO NOT APPLY IF: - You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait. - You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it. - You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next. - You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking. - You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale. - Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker - You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast. - You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure - You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating" - You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it" - You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term - You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation --- HIRING PROCESS 1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions 2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner 3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay 4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion 5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7 6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance --- HOW TO APPLY Submit your application through this Tally form: | ---------- | IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience. The form will ask for: - A screenshot of your typing test results ( ---------- ) - A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net) - A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor) - A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages - A few short questions to gauge fit - A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) - A short Loom video introducing yourself Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form. --- Looking forward to meeting the right person. Ethan Founder, Midnight Siren --- Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role. --- OTHER BENEFITS 1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year 2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can. 3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation. To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form --- TARGET KPIs - Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+ - Show Rate: 90%+ - Bookings per day: 4–9 - Showed appointments per month: 100–160 - Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit. --- WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Background: - Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders. - Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required. Non-negotiable skills: The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for: - Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role. - Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings. - Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going. - Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe. - Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists. Everything else: - ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier. - STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work. - Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application. - Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind. - Script discipline for the structured parts of the call. - Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused. - Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified. - Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising. - Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean: - Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire. - Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop - Mouse - Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods. - Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls. - Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients. Preferred: - Second monitor - You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster) --- DO NOT APPLY IF: - You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait. - You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it. - You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next. - You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking. - You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale. - Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker - You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast. - You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure - You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating" - You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it" - You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term - You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation --- HIRING PROCESS 1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions 2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner 3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay 4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion 5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7 6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance --- HOW TO APPLY Submit your application through this Tally form: | ---------- | IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience. The form will ask for: - A screenshot of your typing test results ( ---------- ) - A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net) - A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor) - A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages - A few short questions to gauge fit - A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) - A short Loom video introducing yourself Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form. --- Looking forward to meeting the right person. Ethan Founder, Midnight Siren --- Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

job_title: Operations & Customer Support Assistant — AU Company, Day Shift, ₱35-45K
description: About us Lee Mathematics Tuition is a fast-growing online maths tutoring company based in Sydney, Australia, supporting 245 families and 261 students across the country. We match students with expert tutors and look after them through their whole learning journey. Our operations team is small and tight, and we are growing fast - so we need another reliable set of hands. About the role You will work alongside our Student Success Manager, who you report to day to day. You are the voice our families hear. When a parent rings because their child is sick, or their tutor has not shown up, or they need to move tomorrow's lesson - you are the person who picks up, sorts it, and makes them feel looked after. That is the heart of this job. The other half of the job is getting new students started. When a family signs up, you own them until their first lesson has actually happened. Our system does the heavy lifting of working out which tutors are a good fit and are free - but a system cannot get a busy tutor to reply, and it cannot pin a family down to an exact day and time. That part is yours. You will be messaging tutors back and forth, confirming the precise times with the parent and the student, and getting the lesson locked into the calendar. It is a real back-and-forth job, it takes persistence, and it is a big part of your week. A lot of the repetitive admin here is already automated, and more of it will be. So what we actually need from you is the part a system cannot do - warmth on the phone, chasing people who have not replied yet, good judgment when something does not fit the rules, and never dropping a ball when three things land at once. What you will do - Answer and return parent calls, texts and emails - promptly, warmly, and in a way that leaves them feeling looked after - Handle whatever comes up during the evening lesson window - a tutor running late, a student not showing, a parent asking if tonight is still on - Coordinate tutors and families to get new students booked in - our system shortlists who can take a student, then you message the tutors, agree the exact days and times with the parent, and lock the lesson into the calendar - Own each new family until their first lesson has happened - records set up, tutor confirmed, first lesson booked, and the family told what to expect - Send welcome messages, first-lesson check-ins and payment reminders (templated - you are not writing these from scratch) - Help out with some billing admin - chasing up unpaid invoices and following up with families, working alongside our team - Keep our task boards and records accurate so nothing slips between people - including chasing tutors who have not written up their lesson notes yet Who you are - Warm, clear, confident English on the phone with Australian parents. You are comfortable ringing someone back, and comfortable being the person who says "leave that with me." This is the single most important thing. - Good judgment. Much of this job is situations that do not quite fit the rule. We will give you a clear list of what you can d ---------- on your own - we need someone who will actually use it rather than checking in on everything. - Exceptionally organised. You juggle many things at once, prioritise fast, and stay calm and methodical when it is busy. - Persistent, in a friendly way. A lot of this job is people not replying yet. You are comfortable following up a tutor for the third time without it becoming awkward, and you do not let something sit just because you are waiting on someone else. - Reliable and proactive - you follow things through and keep your own systems tidy without being chased. - Comfortable learning new software quickly (we use TutorBird, Notion, Asana and Aircall, and you will be on Slack with our team and WhatsApp with our tutors every day). - Available for the hours below, including the afternoon/evening shift, plus one weekend morning. Nice to have - Experience in operations, admin, coordination, or a virtual assistant role - Experience speaking with English-speaking (ideally Australian) customers by phone Details - Full time, remote (work from home) - These are normal daytime hours. This is not a night shift - we are in Australia, so our working day lines up closely with yours. - Your first month - training: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM Manila time. You will work these hours alongside our Student Success Manager while you learn the role. - After that, ongoing: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 6:30 PM Manila time. From 4 October this becomes 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM Manila, so that your Australian hours stay the same through daylight saving. This is the busiest part of our day - lessons run in the Australian evening, so that is when parents call - and for the last few hours you will be the only one on. It is a role with real ownership, and we will move you onto it once you are confident, not on day one. - Plus 2.5 hours on one weekend morning (Saturday or Sunday - we will agree which with you). Around 45 hrs/week in total. - PHP 35,000 - 45,000/month, and where you start in that range depends on your experience - for the right person we will start you above the bottom of it. - The pay increases are real and important to us as we want you to grow with us. Your rate is reviewed at the end of your 2-month probation and again at 6 months, and it steps up as you take on the full role. - 13th month pay provided of course. - Paid time off - 3 paid sick days and 6 paid public holidays each year - A long-term role on a small team that is growing fast. We have gone from around 130 families at the start of this year to 245 today, and you would be one of only two people running operations for all of them. There is real room to grow here as we scale, and we would rather grow the people we have than keep hiring around them. How to apply Start your application with the word SYDNEY so we know you read this properly. Then send us a 2-3 minute video - just talk us through these three things in one go: 1. A quick intro about yourself 2. This scenario: "A parent rings you at 6pm, upset. Their tutor has been late twice in two weeks, and tonight they were 15 minutes late again. The parent wants to know whether they are being charged for the full lesson. Talk to them - what do you actually say?" 3. And this one: "Three things land at the same time. A parent is waiting on a call back about tomorrow's lesson, a tutor has just messaged to say they cannot make tonight, and two new families need their first lessons booked this week. What do you do first, and why? And how do you keep track of the other two so they do not get forgotten?" Film it on your phone. One take is fine and it does not need to be polished - we would rather see you thinking than see you rehearsed. Share it as a link (Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube unlisted). We want to see and hear how you come across, how you handle someone who is unhappy, and how you organise yourself when several things need you at once. Shortlisted applicants will do a live interview including a role-played parent call and a short hands-on organisation exercise.

Studios under $20,000/month get turned away — we'd rather lose the sale than take money from someone it won't work for - Keep GoHighLevel clean: notes, pipeline stages, follow-up tasks Hours Calls run in United States timezone: - US East Coast: late evening / overnight PHT You need to be genuinely available in the US block. title: Burnout & Sustainable Performance Sales Advisor
description: # Burnout & Sustainable Performance Sales Advisor **Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week Initially | $2/Hour + High Commission** We are looking for an experienced **B2B Sales Advisor** who can develop relationships with business leaders, conduct consultative sales conversations, and close professional-services engagements. This is not an appointment-setting role. You will own opportunities from initial outreach through paid-client handoff. ## What You Will Sell ### Burnout & Sustainable Performance Operating Review A focused **3-week, $9,500 professional-services engagement** that helps leadership teams identify what is driving burnout and unsustainable pressure, determine what needs to change, and build a practical 90-day action plan. Our core client proposition is: **We help leaders identify what is driving burnout, reduce the pressures they can control, and build a 90-day plan for healthier, more sustainable performance.** Within three weeks, the leadership team will know: * the 3 to 5 biggest sources of unsustainable pressure contributing to burnout * what needs to be stopped, reduced, redesigned, or protected * which leadership actions will have the greatest impact * who owns each action * what should happen over the next 90 days The buyer is purchasing a structured organizational diagnosis, leadership alignment, and practical action plan. This is not a wellness program or resilience training. ## Who You Will Sell To Potential buyers include: * CHROs and Chief People Officers * Heads of Talent or Leadership Development * Business Unit Executives * Transformation Leaders * PMO and Enterprise Delivery Leaders * COOs * Directors, Senior Directors, and VPs responsible for high-pressure teams, functions, or business units Our initial focus is typically a contained leadership team, department, function, transformation team, PMO, or business unit rather than an enterprise-wide engagement. ## What You Will Own You are responsible for moving opportunities through the entire sales process. Responsibilities include: * reviewing prospects provided to help build your pipeline * identifying and developing additional opportunities * conducting personalized B2B outreach * building relationships with senior decision-makers * qualifying business need, urgency, authority, and fit * conducting consultative sales conversations * clearly explaining the Burnout & Sustainable Performance Operating Review * handling objections professionally * maintaining disciplined follow-up * progressing qualified opportunities through the pipeline * closing the $9,500 engagement * securing client payment * handing the paid client to the Founder for delivery The Founder delivers the engagement after the sale. **You are responsible for closing the business.** Prospects will be provided to help build your pipeline. Advisors are also expected to develop additional opportunities through their own research, relationships, referrals, LinkedIn, and other appropriate B2B channels. **Advisor-generated opportunities earn a higher commission rate.** ## Compensation **Base Pay: $2/hour** ### Company-Sourced Prospects **20% of net collected client revenue** At the standard $9,500 engagement price, this represents approximately **$1,900 in commission before applicable transaction-specific deductions.** ### Advisor-Sourced Prospects **25% of net collected client revenue** At the standard $9,500 engagement price, this represents approximately **$2,375 in commission before applicable transaction-specific deductions.** Commission is paid on **net collected client revenue**. Net collected client revenue means client payments actually received, less applicable transaction-specific charges such as payment-processing fees, currency-conversion fees, refunds, chargebacks, and similar direct transaction costs. Lead source is established when the prospect enters the company lead system. Company-generated prospects are identified and classified when added to the lead database. Advisor-generated prospects must be submitted and validated before outreach begins. **Lead source is determined by the earliest validated entry in the lead database.** ## Schedule **Initial schedule: 10 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase to 15–20 hours per week based on demonstrated performance and pipeline development.** This role has room to grow for an Advisor who consistently develops pipeline, conducts strong sales conversations, follows up professionally, and closes business. ## DO NOT APPLY Unless You Meet the Criteria This role is not a fit if your sales experience consists primarily of: * inbound leads * customer service * warm leads only * appointment setting without closing responsibility * reading scripts without conducting real sales conversations * high-volume transactional sales with little interaction with business decision-makers * relying completely on company-provided leads We need someone who can confidently sell a sophisticated professional service to business leaders. ## Strong Candidates Will Have * proven B2B sales experience * experience developing their own pipeline * experience selling services, solutions, consulting, or other high-value B2B offerings * experience communicating with Directors, VPs, executives, or other senior decision-makers * strong discovery and qualification skills * excellent written English * strong spoken English * disciplined follow-up habits * professional objection-handling skills * experience closing business rather than simply setting meetings * evidence of measurable sales results * strong professional judgment * ability to quickly learn a specialized professional-services offering and communicate its value clearly Experience selling consulting, advisory services, leadership development, HR solutions, organizational development, transformation services, professional services, executive education, or similar B2B offerings is especially relevant. ## Application Questions Please answer every question. Generic applications will not be considered. 1. How many years of direct B2B sales experience do you have? 2. What products or services have you personally sold? 3. Who were your typical buyers or decision-makers? 4. What was the typical price of the offer you sold? 5. Were you responsible for generating your own leads, working company-provided leads, or both? 6. Describe how you build a prospect list when no leads are provided. 7. Approximately how many outbound prospecting activities did you complete each week? 8. Approximately how many qualified sales conversations did you generate? 9. What percentage of your previous role involved closing versus appointment setting? 10. Describe your strongest example of a B2B sale you personally sourced and closed from beginning to end. 11. What do you say when a prospect tells you, **“Let me think about it”?** 12. What do you do when a prospect expresses interest and then stops responding? 13. How would you approach selling a $9,500 professional-services engagement to a Director, VP, or executive? 14. What evidence can you provide that demonstrates your actual sales performance? 15. Why does this opportunity interest you? ## About the Opportunity Organizations are under increasing pressure to deliver results while managing workload, competing priorities, organizational change, burnout, and accelerating demands. The Burnout & Sustainable Performance Operating Review helps leadership teams understand what is creating unsustainable pressure, identify what leadership can change, and take practical action before burnout begins affecting performance, engagement, decision quality, or key talent. We are building this practice deliberately and are looking for a strong B2B Sales Advisor who wants to help grow the client base, earn meaningful commission, and expand their role as performance is demonstrated.

title: Crypto Business Development Manager | Partnerships & Appointment Setting
job_title: Crypto Business Development Manager | Partnerships & Appointment Setting
description: How to apply Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send: 1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week. 2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects. 3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?" 4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send. 5. Your Telegram handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date. Subject line must start with: BOND OPS At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer. About GMI GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more). LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning ---------- % APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped. Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit. We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar. The role One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week. The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis. This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output. The metric Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+. A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified. Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds. What you own 1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30. 2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach. 3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not. 4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage: A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a Telegram group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing. B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline. C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting." D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep. E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks. 5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. 6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d ---------- , and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete. 7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder. If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker. Time allocation A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up. First 30 days (paid trial) Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace. Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale. Compensation A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked Partnership revenue, two lanes: D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling). E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal. F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both) H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start Requirements A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers E. Organized: CRMs, trackers, Telegram, X, LinkedIn, email, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy) F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8 G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call Working standards Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

Canva, CapCut, Adobe or whatever you are best with. - Plan, launch and manage Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads and Google ads: audiences, creatives, budgets, tracking, reporting. Tell us what is working and what to stop. - Manage and improve our WordPress website: update pages, add vacancies, build landing pages, fix what is broken, keep it fast and looking good, basic SEO. - Write and send email campaigns to support coordinators and referrers, and build the contact list. - Keep our listings current on Housing Hub, Nest and Google Business Profile. - Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, image and video generators, scheduling and automation tools) every day to move faster. - Report weekly: reach, engagement, leads, ad spend, enquiries, what you changed and why. Australian audience, so no American spelling and no AI sounding copy. - You already use AI tools in your work and can explain how. - Healthcare, aged care, disability or NDIS marketing experience is a big plus. - Self managed. You bring the plan, we approve it, you run it. - Available Monday to Friday, Sydney business hours, with a one hour lunch break. - Own computer that can handle design and video work, stable internet with a backup, quiet workspace. WHAT YOU GET - PHP 50,000 to 90,000 a month depending on experience and portfolio, plus 13th month pay. Paid monthly. - Long term, full time, direct hire. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word BONDI so we know you read this. Attach your CV as a PDF. Then answer these four questions. Short, specific answers please. We have an empty room in a supported independent living house in Mittagong, NSW, and we need it filled in 30 days. What would you do, step by step? 4. Which AI tools do you use every week and what do you use each one for? We reply to every applicant who follows the instructions. title: Graphic Designer + Video Editor
description: ABOUT US We are an established North American ecommerce company, sixteen years old, selling reusable, sustainable products directly to consumers. We are small, we move fast, and we have been profitable and independent the whole way. We want a Design person who would like to own the Graphic Design department of our business. SCHEDULE Work your own daytime hours in the Philippines. We need 2 to 4 hours of overlap with our mornings in North American Eastern Time, which is roughly 9pm to 1am Manila time, so we can review work and get revisions back same day. THE HONEST SHAPE OF THIS JOB This is a graphic design job with a daily video routine attached. The video side is not hard. We edit in ---------- (check it out, if you haven't) , which is text based editing, so cutting a video is mostly deleting the sentences you do not want. There are no complex transitions, no motion graphics, no colour grading. It is cut, cut, cut, assemble, caption, publish. If you have never used Descript, we will teach you in a day. All of these videos go on our Social Media channels that have a combined following of 600,000 people. We use the same + some additional videos to make ads. The design side is where we need you to be genuinely good. Packaging, ad creative, product page graphics, email. That is where your portfolio has to earn it. Expect your week to be roughly 40 percent video and publishing, 60 percent design. WHAT YOU WILL OWN 1. DAILY VIDEO AND PUBLISHING - Around 10 new video cuts per week, edited in Descript from raw footage of our founder talking to camera - Repurpose and reformat existing videos so we have 2 posts going out per day - Add captions, on-screen text, music and simple graphics - Upload and schedule everything in Metricool for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn - Write the social captions for each video and put them in a shared Google Drive doc, then send the link over so the Instagram and Facebook posts can go out ---------- from the app - Occasional longer horizontal edits for YouTube 2. PAID AD CREATIVE - Static image ads for Meta, built from product photography, customer reviews and product benefits - Multiple variations and sizes of each concept so we can test properly - Video ad cutdowns from footage we already have 3. WEBSITE AND EMAIL GRAPHICS You are not building or redesigning the website. You are designing the things that go on it. If you have UI/UX experience - fantastic!! - Product page graphics: infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, how-to-use visuals - Homepage and collection banners, campaign and landing page graphics - Email graphics, banners and templates - Product photo retouching and clean-up - Everything mobile first, because most of our customers are on their phones 4. PACKAGING AND PRINT - Edits and updates to existing packaging artwork and dielines - New packaging for new products, working from our specs - Inserts, hang tags, labels, care instruction cards, thank you cards - Print ready files: correct bleed, CMYK, and files a manufacturer will not send back You will also keep our brand assets organized so we stop losing files, and keep everything looking like it came from the same company. WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE - A portfolio of real design work. This is the thing that d ---------- it. We want to see packaging or print alongside digital work if you have both. - Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. You need to be genuinely fast in both. - Print and packaging experience. You know what a dieline is, you set up bleed correctly, and you understand what a printer or manufacturer needs from you. - An eye for what sells. Our ads and product graphics have a job to do. Pretty is not enough. - Written English good enough to write our social captions. Your captions go out under our brand name. - A reliable computer and internet that can handle moving large video files without you losing half a day to it. - Curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to build them into your workflow. We want you faster, not replaced. ON VIDEO EXPERIENCE: it is a bonus, not a requirement. We are not asking for a showreel. Descript is genuinely easy and we will teach you. If you have edited video before, tell us. If you have not, that will not count against you. ON DEGREES: a design or fine arts education is a plus, not a requirement. We will read every portfolio properly regardless of what is on your resume. ON EXPERIENCE: more is better, but we are open to someone fresh out of university, or still in it. We have hired people at that stage before and it worked out well. If your work is good, apply. NICE TO HAVE - Descript, or any text based video editor - Premiere Pro or After Effects for the occasional heavier edit - Figma - Familiarity with Shopify page and section design - Klaviyo or any email platform - Experience working with a direct to consumer brand or an ecommerce store WHO THIS JOB IS NOT FOR - Anyone who skims. We are detail people, and this job is full of details that cost real money if you miss them, like a bleed setting or a wrong price on a package. So here is the check: start your application with the word mango, in lowercase. It is the only place we mention it, and we will not remind you again further down. Applications without it get deleted without being read. - Anyone who needs a creative director to hand them a brief. Nobody here is going to art direct you. You get the product, the footage and the goal, and you come back with the work. - Anyone who is going to be quietly running four other clients at the same time. This is a full time job. - Anyone who wants to only design and never touch the video routine. The daily publishing has to happen, every day, and it is part of the job. HOW TO APPLY There are two steps, and step one is quick on purpose. We do not want you spending hours on a task before we have even seen your work. STEP 1, RIGHT NOW: send us your portfolio and your answers to the questions below. Your portfolio. A link we can open without asking permission. Show us design work. If any piece was made with AI tools, say so next to it. We do not mind AI in the process, we mind being misled. The questions. Short answers are fine, honest answers are better. Please don't use AI for the answers - we can detect it easily. We want you to write in your own words. 1. Rank these four from your strongest to your weakest: packaging and print, static ad design, website and email graphics, video editing. Then tell us what you enjoy the most and why 2. Tell us about one thing you designed that had a job to do, like selling something or explaining something, and how you knew whether it worked. If it's something you did in university or for a client, please attach it with explanations. 3. Walk us through one packaging or print file you have prepared. What was it, what were the specs, and did it come back from the printer correctly the first time? If you have never done print work, say so and tell us about the most technically demanding file you have prepared instead. 4. Have you edited video before? If yes, what software and how long does a 60 second vertical video with captions take you. If no, just say no. 5. Which of these do you have you worked on before and for what purpose: Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Figma, Canva, Descript? STEP 2, ONLY IF WE LIKE YOUR PORTFOLIO AND YOUR ANSWERS: a short test task will be given to you. If your work is a fit, we will get in touch and send you a task that takes about 2 hours, using our real files. One static ad, one packaging text change, and one short video cut. Nobody gets asked to do this until we have looked at their portfolio and d ---------- we are interested, because we do not want to waste your time either. WHAT WORKING HERE IS LIKE Our founder & Operations Manager will be your main point of contact and the folks who will approve your work. We move fast, we say what we think, and we would rather you tell us an idea is bad than quietly make it. We will invest in your growth. Most people who work with us stay with us for 3 years minimum. We are looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with business. Most of our team has been with us for years, and we would like this position to be that too.

You keep your own list of everything in motion and you never need to be reminded. You are the person who makes sure everyone is doing their job properly, and you do it with warmth and confidence so people want to help you. You are comfortable calling an Australian government agency or a hospital discharge team and getting an answer. You will also own the NDIS paperwork: service agreements, client intake, staff compliance documents, and keeping ShiftCare and SharePoint tidy and current. We want someone who has done this before at executive level, uses their own judgement, and does not need to be told twice. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Chase. Staff, managers, families, support coordinators, agencies and suppliers, by phone, email and text, until it is done. Then confirm it is done. - Keep a running list of every task, promise and deadline in the business and make sure none of them are missed. - Run the Director's inbox and calendar, reply on his behalf, and protect his time. - Handle business and personal admin: bookings, suppliers, bills, appointments, travel, anything that takes time off his plate. - Prepare and file NDIS paperwork: service agreements, intake and consent forms, risk assessments, care plans. - Keep staff files up to date (police checks, NDIS worker screening, first aid, training) and chase renewals before they expire. - Draft emails, letters and simple reports in clear Australian English. - Support invoicing and basic bookkeeping in Xero. - Keep records in ShiftCare and SharePoint accurate and complete. - Over time, take on more: coordinating the team, tracking projects, and running processes so the Director does not have to. WHAT WE NEED - At least 3 years as an executive assistant or senior virtual assistant for an Australian, UK or US business owner or executive. - You have worked in ShiftCare and SharePoint before. This is a must. Tell us where and what you did in them. - NDIS experience is strongly preferred. If you have worked for an Australian disability, aged care or home care provider, tell us in your application. - Confident on the phone. You will call Australians every day, including people who do not want to be chased, and you can be friendly and firm at the same time. - Excellent written and spoken English. You will be writing to families and government agencies. - Sharp, organised and relentless. You answer messages the same day, you notice what has been missed, and you do not let things slip. - A professional, warm personality. People should enjoy dealing with you and still do what you asked. - Comfortable with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams), Xero and WhatsApp. - Available Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Sydney time (6am to 4pm Manila, one hour earlier during Australian daylight saving), with a one hour lunch break. - Own computer, stable internet with a backup, quiet workspace. WHAT YOU GET - PHP 55,000 to 100,000 a month depending on experience, plus 13th month pay. Paid monthly. - Long term, full time, direct hire. No agency in between. - Paid Philippine public holidays and paid annual leave after probation. - A boss who will train you, trust you, and give you more responsibility as you prove yourself. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word MASCOT so we know you read this. Attach your CV as a PDF. Then answer these four questions. Short, specific answers please. No generic cover letters. 1. Tell us about the business owner or executive you supported most recently. What did a normal day look like and what did you take off their plate? 2. Which NDIS provider did you use ShiftCare and SharePoint for, and what exactly did you do in each? Name any other NDIS admin you have done. 3. A support worker's first aid certificate expires in 7 days and she has ignored two messages. What do you do, step by step, and what do you say when you get her on the phone? 4. What is your internet speed (speedtest.net screenshot) and what backup do you have if power or internet drops? We reply to every applicant who follows the instructions. Shortlisted applicants will get a short email task, then a video interview with the Director.

title: Construction Employer Outreach and Recruitment Specialist
job_title: Construction Employer Outreach and Recruitment Specialist
description: We are seeking a confident, persistent, and professional Virtual Assistant to contact construction companies and recruit contractors willing to hire graduates from our construction training program. Our trainees receive hands on construction training and will be prepared for entry level construction employment after graduation. The Virtual Assistant will be responsible for building relationships with construction employers and securing signed participation agreements from companies that have legitimate hiring needs. Project Goal The first phase of this project must be completed within 7 to 10 days. During this period, the Virtual Assistant must secure signed participation agreements from 20 qualified construction contractors who are willing to interview and hire eligible program graduates at a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour. Responsibilities • Research qualified construction companies and contractors • Make outbound calls to business owners, hiring managers, and other decision makers • Introduce our construction training and job placement program • Explain the skills and preparation trainees receive • Identify contractors with current or upcoming hiring needs • Confirm that contractors are willing and able to pay at least $21 per hour • Secure completed and signed contractor participation agreements • Collect all required employer information and documentation • Schedule follow up calls with interested contractors • Maintain accurate records of every call, contact, response, and follow up date • Provide regular progress reports throughout the project • Follow up with contractors when graduates are ready for interviews and placement • Help track graduate employment through the 90 day retention period Contractor Requirements To qualify toward the project goal, each contractor must: • Operate a legitimate construction business • Have a current or upcoming need for workers • Agree to consider, interview, or hire qualified program graduates • Agree to pay hired graduates a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour • Complete and sign the required contractor participation agreement • Provide accurate company and hiring information Contractor contact information without a completed and verified participation agreement will not count toward the project goal. Qualifications • Strong spoken and written English • Confident and professional telephone presence • Experience with outbound calling, recruiting, appointment setting, sales, or lead generation • Comfortable speaking with construction company owners and hiring managers • Strong organizational and follow up skills • Able to work independently and meet strict deadlines • Able to complete a high volume of calls within 7 to 10 days • Comfortable working in a performance based position • Experience in construction recruiting, workforce development, or employer outreach is preferred, but not required Compensation This is a performance based independent contract position with total earning potential of $2,500. • $1,000 after 20 qualified construction contractors sign the required participation agreements within 7 to 10 days • $1,000 after eligible program graduates are hired by participating contractors at a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour • $500 completion bonus after the hired graduates successfully complete 90 days of employment and all required documentation has been submitted All results must be verified before payment is issued. Incomplete agreements, invalid companies, duplicate contractors, or contact information without signed agreements will not qualify for payment. To Apply Please provide the following: • A brief introduction • A summary of your outbound calling, recruiting, or lead generation experience • A short voice recording introducing yourself to a construction company • Your availability and time zone • The number of outbound calls you can complete each day • Examples of similar projects or results • Confirmation that you understand this is a performance based position We are looking for someone who is persuasive, organized, professional, and capable of producing verified results within the required timeline.

job_title: Marketing Coordinator – Freelance | Australian Education Start-Up

Only complete applications will be reviewed. Due to expected volume, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Bookkeeper
