A GHL snapshot built and deployed into a new sub-account 10. A landing page built in GHL to match a specific ad campaign 11. An email or SMS template designed in GHL that matched a client's brand 12. A form built, submitted live by you, and confirmed to have created the contact 13. A calendar and booking page set up and styled in GHL 14. A simple workflow wired behind your own page: form submitted, notification, redirect 15. Meta Pixel installed on a GHL funnel and verified in Events Manager 16. Google Tag Manager installed on a GHL site and a tag verified as firing 17. A client domain pointed at a GHL site or funnel (A record or CNAME, root vs subdomain, SSL) 18. A membership area or client portal styled in GHL 19. A page designed in Figma or similar first, then rebuilt faithfully in GHL 20. Handover documentation written for a build so someone else could maintain it 3. THREE LIVE URLS YOU BUILT IN GOHIGHLEVEL. This is the most important answer in your application. Three links we can open right now. For each one tell us: what it is, what you built versus what you inherited, and the one thing on that page you are least happy with. If a site has since been taken down or rebuilt by someone else, say so and send a screenshot instead. If everything you have built is behind a client login, send screenshots and be ready to open the builder live at the interview. We are looking at layout, mobile, and whether it looks like GoHighLevel. Be honest about which parts were a template. A well chosen template well executed is a legitimate answer. A template you are pretending you designed is not, and we will spot it. 4. THE CSS QUESTION. Give us one real example where the GoHighLevel drag and drop builder could not do what the design needed, and you solved it with custom CSS or a code block. What was the problem and roughly what did you write? If you have never had to do this, write NEVER and say so plainly. 5. THE MOBILE QUESTION. You have built a client site in GHL. On desktop it is perfect. On an iPhone the hero text sits on top of the image, the call to action button is below the fold, and the form fields are cut off. Walk us through what you check and what you change, in order. 6. FIX THIS PAGE. Pick any website you did not build, from a tradesperson or home service business in any country. Send us the URL. Then tell us the three things you would change first, in order, and why that order. One of the three should be about whether the page converts, not only how it looks. 7. THROUGHPUT, YOUR NUMBER AND YOUR EMAIL. - How many client sub-accounts are you actively building in right now? - Pick one real build you finished: the date you got the brief, the date it went live, and the number of working days you personally spent on it. If it took three weeks, write three weeks. We are calibrating how you work, not only how fast you are. - What you design in before you build, if anything: Figma, Canva, paper, or straight into the builder. There is no wrong answer, we want to know how you work. - The monthly PHP figure you are working for right now, and the figure you would need to commit to us full time and exclusively. If those are two different numbers, say so. - An email address we can reach you on. This platform's messaging has gone down on us before. HOW TO WRITE THIS Write it yourself. We are going to be straight with you about why we care. In our last round, the single most impressive written application we received named exact tools and exact failure modes. It read like someone who had done the work for years. In the live interview, that same person could not name one tracking tool and had no example he could open. The application had almost certainly been written by an AI. We did not shortlist him and we both lost an afternoon. Plain English with a typo in it beats a polished paragraph that says nothing. Use AI to fix your spelling if you like. If it writes your answers, it will show up in the first three minutes of the interview, because we open your own work and ask you about your own decisions.

description: ABOUT US We are an Australian digital marketing agency. Open the execution logs, find the step that failed, work out whether it is the trigger, the filter, the data or the integration, and fix it AI inside GoHighLevel. The other half of the seat. - Conversation AI, voice AI, booking bots and the AI employee features. You build that guardrail in and you prove it holds - You use AI in your own work every day. We give you a Claude account. You use it to draft, debug and document faster, and you know when not to trust it Build in GoHighLevel. On day one you get a written standard describing exactly what good delivery looks like in this seat. At 60 days we review your delivery against that written standard. We would rather you d ---------- it is not for you today than discover something you did not expect in week three. - This is an independent contractor engagement. It is not employment. You invoice us each pay period and we pay the invoice. - You are responsible for your own tax and any local statutory contributions. We do not withhold tax. We are telling you this in the ad rather than letting you find it out later. - You are paid twice a month, in PHP, by Wise. - Hours are 7:00am to 3:30pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. 40 hours a week. - Full time and exclusive for the engagement. Exclusive means what it says: while you are engaged with us you do not hold other retained clients and you do not work for another agency, evenings and weekends included. If you have existing commitments, tell us at application stage. - 3 month probation. - There is a PAID test task before any offer, and for this seat it is a real workflow build in a sandbox sub-account. We pay you for the time you spend on it, whether or not we make you an offer. - Your equipment and your internet are yours: your own computer, a reliable connection at 25 Mbps or better, a backup connection, and a plan for power outages. - Either side can end the engagement with two weeks written notice. That happens and it is fine. - If you do not turn up and you did not tell us, your application is closed. In our last round more than half the people we booked did not attend. The actual back end, live. - So do not claim anything you cannot open. There is no penalty for a small amount of experience honestly described. HOW TO APPLY Line one of your application must read: TRIGGER followed by the number of GoHighLevel workflows you have personally built and turned on. Example: TRIGGER 46 Applications that do not start this way are not read. That is the only trick in this ad and we have just told you what it is. Then seven things. Meta Conversions API with event_id deduplication 18. UTM, GCLID and fbclid captured into contact custom fields 19. SPF, DKIM and DMARC set for LC Email or Mailgun on a client domain 20. A funnel page built in the GHL builder and made genuinely mobile responsive 3. ONE WORKFLOW YOU BUILT. Name it. Then tell us: - what triggers it, exactly - what the filters or conditions on that trigger are - what each step does, in order - what happens if the contact replies halfway through - one thing about it you would build differently now Write it as steps. Rough is fine. This is the answer we read first. 4. ONE PIPELINE YOU DESIGNED END TO END. description: We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required APPLY HERE: ---------- / ---------- Email: ---------- About Allied Health Media Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins. Do Not Apply If... You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms. You don't have a background or practical experience in web development. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture. Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures. Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability. Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup. Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes. Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches. Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking. Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection. Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off. Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site. Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports. Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks. Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content. Skills and Tools Required At least two years of practical SEO experience. Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation. Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact. Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures. Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals. Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply. Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager. Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush. Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools. title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant (Accounting Degree Required)
job_title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant (Accounting Degree Required)
description: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required ***About the Role We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses. This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting. You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder. This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others. We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility. You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group. **Key Responsibilities 1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including: • Bank and credit card reconciliations • Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight • Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations • Intercompany transactions and reconciliations • Balance sheet reconciliations • Fixed asset and accounting schedules • Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation • Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies • Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records • Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required. 2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts Take full ownership of the month-end process, including: • Month-end journals • Accruals and prepayments • Payroll reconciliations • Balance sheet reconciliations • Intercompany reconciliations • Revenue and expense cut-off • Review of P&L and balance sheet • Investigation of unusual movements • Preparation of management accounts • Month-end management commentary • Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task. 3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow • Prepare and maintain annual budgets • Maintain rolling forecasts • Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast • Monitor actual results against budget • Analyse and explain material variances • Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks • Monitor working capital • Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues • Recommend practical actions based on financial results 4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group. This includes: • Gross profit by client • Gross profit by employee • Gross profit by team/division • Gross profit by business entity • Client revenue versus labour cost • Actual hours/cost versus client budget • Employee utilisation and productivity • Revenue and cost per employee • Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas • Identification of scope creep and cost overruns • Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies • Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change. 5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group. Responsibilities include: • Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards • Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data • Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP% • Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity • Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost • Monitor employee utilisation and productivity • Track budget versus actual performance • Monitor cash flow and working capital • Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts • Maintain historical KPI trends • Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention • Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance • Provide concise management commentary and recommendations • Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group. This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports. 6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including: • Insurance renewals • Professional and business licence renewals • Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals • Finance and loan documentation • Subscription and contract renewals • Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar • Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance • Obtaining information and quotations where required • Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation • Escalating matters requiring management approval An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up. 7. Founder / Personal Finance Support Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including: • Personal cash flow and financial reporting • Investment and property-related accounting records • Loan and finance schedules • Personal financial administration • Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning • Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential. 8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement • Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems • Reduce unnecessary manual work • Identify opportunities for automation • Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency • Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled • Document important finance processes • Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth **What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis. You should have: • Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent • CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded • Strong Australian accounting experience • Strong management accounting experience • Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close • Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience • Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills • Advanced Excel skills • Strong Xero experience • Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills • Experience working across multiple entities • Strong attention to detail • Strong written and verbal communication skills • Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills • High level of confidentiality and professional judgement • Ability to work independently with limited supervision **The Person We Want We are looking for someone who: • Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions • Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion • Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why • Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis • Is willing to remain hands-on • Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment • Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems • Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks • Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent • Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes • Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes • Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information **Key Measures of Success Success in this position will include: • Accurate and timely month-end closing • Reliable management accounts • Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts • Reliable budget versus actual reporting • Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting • Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area • Reliable KPI dashboards • Early identification and escalation of financial risks • Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility • No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines • Improved finance processes, controls and automation • Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up **The Opportunity This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group. For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: Project Coordinator- Construction
company: Maybridge Development LLC dba Maybridge Construction
description: IMMEDIATE HIRING: PROJECT COORDINATOR — CONSTRUCTION Remote | Full-Time | Maybridge Development LLC | North Carolina-Based Government Construction Company WE ARE HIRING IMMEDIATELY We are looking for a Project Coordinator with construction experience to join our growing team. This is a fast-moving position for someone who is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and moves with urgency. Your goal is simple: Help us move the needle. We do not want someone who waits to be told what to do every step of the way. We need someone who can look at what is happening across our projects, identify what needs attention, take action, follow up with the right people, and keep things moving. If you are someone who naturally thinks: “What needs to happen next?” —you may be a great fit for this position. ABOUT MAYBRIDGE Maybridge Development LLC is a growing North Carolina-based government construction company specializing in construction, restoration, energy efficiency, and government contracting. We work on projects for government agencies and are building a company with strong systems, processes, and a high standard of execution. Because we are growing quickly, we need people who can keep up with the pace of the company. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES As Project Coordinator, you will be responsible for keeping projects, documentation, communication, and administrative processes organized and moving forward. Your responsibilities include: • Coordinate project activities, deadlines, and deliverables • Track open tasks and follow up until they are completed • Monitor project status and identify items that are falling behind • Coordinate communication between Project Managers, field staff, subcontractors, vendors, and internal team members • Maintain accurate project files and documentation • Review contracts, work orders, proposals, reports, invoices, and other project documents • Review documents for accuracy, completeness, grammar, and inconsistencies • Prepare and organize bid and proposal documentation • Track outstanding documentation and follow up with responsible team members • Coordinate site visit scheduling and project-related logistics • Maintain project management systems and update project information • Track project requirements and deadlines • Support project closeout and ensure required documentation is completed • Identify gaps in our processes and bring them to leadership's attention • Help create, improve, and maintain company SOPs and workflows • Conduct administrative and project audits • Monitor whether team members are following established processes • Communicate issues quickly when something is off track • Complete administrative and operational projects assigned by leadership • Support company communications and social media updates when needed CONSTRUCTION EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED You must have some previous experience in construction or a closely related industry. However, you should already understand basic construction terminology and how construction projects operate. You should be familiar with things such as: • Scope of work • Work orders • Contracts • Bid proposals • Change orders • Subcontractors • Project schedules • Site visits • Punch lists • Project documentation • Invoices • Project closeout We do not want to spend months teaching someone the basics of construction. You should be able to enter a construction environment and understand what you are looking at. WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO: Moves with urgency. This is one of the most important qualities we are looking for. You should be someone who: • Responds quickly • Takes action without constant direction • Follows through • Notices when something is missing • Follows up without being asked • Doesn't let tasks sit unnecessarily • Can prioritize competing deadlines • Learns fairly quickly • Is highly organized • Has strong attention to detail • Communicates clearly • Can work independently • Is comfortable being held accountable • Looks for solutions instead of simply identifying problems • Wants to grow with a company You do not need to be bubbly or overly outgoing. We care about urgency, accuracy, ownership, communication, and execution. THIS IS NOT A "WAIT FOR INSTRUCTIONS" JOB If your working style is: “I finished what I was assigned, so now I'll wait.” This probably isn't the right position for you. We want someone who sees an unfinished task and thinks: “This needs to get done. Who do I need to contact? What information am I missing? What can I do right now to move this forward?” That mindset is extremely important to us. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS We move quickly, and we believe performance should be evaluated based on actual results. You will have a 30-day performance review. During your first 30 days, we will evaluate: • Speed and urgency • Accuracy • Follow-through • Communication • Organization • Ability to learn our systems • Ability to work independently • Ability to manage multiple priorities • Initiative • Overall contribution to the team We want to know one thing: Are you helping us move the needle? SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE Experience with any of the following is a plus: • Fieldwire • Procore • Buildertrend • ---------- • Asana • ClickUp • Microsoft Office • Google Workspace • Slack You do not need to know every system. You do need to be comfortable learning new software quickly. THIS POSITION IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU IF... You enjoy being the person who keeps things organized. You like solving problems. You notice details other people miss. You don't need someone checking on you every hour. You like a fast-paced environment. You want to grow into greater responsibility. And most importantly, you take pride in getting things done. HOW TO APPLY Please send: 1. Your resume 2. A voice recording  Tell us about yourself  A brief description of your construction experience  The construction/project management software you have used Answer this question in your application: You are reviewing a construction project and notice that an important document is missing, a team member has not completed an assigned task, and a deadline is approaching. What would you do? We are looking for how you think and how you take action, not a textbook answer. Applications that do not answer this question will not be considered. ONE LAST THING We are a growing company. That means there will be a lot to do, priorities will change, and there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Maybridge, not someone who is simply looking for another job. If you are smart, organized, fast-moving, and ready to contribute, we want to hear from you.

description: Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter Full Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia Time QPC Group is an established Australian office technology company providing Managed Print Services, printers and photocopiers, VoIP phone systems and other business technology solutions. We are looking for an experienced B2B outbound cold caller and appointment setter. This is a pure HUNTER role. There are ZERO leads provided to you. You will be responsible for researching your target market, building your own prospect lists, identifying the correct decision-makers, cold calling businesses and generating qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team. If your experience is primarily answering inbound calls, working supplied leads or calling warm databases, this role is not for you. What You Will Do You will be given the industries and target markets we want to pursue. From there, you own the process. You will be responsible for: * Researching businesses within our target markets. * Creating and maintaining your own prospecting lists. * Using LinkedIn and other online sources to research businesses. * Identifying the correct decision-maker within each organisation. * Understanding which job titles to target depending on the business. * Finding IT Managers, IT Directors, Owners, General Managers, Purchasing/Procurement Officers, Office Managers and other relevant decision-makers. * Researching names, company details, phone numbers and other useful information before calling. * Calling businesses completely cold. * Asking for the decision-maker by name wherever possible, rather than simply asking reception who handles something. * Navigating receptionists and gatekeepers professionally. * Speaking confidently with Australian businesses. * Starting conversations and uncovering opportunities. * Identifying pain points and potential requirements. * Generating qualified leads. * Booking appointments directly for our Sales Team. * Recording accurate prospect and call information. * Following up prospects when appropriate. This Is 100% Outbound Cold Calling We want to be extremely clear about this. We will NOT provide you with leads to call. You need to know how to go from: Target Market → Research → Company → Decision-Maker → Contact Details → Cold Call → Conversation → Qualified Appointment We are looking for someone who has done this extensively before. You need to genuinely enjoy prospecting and cold calling. You should be comfortable hearing “no”, making another call and continuing until you find an opportunity. We don’t want someone who waits for leads. We want a hunter who creates them. You Must Have * Extensive previous B2B outbound cold-calling experience. * Proven appointment-setting experience. * Experience creating your own prospecting/call lists. * Strong LinkedIn research skills. * Ability to identify decision-makers based on job titles and company structures. * Excellent spoken English. * Confidence speaking with Australian business customers. * Strong communication and questioning skills. * Experience navigating gatekeepers. * Ability to work independently. * Strong research skills. * Confidence working to activity and appointment targets. * Resilience and persistence. Please only apply if you have extensive experience doing this type of work. Working Hours This is a full-time position: Monday to Friday 9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time You must be available for the full shift. IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required Because this is a telephone-based sales position, your voice recording is an essential part of your application. Please record yourself delivering the following as though you were speaking to a real Australian business prospect: “Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. We are an office technology company. We provide managed print services and VoIP phone systems. I’d love to know which one’s your biggest pain point in your office to see how we can help you today.” Don’t rush through it or simply read the words. We want to hear your natural telephone voice, confidence, energy and spoken English. How to Apply Your application MUST have the following subject line: Outbound Sales Genius Please include: 1. Your voice recording using the script above. 2. A summary of your previous B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience. 3. Explain how you have previously built your own prospect lists and found decision-makers. 4. Your CV/resume. 5. Your internet speeds and backup plan for power and internet outages . 6. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Perth time. Minimum Apply Points: 3 Applications using fewer than 3 Apply Points will not be considered. If you’re an experienced outbound salesperson who knows how to research a market, find the right person, pick up the phone and create opportunities from absolutely nothing, we’d like to hear from you.

title: SEO Manager
description: Reports to: SEO Director Location: Remote Purpose of the Role The SEO Manager leads a team of SEO specialists while owning day-to-day SEO strategy and execution for a portfolio of dental practices, driving more high-value patients through organic and local search. This is a true people-management role: the SEO Manager sets direction for the executional team, holds them accountable to quality and deadlines, and develops their skills. They turn client goals into clear SEO plans, own the website strategy and information architecture behind organic performance, and build the systems that let the department deliver consistently at scale. They work within the organization's established processes and brand standards, and partner with account, content, and dev teams to deliver measurable growth in leads. Scope of Ownership Leadership and performance management of an executional SEO team (specialists/coordinators), including workload, quality, and professional development. Organic and local SEO performance for assigned dental clients. Keyword, content, and on-site optimization strategy tied to priority services and locations. Website strategy and information architecture for new builds, redesigns, and ongoing site improvements — sitemap and service-page structure, URL hierarchy, internal linking, redirects, migrations, page prioritization, and final SEO QA before and after launch. Local search presence (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for each practice. SEO reporting and insights that support client retention and upsell opportunities. The SEO delivery system — the workflows, templates, QA checkpoints, automation, capacity planning, and documentation the department runs on. Consistent application of the organization's SEO methodology, brand guidelines, and documented processes across the team. Core Responsibilities 1. Team Leadership & Management Lead, mentor, and manage a team of SEO specialists—setting clear priorities, assigning work, and ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met. Hold the team accountable for executional output, reviewing work and giving direct, constructive feedback that raises the standard over time. Develop the team's capabilities through coaching, training, and regular one-on-ones; identify skill gaps and close them. Manage capacity and workload across the team to balance client demands with realistic delivery. Own team performance against client outcomes, treating missed deadlines or quality issues as the manager's responsibility to resolve. 2. Strategy & Planning Build and maintain SEO strategies and roadmaps for each client based on goals, competition, and budget. Conduct keyword, SERP, and competitor research to prioritize high-value opportunities (implants, ortho, cosmetic, emergencies, etc.). 3. Website Strategy & Information Architecture Own the SEO strategy behind new websites, redesigns, and ongoing site improvements—translating client goals and search demand into a site structure that ranks and converts. Plan sitemaps and service-page structure, including how services, procedures, and locations are grouped, nested, and prioritized. Define URL hierarchy and naming conventions, and maintain them as sites grow. Design and maintain internal linking architecture that distributes authority to priority pages and supports topical coverage. Plan and QA redirects and site migrations—mapping old to new, protecting rankings and traffic, and validating post-launch. Prioritize pages for build and optimization based on search demand, revenue potential, and competitive opportunity. Run final SEO QA before launch and after go-live (indexation, metadata, headings, schema, internal links, redirects, tracking), and document what shipped. Partner with design, content, and dev on execution in WordPress, working from a clear SEO spec rather than reacting after the build. 4. On-Page & Technical SEO Perform SEO audits and implement on-page optimizations (metadata, headings, copy, internal links, schema). Identify technical issues (indexing, speed, mobile, CWV) and coordinate fixes with dev/WordPress support. 5. Local SEO for Dental Practices Optimize and maintain Google Business Profiles (categories, services, posts, photos, tracking). Oversee citations/NAP consistency and advise on review generation and reputation strategies. 6. Content & Collaboration Create SEO briefs and outlines for new and updated content (service pages, blogs, FAQs, location pages); briefs are informed by SERP analysis and search intent, not just keywords. QA content for SEO best practices before and after publishing, ensuring proper on-page optimization. 7. Reporting & Optimization Build and maintain dashboards and monthly reports (traffic, rankings, GBP metrics, leads). Analyze performance, surface insights, and propose clear next-step optimizations. Join client calls as the SEO voice, explaining results and recommendations in plain language. 8. Process, Systems & Documentation Follow, enforce, and improve the organization's SEO checklists, templates, SOPs, and brand guidelines—ensuring the team works the same way to the same standard. Build and improve scalable workflows across the SEO department so quality holds as client volume grows, rather than depending on individual memory or heroics. Create and maintain templates, checklists, and QA systems that make the right output the default and catch issues before they reach a client. Identify repetitive work and introduce automation or tooling to remove it, freeing the team for strategy and execution that needs a human. Own capacity planning for the department—forecasting workload against team availability, flagging constraints early, and proposing solutions before delivery slips. Document processes, decisions, and standards so the department is transferable, trainable, and not dependent on any one person. Take ownership of the delivery system end to end, so day-to-day monitoring, chasing, and follow-up do not need to come from leadership. Ensure all client-facing and on-site work adheres to organizational guidelines, brand voice, and compliance requirements before it ships. Train account and junior team members on SEO basics relevant to their roles. Support the team's day-to-day work by assisting with research, implementation guidance, QA, and documentation as needed to unblock work and keep projects moving. Success Metrics / KPIs Success in this role is built on consistent execution across five core areas: daily and weekly task ownership, accurate and descriptive time tracking, proactive capacity management, timely follow-up without being prompted, and thorough QA before work moves forward. We value team members who take pride in the details and hold themselves accountable to a high standard before anyone else has to ask. Growth in organic traffic and organic new patient leads for assigned clients. Improved rankings and visibility for priority keywords and local searches in target markets. Increased GBP engagement (calls, website clicks, direction requests) and stable/improved local pack presence. On-time completion of SEO deliverables by the team (audits, optimizations, briefs, reports). Website launches and migrations that protect or improve organic performance, with SEO QA completed before and after go-live. Team performance, growth, and retention—measured by quality of output, adherence to process, and individual development. Measurable improvement in the SEO delivery system—documented workflows, working templates and QA checkpoints, reduced rework, and less day-to-day follow-up required from leadership. Consistent adherence to organizational guidelines and brand standards across all team output. Positive internal and client feedback on clarity of communication and strategic value. Required Skills & Experience Must have reliable and stable internet connection Must be able and willing to work 8am - 12pm EST Monday - Friday to overlap with US team; other 4 hours per day can be completed at your convenience Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, as this role writes client-facing deliverables, joins client calls as the SEO voice, and documents processes for the department. 3–5 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in an agency or lead-generation environment. At least 2+ years directly managing or leading an executional team, with demonstrated ability to assign work, hold people accountable, and develop performance. Experience planning websites and website improvements from an SEO perspective—sitemap and service-page structure, URL hierarchy, internal linking, redirects, migrations, page prioritization, and final SEO QA. Demonstrated experience building or improving team processes—workflows, templates, QA systems, documentation, or automation—not just working inside processes someone else built. Proven ability to work within an organization's established processes, brand standards, and guidelines—and to hold a team to them consistently. Demonstrated success with local SEO for service businesses (healthcare, dental, home services, or similar). Strong understanding of semantic SEO, including search intent, topical coverage, internal linking strategy, and content structure aligned with modern SERPs. Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, a keyword research tool, a site crawler, and a rank tracker. Working knowledge of WordPress (Elementor or similar) and basic HTML best practices, with enough site-level ownership to spec and QA structural changes rather than only requesting them. Experience with capacity planning or workload forecasting across a team. Strong analytical skills and comfort turning data into clear, practical recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with content optimization tools such as SurferSEO, ---------- , NeuronWriter, or similar platforms. Required Leadership Behaviors As SEO Manager you will balance team leadership with direct execution. This means personally jumping into audits, GBP work, on-page optimization, content briefs, internal linking, reporting, and QA alongside managing and developing the team around you. Given the scale of our client portfolio, the right person thrives in a high-volume environment, takes ownership of the delivery system, and keeps things moving without needing direction at every step. Manages and develops people: Leads an executional team directly—sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback, and grows the people on the team. Builds the system, not just the output: Improves how the work gets done—workflows, templates, QA, automation, documentation—so quality scales with volume. Follows and upholds guidelines: Works within the organization's processes and brand standards, and ensures the team does the same; sees consistency as a strength, not a constraint. Ownership: Takes responsibility for SEO outcomes, website performance, and team delivery on assigned accounts; reliably follows through. Collaborative: Partners with account, content, design, and dev to move work forward without friction, and removes blockers for the team. Proactive: Spots issues and opportunities early and brings forward solutions, not just problems. Client-friendly communicator: Explains SEO concepts and results in a way that builds trust and understanding. Growth-oriented: Keeps up with SEO and local search changes and looks for ways to improve client and agency performance. Models accountability: Owns results, follows through on commitments, and addresses issues directly instead of deflecting or blaming. Builds trust: Approachable, transparent, and willing to admit mistakes—then leads the way on solutions. Energizes a remote team: Brings positivity through engaging meetings, creative rituals, and inclusive activities that make work feel fun, not flat. Nice to Haves Experience designing or using SEO automation workflows (e.g., for content production, internal linking, reporting, or local SEO tasks). Experience leading or supporting a website migration or large-scale redesign from the SEO side. Open and curious mindset toward testing and adopting AI- and automation-powered tools to improve content quality, efficiency, and SEO performance.

title: Administrative & Operations Coordinator

Create and maintain task lists, reminders, calendar invites, and project follow-ups. Follow through on assigned responsibilities and provide timely updates on progress. Help ensure tasks do not get lost between meetings, conversations, or different team members. Coordinate with operations, recruiting, marketing, leadership, and other functions as needed. 4. Reporting & Business Support Assist with tracking important business metrics and activities. Help prepare reports and structured updates for leadership. Monitor information such as leads, activities, projects, and campaign progress. Keep information organized so leadership and the team have visibility into what is happening. 5. Marketing & Light Creative Support Assist with content organization, research, and basic marketing activities. Support social media updates, analytics tracking, and content planning. Assist with transcription of audio or video content and newsletter preparation when needed. Conduct research on trends, content ideas, and potential marketing opportunities. 6. Customer & Client Administrative Support Assist with collecting client feedback and coordinating review requests. Help identify missing follow-ups or gaps in client communication. Support administrative activities that contribute to an organized and positive client experience. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration & General Support Work collaboratively with leadership and different areas of the business rather than operating independently from the team. Participate in team conversations, meetings, and shared initiatives. Communicate openly about progress, questions, challenges, and opportunities to help. Provide administrative support across recruiting, operations, marketing, and leadership without necessarily owning those functions. Help organize workflows, monitor deliverables, and maintain internal systems. Step in and support teammates when appropriate and when priorities shift. What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate is: Highly collaborative and team-oriented – enjoys working with people, contributing to conversations, and being part of a shared goal. Proactive – notices what needs attention and takes initiative instead of always waiting for instructions. Organized and detail-oriented – able to manage multiple moving pieces without losing track of important details. Reliable with follow-through – takes ownership of commitments and closes the loop. Communicative – provides updates, asks questions, and raises concerns early. Adaptable – comfortable supporting different areas of the business as priorities evolve. People-focused – understands that relationships and teamwork are just as important as completing individual tasks. Comfortable with technology – able to learn and work within CRM, project management, communication, and productivity tools. Success in This Role Success is not measured only by how many tasks are completed. We are looking for someone who becomes a trusted and engaged member of the team. The right person will help keep the business organized while also building strong working relationships, communicating consistently, contributing ideas, supporting teammates, and taking shared ownership of the team's success. How to Apply: Please submit the following: - Your updated resume - Your availability and expected hourly/monthly rate - A 60–90 second self-introduction video sharing: Your experience as an Admin Assistant Subject Line: Admin – [Your Name] Important: Only applications submitted within 48–72 hours of this posting will be considered. We look forward to meeting a highly organized Admin Assistant professional who can become a trusted right hand to the executive team.

title: Client Care & Inside Sales Coordinator – $6/Hour + Benefits & Performance Incentives | Growth Path to Office Manager
job_title: Client Care & Inside Sales Coordinator – $6/Hour + Benefits & Performance Incentives | Growth Path to Office Manager
description: Client Care & Inside Sales Coordinator – $6/Hour + Benefits & Performance Incentives | Growth Path to Office Manager Long-Term Growth Path to Office Manager Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Video Recording Required to Apply Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post. Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information. Do you enjoy helping customers and being part of a team where your work matters? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can learn, take ownership, and grow into greater responsibility? If you enjoy talking with customers, staying organized, solving problems, and providing excellent support, keep reading. About Boulder Pro Painters Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an exceptional customer experience. We are building an entrepreneurial company where customers are treated with care, team members are treated with respect, and people have the opportunity to grow as the business grows. We value integrity, responsibility, honest communication, and life balance. We believe work should contribute to a good life, not consume it. We want our team members to know what is expected of them, have the support and feedback they need to succeed, and have meaningful opportunities to develop their skills and take on greater responsibility. Our growth depends on the culture we create together. We are looking for ambitious, dependable people who take ownership of their work, are willing to learn, communicate honestly, and care about producing great results. In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow-up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business. This is an important long-term role. You will have the opportunity to learn how the business operates, develop your skills, take ownership of increasingly important responsibilities, increase your hours, and potentially grow into our Office Manager as both you and the company grow. What You Can Expect From Us We believe people do their best work when expectations are clear, communication is honest, and they have room to learn and take ownership. You can expect training, clear expectations, regular feedback, and support as you learn the role. You will also be trusted with real responsibility and expected to follow through on your commitments. You will not be expected to know everything on day one. We care about your willingness to learn, ask questions, practice, receive feedback, solve problems, and become increasingly capable over time. As you demonstrate that capability, we want to give you greater ownership and opportunities to grow with the company. Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing We are committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service. We want our customers to feel heard, cared for, and confident about working with Boulder Pro Painters. Our goal is to create an experience that earns their trust and makes them want to work with us again and recommend us to others. This role is a large part of creating that experience. Here are some of the things you’ll be doing regularly: * Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly. * Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate. * Asking thoughtful qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations. * Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates. * Managing estimate appointments in my calendar. * Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests. * Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment. * Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision. * Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our Facebook and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile. * Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers. * Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms. * Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow-up activities. * Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized. * Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications. * Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business. As You Grow in the Role As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability to take ownership of your responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities, including: * Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services. * Reconnecting with past customers about future projects. * Requesting customer reviews and referrals. * Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners. * Supporting customers after their project is approved. * Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps. * Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information. * Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems. * Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow-up reports. * Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records. * Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows. Our goal is not simply to give you more tasks. As your skills and understanding of the business grow, we want you to become capable of owning increasingly important parts of the company’s day-to-day operations. Who We Are Looking For: About You * You thrive in a fast-paced work environment. * You enjoy being in a support role and take pride in helping customers and teammates get the clarity and support they need to move things forward. * You enjoy talking with customers and get satisfaction from providing an excellent experience each time you interact with them. * You are a natural communicator and are very comfortable talking on the phone. * You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States. * You bring a positive, professional presence to your conversations with customers and teammates. * You take initiative. Once you understand the goal and expectations, you look for the next responsible action rather than waiting to be told every step. * You are proactive and look for ways to improve the customer experience, support the team, and make our systems work better. * You are highly organized and pay close attention to details. * You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders. * You take ownership when something needs to be completed. * You are willing to ask questions when something is unclear rather than guessing or allowing a problem to go unnoticed. * You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation. * You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations. * You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow-ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details. * You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy. * You are comfortable receiving honest feedback, practicing calls, learning from mistakes, and continuously improving. * You want a stable, long-term position where you can develop your capabilities and grow with the company. * You are available to transition into a full-time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase. * You have reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace. * You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions. Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States-based company is preferred. Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software, Facebook, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required. We are willing to train the right person. Your attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, reliability, willingness to learn, and ability to take ownership matter more to us than checking every experience box. Compensation and Job Details * This is a remote, long-term position for candidates located in the Philippines. * The position will begin with a paid 30-day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week. * Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time. * The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. * The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred. * Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full-time. * Full-time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one-hour unpaid meal break. * The current corresponding full-time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. * Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year. * Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour. * You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed. * To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner. * The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self-scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member. * You’ll be paid twice per month. * Paid training is included. * Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days. * Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90-day review. * You will receive prorated 13th-month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year. * Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days. * As your skills, contribution, and responsibilities grow, there will be opportunities for increased compensation, additional performance incentives, and advancement. * This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow. A Long-Term Opportunity This is more than a short-term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, learn how the company operates, develop their capabilities, and take on greater responsibility over time. We will provide training, feedback, clear expectations, and opportunities to grow. What you create with those opportunities will depend on the ownership, reliability, initiative, and results you bring to the role. Our business is growing, and we are looking to hire within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit. If this sounds like the kind of work, responsibility, and growth opportunity you are looking for—and you believe your strengths and goals align with what we are building—we would love to hear from you. To Apply, Please Submit All Eight Items 1. A cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position and why you believe you would be a strong fit for the role and our team. 2. Your current résumé. 3. A one- to two-minute video recording introducing yourself. Please tell us a little about yourself, why you are interested in this position, and any relevant experience you have in customer service, inside sales, office administration, social media, or supporting a U.S.-based company. You do not need professional video equipment or editing. A simple recording from your phone or computer is fine. We are interested in getting to know you and seeing how naturally and professionally you communicate. Please provide a link to your video and confirm that anyone with the link can view it. 4. Confirmation that you can work the initial part-time schedule and transition into the required full-time Mountain Time schedule. 5. Your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time. 6. A description of your internet connection and backup plan for power or internet interruptions. 7. Confirmation of whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers. If yes, include your current working schedule. 8. Your brief answer to this question: A homeowner requested an estimate but did not answer your first call. What would you do next? Before submitting, confirm that all files and links work and that anyone with the link can access them. Attention to detail is an important part of this role, and following these application instructions is the first opportunity to demonstrate it. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information. Best, Jonathan Ramirez Founder & CEO Boulder Pro Painters

title: AI Systems & Automation Engineer
description: AI Systems & Automation Engineer — Build Our AI Workforce About the Role We are looking for a highly skilled AI Systems & Automation Engineer to help us design, build, and continuously improve an AI-powered operating system across our businesses. This is NOT a basic VA position. This is NOT simply a Zapier or ChatGPT position. We are looking for someone who understands AI agents, automation, APIs, integrations, business processes, and systems architecture and can use those skills to make our companies more efficient. Our goal is to build an AI workforce—AI agents and automated systems that work alongside our human team, eliminate unnecessary manual work, connect our applications, improve accountability, and allow our companies to scale more efficiently. What You’ll Be Responsible For You will help us: • Build AI agents/“AI employees” capable of performing specific business functions • Connect multiple applications so information flows seamlessly throughout the organization • Build advanced automations using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks • Integrate AI models such as OpenAI and Claude into our business workflows • Build systems that can analyze information, make decisions based on defined rules, take approved actions, and escalate situations to humans when necessary • Integrate AI and automation with our CRM, especially GoHighLevel • Create automated reporting and KPI systems • Build databases and knowledge systems that AI agents can access • Build internal AI assistants that understand our SOPs, processes, training, and company knowledge • Monitor automations and identify failures before they become larger business problems • Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve existing automations • Document systems so they are understandable and maintainable VERY IMPORTANT: You Must Be Proactive We are NOT looking for someone who waits for us to identify every automation that needs to be built. A major responsibility of this position will be to learn our business and proactively identify where AI and automation can improve it. You should be able to study our departments, workflows, software, and processes and tell us: “You’re currently using three people and five manual steps to accomplish this. We can automate 70% of this process, connect these systems, and have an AI agent handle these responsibilities.” You will be expected to: • Audit existing workflows and technology • Identify repetitive manual work • Identify bottlenecks between departments • Identify areas where information is being entered multiple times • Identify where applications should be connected • Recommend where AI agents could replace, assist, or enhance existing processes • Recommend new AI tools and technologies when appropriate • Estimate potential time and cost savings • Prioritize projects based on business impact • Build the approved solutions • Measure whether the automation actually improved the business We want someone who doesn’t just ask: “What do you want me to build?” We want someone who also asks: “Why are you doing it this way, and is there a better way to accomplish this with AI?” Examples of AI Employees We Want to Build Some potential projects include: AI Operations Assistant Monitors workflows, deadlines, assignments, and incomplete tasks and alerts leadership when something requires attention. AI Reporting & KPI Analyst Pulls information from multiple systems, analyzes performance, identifies trends/problems, and automatically provides management reports. AI Lead Qualification Agent Analyzes incoming leads, scores them, updates the CRM, assigns them appropriately, and initiates the correct follow-up process. AI Follow-Up Agent Tracks leads and tasks and automatically triggers appropriate follow-up when action has not occurred. AI Recruiting Assistant Helps screen applicants, analyze qualifications, organize candidates, schedule interviews, and maintain recruiting pipelines. AI Marketing Analyst Analyzes marketing data across platforms and identifies performance trends, opportunities, and potential problems. AI Quality-Control Agent Reviews processes, records, or completed work against established standards and flags potential issues for human review. AI Knowledge Assistant Allows employees to ask questions and receive answers based on our company’s SOPs, training, policies, and internal knowledge. These are examples. We expect the person in this position to identify additional opportunities. Required Skills Strong experience with: • n8n — HIGHLY preferred • GoHighLevel (GHL) • OpenAI API / ChatGPT • Claude / Anthropic API • ---------- and/or Zapier • REST APIs • Webhooks • JSON • OAuth / API authentication • Python and/or JavaScript • Databases and data management • Error handling, monitoring, and troubleshooting Strongly Preferred Experience Experience with some of the following is a major advantage: • AI Agents / Agentic Workflows • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) • Supabase • PostgreSQL • Airtable • Vector databases • Pinecone / Qdrant / pgvector • MCP • Voice AI • Vapi • Retell AI • ElevenLabs • Twilio • AI knowledge bases • Prompt engineering • CRM architecture • Automated dashboards/reporting • Human-in-the-loop AI systems You do NOT need to know every tool listed above. We care more about your ability to understand a business problem, design the right solution, and figure out how to build it. The Type of Person We’re Looking For The ideal candidate is: Part AI Automation Engineer Part Systems Architect Part Business Process Consultant You should be naturally curious and constantly looking for ways to make systems better. We want someone who thinks: “There has to be a better way to do this.” Then figures out how to build it. How to Apply Please do NOT send us a generic application. Start your application with the words: “AI WORKFORCE” Then answer the following: 1. What is the most sophisticated AI or automation system you have personally built? Explain what it did, what applications were connected, and what business problem it solved. 2. What is your experience with n8n? Please rate yourself from 1–10 and explain why. 3. What is your experience with APIs and webhooks? Give us an example of an integration you built that required working directly with an API. 4. What experience do you have with GoHighLevel? 5. Tell us about an automation you built that broke after being deployed. How did you discover the problem, what caused it, and what did you change so it wouldn’t happen again? 6. Give us an example of a business process where YOU identified the opportunity to automate it rather than the company telling you exactly what to build. This question is extremely important to us. REQUIRED: Loom Video Please submit a 3–5 minute Loom video showing us an actual AI or automation system you personally built. Do not just describe it. Share your screen and show us: • The workflow • The applications being connected • The automation logic • Where AI is being used • How data moves through the system • How errors/failures are handled • What business problem the system solved Applications without a Loom demonstration may not be considered. Final Challenge At the end of your application, briefly explain how you would approach this scenario: We receive leads from multiple marketing sources into GoHighLevel. We want AI to analyze and score each lead, determine which team member should receive the lead, update the CRM, assign the lead, trigger the appropriate communication, track whether the assigned person follows up, automatically initiate additional follow-up when appropriate, and provide management with reporting showing lead source, appointments, conversions, team performance, and potential problems. Do not build it. Simply explain how you would architect the system. We’re not looking for someone who simply knows AI tools. We’re looking for someone who can help us build the AI infrastructure that makes our entire company operate better.

title: eCommerce Supply Chain Manager (Amazon FBA & D2C)
job_title: eCommerce Supply Chain Manager (Amazon FBA & D2C)
description: ## READ THIS FIRST ## We're a fast-growing 7-figure car-care brand from Germany, selling mostly on Amazon (FBA) across the EU plus our own D2C store. Our founder has run the entire supply chain himself until now — we're handing it over. You'll become the person who owns our daily supply chain operations. This is a real ownership role, not a task list for a junior VA — but it's also hands-on, brand-side operations for OUR OWN Amazon business. Not agency, consulting, or client-support supply chain, and not a role where you manage a team: you own the work and do it yourself. We're moving onto professional inventory-planning software that handles the heavy calculations, so a big part of the job is running the process, checking the outputs, and executing — reliably and independently. You'll still use spreadsheets here and there and handle plenty of work outside the tool, so you need to be comfortable with numbers and data — but you won't be building complex spreadsheet models. APPLY ONLY IF ALL OF THESE ARE TRUE: - 3+ years in e-commerce supply chain / inventory management, in FULL-TIME roles - Hands-on AMAZON FBA & SELLER CENTRAL experience at a sizeable seller / brand doing SEVERAL MILLION+ in annual revenue, in a full-time role - You've operated an inventory planning / replenishment tool (Inventory Planner, SoStocked, or similar) OR a large ERP like SAP / Oracle - Excellent written English - Detail-oriented, structured, and comfortable working with numbers and data - Happy as a hands-on individual contributor who owns the work end-to-end — this is NOT a team-lead role - A stable, high-speed internet connection reliable enough for daily video calls, and a quiet, focused place to work - Available full-time, long-term, with at least a few hours of daily overlap with German business hours (CET) If that's you, read on. ## ABOUT US ## A German premium car-care brand with ~200 SKUs. ~80% of sales run through Amazon (FBA) with additional bundles via a 3PL; ~20% through our own online store. We're a small, focused team, and we're expanding into new EU marketplaces over the next 12 months. We use AI tools for data aggregation and the repetitive work — but the smart decisions stay with the human running the process. That'll be you. ## THE ROLE ## You'll be the daily operator of our inventory-planning tool and own the process end-to-end. Onboarding is hands-on and directly from the founder. We're still building out our SOPs, so you'll help document and improve the processes as we go — you should enjoy creating structure, not just following it. Once you're up to speed, you run it yourself and escalate decisions back to the founder if needed. ## WHAT YOU'LL DO ## - Demand forecasting: review and maintain SKU-level forecasts (seasonal products), apply manual overrides for promotions, growth, and new launches - Purchasing: turn replenishment recommendations into POs to suppliers in Asia and Europe - Component planning: ensure components we supply to our contract manufacturers ship on time for scheduled production - Amazon FBA replenishment: review/approve weekly FBA transfers per marketplace, create and finalize shipments in Seller Central, monitor inbound - PO tracking: monitor open POs, keep landed-cost and payment data current, export payment data for finance - Stock monitoring: watch coverage and stockout / overstock risk across all locations (FBA EU, 3PL, manufacturer) - Master data: keep lead times, MOQs, costs, weights/volumes, BOMs accurate - Communication: coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, and our 3PL — mostly in English. A few suppliers may communicate partly in German; we'll support that with AI translation, so German is not required. ## WHAT WE OFFER ## - $1,500–1,800 USD / month, based on experience — full-time, long-term - 100% remote, flexible hours, no graveyard shift (some overlap with CET) - Direct collaboration with the founder, real ownership, and modern tools - Hands-on onboarding from the founder, and the freedom to shape our processes as we build them out - Paid time off, long-term stability, room to grow as the brand expands - Start date: asap 2026 ## HOW TO APPLY ## To show us you read the whole post, START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD: STOCK-READY Then answer these briefly: 1. For which Amazon seller(s) did you handle supply chain / inventory — roughly how many SKUs, what annual revenue, and was it a full-time role? 2. Describe one supply chain decision you made ENTIRELY ON YOUR OWN that went beyond routine execution. What did you d ---------- , and what was the outcome? 3. Which inventory planning / replenishment tools or ERPs have you operated, and for how long? Also: your written English level, earliest possible start date, and expected monthly salary. 4. Confirm your work setup: how reliable is your internet for daily video calls (rough speed / any backup), and is your workspace quiet and free of distractions? Attach your updated CV. Applications that don't start with the codeword, or that skip the questions, won't be considered. Thank you for your interest! Jonas

description: Job Type: Full-time / Part-time (Remote, WFH) Location: Work From Home Salary: Open / Based on experience Job Description: We are looking for an experienced Marketing Director or Meta Ads Campaign Manager to help grow our brand through strategic marketing and paid advertising.
