About the Role We are looking for a friendly, dependable Customer Experience Representative to support Teton customers primarily by phone, with additional support through email, live chat, social media, and customer reviews. This is a hands-on Customer Experience role. You will help customers throughout the full resolution process—not simply answer questions. This includes investigating concerns, troubleshooting products, processing warranties and returns, placing orders, coordinating follow-up, and completing other work created by customer interactions. The phone queue will be the primary focus of this position. The right person will enjoy talking with people, solving problems in real time, and helping turn difficult situations into positive customer experiences. As your knowledge grows, you will take on additional CX responsibilities and projects based on the needs of our customers, team, and business. Schedule This position has a regular, fixed schedule based on Teton’s U.S. Mountain Time business hours and requires consistent overnight availability. Day U.S. Mountain Time Philippine Time* Monday 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. 10:00 p.m.–6:00 a.m. Tuesday–Thursday 8:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. 10:00 p.m.–3:00 a.m. Friday 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. 12:00 a.m.–6:00 a.m. Saturday *Philippine working hours shift one hour later when Utah changes from daylight to standard time. Occasionally, we may ask whether you are available to work additional or adjusted hours to help cover team vacations, absences, holidays, or increased customer demand. Flexibility is appreciated, but additional hours are not guaranteed, and schedule changes will be communicated as far in advance as possible. The initial training schedule may differ from the regular schedule and require adjusted availability. Training details will be discussed during the interview process. Key Responsibilities • Provide timely, friendly, and professional support primarily by phone, with additional support through email, live chat, social media, and customer reviews. • Manage customer cases from initial contact through resolution, including researching concerns, troubleshooting products, processing warranties and returns, placing orders, documenting actions, and completing necessary follow-up. • Help customers choose products that fit their needs and understand how to use and care for their gear. • Use Teton’s policies, systems, training, and available resources to determine appropriate solutions and recognize when an issue requires approval or escalation. • Maintain ownership of assigned work through completion or a clear, documented handoff. • Follow up with customers and other Teton departments to ensure requests and agreed-upon actions are completed. • Respond to customer-support needs through approved social-media and customer-review platforms. • Identify and share recurring customer concerns, product feedback, and opportunities to improve the customer experience. • Help maintain Teton’s help desk, customer records, macros, internal processes, and knowledge resources in Guru/Teton AI. • Use approved AI tools responsibly to research information, improve communication, summarize details, and work more efficiently while verifying accuracy and protecting customer information. • Support other Customer Experience responsibilities and improvement projects as the needs of Teton, the team, and our customers evolve. Qualifications • Three or more years of customer-service experience, including experience providing support by phone, is preferred. • Experience in e-commerce, retail, order support, warranties, returns, or a similar customer-facing environment is a plus. • Strong spoken and written English communication skills. • Comfortable spending the majority of the scheduled shift answering inbound calls and making outbound follow-up calls. • Able to communicate naturally and empathetically with customers, including during complaints and difficult conversations. • Strong organization, attention to detail, time management, and follow-through. • Comfortable asking questions, sharing your thought process, and seeking guidance when unsure. We do not expect someone to know everything immediately, but we do expect you to use available resources, learn from feedback, and apply what you have learned as your experience grows. • Communicates openly rather than guessing or allowing an issue to remain unresolved. • Comfortable learning and working in several technology platforms and responsibly using AI-assisted tools. • Professional experience with ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools is a plus. • Experience with Slack, Microsoft Office, e-commerce platforms, Gorgias, Guru, Redo, or similar systems is helpful but not required. • Willing and able to occasionally work additional or adjusted hours when available to help support team coverage. • Outdoor-product experience is helpful but not required. Curiosity and a willingness to learn are more important. Remote-Work Requirements This is a fixed-location, work-from-home position—not a work-from-anywhere or digital-nomad role. Your normal work must be performed from an approved, consistent home workspace. Working while traveling or regularly changing locations is not compatible with this position. If an internet or power interruption requires you to use a backup location, that location must still provide a quiet and private environment, reliable connectivity, clear call quality, and protection of customer information. Temporary location changes must be communicated to and approved by your manager. A quiet and private workspace, stable home internet with at least 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload, backup internet access, reliable power, and a professional headset with clear audio are required. Applicants may be asked to provide a current internet-speed test. During scheduled hours, team members are expected to be logged in, available for customer contacts, responsive to the team, and fully engaged in Teton work. Why Join Teton? At Teton, Customer Experience is about more than answering questions—it is about building relationships, solving problems thoughtfully, and serving as the connection between our customers and the rest of the company. Our work is guided by our FORWARD core values: Freedom & Independence, Ownership, Do It Right, Win/Win/Win, Always Learning Never Learned, Results Focused, and Do More with Less. These values shape how we make decisions, work together, learn, and care for our customers. You will receive training and support as you learn our products, policies, and systems. We encourage questions and do not expect you to know everything immediately. As your knowledge and experience grow, you will have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities, contribute ideas, improve processes, and support projects throughout Customer Experience. How to Apply • Apply with 8 or more Apply Points Send a brief introduction explaining why you would be a good fit for this role. • Attach your updated résumé. • Confirm that you can consistently work the required overnight schedule. • Include a current internet-speed test. • Share the best times to contact you for an interview. Before applying, please visit ---------- to learn more about our products and company.

title: Video Editor (Long term contract)
description: Company: Kops Location: Remote Schedule: Part-Time Hours: 4 hours per day, 20 hours per week Start Date: ASAP ABOUT KOPS Kops is a media company behind some of the biggest creator brands on YouTube. Our CEO, Jordi, is one of the biggest content creators on YouTube, with millions of viewers around the world. Our YouTube channels include Kwebbelkop, with over 15 million subscribers, and BlooGaming, with over 3 million subscribers. We are currently looking for a talented and experienced Long-Form Video Editor to join the BlooGaming team and help us create high-quality, entertaining gaming content for a massive global audience. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Long-Form Video Editor for BlooGaming, you will take raw gameplay recordings and transform them into engaging, entertaining, and polished YouTube videos. A major part of the role involves working with recordings from 2–3 different POVs. You will need to sync the footage, identify the strongest moments, build the story, and create an edit that keeps viewers engaged throughout the entire video. You will work closely with the Channel Manager and will be responsible for implementing creative direction and revisions while maintaining a consistent editing style. WHAT YOU'LL DO You will sync and cut recordings from 2–3 different POVs and combine them into a cohesive and entertaining long-form video. You will edit gameplay footage with music, sound effects, visual overlays, transitions, and other elements that improve the overall viewing experience. You will use AI tools to generate footage that can be incorporated into key moments of the video when appropriate. You will identify opportunities to improve pacing, comedy, storytelling, and viewer retention. You will follow creative direction from the Channel Manager and make revisions based on feedback. You will organize your projects and assets efficiently and make sure completed videos are delivered on schedule. You will work as part of a remote production team focused on consistently producing high-quality content. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who understands that great YouTube editing is about more than simply cutting footage together. You should have a strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, comedy, sound design, and viewer retention. You should be able to take hours of raw gameplay footage and quickly identify the moments that matter, build a compelling sequence, and turn them into a video that people want to keep watching. Strong familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro is required. You must have experience editing long-form YouTube content and be comfortable working with multiple gameplay POVs. Strong communication skills are important because you will be working directly with the production team and receiving creative feedback. You should also have strong time management skills and be able to consistently meet deadlines. You must be comfortable making revisions and implementing feedback from the Channel Manager. NICE TO HAVE Experience with GTA 5 is highly preferred. Experience editing gaming content or content similar to the Bloo channel is a major advantage. Experience working with multi-POV gameplay recordings is highly preferred. Experience using AI tools for video or shot generation is also a strong advantage. Experience working with established YouTube creators or large YouTube channels is a plus. THE IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is a creative editor who understands gaming content and knows how to make a video entertaining. You don't just follow instructions. You understand why certain cuts, sound effects, music, visual effects, and pacing choices make a video better. You are comfortable working with large amounts of raw footage, finding the best moments, and turning them into a cohesive story. You are also reliable, responsive, open to feedback, and capable of working independently in a remote environment. SCHEDULE This is a part-time position requiring 4 hours per day, 20 hours per week. We are looking to hire ASAP, so candidates who are available to start quickly are strongly preferred. HOW TO APPLY If you are interested in joining the BlooGaming team, please send your updated resume and portfolio to: ---------- Please make sure your portfolio includes examples of your long-form YouTube editing work. Gaming content, multi-POV editing, GTA 5 content, or videos demonstrating strong pacing, storytelling, sound design, visual effects, and AI-enhanced editing are highly preferred. We are looking for someone who can help us create content that millions of people will watch. If you believe you have the editing skills and creativity to work with the BlooGaming team, we want to hear from you.

title: Facade / Cladding Shop Drawing Drafter & Takeoff Specialist

description: Built Exteriors is a commercial exterior construction subcontractor in the United States looking for an experienced Facade / Cladding Shop Drawing Drafter & Takeoff Specialist to join our team remotely. This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone with strong construction knowledge who can read architectural plans, perform accurate quantity takeoffs, and create professional exterior facade and cladding shop drawings using AutoCAD. The ideal candidate already has experience producing shop drawings for exterior building systems and understands how to turn architectural design documents into detailed drawings that can be used for submittals, project coordination, material planning, and field installation. What We Build Our exterior scopes include systems such as: Fiber cement siding and panels EIFS and stucco ACM and architectural metal panels Sheet metal Soffits and fascia Weather barriers Flashings Exterior trim systems High-end architectural cladding Other commercial building-envelope systems Our projects include multifamily buildings, commercial buildings, schools, government facilities, healthcare projects, and other large commercial construction. Primary Responsibilities Facade and Cladding Shop Drawings You will review architectural construction documents for projects awarded to our company and develop shop drawings specifically for our exterior scopes. Responsibilities may include: Review architectural plans, elevations, sections, wall types, details, specifications, and addenda. Create professional shop drawing packages in AutoCAD. Develop exterior elevations showing our materials and scopes. Create wall sections and enlarged construction details. Create original details based on architectural documents, manufacturer requirements, and project conditions. Detail window heads, jambs, and sills. Detail door and storefront conditions. Detail inside and outside corners. Detail vertical and horizontal material transitions. Detail base-of-wall conditions. Detail parapets, soffits, fascia, balconies, penetrations, and other exterior conditions. Show weather barrier, flashing, drainage, furring, cladding, trim, sealant, and related components where applicable. Identify our work versus adjacent work or work by others. Create material legends, detail callouts, notes, dimensions, and drawing references. Revise shop drawings based on GC, architect, project manager, manufacturer, or field comments. Maintain organized drawing sets and revision histories. Help develop standard details and drafting libraries that can be reused on future projects. We are not looking for someone who simply traces architectural drawings. We want someone who can understand how exterior systems actually come together and use construction judgment when developing shop drawings. Quantity Takeoffs This position will also support our estimating department. Responsibilities include: Review commercial architectural construction documents. Perform accurate exterior quantity takeoffs. Use PlanSwift or similar professional takeoff software. Measure siding, panels, stucco/EIFS, sheet metal, soffits, fascia, flashing, trim, weather barrier, and other exterior materials. Separate quantities by material, elevation, color, system, building area, or other required breakdown. Identify missing scope, inconsistencies, unusual conditions, and potential estimating questions. Clearly document assumptions. Provide organized takeoff information that our U.S.-based estimators can easily review. Required Qualifications You must have: Extensive professional AutoCAD experience Strong ability to create architectural and construction drawings Experience producing shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation drawings, or detailed construction drawings Ability to independently draw construction details Strong ability to read commercial architectural plans Strong understanding of: Plans Elevations Sections Wall assemblies Construction details Dimensions Material transitions Building-envelope conditions Experience performing construction quantity takeoffs Experience with PlanSwift or another professional takeoff software Strong attention to detail Strong written English communication Ability to recognize missing information and ask questions instead of making unsupported assumptions Ability to organize technical information clearly and professionally Reliable computer and internet connection Strongly Preferred Experience We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in: Facade or cladding shop drawings ACM / aluminum composite material Metal panels Fiber cement siding or panels EIFS Stucco Architectural sheet metal Curtain wall Storefront Waterproofing Weather barriers Rainscreen assemblies Roofing Building-envelope systems Experience working with U.S. commercial construction documents is strongly preferred. Experience with the following software is also valuable: AutoCAD PlanSwift Bluebeam Revu Revit On-Screen Takeoff Excel AutoCAD proficiency is mandatory. What We Are Looking For We want someone who can eventually look at an exterior building condition and think beyond simply what is drawn. For example: How will this actually be installed? What material terminates here? How does the weather barrier transition? Is flashing required? What is included in our scope? What belongs to another trade? Does the architectural detail provide enough information? Does the detail make sense? Is additional information required from the architect or GC? What does our field crew need to see to correctly install this condition? You do not need to know every Built Exteriors system on your first day. We will train the right person on our specific materials, systems, standards, and workflows. However, you must already be highly competent in construction drafting, AutoCAD, and architectural plan reading. REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS Please read this section carefully. We will not review incomplete applications. Every application must include: Resume Technical drafting portfolio Completed quantity takeoff assessment Completed shop drawing assessment Desired hourly compensation Years of professional AutoCAD experience Years of construction drafting/shop drawing experience Years of estimating/quantity takeoff experience List of drafting and takeoff software you are proficient in PORTFOLIO REQUIRED DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO. Your portfolio must contain examples of technical drawings you personally produced. We want to see examples such as: Facade shop drawings Cladding shop drawings Exterior elevations Wall sections Construction details Window, door, storefront, parapet, flashing, soffit, or transition details Fabrication drawings Installation drawings Architectural construction drawings Renderings alone are not sufficient. We are evaluating your ability to produce technical construction drawings that can actually be used for coordination, submittals, fabrication, or installation. Applications without a technical drafting portfolio will not be considered. REQUIRED SKILLS ASSESSMENT Every applicant must also complete our technical assessment. All assessment files can be found here: ---------- IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE STARTING The Dropbox folder contains files for two different projects/purposes. TEST PROJECT The files labeled: 01 - TEST PROJECT - Marmalade Permit Set and 02 - TEST PROJECT - Material Legend are the files you will use to complete your assessment. You will perform BOTH your: Quantity takeoff Shop drawings using the Marmalade Permit Set. REFERENCE SHOP DRAWINGS ONLY The file labeled: 03 - REFERENCE ONLY - Example Exterior Shop Drawings is provided only to show you an example of the type and level of shop drawing package we produce. DO NOT perform a takeoff of the reference project. DO NOT recreate the reference project. Use it only as an example of how exterior subcontractor shop drawings may be organized and detailed. PART 1: QUANTITY TAKEOFF Using the Marmalade Permit Set and provided Material Legend, prepare an exterior quantity takeoff. PlanSwift is preferred. You may use another professional takeoff program if necessary. Your takeoff should clearly identify and quantify the exterior materials included in the provided Material Legend. We want to be able to understand: What you measured Where you measured it How much you measured How you organized the quantities Any assumptions you made Any unclear conditions you discovered Any questions you would ask before finalizing the estimate Submit: Quantity summary PDF or screenshots showing your takeoff Native PlanSwift or takeoff file, if available List of assumptions List of questions, discrepancies, or missing information you identified Approximate time spent completing the takeoff PART 2: EXTERIOR SHOP DRAWINGS Using the same Marmalade Permit Set, create an exterior-scope shop drawing package using AutoCAD or comparable professional CAD software. Use the provided example shop drawings to understand the type of work we are looking for. We do not expect you to copy the example exactly. We want to evaluate your ability to independently interpret architectural documents and develop professional exterior subcontractor shop drawings. Your package should demonstrate, as applicable to the test project: Exterior elevations Exterior material identification Material legend Relevant dimensions Detail callouts Exterior wall/cladding details Material transition details Termination conditions Window and door conditions Inside and outside corners Base-of-wall conditions Parapets Soffits/fascia Flashing Weather barrier relationships Other important exterior conditions you identify Clearly identify assumptions and information that requires clarification. If the architectural drawings do not provide enough information to confidently detail a condition, do not simply invent an answer. Instead, show your reasonable interpretation when appropriate and identify what question you would send to the project manager, general contractor, or architect. Knowing when to ask a good construction question is part of what we are evaluating. Submit: PDF shop drawing package Native DWG or other CAD files List of assumptions List of questions or clarifications Approximate time spent completing the shop drawings FINAL APPLICATION CHECKLIST Your application must contain: Resume Technical drafting portfolio Completed Marmalade quantity takeoff Takeoff summary Completed Marmalade shop drawing package Native CAD file Native takeoff file, if available Assumptions/questions Time spent on both portions of the assessment Desired compensation Software experience If your application does not contain the portfolio AND completed assessment, it will not be reviewed. One Final Question In the first line of your application, tell us: Which exterior facade or cladding system do you have the most experience detailing, and what type of shop drawings have you produced for it? This helps us confirm that you carefully reviewed the position before applying. Position Opportunity This is intended to be a long-term role. The right person can become an important technical resource supporting both our estimating and project teams. As your knowledge of our exterior systems grows, we expect the position to expand beyond basic drafting into greater responsibility for: Exterior shop drawing production Standard details Project-specific detailing Takeoffs Constructability review Drawing coordination Field installation drawings Process improvement and standardization We are looking for someone who wants to become highly knowledgeable in commercial exterior facade construction and grow with our team.

title: Executive + Growth Assistant | Long-Form YouTube Editor
job_title: Executive + Growth Assistant | Long-Form YouTube Editor
description: Executive + Growth Assistant | Long-Form YouTube Editor Part-Time | 15–20 Hours/Week - Goal to grow revenue to move to full time within 60/90 days based on direct revenue growth We are a founder-led U.S. coaching business serving high-performing women in real estate. Our work is warm, faith-based, direct and focused on helping women build profitable businesses, wealth and lives they actually have time to enjoy. You will work directly with our founder, Saundra Kandler, and become a key person in a small, growing company. This is not a traditional VA role. I am looking for someone who becomes my right hand in execution, someone who thinks ahead, communicates constantly, takes ownership and helps turn fast-moving ideas into results. You must also already be an excellent, efficient long-form YouTube video editor. BEFORE YOU APPLY, KNOW WHAT YOU'RE WALKING INTO I move fast. I think out loud. I generate ideas quickly. I coach, create, sell, speak, build relationships and drive the vision of the company. I need someone beside me who naturally thinks: What happens next? You notice what's coming. You follow up without waiting to be asked. You remind me when I need reminding. You catch mistakes before I see them. You ask smart questions when something isn't clear. You communicate before something becomes a problem. You understand the result we're trying to create, not simply the task you've been assigned. Sometimes I want to hear: “Saundra, I noticed this and already handled it.” Or: “Here's what I found. Here's what I recommend.” Or: “I need this from you today so we stay ahead.” If you prefer receiving a perfectly prepared task list and working quietly on your own, this will probably not be the right role. If you love being trusted, solving problems, collaborating closely with a founder and taking ownership, keep reading. YOUR FIRST MISSION: HELP US SELL EVENT TICKETS We're hiring at an important moment. We have an immediate, measurable business priority. We have approximately one week to significantly increase ticket sales for an upcoming live event. One of your first responsibilities will be helping us personally reach top women in real estate across approximately 15 priority U.S. markets. This is not an assignment to simply create a few event graphics and schedule posts. We need action. You will help: Research and identify high-performing women in real estate in our priority markets Build and maintain accurate prospect lists Help send thoughtful, personalized DMs and outreach Track every person contacted Track responses, conversations and follow-up Identify warm prospects who need personal outreach from Saundra Make sure interested prospects receive timely follow-up Keep our contact and CRM information current Track registrations against our goal Identify which messages and approaches are producing conversations Adjust quickly based on what is working Keep Saundra focused on the highest-value conversations Look for additional opportunities to increase registrations You will not personally control whether someone buys a ticket. You WILL own the quality, consistency, tracking and follow-through of the actions within your control. Sending a certain number of DMs and checking the task off the list is not the goal. I want someone looking at the numbers and asking: “Are our actions producing the result we need? If not, what should we change?” THE LONG-TERM MISSION After this immediate event push, the mission remains simple: Protect the founder's time, help create revenue, execute our content at a high level and make sure important things get finished. Success means that over time: I carry less in my head because you are here. You know what's coming. You know what's open. You know what needs my attention. You know what you can handle without me. And things don't quietly fall through the cracks. LONG-FORM YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITING This is a required technical skill, not a bonus. Every week, you will independently take approximately one long-form video from raw footage to a polished, professional, YouTube-ready final product. You must already be able to: Edit long-form talking-head, coaching or educational videos efficiently Make intelligent cuts without being told where every cut belongs Remove mistakes, unnecessary pauses and distractions Create engaging pacing Clean and balance audio Add tasteful B-roll, graphics and text when they improve the video Maintain a sophisticated, professional visual style Catch editing mistakes before I see them Create or support strong thumbnails Upload and correctly format videos on YouTube Help optimize titles and descriptions Meet deadlines consistently I should not have to re-edit your edits. If you are still learning long-form video editing, please do not apply. EXECUTIVE SUPPORT This is where this position differs from a traditional content or social media VA. You are helping me run the business. You will help with: Calendar awareness and meeting reminders Tracking deadlines and commitments Following up with me when you need something Preparing information before meetings Client and prospect follow-up Research Maintaining project and task systems Keeping open loops visible Creating simple SOPs for recurring work Making sure important commitments actually get completed Here's a simple example: If we have a meeting at 10:00 AM and I haven't joined by 10:03, message me. If you need something from me on Wednesday to meet a Friday deadline, ask me before Wednesday. If instructions are unclear, ask rather than guessing. If you discover a problem, bring me the problem and what you recommend we do about it. If something might be late, tell me before it's late. I should gradually have to remember less, not more, because you're here. CONTENT + MARKETING We are not interested in producing content simply to hit a posting quota. I care about quality, consistency and business impact. You will help: Repurpose our weekly YouTube video into strategic short-form content Edit Reels and Shorts Create polished Canva graphics when needed Schedule content across Instagram, Facebook and ---------- Help build and schedule our weekly email Create promotional content for events and offers Maintain our content calendar Proofread and quality-check everything before publishing Use ChatGPT and other AI tools intelligently Track what is working and help us improve You need a strong visual eye. Quality matters. Accuracy matters. LIVE MEETINGS ARE PART OF THIS JOB Please read this section carefully. This is NOT an asynchronous-only role. You will work directly with me through regular live Google Meet or Zoom conversations, generally several times per week during agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours. There may also be times when you join a planning, client or event-related meeting when your work is relevant. You must genuinely enjoy live collaboration and be comfortable on camera. I think out loud, and some of our best work will happen through real-time conversation. Your responsibility is to listen carefully, ask intelligent questions, capture what matters and turn the conversation into action. After our meeting, I should not have to sit down and create your task list for you. You should leave knowing: What you own. What I own. What happens next. Please do not apply if regular live video meetings feel inconvenient, you strongly prefer asynchronous-only work, you are uncomfortable being on camera, or you want a role where you rarely interact directly with the founder. There is nothing wrong with preferring that environment. It simply isn't this position. COMMUNICATION I want an over-communicator. You will never bother me by respectfully reminding me about something important. I want to know what's completed, what's still open, what you need from me, what may be at risk and what you believe should happen next. If something is unclear, ask. If you need something, follow up. If you make a mistake, tell me, correct it and learn from it. If something changes, communicate early. If you notice an opportunity, speak up. Silence creates more work. Communication creates trust. RELIABILITY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE Because this role includes live collaboration, executive support and video production, you must have a dependable work setup. You need: Strong, reliable primary internet Backup internet, such as mobile/hotspot or a second provider A backup power solution A reliable computer capable of efficiently editing long-form video A dependable workspace Unexpected things happen. What matters is preparation and communication. Repeated internet, power or equipment issues that prevent consistent work will make this role difficult. HOW YOU THINK MATTERS I do not expect you to know everything. I DO expect you to think before asking me to think for you. When you encounter something you don't know: Research it. Use AI. Look at our existing systems. Think through the options. Then come to me with a recommendation when appropriate. I am looking for someone who naturally asks: What outcome are we trying to create? What happens next? What could fall through the cracks? What can I handle without Saundra? What actually needs Saundra? You are being hired for your skills and your brain. Please use both. EXPERIENCE + SKILLS You should have: Proven long-form YouTube editing experience Excellent written and spoken English Strong Canva skills Social media/content publishing experience Strong attention to detail Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools Google Workspace experience Project/task management experience Ability to research and learn technology quickly Experience with CRM systems, email marketing, events, coaching businesses, personal brands or real estate is a plus. HOURS + COMPENSATION This role will begin at approximately 15–20 hours per week. Consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required. There is an opportunity for responsibilities, hours and compensation to grow as the company grows and trust is established. Please include your desired monthly compensation for 15–20 hours per week when applying. HOW TO APPLY Please read carefully. Your application is your first assignment. Generic applications will not be considered. Start your application with: I STAY AHEAD | [YOUR FIRST NAME] Then answer the following 7 questions. 1. SHOW ME YOUR WORK Send links to two long-form YouTube videos you personally edited. For each, tell me what you personally handled, what software you used, approximately how long the raw footage was and approximately how many hours the edit took you. Applications without long-form editing examples will not move forward. 2. YOUR 7-DAY PLAN Imagine today is your first day. We tell you: We have 7 days to significantly increase ticket sales for our live event. We want to personally reach high-performing women in real estate across our 15 priority U.S. markets. You have access to our social media accounts, existing audience and contacts, CRM/contact lists, event information, registration page, existing content, AI tools and Saundra for high-value personal outreach. You have approximately 15–20 working hours this week. Walk me through what you would do during those seven days to give us the best possible chance of hitting our ticket goal. Tell me: How would you identify the right women? How would you approach personalized outreach without making it feel like spam? What would YOU handle? What would you ask Saundra to handle? What would you track each day? How would you know whether your actions were working? If we were behind pace after Day 3, what would you change? Be specific. I am less interested in a textbook marketing answer than I am in seeing how you think. 3. PRIORITIZE You begin work and discover: Our event registration link isn't working Five warm event prospects need follow-up Our weekly YouTube video is due tomorrow Three social posts need to be created I have an important meeting later today What do you handle first, second and third, and why? 4. OWNERSHIP Tell me about one real situation where you noticed something your employer or client needed before they asked you. What did you notice? What did you do? What happened? 5. LIVE COLLABORATION Tell me about your ideal working relationship with a founder. How frequently did you meet live with your most recent founder, executive or client? What did you personally do during and immediately after those meetings? What do you enjoy about working closely with a founder in real time? What do you find challenging about it? 6. RELIABILITY Tell me: What computer you use for video editing Your primary internet setup and typical speed Your backup internet solution Your backup power solution What U.S. Eastern Time hours you can consistently overlap How many hours per week you can commit 7. WHAT DO YOU SEE THAT I DON'T? After reading this entire job description: What is one thing you believe I will need from you that I haven't specifically asked for? Finally, tell me your desired monthly compensation for 15–20 hours per week. At the very END of your application, write: Details create trust. Finalists will complete a live video interview followed by a paid practical assignment before an offer is made. If you love producing excellent work, solving problems, communicating clearly, collaborating closely with a founder and being the person already thinking about tomorrow, I would love to hear from you.

title: Top 1% Meta Media Buyer
description: Meta Ads Launch Specialist - Grow Into Media Buyer (Part-Time, 1-2 hrs/day, Remote) We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer health brand. We test a lot of creative: our strategists and editors ship new video and static ads every week, and every one of them has to go live in Meta fast, clean and correct. That's the seat we're hiring for. You'll own the launch side of our Meta ad account. Our team hands you finished ads and a brief. You get them live, exactly right, every time, and you keep the account organized as the volume grows. You'll have an SOP for structure, naming and settings from day one, so you're never guessing. Over time we want the person in this seat to grow into a full media buyer. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Launch new creatives from briefs into the right campaigns and ad sets in Meta Ads Manager, and build new ad sets when the brief calls for it. - Set every ad up correctly: primary text, headlines, descriptions, CTA, URL and tracking, page and Instagram identity, placements, the optimization event, and our naming convention. - Write and adapt primary text and headline variants from our copy bank, using AI tools to move fast without lowering the quality. - QA every ad before and after publishing: right creative, right copy, right link, right settings, no typos. Catch mistakes before they cost money. - Watch approvals daily, handle rejections and policy flags, fix and resubmit, and tell us when something needs a decision. - Keep the launch tracker and creative log current so the whole team always knows what's live, what's paused and what's been tested. - Do a short daily account check and a weekly summary: what launched, what broke, what looks off. - Help us keep the SOP sharp. If you find a faster or safer way to do something, we want it in the doc. WHERE THIS GOES This starts as a part-time launch role, around one to two hours a day, most days of the week. It isn't a full media buying seat on day one: strategy and budget decisions sit with the founder and our strategist for now. But we're not looking for a button-pusher. The person we want understands why an account is structured the way it is, reads the numbers, and wants more. After a successful trial the scope grows: reporting, then kills and scales inside our rules, then your own testing lanes. If you're hungry and reliable, this becomes a full-time media buyer role with bonuses tied to performance. YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU - Have real hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience: you've personally built and launched campaigns, ad sets and ads for an ecommerce or DTC brand, ideally in health, supplements or beauty. - Are obsessive about detail. A wrong URL or the wrong creative in the wrong ad set is a real loss to you, not a typo. - Use AI tools daily (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) for copy variants, checklists and quick analysis, and you know when not to trust them. - Are comfortable in Google Sheets and a task board, and you reply fast on Slack or WhatsApp. - Have clear written English and can work a daily window between 3 PM and 11 PM Manila time (we're in Europe). - Want to become a media buyer, not stay an uploader. WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT (YET) Not creative production (our editors do that), not agency account management, not strategy or budget ownership on day one. It's the launch engine of a real brand, done with care, with a clear path to more. PAY AND TERMS $8-12 USD per hour depending on experience, roughly 7-14 hours a week, paid monthly. One-month paid trial at the full rate. Bonus once you own more of the account. Long-term. HOW TO APPLY Start your message with the word LAUNCH so we know you read this. Which ecommerce or DTC brands have you run Meta ads for, and what did you personally build, launch or change inside Ads Manager? 2. What are the first three things you check? 4. Tell us about a mistake you caught while launching or managing ads. What was wrong and what did you do? 5. Your available hours per week, your timezone, and the rate you want. Include a link to one or two screenshots from an Ads Manager account you've worked in (blur anything sensitive). Position Summary AZTAC provides outsourced billing, accounting, cost reporting, regulatory compliance, and strategic advisory services to intellectual disability care providers. We're looking for an Analyst, Revenue Cycle Management to manage the end-to-end billing cycle for our client portfolio, from claims submission through AR follow-up and denial resolution. Initially, this role will focus on claims submission through Pennsylvania’s PROMISe system (Medicaid), with the expectation that coverage will expand to additional public and private payers over time. This role is critical to keeping client cash flow healthy and requires someone comfortable working across multiple clients and stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Core revenue cycle management responsibilities: - Perform billing audits to identify previously unbilled or unpaid claims covering previous dates of service - Review client-prepared census reports to ensure completeness and standardize census data - Prepare and submit claims via Pennsylvania's PROMISe system (Medicaid) on behalf of client accounts, with the expectation of taking on additional public and private payers as the client portfolio grows - Prior to submission, verify claims for accuracy, including service codes, units, authorizations, and required documentation - Monitor claim status and proactively follow up on unpaid, pending, or rejected claims to ensure complete collections - Investigate and resolve claim denials and underpayments, including researching root cause, correcting and resubmitting claims, and filing appeals where needed - Reconcile payments against electronic remittance advice documents (ERAs) to verify expected reimbursement and prepare revenue recognition documents and entries Stakeholder management responsibilities: - Stay current on payer-specific billing rules and requirements relevant to intellectual/developmental disability services, including PA PROMISe requirements - Proactive outreach to clients to collect missing census data as necessary - Maintain organized records of authorizations, claims, and correspondence for each client - Liaise with state and local government agencies and supports coordinators as needed to facilitate accurate and timely billing - Prepare weekly revenue reporting for clients based on billing and collections activity - Participate in weekly status update calls internally with the team and externally with clients - Communicate proactively with the Manager, Client Accounting Services, and CEO on aging issues, denial trends, and payer problems Process improvement responsibilities: - Identify recurring denial patterns, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies in the billing workflow, and recommend process improvements to reduce errors and accelerate reimbursement - Propose and/or build new software and spreadsheet tools to improve data ingestion and reporting capabilities to drive operational efficiency - Support the ongoing refinement of billing procedures and checklists as the client base and payer mix expand Qualifications Required: - Bachelor's degree in accounting, business, economics, finance, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) - 1-3+ years of medical billing experience (3+ preferred); experience with Medicaid/HCBS waiver billing or IDD/behavioral health billing is a strong plus - Strong written and verbal English communication skills for a remote, U.S.-based team - Working knowledge of the claims lifecycle: submission, adjudication, denial management, and appeals - General comfort learning new payer portals and systems is more important than experience with any specific clearinghouse or coding set - Organizational ability to manage multiple clients/payers simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret spreadsheets (including strong Excel experience), claims documents, and AR data; identify trends; and translate findings into practical process improvements - Reliable internet connection and ability to work U.S. business hours (or significant overlap) - Self-directed and able to work independently in a fully remote environment Nice to have: - Experience billing for intellectual/developmental disability (I/DD) or behavioral health service providers - Experience with Pennsylvania's PROMISe claims submission system - Experience with accounting software like QuickBooks Online Benefits AZTAC offers benefits including: - Remote work environment, willingness to hire global remote workers - Flexible work schedule - we care about results, not rigid hours, with an expectation of adequate time overlap with the US team for regular check-ins - Contractors are offered flexible time off, with a benchmark target of 160 hours / 4 weeks and 11 firm-wide holidays (in line with the US team) - Annual discretionary bonus Why This Role The day-to-day work in this role is similar to a typical revenue cycle management / medical billing position, but our mission is to ultimately support nonprofit and charitable organizations who exist to serve their communities. This role is an opportunity to join a lean, growing firm where your work directly affects the funding and stability of organizations caring for vulnerable populations. Our organization will train the right candidate and we are willing to invest in long-term career development.

description: Second Screen Digital is a Los Angeles-based performance marketing agency looking for an experienced Paid Social Media Buyer who is equally comfortable developing high-level strategy and handling the technical details required to make campaigns work. This is a remote position, but you must be available to work consistent U.S. business hours and collaborate with our team and clients during the Pacific Time workday. We need someone who can do more than launch ads and report on ROAS. You should understand the full paid social ecosystem—from campaign structure, creative testing, and budget allocation to UTMs, pixel implementation, event tracking, attribution, catalog troubleshooting, and quality control. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding opportunities for growth but is also willing to dig into the less glamorous work behind the scenes. Sometimes the problem is the strategy. Sometimes it’s a broken event, an incorrect UTM, or a product catalog having a bad day. You should be comfortable diagnosing all of it. What You’ll Do * Develop and execute paid social strategies across Meta and TikTok * Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns based on each client’s objectives * Manage e-commerce and lead-generation accounts with varying budgets and levels of complexity * Create thoughtful campaign structures that support testing, scaling, and accurate reporting * Develop testing roadmaps for audiences, offers, messaging, formats, landing pages, and creative concepts * Analyze performance beyond surface-level platform metrics to identify what is actually driving results * Make strategic decisions about budget allocation, scaling, consolidation, and account structure * Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams * Collaborate with creative strategists, designers, editors, account managers, and other media buyers * Provide clear creative feedback based on performance trends and audience behavior * Monitor pacing, spend, efficiency, tracking accuracy, and campaign health * Identify performance issues early and take ownership of solving them * Stay current on platform changes, new ad formats, measurement updates, and paid social best practices Tracking and Technical Responsibilities You must be fully comfortable owning the technical details of paid social advertising, including: * Creating and maintaining accurate UTM structures * Installing, reviewing, and troubleshooting Meta Pixels and TikTok Pixels * Setting up and validating standard and custom conversion events * Working with Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API * Testing events using platform diagnostic and event-testing tools * Reviewing event prioritization, deduplication, match quality, and attribution settings * Using Google Tag Manager and GA4 to support campaign tracking and reporting * Troubleshooting discrepancies between ad platforms, Shopify, GA4, Triple Whale, and other attribution tools * Setting up and troubleshooting product catalogs, feeds, and dynamic product ads * Conducting detailed pre-launch quality-control checks * Documenting tracking setups, campaign structures, tests, and account changes * Diagnosing technical issues instead of immediately assuming poor performance is a creative or audience problem What We’re Looking For * At least 3–5 years of hands-on paid social media buying experience * Strong experience managing both Meta Ads and TikTok Ads * Demonstrated success managing and scaling e-commerce campaigns * Experience with lead-generation campaigns is a plus * Strong knowledge of campaign architecture, testing methodology, attribution, and performance analysis * Hands-on experience with pixels, conversion events, UTMs, product feeds, and server-side tracking * Working knowledge of Shopify, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager * Experience with attribution platforms such as Triple Whale is a plus * Ability to distinguish between a creative problem, an offer problem, a landing-page problem, a tracking problem, and a media-buying problem * Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large amounts of performance data * Excellent attention to detail, particularly during setup and quality control * Clear written and verbal communication skills * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities * A proactive, solution-oriented mindset * Willingness to take ownership of both strategy and execution * Reliable availability during U.S. business hours, with regular overlap during Pacific Time * Ability to attend scheduled team meetings and respond to time-sensitive client or campaign needs during the U.S. workday ## You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You * Can explain not only what happened in an account, but why it happened and what should happen next * Know when to follow platform best practices and when the data supports a different approach * Enjoy developing strategy but do not consider tracking, naming conventions, documentation, or QA “someone else’s job” * Can turn performance data into useful feedback for a creative team * Catch small errors before they become expensive ones * Communicate concerns early and arrive with potential solutions * Are comfortable being accountable for results without pretending every outcome is fully within the ad platform * Approach media buying with curiosity, discipline, and sound judgment * Work well with a distributed, international team while maintaining consistent U.S. working hours ## What Success Looks Like * Campaigns are launched accurately, on time, and without preventable tracking or setup errors * Client budgets are managed responsibly and paced appropriately * Testing is structured around clear hypotheses rather than random changes * Performance insights lead to better creative, stronger landing pages, and smarter account decisions * Reporting is accurate, meaningful, and connected to the client’s business goals * Account issues are identified and resolved proactively * Clients and internal team members understand what is working, what is not, and what we are doing next ## About Second Screen Digital Second Screen Digital is a Los Angeles-based performance marketing agency supporting growing brands through paid media, creative strategy, email marketing, SEO, and web design. Although our team works remotely, our clients and core operations are based in the United States. Team members in this role must maintain reliable availability during U.S. business hours and collaborate regularly with colleagues working in Pacific Time. We value integrity, excellence, clear communication, thoughtful problem-solving, and people who take genuine ownership of their work. This is not a role for someone who wants to press a few buttons, check the dashboard, and call it media buying. We are looking for someone who understands how strategy, creative, tracking, attribution, and execution work together—and is comfortable owning the details that make strong performance possible.

title: Real Estate Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist
job_title: Real Estate Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist
description: We are looking for a sharp, confident, highly motivated Real Estate Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist with direct real estate experience. This is not a basic call-center or administrative position. We need someone who understands real estate leads, discovery calls, qualification, follow-up, lead nurturing, appointment setting, and pipeline management and who is comfortable taking ownership of leads until they are successfully moved to the next stage. You should be quick-thinking, articulate, persuasive, personable, and extremely comfortable on the phone. You need to know how to have a natural conversation with buyers, sellers, investors, and prospects; ask the right questions; uncover motivation; understand timelines; handle objections; and confidently secure the next step. You will communicate with leads through telephone calls, text messages, and email, so excellent professional English—both spoken and written—is mandatory. We are looking for someone who enjoys results, numbers, accountability, and moving deals forward. Your Responsibilities Immediately contact new buyer, seller, and real estate leads. Conduct professional discovery and qualification calls. Ask intelligent questions to uncover the client's motivation, needs, timeline, expectations, and readiness to move forward. Build rapport quickly and communicate confidently with different types of personalities. Schedule qualified appointments for our real estate team. Confirm appointments and reduce cancellations and no-shows. Follow up consistently with leads who are not yet ready to schedule. Nurture short-, medium-, and long-term prospects. Communicate through phone, SMS/text, and email throughout the lead lifecycle. Know when to push for an appointment and when a prospect needs additional nurturing. Handle common objections professionally and confidently. Keep leads moving through the sales pipeline. Maintain accurate notes and update every lead's status after conversations. Know exactly where active prospects are within the pipeline. Identify leads that are becoming opportunities and communicate them immediately to the appropriate team member. Communicate client expectations, deadlines, timelines, and important details clearly to management and agents. Follow up internally when team members need to take action on a lead. Make sure opportunities do not fall through the cracks because someone forgot to call, text, email, or follow up. Track your personal activity and performance every day. Report on calls, conversations, follow-ups, appointments, qualified opportunities, and pipeline movement. Identify problems in the lead-conversion process and bring them to management's attention. Take ownership of your numbers and continually look for ways to improve your conversion rate. What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate has direct experience working with real estate leads and understands that a person who submits an inquiry today may be ready immediately, in 30 days, in six months, or even later. You understand how to determine the difference and create the appropriate follow-up. You must be: Experienced in real estate lead qualification and appointment setting. Extremely comfortable speaking with prospects on the telephone. Fluent in professional spoken and written English. Quick-thinking and able to respond naturally without sounding scripted. Confident speaking with sophisticated clients. Excellent at asking discovery questions. Able to uncover motivation without interrogating the prospect. Persuasive without being overly aggressive. Good at objection handling. Highly organized with follow-up. Comfortable managing many leads at different stages simultaneously. Excellent at texting and email communication. Self-motivated and able to work without constantly being reminded what to do. Competitive and motivated by measurable results. Comfortable being held accountable for daily and weekly performance. Able to understand and communicate deadlines and timelines. Proactive about communicating problems before they become bigger problems. Comfortable working closely with agents and management. Able to take constructive feedback and improve quickly. Real Estate Experience Is Important We strongly prefer someone who has previously worked as a: Real estate ISA, appointment setter, lead manager, inside sales representative, transaction-focused sales assistant, real estate acquisition specialist, or similar real estate sales position. You should already understand basic real estate terminology and be comfortable discussing subjects such as: Buying and selling timelines Motivation for selling Buyer requirements Property types Price ranges Financing/pre-approval Cash versus financed buyers Listing appointments Property-showing appointments Follow-up timelines Agent availability Client expectations We do not want to train someone from zero on how a real estate conversation works. CRM / GoHighLevel Experience with GoHighLevel is a major plus. You should be comfortable using a CRM every day to: Update lead statuses. Move opportunities through pipeline stages. Record detailed notes. Schedule tasks and appointments. Send SMS and email. Track conversations. Set follow-up dates. Monitor leads requiring immediate attention. Identify stale opportunities. Report where leads are in the pipeline. If you have experience building or working with GoHighLevel workflows, campaigns, automations, calendars, or pipelines, please mention this when applying. You Must Be Results Driven We want someone who knows their numbers. Every day, you should be able to tell us things such as: How many calls did I make? How many people did I actually speak with? How many meaningful conversations did I have? How many leads did I qualify? How many appointments did I schedule? How many appointments were confirmed? How many leads require follow-up? Which opportunities are closest to converting? Which leads are becoming stale? Where are leads getting stuck? We are looking for someone who enjoys improving these numbers rather than someone who simply wants to complete a shift. Important Work Requirements This is a dedicated full-time position. You may not hold another full-time job or provide overlapping services to other clients during our scheduled working hours. You must have fluent, professional-level spoken and written English. You will regularly speak directly with prospective buyers, sellers, clients, agents, and management. Our team works collaboratively on Zoom throughout the workday, and you must be comfortable remaining connected on Zoom and sharing your screen while working when required. You will work closely with management and our real estate team, so communication, transparency, availability, accountability, and responsiveness are essential. You must also have: A professional and quiet working environment. Reliable high-speed internet. A reliable computer. A quality headset/microphone. Backup internet access whenever possible. The ability to work our required schedule consistently. The Personality We Want We want someone who is sharp, hungry, resourceful, confident, and self-driven. If a lead does not answer, you don't simply mark them as "no answer" and forget about them. You think: When should I call again? Should I text them? Should I email them? What did they originally inquire about? What might get them to respond? What's their timeline? What is the next action? You should naturally want to move opportunities forward. We value people who see a problem, communicate it, and work toward solving it rather than waiting for someone to give them instructions.

A real understanding of the payout-vs-sales gap and how to use a platform's reports to explain it. Strong written English and reliable overlap with US business hours (some hours between 9am–5pm Pacific Time). Accuracy, discretion with financial data, and the ability to work independently. Nice to have: Experience across several of the platforms above. Familiarity with platform financing products and how their repayments are reported. title: GoHighLevel system
description: GoHighLevel Recruiting Automation Project Brief Implementation Instructions for Selected GHL Automation Specialist Project Overview You have been selected to build First Family Trust's recruiting and interview automation system inside our existing GoHighLevel account. The hiring framework has already been designed. Your responsibility is to translate the approved process into a clean, functional, tested, and documented GoHighLevel system. Primary objective: A candidate should move from application through screening, assessment, CEO review, paid trial, offer, and final hiring outcome with the CRM controlling pipeline stages, scheduling, communications, reminders, internal tasks, and handoffs. 1. Project Scope • Work inside our existing GoHighLevel account. • Do not modify unrelated existing workflows without approval. • Build the recruiting system using clear workflow names, folders, tags, custom fields, calendars, and pipeline stages. • Use our approved candidate communications and hiring process. • Ask for clarification before making a business-rule assumption that could affect candidates or existing systems. • Test all major paths before the project is considered complete. 2. Dedicated Interview Rooms Coordinate/configure two dedicated recurring Zoom rooms and connect the appropriate links to the scheduling and communication workflows. Room Purpose First Family Trust | Candidate Interview Room Stage 1 recruiter screening First Family Trust | Candidate Assessment Room Stage 2 skills assessment • Do not use the CEO's Personal Meeting ID. • Stage 1 communications must populate the Stage 1 room link. • Stage 2 communications must populate the Assessment room link. • Account for rescheduling/cancellation so outdated reminders are not sent. 3. Build the Recruiting Pipeline Create the pipeline: VA Recruiting Pipeline - 2026. 1. Application Received 2. Application Under Review 3. Interview Approved 4. Stage 1 Scheduled 5. Stage 1 Completed 6. Stage 2 Approved 7. Stage 2 Scheduled 8. CEO Interview 9. Paid Trial 10. Offer Pending 11. Hired 12. Future Consideration 13. Not Selected 4. Candidate Records & Custom Fields Create standardized candidate fields sufficient to operate and report on the recruiting process. • Name, email, phone, location/time zone and application date • Resume/resume link and video introduction link • Current pipeline stage • Interview dates/times and assigned interviewer • Stage 1 score and recommendation • Stage 2 score and recommendation • CEO score/decision • Paid trial score • Strengths, concerns, red flags and technical/communication notes • Follow-up required • Next action and next-action due date • Final decision Use controlled dropdowns where appropriate for recommendations, decisions, interviewer assignment, and other standardized values. 5. Interview Scheduling • Create/configure separate Stage 1 and Stage 2 interview calendars. • Prevent double booking. • Capture and correctly display candidate time zone. • Assign the correct interviewer. • Insert the correct Zoom room link. • Move/update the opportunity when the appointment is booked. • Create internal interviewer notification/task. • Handle reschedules, cancellations, and appointment-status changes correctly. 6. Candidate Communication Automations Trigger / Status Required Action Interview Approved Send approved interview acceptance email. Stage 1 booked Immediate confirmation with date, time, time zone, Zoom link, duration, and preparation instructions. 24 hours before Stage 1 Reminder. 2 hours before Stage 1 Reminder. 15 minutes before Stage 1 Reminder. Stage 2 Approved Send advancement / Stage 2 scheduling communication. Stage 2 booked Send assessment confirmation and correct Assessment Room link. Stage 2 upcoming Send configured reminders. Future Consideration Stop active interview sequence; send approved communication when applicable. Not Selected Send approved rejection communication and stop interview reminders. Offer Pending Trigger internal offer task and approved candidate communication. Hired Stop recruiting workflows and hand off to onboarding. 7. Internal Team Automations • Interview Approved -> scheduling task for Data Manager / Recruiting Coordinator. • Stage 1 Scheduled -> notify HR interviewer and create interview-prep task. • Stage 1 Completed -> create scorecard-completion task if score/recommendation is missing. • Stage 2 Approved -> scheduling task. • Stage 2 Scheduled -> notify Operations Manager and create assessment-prep task. • CEO Interview -> notify CEO/assistant with candidate details, prior scores/notes, and meeting information. • Paid Trial -> create trial setup tasks. • Offer Pending -> create offer preparation/follow-up tasks. • Not Selected or Future Consideration -> close obsolete tasks and stop active interview reminders. 8. Decision & Pipeline Logic The system must support these outcomes without incorrect communications: • Advance • Hold • Decline • Reschedule • Cancel • No-show • Future Consideration • Paid Trial • Offer Pending • Hired Example: once a candidate is declined, canceled, or moved out of an active interview stage, they must not continue receiving interview reminders. 9. Stage Handoffs Stage 1 Handoff • Provide interviewer access to candidate record, resume/link, interview time, Zoom link, and score fields. • Allow interviewer to record score, notes, and Advance / Hold / Decline recommendation. • Advance triggers Stage 2 process; Hold does not a ---------- trigger advancement or rejection; Decline triggers Not Selected process. Stage 2 Handoff • Operations Manager receives candidate details and assessment information. • Candidate receives correct assessment scheduling information and Zoom link. • Store Stage 2 score/recommendation and move passing candidates to CEO Interview. CEO / Paid Trial Handoff • CEO receives finalist information, prior scores, strengths/concerns, and interview details. • CEO approval moves candidate to Paid Trial. • Paid Trial completion captures trial score/final decision. • Approved candidate moves to Offer Pending and then Hired. • Hired candidates leave recruiting workflows and enter onboarding handoff. 10. Recruiting Dashboard Build a simple management view/dashboard showing at minimum: • Total applications • Under review • Interview approved • Stage 1 scheduled/completed/passed • Stage 2 candidates • CEO finalists • Paid trials • Hired • Upcoming interviews • Overdue follow-ups / next actions Leadership should be able to understand the recruiting funnel without opening each individual candidate record. 11. QA & Testing Requirements Before delivery, run test candidates through the system. Test Path Required Application -> Interview -> Stage 2 -> CEO -> Paid Trial -> Offer -> Hired Yes Application -> Interview -> Not Selected Yes Hold Yes Reschedule Yes Cancellation Yes No-show Yes Future Consideration Yes • Verify merge fields: name, date, time, time zone, Zoom link, interviewer, duration. • Verify duplicate-message prevention. • Verify reminders stop when no longer applicable. • Verify pipeline movements. • Verify internal notifications and tasks. • Verify appointment/reschedule/cancellation logic. • Verify no existing unrelated GHL automation is disrupted. 12. Documentation & Handoff At project completion, provide a basic handoff explaining: • Pipeline and stages created • Custom fields created • Calendars configured • Workflows created • Workflow triggers and stop conditions • Tags or naming conventions used • How Stage 1 and Stage 2 scheduling works • How candidate decisions trigger next steps • How to edit candidate email/reminder templates • How to troubleshoot the most likely workflow issues All workflows should be named and organized clearly enough that another GHL administrator can maintain the system later. 13. Definition of Done The project is complete when a test candidate can move through the full First Family Trust recruiting process with correct pipeline stages, scheduling, Zoom links, candidate communications, reminders, internal tasks, score/decision capture, reporting, and final hiring outcome without the team manually rebuilding the process for each candidate. Operating standard: Nobody gets lost in the pipeline, every next action is clear, and automation reduces administrative work without sacrificing accuracy. 14. Completion Checklist ☐ Recruiting pipeline created ☐ Candidate custom fields created ☐ Stage 1 calendar configured ☐ Stage 2 calendar configured ☐ Zoom links connected ☐ Acceptance workflow built ☐ Stage 1 confirmation/reminders built ☐ Stage 2 advancement/confirmation/reminders built ☐ Internal notifications/tasks built ☐ Scorecard follow-up logic built ☐ CEO handoff built ☐ Paid Trial / Offer Pending handoff built ☐ Not Selected / Future Consideration logic built ☐ Hired / onboarding handoff built ☐ Dashboard/reporting view built ☐ All required test paths passed ☐ System documented and handed off

title: Amazon Operations Specialist - Listings, PPC & AI Images (Full-Time)
job_title: Amazon Operations Specialist - Listings, PPC & AI Images (Full-Time)
description: PAY AND HOURS - READ THIS FIRST I am putting this at the top instead of the bottom, because I would rather you stop reading now than after you have done a test task. Rate: $2.50 - $3.00 USD per hour, depending on experience. One-month trial: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday (roughly $220 - $260 for the month) After the trial: full-time, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday (roughly $430 - $520 per month) This is not a premium rate and I am not going to pretend otherwise. What it is, is stable, long-term, and honest about itself from the first line. If that number does not work for you, close this now with no hard feelings - you are not wrong to want more, and I would rather you told me at the start than three months in. At the end of the trial month we both d ---------- . You say whether you want to go full-time, I say whether I want you to. If either answer is no, we stop there with nothing owed either way. WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS Amazon private label operations, across multiple accounts and marketplaces (US, UK, CA, AU). Day to day: - Keyword research, then writing listings from it - title, bullets, description, backend search terms - inside Amazon's character and byte limits and inside Amazon's rules on what you may and may not claim - Producing listing images with AI: main image, the seven-image gallery, A+ and Premium A+ modules - Creating and managing Sponsored Products / Brands / Display campaigns, reading the reports, and changing bids and negatives because of what the data says - Booking deals, setting up coupons, monitoring them - Listing maintenance: suppressions, compliance flags, category and browse node issues, appeals and Plans of Action when they are needed This is an operations job. AI is a tool inside it, not the point of it. STRICT SOP COMPLIANCE - THE PART MOST PEOPLE UNDERESTIMATE Almost everything here is done against a written SOP. Image dimensions, file naming, what may be claimed about a product, how a deal is booked, what goes in a calendar entry. These are not style preferences. On our accounts a wrong character in a file name makes a bulk upload fail silently - the asset never goes live and nothing reports an error. An unsupported claim in a bullet can suppress a listing. A missing field in a calendar entry breaks an automated check downstream. I need someone who reads the document, follows it exactly, and tells me when the document does not cover the situation - rather than guessing and carrying on. If following written process precisely bores you, this is the wrong job and we will both find that out in week two. WHAT YOU MUST HAVE - Two years or more of hands-on Amazon operations experience, inside Seller Central yourself, not producing assets for someone else to upload - Listing creation from keyword research, with a real keyword tool (Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout, SellerSprite - name yours) - AI image production for listings, including A+ and main images - PPC: you have built campaigns and changed them based on reports, not just watched someone else do it - Written and spoken English good enough to read a compliance policy and write copy that sells - Overlap with Australian business hours (Manila is 2 hours behind Sydney, so normal Philippine working hours are fine) Nice to have, not required: video editing or AI video, Shopify, experience with health, beauty or personal care categories. HOW TO APPLY Put the word WOMBAT at the top of your application. I use it to see who reads to the end. Applications without it are not read. Then answer these. Short answers are fine. Made-up answers are worse than short ones. 1. Which Amazon accounts or brands have you worked on? Give me one live ASIN or storefront link I can open. 2. How many years have you personally worked inside Seller Central? What do you do in there in a normal week? 3. What tool do you use for keyword research, and what do you do with the export once you have it? 4. Which AI tools do you use for listing images? Send me ONE image you made yourself, and tell me: what the first generation got wrong, what you changed, and how many attempts it took. The failed versions are more useful to me than the finished one. 5. In your experience, what is the most common way AI product images go wrong, and how do you catch it before it goes live? 6. Have you handled a suppressed listing, a policy warning, or a compliance appeal? Describe one - what was wrong, what you actually did in Seller Central, and how long it took. 7. Your rate, and when you could start. BONUS QUESTION - this is the one I read first Pick any product that is currently number one in its category on Amazon. Send me the link, and tell me five things you would change about its listing and why. You are allowed to tell me it is already good and that there is nothing worth changing - if that is your honest read, say so and explain it. I am not testing whether you can find faults. I am testing whether you can look at a page and see what is actually driving it. A FEW THINGS ABOUT HOW I WORK I read every application properly and I reply to everyone, including no. If I ask you to do a test task, it will be short - an hour or two of work, not a day of it. I would rather you tell me you do not know something than guess. Asking questions before you start is a good sign, not a bad one. Thanks for reading this far.
