title: SEO & AI Visibility Account manager
description: # SEO & AI Visibility Client Success Manager ## About SaaSLaunch SaaSLaunch helps SaaS companies grow through predictable acquisition systems, AI-powered search visibility, and high-performing digital infrastructure. We're looking for an **SEO & AI Visibility Client Success Manager** to take ownership of client communication and oversee the execution of our SEO, AEO, and GEO services. This is **not a traditional SEO specialist role where you'll spend your entire day writing articles or manually doing SEO work.** You'll be responsible for making sure our clients get results. You'll communicate directly with clients, coordinate with our developers, QA website and landing page work, identify opportunities, and make sure everything that needs to get done actually gets done. You'll also use our internal software and systems to manage blogs, articles, artifacts, website scans, AI visibility analysis, and other SEO/AEO/GEO initiatives. ## About the Role You'll own a portfolio of SaaS clients and act as the bridge between the client and our execution team. A typical day might include reviewing a client's website, identifying pages that should be created or improved, assigning changes to our developer, QA'ing completed work, making small website or Google Business Profile updates, reviewing visibility data, and communicating progress to the client. We're looking for someone who takes initiative. If you notice a client needs a new page, you shouldn't wait for someone to tell you to create it. You should identify the opportunity, coordinate with the developer, QA the finished work, and make sure it gets launched. Our systems handle much of the heavy lifting. Your job is to **manage, oversee, QA, communicate, and continuously look for ways to improve client results.** ## Responsibilities * Own day-to-day communication with assigned clients * Build strong client relationships and keep clients informed on progress * Oversee SEO, AEO, and GEO execution across client accounts * Review client websites and identify opportunities for improvement * Coordinate website and landing page changes with our developer * Request new pages when opportunities are identified * QA landing pages, website changes, content, and other deliverables before they go live * Optimize existing website pages when needed * Make smaller website and Google Business Profile updates * Use our internal software to manage blogs, articles, artifacts, scans, analysis, and AI visibility initiatives * Review SEO and AI visibility performance and determine what should happen next * Identify problems or opportunities before the client has to point them out * Keep developers and other team members accountable for completing client work * Ensure client accounts continue moving forward without requiring founder involvement ## You're a Strong Fit If You * Have experience with SEO, AEO, GEO, website management, or digital marketing * Understand the fundamentals of on-page and technical SEO * Are comfortable working with websites, landing pages, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile * Can review a landing page or website and identify obvious problems or opportunities * Are comfortable communicating directly with clients * Can translate technical work into simple updates clients understand * Have experience coordinating developers, designers, writers, or other specialists * Are highly organized and can manage multiple client accounts simultaneously * Take initiative instead of waiting to be given every task * Follow up relentlessly when something needs to get completed * Are comfortable learning new AI and SEO software quickly * Care about client results and retention, not simply completing a checklist Experience working with SaaS or B2B companies is a major plus. ## What Success Looks Like **Client Success:** Clients are happy, informed, seeing progress, and getting measurable results. **Ownership:** Accounts move forward without the founders needing to manage day-to-day execution. **Execution:** Website changes, new pages, optimizations, and deliverables are completed quickly and correctly. **Quality:** Work is properly reviewed and QA'd before reaching the client or going live. **Initiative:** You're constantly identifying the next opportunity to improve a client's SEO, AEO, and GEO performance. ## How to Apply Apply here: ---------- Please include: * A 1-minute Loom video introducing yourself * Relevant SEO, website management, client success, or project management experience * Examples of SEO results or websites you've worked on * An explanation of how you've managed clients, developers, or other team members in the past **Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.** We're looking for someone who takes ownership. If something can improve a client's results, we want someone who identifies it, gets it implemented, verifies it was done correctly, and communicates the progress to the client.

title: VIRTUAL MARKETPLACE DEAL SPECIALIST
description: Deal Finding • Online Flipping • Facebook Marketplace • Sales • Research • AI WE ARE HIRING 2 PEOPLE—READ THIS ENTIRE POSTING BEFORE APPLYING. We are starting at ground zero to build a virtual flipping business and looking for TWO hungry, resourceful, profit-driven virtual assistants who want an opportunity to grow with a business rather than simply complete tasks. This is NOT a traditional VA/data-entry position. We are looking for people who think like deal hunters, researchers, negotiators, and salespeople. Your job is simple to understand: FIND OPPORTUNITIES. CREATE DEALS. GENERATE PROFIT. We will provide the systems, technology, training, and some scripts. You bring the hustle, judgment, communication skills, creativity, and desire to make money. WHAT WE DO We are building a technology-assisted virtual flipping operation. Our AI-powered scraping system will identify potential opportunities from online marketplaces and classified websites such as Craigslist, OfferUp, Facebook Marketplace, and similar platforms. We will pursue two primary types of opportunities. LOW-TICKET FLIPS Examples include: Couches • Furniture • TVs • Electronics • Appliances • Watches • Tools • Exercise Equipment • Household Items • Free Items Our system may identify something being given away FREE or sold significantly below its potential resale value. Your job is to determine: Is there actually money here? You may research comparable items, determine realistic resale value, improve the listing, communicate with buyers/sellers, and help move the opportunity toward an actual sale. HIGH-TICKET OPPORTUNITIES We will also pursue: Cars • Trucks • Motorcycles • Boats • RVs • ATVs • Trailers • Equipment and other valuable assets. Depending on the opportunity and applicable rules, the business may pursue an authorized referral/finder arrangement, negotiated spread, or other appropriate transaction structure. You must never misrepresent ownership, possession, title status, or our authority regarding an item. THE AI FINDS LEADS. YOU FIND THE MONEY. We already have technology designed to help identify potential listings. We are NOT hiring you to manually scroll through websites for eight hours per day. The system helps generate possibilities. Your value is what happens AFTER the lead appears. You will evaluate opportunities and ask questions such as: What is this actually worth? Is the asking price really below market? What are comparable items selling for? How quickly could we realistically sell it? Is there enough margin? Is this worth our time? What information is missing? What could kill the deal? How should we market it? Who is the likely buyer? Should we negotiate? How can we turn this lead into PROFIT? We want someone who eventually sees opportunities that the system itself missed. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your responsibilities may include: Reviewing leads generated by our AI scraper Researching realistic resale values Finding comparable listings Calculating potential margins Identifying the strongest opportunities Ranking and prioritizing deals Researching products, vehicles, and other assets Verifying listing information Improving titles and descriptions Preparing Facebook Marketplace listings Monitoring active listings Adjusting pricing and strategy Responding to buyer and seller messages Following up with interested prospects Negotiating within approved guidelines Tracking leads and deals Maintaining accurate records Flagging scams and suspicious opportunities Finding creative ways to get slow-moving inventory sold Reporting what is working and what isn't Helping improve our process as we learn Most importantly: YOU ARE EXPECTED TO ACTIVELY HELP TURN OPPORTUNITIES INTO PROFIT. YES — YOU MUST BE COMFORTABLE TALKING TO PEOPLE This position is NOT text-only. You must be comfortable communicating with people through: Phone calls • Voice drops/messages • Text/chat • Email • Marketplace messaging We will provide scripts for many situations. However, real conversations don't always follow scripts. Sometimes a seller is going to ask something unexpected. Sometimes a buyer needs reassurance. Sometimes you need to negotiate. Sometimes you simply need to have a normal human-to-human conversation. If you are uncomfortable speaking with people, making calls, leaving voice messages, following up, or having unscripted conversations in English, this position is probably not for you. You do NOT need a perfect American accent. You DO need to communicate clearly, confidently, professionally, and naturally. WE ARE LOOKING FOR ENTREPRENEURS — NOT TASK CHECKERS This is extremely important. We do NOT want someone whose mindset is: “I posted my listings. My work is finished.” Posting something does not make the business money. Selling it does. If something isn't selling, we expect you to think: Should we change the price? Should we improve the photos? Should we rewrite the title? Should we change the description? Should we target a different buyer? Should we follow up with previous inquiries? Should we pursue another platform? What can we learn from competing listings? What else can we do to MOVE THIS DEAL? We want people who naturally think: “What can I do to help turn this into money?” 60-DAY PROFITABILITY TRIAL The first 60 days are a trial period. During those 60 days, we will build the operation together, test strategies, improve our systems, learn which categories perform best, and determine whether you can consistently contribute to profitable transactions. We understand that building a new operation takes time. We are NOT expecting magic on Day 1. But we ARE expecting urgency. By the end of the 60-day period, we need to see clear evidence that the operation — and your individual contribution to it — can produce profit. Simply logging in, posting listings, completing assigned tasks, and collecting a paycheck will not be enough. We are looking for people who want to BUILD something. COMPENSATION & PROFIT-SHARING Starting Base Pay: $200 USD biweekly The base salary provides guaranteed starting compensation while we build and test the operation. But the base salary is NOT where we want your income to stop. Our objective is to create a profitable operation where performance becomes considerably more valuable than base pay. Once the business reaches the defined profitability threshold, each team member may earn approximately: 10%–15% OF ELIGIBLE GROSS PROFIT Final percentages, qualifying transactions, calculation methods, and payment rules will be documented as part of the compensation plan. The long-term business target is: $10,000–$20,000+ MONTHLY PROFIT That will not happen overnight, and it is NOT a promise or guarantee of earnings. It is the target we are building toward. As the business becomes profitable, the goal is for strong performers to have significantly more upside through performance compensation than they would receive from base salary alone. We want your financial interests aligned with ours. When the business makes more money because of your contribution, we want you to have the opportunity to make more money too. WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE? You may be a great fit if you are: HUNGRY — You want more than a basic VA position. RESOURCEFUL — When you don't know something, you figure it out. PROFIT-MINDED — You understand that activity and results are different things. PERSISTENT — One unanswered message doesn't mean the lead is dead. A RESEARCHER — You can investigate an item and determine what it is realistically worth. COMFORTABLE WITH PEOPLE — You can communicate by phone, voice, chat, and email. TECH-SAVVY — You are comfortable learning AI tools and new systems. INDEPENDENT — Once trained, you don't need someone watching you every minute. CREATIVE — If Strategy A isn't working, you start thinking about Strategy B. ORGANIZED — Leads, buyers, sellers, follow-ups, prices, and transactions must be tracked accurately. COACHABLE — We are building this system together and will constantly improve it. EXPERIENCE THAT WILL GET OUR ATTENTION Experience with any of these is helpful: Facebook Marketplace • Craigslist • OfferUp • eBay • Mercari • Online Arbitrage • Reselling • Marketplace Selling • Lead Generation • Product Research • Vehicle Research • Used-Car Sales • Appointment Setting • Sales • Negotiation • Cold Calling • Customer Service • Real Estate Wholesaling • Deal Sourcing • Google Sheets • Excel • CRM Systems • ChatGPT • AI Tools You do NOT need experience with everything. We would rather hire someone intelligent, hungry, resourceful, and coachable than someone with a perfect résumé and no drive. CAREER GROWTH We are initially hiring TWO people. As the operation grows, responsibilities may expand into areas such as: Deal Acquisition Marketplace Sales High-Ticket Deal Research Negotiation Team Leadership Training Quality Control Operations Management Our goal is to identify people early who can eventually help RUN parts of this business instead of simply working inside it. IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY THROUGH THIS POSTING LIKE EVERYONE ELSE We intentionally created a specific application process. If you read this entire job posting, follow the instructions below EXACTLY. Generic applications will not receive a response. Do not send a long cover letter. Do not send us an AI-generated essay explaining why you are hardworking. We want to see whether you can follow instructions. STEP 1 — EMAIL APPLICATION Send an email directly to: ---------- Your email subject line MUST be: FLIP TEAM 2026 — [YOUR FIRST NAME] Example: FLIP TEAM 2026 — Maria Do not change the words FLIP TEAM 2026. Our system uses this exact phrase to trigger the next stage of the application process. If you follow the instructions correctly, you will receive the Stage 1 Applicant Assessment. Complete Stage 1 carefully. Only the strongest Stage 1 applicants will be invited to Stage 2. Stage 2 will be significantly more difficult and will test whether you can actually identify, research, evaluate, and think through real opportunities. We are not looking for the most applicants. WE ARE LOOKING FOR TWO SUPERSTARS.

What you will do Apparel design (the main job) + Shopify Store Assistant Create original vector artwork for all-over-print combat sports apparel: rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees. Build print-ready files that match manufacturer specs: correct dimensions, resolution, bleed, panel placement, and seam alignment across sizes. Develop colorways and variations of existing designs, and keep whole collections visually consistent. Work from a brief and from our existing style, while bringing your own ideas for designs you think will sell. Mockups and visuals Produce clean, realistic product mockups for the store, ads, and social. Retouch and edit imagery in Photoshop so the catalog looks consistent and premium. Create supporting graphics when needed: collection banners, promo images, product-page graphics. General store assistant work Upload and organize products in Shopify: images, variants, collections, tidying up messy or duplicate listings. Prepare and resize assets for different placements across the store and ad channels. Handle small ongoing tasks that keep the store accurate and up to date. What we are looking for Must have Strong vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator. This is the core skill and we will test it. Real experience designing apparel for print, ideally all-over sublimation. You understand how a flat file becomes a finished garment. Photoshop skills for mockups and image retouching. A portfolio of apparel or graphic design work. Required, no exceptions. A strong eye for bold, modern design that fits combat sports culture. Precision. Print files that are off by a few millimeters cost us real money, so details matter. Willingness to do the non-design store tasks as well. This is not a pure design role. Good written English and reliable communication. Nice to have You train BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, or wrestling, or you genuinely follow the sport. Shopify experience. Comfort using AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal) to work faster. Figma, or experience building tech packs and working directly with manufacturers. How we work Before each project we agree on the brief, the references, and the specs, so nothing is fuzzy. We move fast and ship often. Strong applicants get a short paid trial task (one rashguard design plus a mockup) before we finalize. How to apply All applications go through our form. We do not accept applications by email or DM. Applications with the wrong or missing keyword are not reviewed.

description: ReloCovered is a U.S.-based temporary housing company that helps families find furnished housing when they are displaced from their homes due to fire, water damage, insurance claims, renovations, and other covered losses. We are looking for an **experienced Temporary Housing Placement Coordinator** who understands the insurance relocation and corporate housing industry. **This position is specifically for candidates with temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance relocation, ALE, leasing, or similar housing-placement experience.** ### Responsibilities * Manage temporary housing requests from initial intake through completed placement * Review each family's housing requirements, location, budget, move-in date, pets, bedrooms, school needs, and other requirements * Source appropriate furnished and unfurnished properties * Contact landlords, property managers, real estate agents, and property owners * Verify availability and property details * Negotiate rental rates, deposits, lease terms, utilities, furnishings, and extensions * Present housing options for approval * Communicate with insurance relocation companies, adjusters, policyholders, landlords, and agents * Follow up consistently until the housing placement is approved and secured * Coordinate rental applications and screening through approved secure systems * Prepare and coordinate lease documentation * Coordinate move-in details * Manage lease extensions when additional temporary housing is required * Maintain accurate notes and status updates for every housing case * Protect confidential company pricing, negotiated rates, client information, and business margins * Work closely with ReloCovered management to successfully complete placements ### Experience We Are Looking For **Strong preference will be given to applicants who have previously worked for:** * Temporary housing companies * Insurance relocation companies * Corporate housing companies * ALE / Additional Living Expense housing providers * Property insurance claims organizations * Furnished housing companies * Relocation companies * Mid-term rental companies Experience working with insurance adjusters, displaced policyholders, landlords, real estate agents, and property managers is highly preferred. Existing experience or relationships within the **insurance temporary-housing industry** is a major advantage. ### You Should Be Able To: * Understand how an insurance temporary-housing placement works from beginning to end * Speak confidently with U.S. landlords, agents, adjusters, and clients * Negotiate rental terms professionally * Search quickly for properties that meet specific housing requirements * Manage multiple active housing placements simultaneously * Follow up aggressively and professionally * Keep every case organized and documented * Work independently and solve problems * Communicate clearly in written and spoken English * Maintain strict confidentiality regarding pricing and client information ### Ideal Candidate We are especially interested in someone who has **already worked inside the temporary housing / insurance relocation industry** and can bring real-world knowledge of how placements are handled. We do not want to train someone from zero on what temporary housing is. We want someone who understands the industry and can help ReloCovered grow its housing-placement operation. ### Compensation Competitive compensation based on experience. **Performance and placement bonuses available for successfully completed housing placements.** ### HOW TO APPLY Please provide: 1. Your resume 2. A short voice introduction 3. The names or types of temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance, relocation, or property companies you have worked for 4. How many years of temporary-housing or relocation experience you have 5. Describe your role in completing a housing placement from the initial request through move-in 6. Tell us whether you have experience communicating with insurance adjusters or ALE/relocation companies 7. Tell us whether you have existing industry relationships 8. Your expected compensation **Please apply only if you have relevant housing, relocation, corporate housing, leasing, or insurance-industry experience.**

description: Schedule: Full-Time | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST Requirement: Strong Customer Service & Operations Experience VT Start Date: Immediate About the Role: We’re looking for a reliable, warm, organized, and proactive Member Support & Operations Specialist to become the operational backbone of the member experience. As a Member Support & Operation Specialist, You Will Be Responsible For: * Member Support and Customer Service * Own the member support inbox across Lovable, Wix, and email * Triage, respond to, resolve, and route member questions and concerns * Handle login, access, account, and membership troubleshooting * Maintain a first-response target so members are not left waiting more than one business day; weekends may allow up to 48 hours * Build and maintain a template library for consistent, warm, and on-brand communication * Develop and maintain FAQs and help documentation to reduce recurring questions * Track recurring member issues and identify patterns * Recognize onboarding, outreach, and potential churn signals and hand them off to the appropriate team member with context Billing and Payments * Manage day-to-day Stripe activities * Investigate failed payments, expired cards, disputes, and payment issues * Process refund requests with the required approval * Support payment recovery efforts before memberships lapse * Handle membership plan and account-related billing concerns * Reconcile Stripe information with the member platform * Maintain clean and accurate billing records * Handle sensitive payment and member information with discretion Community Support and Moderation * Moderate the member community and help keep the space safe, organized, and on topic * Post announcements and promote upcoming events * Highlight member wins, stories, and positive contributions * Maintain pinned posts, resources, and community housekeeping * Partner with the team to ensure members feel welcomed and supported Events and Live Sessions * Create and manage Zoom links * Set up calendar invites and event reminders * Ensure events are added to the appropriate internal team calendars * Support day-of event logistics and setup Track event attendance * Record live sessions and ensure replays are uploaded and accessible to members * Post and promote upcoming events within the community Content Operations * Upload and organize content within the member platform * Keep the content library organized, tagged, and easy to navigate * Monitor content usage and engagement by topic * Gather member feedback regarding content * Identify outdated content, gaps, and opportunities for improvement * Report which content and topics members are actually using Feedback & Bug Tracking * Track and organize member feedback into clear themes * Run simple member surveys, including sending, collecting, and summarizing responses * Log platform bugs with clear reproduction steps and severity * Coordinate with the appropriate team members or developers when issues need to be fixed * Follow up and close the loop with members once reported issues are resolved * Surface recurring concerns and provide recommendations to the team Data, Reporting and Documentation * Maintain an accurate and organized member database * Track cancellation and churn trends * Prepare a weekly metrics snapshot covering new members, churn, trial conversion, event attendance, and content usage * Keep operational records clean and up to date * Document recurring processes so important workflows do not depend on one person's knowledge * Provide insights and recommendations based on member activity and feedback Tools and Technical Capability * Experience with the following tools is not required, as training will be provided. However, candidates should demonstrate strong digital fluency and the ability to learn new platforms quickly. * Stripe – subscriptions, failed payments, refunds, and payment issues * Lovable – member community and platform operations * Zoom – scheduling, links, recordings, and live-session logistics * Wix Calendar – calendar and event management * Slack – internal team communication * Email platforms – member communication and support * Spreadsheets – maintaining member data and preparing weekly reporting * General digital tools and platform backends You should be the type of person who can explore a new tool, figure out how it works, and become comfortable using it without needing step-by-step training for every task. Nice To Haves * We’d especially love to hear from you if you have: * Experience working for a membership, subscription, or community-based business * Experience with customer success or member support * Experience handling refunds, disputes, or subscription billing * Light copywriting or content organization experience * Experience supporting live virtual events * Experience moderating an online community * Experience working with SaaS platforms or multiple web-based systems * Experience supporting a family-focused organization or audience * A background that gives you a natural understanding of the needs of families We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, takes ownership of problems, and can keep multiple moving parts organized without constant supervision. description: M&A Acquisition Research & Deal Sourcing Specialist I am looking for a sharp, resourceful researcher to help identify privately owned U.S. businesses that may be potential acquisition targets. This is NOT a basic data-entry or list-scraping position. Your job is to research companies against specific acquisition criteria, determine whether they are actually qualified targets, identify the owner/decision-maker, verify company and contact information, and maintain an organized acquisition pipeline. Responsibilities Find privately owned U.S. businesses matching acquisition criteria I provide Research and qualify each company before adding it to the final list Identify the actual owner, founder, CEO, or appropriate decision-maker Research estimated revenue/company size using credible sources and reasonable proxies Find and verify business email addresses and phone numbers Find owner and company LinkedIn profiles Research employee count, years in business, ownership and company background Understand the company's primary services and business model Identify whether the company appears independently/founder owned or institutionally/PE owned Maintain clean records and remove duplicates Add qualified companies and contacts into our CRM Eventually assist with email, LinkedIn and phone outreach to business owners Track outreach, responses and follow-ups Important: We measure production based on unique qualified companies, not number of contacts. Finding two executives at one company does not count as two acquisition targets. You should be comfortable using: Google, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, company websites, Google Maps, Apollo or similar databases, email verification tools, Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and AI research tools. Experience researching privately held businesses, M&A targets, business owners, B2B leads, private equity, investment banking, commercial lending, or business brokerage is strongly preferred. What I'm looking for I need someone who can think critically and investigate—not someone who simply copies information from a database. If revenue is not publicly available, I expect you to know how to use available information such as employee count, company history, industry, locations and other sources to develop a reasonable company-size estimate and clearly identify it as an estimate. Accuracy matters, but so does efficiency. APPLICATION TEST — REQUIRED In your application, answer these questions: Tell me about any experience you have researching privately owned companies or acquisition targets. What tools would you use to estimate the revenue or size of a private company when exact financials aren't publicly available? How would you determine whether a company is founder-owned, independently owned, or owned by private equity? How many unique companies do you reasonably believe you can source, qualify and enrich in a 4-hour work period? What lead-generation/research tools do you currently know how to use?

description: I am launching a running coaching business focused on helping serious recreational runners improve their performance. The business will initially offer personalized 1-on-1 coaching and may later expand into a paid online running community. I am looking for a smart, creative, highly reliable person to help me build and operate the digital side of the business. This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant role. I am looking for someone who can take raw ideas, videos, photos, voice notes, and coaching concepts and turn them into polished, professional content. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Manage and help grow the business's Instagram presence • Edit short-form running videos and Reels • Create clean, professional graphics and carousel posts • Write strong captions and other content based on source material I provide • Help build and maintain a simple, professional coaching website • Maintain a content calendar and schedule posts • Repurpose individual pieces of source material into multiple pieces of content • Help establish and maintain a consistent visual brand and writing style • Use AI tools intelligently to make the content-development process faster and better • Eventually assist with email/newsletter marketing and the digital/administrative side of a paid running community HOW WE'LL WORK I will provide the expertise and source material: raw videos, voice notes, photos, training observations, ideas, and conversations about running and coaching. Your job is to turn that raw material into finished content. For example, I might send you a 5-minute video explaining a marathon-training concept. A great person in this role might see opportunities to turn that single video into a Reel, carousel, written post, website article, and several future content ideas. I do NOT want generic AI-generated fitness content. The coaching philosophy and technical running advice will come from me. I want you to help me communicate those ideas exceptionally well. WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR You should be strong in most of the following: • Excellent written English • Instagram content creation • Short-form video editing (CapCut or similar) • Canva • ChatGPT and/or other AI tools • Content repurposing • Squarespace, WordPress, or similar website platforms • Strong visual/design judgment • Excellent organization and reliability • Ability to work independently and take initiative BONUS: RUNNING / ENDURANCE SPORTS A genuine interest in running, marathon training, endurance sports, fitness, or sports science would be a major advantage. You do NOT need to be a running coach. But if you're a runner yourself—or genuinely interested in endurance sports—please tell me about it. This is approximately 10 hours per week initially, with a flexible schedule. There is an opportunity for the role to grow as the coaching business grows. HOW TO APPLY Please do not send me a generic application. I care much more about your work, creativity, and how you think than I do about a long résumé. title: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
job_title: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator Custom Artwork / Sports Apparel / Illustration / Seamless Patterns $12–$20 USD/hour | Long-Term | Approximately 15–25 Hours/Week We are looking for an exceptionally creative, senior-level graphic designer and illustrator to join our team on an ongoing freelance basis. CREATIVITY IS THE #1 REQUIREMENT FOR THIS ROLE. This is not primarily a production design position. We are not looking for someone who simply places logos on templates, follows detailed instructions, or waits to be told exactly what to create. We need an outstanding visual designer who can be given very limited creative direction and develop the idea themselves. Your primary responsibility will be creating custom artwork and product graphics based on customer logos, brands, themes, and design requests. A typical project may begin with nothing more than: A customer’s logo + a few colors + a short sentence describing what they want. From there, you are the creative. You will be expected to determine the visual direction and create the patterns, illustrations, icons, typography, supporting graphics, layouts, and other artwork necessary to turn that limited information into an exceptional finished collection. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Interpret customer requests with very little creative direction - Develop original visual concepts independently - Create original graphics and artwork for apparel and other products - Design cohesive collections across multiple products - Determine how artwork should merchandise across different products rather than simply repeating the same design - Create original vector illustrations, icons, badges, logos, typography, and supporting artwork - Create sophisticated seamless repeating patterns - Work with customer logos and existing brand assets - Recreate low-resolution customer logos as clean vector artwork when necessary - Develop artwork specifically for sublimated sports/performance apparel - Adapt creative concepts across apparel, accessories, and other products - Use AI intelligently to accelerate portions of the creative process when appropriate - Take feedback well and quickly develop revised creative solutions CREATIVITY IS ESSENTIAL We cannot emphasize this enough. We are looking for someone with excellent taste, strong visual instincts, and the ability to generate ideas independently. If you require detailed creative briefs, sketches, or step-by-step instructions before you can begin designing, this will not be the right position for you. We want someone who can look at a customer’s brand, understand its personality, and think: “Here are five interesting directions we could take this.” Not: “What exactly would you like me to make?” You should be comfortable making creative decisions yourself and presenting strong solutions rather than waiting for someone else to solve the creative problem for you. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Adobe Illustrator — EXPERT LEVEL You must be an exceptional Adobe Illustrator user. You should be able to work quickly and confidently with complex vector artwork without assistance. You must have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator. We will train you on our internal processes. We will not train you on design software. Illustration — STRONG/EXPERT You must actually be able to illustrate. This includes creating: - Original vector graphics - Icons - Logos and badges - Custom typography - Mascots/characters when needed - Graphic elements - Pattern assets - Supporting collection artwork We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is arranging stock assets. Seamless Patterns — ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED You must know how to professionally create seamless repeating patterns in: Adobe Illustrator AND Adobe Photoshop. This is a core requirement of the position. Sports / Sublimated Apparel Experience You should have professional experience designing for sports, performance, or sublimated apparel. Experience with categories such as golf, cycling, running, outdoor, team sports, or similar products is highly desirable. You must understand how artwork interacts with garment panels and how to design a collection that works across multiple product types. AI EXPERIENCE We actively use AI as a creative accelerator, and you should be comfortable doing the same. You should understand how to use modern AI creative tools to help: - Explore concepts - Generate reference material - Develop supporting assets - Accelerate illustration - Explore compositions - Generate ideas faster However, the finished work cannot look AI-generated. AI is a tool—not a substitute for design ability. You must have the taste and technical ability to recognize poor AI output, refine/rebuild assets when necessary, and turn generated ideas into polished, professional artwork. A great designer using AI should become faster and more capable, not produce generic AI artwork. THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR We want someone who is: - Extremely creative - A genuinely strong visual problem solver - A senior-level designer, not someone still learning their craft - An excellent illustrator - Highly self-sufficient - Fast in Adobe Illustrator - Comfortable starting with very limited direction - Able to take constructive feedback without becoming dependent on direction - Capable of switching between completely different visual styles - Excellent at color, typography, composition, and pattern - Able to understand a brand quickly - Organized and reliable - Comfortable managing multiple custom projects - Excited about making genuinely cool artwork Creativity and portfolio quality matter more to us than years of experience or formal education. HOURS & COMPENSATION This is intended to become a consistent, long-term working relationship. Our target is approximately 25 hours per week at $12–$15 USD/hour, depending on experience, speed, and portfolio quality. However: We are willing to pay up to $20 USD/hour for an exceptional designer, even if that means fewer guaranteed weekly hours. We would rather have 15–20 hours from an incredible designer than 25 hours from an average one. During busy periods, there may also be opportunities to take on additional projects/hours for additional compensation or performance bonuses, based on availability. PORTFOLIO REQUIRED — NO EXCEPTIONS Do not apply without a portfolio. Your portfolio is the most important part of your application. We especially want to see: - Your most creative work - Sports/performance apparel graphics - Sublimated apparel - Complete coordinated collections - Seamless patterns - Original vector illustration - Logos, badges, and icons you personally created - Projects where you developed the creative direction yourself We are not particularly interested in portfolios dominated by social media graphics, corporate presentations, UI/UX, Canva templates, or generic branding projects. We want to see ARTWORK. TO APPLY Please include: 1. Portfolio link — REQUIRED 2. Show us the 3 projects that best demonstrate how creative you are. 3. Show us a sports/apparel collection you personally designed. 4. Show us at least 2 seamless patterns you personally built and tell us what software you used to create them. 5. Show us examples of your original vector illustration work. 6. Describe your experience with sublimated apparel. 7. Tell us which AI creative tools you currently use and how they fit into your design process. 8. Confirm that you have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator. 9. Confirm your weekly availability and desired hourly rate. FINAL CREATIVE QUESTION: Imagine a customer gives you only their logo, brand colors, and the words “retro tropical golf.” They want a collection but provide no additional creative direction. Briefly describe the first 3 visual concepts you would explore. Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

Your responsibilities: - Find products that are selling well on Amazon USA - Find the lowest legitimate purchase source for each product - Compare the Amazon selling price with the purchase price - Research sales demand and estimated monthly sales - Review Keepa price history and pricing stability - Check competition, seller count, and whether Amazon sells the product directly - Estimate Amazon fees, net profit per unit, and ROI - Find clearance deals, discounts, coupons, wholesalers, distributors, and legitimate retailers - Prioritize products that can be purchased and resold repeatedly - Enter every qualified opportunity into a Google Sheet Initial target: I am willing to start with lower-profit products if they sell quickly. Good leads may make approximately $1-$5+ net profit per unit, provided they have high sales volume, consistent demand, stable Amazon pricing, and replenishment potential. Consistent sales volume is more important than a large profit on one item. Every product lead must include: - Product name and ASIN - Amazon URL - Purchase source and source URL - Purchase price and Amazon selling price - Estimated Amazon fees - Estimated net profit and ROI - Estimated monthly sales - Number of Amazon sellers - Keepa price history and pricing-stability notes - Whether Amazon sells the product directly - Known restrictions or intellectual-property concerns - Whether the product appears replenishable - A concise explanation of why you recommend it Important scope limits: You will not purchase products, use my bank or credit cards, buy or create shipping labels, choose or contact shipping carriers, handle customer orders, ship products, manage Seller Central, change Amazon listings, or receive access to my main Amazon password. Your work is strictly: find products, find the best legitimate price, analyze the Amazon opportunity, and send me the results. Preferred experience: - Amazon product research - Keepa and SellerAmp - Online arbitrage and wholesale sourcing - Amazon USA - Google Sheets - Product profitability analysis When applying, please answer all 10 questions: 1. How long have you researched products for Amazon? 2. Do you use Keepa? 3. Do you use SellerAmp? 4. Have you done online arbitrage? 5. Have you researched wholesale products? 6. How do you determine whether a product sells well? 7. How do you determine whether Amazon pricing is stable? 8. How many quality product leads can you realistically find per day? 9. What hourly rate do you charge? 10. What country are you located in? Selected applicants may be given a small paid test before being hired for ongoing work.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor — DTC Product Launch (US market)
job_title: Meta Ads Video Editor — DTC Product Launch (US market)
description: Are you a video editor who can turn one 10-second clip into 12 testable ad variants — and knows why that matters more than the edit itself? We're launching Lielow in the US: a bean bag you carry like a tote. You put it on the ground, sit on your towel, and lean back on it. 1.8 lbs, arrives already filled, four colourways. It's proven in Portugal — sold out ten times — and completely unknown in America. We have ~80 raw clips, AI studio shots, and 8 finished ad scripts ready to edit. We need one editor to own the whole batch and every batch after it. What You'll Be Doing Editing 8 launch ads from finished scripts — shot list, timings, on-screen text and VO are all written for you. You cut, not concept. Delivering every ad as a textless master + 3 hook-overlay versions, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. That's ~10 files per ad. This is the core of the job. Building ads that work with the sound off — burned-in captions on every beat, product visible in frame one, cut on the action. Turning around new hook variants and new batches weekly as we find out what works. Working directly with the creative director on what's converting and what to cut. Requirements Proven Meta / Facebook ads editing — not TikTok organic. If your reel is trending-audio edits, this isn't the role. You already know: no CapCut watermarks, no unlicensed trending audio, text in the middle third only, light grade (Meta compression destroys heavy LUTs), first frame = thumbnail. Fast and consistent at volume. We'd rather have 12 good variants this week than 3 perfect ones next week. Comfortable with burned-in captions, clean type, and matching an existing brand look. Strong English — the ads are for US consumers and the copy is written in US English. Reliable async communication and clear file naming. We ship on a schedule. Nice To Have eCommerce / DTC / Shopify brand experience Basic graphic design (statics and carousels) — we need those too Experience editing founder/UGC talking-head content Why Join Us Ground floor of a US launch. You'll see every result — hook rate, CTR, cost per purchase — on the ads you cut. Every ad you make has a written hypothesis. You'll learn direct-response creative properly, not by guessing. Ongoing work, not a one-off batch. We test weekly and we don't stop. Performance bonus on creatives that win. To Apply, Send: 2–3 paid ads you edited — not organic content. Tell us the platform and, if you know it, how they performed. A one-line answer: why does an ad need to work with the sound off? Your hourly rate, and how many hours you have available per week. Put "Montauk" in your application title. Paid test before we hire: we'll send you one raw clip and one script. You deliver a 10-second cut — textless master plus two hook versions, 9:16 and 4:5. Paid at your quoted rate.

title: Part-Time Sales & Client Outreach Assistant
description: # Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor **Remote | 40 Hours Per Week- $108 per week | Initial Week-to-Week Trial** Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. is seeking a confident, reliable, organized, and results-driven **Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor** to support our outbound calling, lead generation, customer follow-up, appointment setting, and business development activities. This is an **independent contractor engagement and not an employment position**. The engagement will begin with a **four-week trial period conducted on a week-to-week basis**. Following successful completion of the trial period, Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. may continue the contractor engagement for approximately **3–6 months**, depending on performance, reliability, results, and ongoing business requirements. --- ## 1. Contract Term & Week-to-Week Trial The first **four (4) weeks** will be considered a trial period. During the first month: * The engagement will operate on a **week-to-week basis**. * Each week will be evaluated independently. * Performance, reliability, punctuality, communication, call activity, lead follow-up, professionalism, and results will be reviewed. * Continuation into the following week will depend on satisfactory performance and the ongoing requirements of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. * Completion of the four-week trial does not automatically guarantee a longer-term contract. The purpose of the trial period is to determine whether the working relationship is a suitable fit for both the Contractor and Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. Following successful completion of the four-week trial, Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. may continue the contractor engagement for approximately **3–6 months**. There is no guarantee that the contract will continue for the full 3–6 month period. Continuation will depend on performance, results, reliability, professionalism, conduct, and business requirements. --- ## 2. Required Service Schedule The Contractor must be available to provide services during the following agreed hours: **Monday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time **Tuesday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time **Thursday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time **Total: 12 hours per week** ### Strict Schedule Requirement These service hours are a **material requirement of this contract**. The Contractor must be logged in, available, and actively performing the agreed services beginning at **8:30 AM Pacific Time** and continuing until **12:30 PM Pacific Time** on each scheduled day. The Contractor is expected to: * Be ready to begin work at 8:30 AM Pacific Time. * Remain available and actively performing contracted services until 12:30 PM Pacific Time. * Be available for calls, follow-ups, and communication throughout the agreed service period. * Accurately report hours and activities completed. * Notify Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. as soon as reasonably possible in the event of an emergency. * Request approval in advance for planned schedule changes. The agreed hours cannot routinely be moved to evenings, other days, or different times without prior approval from Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. Repeated lateness, missed service periods, unauthorized schedule changes, extended unexplained absences during agreed hours, or failure to actively perform assigned services may result in the contract not being continued or being terminated. --- ## 3. Primary Responsibilities The Contractor's primary responsibility is to actively generate and develop sales opportunities for Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. Responsibilities include: * Making outbound calls to prospective customers. * Conducting cold and warm outreach. * Contacting leads provided through Client Reach. * Following up with new inquiries. * Following up on outstanding estimates and sales opportunities. * Reconnecting with previous customers and prospects. * Contacting prospective B2B partners. * Identifying business owners and decision-makers. * Introducing Bloom Bug Screens products and services. * Identifying customer needs and potential opportunities. * Generating qualified leads. * Booking appointments, consultations, estimates, and follow-up calls. * Developing relationships with contractors, builders, property managers, stratas, restoration companies, designers, window companies, and other potential partners. * Consistently following up with assigned prospects until an appropriate outcome has been established. This is an **active outbound sales and client outreach role**. The expectation is that the Contractor will actively make calls, contact prospects, complete follow-ups, and develop opportunities during the agreed service hours. --- ## 4. Client Reach Requirements **Client Reach** will be the primary system used for lead management and sales activity. All assigned customer and prospect interactions must be properly documented in Client Reach. The Contractor will be responsible for: * Reviewing assigned leads. * Recording calls and contact attempts. * Updating customer and prospect contact information. * Adding clear and accurate notes following conversations. * Updating lead status. * Scheduling callbacks. * Creating follow-up activities. * Recording customer requirements and interests. * Identifying hot, warm, cold, and future opportunities. * Maintaining an organized and accurate sales pipeline. **Every assigned customer interaction and outreach attempt must be documented in Client Reach.** Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. must be able to review Client Reach at any time and clearly determine: * Who was contacted. * When they were contacted. * Whether they answered. * What was discussed. * What the customer or prospect is interested in. * Whether an estimate or appointment is required. * What follow-up is required. * When the next contact should take place. * Which opportunities have the strongest potential to convert. --- ## 5. RingCentral – Business Calls & Call Recording The Contractor will use the Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. **RingCentral** system for authorized business calls. The Contractor will be expected to: * Use the assigned Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. RingCentral account for authorized business calls. * Make outbound calls during the agreed service hours. * Maintain professional telephone etiquette. * Follow approved scripts, talking points, and procedures. * Leave professional voicemail messages when appropriate. * Record relevant call outcomes and notes in Client Reach. * Schedule appropriate follow-up actions. * Maintain professional conduct whenever representing Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. ### Call Recording RingCentral includes **call-recording functionality**. Where enabled and permitted under applicable laws and company policies, calls made or received through the Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. RingCentral system **may be recorded**. Recordings may be reviewed by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. for legitimate business purposes, including: * Quality assurance. * Training and coaching. * Customer service. * Verification of customer conversations. * Sales performance. * Follow-up verification. * Dispute resolution. * Compliance with company procedures. The Contractor acknowledges that authorized business communications conducted through company systems may be recorded and reviewed. The Contractor must comply with all instructions provided by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. concerning privacy, customer notification, consent, confidentiality, storage, and handling of recorded communications. Business communications conducted through company-provided systems should not be considered private communications. --- ## 6. Performance Expectations This is a **results-oriented contractor role**. Performance will be evaluated throughout the week-to-week trial and during any subsequent contract period. Performance may be evaluated based on: * Punctuality and reliability. * Adherence to agreed service hours. * Outbound calls completed. * Meaningful customer conversations. * Decision-makers contacted. * Follow-ups completed. * Qualified leads generated. * Appointments generated. * Estimates or quote opportunities generated. * B2B opportunities developed. * Sales opportunities moved forward. * Quality and accuracy of Client Reach documentation. * Professionalism when communicating with customers and prospects. * Compliance with agreed processes and procedures. Simply being logged into Client Reach, RingCentral, or another company system does not constitute completion of the contracted services. The Contractor is expected to be **actively performing the agreed sales, calling, prospecting, and follow-up activities during the scheduled service hours**. --- ## 7. Weekly Invoicing & Payment Terms The Contractor will be paid **weekly by invoice** for authorized services completed during the applicable week. ### Invoice Procedure Invoices must always be submitted **after all scheduled working hours for that week have been completed**. The Contractor may not submit an invoice in advance for hours or services that have not yet been completed. The weekly process will be: 1. The Contractor completes all authorized service hours for the applicable week. 2. Once the week's scheduled services have been fully completed, the Contractor prepares the invoice. 3. The invoice must be emailed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. 4. The invoice must include a **PayPal invoice/payment link** that allows Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. to make payment through PayPal. 5. Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. will review the invoice against the authorized hours and services completed. 6. Correct and approved invoices will normally be paid within **24–48 hours after the invoice has been received by email**. ### Invoice Requirements Each weekly invoice must clearly include: * Contractor's name or business name. * Invoice number. * Invoice date. * Week/service period being invoiced. * Authorized hours completed. * Agreed hourly rate or contractor fee. * Total amount due. * Applicable taxes, if legally required. * **PayPal invoice/payment link.** * Any other information reasonably required for payment processing. The invoice must accurately reflect the authorized services actually completed. ### When the Invoice Should Be Submitted The regular service schedule is: **Monday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time **Tuesday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time **Thursday:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time Therefore, the Contractor's weekly invoice should only be raised and submitted **after the Thursday shift has been fully completed**, unless Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. has approved a different arrangement in writing. Invoices must not be raised on Monday or Tuesday for the full week because the remaining contracted services have not yet been completed. ### Payment Timeline Once a correctly prepared invoice has been emailed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. and the week's authorized services have been completed, payment will normally be processed within **24–48 hours of receipt of the invoice**. If an invoice contains incorrect hours, missing information, an incorrect amount, or does not include the required PayPal payment link, the Contractor may be asked to correct and resubmit the invoice. In such cases, the 24–48 hour payment period will begin after the corrected invoice has been received and approved. ### No Advances **Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. does not provide advances against future contractor fees, future working hours, or future invoices.** This means: * No invoices may be submitted for services that have not yet been completed. * No advance payments will be made for future scheduled hours. * No advances against future invoices will be provided. * No personal loans will be provided. * No early payment will be made for services that have not yet been completed. The Contractor acknowledges that this is a **post-service weekly invoicing arrangement**. **Services are completed first. The invoice is submitted afterward. Approved payment is then processed within 24–48 hours of receipt.** --- ## 8. Independent Contractor Relationship The Contractor is engaged as an **independent contractor and not as an employee of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.** Nothing in this arrangement is intended to establish an employer-employee relationship, partnership, joint venture, or other relationship beyond the independent contractor engagement. The Contractor is responsible for their own applicable taxes, filings, registrations, insurance, and other obligations associated with their independent contractor status, subject to applicable law. --- ## 9. Confidentiality & Company Information The Contractor may receive access to confidential and commercially sensitive information belonging to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd., including: * Customer names and contact information. * Lead databases. * Customer requirements. * Pricing. * Supplier information. * Business partner information. * Sales strategies. * Call scripts. * Marketing information. * Internal business processes. * Login credentials. * CRM information. * Recorded communications. * Company documents and data. All company and customer information remains confidential and must only be used for authorized Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. business purposes. The Contractor must not copy, download, distribute, disclose, sell, retain, transfer, or use company or customer information for personal purposes or for another business. Upon completion or termination of the engagement, the Contractor must immediately cease accessing company systems. Access to Client Reach, RingCentral, email, and other company systems may be removed immediately upon completion or termination of the contract. Any confidential company or customer information in the Contractor's possession must be returned or permanently deleted as instructed by Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. --- ## 10. Position Summary **Role:** Independent Sales & Client Outreach Contractor **Company:** Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. **Relationship:** Independent Contractor **Initial Trial:** 4 Weeks – Week-to-Week **Potential Continued Contract:** Approximately 3–6 Months **Commitment:** 12 Hours Per Week **Days:** Monday, Tuesday & Thursday **Service Hours:** 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM Pacific Time **Location:** Remote **Payment:** Weekly Upon Submission of Invoice **Payment Method:** PayPal Invoice/Payment Link **Payment Processing:** Normally Within 24–48 Hours of Receiving a Correct Invoice **Primary Systems:** Client Reach & RingCentral **Primary Focus:** Outbound Calling, Lead Generation, Customer Follow-Up & Appointment Setting --- ## 11. Important Terms & Conditions By accepting this engagement, the Contractor acknowledges and agrees that: * This is an **independent contractor arrangement and not employment**. * The first four weeks are a **week-to-week trial period**. * Continuation from one week to the next during the trial depends on satisfactory performance, reliability, results, and business requirements. * Successful completion of the four-week trial does not guarantee continued engagement. * Following successful completion of the trial, the engagement may continue for approximately **3–6 months**. * The agreed Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday service hours are a material requirement of the engagement. * Consistent punctuality and availability during the agreed service hours are required. * Schedule changes require prior approval except in genuine emergencies. * All assigned customer and lead activities must be documented in Client Reach. * Business calls will be conducted using RingCentral. * RingCentral includes call-recording functionality, and authorized business calls may be recorded where enabled and permitted. * Contractor activity and performance may be reviewed through company systems. * The Contractor must complete the week's authorized services **before raising the weekly invoice**. * The weekly invoice must be submitted after completion of the Thursday service period unless otherwise agreed. * The invoice must be emailed to Bloom Bug Screens Ltd. * The invoice must contain a **PayPal invoice/payment link**. * Correct and approved invoices will normally be paid within **24–48 hours after receipt by email**. * **No advances against future contractor fees, future hours, or future invoices will be provided.** * Company, customer, lead, pricing, supplier, and business information is confidential. * Continued engagement depends on performance, reliability, professionalism, results, compliance with agreed procedures, and the ongoing business requirements of Bloom Bug Screens Ltd.

We need someone who can take an entrepreneur’s ideas, projects and vision and turn them into completed results—without requiring detailed step-by-step instructions or constant owner follow-up. WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH You will work directly with a fast-moving American entrepreneur who is highly driven, direct, decisive and constantly generating ideas and opportunities. You must be able to carry a confident, professional conversation with a strong American personality without becoming intimidated, defensive or passive. We specifically expect you to respectfully challenge the owner when necessary. If: * A deadline is unrealistic * The team does not have sufficient capacity * A project is being approached incorrectly * Something cannot be accomplished as requested * Another solution would produce a better result We expect you to say so. We don’t want: “That can’t be done.” We want: “That timeline won’t work because of X and Y. Here are the options I recommend instead.” Your job is not to agree with the owner. Your job is to help the owner and businesses win. WHAT YOU WILL OWN You will: * Translate owner vision and objectives into executable projects. * Determine next actions without waiting for detailed instructions. * Break projects into milestones, tasks, owners, deadlines and dependencies. * Assign and delegate work across the team. * Prioritize competing projects based on urgency, revenue impact, customer impact and available capacity. * Monitor workloads and identify when priorities or deadlines must change. * Follow up with team members so the owner doesn’t have to. * Identify and remove roadblocks before they become emergencies. * Resolve routine problems independently. * Escalate only decisions that genuinely require the owner. * Hold team members accountable for commitments, quality and deadlines. * Coordinate larger projects with leadership. * Run project and accountability meetings. * Maintain accurate project-management systems, dashboards and SOPs. * Provide concise executive updates: completed, in progress, blocked, decisions needed and next actions. * Keep projects moving until they are actually completed. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE The owner should rarely need to ask: “Whatever happened with _____?” You already know. You followed up. You removed the roadblock. You reassigned it if necessary. Ideally, it’s already done. When the owner says: “Here’s what I’m trying to accomplish…” Your instinct should be: “Understood. I’ll determine what needs to happen and bring back the execution plan and any decisions I need from you.” NON-NEGOTIABLE QUALITIES High agency: You act without waiting to be told every step. Exceptional follow-through: Open loops bother you. Strong judgment: You understand what you can decide independently and what genuinely requires owner approval. Prioritization: You distinguish revenue-producing and urgent work from work that can wait. Confidence and executive presence: You can respectfully challenge a strong personality. Resourcefulness: When Plan A fails, you find Plan B. Accountability: You own mistakes and solve them rather than explaining them away. Leadership: You can direct professionals, coach them and hold them accountable. Organization: You can manage numerous simultaneous projects without losing control. Excellent spoken and written English: You can comfortably carry substantive conversations with American executives. Business thinking: You think about outcomes, revenue, customers, deadlines, capacity and ROI—not merely completing assigned tasks. EXPERIENCE & SKILLS Strong candidates may have experience as an: * Operations Manager * Executive Operations Manager * Chief of Staff * Senior Project Manager * BPO Operations Manager * Account/Client Operations Manager * Integrator * Similar leadership position Preferred experience: * 5+ years professional experience. * 2+ years managing people and/or complex projects. * Experience directly managing multiple employees. * Experience working directly with U.S. executives, entrepreneurs or clients strongly preferred. * Experience managing remote teams. * Experience managing multiple simultaneous projects. * ClickUp or comparable project-management software. * Google Workspace and spreadsheets. * Slack and Zoom. * Strong working knowledge of AI tools. * GoHighLevel familiarity is a plus. A COLLEGE DEGREE IS LESS IMPORTANT TO US THAN DEMONSTRATED ABILITY AND RESULTS THIS POSITION IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF… You need detailed instructions before beginning. You are uncomfortable professionally disagreeing with your boss. You avoid difficult conversations. You regularly wait for someone to follow up with you. You believe identifying a problem completes your responsibility. You become overwhelmed when priorities change. You prefer being given individual tasks rather than being accountable for outcomes. You are primarily looking for a traditional VA/admin position. COMPENSATION Competitive compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability. This is intended to be a long-term, full-time position with opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance. Applicants must include their expected hourly rate in USD. HOW TO APPLY Send the following to: ---------- Subject: Executive Operations Manager – [First & Last Name] Include: 1. Résumé/CV. 2. Expected hourly rate in USD. 3. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself. Do not simply repeat your résumé. 4. Largest team you have directly managed and the roles you managed. 5. One example where an owner gave you an objective without telling you exactly how to accomplish it. What did you do? 6. One example where you disagreed with your boss about a deadline, strategy or decision. What did you say, and what happened? 7. One example of a project that was falling behind and how you got it back on track. In your Loom video, explain why you can successfully manage a fast-moving American entrepreneur, communicate candidly when necessary, and turn ideas into execution.

You should have advanced Adobe Photoshop skills, including: * Masking * Compositing * Color correction * Lighting * Shadows * Reflections * Perspective matching * Smart objects * Non-destructive editing You should also have: * Proven experience creating realistic product photo manipulations. * Experience creating lifestyle product compositions. * Experience producing photorealistic AI-assisted product photoshoots. * Experience creating advertising images. * Experience combining AI-generated environments or models with original product assets. * Strong understanding of scale and proportion. * Strong understanding of perspective. * Strong understanding of lighting and materials. * Exceptional attention to product accuracy. * Ability to recognize AI errors and manually correct them in Photoshop. * Ability to follow detailed creative briefs. * Ability to work independently. * Strong file-organization habits. * Reliable communication. * Ability to consistently meet agreed deadlines. * Ability to receive direct feedback and complete revisions quickly. * Strong problem-solving and ownership. ## Preferred Experience Experience with any of the following is a plus: * Established e-commerce brands * Direct-to-consumer brands * Meta advertising creatives * TikTok advertising creatives * Amazon product graphics * Shopify product creatives * AI image generation * Inpainting * Outpainting * AI upscaling * Reference-controlled generation * Reviewing another designer's work * Creating creative workflows or SOPs * Basic AI image-to-video workflows Approved AI subscriptions and generation credits may be provided for company projects when required. # HOW TO APPLY Please email your application to: ---------- Use a clear subject line such as: **Graphic Designer Application – Your Name** ## 1. Send Your Graphic Design Portfolio Please send **5 of your strongest and most relevant product-design samples**. We are especially interested in: * E-commerce product advertisements * Product retouching * Photo manipulation * Lifestyle product compositions * AI-assisted product photography * Photorealistic AI advertising images ### You must also include: **At least 2 before-and-after Photoshop examples** Show: * Original image * Final retouched or manipulated result **At least 2 AI-assisted product-image examples** Show: * Original product reference * Final image * Which parts were AI-generated * Which parts were manually edited in Photoshop **Applications without relevant product examples may not be reviewed.** ## 2. Confirm the Compensation Please confirm in your email that you understand and accept our compensation structure: **$2 USD per completed image.** Projects are typically assigned in multi-image batches. If you are not comfortable with this rate, please do not apply. ## 3. Answer These Screening Questions Please **copy and answer all questions below** in your application email. ### Graphic Designer Screening Questions **1. How many years have you professionally worked in graphic design, Photoshop retouching, product manipulation, or e-commerce creative production?** **2. How would you rate your Photoshop ability from 1–10?** Briefly tell us which Photoshop tasks you perform regularly. Examples: * Masking * Compositing * Retouching * Color correction * Perspective matching * Lighting * Shadows * Reflections * Smart objects **3. Which AI image-generation tools do you currently use confidently?** Please list only tools you have actual hands-on experience using. Also mention whether you have experience with: * Inpainting * Outpainting * Reference-image generation * AI upscaling * Product-consistency workflows **4. Have you professionally created product advertisements or e-commerce creatives?** If yes, briefly describe the types of products, brands, or platforms you have worked with. **5. From the portfolio samples you submitted, which ONE image best demonstrates your product-compositing ability, and why?** Briefly explain: * What the original assets were * What you personally created * What was AI-generated * What was manually edited * What the biggest technical challenge was **6. When combining a real product packshot with an AI-generated environment, what steps do you take to make the final result look realistic?** Keep your answer short and focus on the most important steps. **7. An AI-generated image looks excellent, but you notice that the product logo is slightly warped, the product is approximately 10% wider than the original, and its material has changed from matte to glossy. What would you do?** Answer in 2–4 sentences. **8. Would you ever submit an AI-generated product image that looks attractive if one important product detail is inaccurate? Why or why not?** **9. Before submitting a finished product image, what are the five most important things you personally check?** **10. How do you organize your Photoshop source files?** Briefly describe your approach to: * Layers * Groups * Masks * Smart objects * File naming **11. If you realize you may miss a deadline because an important asset is missing or an AI-generation workflow is failing, when and how would you communicate this to the team?** **12. What is your typical turnaround time for a standard e-commerce product image with simple-to-moderate Photoshop compositing?** **13. What is your current weekly availability?** Please list the days you are normally available to receive freelance projects. **14. Please confirm: Are you comfortable accepting $2 USD per completed image?** Answer **YES or NO**. # Hiring Process Candidates who pass the initial application screening may move through the following steps: 1. **Portfolio Review** 2. **10-Minute Quality-Control Assessment** 3. **Portfolio / Photoshop Interview** 4. **Standardized Paid Design Test** ## Portfolio Review We may compare your finished images directly against the original product references. We will specifically check whether you preserved: * Logo * Packaging text * Product color * Proportions * Materials * Product features We may also ask you to explain exactly what you created manually versus what was generated with AI. ## Quality-Control Assessment Shortlisted applicants may receive a product image containing intentional errors. Examples may include: * Warped logo * Incorrect product color * Incorrect shadow * Changed product material * Distorted proportions You will be asked to identify the problems and explain how you would correct them. ## Portfolio / Photoshop Interview You may be asked to open a Photoshop project that you personally created and explain: * What was AI-generated * What was manually edited * How the product was composited * What problems you encountered * How you protected logos and packaging * How you handled feedback * What you would improve if you created the image again You may also be asked to show your Photoshop layers and working-file organization. ## Standardized Paid Test Final candidates may be asked to complete a **paid design test**. For example, you may receive one clean product packshot and be asked to: * Create one realistic **4:5 lifestyle product image** * Generate the environment using an approved AI tool * Composite the original product manually in Photoshop * Preserve the exact product logo * Preserve all product text * Preserve product color * Preserve product proportions * Preserve materials * Preserve essential product features * Deliver the final image * Deliver an organized layered PSD * Briefly explain your process The test may use a fixed **2–3 hour working window**. Applicants completing the same test will receive the same core product, brief, reference, deadline, requirements, and compensation. We do **not** use unpaid client work as an applicant test. # How We Evaluate Designers Candidates are primarily evaluated on: * **Product Accuracy – 30%** * **Photoshop & Realism – 20%** * **Brief Compliance – 15%** * **Composition & Brand Fit – 10%** * **Source-File Organization – 10%** * **Speed & Reliability – 10%** * **Communication & Ownership – 5%** Critical product inaccuracies—including incorrect logos, packaging text, essential product features, materials, or proportions—may disqualify a candidate regardless of how attractive the final image looks. A strong portfolio alone is not enough. We are not simply looking for the cheapest applicant or the most confident designer. We want someone who repeatedly demonstrates: * Product accuracy * Realism * Strong Photoshop ability * Attention to detail * Reliability * Coachability * Clear communication * Problem-solving * Ownership of their work A great designer should not simply generate an attractive image. They should recognize when something is wrong, manually correct it, protect the integrity of the product, communicate risks early, and consistently deliver organized professional work.
