title: Guest Experience & Operations Coordinator – Short-Term Rentals
job_title: Guest Experience & Operations Coordinator – Short-Term Rentals
description: About Cabin Living Cabin Living is a growing Norwegian short-term rental management company managing holiday homes, cabins and apartments across Norway. We provide full-service property management for our owners and take care of the entire guest journey – from booking and pre-arrival communication to check-in, problem-solving during the stay and follow-up after departure. We are now looking for an experienced Guest Experience & Operations Coordinator to become an important part of our operations team. This is not a basic Virtual Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of situations, solve problems independently and make both guests and property owners feel that they are in professional hands. Your Main Responsibility Your job is simple to describe: Make sure things get solved. When a guest has a problem, we don't only want someone who replies to the message. We want someone who understands the problem, takes ownership, finds a solution, coordinates the right people and follows the case until it is closed. You will communicate with guests, property owners, cleaners, maintenance partners and our internal team. Typical Responsibilities Guest Experience Respond to guest messages through our property management system and booking platforms Handle questions before, during and after stays Assist guests with check-in and check-out Troubleshoot access problems, WiFi, heating, hot water and other property-related issues Handle complaints professionally and calmly Proactively follow up guests when an issue occurs Protect the guest experience and our review scores Operations Coordinate cleaners, linen providers, caretakers and maintenance partners Handle situations where cleaning has not been completed correctly Arrange assistance when something needs to be fixed Follow operational cases until they are actually resolved Document incidents and actions taken Escalate serious situations according to our SOP Property Owner Communication You will also communicate with our property owners. This requires a different communication style than guest support. Our owners trust us with valuable homes and expect professional, accurate and confident communication. You must therefore be comfortable explaining situations clearly and professionally to property owners. What We Are Looking For Required Excellent spoken and written English Strong communication skills Excellent problem-solving ability High level of personal responsibility Calm under pressure Very organised Comfortable making decisions Comfortable calling guests and suppliers when necessary Stable high-speed internet Quiet professional workspace Reliable computer and backup solution Ability to work European/Norwegian hours Strongly Preferred Previous experience with one or more of: Short-term rentals Airbnb Booking.com VRBO Property management Hotels or hospitality Guest experience Customer support Property maintenance coordination PMS/property management software Experience with short-term rentals will be considered a major advantage. The Person We DON'T Want We are not looking for someone whose standard response to a problem is: "I informed my manager." We are looking for someone who thinks: "How can I solve this?" You should know when to follow a procedure, when to investigate further and when a situation genuinely needs to be escalated. Example A guest arrives at 10:30 PM and cannot access the property. The owner doesn't answer. What do you do? We expect you to: Respond immediately. Verify the information and access instructions. Troubleshoot the problem. Contact relevant local resources if necessary. Keep the guest informed. Find an alternative solution if the first solution fails. Document what happened. Escalate only when necessary. That mindset is extremely important to us. About the Position This is intended to be a long-term position. Cabin Living is growing and we want someone who can grow with the company and gradually take greater responsibility. You will receive: Detailed SOPs and operational procedures Training in our systems Clear escalation procedures Templates and communication guidelines Support from our management team But we expect you to eventually operate independently within those procedures. Working Hours The position requires significant overlap with Norwegian/European time (CET/CEST). Short-term rentals operate seven days a week, so some weekend work will be required. Exact working hours and rotation will be agreed with the successful candidate. How to Apply Please send us: 1. Your CV 2. A short description of your experience with short-term rentals, hospitality or customer service. Please be specific about: Number of properties you supported Booking platforms you worked with PMS/software you have used Your responsibilities Whether you communicated directly with property owners 3. A 90-second video introduction in English. Please introduce yourself and tell us: Who you are Your relevant experience Why you think you would be good at this role Please do not read from a prepared AI-generated script. We want to hear how you naturally communicate. 4. Answer this question in your application: A guest checks into a cabin at 9:30 PM. They message you: "There is no hot water. We have three children and this is unacceptable. We want a refund." The owner does not answer the phone. Explain exactly what you would do during the next 30 minutes. We are more interested in how you think than in getting a perfect answer. Applications that do not include the video and case response will not be considered. Important Please start your application with the words: "I solve problems." This allows us to see that you have read the full job description. We look forward to hearing from you. Cabin Living Norway

title: Chargeback & Dispute Manager –  (Shopify Store, On-Call)
description: READ THIS FIRST This role is paid per case, not per hour and not per month. There is no fixed salary and no guaranteed volume. Some months we will send you two or three cases. Some months, none at all. We are being blunt about this up front so nobody wastes their time. If you need predictable monthly income, this is not the role for you. If you already have other clients and want a small, well-paid task you can pick up when it lands, keep reading. ABOUT US Wattle & Reed is an Australian women's fashion brand selling online through Shopify. THE ROLE When a customer disputes a payment with their bank, we have a hard deadline to submit evidence. Win or lose comes down entirely to how well that evidence is put together. Right now the founder does this in a rush between other work. We want one person who owns it and does it properly, every time. Each case is roughly 30 to 45 minutes of work. WHAT YOU WILL DO PER CASE - Pick up the case within 24 hours of us sending it to you - Build the evidence package: order details, fulfilment and tracking records, the full customer email history, our published delivery and returns policy, and proof of what the customer saw at checkout - Write the response narrative. Factual, structured, no emotion. It is read by a bank reviewer who will spend two minutes on it. - Submit before the deadline. Late means an automatic loss. - Log the case in our sheet: order, reason code, amount, deadline, evidence submitted, outcome - Tell us in one line what caused the dispute, so we can stop it happening again PAY - Fixed fee per case handled - Additional bonus for every case won - Paid via Wise, within one week of submission - Exact amounts discussed on the call REQUIREMENTS - Previous experience handling chargebacks or payment disputes for an e-commerce store. This is the core requirement, not a preference. - Understanding of common reason codes, particularly item not received and item not as described - Strong written English. Your submission d ---------- whether we keep the money. - Able to work in Shopify admin: orders, fulfilment status, tracking - Reachable and able to start a case within 24 hours of us contacting you - Meticulous with deadlines NICE TO HAVE - Experience with Shopify Payments disputes specifically - Familiarity with fraud prevention or order risk review WHAT WE OFFER - Clean, self-contained work with a clear outcome - No meetings, no daily check-ins, no fixed hours - A long-term arrangement. As the store grows, so does the volume. - Paid promptly, every time HOW TO APPLY Reply with the subject line "Wattle & Reed - Disputes" and tell us: 1. Which stores you have handled chargebacks for, roughly how many per month, and your approximate win rate 2. Which payment providers you have submitted evidence through 3. Your fee per case, and whether you want a win bonus on top 4. How quickly you can normally pick up a case Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short video call.

title: AI Systems & Automation Specialist
description: We are looking for a highly capable AI Systems & Automation Specialist who can help us bring AI into different areas of our furniture business. Showhome Furniture is a furniture store based in Calgary, Alberta. We are looking for someone who does more than simply use ChatGPT. We want someone who can **design, build, connect, and improve AI-powered systems that make our business faster, smarter, and more efficient.** This role is ideal for someone who enjoys figuring out how a business operates, identifying repetitive or inefficient processes, and then building practical AI solutions to improve them. ## What You Will Be Doing You will work with our team to identify areas where AI and automation can improve our day-to-day operations. Your responsibilities may include: * Building custom AI assistants and internal AI tools * Creating AI-powered workflows for different departments * Automating repetitive administrative tasks * Connecting AI tools with our existing software and platforms * Building systems using APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms * Creating AI systems for customer inquiries and customer service * Developing AI tools to help our sales team * Automating lead follow-up and lead qualification * Building AI-powered systems for marketing and content creation * Improving our SEO, social media, advertising, and content workflows with AI * Creating systems that can analyze business data and produce useful reports * Automating product information, descriptions, categorization, and merchandising workflows * Creating internal knowledge bases that employees can search using AI * Finding opportunities where AI can save employees time * Testing new AI tools and determining whether they are useful for our business * Documenting the systems you build so our team can understand and maintain them * Monitoring existing automations and improving them over time ## Examples of Projects You May Work On We are interested in building systems such as: * AI sales assistant for our furniture sales team * AI customer support assistant * AI-powered internal company knowledge assistant * Automated lead qualification system * Automated follow-up system for customers and leads * AI-generated marketing content workflows * Automated social media content systems * AI-assisted Google Ads and Meta Ads workflows * AI SEO research and content optimization systems * AI product-description and product-data automation * AI reporting dashboards * Automated review and reputation management workflows * AI tools that help employees answer customer questions faster * Systems that connect Shopify, CRM tools, email, spreadsheets, advertising platforms, and other business software We are open to your ideas as well. If you see an opportunity to improve the business using AI, we want you to be able to propose it, build it, test it, and improve it. ## Skills We Are Looking For You should have strong experience with several of the following: * ChatGPT / OpenAI * Claude * Gemini * AI agents * OpenAI API or other LLM APIs * ---------- * n8n * Zapier * APIs * Webhooks * JSON * Prompt engineering * AI workflow design * Automation architecture * Google Sheets * Shopify * CRM integrations * Email automation * Databases * Vector databases / RAG systems * AI knowledge bases * Python or JavaScript * Data processing and reporting You do **not** need to know every tool listed above. We care more about whether you understand how to solve business problems using AI and automation. ## The Person We Are Looking For We want someone who: * Thinks like a problem solver, not just a task worker * Can look at a manual process and figure out how to automate it * Understands both AI and business operations * Can research solutions independently * Can build systems from start to finish * Is comfortable learning new AI tools quickly * Tests their work carefully before deploying it * Pays attention to accuracy and reliability * Understands that AI outputs must sometimes be verified * Can explain technical systems in simple language * Documents their work clearly * Communicates well * Takes ownership of projects * Looks for ways to continuously improve systems We especially value someone who can say: **"I noticed your team is doing this manually. I think I can build a system that handles 80% of it automatically."** That is the mindset we are looking for. ## Important We are **not** looking for someone whose only AI experience is writing prompts in ChatGPT. Using ChatGPT is useful, but this role requires someone who understands how to **build AI into actual business processes.** You should be comfortable working with automation tools, integrations, APIs, and AI systems. ## Experience With Retail or E-Commerce Is a Plus Experience in any of these areas would be helpful: * Furniture * Retail * E-commerce * Shopify * Digital marketing * SEO * Google Ads * Meta Ads * CRM systems * Sales automation * Customer service automation Furniture industry experience is **not required**. ## How We Will Measure Success Your success will not be measured by how many AI tools you use. It will be measured by results such as: * Hours of manual work eliminated * Faster response times * Better lead follow-up * More efficient employees * Fewer repetitive tasks * Better use of company data * Improved marketing productivity * Better customer experiences * More reliable business processes * Systems that continue working without constant supervision ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. Tell us about **3 AI or automation systems you have personally built**. 2. Explain what problem each system solved. 3. Tell us which tools you used. 4. Explain what parts you personally built. 5. Include screenshots, Loom videos, portfolio links, or examples if available. 6. Tell us which AI and automation tools you are strongest with. 7. Describe one business process you have automated that saved a company significant time or money. 8. Tell us your expected monthly salary. 9. Tell us how many hours per week you are available. ### Small Application Test At the end of your application, answer this question: **Imagine you joined a furniture store with salespeople, customer inquiries, Shopify, marketing campaigns, product information, emails, spreadsheets, and repetitive administrative work. What are the first 5 AI systems or automations you would investigate building, and why?** We will pay close attention to your answer. We are looking for someone who wants to become the person responsible for helping us **implement AI throughout the business**, not simply complete individual AI tasks. If you enjoy building systems, automating processes, experimenting with new technology, and seeing your work make a real difference inside a company, we would like to hear from you.

title: Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Part-Time | $5/hr + Bonuses | Growth to Full-Time
job_title: Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Part-Time | $5/hr + Bonuses | Growth to Full-Time
description: We are a U.S.-based life insurance business looking for a HIGH-PERFORMING Appointment Setter to join our team. This position starts PART-TIME at 20 hours per week. Strong performers may have the opportunity to grow into a full-time, long-term position based on performance. Full-time hours are a potential future opportunity, not the starting schedule. Please read the entire post before applying. This is NOT a position for someone looking to simply clock in, make a few calls, and collect an hourly paycheck. We're looking for someone who wants to PERFORM. Someone competitive. Someone hungry. Someone who likes seeing their numbers improve. Someone who can hear "no" 20 times and still make call #21 with the same confidence and energy as call #1. If that's you, keep reading. WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH My name is Jose, and I've worked in life insurance and financial services for about 16 years. I'm very involved in the business, and you'll work directly with me and our team. I'm serious about what we're building. I have BIG goals for this business, and I'm building the systems and team needed to reach them. I believe in treating people well, communicating clearly, having fun, and creating an environment where good people can grow. But make no mistake: WE ARE HERE TO PRODUCE RESULTS. I have high expectations for myself, and I will have high expectations for you. I don't expect perfection. I DO expect effort, consistency, accountability, coachability, and performance. If you make a mistake, we'll fix it. If you don't understand something, ask. If I see something that can make you better, I'm going to coach you on it. And if you're performing at a high level, I want to reward that and give you opportunities to grow. THE TYPE OF PERSON I WANT I'm not trying to hire everybody who applies. I'm looking for TOP PERFORMERS. I want the person who was one of the strongest callers on their last team. The person who actually enjoys appointment setting. The person who gets competitive when they see their numbers. The person who wants to beat yesterday's results. The person who doesn't need someone standing over their shoulder every five minutes telling them to make another call. You should be able to handle rejection without letting it destroy your energy. You should know how to listen. You should know how to ask good questions. You should be able to follow a script without SOUNDING like you're reading a script. Most importantly, you should understand that activity alone isn't enough. We're looking for QUALITY appointments that turn into real conversations with qualified prospects. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Make outbound calls to leads we provide • Follow our proven call script and process • Have natural conversations with prospects • Ask qualification questions • Identify qualified prospects • Book qualified appointments directly onto our calendar • Follow up with prospects when needed • Keep accurate notes inside our CRM • Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows You are NOT responsible for selling or closing life insurance. That's my job. Your job is to create the opportunity. Get the right person on the phone. Have a strong conversation. Qualify them. Book the appointment. And move to the next one. WHAT WE PROVIDE We're going to give you the tools to perform. • Leads • Calling system • Scripts • CRM • Training • Qualification guidelines • Coaching and feedback • Clear performance expectations • A system to follow We're not going to throw you on the phone and tell you to figure everything out. But once you're trained, we WILL expect you to execute. PAY Starting pay is $5 USD per hour. PLUS $5 for each qualified confirmed appointment that meets our qualification requirements. This position begins PART-TIME at 20 hours per week (80 hours over a four-week period). Total hours in a calendar month will vary with the number of weeks. Strong performers can earn more through performance bonuses and may be offered additional hours and the opportunity to move into a FULL-TIME position. I want performance to create opportunity. title: US Home Health Case Manager
description: About Us Our Home Health is a home health agency in Southern California's Inland Empire. We provide skilled nursing and therapy services to patients in their homes. We are a small, close team — you will not be a number here, and you will work directly with the agency's leadership and clinical staff. We are hiring one full-time Case Management Coordinator to support our licensed clinical team. This is a long-term role, not a short project. The Role in One Sentence You make sure every patient's plan of care actually gets carried out — on time, fully documented, and properly authorized — for the entire certification period. You are the person who notices that an authorization expires in nine days, that a physician never signed the 485, that the PT was ordered three days ago and still hasn't been scheduled, and that a patient's 2W9 frequency is behind by two visits. You catch it, and you chase it down until it's closed. Schedule Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Pacific Time This is approximately 11:00 PM – 8:00 AM Philippine Time (shifts by one hour with US daylight saving) 40 hours per week, night shift, permanent Please only apply if you can commit to this schedule long term. This is not negotiable — you must be available and responsive during US business hours, when physicians' offices, insurance companies, and DME suppliers are open. What You Will Do Plan of Care Management Track each patient's plan of care from start of care through the end of the certification period Monitor visit frequency compliance (e.g., 2W9, 1W4) and flag when a discipline is falling behind Track missed visits, get them documented, and follow up on rescheduling Monitor certification period end dates and initiate the recertification process before it's late Track 485 / Plan of Care documents: sent out, signed, returned, filed Track face-to-face encounter documentation Physician & Order Coordination Order and follow up on PT, OT, ST, and MSW evaluations and follow-up visits Prepare and send physician orders; track them until signed and returned Follow up relentlessly on unsigned orders — this is a large part of the job Document new orders received and route them immediately to the assigned licensed RN Case Manager Communicate with physician offices by phone, fax, and email Supplies, DME & Vendors Coordinate DME orders and delivery with suppliers Order and track patient medical supplies Follow up on delivery confirmation Documentation Follow-Up Monitor that clinician visit notes are submitted on time Track OASIS submission timelines and flag anything at risk Keep the patient chart complete and audit-ready in DSL Run and maintain daily tracking reports for leadership Communication Manage the agency's provider-facing email inbox Coordinate with physicians, payers, vendors, and staffing Report status daily to agency leadership What This Role Is NOT Please read this carefully — it defines your professional boundary. You are a coordinator supporting our licensed California clinical team. You are not the patient's clinical case manager, and you do not practice nursing in this role. You will NOT: Make clinical assessments or clinical judgments Accept, verify, or independently act on verbal or telephone orders Triage a patient's change of condition Write, sign, or alter clinical documentation on a clinician's behalf Give clinical advice to patients or families When a patient reports a complaint or a change in condition, you document it and escalate it immediately to the assigned licensed RN Case Manager. The licensed clinician makes every clinical decision. Your nursing background matters because it lets you understand what you're reading, ask the right question, and recognize what's urgent — not because you'll be practicing. Our patient- and family-facing communication is handled by our US-based office staff. Your focus is provider-facing coordination. Requirements Must Have Registered Nurse licensed in the Philippines (active or inactive PRC license — please state which) Minimum 2 years of experience working for a US home health agency. Two years is what we're looking for; one year of very strong, directly relevant experience will be considered. Hospice-only experience is not a substitute — we need home health. Hands-on experience with Data Soft Logic (DSL). If you have deep experience in another major home health EMR (Axxess, WellSky/Kinnser, HCHB, MatrixCare) and can learn DSL quickly, tell us specifically why. Working knowledge of Medicare home health requirements: certification periods, 485/plan of care, face-to-face encounters, OASIS timelines, visit frequency Experience with managed care authorizations and re-authorizations Excellent spoken and written English — you will be on the phone with US physician offices and insurance companies every single day Comfortable making outbound phone calls to US providers. A large part of this job is polite, persistent follow-up. Strong organization and follow-through. You track many open items at once and close every one of them. Committed to the permanent night shift Nice to Have Experience with Medi-Cal / California managed care plans Experience with authorization portals (Availity, Office Ally, or payer portals) Experience in a small agency where you wore several hats Technical Requirements These will be tested during the interview. Please do not apply if you cannot meet them. Primary internet: wired fiber or cable, minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload. Mobile-data-only setups will not be accepted. Backup internet: a second, independent connection (different provider or a mobile hotspot) you can switch to within minutes Backup power: UPS at minimum; generator strongly preferred Computer: Windows 10/11 or macOS, minimum 8GB RAM, dual monitors preferred Headset: wired USB noise-cancelling headset with a quality microphone Workspace: quiet, private, dedicated home office. No background noise — you will be on calls with physician offices all shift. Webcam for daily team check-ins

title: Senior Marketing Manager – Growth & Strategy
description: Marketing Systems & Growth Manager – Healthcare Full-Time | Remote | NZ Business Hours We are launching a new integrative healthcare clinic in New Zealand and are looking for an experienced, commercially minded Marketing Manager to build and own our marketing function. This is not a VA, social-media-only or coordinator role. We already have an established healthcare marketing operation, specialist marketing and technical resources, proven acquisition funnels and years of campaign data and learning. Your job will be to understand what works, turn that knowledge into a documented marketing operating system, and use it to build and manage the marketing engine for our new healthcare brand. Your Primary KPI Ultimately, marketing exists to generate the required number of quality Discovery Call bookings each week at an acceptable acquisition cost. You will own the marketing dashboard and understand performance across the entire funnel: Spend → Leads → CPL → Landing Page Conversion → Discovery Call Bookings → DC Show Rate → Initial Consultations → CAC → Revenue We don't want someone who simply reports the numbers. We want someone who asks: What's working? What's not working? Why? What are we changing this week? And then makes sure it happens. Your First 30 Days – Marketing Function Mapping Your first major project will be to work alongside our existing marketing, technology and leadership team to map and document our current healthcare marketing operating model. You will identify and document: Every marketing function and who owns it Roles, responsibilities and dependencies Inputs and outputs for each function Weekly and monthly deliverables Marketing KPIs and targets Reporting dashboards and data sources Paid acquisition structure across Meta and Google Campaign development and optimisation processes Creative strategy and production Hooks, messaging, copy and offers Organic content strategy and production SEO strategy and content Website and landing-page management Lead-generation funnels GoHighLevel workflows and automation Lead nurture and reactivation Tracking and attribution Marketing meetings and reporting rhythm SOPs and processes Technology and integrations Agency, contractor and internal responsibilities You'll interview and work directly with the people currently responsible for these areas rather than simply reviewing documents. Your job is to understand how the whole marketing machine works. Then Build the New Marketing Function Once you've mapped the existing model, you'll determine: What should be replicated What should be improved What isn't necessary What resources the new business actually needs What should be automated What should remain specialist-led What should be managed internally You'll turn this into a practical Marketing Playbook and operating structure for the new clinic. Your Ongoing Role You will: Own and execute the marketing plan Drive weekly Discovery Call targets Own the marketing dashboard Identify funnel problems quickly Manage marketing specialists and contractors Coordinate paid media, SEO, content, creative and technology Develop campaigns, hooks, offers and messaging Own the organic/content strategy Manage projects, priorities and deadlines Work closely with our GHL and technical specialists Improve lead quality and conversion Monitor CAC and marketing efficiency Run weekly marketing performance meetings Turn data into actions Hold the team accountable for delivery The Team Around You You won't be expected to personally execute every marketing discipline. You'll work with specialists covering areas including: Meta and Google Ads SEO and copy Content and organic social Design and creative GoHighLevel Development WordPress Automation and integrations Your role is to make the specialists operate as one marketing function. We're Looking For You will ideally have: Strong digital marketing experience Experience managing a marketing team or multiple specialists Demonstrated lead-generation experience Strong analytical and commercial skills Excellent understanding of conversion funnels Meta/Facebook advertising knowledge Understanding of Google Ads SEO and content knowledge CRM/funnel experience GHL experience highly desirable Strong project-management capability Excellent written and spoken English Strong documentation and process-mapping skills The confidence to challenge existing processes Excellent follow-through Most importantly, we're looking for someone who takes ownership. You don't need to personally be the world's best Meta buyer, SEO specialist, developer or copywriter. You need to understand these disciplines well enough to manage the experts, interrogate the numbers, identify problems and drive the team towards commercial outcomes. What Success Looks Like Within your first month, we should have a clearly documented marketing operating system covering: People + Process + Technology + Funnels + Creative + Data + KPIs + Reporting From there, your responsibility is to turn that knowledge into a lean, scalable acquisition engine for our new healthcare brand. How to Apply Please send: Your CV Portfolio or examples of relevant work A 2–4 minute Loom explaining the largest marketing function/team you've managed An example of a lead-generation funnel or campaign you're particularly proud of Actual performance metrics/results you've been responsible for Your experience with GHL, CRM systems, funnels and automation An example of a marketing process or function you've previously documented, rebuilt or improved

title: GoHighLevel Operations Specialist (Client Sub Account Builds + AI Agents)
job_title: GoHighLevel Operations Specialist (Client Sub Account Builds + AI Agents)
description: What we do We build AI phone agents and follow up systems for small service businesses in the US. Personal injury law firms, med spas, dental offices, HVAC and roofing companies, real estate teams. The client pays us, we build the whole back end in GoHighLevel, and their phone gets answered and their leads get followed up around the clock. The systems work. The bottleneck is me. Every sub account build is currently sitting on my plate, and it is slowing down how many clients we can take on. That is the job. You own the build. What you will actually do You take a new client from signed to live in about two weeks, following our internal setup checklist. Every step of that checklist is a thing you should already know how to do: Provision the LC Phone number and submit A2P 10DLC registration under the client's legal name and EIN, then push it through to approval Set up email sending on a subdomain and get SPF, DKIM and DMARC all verified and landing in the Gmail inbox Build calendars with the right duration, buffers, availability and timezone, and test the booking widget end to end Build the pipeline and stages to match how the client actually sells Create custom fields and custom values before you build anything that references them Build the automations: missed call text back, instant response inside 60 seconds, and a Day 1, Day 2, Day 4, Day 7 follow up mixing SMS and email that stops the second someone replies or books Build and configure the AI agents, conversational and voice, including the knowledge base and the handoff trigger to a human Test every entry point with a real contact before anything is called live Set up the client user, the dashboard widgets, and the support ticket form When you message me about this role, use the subject line First Ring Ops followed by the one automation you would turn on before any other for a brand new client. Two words for the subject, then your answer. Over time this role grows into owning our internal systems too. Onboarding automations, invoicing workflows, and the templates we reuse across every new client. Who I am looking for Real GoHighLevel experience. Not "I watched tutorials." You have built sub accounts for actual paying clients. HighLevel certified is a strong plus. If you are not certified, show me the work instead and you are still in the running. Two or more years in marketing automation, CRM builds, or agency operations. If you have less time but your GHL and AI skills are sharp, apply anyway and let the work speak. You have built or configured an AI agent before. Conversational AI, Voice AI, a chatbot, an n8n or Make workflow, something. This is the highest priority skill on this list next to GHL itself. You know what a silent fail looks like. Workflows that reference a field that does not exist, overlapping enrollments, two campaigns firing on the same contact. Written English good enough to write client facing SMS and email copy that does not sound like a robot wrote it. You test your own work before you tell me it is done. Nice to have: DNS and domain experience, Twilio, funnel and website builds, Zapier or Make, basic Canva. The sample task Do not send me a resume with nothing attached. I want to see how you think. The scenario: A roofing company in Marietta, Georgia. Two crews, one owner, one office manager. They spend about $3, ---------- a month on Facebook lead ads and miss most of the calls that come in because everybody is on a roof. They have never used a CRM. Send me these four things: A screen recording, six minutes or less, walking me through a missed call text back workflow inside a GHL account you have access to. Show me the trigger, the actions, and the stop condition. Talk out loud about why you built it that way. Loom or Google Drive link is fine. A list of the custom fields you would create for this client before you build a single workflow, and one line on why each one matters. The first SMS that goes out when a new lead comes in from the ad. Write it the way you would actually send it, including opt out language. One short paragraph: the client's A2P campaign gets rejected. What are the first three things you check? If you already have a portfolio of client sub accounts you have built, send that too. Screenshots of the workflow builder, calendars, pipelines, and any AI agent configuration. Real work beats a practice task every time. This should take you under an hour. If it takes longer than that, this role probably is not the right fit, and that is fine. How you will be judged Not on how pretty it looks. On whether the workflow has a stop condition, whether the fields exist before the automations that use them, whether the SMS sounds like a human, and whether you followed the instructions in this post exactly as written. How to apply Reply through OnlineJobs.ph with: The subject line described above Your GHL experience: how many sub accounts, what industries, how long Your HighLevel certification status The four sample task items Your portfolio link if you have one Your rate and your available hours in US Eastern time At the very bottom, tell me how long the sample task took you I read every application myself. If your work is solid you will hear from me inside 48 hours and we will do a short call where you walk me through one of your builds live.

title: Social Media Manager
description: ABOUT SKYACCESS SkyAccess is a marketplace for private jet charter and empty leg flights. Around 40% of private flights fly empty, repositioning with nobody on board. That inventory has always sat behind brokers, phone calls, and quotes you had to ask for. We put it in a search bar: real flights, real prices, booked directly with Part 135 certified operators. We sell whole aircraft, never seats. We are early and small. There is no content committee, no legacy calendar to inherit, and no agency layer between you and what ships. There is a brand system, a stream of real flight inventory that changes daily, and a lot of room. What we believe: no one else should decide what is possible for you. We show people what is already there. The jets were just the first door. THE ROLE You start your day inside the feed. You are studying what is actually performing right now: the carousel that got 40,000 saves, the thread that got quoted 300 times, the hook that made someone stop scrolling. Not just in aviation. In luxury travel, in real estate, in watches, in finance, in whatever corner of the internet is currently teaching people how to hold attention. You pull those posts apart until you can explain exactly why they worked, then you rebuild that structure around SkyAccess. Then you make the thing. You write the hook slide, the eight slides after it, and the caption. You design every slide yourself in our brand system so it looks like SkyAccess and not like a template. On X you do the same work in a different shape: threads, image posts, and screenshots built to be quoted. Something goes live on both accounts most days. The hard part is not the making. It is the honesty afterward. You will publish things you were sure would work that will do nothing, and you will need to look at the saves, shares, and profile visits, decide what actually caused the miss, and change the format instead of defending it. Volume plus judgment is the whole job. People who need two weeks and three approvals to ship one post will find this uncomfortable. You will work directly with the founder. When you see a format working on Tuesday, you can have our version of it live on Wednesday. That speed is the reason this role exists. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Format research and intelligence Maintain a living swipe file of high performing carousels, threads, and image posts, organized by what makes them work: hook type, slide count, pacing, contrast, and payoff. Run a weekly teardown of three to five standout posts and turn each into a format we can actually test, with a clear reason it should transfer to our audience. Track what is changing on both platforms: what the algorithm is rewarding, what is getting throttled, what formats are getting tired. Bring formats from outside aviation. Most of our best ideas will not come from other jet accounts. Instagram Write and design carousels end to end: cover hook, slide copy, sequencing, final CTA slide, and caption. Turn live flight inventory, including weekly empty leg drops, into posts people save and send to a friend. Own the hook. The first slide decides whether the other nine get seen, and you will write ten versions before picking one. Build captions that carry search terms and route names naturally, and drive comment based CTAs. X Adapt carousel thinking into the formats X actually rewards: threads, standalone image posts, and quotable one liners. Repurpose strong Instagram content into X native versions rather than cross posting the same file. Post consistently enough to build a recognizable voice on the account, not just occasional bursts. Design and brand craft Build every slide yourself in Canva or Figma inside the SkyAccess system: Tucson Red, Simple Tan, True Black, Inter, photography led. Hold the line on restraint. Our posts should look like a brand with a point of view, not a stock template with text on top. Grow the component library over time so recurring formats get faster to produce without getting stale. Measurement Report weekly on saves, shares, profile visits, follows, and comment volume, and say plainly what you are repeating and what you are retiring. Run deliberate tests: same content, different hook, different slide count, different opening image. Kill formats that stop working, including ones you invented. WHO YOU ARE You are the person who screenshots a post that stopped you mid scroll and immediately starts figuring out why it worked. You probably already have a folder of them. You care more about whether something performs than whether it was your idea. Format obsessed. You can look at a post that did huge numbers and explain the mechanics behind it: what the hook promised, where the tension sat, why slide four made people swipe again. This is the one trait that cannot be trained. You ship. You would rather publish five good posts this week than one perfect one next month, because you know the fifth one teaches you something the first four could not. You have taste. Your work looks considered. You know what to leave out, you respect a grid, and you can tell the difference between clean and empty. You write short. You can get a full idea into six words on a slide and make those six words feel inevitable. You are unsentimental about your own work. A flop is information. You go find the reason, adjust, and post again. You are self directed. Nobody is going to hand you a content calendar. You build it, defend it, and change it when the data says to. You are genuinely curious about the subject. Routes, aircraft types, why a Miami to Aspen leg comes back empty. The people who follow us can tell when the person posting actually finds this interesting. Backgrounds we are open to: you may have grown your own account to a real following, ghostwritten threads for a founder, run a meme or niche interest page, designed thumbnails and packaging for a YouTube channel, made carousels for an e-commerce or creator led brand, laid out a newsletter, or done social for a restaurant group, a watch dealer, or a real estate team. None of that is aviation and none of it needs to be. If your work is good, we want to see it. REQUIREMENTS A portfolio of social content you personally made, with the numbers attached. We want to see the posts and what they did. You can design in Canva or Figma well enough to take a slide from blank to finished without a designer. You can write a hook, and you can show us ten different versions of one. You understand how Instagram and X differ in what they reward, and you can explain why a format that works on one may not transfer to the other. You are comfortable being measured on output and performance, and comfortable working in public where every result is visible. BONUS You have grown an account from near zero to a real, engaged audience and can walk us through how. You have written threads that traveled, for yourself or for someone else. You have worked in a category where the buyer is high net worth: travel, real estate, watches, cars, hospitality, or finance. You can cut short form video as well as design static content. You have run paid amplification on organic content that was already performing. You have built and maintained a component or template system that made a team faster. If you are already the person your friends send posts to and ask why is this getting so many views, this is your job.

description: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Lead We are launching a new web and software development company focused on building custom websites, web applications, and software solutions for businesses. We are looking for a highly skilled and dependable Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Lead who can help us build projects from the ground up and grow with the company. This is not a position for someone who only knows WordPress, Shopify templates, or no-code website builders. We need someone who genuinely understands software development and can read, write, debug, modify, and build custom code from scratch. What You’ll Be Doing You will work directly with the business owner to take ideas and client requirements and turn them into working products. Responsibilities may include: * Building custom websites from scratch * Developing web applications and custom software * Front-end and back-end development * Designing and working with databases * Building and integrating APIs * Integrating third-party services and payment systems * Authentication and user account systems * Debugging and improving existing code * Deploying and maintaining production applications * Setting up hosting, domains, servers, databases, and cloud infrastructure * Reviewing code written by other developers * Helping estimate project timelines and technical difficulty * Recommending the best technology stack for each project * Explaining technical issues in clear language to a non-technical business owner * Potentially helping hire and manage additional developers as the company grows What We’re Looking For You should have strong real-world experience as a full-stack software developer. You should be comfortable with technologies such as: * JavaScript / TypeScript * HTML / CSS * React, Next.js, Vue, or similar modern frameworks * Node.js, Python, PHP, or another strong backend language/framework * SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL * REST APIs and/or GraphQL * Git / GitHub * Cloud hosting and deployment * AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel, or similar platforms * Website and application security * Responsive/mobile-first development Experience with AI APIs, SaaS applications, automation, mobile development, e-commerce, payment processing, and DevOps is a major plus. Most Important Qualities Communication and reliability are extremely important. We need someone who: * Responds consistently and communicates clearly * Can work independently without constant supervision * Can take an idea and determine how to technically execute it * Is comfortable solving problems they haven’t encountered before * Writes clean, organized, maintainable code * Can explain complicated technical concepts to someone who does not code * Is honest about what they know and don’t know * Can meet agreed-upon deadlines * Wants to build a long-term working relationship We are not looking for someone who disappears for several days in the middle of a project. Opportunity This is a new company, so the right person will have the opportunity to become an important part of the business from the beginning. Initially, the position may involve directly building projects. As we grow, the role could develop into a Lead Developer / CTO-style position, where you help oversee projects and other developers. title: Project Manager
description: The Project Manager (Project Manager) is the operational “air-traffic controller” for active construction projects. You keep projects moving by coordinating communication, scheduling, documentation, purchasing support, inspections, and payment/change-order tracking—while protecting the production team’s time and maintaining clear client expectations. This is a remote role supporting California projects; you must work Pacific Time hours and coordinate across multiple stakeholders. Core Responsibilities • Project documentation & research: maintain complete project files, permit/inspection notes, plan sets, client communications, and internal logs • Materials coordination: support ordering and delivery coordination; confirm site readiness; track lead times; flag risks early • Stakeholder coordination: communicate with crews, subcontractors, and clients to ensure clarity, alignment, and next actions. • Inspections scheduling: request and schedule city/municipal inspections as required; confirm prerequisites; communicate outcomes and next steps. • Invoicing & payment tracking: prepare invoice support, track client payments, and follow up on outstanding balances per company policy. • Change orders: draft CO documentation, gather approvals, track status, and ensure COs are billed and paid. • Crew attendance / performance tracking: collect daily/weekly field updates and flag issues to the Director of Operations. • Pipeline support (as needed): track and follow up project-related leads/items in the company pipeline and ensure clean handoffs. title: Dispatcher - Non Emergency Medical Transportation
description: How to Apply Submit the following: Your résumé. A brief introduction describing your relevant experience. Your mandatory English communication recording. (See script below) Details about your primary and backup internet connections. Details about your computer, headset, backup power, and VPN. Your experience working U.S. hours or overnight shifts. Your expected monthly compensation. Your earliest available start date. Incomplete applications, including applications submitted without the required English recording, will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete an additional computer-skills assessment and video interview. Applicants must have: A reliable high-speed internet connection. A computer capable of running browser-based dispatch and communication systems. A quality headset with a clear microphone. A quiet and professional home workspace. A reliable backup internet connection. A backup power solution. An active, reputable VPN with access to a reliable U.S. server. The ability and willingness to use the VPN and security settings required by the company. Mandatory English Communication Assessment Every applicant must submit a video or audio recording of themselves reading the passage below. Applications submitted without this recording will not be considered. Please begin the recording by stating your full name. Then read the following passage naturally and clearly: “Good morning, this is [your name] calling from ReliaWheels Transportation. I’m contacting you with an update regarding your scheduled pickup. Your driver is expected to arrive at approximately 8:45 a.m. Please remain available near the designated entrance and keep your telephone nearby. If anything changes or you need additional assistance, please contact our dispatch office. We appreciate your patience and look forward to safely transporting you to your appointment.” Recording Requirements The recording must be completed in English. Record in a quiet area without background noise or music. Speak naturally—do not use voice modification or artificial-intelligence-generated audio. Your voice must be clear and easy to understand. Upload the audio or video file with your application or provide a working shareable link. Confirm that the link can be opened without requesting additional access. Position Summary The dispatcher will coordinate drivers, vehicles, and passenger trips while maintaining excellent communication with passengers, healthcare facilities, transportation brokers, and our management team. This is a fast-paced position that requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to solve problems calmly. Key Responsibilities Monitor the daily transportation schedule and ensure trips are assigned appropriately. Dispatch drivers based on pickup times, locations, vehicle capacity, and passenger needs. Communicate with drivers regarding assignments, delays, changes, and additional trips. Answer calls from passengers, facilities, drivers, and transportation brokers. Provide accurate estimated arrival times and trip-status updates. Contact passengers and facilities to confirm transportation details when necessary. Monitor driver locations and identify potential delays before they affect service. Reassign trips when drivers are delayed, absent, or unavailable. Coordinate same-day requests, rescue trips, cancellations, and will-call returns. Confirm that wheelchair-accessible vehicles are assigned when required. Accurately enter and update trip information in the dispatch software. Document calls, schedule changes, cancellations, no-shows, and operational issues. Immediately escalate a ---------- , safety concerns, and serious service issues. Help reduce unnecessary mileage while ensuring passengers arrive safely and on time. Protect passenger confidentiality and handle sensitive information professionally. Complete shift notes and provide a clear handoff to the next dispatcher. Required Qualifications Excellent spoken and written English. Clear, confident, and professional telephone communication. Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly. Excellent organization, multitasking, and problem-solving skills. Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Reliable, punctual, and comfortable working independently. Ability to work hours aligned with U.S. Eastern Time, including overnight hours in the Philippines. Previous experience in dispatching, transportation, logistics, customer service, or call-center operations is preferred. Experience supporting a U.S.-based company is a plus. Experience with medical transportation or healthcare scheduling is a plus. What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate takes ownership, communicates proactively, and does not wait for small problems to become emergencies. This person should be comfortable managing several priorities while treating every passenger, driver, and client with patience and respect. Success in this role means keeping trips organized, minimizing delays and unnecessary mileage, communicating clearly, documenting information accurately, and helping the entire operation run smoothly.

title: Quickbooks accountant
description: We're a residential construction company in Utah — new homes, remodels, and light commercial. We build the projects; we need someone sharp to keep the books clean behind us. This is not a data-entry job. We job-cost every project, and we need someone who understands that a receipt for lumber has to land on the right job and the right cost code, not just in "Materials." What you'll do: Categorize and reconcile all transactions in QuickBooks Online, weekly Code every expense to the correct job and cost code Enter and track subcontractor and vendor bills; flag anything missing a W-9 or invoice Manage AR — send invoices and draw requests, track what's outstanding, follow up Bank and credit card reconciliations monthly Prepare month-end reports: P&L, balance sheet, job cost reports by project Track 1099 subcontractors and prepare year-end 1099 information Flag discrepancies instead of guessing — we'd rather answer a question than fix a mistake Requirements: 3+ years of QuickBooks Online experience (QBO specifically, not just Desktop) Direct experience with construction, contractor, or project-based job costing Strong written English — you'll be emailing vendors and clients on our behalf Comfortable working independently and keeping your own schedule of recurring tasks Reliable internet and a quiet place to work Nice to have: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification Experience with construction PM software (Buildwise, Buildertrend, CoConstruct, or similar) Familiarity with US construction cost code structures (NAHB or similar) Why work with us: Small team, direct communication with the owner, no layers of management. If you do good work you'll get more responsibility and more hours. Long-term position — we're looking for someone to grow into managing our full back office, not a short project. To apply: Send a message with: The subject line: "Books — [your first name]" How many years you've done QBO for a construction or contractor client, and what kind of work they did This question answered in your own words: A $4,200 lumber delivery covers two different jobs. How do you handle it in QBO? Your available hours in Philippine time Applications without the subject line and the question answered will not be reviewed.

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant
job_title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant
description: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required About the Role We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses. This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting. You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder. This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others. We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility. You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group. Key Responsibilities 1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including: • Bank and credit card reconciliations • Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight • Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations • Intercompany transactions and reconciliations • Balance sheet reconciliations • Fixed asset and accounting schedules • Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation • Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies • Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records • Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required. 2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts Take full ownership of the month-end process, including: • Month-end journals • Accruals and prepayments • Payroll reconciliations • Balance sheet reconciliations • Intercompany reconciliations • Revenue and expense cut-off • Review of P&L and balance sheet • Investigation of unusual movements • Preparation of management accounts • Month-end management commentary • Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task. 3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow • Prepare and maintain annual budgets • Maintain rolling forecasts • Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast • Monitor actual results against budget • Analyse and explain material variances • Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks • Monitor working capital • Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues • Recommend practical actions based on financial results 4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group. This includes: • Gross profit by client • Gross profit by employee • Gross profit by team/division • Gross profit by business entity • Client revenue versus labour cost • Actual hours/cost versus client budget • Employee utilisation and productivity • Revenue and cost per employee • Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas • Identification of scope creep and cost overruns • Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies • Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change. 5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group. Responsibilities include: • Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards • Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data • Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP% • Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity • Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost • Monitor employee utilisation and productivity • Track budget versus actual performance • Monitor cash flow and working capital • Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts • Maintain historical KPI trends • Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention • Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance • Provide concise management commentary and recommendations • Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group. This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports. 6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including: • Insurance renewals • Professional and business licence renewals • Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals • Finance and loan documentation • Subscription and contract renewals • Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar • Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance • Obtaining information and quotations where required • Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation • Escalating matters requiring management approval An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up. 7. Founder / Personal Finance Support Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including: • Personal cash flow and financial reporting • Investment and property-related accounting records • Loan and finance schedules • Personal financial administration • Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning • Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential. 8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement • Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems • Reduce unnecessary manual work • Identify opportunities for automation • Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency • Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled • Document important finance processes • Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis. You should have: • Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent • CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded • Strong Australian accounting experience • Strong management accounting experience • Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close • Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience • Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills • Advanced Excel skills • Strong Xero experience • Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills • Experience working across multiple entities • Strong attention to detail • Strong written and verbal communication skills • Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills • High level of confidentiality and professional judgement • Ability to work independently with limited supervision The Person We Want We are looking for someone who: • Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions • Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion • Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why • Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis • Is willing to remain hands-on • Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment • Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems • Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks • Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent • Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes • Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes • Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information Key Measures of Success Success in this position will include: • Accurate and timely month-end closing • Reliable management accounts • Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts • Reliable budget versus actual reporting • Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting • Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area • Reliable KPI dashboards • Early identification and escalation of financial risks • Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility • No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines • Improved finance processes, controls and automation • Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up The Opportunity This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group. For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: Australian Tax Accountant Wanted
description: Australian Tax Accountant Wanted We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Tax Accountant to join our growing Australian tax accounting firm. This role is ideal for someone with solid experience in Australian tax compliance and a genuine passion for helping business clients stay on top of their obligations while identifying tax-saving opportunities. Key Responsibilities • Prepare and lodge quarterly BAS for multiple client groups • Prepare financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, self-managed super funds, and individuals • Ensure full compliance with Australian tax legislation and ATO requirements • Utilise Xero Tax and BGL software efficiently and accurately • Liaise with clients to gather information, clarify queries, and provide professional guidance Requirements • Minimum 2 years’ experience in an Australian tax accounting firm • Strong understanding of Australian income tax, GST, CGT, and SMSF compliance • Proficiency in Xero Tax, BGL, and Microsoft Office • Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail • CPA or CA qualified, or currently working towards qualification (preferred) Additional Attributes (Preferred) • Experience managing budgets or client portfolios • Prior managerial or team leadership experience • A genuine interest in managing people and ambition to grow into a Team Leader role If you are a proactive tax professional who takes pride in accuracy, compliance, and client service — and you are looking to grow within a progressive firm — we would love to hear from you.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: About Us We are a fast-growing exterior home services company in the U.S. We are looking for a dependable, proactive, and organized Administrative Assistant to support our daily operations. This is a long-term position for someone who wants to grow with our company and become a valuable part of our team. We are looking for someone who is responsible, detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with customers, and able to take initiative without constant supervision. Responsibilities Your primary responsibilities will include: Answer and manage inbound customer calls Respond to customer inquiries by phone, email, and text Provide friendly and professional customer service Schedule customer appointments and estimates Confirm upcoming appointments Reschedule appointments when necessary Make outbound follow-up calls Follow up with leads and customers Manage and maintain the company calendar Communicate appointment details with our team Update customer information and job details in our CRM Enter data accurately and keep records organized Follow up on missed calls and messages Track daily tasks and make sure nothing is overlooked Assist with general administrative duties Prepare basic reports and spreadsheets Conduct online research when needed Organize digital files and documents Use AI tools to improve productivity and complete administrative tasks Learn new software, systems, and processes Assist management with other daily operational tasks AI Tools & Technology We are looking for someone who is comfortable with technology and interested in using AI to work more efficiently. Experience with the following is a plus: ChatGPT AI productivity tools Google Workspace Microsoft Office CRM systems Calendar and scheduling software Online communication platforms You do not need to be an AI expert. We want someone who is willing to learn and use new technology. What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is: Dependable and reliable Proactive and self-motivated Organized and detail-oriented Professional and friendly Confident communicating with customers Comfortable answering phone calls Excellent in written and spoken English Able to multitask and prioritize A quick learner Comfortable using computers and online software Able to work independently Good at solving problems Someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities Looking for a stable, long-term position Important We are not looking for someone who needs constant supervision. We want someone who can take a task, understand what needs to be done, and follow through. If a customer doesn't confirm an appointment, you follow up. If a call is missed, you make sure it is returned. If you notice a scheduling issue, you communicate it. We want someone who takes initiative and helps keep our daily operations running smoothly. Requirements Previous Administrative Assistant or Virtual Assistant experience preferred Customer service experience preferred Experience handling phone calls Excellent English communication skills Strong organizational skills Good computer skills Comfortable learning new software Reliable high-speed internet Reliable computer/laptop Quiet and professional workspace Ability to work during U.S. business hours Strong attention to detail Commitment to a long-term working relationship Preferred Experience Experience in any of these areas is a plus: Administrative Assistant Virtual Assistant Customer Service Appointment Setting Scheduling Call Center CRM Management Lead Follow-Up Home Services Exterior Services Painting Roofing Construction Remodeling AI Tools ChatGPT What We Offer Long-term, stable employment Competitive compensation based on experience Training and onboarding Supportive team environment Opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding company Opportunities for increased responsibility Opportunity to learn and use modern AI tools and technology How to Apply Please include the following in your application: Your resume A brief introduction about yourself Your previous administrative/customer service experience Your experience handling inbound calls and scheduling The AI tools you currently use Your expected monthly salary Your availability and preferred working hours Application Question Please answer this question at the beginning of your application: "What would you do if you had several customer calls, appointments to confirm, and other administrative tasks at the same time? How would you prioritize your work?" Applications that do not answer the question may not be considered. We are looking for a dependable, proactive, organized, and motivated person who wants to build a long-term relationship with our growing company. If you are a self-starter who enjoys helping customers and keeping things organized, we want to hear from you!

This is accuracy and production work—not creative logo design. ## Responsibilities * Identify the correct logo from the information provided. * Search official websites, archived websites and other reliable sources for the best available version. * Record the source URL for every logo found. * Manually recreate low-resolution logos when no suitable vector version exists. * Preserve the original shapes, typography, colours, spacing and proportions. * Export files according to the required naming and formatting rules. * Flag uncertain identities, unreadable text or conflicting versions instead of guessing. * Maintain a spreadsheet showing the source and status of every logo. ## Required skills * Strong Adobe Illustrator, Affinity Designer, CorelDRAW or equivalent vector-editing experience. * Proven experience with manual vector tracing and logo reconstruction. * Good online research skills. * Excellent attention to typography, spacing, curves and alignment. * Ability to follow detailed instructions consistently. * Good written English. * Reliable communication and careful file organisation. ## Deliverables For each approved logo: * Editable SVG. * Transparent PNG at the requested dimensions. * Editable AI, EPS or equivalent source file. * Clean vector paths without embedded low-resolution images. * Correct file name. * Source URL and a brief source note. Logos must be exact reconstructions. Do not modernise, redesign, simplify or invent missing details. Do not use automatic tracing without carefully cleaning and checking the result. AI-generated approximations are not acceptable. ## Paid Test Shortlisted candidates will receive the same paid test involving five logos of varying difficulty. Your weekly availability. 7. A brief explanation of how you verify that you have found the correct logo. 8. The words **“Exact Logo Recreation”** at the beginning of your application. Please do not apply if your portfolio consists mainly of Canva templates or automatically generated logos. We need someone who is patient, methodical and capable of producing accurate vector artwork. Salary US$5 per hour, initially for 10–20 hours per week. This is a long-term position for the right person. Four or more uploads a week, every week, no gaps, filmed solo across more than 10 countries. The content is travel, culture and food, with a meaningful part coming from his perspective as an Australian Muslim creator. We are not slowing down. The brand is what brings the brand deals in, so the bigger it gets, the more UGC work there is. That is the growth in this role and it is not theoretical: it is the same engine, and you would be on the side of it that keeps expanding. THIS IS AN EARLY EDITOR ROLE You would be joining a small team early, not slotting into a big one.

title: Call Centre Sales Manager
description: We're looking for a sales manager to run our appointment setting team. You'll own the hiring, the training, and the day-to-day management of the appointment setters who book appointments for our medical spa clinics in the United States.
