title: Multiple Paid Remote Roles for Feminist Company
job_title: Multiple Paid Remote Roles for Feminist Company
description: Please read this entire posting carefully before applying. ABOUT THIS RECRUITMENT Décalage Solutions is building a small, skilled, values-aligned remote core team. We are recruiting for multiple paid positions across several areas of the business. This is not one position requiring one person to perform every function listed below. We are looking for professionals with genuine expertise in different areas. We would rather hire several people with demonstrated depth in their respective fields than one person who claims to do everything. Opportunities may be part-time, project-based, or ongoing, depending on the function, current business needs, and each applicant’s demonstrated ability. Compensation ranges from $8 to $15 USD per hour, depending on the role, experience, and demonstrated level of skill. These opportunities are open only to women and transgender applicants. Across every position, we want professionals who communicate directly, think critically, recognize problems, recommend solutions, take responsibility for their work, and care about the success of the company. ABOUT DÉCALAGE SOLUTIONS Décalage Solutions is a feminist company serving women who are creating social, political, and community change. Our growing business includes private advisory and coaching, online education, community programming, retreats, speaking, writing, content creation, conscious travel, partnerships, and other values-led projects. We are building a financially successful business without separating commercial success from political and ethical responsibility. WHAT WE STAND FOR Our work is grounded in intersectional feminism. This means we understand that gender inequality cannot be separated from racism, colonialism, class, disability, sexuality, gender identity, migration, economic inequality, and other systems of power. Our values include: * Feminism that challenges patriarchy rather than helping individual women succeed at the expense of others * Anti-racism and an active commitment to confronting white supremacy * Anti-colonial practice and respect for Indigenous sovereignty, knowledge, and self-determination * Palestinian liberation and meaningful commitment to the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement * LGBTQ+ inclusion and respect for people of all sexual orientations and gender identities * Disability justice and accessibility * Economic and labour justice * Human rights, collective liberation, and community responsibility * Ethical consumption and corporate accountability * Trauma-informed, anti-oppressive, and non-exploitative ways of working * Respect for women’s autonomy, expertise, bodies, choices, and leadership * Recognition that no person’s liberation should depend upon the oppression, exploitation, or disposability of another community We do not practise a feminism that centres only privileged women, treats individual corporate success as liberation, ignores racism and colonialism, excludes transgender people, or remains silent about genocide and state violence. This is not a politically neutral workplace. Identity alone does not establish values alignment. Being a woman or transgender does not automatically mean that someone understands or supports feminism, intersectionality, anti-racism, anti-colonial practice, Palestinian liberation, LGBTQ+ rights, or BDS. Applicants must understand these commitments, take them seriously, and demonstrate how they would affect their actual work. AREAS IN WHICH WE ARE RECRUITING We are recruiting professionals with demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas: * Operations and project management * Executive assistance * Administrative and virtual assistance * Launch strategy and coordination * Funnel implementation and testing * Email marketing and automation * Copywriting and sales-page support * Social-media strategy, management, and scheduling * Video editing and content production * Systems, standard operating procedures, and workflow development * Client experience and customer support * Retreat and event coordination * Partnership, sponsorship, and affiliate development * Travel, venue, and hospitality coordination * Website, technology, and platform support * Contractor and team coordination * Progress reporting, data analysis, and performance tracking *Bookkeeping, accounting, and cross-border financial compliance, including Canadian, U.S., and Paraguayan requirements, with the ability and willingness to research additional jurisdictions as needed We are not looking for one person to perform every function. Do not claim that you can perform everything listed. Identify the areas in which you have genuine professional competence and provide evidence of what you have accomplished. Applicants must explain: * What they can perform independently at a professional level * What they can perform with direction * What they are currently learning * What they are not qualified to perform * What measurable results they have previously produced Honest self-assessment is part of professional competence. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for people who: * Read complete instructions carefully * Pay attention to context, details, and deadlines * Are genuinely skilled, not simply willing to try * Can provide evidence of previous work and results * Communicate clearly, directly, and confidently in English * Ask thoughtful questions when information is missing or unclear * Are comfortable communicating through written messages, meetings, video, and voice notes * Can give, receive, and implement constructive feedback * Think critically rather than automatically agreeing * Can respectfully challenge an idea and explain their reasoning * Notice problems and propose practical solutions * Exercise independent professional judgment * Take ownership of their work, decisions, and mistakes * Meet deadlines and arrive prepared and on time * Communicate early when a genuine emergency affects a commitment * Can distinguish between an unavoidable emergency and a competing personal priority * Work independently without disappearing, silently guessing, or requiring constant supervision * Care about quality, client experience, revenue, and measurable business results * Are emotionally intelligent, mature, dependable, discreet, and professional * Can communicate professionally with senior leaders, clients, partners, sponsors, affiliates, venues, speakers, and other organizations * Want to contribute to a strong team rather than complete disconnected tasks mechanically We do not want “yes people.” If you see a problem, risk, inconsistency, or better way to accomplish something, we expect you to raise it respectfully. We value informed professional opinions, sound reasoning, and people who can explain why they recommend a particular approach. Discussion must lead to action. Strong communication is not a substitute for completing excellent work. FEMINIST VALUES, ETHICAL JUDGMENT, AND BDS Every team member must remain aware of the company’s ethical commitments and apply them consistently. Décalage Solutions supports Palestinian liberation and takes the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement seriously. Team members must not select or recommend companies, platforms, products, speakers, venues, sponsors, affiliates, partners, media outlets, suppliers, or service providers without considering who owns them, what they support, and whether working with them is consistent with our values. This responsibility applies to every role. Team members may be expected to: * Research company ownership, parent companies, investors, partnerships, and corporate conduct * Check companies and products for known BDS targets and other ethical concerns * Consider anti-racist, anti-colonial, feminist, LGBTQ+ inclusive, disability, labour, environmental, and human-rights implications * Identify potential conflicts before presenting a recommendation * Explain the evidence and reasoning behind an assessment * Recommend ethical alternatives when an option is not aligned * Continue monitoring relevant information rather than assuming that a company’s status will never change If you do not know whether something is aligned, you are expected to investigate and ask. You must never assume that an option is acceptable simply because it is popular, convenient, profitable, or used by other companies. Applicants will be tested on their understanding of our values and on how they would apply those values within their specific area of work. Repeating definitions or copying our language will not demonstrate alignment. Applicants must be able to evaluate unfamiliar situations, identify ethical concerns, conduct appropriate research, and make reasoned recommendations. QUALITY CONTROL AND DEFINITION OF COMPLETION Work must not be represented as complete until it has been reviewed and tested. Depending on the responsibility, quality control may include: * Checking every link and button * Testing forms, payment processes, email sequences, automations, and scheduling systems * Reviewing work on desktop and mobile devices * Confirming that the complete client or customer journey functions as intended * Checking names, dates, prices, spelling, formatting, permissions, and access * Verifying that claims, research, and recommendations are accurate * Confirming BDS and broader ethical alignment * Ensuring that the work meets the complete original brief * Reporting anything that remains incomplete, uncertain, or untested “Complete” means that the work has been finished, checked, and shown to function. It does not mean that something has merely been drafted, uploaded, scheduled, or assumed to work. Team members must communicate progress without waiting to be chased. If a deadline, deliverable, or result is at risk, we expect early communication together with a proposed solution. PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY Life happens, and genuine emergencies occur. Professional accountability means communicating promptly, taking responsibility, and helping protect the work when circumstances change. Repeated lateness, last-minute notice about foreseeable conflicts, missed instructions, unexplained absences, unfinished work, or excuses in place of accountability will not be compatible with this team. If you commit to a meeting, deadline, or agreed working period, we expect you to organize your other responsibilities accordingly. Mistakes can be discussed and corrected. Dishonesty, repeated carelessness, misrepresentation of ability, and refusal to take responsibility cannot. We are interested in what you can reliably contribute, not promises unsupported by evidence. AI USE We use AI in our work. Applicants may use AI tools to help organize, edit, or refine their applications and work. Using AI is not a problem. Using AI to misrepresent your experience, judgment, communication ability, knowledge, or technical competence is a problem. We assume that some applicants will place this posting into an AI tool and generate polished answers. A polished application will not be treated as evidence that you can perform the work. You must be able to explain and defend everything submitted under your name. You may be asked detailed follow-up questions about any answer, claim, recommendation, or work sample. Shortlisted applicants will be tested through live discussion, unfamiliar scenarios, verification of previous work, and a paid practical assessment. HOW TO APPLY Submit a concise, personalized application that answers every question below. 1. Which specific area or areas listed in this posting are you applying for? 2. What are your three strongest professional skills? 3. Which responsibilities can you perform independently at a professional level? 4. Which responsibility listed here should we not hire you to perform, and why? 5. Describe one project for which you took meaningful ownership. What were you responsible for, what problem arose, and what result did you produce? 6. Describe a time you disagreed with a client or supervisor. How did you communicate your concern, and what happened? 7. Describe a professional mistake you made. How did you address it? 8. What does intersectional feminism mean to you, and how has it influenced a decision you have made? 9. What is your understanding of the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement? 10. Imagine that a potentially profitable sponsor, affiliate, platform, or business partner has a connection to a BDS target or a record of human-rights violations. Explain exactly what you would do before making a recommendation. 11. What would you do if you noticed that company content, a potential partner, or another team member’s recommendation conflicted with the stated values of Décalage Solutions? 12. How could your specific area of work contribute to both our mission and the financial success of the company? 13. What working hours can you reliably commit to? Include your time zone, availability, internet reliability, and current work commitments. 14. What is your expected hourly rate? 15. Provide links to relevant work samples, case studies, or a portfolio. Explain what part of each example you personally completed. 16. Include a link to a short video or voice introduction of no more than two minutes. Tell us why you are interested in Décalage Solutions and what you could contribute. Begin your application with this sentence: “I read the complete posting. I am applying in the area of __________.” Generic, copied, mass-produced, or incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Statements that you are hardworking, passionate, loyal, dedicated, or willing to learn are not evidence of competence. Show us how you think, communicate, solve problems, and produce results. SELECTION PROCESS Our selection process is rigorous because we are looking for demonstrated ability, judgment, emotional intelligence, reliability, and values alignment. Depending on the role, the process may include: * Review of the complete written application * Verification of previous work and results * A short exploration meeting * Detailed follow-up questions * Live values and judgment scenarios * A small, time-limited paid practical assessment * Reference verification * A clearly defined paid trial period * Written expectations, deadlines, and performance measures Before beginning a paid assessment, the applicant will receive the following information in writing: * The task * The expected deliverable * The maximum authorized time * The payment * The deadline * The evaluation criteria Completing an assessment does not guarantee ongoing work. Applicants may be evaluated on: * Role-specific technical skill * Accuracy and attention to detail * Quality of judgment * Emotional intelligence * Ability to follow the complete brief * Ability to identify missing information * Clear and timely communication * Appropriate use of AI and other tools * Ability to explain decisions * Application of feminist and ethical values * Understanding and application of BDS * Ability to receive and implement feedback * Reliability and respect for deadlines * Honest representation of competence * Overall quality of completed work Only agreed tasks and authorized time will be paid. Applicants must not exceed the stated time limit, expand the assignment, or perform additional work without written approval. PAID TRIAL PERIOD AND CONTINUED WORK Applicants who successfully complete the selection process may be offered a limited paid trial period for a specific role. Each trial period will have clearly defined: * Responsibilities * Authorized working hours * Deliverables * Deadlines * Communication expectations * Performance standards * Evaluation dates Continued work depends on meeting the written standards established for the role. Décalage Solutions may end a trial or working relationship if a team member: * Cannot demonstrate the skills represented in their application * Misrepresents experience, availability, competence, working time, or completed work * Repeatedly misses or misunderstands clear instructions * Produces work below the agreed standard * Fails to meet agreed deadlines * Does not communicate promptly about problems * Requires substantially more supervision than the role permits * Does not receive or implement feedback * Is repeatedly unavailable during agreed working periods * Records unauthorized hours or performs unauthorized work * Does not meet the role’s written performance measures * Disregards the company’s feminist, political, BDS, or ethical commitments All authorized work completed up to the end of the arrangement will be paid. Ending the arrangement means that no additional work or hours will be assigned. Please apply only if you are comfortable having your stated skills, professional judgment, emotional intelligence, reliability, and values alignment tested. We are building a company with ambitious goals, substantive values, and high professional standards. We want people who are proud to contribute to work that matters, who care whether the business succeeds, and who possess the professional discipline to help make that success possible.

The ideal candidate will understand ethical book promotion, Amazon’s review policies, and the rules of third-party websites. This person will identify legitimate opportunities for book reviews, submit or place books on appropriate websites, track results, and provide a detailed monthly report. This position is focused on building long-term visibility and reader engagement. It does not involve purchasing reviews, creating fake accounts, writing reviews for readers, or guaranteeing positive ratings. Key Responsibilities Book Review Outreach Research legitimate book review websites, book blogs, newsletters, podcasts, reading groups, and reviewer communities. Identify reviewers whose interests match each book’s genre and target audience. Submit books to reviewers according to each reviewer’s submission requirements. Prepare professional and personalized outreach messages. Maintain a record of every reviewer contacted. Follow up professionally when permitted. Third-Party Book Placement Find reputable websites where books can be listed, featured, promoted, reviewed, or submitted. Place books on free and paid promotional websites after receiving approval. Review each site’s rules before submitting a book. Ensure book descriptions, author information, categories, pricing, links, and cover images are accurate. Track submission dates, publication dates, fees, results, and expiration dates. Recommend new promotional opportunities based on genre, audience, price, and expected value. Avoid websites that use fake traffic, automated reviews, review exchanges, or misleading promises. KDP and Policy Compliance Understand and follow Amazon KDP and customer-review policies. Keep up with policy changes that may affect book reviews and promotions. Avoid compensated reviews, review manipulation, fake reviews, and prohibited review exchanges. Do not ask friends, relatives, employees, or individuals with a close personal or financial relationship to post reviews. Follow the rules of Goodreads, BookBub, social media platforms, review websites, and promotional services. Immediately report any questionable opportunity before submitting a book or making a payment. Tracking and Monthly Reports Provide a monthly report that includes: Books promoted during the month. Reviewers and websites contacted. Dates of all submissions. Free and paid placements completed. Amount spent on each placement. Pending, accepted, declined, and completed review requests. Links to published reviews and promotional listings. New Amazon reviews received during the reporting period. Changes in each book’s average rating and total review count. Website traffic, clicks, downloads, sales, or other available results. Problems, policy concerns, or negative feedback discovered. Recommendations and priorities for the following month. The specialist must maintain an organized spreadsheet or tracking system that can be reviewed at any time. Required Qualifications Experience with book marketing, publishing, blogging, or review outreach. Familiarity with Amazon KDP and Amazon’s customer-review policies. Strong online research and written communication skills. Ability to evaluate whether a promotional website is legitimate. Excellent organization and attention to detail. Ability to manage several books and submission deadlines. Experience using spreadsheets and preparing performance reports. Ability to work independently and communicate consistently. Strong commitment to ethical and policy-compliant promotion. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience promoting nonfiction, personal finance, investing, business, credit, retirement, or expatriate books. Existing relationships with book bloggers, reviewers, podcasts, newsletters, or promotional websites. Experience with BookBub, Goodreads, Booksprout, NetGalley, BookSirens, or similar platforms. Basic knowledge of SEO, keywords, metadata, and Amazon book listings. Experience tracking promotional expenses and calculating results. Performance Expectations Success will be measured by: Number and quality of legitimate review opportunities identified. Number of accurate book submissions and placements completed. Growth in honest reader reviews and book visibility. Compliance with Amazon and third-party platform policies. Accuracy and completeness of monthly reports. Ability to meet deadlines and stay within the approved budget. Quality of communication and recommendations. Reviews, ratings, rankings, and sales cannot be guaranteed. The specialist will be evaluated on the quality and consistency of the work—not on promises of positive reviews. Important Restrictions The selected candidate must not: Purchase fake or guaranteed reviews. Write reviews on behalf of readers. Create or use fake reviewer accounts. Offer payment in exchange for a positive review. Require a reviewer to leave a specific rating. Participate in review-for-review arrangements. Use automated or bot-generated reviews. Violate Amazon KDP policies or the rules of another platform. Pay for any service without prior approval. Any activity that could place an author’s Amazon account, books, or reputation at risk must be reported immediately. How to Apply Please submit the following: A short introduction describing your book-promotion experience. Examples of books or authors you have previously supported. A list of book-review or promotional platforms you have used. An explanation of how you ensure compliance with Amazon’s review policies. A sample monthly report or tracking spreadsheet, if available. Your requested hourly rate or monthly fee. Your weekly availability. A brief explanation of how you would promote a newly published KDP book during its first 30 days. title: AI Video Generation Operator (Full Time, Long Term, Training Provided)
job_title: AI Video Generation Operator (Full Time, Long Term, Training Provided)
description: We produce AI generated video ads for international brands. Demand has grown past what one person can produce, so we are hiring one person to train as our AI video generation operator. This is not a button pushing role. You will be trained directly by the founder to do the real creative generation work. What the job actually is: You will be given a reference video. Your job is to study it, work out how it was built, write the prompts, generate the clips, and pick the best output from everything you generate. Most of the work is reference based, which means you are not inventing from nothing. You are looking at something that already works and rebuilding it. That is a skill that can be taught, and we will teach it. The most important part of the job is judgment. When you generate clips, you need to know which three are actually good and why the other seventeen failed. That is the skill we care about most and it is the one we will build in you. Who this is for: -You have played with AI video tools and you have an eye for what looks right and what looks fake or off -You are willing to generate twenty versions to get three good ones without getting frustrated -You notice small details. Hands, faces, lighting, motion, timing -You want a stable long term role, not a series of short gigs -You are coachable and you want to get genuinely good at something You do not need years of experience. You do not need a long list of tools on your resume. If you have the eye and the patience, we will train the rest. Who this is not for: -You are planning to start your own agency soon and want a stepping stone -You want to be handed a template and repeat it without thinking -You juggle several clients and would treat this as one of many side gigs What you get: -Direct training, including recorded walkthroughs of real jobs -Paid access to the tools. You will never be asked to burn your own credits -A clear standard and real feedback, not vague direction -Salary that grows as your quality grows -Long term stability. We are building a team, not filling a gap Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week, Philippine timezone. Requirements: -Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work -Good written English -Video editing is a strong bonus. Not required, but if you can cut, caption, and assemble simple videos in CapCut, say so. -There will be editing work during quieter periods, especially early on -Willing to sign a simple confidentiality agreement. Our client work is private How to apply: Read this carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed. 1. Start your application with the word LOCKED so I know you read the whole post. 2. Send two or three complete AI generated videos you have made. Full finished videos, not single clips or raw generations. They do not need to be client work. Personal projects are fine. 3. Tell me which tools you have used and what your setup is. Include any editing tools you know. 4. Tell me when you can start. Shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test on real work. You will be paid for that test whether or not you are hired.

title: PERSONAL BRAND & EDUCATION CONTENT MANAGER
description: PERSONAL BRAND & EDUCATION CONTENT MANAGER Social Media Marketing | Reels | TikTok | Content Strategy - HAIR INDUSTRY Remote | Philippines Part-Time Initially | Long-Term Growth Opportunity I’m an Australian hairloss educator , hairloss clinic and salon owner and founder looking for a creative, experienced Content Manager to take ownership of my personal brand and professional education content. I already have someone managing the regular social media content for my hair salon this is for my personal Instagram + TikTok This role is specifically focused on my personal brand and professional hair education. I create a LOT of content. I need someone to help me create my course sales and gain my clients this isn’t about followers. Videos, photos, client transformations, education, training days, behind-the-scenes footage, business content, voice notes, ideas and everyday moments. My problem isn’t having things to talk about. My problem is consistently turning everything I have into great content and actually getting it posted. That’s where you come in. WHAT I NEED FROM YOU I want us to work together initially to create a clear content strategy. We’ll establish: * What we’re trying to achieve * Who we’re speaking to * What we want to grow * What we want to promote * The different areas of my personal brand * My professional education goals * How frequently we should be posting * What types of content we need You don’t need to magically understand my voice on day one. You’ll learn that by working with me. But once we’ve established the direction together, I need you to take charge of making it happen every single week. I don’t want consistency to rely on whether I’ve had time to sit down and create a Reel. YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY TAKE WHAT I GIVE YOU AND TURN IT INTO CONTENT. I will provide the raw material (you will create what raw material is needed) You will: * Organise it * D ---------- how we can use it * Find the strongest angles * Create the hooks * Edit the videos * Turn them into Reels and TikToks * Create carousels/posts where appropriate * Write captions * Create supporting Stories * Repurpose content * Schedule it * Post it * Keep everything organised * Make sure we’re consistently showing up every week You should be able to take one folder of footage and see multiple pieces of content inside it. If I send you a 10-minute video, you should be thinking about the Reel, TikToks, educational clips, Story content and anything else we can create from it. INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK You’ll be responsible for taking the content I provide and turning it into engaging content for both Instagram and TikTok. I don’t necessarily want the exact same piece blindly posted everywhere. You should understand how content can be adapted for each platform while still allowing us to work efficiently and repurpose what we create. You need to be FAST and confident with short-form video editing. I don’t want footage sitting unused for weeks because nobody has had time to do anything with it. KEEP ME CONSISTENT This is a huge part of the role. I need someone who keeps the content moving. You’ll maintain the content calendar and know: What’s being posted this week? What’s already edited? What’s waiting for approval? What content do we have available? What are we missing? What do you need me to film next? I don’t want to have to remember to ask you what content you need. I want YOU to ask ME. For example: “This is what we’re posting next week. I have four pieces ready, but I need you to film these two things for me.” Or: “We need more content around this topic. Can you answer these three questions on camera and send them to me?” That’s the relationship I’m looking for. PERSONAL BRAND You’ll work closely with me to understand my personal brand over time. My content covers areas including: Hair | Hair Loss | Business | Education | Leadership | Founder Life | Behind the Scenes | Personal/Lifestyle Some content is fun and fast. Some is educational. Some is opinion or founder-led. Some is very personal. And some of the work we do with hair-loss clients can be extremely emotional. I need someone who understands storytelling and human emotion, not just transitions and trending audio. As we work together, I want you to become increasingly confident at recognising: “This sounds like her.” And equally: “She would never post this.” PROFESSIONAL HAIR EDUCATION A major part of the role will also be consistently marketing and growing my professional hair education. I don’t only want to post when I’m selling training. We need to consistently nurture the audience so hair professionals: Discover me → Learn from me → Follow me → Trust me → Engage → Eventually want to train with me. You’ll help create and publish content around: * Education * Training days * My expertise * Student results * Student transformations * Testimonials * Behind the scenes * Industry education * FAQs * Common objections * Case studies * Success stories * Upcoming training * Educational tips * Content that builds authority * Content that nurtures potential students You’ll also help engage with the audience, respond to comments and appropriate DMs, and identify what potential students are asking about so we can create more content around those topics. I don’t want spammy sales outreach. I want genuine community building and consistent nurturing. BRING ME IDEAS Although I’ll provide lots of the raw content and we’ll set the strategy together, I don’t want to be responsible for thinking of everything forever. Once you understand the goals, I want you to start bringing ideas to me. Tell me: What should we create? What are we missing? What should I film? What should we talk about more? What performed well? What should we repeat? What are people asking us about? I want someone who becomes another creative brain behind the brand. HAIR & BEAUTY EXPERIENCE Experience creating content within the hair or beauty industry is strongly preferred. Particularly: Hair salons Hair extensions Haircare Hair loss Beauty brands Beauty educators Hair educators Beauty/hair personal brands You need a strong visual eye and an understanding of what makes hair and beauty content engaging. YOU NEED MORE THAN EDITING SKILLS Yes, you need to be excellent and FAST with CapCut, Canva, Instagram, TikTok or similar tools. But I’m looking for someone with real marketing knowledge, not simply a video editor. You should understand: * Social media marketing * Content strategy * Personal branding * Short-form video * Storytelling * Hooks * Viewer retention * Audience nurturing * Community engagement * Organic growth * Calls to action * Analytics * Lead generation * Content that converts WHO I’M LOOKING FOR You’re creative, proactive and organised. You’re a strong short-form video editor. You have a great eye for hair/beauty content. You understand marketing, not just design. You can take a lot of raw footage and turn it into organised content. You can manage a content calendar and keep us consistently posting. You don’t need constant instructions. You ask for what you need. You bring ideas. And you’re interested in becoming genuinely invested in growing the brand. THE OPPORTUNITY This role will initially be part-time. However, I own multiple businesses and brands, so there is significant potential for growth. If you nail this role, there is potential for more hours, more responsibility and long-term work with me. I’m looking for someone who can eventually take full ownership of keeping my content organised, created and consistently published, while we continue developing the strategy together. How to use MANYCHAT is a bonus! HOW TO APPLY Please send: 1. A short introduction about your marketing and social media experience. 2. Your portfolio, including Reels and TikToks you have personally edited. 3. Links to social media accounts you have worked on, explaining exactly what you were responsible for. 4. Hair & beauty experience. Tell me about any hair, beauty, salon, clinic, education or personal-brand accounts you’ve worked with. 5. Marketing results. Show me any examples where your content helped increase reach, engagement, followers, enquiries or sales. 6. Tell me about a brand where you were responsible for keeping the content consistently moving. How did you plan it, organise the raw content and make sure posts actually went out every week? 7. Tell me which editing/design tools you’re strongest in and approximately how quickly you can turn raw footage into a finished Reel or TikTok. 8. Tell me your availability and hourly rate in AUD. IMPORTANT Please begin your application with the words: CONTENT FIRST This is simply so I know you’ve actually read the full job description. Applications that don’t begin with CONTENT FIRST will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short paid editing task before final interviews.

title: Executive Assistant / OBM / Operations Manager
description: About the Role Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory. Right now a large volume of daily operational work sits on the founder's desk. Around 45 recurring administrative and IT tasks are documented, along with a long tail of requests that have never been written down at all. This role takes them over. The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets, email threads, and automations with custom software, with the first phase going live shortly. A lot of what you learn manually in your first months will be automated in your later ones. They need someone who understands why the current process works the way it does, so that when the new system takes over, someone there can still tell when it is producing the wrong answer. Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no department to hand something to. If you spot a problem, you either own it or you flag it, and both are fine. Priorities move, several things run at once, and you will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between. As the company grows this role will change shape more than once. That suits some people and frustrates others, and it is worth knowing which one you are before you apply. This is not a role where you wait to be told the same thing twice. You learn a process, run it correctly, write down what the instructions were missing, and then help make it faster. What You'll Own Workflow, Automation and Documentation (about 40%) Learn each recurring process by running it manually and correctly before proposing to change it Write and update standard operating procedures as you go, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive work, stored in portable form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform Maintain existing automations across the connected tools: diagnose failures, find where a handoff broke, fix or escalate Review automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct. An automation that quietly produces the wrong result is worse than a manual step, and catching that is part of this role. title: Bookkeeper
description: About the Role Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory. They are looking for a Bookkeeper to own the day to day accuracy of their financial records — transaction processing, coding, reconciliation, and the disciplined execution of the payables, receivables, and payroll cycles. This role carries more weight than the title usually implies. Most bookkeeping roles are volume roles. This one is a judgment role with volume attached. Multi-phase engagements bill on milestones, subcontractor invoices have to be matched against agreed rates before anything moves, and expense submissions get checked against policy rather than waved through. The hard part is not entering the transaction, it is knowing where it belongs and saying so when you are not sure. Expect 25 to 30 hours a week during onboarding and training, settling to around 20 once you are running the cycle independently. Hours grow from there: transaction volume is rising, the second company is just launching, and the more of the repetitive work you systematise and take on, the faster the role moves toward full time. You would support two companies under the same ownership. The second is newly launching as an extension of the services the first provides, which means you will be setting up its finance processes rather than inheriting them, and keeping the records for the two entities cleanly separated as it grows. Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no finance department behind you. You will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between, and the volume of transactions is rising as both companies grow. Priorities move and several things run at once, but the finance cycle still has to close on time and correctly every month. Holding both of those at once is the job. The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets, email threads, and automations with custom software. A meaningful part of this role is learning how the finance processes work today, documenting them properly, and automating the parts that should not need a person at all. We want someone who reaches for a system before they reach for a repetitive workaround. What You'll Own Accounts Payable and Contractor Payment Process vendor bills daily, coding each to the correct account, customer, class, and billable flag in QuickBooks Online Match subcontractor invoices against project records, agreed rates, and time tracking before anything is queued for payment Review contractor expense submissions against the travel and expense policy, and flag exceptions rather than processing them Prepare the semi-monthly payment run and produce the run summary for approval Maintain vendor records, W-9s, and the onboarding documentation set Billing and Accounts Receivable Run the monthly invoicing cycle from time tracking into QuickBooks, ensuring every completed engagement is billed accurately and completely, including recoverable expenses Apply milestone and deposit billing terms correctly for multi-phase engagements Maintain the collections log on a weekly cycle: refresh status, issue past-due notices, and track follow-up dates Report debtor ageing and escalate anything past the defined threshold rather than carrying it quietly Reconciliation and Record Integrity Perform monthly bank, credit card, and inter-system reconciliations on the defined cycle Investigate and resolve reconciling items rather than carrying them forward Maintain expense categorization consistency and flag coding that does not fit the existing chart of accounts Prepare the month-end close file and supporting schedules for review Payroll and Statutory Support Own the payroll change cycle: enter approved new hires, approved terminations, and approved rate or salary changes into the payroll system Verify that every approved change has been entered before the cutoff, and prepare the payroll change summary for review Prepare the monthly payroll run, ensuring deductions, classifications, and filings are correct and on time. (Approval of the underlying changes, review of the change report, and final approval and submission of payroll all sit with the Managing Director.) Maintain a clean distinction between payroll and contractor payment per engagement classification Prepare annual contractor tax forms Assemble the underlying numbers for state tax filings, workers' compensation premium audits, and annual insurance renewals You prepare and support these. You do not own the filing decision or the external relationships. Systems, Documentation and Automation Run each finance process manually and correctly before proposing to change it Write and update the procedure for every recurring task you own, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for the repetitive, rules-based work, and store them in a form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform Quality check automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct Support the migration of finance data and workflows into the new operating platform, and own the approval steps it routes to a person Keep a running log of every task you are asked to do and every question you had to ask to complete it Report monthly on which tasks were automated and how many hours of manual work that removed What You Bring Six or more years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in a professional or technical services environment Demonstrable QuickBooks Online experience: coding, reconciling, invoicing, and closing. Not familiarity — this has been your actual job. Accuracy under volume, and the discipline to resolve a reconciling item rather than carry it The judgment to reason about where a transaction belongs, and the honesty to say "I am not sure about this one" instead of guessing Real working use of AI tools. You should be able to describe a specific repetitive task you handed to an AI tool, which tool you used, how you set it up, and how you verify the output. Experience building or maintaining a workflow or automation in any tool, or clear evidence you look for the systemic fix rather than repeating the workaround Strong written English Ability to record your screen and narrate what you are doing clearly Strong advantages CPA, or an equivalent national professional accountancy qualification A degree in accounting, finance, or a related field Experience maintaining books for more than one entity under common ownership Experience with time tracking systems, relational database tools, expense and card management platforms, payroll providers, or workflow automation platforms Experience through a finance system migration or accounting software implementation Exposure to a regulated, audited, or ISO-certified environment Experience supporting a US-based firm How Success Is Measured 100% of completed engagements invoiced within the defined period Debtor days within agreed target 100% of reconciliations completed on cycle, with no unresolved items carried forward Month-end close file delivered within the agreed timetable Zero payments released against unmatched or unverified documentation Coding accuracy verified on review sample A written procedure exists for every recurring task in the role, and each one is reviewed and updated on a defined cycle rather than written once and left Procedures updated promptly as processes change, including the full rewrite required when the new platform replaces a manual workflow Both entities closed cleanly and separately, with no cross-coding between them Documented reduction in manual hours through automation, reported monthly How to Apply Complete our application form here: ---------- It takes about ten minutes. I want technology to remove unnecessary administration while allowing our team to provide an even better and more personal client experience. PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION & STUDENT JOURNEY We also operate a professional hair education business. title: Ecom Automation Expert and Controller (Social Media, Crossposting, AI Video Creation, Creative Briefs)
job_title: Ecom Automation Expert and Controller (Social Media, Crossposting, AI Video Creation, Creative Briefs)
description: # Job Offer: Senior AI Social Automation Architect ### Build the operating system behind a multi-market AI content network We are building a next-generation organic social commerce engine across multiple European markets. This is not a social media manager role. This is not a “make a few automations in ---------- ” role. We are looking for someone who can architect, build and continuously improve an AI-native system that turns: **Product → Audience → Pain Point → Content Idea → Script → Video → Localisation → Publishing → Engagement → Funnel → Revenue → Learning** into a scalable automated workflow. Our initial focus is Finland, Sweden, Poland, Netherlands and Belgium, with more markets to follow. The long-term goal is to operate dozens — potentially hundreds — of localised social accounts across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook. --- ## Your Mission Build the infrastructure that allows us to launch and operate social brands at scale. A typical setup may look like: **3 markets × 3 accounts × 3 posts per day** That already means: **27 localised videos per day** Across multiple platforms, this quickly becomes thousands of monthly content placements. Your job is to make that scalable, measurable and increasingly autonomous. --- # What You Will Build You will design the entire automation layer connecting AI models, APIs, databases, social platforms, video-generation tools and analytics systems. A typical workflow might look like: **Market / Product / Persona** → Pain Point Research → Content Angle → Hook Generation → Script → Localisation → Avatar / Creator → Voice → B-roll / AI Video → Automated Editing → Captions → QA → Publishing → Engagement → Analytics → Funnel Revenue → Performance Feedback Loop The system should become smarter over time based on what actually performs. --- # The Content Engine We do not want generic AI scripts. The system needs to understand: ### Pain What keeps the target audience frustrated? ### Desire What do they actually want their life to look like? ### Identity Who do they want to become? ### Transformation What change are they hoping to experience? For example, a 60+ wellness account is not really selling: **protein, supplements or recipes.** It may be selling: **energy, confidence, attractiveness, independence, longevity and the feeling of still being fully alive at 60+.** The scripting system needs to understand that distinction. --- # Content Formats You will help create automated pipelines for formats such as: * Lifestyle creators * Wellness creators * Fitness 50+ * Healthy ageing * Beauty * Recipes * Nutrition * Biohacking * Educational content * Product education * Storytelling * UGC-style content * Animated / 3D characters * AI hosts * Real creator digital twins * Faceless accounts The objective is not overly polished AI content. The objective is: **Believable. Native. Emotional. Interesting. Consistent.** Sometimes an imperfect-looking smartphone-style video will outperform a visually perfect AI commercial. You need to understand that. --- # AI Avatar Infrastructure A major part of the role will involve creating consistent digital creators. For example: A female wellness creator in her 60s. The character needs consistency across: * Face * Body * Age * Hair * Voice * Clothing * Personality * Environment * Communication style She should look like the same creator after 300 videos. The same applies to animated characters and educational personalities. Where fictional or AI-generated creators are used, the system should follow applicable platform disclosure and advertising requirements rather than relying on deceptive impersonation. --- # Localisation We are not interested in simply translating English scripts. Each market should feel native. The system should handle: **Master Concept** → Finnish → Swedish → Polish → Dutch → Flemish → Future markets Localisation may include: * Native phrasing * Local cultural references * Localised hooks * Local voices * Local products * Local pricing * Local currencies * Local landing pages * Local CTAs * Market-specific pain points * Different creative styles We want: **Central strategy. Local execution.** --- # Competitive Intelligence We want systems that continuously analyse successful public social content in our niches. The objective is not to copy creators. The objective is to understand patterns. For example: Analyse hundreds of high-performing videos. Extract: * Hooks * Topics * Video structures * Pain points * Story formats * First frames * Video lengths * Captions * CTAs * Comments * Audience questions * Emerging trends Then cluster these into strategic insights. Example: **500 videos** → transcription → classification → hook analysis → pain-point clustering → engagement analysis → original strategy generation Tools may include: * Apify * platform APIs * social intelligence software * transcription tools * LLMs * custom scrapers where permitted * databases * internal dashboards --- # Automation Stack We do not care which tool is fashionable. We care about: **Quality × Cost × Reliability × Speed × Scalability** Potential technologies may include: ### Automation * n8n * Make * custom workflows * event-driven services ### AI * Claude * Gemini * OpenAI models * specialised models ### Video * Higgsfield * Veo * Kling * Runway * HeyGen * emerging video models ### Images * Gemini Image * Flux * specialised character models ### Voice * ElevenLabs * other high-quality multilingual TTS ### Rendering * Creatomate * Remotion * FFmpeg * Shotstack ### Internal Tools * Base44 * Supabase * PostgreSQL * custom dashboards ### Distribution * Metricool * Ayrshare * ---------- * official platform APIs ### Agent Infrastructure * MCP * Claude Code * custom agents * API orchestration You should continuously test whether something better has appeared. --- # We Want Agents, Not Just Workflows Eventually, we want to issue instructions such as: **“Prepare tomorrow's three videos for the Finnish wellness account.”** The system should then: 1. Review previous performance. 2. Find winning themes. 3. Select pain points. 4. Select content angles. 5. Generate scripts. 6. Localise them. 7. Generate assets. 8. Create voice. 9. Assemble the videos. 10. Run QA. 11. Queue the content. 12. Publish. 13. Collect performance data. 14. Update the content database. Humans should increasingly manage exceptions and strategy instead of manually moving files between tools. --- # Publishing Infrastructure You will build reliable distribution across: * TikTok * Instagram Reels * Facebook Reels * YouTube Shorts The system should account for platform-specific requirements such as: * Video length * Captions * Titles * Descriptions * Cover frames * Subtitle positioning * Safe zones * CTAs * Posting schedules * Aspect ratios * Content formatting One video does not necessarily mean one identical upload everywhere. --- # Engagement Automation You will also investigate intelligent engagement workflows. For example: **New comment** → understand intent → classify comment → generate appropriate response → automatically answer suitable FAQs → escalate sensitive comments → identify buying intent → identify customer-service issues The goal is to assist genuine account engagement at scale, not create spam or fake engagement. --- # Account Management As we scale, we need a control centre for the entire network. Every account should have structured information such as: * Market * Language * Persona * Product * Funnel * Platform * Posting status * Last post * Next post * Account owner * Performance * Funnel clicks * Revenue * Errors * Automation status We may operate accounts through dedicated devices or managed mobile infrastructure where appropriate. The objective is stable, secure multi-account operations — not bypassing platform enforcement systems. --- # Automated QA The system needs to catch bad content before it goes live. Examples: * Broken subtitles * Wrong language * Wrong CTA * Wrong landing page * Broken lip sync * Character inconsistency * Strange AI artefacts * Incorrect product * Unsupported health claims * Duplicate content * Failed rendering * Incorrect currency * Watermarks * Audio problems * Incorrect aspect ratio You should design automated checks wherever possible. --- # Health & Supplement Content Some of our products may involve health, wellness and supplements. This requires stronger QA. The content engine should work from approved claims and approved product information rather than allowing models to invent medical or health promises. The automation architecture needs to support this. --- # Performance Feedback Loop This is one of the most important parts of the job. Every video should become structured data. Example: **Market:** Poland **Persona:** Women 55+ **Pain:** Low Energy **Angle:** Identity **Hook:** 07 **Format:** Lifestyle Story **Product:** X Performance: * Views * Retention * Completion rate * Saves * Shares * Comments * Profile visits * Link clicks * Purchases * Revenue The system should eventually identify: > “Identity-based hooks about energy significantly outperform educational hooks for this persona in Poland.” Then create more content around that pattern. Our competitive advantage should eventually become our own dataset. --- # We Care About Revenue Follower count is useful. Views are useful. But they are not the final objective. We care about: ### Revenue per 1,000 views ### Funnel CTR ### Revenue per account ### Revenue per content angle ### Revenue per persona ### Revenue per market ### Customer acquisition economics The infrastructure needs to connect social performance to commercial performance. --- # Your Daily Responsibilities You will monitor and improve the machine every day. This includes: * Check failed workflows * Check failed uploads * Check API issues * Review AI output * Review account health * Monitor content quality * Monitor generation costs * Monitor localisation quality * Review analytics * Improve prompts * Improve scripts * Test new tools * Test new models * Reduce unnecessary costs * Improve speed * Reduce manual intervention * Fix edge cases * Improve dashboards You are responsible for the **system**, not merely individual automations. --- # Weekly Responsibilities Every week we expect a short operating review. ### What worked? Which: * Hooks * Markets * Personas * Formats * Products * Characters * Angles performed best? ### What failed? What broke? Why? ### What can be automated next? Where are humans still wasting time? ### What changed in AI? What new model or tool should we test? ### Where can costs drop? Can we achieve the same output for 30% less? ### What do we test next week? There should always be an experimentation roadmap. --- # Ideal Candidate You are probably someone who already spends too much time experimenting with new AI tools. You should be comfortable with: * n8n * APIs * REST * Webhooks * MCP * OAuth * JSON * JavaScript * Python * Databases * SQL * LLMs * Prompt systems * AI video * AI images * AI voices * Browser automation * Social APIs * Cloud services * FFmpeg / rendering workflows * Debugging * Analytics You do not have to be a hardcore backend engineer. But you need to be extremely good at **making software work together.** --- # We Are NOT Looking For Someone whose entire automation skill set is: **ChatGPT → ---------- → Google Sheet.** Someone who recommends tools without understanding API limitations. Someone who builds workflows that work once and break every third day. Someone obsessed with AI quality while ignoring generation cost. Someone who understands automation but has zero understanding of marketing. Someone who celebrates views without asking whether they generated sales. --- # You Think Like an Operator When you see repetitive work: > “Why are we doing this manually?” When you see an expensive model: > “Does the performance justify the cost?” When you see a new AI tool: > “Can I test this against what we're currently using?” When something breaks: > “How do I make sure this failure can never happen silently again?” When content performs: > “What caused it, and how can we systematically reproduce it?” --- # First 30 Days Your first assignment is to build the V1 operating system. ### Initial target **3 countries** × **3 accounts per country** × **3 posts per account/day** = ## 27 localised videos per day The first version should automate as much as possible of: 1. Research 2. Pain-point collection 3. Content ideation 4. Hook generation 5. Script generation 6. Localisation 7. Voice generation 8. Avatar/content generation 9. B-roll 10. Editing 11. Subtitles 12. QA 13. Publishing 14. Analytics collection 15. Performance storage --- # 60-Day Goal By Day 60: * Significantly less manual work * Stable content pipeline * Reliable publishing * Centralised dashboard * Better creative consistency * Automated performance collection * Basic winner identification * Automated content variation * Clear production economics --- # 90-Day Goal By Day 90, we want to move toward: **Product + Market + Persona** ### IN ↓ Research Scripts Creative Localisation Publishing Analytics ↓ ### CONTENT ENGINE OUT The team should mainly focus on: **Products, strategy, creative direction and scaling.** Not moving files between SaaS tools. --- # What Success Looks Like The best person in this role will eventually be able to say: > “We launched three new countries this week without adding another employee.” That is the standard. --- # Why This Role Is Interesting You will not be maintaining a boring internal automation. You will be building an infrastructure where: **AI + Content + E-commerce + Automation + Data** all meet. You will have significant freedom to choose the technology. If a better model launches tomorrow, we want to know. If a workflow can be replaced with an agent, test it. If we can eliminate a SaaS subscription with a small internal tool, build it. If a €500/month tool produces €20,000/month of additional output, use it. We want someone who thinks commercially, not dogmatically. --- # Application Do not send us a generic CV only. Show us what you can build. Please send: **1. Your strongest automation project** Explain what it did and how the architecture worked. **2. Your current preferred AI content stack** What would you use today for: * scripting * localisation * image generation * video generation * avatars * voices * editing * publishing * analytics And why. **3. Architecture Challenge** Explain how you would build: > **3 markets × 3 accounts × 3 videos/day across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts.** We want to understand: * Architecture * Software * APIs * Database * Estimated monthly costs * Failure handling * How you would keep characters consistent * How you would collect performance data * How you would improve the system over time **4. Tell us what you would NOT automate.** This question matters. --- ## Role **Senior AI Social Automation Architect / AI Growth Systems Engineer** **Remote** **Long-term** **High ownership** Compensation depends on experience and demonstrated ability. For the right person, this is not a small freelance automation project. **You will own the technology layer of a system we intend to scale across markets, products and potentially hundreds of social channels.**

title: Trailer Repair Admin
description: GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery. If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation. Role Overview You are responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution. The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending. What You’ll Be Doing Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination • Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors. • Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step. • Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations. • Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team. • Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending. Fleetio and Data Integrity • Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift. • Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current. • Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information. • Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation. • Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible. Off-Tour Trailer Operations • Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up. • Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team. • Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements. • Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability. • Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts. Documentation and Morning Handoff • Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift. • Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups. • Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation. • Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff. • Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups. What Success Looks Like • Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution. • Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift. • Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs. • Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions. • The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items. Who We’re Looking For • Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination. • Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred. • Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps. • Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation. • Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus. • Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power. Schedule and Work Setup • Long term and full time remote independent contractor role • Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO • Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT • Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required • Zoom presence with camera on is required throughout the scheduled shift. • Time-tracking software is used for attendance, accountability, and performance support. What You’ll Get • Independent contractor setup with a $75 monthly insurance stipend after 30 days. • Reliable biweekly payments and a stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based. • Direct exposure to a live U.S. transportation and fleet operation. • Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity and maintenance coordination. • Growth opportunities across Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, and broader logistics operations. This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning. Apply Here: ---------- /team/ ---------- /GHApplicationForm Visit Us: ----------

title: B2B Sales and Account Manager
description: We have a premium headwear brand based in New York City. We make unbranded, better-fitting caps in three real sizes and sell them direct to consumers and to businesses that want custom embroidered caps for their teams, events, and merch. More than 500 companies have ordered from us, including Google, Shopify, The Ritz-Carlton, and Stanford University. Our wholesale side is growing fast. We now handle around 125 wholesale and custom orders every month, and we need someone whose full-time job is making sure those customers feel looked after and come back. ## The role This is a customer relationship role with two halves. 1. Wholesale customer success - Reach out to every new wholesale customer after their order ships to make sure it arrived and they are happy with it - Check in with existing accounts on a regular schedule (30, 60, 90 days and beyond) to see how the caps are being used, whether they need a reorder, and whether anything went wrong that we should fix - Keep our CRM accurate and up to date for every wholesale account, including contact details, order history, notes from each conversation, and next follow-up dates - Spot reorder opportunities (events coming up, new hires, seasonal needs) and bring them to the team - Flag any issue, complaint, or at-risk account to the founders right away - Work closely with the Lift Down team to learn our communication style and upsell tactics, and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and what they need ### 2. Instagram B2B outreach: Many businesses follow our Instagram after seeing one of our B2B ads. They are interested but not ready to order yet, or they mean to come back to our custom cap configurator and forget. Your job is to catch them before they go cold. - Monitor new followers, likes, comments, saves, and DMs every day and identify which ones are business accounts, brands, agencies, or companies - Assess whether an account is a legitimate business worth pursuing (real website, real team, real activity) versus a fake, spam, or irrelevant account - Reach out to qualified accounts by DM or email, introduce Lift Down, and offer a blank sample cap so they can feel the quality - Point them to our self-serve custom cap configurator and help them get started - Log every lead in the CRM with a status and a follow-up date, and follow up on schedule until they order or clearly decline - Report weekly on how many accounts you reached out to, how many replied, how many requested samples, and how many placed an order ## What we are looking for - At least 2 to 3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or B2B sales, ideally for an ecommerce or product brand - Sales experience is important. A big part of this role is turning interested followers into customers and existing customers into repeat customers, so you need to be comfortable asking for the order - Excellent written English. You will be writing to US business owners, marketing managers, and procurement teams every day, and your messages need to read as clear, warm, and professional - Able to write without relying on AI. Our customers should never feel like they are talking to a bot, so you need to be able to write messages in your own voice and style, without running everything through ChatGPT first. AI tools are welcome for working through complex problems or tightening up a sentence now and then, but your English has to be strong enough to stand on its own - Hands-on experience keeping a CRM organized (any CRM is fine as long as you are disciplined about it) - Comfortable doing outreach on Instagram and by email, and comfortable with polite persistence - Good judgment about people. You can tell the difference between a real company and a time-waster, and you know when to push and when to back off - Organized and self-directed. You will own your own follow-up calendar and nobody will chase you on it - A real understanding of how different kinds of businesses work and buy. A 10-person startup, a marketing agency ordering for a client, a hotel, a university, and a Fortune 500 procurement team all have different needs, timelines, and decision makers, and you should be able to adjust how you talk to each one - Comfortable dealing with large companies. Some of our customers are S&P 500 companies, and you need to be able to hold a professional conversation with them without being intimidated or overly casual - Familiarity with Shopify is a plus - Full alignment with the US Eastern schedule. You need to be online and available from at least 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday ## Who you are - Communication is the most important trait for this role. You write clearly, you listen well, and people enjoy hearing from you - You understand how business relationships actually work. Trust is built over time, not in one message, and a customer who feels remembered is a customer who reorders - Adaptable and a quick learner. We are a fast-growing company and things change often. You pick up new tools and processes quickly and you are not thrown off when priorities shift - Comfortable with ambiguity. You should be comfortable speaking with sellers in situations involving: * Inherited properties * Vacant properties * Landlords * Properties needing repairs * Distressed properties * Relocation * Financial pressure * Foreclosure situations * Sellers considering a Realtor * Sellers comparing cash offers * Sellers with unrealistic price expectations * Sellers who need repeated follow-up before making a decision ### THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT POSITION IF YOU: * Mainly schedule appointments * Only have cold-calling experience * Depend completely on a script * Are uncomfortable discussing money * Are afraid to challenge a seller's price expectations * Give up after receiving an objection * Do not follow up consistently * Need someone to tell you every day who to call * Fail to maintain detailed CRM records * Have never worked with motivated property sellers We want someone who understands the difference between **having a conversation and advancing a deal.** ### COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS Excellent spoken and written English is required. Because you will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, your telephone communication must be professional, natural, confident, conversational, and easy to understand. Describe your experience speaking directly with motivated U.S. property sellers. 2. What real estate companies or investors have you previously worked with, and what exactly were you responsible for? 3. Were you primarily a cold caller/appointment setter, or were you personally responsible for converting and closing seller opportunities? Explain. 4. Approximately how many seller leads did you personally handle each week? 5. Approximately how many resulted in contracts, listings, appointments, or other committed opportunities? 6. Describe your experience with **Follow Up Boss**. Tell us specifically which Follow Up Boss features you have personally used. 7. A homeowner tells you: “Zillow says my house is worth $250,000, so I'm not taking $190,000.” Write exactly what you would say next as if you were actually speaking with the seller. Do not explain your sales strategy. 8. A homeowner says: “I'm not in a hurry. I'll just list it with a Realtor if I don't get my price.” Write exactly how you would continue the conversation. 9. Tell us about one difficult seller objection you successfully overcame. What was the objection, what did you say or do, and what happened? 10.
