We are specifically looking for someone who has already spoken with **motivated property sellers and moved those conversations toward contracts, listings, or another definitive commitment.** If you are an experienced seller closer looking for a long-term position where your ability to convert opportunities will be recognized and rewarded, we want to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Seller Solutions Closer – Listings, Cash Offers & Online Auctions
job_title: Real Estate Acquisition & Seller Solutions Closer – Listings, Cash Offers & Online Auctions
description: REAL ESTATE ACQUISITION & SELLER SOLUTIONS CLOSER Listings • Cash Offers • Competitive Online Sales • Auctions We are building a different kind of real estate seller-conversion platform and looking for an experienced **Real Estate Acquisition / Seller Solutions Closer** who can speak confidently with U.S. property owners and help them determine the best way to sell. This position is for someone who understands that **not every motivated seller should be forced into a wholesale cash offer.** Depending on the seller's goals, property, equity, condition, timing, and price expectations, we may be able to offer several different solutions. Our goal is simple: **Understand what the seller is trying to accomplish and move them toward the best available solution.** ### OUR PLATFORMS Our seller and competitive-sale programs include: **Realty Offers Now** Our seller-facing real estate marketplace and seller-solutions platform. ** ---------- ** Our competitive online bidding platform used for online real estate sales and auction-style transactions. **Seller Options Now** Our motivated-seller platform for direct purchase opportunities and alternative seller solutions. Our business combines traditional real estate, investor acquisitions, seller lead conversion, and competitive online bidding. ### SELLER SOLUTIONS MAY INCLUDE Depending upon the seller and property: - Direct cash / investor purchase - Traditional real estate listing - Competitive online bidding - Real estate auction - Offer-to-Sold competitive-sale strategy - Accelerated sale - Other structured seller solutions - Continued follow-up and nurture when the seller is not ready today We are looking for someone who can recognize the difference between these opportunities and confidently explain the appropriate solution to the seller. ### THIS IS A CLOSING POSITION This is NOT primarily an appointment-setting position. Our lead-generation team identifies and contacts property owners. You will work primarily with: - Interested sellers - Warm seller leads - Previously contacted property owners - Sellers requesting offers - Aged leads requiring re-engagement - Property owners considering a Realtor - Sellers whose price does not fit a traditional investor acquisition - Sellers who may benefit from an accelerated or competitive-sale strategy - Real estate agents who may have properties appropriate for our online bidding platform Your responsibility is to **advance the opportunity.** ### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES - Speak with warm U.S. property-owner leads - Build rapport and trust quickly - Determine the seller's true motivation - Understand timing and urgency - Discuss property condition - Determine price expectations - Discuss mortgage/equity information when appropriate - Identify decision-makers - Present and discuss potential selling solutions - Handle seller objections - Negotiate purchase opportunities - Discuss realistic property values and expectations - Recognize when a cash acquisition is NOT the right solution - Transition qualified sellers toward a traditional listing when appropriate - Explain competitive online sale and auction options - Follow up persistently with sellers who are not ready immediately - Ask for clear commitments and next steps - Maintain detailed CRM records - Coordinate qualified opportunities with management and licensed real estate professionals - Help move seller opportunities toward signed agreements and completed transactions ### THE PERSON WE WANT We are especially interested in candidates who have previously worked as: - Acquisition Manager - Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist - Seller Lead Manager - Real Estate Sales Closer - Disposition Manager - Wholesale Acquisition Manager - Inside Sales Agent - Listing Conversion Specialist - Real Estate Investor VA with closing responsibilities - Real Estate Sales Manager - Lead Conversion Manager Experience working with **U.S. motivated property sellers is strongly preferred.** ### DIRECT REAL ESTATE CLOSING EXPERIENCE IS HIGHLY VALUED We want to hear from candidates who have personally: - Presented offers to homeowners - Discussed purchase prices - Negotiated with sellers - Handled price objections - Followed sellers over multiple conversations - Obtained purchase agreements - Helped obtain listing agreements - Worked transactions from lead through contract - Coordinated closings - Worked acquisitions and/or dispositions If your only real estate experience is reading a cold-calling script and scheduling appointments, this is probably not the right position. ### MULTIPLE-SOLUTION SELLING One of the most important parts of this role is recognizing that not every seller belongs in the same box. For example: A seller who needs immediate certainty and has a property requiring major repairs may be appropriate for a direct purchase. A seller who wants closer to full market value may be better suited for a traditional listing. A property where competitive buyer demand may produce a better result could be appropriate for a competitive online sale through RealtyBidNow. A seller who wants market exposure but also wants a defined selling timeline may be appropriate for our Offer-to-Sold strategy. Your job is to ask enough questions to determine the appropriate direction. ### REALTOR / AGENT OPPORTUNITIES This position may also involve conversations with real estate agents. RealtyBidNow can be used as an additional selling tool for agents who have clients or properties that may benefit from a competitive online sale or accelerated-sale strategy. We cooperate with real estate professionals rather than attempting to remove them from the transaction. Depending upon the opportunity and written agreement: - The referring/listing agent may remain involved with their seller - The agent remains informed and included - Property marketing is coordinated collaboratively - Photography and property presentation remain important - Agent participation and referrals may be compensated according to the specific written agreement - Our online bidding platform can become an additional tool for the agent and their client You must be comfortable speaking professionally with both homeowners and real estate professionals. ### CRM EXPERIENCE Experience with real estate CRM systems is important. **Follow Up Boss experience is strongly preferred, but it is NOT mandatory for an otherwise exceptional acquisition closer.** Experience with any of the following is valuable: - Follow Up Boss - Podio - GoHighLevel - InvestorFuse - REISimpli - REI BlackBook - REI Reply - Salesforce - HubSpot - Pipedrive - LionDesk You must be comfortable managing: - Lead stages - Notes - Tasks - Follow-up - Pipelines - Calls - Text messages - Email communication - Long-term nurture - Detailed seller histories ### TYPES OF SELLERS YOU MAY SPEAK WITH - Inherited / estate property owners - Tired landlords - Absentee owners - Vacant-property owners - Properties needing significant repairs - Pre-foreclosure owners - Owners experiencing financial pressure - Sellers relocating - Investors - Owners of rental property - Commercial property owners - Landowners - Sellers with unrealistic price expectations - Sellers considering traditional Realtors - Sellers who already received investor offers - Sellers who need weeks or months of follow-up before d ---------- ### COMMUNICATION STYLE We do NOT want a robotic script reader. You should be: - Confident - Professional - Conversational - Curious - Persistent - Comfortable discussing money - Comfortable asking difficult questions - Able to listen - Able to challenge assumptions respectfully - Able to control a sales conversation without being aggressive Excellent spoken English is required. ### COMPENSATION Expected base compensation: **$1,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience** We are especially interested in creating a compensation structure that rewards results. Qualified candidates may receive: - Base compensation - Performance bonuses - Signed-agreement bonuses - Transaction bonuses - Closing incentives - Other performance-based compensation The exact structure will depend upon the candidate's experience and role. Exceptional performance may lead to increased responsibility in seller conversion, acquisition management, sales operations, or team leadership. ### WORKING HOURS Approximately **30–40 hours per week**. You must have meaningful overlap with **U.S. Eastern Time**, including normal daytime seller-contact hours. This is intended to become a long-term position. ### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS You must have: - Reliable computer - High-speed internet - Quiet professional workspace - Quality microphone/headset - Ability to participate in video meetings - Reliable availability during agreed U.S. hours - Backup internet or power solution strongly preferred ### HOW TO APPLY Begin your application with: **“I ADVANCE REAL ESTATE DEALS”** Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed. Then answer the following questions. 1. How many years have you worked in U.S. real estate? 2. Describe your experience personally speaking with motivated property sellers. 3. What was your most recent real estate position? 4. Were you personally responsible for negotiating with sellers and obtaining contracts, or did you primarily set appointments for someone else? 5. Walk us through one actual seller transaction you personally helped move from initial conversation through offer, negotiation, contract, and closing. 6. Approximately how many seller leads did you personally handle each week or month? 7. Approximately how many purchase agreements, listings, or other signed seller opportunities did you personally generate in an average month? 8. Describe your experience running comps, calculating ARV, estimating repairs, or determining offer prices. 9. Describe your experience with acquisitions and dispositions. 10. Which CRM systems have you personally used? 11. Have you used Follow Up Boss? If yes, explain exactly how you used it. If not, tell us which real estate CRM you know best. 12. A seller wants $275,000. Your direct purchase number is approximately $200,000. The seller is not distressed and says they would rather list the property than accept $200,000. What would you do next? 13. Have you ever worked with traditional listings, auctions, competitive online sales, novations, seller financing, or other alternative real estate sale methods? Explain. 14. Are you comfortable speaking with Realtors and real estate brokers about referring or cooperating on seller opportunities? 15. What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time? 16. What base hourly or monthly compensation are you requesting? 17. Would you consider a base compensation plus performance bonuses or commissions? ### VOICE OR VIDEO SAMPLE REQUIRED Please include a 60–90 second voice or video introduction. Tell us: - Your name - Your real estate background - Your acquisitions/closing experience - The types of sellers you have worked with - Why you believe you can advance seller opportunities rather than simply schedule appointments We are looking for an experienced real estate professional who understands one important principle: **The goal is not to force every seller into one offer. The goal is to find the right path to a transaction.**

title: Business Credit Reporting & Compliance Coordinator
description: Corpire Capital is a business credit and funding-readiness company helping entrepreneurs build fundable businesses. We're looking for a detail-driven Reporting & Compliance Coordinator to own our monthly tradeline reporting cycle across three bureaus — Experian, CreditSafe, and Equifax. This is a small, contained role by hours, but it carries real weight: what you report each month becomes part of our audit trail, so accuracy and consistency matter more than speed. What your monthly cycle actually looks like: Using Ai based software 1. Pull the current member account list (currently 12 active accounts) from our internal tracking sheet. 2. For each account, review the payment history and current utilization to d ---------- whether a balance should be reported that cycle — this requires real judgment, not a fixed rule. 3. Prepare the CSV report formatted correctly for each bureau (Experian, CreditSafe, and Equifax each have their own format). 4. Upload each CSV to its bureau portal. 5. For any account with a reported balance change, generate a matching invoice in our invoicing system so our records stay audit-ready. 6. Log what was reported, to which bureau, and why, in our monthly compliance log. 7. Flag anything unusual — a missed payment, an unexpected utilization spike — to Dee before it's reported. You'll be a strong fit if you: • Are genuinely comfortable with numbers — you can look at a balance and payment history and reason through a judgment call, not just follow a checklist. • Have basic bookkeeping or invoicing experience (QuickBooks, Wave, or similar). • Are reliable on a monthly deadline — this role has few hours, but they can't slip. • Can be trusted with sensitive financial data. • Bonus: any prior exposure to business credit bureaus or tradeline reporting. Pay: , part-time, 2 hours/week. Will increase as members subscribe to product.This role is replacing a departing team member, so a short training handoff will be provided.

title: T-shirt designer for POD

title: Remote Operations & Client Coordinator
description: Job Title: Remote Operations & Client Coordinator | Part-Time to Full-Time Job Description: NuePrint is a commercial printing, signage, apparel, and branded-products company based in the Chicago area. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Operations & Client Coordinator to help keep customer requests, quotes, orders, production, purchasing, follow-ups, and day-to-day communication moving. This is not a role where you will simply wait for someone to assign your next task. We have internal systems, an ERP, documented training materials, and automated workflows. We do not expect you to memorize every product, material, vendor, or process. We do expect you to know how to find answers, verify information, solve routine problems, and take ownership of work without continuous management supervision. Responsibilities: - Monitor and follow up on open customer requests. - Make sure customer questions, approvals, artwork, payments, and other pending items do not get forgotten. - Prepare and review quotes, orders, and invoices in our ERP. - Follow up on outstanding quotes, deposits, and invoices. - If you are unsure about a quote, invoice, or next step, follow up with the person who created it or the account owner before letting it sit. - Monitor customer deadlines and identify problems before they become urgent. - Keep Jira project and production statuses accurate. - Verify actual production status before reporting that a job is current, complete, or ready. - Source apparel, materials, and outsourced products from approved vendors. - When an item is unavailable, check other warehouses, backup suppliers, and reasonable alternatives before escalating. - Review vendor pricing and help keep ERP product and material costs current. - During slower periods, review stale pricing, open orders, unpaid invoices, customer follow-ups, Jira statuses, purchasing needs, and training materials. - Maintain accurate customer and order information. - Research products and vendor information using spreadsheets, vendor websites, internal systems, and company documentation. - Answer inbound customer and prospect phone calls through our company phone system. - Make outbound calls to customers, vendors, prospects, and account contacts when follow-up is needed. - Assist with sales follow-up and, over time, help with outbound prospecting and cold calling. - Communicate professionally and confidently by phone, email, and internal messaging. - Communicate clearly with customers, vendors, production staff, sales staff, and management. What Matters Most: Printing experience can be learned. What matters most is how you approach the work. We need someone who consistently: - Looks for the answer before asking. - Follows a customer issue through until it is resolved or clearly handed off. - Verifies information before saying something is complete, accurate, or current. - Checks alternatives when the first solution does not work. - Notices and manages deadlines without needing reminders. - Uses available downtime productively. Before escalating a routine issue, we expect you to check the available training materials, ERP, previous orders, vendor information, Jira, and other company resources first. When bringing a problem to management, you should be prepared to explain: - What is the problem? - What have you already checked? - What options did you find? - What do you recommend? Requirements: - Excellent written and spoken English. - Clear, professional phone communication skills. - Comfortable answering calls from U.S.-based customers and prospects. - Comfortable making outbound customer follow-up calls. - Willing and able to assist with cold calling and sales prospecting as the role develops. - Strong attention to detail. - Strong organizational and follow-up skills. - Ability to work independently without constant supervision. - Comfortable researching answers and learning new systems. - Experience in operations, customer service, order management, purchasing, project coordination, sales support, or a similar role. - Comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, email, PDFs, and web-based business software. - Comfortable working with ERP, CRM, project-management, and vendor-ordering systems. - Reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs, Microsoft applications, ERP systems, and VoIP phone software. - Reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for clear VoIP phone calls and regular online work. - Reliable headset or microphone setup for professional phone calls. - Ability to work consistently during agreed hours with overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours. Experience with ERP systems, Jira, printing, signage, apparel, promotional products, purchasing, cold calling, sales support, or U.S.-based customers is helpful but not required. Schedule: - This position begins part-time at approximately 20 hours per week. - The first 60 days are a training and evaluation period. - During this time, you will learn NuePrint's systems, procedures, products, vendors, workflow, and communication standards. - After successfully completing the training period and demonstrating that you can independently handle the responsibilities of the position, the role is expected to transition to full-time at approximately 40 hours per week. - The full-time transition is based on performance and is not automatic. Compensation: - $450-$550 USD per month during the initial 20-hour-per-week training period. - Starting compensation within the range will depend on experience, written and verbal communication, systems proficiency, customer-service experience, and demonstrated ability to work independently. - Compensation will increase if the position successfully transitions to full-time after the training period. How to Apply: Please include your resume and answer all of the following questions: - A customer needs an order Tuesday. You emailed them Thursday requesting missing information. It is now Friday morning and they have not responded. What do you do? - You are ordering apparel and your usual warehouse is out of one size. What do you do before contacting your manager? - Your manager asks whether all active projects in the project-management system are up to date. How would you verify that before answering? - You have completed everything assigned to you and still have several hours remaining in your workday. What do you do? - A potential customer calls asking for pricing, but you do not immediately know the answer. How would you handle the call? - Are you comfortable making outbound follow-up calls and eventually assisting with cold calling to potential business customers? Applications that do not answer all six questions will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper – QuickBooks Online
description: We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Part-Time Bookkeeper to join our team and support the bookkeeping and accounting needs of U.S.-based businesses. This is not simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands bookkeeping and accounting principles, can accurately determine how transactions should be classified, understands how a Chart of Accounts works, and knows when something does not look correct. The position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position for the right person. Responsibilities You will be responsible for tasks including: Maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online Reviewing and categorizing bank and credit card transactions Understanding and correctly applying the client's Chart of Accounts Identifying transactions that may be incorrectly classified Bank and credit card reconciliations Reviewing accounts for duplicate, missing, unusual, or incorrectly recorded transactions Accounts payable and accounts receivable support Understanding and processing payroll Reviewing payroll reports and payroll-related transactions Recording payroll entries correctly in QuickBooks Assisting with month-end bookkeeping and account review Preparing and reviewing basic financial reports, including: Profit & Loss Balance Sheet General Ledger Accounts Receivable Accounts Payable Maintaining organized financial documentation and supporting records Communicating questions, discrepancies, or missing information clearly to our team Following up on unresolved bookkeeping items instead of leaving them incomplete Required Qualifications You should have: Strong experience with QuickBooks Online A solid understanding of bookkeeping and basic accounting principles Strong understanding of Charts of Accounts Experience accurately categorizing and classifying transactions Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations Experience with payroll and an understanding of how payroll affects the books Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is strongly preferred Strong attention to detail Ability to identify when financial information does not make sense Ability to research an issue before asking for assistance Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines Strong written English communication skills Ability to communicate questions clearly and provide enough information for someone else to understand the issue Technology Skills Our team primarily works within the Microsoft ecosystem. You should be comfortable using: Microsoft Teams Microsoft Outlook Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft OneDrive / SharePoint PDF documents and PDF editing/organization tools Strong Excel skills are important. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, sorting and filtering information, using formulas, and reviewing financial data. Schedule This is a 20-hour-per-week position, Monday through Friday. You must be able to work during U.S. Central Time. We are flexible regarding the exact schedule. An earlier Central Time schedule or a later afternoon Central Time schedule can both work. We care more about establishing a consistent schedule, meeting deadlines, and being available to communicate with our team when necessary. The schedule can be discussed and finalized with the selected candidate. Compensation $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience and qualifications. Candidates with significant U.S. bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, and payroll experience may qualify toward the higher end of the range. There is an opportunity for increased compensation and transition to a full-time position based on performance, reliability, accuracy, and the growth of the role. What We Are Looking For Accuracy is extremely important in this role. We want someone who does more than simply categorize transactions based on what QuickBooks suggests. You should be able to look at the transaction, understand the business activity, understand the Chart of Accounts, and determine whether the accounting treatment makes sense. If you are unsure, we expect you to ask. We would rather have a clearly documented question than an incorrect assumption. At the same time, we value people who are resourceful and will investigate an issue before immediately asking someone else for the answer. To Apply Please include the following: A brief introduction about yourself and your bookkeeping experience. How many years of QuickBooks Online experience you have. Whether you have worked with U.S.-based businesses. Your experience processing or reviewing payroll. Your experience working with Charts of Accounts. Your current availability in U.S. Central Time. title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description: We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team. In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved. Key Responsibilities Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone. Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask). Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed. Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies. Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings. Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives. Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards. Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid. Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive. Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required. Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms. Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout. Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions. Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools. Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones. Why Join Us? Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses. Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them. Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here. How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test) To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with: A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals. The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using. An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue. Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).

title: AI Implementation Specialist
description: About Tara Zaluski ( ---------- ) Tara Zaluski is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (USA) real estate investing business built and run under Tara's own personal brand at ---------- . We buy and renovate flips, hold a growing portfolio of multi-unit rental properties, and are actively pursuing the acquisition of an established trade business (HVAC) from a retiring owner. We run lean, and we believe AI should be doing far more of the repetitive, systems-level work across our business than it currently is. The Opportunity We're hiring a part-time, fully remote AI Implementation Specialist to find and build the AI-driven systems our business needs, across marketing, sales follow-up, bookkeeping, property management, and day-to-day operations, without waiting to be told what to build. You will be given context about how the business runs, and it will be on you to identify where AI and automation can save time and money, propose it, and implement it. This is not a task-execution role; it's an ownership role. If you need a detailed brief before you can act, or you wait for direction on what to build next, this is not the right role for you. If you naturally notice inefficiency and can't help but go build a fix for it, it is. What You'll Do • Scout and implement. Continuously identify new AI tools, agents, and workflows relevant to a real estate investing business, and bring working solutions, not just suggestions. • Lead generation & cold calling. Build and manage AI-assisted cold calling, texting, and lead follow-up systems that integrate with our CRM (Follow Up Boss). • Social media & marketing. Stand up AI-supported content creation, scheduling, and posting systems for our social platforms under our personal brand. • Bookkeeping & bill pay. Implement AI/automation for expense categorization, invoice handling, and bill-pay workflows, working alongside our bookkeeper rather than replacing her judgment. • Property management support. Build AI tools for tenant communication, maintenance triage, and reporting that make our property manager's job faster. • Deal evaluation. Support AI-assisted analysis for flip deals (targeting ~$100k profit), multi-unit acquisitions, and due diligence on a trade-company (HVAC) acquisition. • Systems & documentation. Document every workflow you build in clear SOPs so the team can use and maintain it without you. • Team enablement. Train and support existing team members (VA, bookkeeper, transaction coordinator, property manager) on new AI tools as you roll them out. • Reporting. Track and report the time, cost, or error savings each implementation produces. What We're Looking For • A track record of actually building AI/automation solutions in a business, not just using ChatGPT casually. You should be able to show us 2–3 concrete examples. • Strong self-direction, comfortable identifying opportunities and acting on them with minimal oversight. • Working knowledge of automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n), AI agent/GPT builders, and prompting for business use cases. • Comfortable learning CRM (Follow Up Boss), bookkeeping (Buildium), and social scheduling tools well enough to automate around them. • Excellent written English — this role is fully async and remote, so clear written communication matters as much as technical skill. • Based in the Philippines, able to overlap for live check-ins with a U.S. Eastern Time business. Nice to Have • Experience in or with U.S. real estate investing, property management, or a related trade/services business. • Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or multi-step automations end-to-end. • Background in cold-calling/lead-gen or digital marketing automation specifically. How to Apply Send: (1) your resume, (2) 2–3 specific examples of AI tools, agents, or automations you've built and the result they produced, and (3) a short note (200 words or less) describing one AI opportunity you'd tackle first if hired and why. Applications without concrete examples will not be considered.

We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the brand guidelines, content calendar, and asset library you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want someone who takes initiative to help build them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading. Responsibilities: • Design static creative for social, community channels, and campaigns — posts, banners, announcement cards, event graphics, presentation assets • Own the content calendar: plan it, keep it filled, and keep it shipping on schedule • Publish and monitor posts across our channels, and track how each one actually performs • Recognize what's working and bring that back into the next round of creative — not just produce volume • Report on performance in numbers, not impressions of impressions — you should be comfortable saying which post did what, and why • Maintain and extend our brand system — colors, type, templates, asset library — so the whole team can move faster • Use AI tools to sharpen your own well-considered concepts, not to generate work you haven't thought through • Keep organized, accessible files — versioned, named properly, findable by someone who isn't you • Escalate anything involving financial claims, promotions, or numbers to your Lead before it goes out — nothing about money publishes unreviewed • Follow team rules, protocols, and brand guidelines diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected • We believe every public post is a first impression for someone, and deserves your full presence and care What We're Looking For: Non-negotiables — read these carefully: • Real graphic design experience. Not "I've used Canva." You should have designed for a brand or client with an actual audience, and be able to walk us through your choices. • A social account you personally ran, with the numbers to show for it. This is the core of your portfolio. We want to see accounts you managed — the graphics you made for them, and the performance behind those posts: impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth over a stated period. Screenshots of your analytics are exactly what we're asking for. A portfolio of pretty graphics with no audience data attached will not get you through this stage. • Japanese market experience is highly preferred. If you've designed or run social for a Japanese brand, a Japan-facing account, or a JP audience — say so early and show it. This is the single biggest differentiator in this search. Also required: • Strong with Figma, Canva, or Adobe — whichever you use, you should be genuinely fluent in it • A body of work that shows range and taste — we care far more about what you've actually made than where you studied • High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges • Confident — you can explain why you made a design choice, and defend it or drop it without going quiet • Understands hierarchy — you know what you can ship yourself and what needs your Lead's eyes, and you act without being told • Conscientious — deadlines hold, files are clean, nothing gets published with a typo in it • Audience-minded — you can tell the difference between a post that looks nice and a post that works • Follows rules diligently — brand guidelines aren't suggestions • Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional, and able to write a caption that doesn't sound like a press release • Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a brief yourself, not just execute the literal request • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch • High discretion — you'll see campaign plans and product information before they're public • Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you): • JLPT N2/N1 or business-level Japanese — especially if you can review Japanese-language creative for tone, not just accuracy • Short-form video or motion graphics ability (Reels, TikTok, CapCut, After Effects) • Experience running paid social or reading analytics beyond surface-level metrics • Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products — and the visual language that comes with them • Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate • Meta Blueprint, HubSpot Marketing, or similar certification • Has grown an account from zero to a real audience • Illustration, 3D, or photography skills Reporting to: Growth Operations Lead and CMO Setup: • 100% WFH from day one • Flexible hours, output-based — you'll need meaningful overlap with Philippine business hours (JST business hours) for team syncs and reviews, but we're not counting the hours you spend at your desk • No time tracker • Deadlines are firm; how you get there is yours to manage • Team communication via Slack • BYOD — your own machine capable of running your design tools, plus stable fiber internet • Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you see any campaign or product information • Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle) • Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your work is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too • Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here • Internal growth and promotions for top performers To Apply: Start your message with the subject line: [Social + Design] – [Your Name] – [City] Then send the following. We read every response personally — take your time with these. 1. Your portfolio, which must include: The social account(s) you personally ran — handle or link, and what your actual role was (you ran it solo, you handled design only, you shared it with a team — just be honest) The numbers. Impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth, over a period you state clearly. Analytics screenshots are ideal. If an account was small, show it anyway — we'd rather see 3,000 real followers you grew than a vague claim about a big one. The graphics you made for those accounts — so we can connect the design work to the results it produced Any Japanese-market work, called out specifically If your best work is under NDA or on an account you no longer have access to, tell us what you can and show what you have. We're reasonable about this — we're not reasonable about people who skip the numbers entirely. 2. Answer all three questions: Pick your best-performing post and your worst-performing post from the same account. What was different about them? (Numbers, then your read on why.) If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us? Think of a time you were part of a startup, org, or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates? A note on AI: using it to help you write or ideate is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it, and we can tell when a portfolio piece was generated rather than made. Edit before you submit. Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, creative, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language. Applications without the correct subject line, a portfolio with performance numbers, and all three answers will not be reviewed.

description: Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC / Meta Ads We are looking for a Creative Strategist & Video Editor to become a key part of our DTC e-commerce operation. We are currently doing 5 figures in daily revenue and our goal is to scale toward $100,000+ per day. Creative is one of the most important parts of our growth, and we are looking for someone who can eventually take significant ownership of the creative side of the brand. This is NOT just a video editing position. We need someone who understands Meta Ads, direct-response marketing, creative strategy, customer psychology and performance creative — while also being able to execute and edit high-quality video ads. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your job will be to help us produce, analyze and continuously improve performance creatives for Meta. You will: Develop and execute new Meta ad creatives Study our winning ads and understand why they are working Build new iterations and executions from proven winning concepts Develop new hooks, openings, scripts and variations Edit high-performing direct-response video ads Create UGC-style ads, VSLs, advertorial-style ads and other performance formats Research competitors and the market to identify new opportunities Understand our customer, their problems, desires and buying motivations Analyze creative performance and use the data to d ---------- what should be created next Identify creative fatigue and produce new iterations before winners stop performing Work with Meta Ads performance data rather than creating based purely on personal preference Continuously test new ideas while scaling what already works As you prove yourself, the goal is for you to take more and more ownership of the brand's creative strategy and production. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You should have a strong understanding of: Meta Ads DTC e-commerce Direct-response marketing Creative strategy Video editing Hooks and angles Customer psychology UGC advertising VSLs Creative testing Creative iteration Competitor and market research Performance metrics Scaling creatives as ad spend increases You should understand that a good-looking video is not necessarily a good ad. We care about performance. You should be able to look at an existing winning ad, understand the underlying message, angle, psychology and structure, and use those learnings to create new ads that can potentially outperform it. IMPORTANT – 2 TEST VIDEO ADS REQUIRED Please read this before applying. The first step of our hiring process is creating 2 test video ads for our brand. We are NOT asking you to figure everything out from zero. We will give you our winning ads and show you the concepts, messaging and angles that are currently working for us. From there, we want you to study the winners, understand why they work, and show us what you can create from that information. Your task will be to create 2 complete video ads that you believe could perform on Meta. You can use our winning ads as inspiration and direction, but we do not want simple copies. We want to see whether you can take something that is already proven and create new hooks, iterations, executions and ideas around the winning message. We will evaluate: Your understanding of our winning ads Your creative strategy Your hooks Your ability to build on proven concepts Your direct-response thinking Your video editing Your pacing and storytelling Your understanding of Meta advertising Your ability to create something that could realistically become another winning ad PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU WON'T DO THE TEST We want to be very clear about this. If you are not willing to create the 2 test video ads, please do not apply. If you only send us a CV, generic cover letter or portfolio and are unwilling to complete the test, we will not move forward with your application. We are looking for serious candidates who are willing to show us what they can actually do. WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE TEST? If we like your 2 test ads, we will invite you to an interview. During the interview, we will discuss: Your decisions behind the test creatives Why you chose your hooks and structure Your previous DTC experience Your Meta Ads knowledge How you analyze winners and losers How you would approach creative testing at higher spend How you could help us build and improve our creative operation The strongest candidate will have the opportunity to join us full-time and long-term. THE OPPORTUNITY We are not looking for someone to edit a few videos and disappear. We want someone who can become an important part of the company as we scale from 5 figures/day toward $100,000+ in daily revenue. If you're good, there will be room for more responsibility, higher compensation and eventually significant ownership over the creative operation. We move fast, test aggressively and care about results. If you're a Creative Strategist who can also execute and edit, understand Meta performance marketing, and want to build alongside a rapidly growing DTC operation, we'd like to see what you can do. INVESTMENT IN YOUR GROWTH If you get accepted and join our team, we will pay for Evolve for you — a premium training program worth $2,000/month. We want you to continuously improve as a Creative Strategist and stay at the highest level of performance creative, Meta Ads and DTC marketing. We invest in people who perform. If you grow, we grow.

description: JOB OVERVIEW • Location: Remote • Contract Type: Independent Contractor • Position: Part-Time • Hours: 20 hours per week • Pay: $250 per month • Brand: Relationship Coaching • Time Zone: Availability to overlap with US working hours ABOUT THE ROLE I’m looking for a hands-on Content Strategist & Social Media Manager to help grow a relationship coaching brand focused on helping estranged parents and grandparents rebuild and strengthen relationships with their children and grandchildren. This is not simply a role where you will be given a list of posts to create each week. I need someone who can think strategically, understand the audience, research competitors, analyse content and performance, identify opportunities and take ownership of the process from research → strategy → content creation → scheduling → analytics → optimisation. You should be comfortable working independently, bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you believe certain content will work. THE MAIN GOAL The primary focus of this role is audience growth, reach and engagement. The goal is to build a strong and relevant audience around the brand, increase visibility and establish the brand as a trusted voice within the relationship coaching space. This means understanding what makes people stop scrolling, engage, share and follow, while ensuring the content remains relevant to the people the brand is trying to reach. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Strategy & Research • Research the target audience, including their questions, problems, emotions, concerns and interests. • Research competitors and successful creators in the relationship coaching and family/relationship space. • Analyse existing content and identify what is working, what isn’t and why. • Develop and maintain content pillars, themes and a platform-specific strategy. • Identify content gaps, trends and opportunities. • Use audience response and analytics to continually improve the strategy. Content Creation • Develop content ideas, angles and hooks. • Create engaging short-form and other social media content. • Write captions, titles, descriptions and CTAs. • Adapt content to the brand’s voice and different platforms. • Edit short-form and other video content. • Create social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails. • Repurpose existing content into new formats. • Develop different creative angles around topics that are already performing well. AI can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must have genuine human judgement, creativity and personality. Planning & Publishing • Build and manage the content calendar. • Schedule and publish content across relevant platforms. • Ensure content, captions, CTAs, links and formatting are correct. • Keep the content workflow organised and ahead of schedule. Analytics & Growth • Monitor views, reach, watch time, retention, engagement, saves, shares, comments, follower growth and other relevant metrics. • Identify patterns in what is performing well and use those insights to double down on successful topics, formats and content approaches. • Identify high-performing content and develop new angles, variations and repurposing opportunities. • Test different hooks, topics, formats, CTAs and content approaches to understand what resonates best. • Use analytics and audience response to continually refine and improve the content strategy. • Recommend what should be created more of, changed or stopped. Community • Monitor and respond to comments and basic messages. • Encourage meaningful audience interaction and conversation. • Identify audience questions and recurring themes that could become future content. • Escalate anything requiring the owner’s input. WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR • Experience in content strategy and social media management, preferably for a personal brand, creator, coach, educator or similar business. • Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. • Strong understanding of audience and competitor research. • Strong content creation and copywriting skills. • Ability to create engaging content that feels natural and authentic to the brand. • Ability to analyse content performance and turn data into action. • Strong video editing skills. • Strong graphic design skills, including creating social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails. • Understanding of SEO/keyword research for social media and YouTube. • Able to work independently and take ownership. • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines. AI & ORIGINALITY Please read this carefully before applying. AI tools can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must demonstrate your own creativity, judgement and understanding of the audience and brand. I’m looking for someone who can take an idea, develop it, add their own perspective and create content that feels natural, engaging and authentic, rather than generic or formulaic. If you rely heavily on AI to produce your content without adding meaningful human input, this role will not be the right fit for you. APPLICATION & SELECTION PROCESS Please note that shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical trial before a hiring decision is made. The trial will give you the opportunity to demonstrate your ability to think strategically, understand an audience, develop content ideas and create content. HOW TO APPLY Please answer these 4 questions in your application: 1. Please share social media accounts that you’ve personally worked on or managed and briefly explain your role and what you were responsible for. 2. Please share links to examples of content you have personally created, particularly hooks, captions, videos or other social media content. 3. Imagine you are taking over the social media for a personal brand you’ve never worked with before. What would you want to understand first before creating or recommending content? 4. What tools do you currently use for content creation, scheduling, analytics, SEO/keyword research and video editing? Please make sure your answers are your own and give us a genuine understanding of your experience and approach.

title: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist
job_title: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist
description: About the Role I’m looking for a highly experienced Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist to join my content creation business on a full-time, long-term basis. I am a medical doctor and content creator producing educational, skincare, beauty and lifestyle content across TikTok and Instagram. This is not a junior editing role. I am looking for someone with significant professional short-form editing experience, exceptional creative judgement and a strong understanding of what drives performance across TikTok, Instagram and the wider social media landscape. The role combines senior-level short-form video editing, creative direction, content ideation and social media trend awareness. A core part of this position will be proactively helping to develop and evolve the editing style of the content. The successful candidate should not simply replicate the existing editing style. They should continuously assess how short-form content is changing and use those insights to introduce new editing techniques, formats and creative approaches that make the content more dynamic, current and engaging. The role also includes proactive content ideation. I am looking for someone who is genuinely immersed in social media and naturally identifies emerging audios, trends, formats, memes, conversations and cultural moments that could be developed into relevant content ideas. This is a permanent, full-time position within a fast-paced content business where daily posting is a core priority. Reliability, flexibility, creative initiative, responsiveness and consistently meeting deadlines are essential. Core Responsibilities Senior Short-Form Editing & Creative Direction * Edit high-performing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, across both organic content and paid brand partnerships * Optimise content for viewer retention, watch time, engagement and overall platform performance * Use strong creative judgement to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure, storytelling and overall execution * Proactively identify opportunities within content to improve performance rather than relying on detailed instructions for every creative decision * Understand the differences between what performs on TikTok and Instagram and adapt editing styles, pacing, formats and creative choices accordingly * Identify opportunities to strengthen content through relevant visual assets, memes, cultural references, trends, audio and platform-native creative techniques * Maintain an exceptionally high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail * Take ownership of edits from raw footage through to final approval Evolving the Editing Style A major responsibility of this role is to actively help shape and evolve the creative editing direction of the content. The successful candidate will be expected to: * Continuously assess how high-performing short-form content is evolving across TikTok and Instagram * Proactively introduce new editing styles, techniques and creative approaches that can make the content more dynamic and engaging * Identify elements of the existing editing style that could be refreshed, improved or replaced * Suggest and experiment with new approaches to hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, text treatments, graphics, audio and overall content structure * Recognise emerging editing trends early and assess whether they are genuinely relevant to the creator’s content and audience * Help ensure the content remains current, competitive and platform-native, rather than relying on an editing formula that becomes dated over time * Balance creative evolution with consistency so that the content continues to feel recognisably aligned with the creator’s personal brand The expectation is not simply to follow an established editing template. The editor should bring the experience and creative judgement required to help determine what the editing style should become next. Content Ideation & Trend Spotting This role extends beyond editing and includes an important content ideation component. The successful candidate will be expected to: * Proactively bring forward content ideas rather than waiting solely for content to be assigned * Regularly identify trending audios, formats, memes, conversations, cultural moments and emerging social media trends that could be relevant to the creator’s content * Suggest specific ways those trends could be adapted into original TikTok or Instagram content * Identify emerging or high-performing content formats and suggest how they could be applied to educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle or personality-led content * Bring forward ideas for new hooks, video structures, recurring formats and creative concepts * Proactively share useful creative references and examples * Understand the difference between blindly following a trend and identifying trends that can be adapted naturally and strategically to the creator’s audience and personal brand * Remain sufficiently immersed in TikTok, Instagram and wider social media culture to identify opportunities while they are relevant, rather than once a trend has already passed For example, if an audio, meme or format begins trending and there is a strong way to adapt it to the creator’s content, the expectation is that the editor would identify that opportunity and proactively suggest the content idea. Picture Carousels & Canva * Create high-quality picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram using Canva * Turn supplied copy, information and concepts into polished, engaging and platform-appropriate carousel content * Contribute creative ideas around carousel formats, layouts, hooks and visual treatments * Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity * Source relevant imagery, graphics, screenshots and visual references where required * Keep up to date with evolving carousel styles and formats across TikTok and Instagram * Help evolve carousel design alongside the broader creative direction of the social channels Paid Brand Partnerships * Edit paid brand partnerships to a consistently high standard while maintaining the creator’s organic content style * Understand and accurately execute campaign briefs and brand requirements * Balance mandatory brand messaging with the need for content to remain engaging and native to the platform * Identify creative ways to integrate brand requirements without making the content feel unnecessarily commercial * Handle brand revisions accurately and efficiently Seniority & Experience This is explicitly a senior-level position. Applicants should have significant professional experience editing short-form social media content and be able to demonstrate a strong portfolio of high-quality work. The successful candidate must already have the technical foundations expected of an experienced professional editor. This role is focused on a higher level of contribution: creative judgement, strategic thinking, platform knowledge, content performance, creative direction and proactive ideation. Applicants should be able to demonstrate: * Significant professional short-form video editing experience * A strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable vertical content * Experience editing content designed to achieve strong social media performance * Advanced proficiency in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro * Strong proficiency in Canva * Excellent knowledge of TikTok and Instagram * A sophisticated understanding of viewer psychology, retention, hooks and short-form storytelling * Strong awareness of social media culture, emerging trends and platform behaviour * The ability to distinguish between a fleeting trend and a genuinely valuable creative opportunity * Strong independent creative judgement * The confidence to suggest improvements or challenge an existing creative approach where appropriate * The ability to take ownership of an edit without requiring detailed step-by-step direction * Strong English comprehension and excellent attention to detail * Clear and proactive communication * Strong organisation and time-management skills * The ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving content environment What I’m Looking For The ideal editor is someone who: * Takes genuine pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work * Is highly experienced and confident in their creative judgement * Understands what makes content perform across both TikTok and Instagram and can adapt editing styles, pacing and formats accordingly * Understands the psychology behind high-performing short-form content * Knows how to strengthen hooks and improve viewer retention through editing * Can identify moments where pacing, captions, visuals, memes, cultural references or structure can be improved to maximise performance * Keeps up to date with TikTok and Instagram trends, formats, platform updates and changes in audience behaviour * Understands how to incorporate relevant trends naturally into content where appropriate to maximise engagement and performance * Proactively helps evolve the editing style rather than simply reproducing the existing one * Is excited by the opportunity to develop new and more dynamic creative approaches as social media evolves * Regularly brings forward content ideas, trending audios, formats and creative references without needing to be asked * Thinks beyond the individual edit and contributes to the broader creative direction and performance of the content * Can follow a creator’s style while also bringing strong creative ideas and suggestions * Understands when innovation will strengthen a piece of content and when a simpler approach is more effective * Learns from feedback and consistently applies it to future work * Communicates clearly and proactively * Is highly dependable and consistent * Takes ownership of deliverables and deadlines * Does not need to be repeatedly chased or micromanaged * Is comfortable operating at the pace required by a creator publishing content daily This role supports a creator who is looking to post daily content. Reliability and meeting deadlines are therefore essential. Turnaround Expectations This is a fast-paced full-time role, and applicants must be comfortable working to consistently short turnaround times. First Draft Turnaround Once raw footage has been received, a fully edited first draft must be delivered within approximately 4–6 hours, depending on the length and complexity of the video. For particularly complex or editing-intensive videos, turnaround may extend to up to 12 hours. The expectation is that newly received footage is prioritised and editing begins promptly. This is not a role operating on a traditional freelance editing turnaround of 24–48 hours. Applicants should only apply if they are genuinely comfortable maintaining this level of turnaround consistently. Revisions * Straightforward revisions must be actioned urgently upon receipt of feedback * More substantial revisions must also be prioritised and completed as quickly as possible * The editor must remain highly responsive to feedback and revision requests * Previous feedback must be retained and applied to future edits to minimise unnecessary repeat revision rounds Flexibility & Availability This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. There are no fixed or pre-agreed daily working hours. Instead, the successful candidate must be flexible around the requirements of a fast-moving content schedule. * The successful candidate must have the flexibility to adapt their working pattern around when footage, feedback and content requirements arise * Capacity to edit content consistently throughout the week is essential * Weekend availability is a non-negotiable requirement of the role * Urgent edits may occasionally require a faster turnaround * The editor must be highly responsive and able to adapt where necessary to meet content and campaign deadlines * Any known periods of unavailability must be communicated in advance Communication, Reliability & Ownership The successful candidate must: * Communicate clearly and proactively * Be highly responsive to new content, feedback and changing priorities * Keep the creator/team updated on the status of edits where necessary * Flag potential issues or delays before they affect a deadline * Take ownership of assigned work rather than requiring repeated follow-up * Manage priorities independently * Maintain high standards even when working to fast turnaround times * Be dependable and consistent Typical Deliverables Typical workload includes: * Approximately 7 short-form videos per week * Picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram as required * A mix of organic content and paid brand partnerships * Videos generally between 30–90 seconds * Revisions and alternative versions where required * Proactive content ideas, trend recommendations and creative references Workload may fluctuate depending on the content calendar, brand campaigns and wider business requirements. Confidentiality & Content Ownership The editor may have access to unreleased content, brand campaign information and other confidential business material. All footage, content, campaign materials and other confidential information must be treated accordingly and may not be shared, uploaded or repurposed externally without permission. All final content, project files and creative assets produced as part of the role will remain the property of the business. Role Details Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist Employment: Full-time, permanent / long-term Location: Remote Hours: Full-time with flexible working hours based around content requirements and deadlines Weekend availability: Required and non-negotiable Start Date: As soon as possible Application Requirements Please include: * A portfolio of short-form content within the following niches ONLY skincare, beauty, Haircare lifestyle * At least 7–10 examples of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable short-form content that you have personally edited * Examples that demonstrate a range of editing styles, formats and creative approaches where possible * Examples of TikTok or Instagram picture carousels you have created Please *only* apply if you have experience editing high-performing short-form content within the above niches, are comfortable contributing proactively to content ideation and creative direction, and can consistently work to the fast turnaround times outlined above. Applications will be immediately disqualified if you are unable to demonstrate previous video editing experience within the beauty/skincare/haircare/lifestyle niche

title: Influencer Outreach VA - Dutch Food & Kitchen Creators (Instagram + Email, Pay Per Message)
job_title: Influencer Outreach VA - Dutch Food & Kitchen Creators (Instagram + Email, Pay Per Message)
description: ABOUT US We are No Layer Kitchen, a Dutch kitchenware brand. We make titanium cutting boards - a replacement for plastic and wooden boards that does not scratch into your food, does not soak up bacteria, and lasts a lifetime. Our customers are people in the Netherlands who cook almost every day and care about what ends up in their food. We grow by getting our boards into the hands of real Dutch home cooks and food creators, not by shouting at strangers with ads. That is your job. THE ROLE IN ONE LINE Find the right Dutch food and kitchen creators on Instagram, send each one a short, genuinely personal Dutch message offering a free titanium cutting board, and keep a simple record of everyone you contacted. Personal beats perfect. One real message to the right person is worth fifty copy-pasted ones. That is the whole philosophy of this job and it is exactly how we score your work. IMPORTANT - ABOUT THE DUTCH LANGUAGE You do NOT need to speak Dutch. We give you a complete Dutch message system: a fixed message template, plus a library of ready-made Dutch opening lines sorted by situation (a recipe they posted, a dish, their kitchen, their kids, a holiday). Your job is to pick the right building block for that specific creator and fill in the real detail you saw on their account. You will be trained on this in your first week. If you can follow a system carefully and pay attention to detail, you can do this job without a word of Dutch. What you DO need is good written English, because that is how you and I will talk to each other every day. WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO, EVERY DAY 1. FIND CREATORS Search Instagram by Dutch hashtag and keyword. Starting terms we use: koken, recept, receptvandedag, foodbloggernl, kokenmetliefde, gezondkoken, mealprepnl, foodienl, keukeninspiratie, hollandsepot, avondeten, watetenwevandaag, bakkenmetliefde. Like and save relevant posts so the algorithm keeps feeding you the right accounts. We also give you access to a creator search tool. 2. CHECK EVERY ACCOUNT AGAINST THE CHECKLIST Six points, below. If one fails, you skip the account and move on. No exceptions. This protects our account and your time. 3. SEND THE MESSAGE Instagram DM using our Dutch system, about 2 minutes per message. If the creator has a business email in their bio, you send the email version instead - those get read more often and are worth more to us. 4. RUN THE FOLLOW-UPS Up to 3 follow-ups per creator, spaced out, each one adding something new. Then you stop, politely. A closed door is better than a burnt bridge. We give you the exact follow-up messages. 5. LOG EVERYTHING A simple sheet: ---------- date contacted, channel (DM or email), follow-up stage, replied yes/no, outcome. 6. HAND OVER THE WARM ONES As soon as someone replies with interest, you send them our Dutch brand PDF and pass the account to me so I can ship the board. THE CHECKLIST - EVERY ACCOUNT MUST PASS ALL SIX 1. FOLLOWERS - between 1,000 and 50,000. Not below 1k, not above 50k. 2. LOCATION - based in the Netherlands and clearly posting to a Dutch audience. You can tell from Dutch captions, Dutch place names, and prices in euros. Belgium (Flemish) also counts. 3. ACTIVE STORIES - they have a story up right now, or they post stories regularly. 4. ACTIVE POSTS - they post almost daily. Their most recent post is no older than 2 to 3 days. 5. REAL ENGAGEMENT - a quick eye test, no maths needed. Likes and comments should look right for the follower count, and the comments should look like real people, not bots or single emojis. 6. THEY ACTUALLY COOK ON CAMERA - the account shows real cooking, real food prep, a real kitchen. They need to be able to show a cutting board in use. A food photography account that never shows the cooking does not pass. THE KIND OF ACCOUNTS WE WANT Go broad across all of these: - Dutch recipe and home cooking accounts (our core) - Meal prep and healthy eating accounts - Dutch mum and family accounts where cooking is a real part of the content - Kitchen and interior accounts where the kitchen is the focus - BBQ, grilling and butchery accounts - Bakers, if they also do savoury cooking THE MESSAGE - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THE JOB Creators get dozens of identical "hi, we love your content!" messages every week and ignore every single one. The only thing that works is proving you actually looked at their account. Every message must open with one specific, real detail about them, their cooking, or their kitchen. That one line is the difference between a real message and a bot. THE FOUR PARTS OF EVERY MESSAGE 1. A unique, specific opening line about their account. Always. Never skip it. 2. Who we are - one warm sentence. 3. The offer - a free titanium cutting board, no obligation to post. 4. A soft, low-pressure question to reply. GOOD OPENINGS - specific, clearly real - "Die ovenschotel met prei die je gisteren postte staat vanavond bij ons op tafel." - "Je keuken met dat groene tegelwerk is echt prachtig." - "Ik zag dat je bijna elke week iets met vis doet - daar zijn er te weinig van." BAD OPENINGS - generic, sounds like a bot - "Hoi, we vinden je content geweldig!" - "Je recepten zien er heerlijk uit, zin in een samenwerking?" If a message could have been sent to anyone, it is wrong. This is a quick scan, not deep research. You have about 2 minutes per message. Open the account, glance at the last few posts, grab one real detail, pick the matching Dutch building block, fill it in. Being quick is fine. Skipping the personal detail is not. KPIs - HOW YOUR WORK IS MEASURED We measure three things: volume, quality and outcomes. Volume on its own is worth nothing to us. A generic blast does not get paid and it hurts our account. DAILY - Qualified contacts sent: 150 target, 120 minimum (roughly 130 Instagram DMs + 20 emails) - Pace: about 30 per hour, around 2 minutes each - Working hours: 5 to 6 hours - Personal opening line present: 100 percent, always - Checklist compliance: 100 percent, always WEEKLY - Qualified contacts sent: 750 target, 600 minimum - Follow-ups sent on schedule: 100 percent of accounts that are due - Tracker updated: every day - One short summary message to me: every Friday MONTHLY - Qualified contacts sent: 3,000 target, 2,400 minimum (about 22 working days) - Reply rate: 8 percent target (roughly 240 replies), 6 percent minimum. This is our main quality signal - generic messages destroy it - Interested creators handed to me: 90 target, 60 minimum - Duplicate or off-checklist messages: zero. No tolerance, this risks our account - Spam flags or account restrictions: zero. No tolerance MONTH 1 IS A RAMP MONTH We expect roughly 60 percent of these numbers in your first month while you learn the niche and the Dutch system. We review together on day 14 and day 30. WEEKLY QUALITY AUDIT Every week I check 20 random messages from your log. Each one must have a genuinely personal opening line tied to that specific account. Messages that fail the audit do not count toward your paid total. PAY This is a performance-based role. There is no fixed monthly salary. You are paid for the work you actually produce and you control your own volume. - $0.10 per qualified Instagram DM - $0.15 per qualified email (these take longer and convert better) - +$50 monthly bonus if you hit 3,000 contacts AND an 8 percent reply rate - +$50 monthly bonus if you hand over 90 or more interested creators - $1.00 for every creator who receives a board and actually posts about it WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE - Part-time, around 75 per day: roughly 1,650 a month, about $180 to $230 - Full pace, around 150 per day: roughly 3,300 a month, about $450 to $520 - Strong performer with a high reply rate: $520 and up Paid twice a month, on the 1st and the 16th, via Wise or PayPal, based on your logged and audited contact count. LONGER TERM If you perform for three months straight, we move you onto a fixed monthly retainer plus bonus, and we grow the role into managing creator relationships from start to finish - onboarding, discount codes, and tracking which creators actually drive sales. WHAT WE PROVIDE - Access to the No Layer Kitchen Instagram account - A VPN set to a Dutch location, which must be on before you ever open the account. This is not optional - Access to a creator search tool - The complete Dutch message system: template, opening line library, follow-up sequence - The Dutch brand PDF to send to interested creators - The tracker template - A 60 minute onboarding call, then a short weekly check-in WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Strong written English. You and I communicate in English every day. - Careful and detail-oriented. The checklist and the log are the job. I would much rather have 120 real messages than 200 fake ones. - Genuinely interested in food and cooking. You will be looking at food content for hours. If that sounds enjoyable rather than boring, this is a good fit. - Self-managing. You set your own hours. Nobody watches your screen. - Reliable internet and a working laptop or desktop. Instagram outreach or influencer marketing experience is a plus, not a requirement. We train you. WHO THIS IS NOT FOR - Anyone planning to copy-paste one message to hundreds of accounts. We audit for it and it does not get paid. - Anyone who needs a guaranteed fixed salary from day one. This role pays for output. - Anyone uncomfortable using a VPN or a shared spreadsheet. HARD RULES - Never open Instagram without the Dutch VPN on. - Never contact an account that fails any checklist point. - Never send the brand PDF in a first cold message. Only after they reply with interest. - Never make health claims. We sell a better cutting board. We do not cure anything. - Never promise a specific commission amount in the first message. That is what the brand PDF is for. - Never contact the same account twice, and never send the exact same wording twice in a row. HOW TO APPLY Send a message with the subject line: NOLAYER - [your first name] Include: 1. A short intro. Who you are, and whether you cook. 2. THE TEST TASK. Go to Instagram and find TWO Dutch food or cooking accounts that pass all six checklist points. For each one, send me: - ---------- and their follower count - one sentence in English describing the specific detail you would build the opening line around - one sentence on why they pass the checklist 3. Your realistic daily capacity and the hours you would work. 4. Whether you can receive payment through Wise or PayPal. Applications without the test task will not be read. It takes about 15 minutes and it is the only thing I actually score. I reply to every applicant who completes it, within 3 working days.
