description: *** PRIOR MEDICAL OR PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED *** Applications without it will not be read. See "REQUIRED BACKGROUND" below. US personal injury law firm hiring ONE full-time Client Intake Specialist & Case Manager. This is a long-term, career position - not a short project. WHO WE ARE Big Bubba Injury Law is a personal injury law firm in West Virginia, USA. We represent people who were hurt in car crashes. We do not charge our clients anything up front - we only get paid when we win. Our clients are ordinary working people, and many of them are scared, in pain, and have never spoken to a lawyer before. =========================================== REQUIRED BACKGROUND - READ THIS FIRST =========================================== You must have real, verifiable experience in ONE of the following. This is not negotiable and it is not a "nice to have." MEDICAL: - Nurse, nursing graduate, or medical assistant - Medical records, medical billing, or medical coding - Health insurance claims processing or utilization review - Medical transcription or medical scribe work - Medical VA work for a US clinic, hospital, or provider OR PERSONAL INJURY / LEGAL: - Intake, case management, or paralegal work for a US personal injury law firm - Demand package preparation, medical records summarization, or lien resolution - Auto insurance claims handling or bodily injury adjusting - Legal VA work for a US plaintiff-side firm You will be reading medical records every single day. You need to already know what an MRI report says, what a chiropractor's SOAP note looks like, what "MMI" means, and why a 30-day gap in treatment matters. We will train you on our systems and our law. We will not train you on medicine. In your application, state exactly where you got this experience, how long, and what you handled. Vague claims will be rejected. =========================================== THE ROLE You are the voice of this firm. An AI answering service takes the first call and passes qualified callers to you. From that moment, you own the client. Two jobs in one: 1. INTAKE AND CLOSING (the first hour of the case) - Take the handoff from our answering service and call the injured person immediately - Build trust fast, get the facts of the crash and their injuries, and confirm we can help - CLOSE. Persuade them to hire us, send the e-signature link, and stay on them until it is signed. Most people call more than one law firm. The firm that answers with a real human who cares is the firm that gets hired. That is you. - Follow up relentlessly on unsigned links - same day, next day, day three 2. CASE MANAGEMENT (the next 6-12 months) - Be the client's single point of contact for the life of their case - Weekly calls while they are actively treating; biweekly at every other stage. We do not let clients wonder what is happening. - Collect, review, and organize medical records and bills as treatment progresses - Track the client's treatment trajectory and flag gaps, pre-existing conditions, and missing providers - Chase down records from doctors' offices, hospitals, and imaging centers - Coordinate with insurance adjusters within the scope the attorney sets - Keep every case file complete and current in our case management software - Prepare the file for the attorney at each stage You are not giving legal advice. The attorney makes every legal decision. You run the relationship and the file. ALSO REQUIRED - NEUTRAL, EASILY UNDERSTOOD AMERICAN ENGLISH ON THE PHONE. This is a hard requirement. Our clients are in rural West Virginia. Many are elderly, many are in pain, and many will hang up if they have to ask you to repeat yourself. You must be understood effortlessly on the first call. Excellent written English as well - you will be sending client emails and texts under our firm's name. - Real experience persuading people on the phone. Sales, appointment setting, closing, retention, collections, or high-end customer service. Tell us specifically what you sold or closed and what your numbers were. - Full-time availability on US Eastern Time, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM ET (9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a night shift in the Philippines. Do not apply if you cannot commit to it long term. - Reliable computer, noise-free work environment, headset, and backup internet AND backup power. Our clients cannot hear roosters, tricycles, or family in the background. - Empathy that is real. You will talk to people on the worst week of their life. If you cannot sit with someone who is crying and still get the information we need, this is not your job. - Organized to the point of being obsessive. You will be managing 30-60 open cases at once. BONUS - Both medical AND personal injury experience - Experience with case management software (Filevine, Litify, Smart Advocate, Clio, CasePeer, or similar) - Experience with US health insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or ERISA subrogation WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive salary paid twice monthly, on time, every time - 13th month pay - Paid US holidays after 90 days - Performance bonus tied to signed clients after 90 days - Direct daily work with the firm's owner-attorney. No layers, no bureaucracy. - Genuine growth. You are our first hire. As we grow, you lead the team. - Full training on our systems and our process HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step will be deleted unread) 1. Put the word CHARLESTON in the first line of your application. This is how we know you read the post. 2. State your medical or personal injury experience in specific detail: employer, dates, and exactly what you handled. 3. Record a 90-second audio or video clip (Loom, Google Drive, or Vocaroo link) in which you: a. Introduce yourself and say why you want this job b. Then role-play this: you are calling Mary, 62 years old, rear-ended three days ago, neck and lower back pain, has not seen a doctor yet, and she is nervous about hiring a lawyer because she thinks it costs money. Get her comfortable, get her to see a doctor, and get her to say yes to signing with us. Improvise. We are listening to your voice, your warmth, and your ability to close. 4. In writing, tell us: - Your experience persuading people by phone, with specific numbers - Your exact home internet speed and whether you have backup internet and backup power - Confirm in one sentence that you can work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine Time long term - Your expected monthly salary in USD We read every application that follows these instructions. We hire one person and we intend to keep them for years.

title: Senior SEO & AI Search Strategist (SEO/GEO)
description: Senior SEO & AI Search Strategist (SEO/GEO) Full-Time | Remote | Philippines JAR Consulting Group is a U.S.-based digital marketing and technology company looking for an exceptionally strong SEO and AI Search/GEO professional. Please read this entire posting before applying. This is NOT an entry-level or intermediate SEO position. We are not looking for someone who has simply used SEO tools, optimized WordPress pages, generated AI content, or recently started calling themselves a GEO expert. We are looking for someone who can prove that their work has produced measurable organic search results and who has a sophisticated understanding of how search is evolving across Google, AI search engines, and large language models. Our goal for our clients is straightforward: Get them found, mentioned, cited, and recommended wherever their prospective customers search—including Google and AI platforms. What Makes This Position Different JAR is building a new SEO/GEO operating model combining: Human expertise + first-party expert content + AI agents + automation + measurable search data. We produce substantial original content through client interviews, podcasts, livestreams, videos, transcripts, articles, FAQs, and short-form content. We are also building AI agents to automate repetitive SEO/GEO activities, analyze websites and data, identify opportunities, assist with content optimization, monitor performance, and eventually execute approved website changes. We are not hiring someone to spend 40 hours per week performing repetitive SEO tasks that software and AI can perform. We need someone capable of thinking, analyzing, developing strategy, validating AI output, identifying opportunities, and determining what needs to happen next. NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS Please DO NOT APPLY unless you meet these requirements. 1. Minimum 3 Years of Advanced SEO Experience You must have at least three years of hands-on responsibility for SEO campaigns where you personally influenced measurable results. We are not interested solely in years of employment. We want evidence of results. 2. You Must Provide Proof of Your Work Your application must include at least three examples of websites or campaigns you personally worked on. For each example, explain: Website/business Your specific responsibilities Starting situation Strategy you implemented Time period Organic traffic improvement Ranking/visibility improvement Leads/conversions when available Tools/data used to measure the results What YOU personally did versus what the rest of the team did Provide supporting evidence wherever possible, including screenshots from Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, or other legitimate platforms. If confidentiality prevents you from showing any evidence whatsoever of previous results, you must find a way to prove you have the experience. If you cannot prove real results, do not apply. **We respect legitimate client confidentiality. You may redact names or sensitive information where necessary. However, you must be able to demonstrate that you have actually produced measurable results. 3. Advanced Ahrefs Experience You should be highly proficient with Ahrefs, including: Site Explorer Site Audit Rank Tracker Keywords Explorer Competitive analysis Content gaps Backlink analysis Organic competitor research Identifying actionable opportunities from the data Simply having used Ahrefs does not qualify. 4. Strong Technical SEO Knowledge You must understand and be able to work in: Crawling and indexing Google Search Console Canonicals Robots.txt XML sitemaps Redirects 404s Internal linking architecture Site structure Core Web Vitals Duplicate/thin content Structured data/schema Entity relationships Local SEO fundamentals You should be capable of diagnosing a technical problem and clearly explaining what a developer needs to fix. 5. Strong Local SEO Experience Many JAR clients are established local and regional businesses. You must understand: Google Business Profiles Local organic search Local Pack/Maps visibility Location/service-area strategy Reviews and reputation signals Citations/listings Local competitive analysis BrightLocal or comparable platforms 6. REAL GEO / AI SEARCH Experience This is extremely important. We are not looking for someone who watched several GEO videos, read some articles, or asked ChatGPT how GEO works. We want someone actively working on AI search visibility. Experience with platforms such as Scrunch, Profound, Peec AI, Otterly, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or comparable AI visibility platforms is strongly preferred. You should understand concepts including: AI mentions AI citations AI recommendations Prompt tracking AI share of voice Citation/source analysis Entity authority Topic authority Brand/entity signals Content extraction and answerability How traditional SEO intersects with AI discovery How to determine WHY one business is being cited/recommended while another is not You must be able to discuss strategies you have actually implemented, not simply explain GEO theory. TECHNICAL & AUTOMATION CAPABILITY You do not need to be a software developer. However, our ideal candidate is technically comfortable. Strong candidates will have experience with some combination of: APIs Webhooks JSON JSON-LD HTML/CSS Basic JavaScript WordPress GoHighLevel Zapier Make n8n AI APIs LLM workflows AI agents Automated reporting/data pipelines Python or other programming experience is a significant plus but is not required. We have dedicated web development and AI automation resources. Your job is not necessarily to build everything yourself. Your job is to be sophisticated enough to work alongside technical resources and help determine what should be built. AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED You must already be using AI professionally. We expect familiarity with platforms such as: ChatGPT Claude Gemini You should understand how to use AI for research, analysis, content optimization, data interpretation, workflow improvement, and quality assurance. We are specifically interested in candidates who think: "How can we automate this?" rather than: "This is how I've always done SEO." At the same time, we do NOT want someone blindly trusting AI output. You must know how to validate it. WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO AT JAR Your role would increasingly focus on strategy, analysis, QA, and opportunity identification, while our automation systems handle more repetitive execution. Responsibilities will include: Analyze traditional SEO and AI-search performance Determine why clients are winning or losing visibility Analyze Ahrefs, Scrunch, BrightLocal, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and other data Identify organic and AI-search opportunities Conduct sophisticated competitive analysis Develop keyword, topic, entity and prompt strategies Analyze AI citations and sources Determine why competitors are being recommended by AI Identify content gaps Recommend podcast/interview topics based on search opportunities Review client transcripts and expert content for SEO/GEO opportunities Determine which existing website pages should be strengthened Develop internal-linking strategies Recommend appropriate structured data Monitor technical SEO health QA AI-agent recommendations Help improve SEO/GEO agents and automation workflows Coordinate technical implementations Work with content resources to turn client expertise into authoritative content Help improve our internal SEO/GEO methodology as search continues evolving COMPENSATION & BENEFITS This is a full-time, long-term position with JAR Consulting Group. Starting compensation: $10–$20 USD per hour, based on demonstrated experience, technical ability, and proven results. Eligible for pay raises at 6 months and 1 year after employment based on performance. We are willing to pay toward the top of that range for someone who can demonstrate that they truly have the experience and capabilities described in this posting. Benefits include: Paid time off Paid local Philippine holidays Company year-end bonus eligibility Weekly Pay Full-time, stable employment Long-term opportunity for advancement Direct access to company leadership Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals Significant opportunity to learn and work with AI agents, automation, GEO, and emerging search technologies We are building this position for the future. As your capabilities and responsibilities grow, there will be opportunities to grow with the company. WHY WORK WITH JAR? We understand that choosing the right company matters just as much as choosing the right employee. JAR is a U.S.-based company, but we have worked successfully with talented professionals in the Philippines and South America for years. Our Filipino team members are a vital part of our company—not simply outsourced 'VA' workers completing tasks. Regardless of where you live in this world, if you are on the JAR Team, you are a full and equal team member. We want talented people who are looking for a place where they can contribute ideas, develop professionally, learn new technologies, and build something long-term. We are investing heavily in AI, automation, SEO, GEO, website technology, content production, and our own internal systems. The person who joins us in this position will have an opportunity to help shape how those systems are built rather than simply being handed a checklist every day. We also want candidates to have the opportunity to evaluate us. For candidates who advance through our interview process, we will arrange an opportunity for you to speak directly with members of our existing Filipino team without company leadership on the call. You can ask them about: What it's actually like working at JAR How our U.S. leadership works with the Philippine team Company culture Communication Expectations Workload Growth opportunities Anything else you want to know before d ---------- whether JAR is the right place for you We want you to hear about the company directly from people in the Philippines who already work here. APPLICATION TEST We assume strong applicants know how to use AI. Therefore, polished writing alone will not impress us. We care about your thinking and your evidence. Answer the following questions in your application: Question 1 — Proven Results Provide your three strongest SEO case studies. Give us numbers. Show us evidence. Tell us exactly what you personally did. Question 2 — GEO Proof Describe a specific project where you attempted to increase a company's visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI results, Copilot, or another AI search experience. What did you do? What did you measure? What changed? If you have not actually done this yet, say so. Do not manufacture an answer. Question 3 — GEO Strategy A well-established roofing company ranks reasonably well on Google but is rarely mentioned when consumers ask AI: "Who are the best roofing contractors in [City]?" Walk us through exactly how you would investigate the problem and what you would do during the next 90 days. Be specific. Question 4 — AI Citation Analysis A client's competitor is repeatedly recommended and cited by AI systems while our client is not. How would you determine WHY? What data and sources would you examine? Question 5 — Automation Name three SEO/GEO tasks you believe should be automated with AI agents and three tasks you believe should remain human-led. Explain why. Question 6 — Technical SEO Give us the most difficult technical SEO problem you personally diagnosed. What was happening? How did you identify it? How was it fixed? What happened afterward? Question 7 — Your Tools Rate yourself 1–10 and state your years of hands-on experience with: Ahrefs Google Search Console GA4 BrightLocal Scrunch WordPress Schema/JSON-LD ChatGPT Claude Gemini APIs/automation Python/programming Do not give yourself a 10 unless you can defend it in a technical interview. REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS Your application must include: Resume/CV LinkedIn profile, if available Three SEO case studies with measurable results Supporting screenshots/data Answers to all seven questions above Examples of websites you've personally worked on Your expected hourly compensation in USD Your preferred working hours in Philippine Time IMPORTANT Applications that do not include case studies and measurable proof of previous SEO results will not be considered. Generic cover letters will not help you. Copying this job description into ChatGPT and submitting a perfect AI-generated response will not help you. We are going to ask you to demonstrate your knowledge live during the interview process. EDUCATION A bachelor's degree in marketing, computer science, information technology, communications, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Demonstrated ability and measurable results matter more to us than the name of your university. WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY Please don't apply if: Your SEO experience is primarily writing articles You primarily install SEO plugins and follow checklists You've never personally been responsible for measurable SEO results You cannot provide evidence of previous results You have no technical SEO knowledge You have no understanding of AI search/GEO You believe GEO simply means writing content with ChatGPT You aren't comfortable analyzing data You don't understand schema You cannot communicate clearly in English You need detailed instructions for every task You are uncomfortable learning rapidly You dislike automation because you believe it threatens traditional SEO work WHO WE WANT We're looking for the person who reads this job description and thinks: "Finally. This is where SEO is actually going." You should be analytical, technically curious, skeptical of easy answers, obsessed with measurable results, comfortable working with AI, and excited about helping build a new operating model rather than inheriting an old one. We aren't looking to fill a chair. We're looking for someone capable of helping us build the next generation of JAR's SEO and AI Search operation.

description: We are a short-term rental co-hosting company managing roughly 56 properties across 15 states. We operate under a co-hosting model — property owners retain their listings, reviews, and branding while we handle operations, guest experience, pricing, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting. We compete on quality, not quantity, and we onboard 1–2 new properties per month with a target of scaling to 200 properties by 2028. Onboarding is the foundation of every client relationship. A property that is onboarded correctly generates clean, stable operations for years. A property that is onboarded poorly generates ongoing friction that drains the entire operations team. We are hiring for an Onboarding & Listing Specialist who owns this function end-to-end. Role Mission Take every new property from signed contract to first booking in a defined, repeatable, high-quality process. You are the first operational touchpoint for every new owner and the architect of the conditions under which every other tea ---------- mber succeeds or struggles. Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like in 90 Days) • Time from signed contract to first live booking: under 21 days on 90%+ of new properties. • Owner satisfaction score on onboarding: 9/10 or higher measured via post-onboarding survey. • Zero listing errors at go-live — amenities, photos, pricing, house rules, and descriptions verified and correct. • Pricing strategy configured correctly on day one — dynamic pricing tools set up with appropriate base rates, seasonality, and event-based adjustments. • Full operational handoff document complete for every new property before go-live — cleaning, maintenance, guest experience, and pricing teams receive complete information. • Onboarding SOP maintained and improved quarterly based on what worked and what broke. Core Responsibilities Owner-Facing Onboarding • Conduct the kickoff call with every new owner — welcome, process walkthrough, expectations, timeline. • Collect all property-specific information: access, utilities, insurance, HOA rules, owner preferences, existing bookings to honor. • Set and manage owner expectations on timeline, pricing strategy, and what they can expect from Divergent through onboarding and beyond. • Serve as the primary contact for the owner during the onboarding period, then warm-handoff to ongoing management. Listing Build & Optimization • Build new listings on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking platforms (owner retains listing ownership in the co-hosting model). • Coordinate professional photography when needed; optimize photo order for conversion. • Write compelling listing titles, descriptions, house rules, and amenity tagging. • Verify all listing details against the actual property — amenities present, safety items in place, access instructions accurate. Pricing Setup • Configure dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or equivalent) with correct base rates, minimum stays, and seasonality curves. • Identify local events and demand patterns; configure event-based pricing rules. • Partner with the pricing lead on mid-term rental (MTR) strategy when applicable. • Set and document pricing assumptions so ongoing management can adjust as data comes in. Operational Handoff • Document everything the cleaning, maintenance, and guest experience teams need: supply PAR levels, cleaner assignment, maintenance vendors, guest communication templates, property-specific quirks. • Ensure the first cleaning, first inspection, and first supply order are complete before the first guest arrives. • Walk the ongoing management team through the property in a formal handoff meeting within the first 14 days. Process Improvement • Maintain and improve the onboarding SOP — what worked, what broke, what changed. • Build reusable templates, checklists, and automations that reduce onboarding time without reducing quality. • Report monthly on onboarding pipeline, time-in-process, and any bottlenecks. Required Experience & Skills • 2+ years of short-term rental operations experience — hands-on, not adjacent. • Demonstrated experience building or launching Airbnb, VRBO, or ---------- listings from scratch. • Working knowledge of a PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez). • Hands-on experience with a dynamic pricing tool (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond). • Strong written English and excellent spoken English — you will be on owner-facing calls. • Project management discipline — you can manage 3–5 simultaneous onboardings without dropping details. • Comfort with checklists, SOPs, and repeatable processes. Preferred (Not Required) • Prior experience in hospitality, property management, or client onboarding. • Experience with Breezeway, Slack, Salesmsg, and GetClearing. • Design eye for listing photos and descriptions. • SEO or listing optimization experience on major OTA platforms. Non-Negotiable Traits • Organizational discipline. You manage multiple onboardings without letting any slip. • Owner-facing confidence. You can hold a call with a $500K+ property owner and make them feel informed, respected, and confident in Divergent. • Process thinker. You build systems, not one-offs. • Ownership mindset. When onboarding breaks, your reflex is "how do I fix this and prevent it," not "who told me to do this." • Professionalism under owner pressure. Owners can be anxious during onboarding. You stay steady, clear, and solution-oriented. What We Offer • Competitive hourly rate for a qualified STR operator. • One of the most strategically important roles in the company — onboarding directly drives growth and retention. • Quarterly performance reviews with bonus opportunities. • Direct access to the owner (Nick) for strategic decisions. • Long-term role with growth potential as we scale to 200+ properties. • Professional development, coaching, and 1:1 time with leadership. Hiring Process 1. Resume and written application — confirm STR onboarding experience. 2. 2-minute Loom video introduction — walk us through a property you onboarded from scratch. 3. First interview (30 minutes) with Divergent leadership. 4. Paid trial project ($75–100): Draft a 5-step onboarding plan with timelines for a sample property, write the owner welcome email, and identify the top 3 risks for this specific property. 5. Reference checks — minimum 2 written references with specific questions. 6. Owner call with Nick — cultural fit and final decision. 7. 30-day paid trial starts.

title: Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role
job_title: Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role
description: # Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role ## READ THIS FIRST — BOTH PAID TEST VIDEOS ARE REQUIRED **You must complete BOTH paid test videos to be considered for this position.** There are **two required test videos**, and both must be completed. If you complete only one, your application will not be considered. Both test videos are paid whether or not you are ultimately hired. The tests are designed to evaluate: * Editing quality * Editing speed * English comprehension * Attention to detail * Ability to source your own assets * Understanding of American culture and internet references * Knowledge of current trends * Ability to follow instructions * Ability to make strong editing decisions independently If you are not willing to complete both test videos, please do not apply. I review completed tests as they arrive and interview strong applicants quickly. There is no fixed closing date. Once I find the right person, the position will be filled. --- ## POSITION **Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor** TikTok / Reels / Shorts --- ## TYPE / SALARY **Full Time** **Starting salary: $2,200 USD/month** Paid through Wise. This is the starting position, not the ceiling. There are several opportunities to move into **higher-paying and higher-responsibility positions** for people who consistently perform well. Raises and advancement are based on: * Editing quality * Speed * Output * Reliability * Communication * Understanding of the content * Ability to operate independently * Trend awareness * Ability to contribute ideas * Ability to take ownership of larger parts of the content operation * Leadership and management ability I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the business over the long term. --- ## SCHEDULE AND WORKLOAD This position requires **6–7 days of availability per week**. Normal working days are approximately **10 hours per day**. You must also be comfortable working **late-night hours in the Philippines and regularly working until approximately 3:00 AM PH time or later when needed**. This is necessary because the role requires significant overlap with U.S. working hours and because content needs to move quickly. Some days will be substantially heavier than others. During major content pushes, launches, high-performing trends, urgent projects, or other time-sensitive periods, you must be comfortable occasionally working **14–16 hour days** when necessary. This is a **high-volume operation**. You must be capable of completing **up to approximately 30–40 short-form videos in a day** when the format and workload require it. Not every day will require maximum output, and different video formats take different amounts of time, but you must have the speed, organization, and stamina necessary to handle extremely high-volume days without sacrificing quality. If you are looking for: * A strict 40-hour-per-week position * A Monday–Friday-only schedule * A fixed daytime schedule in the Philippines * A role where you completely disconnect after your scheduled shift this is probably **not the right position for you**. --- ## JOB DESCRIPTION I run TikTok pages that consistently reach millions of views and produce content at significant scale. I am looking for an editor who can eventually operate as much more than someone who simply follows instructions. You should understand what makes short-form content perform, recognize trends quickly, understand American internet culture, and develop strong instincts for what belongs on screen without needing every decision explained to you. Success in this role comes down to five things above everything else: **Editing quality. Speed. English comprehension. Cultural awareness. Responsiveness.** All five are extremely important. --- ## THE WORK You will primarily edit short-form vertical content including: * Talking-head videos * Voiceover/b-roll videos * Product-focused content * Commentary videos * Trend-driven videos * TikTok Shop content * Other fast-moving vertical formats Typical responsibilities include: * Cutting dead space so videos stay fast-paced * Stitching the strongest takes together seamlessly * Identifying which takes should be used without needing every selection made for you * Adding image overlays that support what is being said * Adding screenshots, comments, posts, website images, memes, and other visual assets * Using zooms, crops, reframes, and movement to keep the frame dynamic * Building b-roll sequences around voiceovers * Matching visuals to individual lines of a script * Finding your own visual assets when they are not provided * Knowing when an image, meme, celebrity photo, reaction, screenshot, or cultural reference makes sense * Reviewing your own exports before submission * Fixing obvious issues before sending work * Learning the brands, people, products, and content styles we work with * Following trends and identifying opportunities before they become outdated --- ## AMERICAN CULTURE, TRENDS, AND ENGLISH This is one of the most important requirements of the entire position. You must have **excellent English comprehension**. You need to understand not only the literal meaning of a sentence, but also: * Humor * Sarcasm * Tone * Slang * References * Internet terminology * American social-media culture * Celebrity culture * Influencer culture * College culture * Reality television references * TikTok trends * Memes * Viral moments * Current online conversations If a script references an American celebrity, viral TikTok moment, reality show, meme, brand, influencer controversy, cultural moment, or popular internet reference, I cannot stop production every time to explain what it means. You should either already understand it or be capable of researching it immediately. You must also be **extremely knowledgeable about current TikTok trends and American internet culture**. Following trends is part of the job. I want someone who naturally spends enough time online to understand: * What people are currently talking about * Which sounds are trending * Which creators are relevant * Which memes are circulating * Which stories are going viral * What visual styles are performing * Why certain content is gaining attention You should not need me to introduce you to every trend. --- ## SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS You must be highly self-sufficient. I will provide direction, scripts, footage, and context depending on the video, but I should not need to create a complete asset folder for every edit. You should be capable of: * Reading or listening to a script and determining what visual belongs with each line * Finding high-quality images of celebrities, influencers, products, brands, locations, and other subjects * Choosing visually strong images rather than simply using the first search result * Finding TikTok comments, Reddit posts, social posts, screenshots, articles, and other supporting material * Navigating brand websites and identifying which areas are worth showing * Taking clean screenshots * Finding relevant b-roll * Understanding which assets strengthen the story * Knowing when an asset is unnecessary * Placing every asset at the correct moment in the video You should be able to receive a script, voiceover, or raw video and independently determine what additional material is needed to make the finished edit engaging. --- ## COMMUNICATION AND RESPONSIVENESS Communication speed is **extremely important**. Short-form content moves quickly, and delays in communication can delay an entire content schedule. During your scheduled working hours, I expect responses to messages within approximately **30 minutes**. Outside of your scheduled working hours, while you are awake, I generally expect responses within approximately **one hour** when something comes up. You are not expected to wake up during normal sleeping hours specifically to respond. However, **once you wake up, you should check your messages immediately and respond to anything outstanding**. You should remain highly responsive throughout the day. This position is best suited for someone who naturally checks communications frequently and does not disappear for many hours without notice. If something prevents you from responding or working normally, communicate that immediately. --- ## WHO I'M LOOKING FOR I am looking for someone who is: ### Extremely detail-oriented You notice when: * A clip is held too long * An overlay is slightly misplaced * Subtitles are wrong * A crop looks awkward * An image does not match the sentence * A video feels slower than it should * Something simply does not look polished ### Fast Quality matters, but you must also be able to produce content at significant volume. ### Reliable If you say something will be completed, I should not have to repeatedly ask about it. ### Highly responsive You communicate quickly and clearly. ### Self-sufficient You solve normal editing and sourcing problems independently rather than waiting for detailed instructions. ### Extremely familiar with TikTok You understand: * Trends * Hooks * Pacing * Memes * Creators * Sounds * Visual styles * Viral formats * What currently performs ### Familiar with American culture You understand the references being made in the content without needing constant explanation. ### Strong in English You understand speech naturally enough to catch nuance, humor, sarcasm, tone, and context. ### Comfortable with direct feedback I give direct feedback. You must be able to apply it quickly and avoid repeatedly making the same mistake. ### Hard-working Some days are normal. Some days are extremely busy. You need to be comfortable with both. ### Interested in advancement I want someone who eventually wants more responsibility and significantly higher compensation. ### Long-term focused I am hiring someone I can build with over years, not someone looking for a short-term freelance project. --- ## EXCLUSIVITY This is a full-time position and should be treated as your primary professional commitment. Because of the workload and responsiveness required, you should **not be simultaneously managing multiple full-time clients, operating an editing agency, or subcontracting your assigned work to other editors**. I want the person hired to personally do the work and become deeply familiar with the pages. In exchange, you receive: * Stable monthly compensation * Consistent workload * Direct access to the person running the pages * Performance-based advancement * Opportunities for substantially higher-paying positions * Increased responsibility as you prove yourself * The ability to grow as the business grows --- ## REQUIREMENTS You must have: * Proven short-form editing experience * Experience editing TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or similar vertical content * CapCut or another editing program you can work extremely quickly in * Strong English comprehension * Strong understanding of American internet and pop culture * Strong knowledge of current TikTok trends * Ability to independently source images, screenshots, b-roll, comments, posts, and other assets * Strong visual judgment * Reliable high-speed internet * A computer capable of handling high-volume editing * Availability **6–7 days per week** * Ability to work approximately **10 hours per normal working day** * Ability and willingness to **regularly work until approximately 3:00 AM PH time or later when required** * Ability to occasionally work **14–16 hour days** * Ability to complete **up to approximately 30–40 videos in a high-volume day**, depending on video complexity * Ability to respond within approximately **30 minutes during working hours** * Ability to respond within approximately **one hour outside working hours while awake** * Ability to check and respond to outstanding communications promptly after waking up * Ability to receive payment through Wise * Ability to take direct feedback and apply it immediately * Ability to work independently without constant supervision * Long-term availability --- ## PAY AND GROWTH **Starting compensation: $2,200 USD/month.** This is **not the ceiling**. There are multiple opportunities to advance into substantially higher-paying positions for someone who consistently performs. I care much more about what you become capable of than how long you have worked here. Someone who demonstrates exceptional: * Editing ability * Speed * Reliability * Judgment * Leadership * Trend awareness * Communication * Understanding of the pages * Ability to manage responsibility can move into larger roles within the operation. The goal is to develop someone who eventually understands the content operation extremely well and contributes far beyond basic editing. --- ## HOW TO APPLY **Subject line:** **EDITOR — [number of the example video you think is hardest to edit]** Example: **EDITOR — 2** Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be reviewed. Please include: ### 1. Portfolio Send links to **2–3 short-form videos you personally edited**. For each video, explain exactly what you handled. If you edited only part of a video, say so. Accuracy matters more than trying to make your experience sound larger than it was. ### 2. Editing Evaluation In your own words and **without AI assistance**, watch example #3 and write **3–5 sentences** explaining: * One editing choice you think worked particularly well * One thing you would have approached differently * Why There is no predetermined correct answer. I want to understand how you evaluate content. ### 3. Background Tell me: * What editing software you use * How long you have used it * Your internet speed * Your typical available hours in Philippine time * Whether you currently have another job * Whether you currently have freelance clients * Why you are looking to leave your current work * How familiar you are with American TikTok and internet culture * Whether you are comfortable regularly working until **3:00 AM PH time or later** * Whether you are comfortable working **6–7 days per week** * Whether you are comfortable with occasional **14–16 hour workdays** ### 4. Trend Question Answer: **What American TikTok trend, meme, creator, celebrity story, or internet topic have you seen repeatedly in the last seven days? Explain it briefly and tell me why you think it became popular.** Do not research an answer specifically for this application. I want to see whether you naturally follow the same internet culture the content depends on. --- ## PAID TEST — YOU MUST COMPLETE BOTH VIDEOS To move forward in the hiring process, you must complete **BOTH paid test videos**. Completing only one test video will **not** qualify you for consideration. You will receive source material including: * Reference videos * Raw footage * Voiceovers * Editing instructions The test folders will intentionally **not contain every visual asset required**. Part of the test is determining what additional visuals are needed, finding those assets yourself, and placing them correctly. The two tests are designed to evaluate different aspects of the position. Together, they will be used to determine whether you move forward to an interview. The tests evaluate: * Editing quality * Editing speed * Attention to detail * English comprehension * Understanding of context * American cultural awareness * Trend knowledge * Visual judgment * Asset sourcing * Ability to follow instructions * Ability to work independently * Ability to make good decisions without being told exactly what to do **Both test videos are paid regardless of whether you are ultimately hired.** A strong performance on both test videos will be followed by a short interview and then a potential start date.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer — UK Agency — Long-term
job_title: Meta Ads Media Buyer — UK Agency — Long-term
description: I'm Leon — I run a Meta media buying operation for UK home-improvement trades (roofing, tree surgery, landscaping, driveways). I manage around 20 accounts myself and I'm scaling. title: Operations Virtual Assistant
description: JOB OPENING: OPERATIONS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT Company: Skyride Auto Services Employment Type: Part-Time (20–25 hours per week) Location: Remote (Must be available during U.S. business hours) About Skyride Auto Services Skyride Auto Services is a rapidly growing car rental company based in Columbus, Ohio, specializing in affordable and reliable vehicle rentals for rideshare and delivery drivers. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service, flexible rental options, and a seamless rental experience. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a motivated, professional, and customer-focused Operations Virtual Assistant to become an important part of our team. Position Overview As our Operations Virtual Assistant, you will play a key role in the day-to-day operations of our business. You will be one of the first points of contact for prospective and existing customers, communicating with customers over the phone, answering questions, following up on rental inquiries, scheduling reservations, and guiding customers through the rental process. In addition to customer communication, you will support administrative, operational, and customer service functions that help keep our business running efficiently. This is a part-time remote position (20–25 hours per week). Applicants must be available to work during U.S. business hours. Key Responsibilities * Customer Communication: Speak with prospective and existing customers by phone, answer questions, explain our rental program, and assist customers throughout the rental process. * Customer Follow-Up: Promptly follow up with rental inquiries, missed calls, and existing customers to provide exceptional customer service. * CRM Management: Manage and update customer information in GoHighLevel (or similar CRM), ensuring accurate records and seamless customer follow-ups. * Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries and resolve issues promptly via phone, text, email, and social media. * Reservation Management: Manage reservations, confirm bookings, and coordinate vehicle pick-up and return appointments. * Fleet Management: Track vehicle availability, coordinate maintenance schedules, and assist with fleet logistics to ensure vehicles are rental-ready. * Billing & Payments: Process rental payments, generate invoices, and maintain accurate payment and financial records. * Administrative Support: Perform data entry, organize documents, maintain rental agreements, and manage all rental records. * Scheduling: Coordinate customer appointments, vehicle maintenance, and other business-related schedules. * Social Media Management: Assist with social media posts, manage online listings, and respond to customer reviews and messages. * Customer Updates: Regularly communicate reservation updates, payment reminders, rental offers, and important company notices to customers. * Perform other administrative and operational duties as assigned to support the growth of the business. Qualifications * Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Customer Support Representative, Administrative Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role preferred. * Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. * Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone throughout the day. * Strong customer service and problem-solving skills. * Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. * Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work independently. * Experience using CRM software (GoHighLevel preferred). * Proficient with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and common communication tools. * Experience in the car rental, automotive, transportation, or rideshare industry is a plus, but not required. What We Offer * 100% Remote Position * Part-Time Employment (20–25 hours per week) * Competitive Pay * Opportunity for growth within a fast-growing company * Supportive and collaborative work environment * Long-term career opportunity with room for advancement How to Apply Please email the following to ---------- * Your resume * A short video introduction (2–3 minutes) * A brief cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit for this position. Subject Line: Operations Virtual Assistant Application We look forward to welcoming a motivated team member who is ready to grow with Skyride Auto Services!

title: QuickBooks Bookkeeper | Financial Organisation
description: I’m looking for a reliable and experienced **Bookkeeper / Finance Manager** who is highly familiar with **QuickBooks** and can take responsibility for keeping my business finances organized and up to date. Responsibilities * Manage and maintain bookkeeping in QuickBooks * Categorize transactions correctly * Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other accounts * Keep income and expenses properly organized * Maintain accurate financial records * Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable * Identify unusual expenses, discrepancies, or missing transactions * Keep the books clean and ready for my accountant/tax advisor * Help create a clear financial structure for the business Weekly Financial Reporting Every week, I want a simple and easy-to-understand financial report covering: * Revenue * Expenses * Profit / Loss * Cash flow * Current cash position * Outstanding payments / liabilities * Major expenses from the week * Comparison to previous weeks * Any financial issues or things I should be aware of The goal is for me to be able to quickly understand **where the business stands financially every week without having to go through QuickBooks myself. Requirements * Strong experience with **QuickBooks / QuickBooks Online** * Previous bookkeeping experience for businesses * Strong understanding of P&L, cash flow, balance sheets, and general accounting * Very organized and detail-oriented * Able to communicate financial information in simple language * Reliable with weekly reporting and deadlines * Comfortable proactively pointing out problems or opportunities instead of only entering transactions When Applying Please include: 1. Your experience with QuickBooks 2. What types of businesses you have handled bookkeeping for 3. An example of what your weekly financial report would include 4. How you normally organize a company's bookkeeping and financial reporting 5. Your availability and expected monthly rate I’m looking for someone long-term who can eventually become the person I rely on to keep the financial side of the business organized, accurate, and easy to understand.

title: Real Estate Data Research & List Cleaning VA
job_title: Real Estate Data Research & List Cleaning VA
description: I’m looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help with data research and list preparation for a U.S.-based real estate investment business. The main responsibility will be reviewing public records and property information, identifying the correct people and property details, and organizing everything accurately in Google Sheets. Typical tasks will include: Reviewing courthouse and public-record information Researching property owners, heirs, executors, and related parties Checking property information using county/property websites Cleaning and organizing foreclosure, probate, and other real estate lead lists Removing duplicate or irrelevant records Entering information accurately into Google Sheets Following written instructions and Loom training videos Flagging anything unclear instead of guessing You do not need extensive real estate experience. I will provide training and step-by-step instructions. I care more about accuracy, reliability, attention to detail, and your ability to follow a process. Requirements: Strong attention to detail Comfortable using Google Sheets Good internet research skills Able to follow detailed instructions Good written English Reliable internet connection Comfortable learning new websites and processes Willing to ask questions when something is unclear This will start as a part-time position of approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the opportunity for more hours and responsibilities over time for the right person. I am looking for someone who can potentially work with me long term. To apply: Start your application with the word ORANGE so I know you read the full job post. Then answer these questions: What experience do you have with data entry, web research, Google Sheets, or real estate? If you are researching a record and the information is unclear, what would you do? What hours are you normally available to work? What is your desired hourly rate?
